Entries.Title: Sebelum Senja Berakhir
Entries.Description: The demonstration against the eviction of the Harmonie Damai nursing home reunites Sendja and Sundari, two old friends who are now separated by betrayal and are struggling and tracing old memories.

Entries.Title: ROH/CMLL Global Wars Mexico
Entries.Description: ROH/CMLL Global Wars Mexico was a professional wrestling event promoted by Ring of Honor (ROH) and Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) and took place June 18, 2025 at Arena Mexico in Mexico City, Mexico.

Entries.Title: Psychic Storm
Entries.Description: New disaster film from Brett Bentman. Plot TBA

Entries.Title: An Evening With Elton John and Brandi Carlile
Entries.Description: Musicians Elton John and Brandi Carlile perform songs from their new album and some of their greatest hits at the London Palladium, and the two close friends also have an intimate chat with actor and fellow friend Dan Levy.

Entries.Title: The Secret Lives of Bill Bartell
Entries.Description: Bill Bartell was a multifaceted individual who traversed the punk rock scene, law enforcement, rodeo riding, and country music. Known for his unique contribution to punk rock through his label Gasatanka Records and band White Flag, Bartell's life defies conventional boundaries, blending hyper-masculinity with subcultural rebellion. His story, filled with mysterious and seemingly contradictory roles, offers a compelling narrative about identity, transformation, and the unexpected paths life can take.

Entries.Title: Saturday Night's Main Event XXXIX
Entries.Description: WWE Saturday Night's Main Event 39 is scheduled for May 24, 2025 at Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida.

Entries.Title: Editorial
Entries.Description: Fashion lifestyle editorial. With a twist.

Entries.Title: Before You
Entries.Description: 14:27  min | Drama | USA  Looking back on her first pregnancy, a woman navigates the echoes of a life-changing loss.  Before You follows a couple in the wake of a decision they never thought they’d have to make: ending a planned pregnancy. With restrained storytelling and emotional honesty, the film explores the intimate—and often invisible—grief of pregnancy loss. It reframes the narrative around abortion, moving beyond politics to illuminate the personal and complex truths of reproductive experience.  Starring Tony-nominated actress Tala Ashe, Before You speaks to the silent grief that touches countless families, offering space for empathy, reflection, and healing.  IN SOLIDARITY WITH  The Planned Parenthood Federation of America, Inc.

Entries.Title: Yours, C Tour Documentary
Entries.Description: On the Yours, C Tour, Camila Cabello reconnects with her fans, her music, and herself. An intimate look at her return to the stage and the joy of performing again.

Entries.Title: Gush
Entries.Description: A traumatized horror novelist is visited by a mysterious mute woman at a solitary writing retreat.

Entries.Title: Mountain Friends
Entries.Description: A new short film from Jon Millstein and Jon Mackey.

Entries.Title: Someone Loves You
Entries.Description: “Someone Loves You” is a narrative short film following the estranged members of a Jamaican family in New York City, as they cope with the slowly declining health of their once-famous artist, beloved matriarch.

Entries.Title: Please Don't Destroy LIVE
Entries.Description: For our last tour, we had a camera rolling the entire time. We independently filmed a bunch of our live shows and backstage pieces along the way hoping to make something cool - a hybrid documentary and comedy special like the ones we loved growing up. It’s finally here! We hope you enjoy!

Entries.Title: Brand New Cadillac
Entries.Description: A short about a vampire mother and her serial killer daughter.

Entries.Title: Barrio Triste
Entries.Description: On the outskirts of Medellín, Colombia in the late 1980s, local residents report strange lights descending from the sky. When a reporter arrives to investigate, a ragtag group of teens from a lawless neighbourhood storm the scene and steal his camera. In the hands of its new owners, the device records a mesmerising plunge into their frantic existence.

Entries.Title: On Trial: The Idaho College Killer
Entries.Description: Uncover how Bryan Kohberger's heinous act gripped social media and shook the nation, with new police body cam footage and family testimony.

Entries.Title: Shock & Awe: Trump's Return
Entries.Description: A look at Donald Trump's second term of Presidency and how it has affected United States society.

Entries.Title: Skillhouse
Entries.Description: Ten influencers are lured into a sinister content house and forced to compete in lethal social media challenges — because in Skillhouse, clout isn’t just currency, it’s survival.

Entries.Title: Mobius Loop
Entries.Description: Senna is a scientist seeking to perfect a mind-jumping time-travel project. Upon finding a VHS tape that compels her to delve into her family's past, she uncovers the key to her research, but in doing so suffers deadly consequences.

Entries.Title: Her/Mine
Entries.Description: Traces the life of director Alexandra Shiva’s late mother, Susan, an actress and travel agent, and the daughter of Hollywood mogul Jules C. Stein. As the filmmaker sifts through her mom’s belongings, including a trove of 16mm footage, she pieces together the traces of a childhood shaped by privilege, loss, and longing.

Entries.Title: A Blood Moon Rising
Entries.Description: A young alchemist struggles to resurrect the old west town of Celeb's Folly but in doing so, finds his family now in jeopardy. As tensions build, the Blood Moon Rises, accompanied by the howling of wolves and the promise of bloodshed.

Entries.Title: I Do Without You
Entries.Description: Newly engaged and totally friendless, Amelia decides to ask her high school ex-BFF to be her maid of honor: who she hasn't talked to in 10 years, and whose crush she stole back in the day... She'll probably be so excited to see her too!

Entries.Title: bratchella: Charli XCX live at Coachella 2025
Entries.Description: Charli XCX live concert for Coachella with special guests Troye Sivan, Lorde and Billie Eilish.

Entries.Title: Nuns vs. The Vatican
Entries.Description: Explores a scandal growing within the Catholic Church.

Entries.Title: Don't Tell Larry
Entries.Description: After lying to her new eccentric coworker Larry about a company party, an ambitious corporate flunky must deal with the deadly consequences.

Entries.Title: dont.4get2smile
Entries.Description: After receiving a chilling call about a classmate's unexpected death, a social-media-obsessed teen is followed by a mysterious account. Worried that it's all connected, she begins to fear that the account's reach extends far beyond the limits of her phone screen.

Entries.Title: Match in a Haystack
Entries.Description: When Russia invaded, the women of Ukraine's leading contemporary dance group struggled to find purpose in their work. A search for new forms of resistance ultimately led them back to dance.

Entries.Title: Stealing Pulp Fiction
Entries.Description: Three friends along with their therapist plan a heist to steal Quentin Tarantino's personal print of Pulp Fiction from his movie theater.

Entries.Title: Closed Doors
Entries.Description: An estranged couple are closed off from each other.

Entries.Title: Planning New York
Entries.Description: Two men (Bowen Yang and Michael Longfellow) imagine and plan out New York City.

Entries.Title: Jungle Beat 2: The Past
Entries.Description: The animals from the African jungle fall through a time portal that the aliens forgot to close behind them. To return to the future, friends will need the help of dinosaurs. But the ancient lizards have their own problems. After all, their world is about to be invaded by cave aliens armed with clubs.

Entries.Title: Hat Trick
Entries.Description: A grieving magician must continue the legacy of her infamous father at a bizarre children's birthday party.

Entries.Title: Strangers in the Same Shirt
Entries.Description: At their father's 3rd wedding, estranged siblings Matt & Haley struggle to connect after years apart. Haley faces relationship issues and Matt’s abrasive nature only makes things worse. Eventually Matt sincerely apologizes and supports Haley in addressing her romantic feelings. Haley, in turn supports Matt’s nature by de-escalating tension between him and their father by playing a song from Matt's band. In the end there is hope for a future between them.

Entries.Title: D(e)AD
Entries.Description: Tillie, a floundering young woman and her charismatic, alcoholic father, struggle to resolve their fractured relationship in the weirdest possible way: after he dies, his ghost appears in mirrors to haunt everyone in the family but Tillie. Tillie’s family must do everything they can to make Tillie see her father or else they will be plagued by this ghost forever.

Entries.Title: Birdsong
Entries.Description: In the confines of an eerily perfect apartment, Bird, trapped and alone for decades, encounters Silesia, a charismatic neighbor. Bird's only way out of the apartment is to fall in love with Silesia and leave her to be the apartment's new muse and victim. Birdsong is a haunting, heartbreaking, retro-cinematic time loop experience in a magical, twisted apartment that asks the ethical question of choosing love or personal freedom when time is never on your side.

Entries.Title: Sabu
Entries.Description: “SABU” is an intimate documentary that follows the enigmatic career of professional wrestler Sabu as he seeks closure in his storied life—a final match. From his tumultuous upbringing under the influence of The Sheik to the electrifying days of ECW, Sabu reflects on his evolution as a performer and the extreme style that defined his legacy. The film captures the highs and lows of his journey, including personal challenges, injuries, and the emotional turmoil that shaped him both inside and outside the ring.

Entries.Title: Strange Journey: The Story of Rocky Horror
Entries.Description: A wild journey into the origins of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, the biggest cult film of all time, its impact on popular culture and socio-political resonance to this day.

Entries.Title: I'll Never Let You Go
Entries.Description: Emily, a successful art gallery director, spirals into emotional turmoil after an impulsive affair with a mysterious Italian artist, Carlo. As she grapples with empty nest syndrome and a strained marriage, her husband Tom must confront the truth of her betrayal. Carlo’s charm soon reveals a darker, more dangerous side.

Entries.Title: Dusty Slay: Wet Heat
Entries.Description: Known for his laid-back Southern charm and razor-sharp wit, Slay is back following his successful 2024 debut Workin’ Man. If you love storytelling with a hilarious twist and a splash of retro flair, this one’s a must-watch.

Entries.Title: The Business of Trouble
Entries.Description: Survivors, a former caregiver, and an investigator reveal systemic abuse and demand accountability from the private equity companies behind the multibillion-dollar Troubled Teen Industry that exploits vulnerable youth under the guise of care.

Entries.Title: Love Survive The Lie
Entries.Description: After a passionate night between Shea Lacy and Ian Jurd, Shea's sister, Gigi Lacy, impersonates her as Ian's one-night stand partner. Six years later, Shea becomes Ian's legal counsel, and over time, they fall in love. Fearing that Shea might take her place as Ian's lover, Gigi frequently attempts to sabotage their relationship. However, Ian always intervenes just in time, preventing Shea from suffering any harm or misunderstanding.

Entries.Title: The Situation Room
Entries.Description: In the midst of an international crisis, President Bennett has less than 10 minutes to authorize a nuclear strike. But with incomplete intelligence and opposing views from his advisors, he must make a choice that will shape the world forever.

Entries.Title: Is It a Crime?
Entries.Description: Helen, with her husband's blessings, rents their guest house to a business man, Derrick, and they all get more than what they bargained for.

Entries.Title: Other People's Bodies
Entries.Description: A queer reimagining of the French classic La Piscine, in which four former friends and lovers reunite on a hot summer weekend, reigniting long-simmering passions, grievances, and regrets. Olivia, a modern dancer, is vacationing with her husband, Seb, at a secluded country house, when they are paid an unexpected visit by Olivia’s former best friend and, briefly Seb’s lover, Mateo, whose own dance career ended after a serious injury. They haven’t seen or heard from one other in eight years since Mateo cut Olivia and Seb off after a painful betrayal. Adding to this emotionally fraught reunion, Mateo brings along his young and very sexy lover, Zaki. When two more former dance colleagues, Gabriella and her husband and Fabian, Olivia’s lover before Seb, pay a surprise visit, everyone’s romantic and sexual pasts, and desires, collide.

Entries.Title: Bury 'Em Deep
Entries.Description: A violent gunslinger sees visions of Hell and decides that in order to redeem himself he'll give his ill-gotten loot to save a beautiful nun's orphanage. But when he is ambushed and left for dead, he sets out on a trail of vengeance.

Entries.Title: Red Plague
Entries.Description: Following the sudden and traumatic loss of his family in the early days of a virulent plague, Carter retreats into the desert, hiding away from what remains of the world. But when a lost girl arrives at his door seeking help, he must confront old wounds and find a way to finally heal... Or bleed out.

Entries.Title: Ali Eats America
Entries.Description: 17-year-old Ali Allouche, who is battling cancer, binges on food shows during his chemo treatments. Inspired by Anthony Bourdain’s "Parts Unknown," Ali plots a cross-country adventure to visit innovative chefs and immerse himself in America’s rich food culture.

Entries.Title: Ask E. Jean
Entries.Description: Chronicles E. Jean Carroll's life, trailblazing work and legal battles.

Entries.Title: DOORS
Entries.Description: Film adaptation of the popular Roblox horror game 'DOORS'.

Entries.Title: On TV: A Black History Month
Entries.Description: Experience a celebration of Black excellence in TV and honor the pioneering legends who transformed the entertainment landscape.

Entries.Title: The R.I.P Man
Entries.Description: A serial killer with a dental condition targets teenagers in a wealthy town. A detective tries to identify and understand the murderer's motives. A young man confronts his past to stop the grisly killings.

Entries.Title: Depart from It
Entries.Description: An old friend's death forces now escort and drug carrier Alexes Mows to go back to her hometown and face a past that she has tried to leave behind. But when secret demons catch up with her, she must make a decision between life and death.

Entries.Title: Triplets Baby
Entries.Description: Nathan Foad ('Our Flag Means Death'), Saskia Chana ('The Bisexual') and Vahid Gold ('Emerald City') star in 'Triplets Baby', written and directed by Nathan Foad, produced by Lulu Baker for Balloon Entertainment ('Newark, Newark', 'Champion', 'Clique').

Entries.Title: Existential Risk
Entries.Description: Existential Risk is a film about the possibility of human extinction or civilizational collapse, as these questions (and others) are grappled with in Cambridge, England. A personal documentary in which the filmmaker's own existential crisis (micro) is contrasted with planetary risk (macro).

Entries.Title: Soul of A Sister
Entries.Description: A singer with a once bright future falls victim to the music business at a young age. A decade later, despite an addiction and depression she rises up one more time with the help of a special friend and her God given gift of voice.

Entries.Title: The Sun Gazer: Cinta Dari Langit
Entries.Description: Moyer, a man who faces an identity crisis after divorcing his wife, Asiyah, due to hereditary problems.Moyer, a man who faces an identity crisis after divorcing his wife, Asiyah, due to hereditary problems.

Entries.Title: Dora the Explorer: Mermaid Adventures
Entries.Description: Dive into a majestic mermaid world with Dora! After playing a magical charango, Dora and Boots turn into mermaids and go on a series of mer-mazing underwater adventures with their new friend, Marisol the Mermaid and her dolphin bestie Rosa!

Entries.Title: House of Abraham
Entries.Description: A woman looking for an end to her suffering, checks in to the House of Abraham, home to a mysterious cult that promises a way out. She soon discovers all is not what it seems and must plan an escape before it's too late.

Entries.Title: The Brooklyn Butcher
Entries.Description: As the city cowers in fear of a deranged serial killer, the residents of one Brooklyn apartment building learn new meanings of the word fear as they each encounter their own personal horrors.

Entries.Title: Felipe Esparza: Raging Fool
Entries.Description: In a furiously funny special, Felipe Esparza riffs on his tough-love Mexican mom, keeping a marriage spicy and why dairy is more dangerous than drugs.

Entries.Title: The Italians
Entries.Description: A young Italian man brings his new girlfriend home to his eccentric family.

Entries.Title: Z! The Magical Girl
Entries.Description: Zatanna Zatara’s origin is explained in this feature length continuation of Max Landis’ Kryptonian Epic. It is the longest piece of visual media dedicated to the character in the history of DC.

Entries.Title: Niimi
Entries.Description: An Indigenous ballerina attempts to reignite her passion for dancing following a traumatic incident with her previous coach.

Entries.Title: Where Heroes Die
Entries.Description: During Word War II, an Air Corps pilot must rescue a group of POWS on a German island before the Invasion of Normandy.

Entries.Title: Santa's Never Been to My House
Entries.Description: A cynical Jewish teenager survives a Christmas dinner at a family friend's house, navigating the eccentric people across the table and his own Jewish identity.

Entries.Title: Dreams in the Attic
Entries.Description: Eccentric Aunt Nellie (Shelley Duvall) has a magical trunk in her attic at the costume shop that she owns. Costumes that are placed in the trunk possess the ability to fulfill the "dreams" of those who wear them.

Entries.Title: I Wish You All the Best
Entries.Description: A non-binary teen is kicked out of their North Carolina home after coming out to their ultra-religious parents. As a result, they move in with their estranged sister and her husband. Though the two are welcoming, they continue to struggle with anxiety further exacerbated by their parents' rejection. As such, they try to keep a low profile at school. However, after they meet a proudly bisexual classmate, their life begins to look a little more hopeful.

Entries.Title: The Perfect Destiny
Entries.Description: Dazed and heartbroken, Alice pieces together the memories of life with her late husband into new memories with the unexpected love she finds in New York City.

Entries.Title: Thick Skin
Entries.Description: Desperate to lose weight, a young woman grapples with the ravenous demons eating her up inside.

Entries.Title: Ed Kemper
Entries.Description: The horrifying true story of Ed Kemper, a cunning and sadistic serial killer shaped by childhood abuse, whose charm masked his grotesque obsession with murder, mutilation, and the ultimate act of revenge on his mother.

Entries.Title: Agoge
Entries.Description: Placed in detention after a physical altercation on the school playground, two teenage boys find their developing friendship challenged by the limits of their emotional honesty.

Entries.Title: ENHYPEN VR CONCERT: IMMERSION
Entries.Description: A groundbreaking VR concert film featuring ENHYPEN, filmed in 12K ultra-HD with immersive visuals and interactive fan experiences, premiering worldwide in August 2025.

Entries.Title: Zedd: Live at Coachella 2025, Weekend 2
Entries.Description: Probably the biggest pull at the Outdoor Theatre was for electronic producer Zedd. During weekend one, there was a revolving door of guests such as John Mayer and Maren Morris, but weekend two might have been even bigger.

Entries.Title: Toxoplasma
Entries.Description: In the aftermath of his father's death, a young man navigates a developing relationship with a brain-eating parasite.

Entries.Title: My Boyfriend's Wife Is Dead
Entries.Description: After a tough divorce, Lena enters into a throuple with glamorous couple Iris and Dean for some fun. But when Iris is murdered, all eyes are on Lena. She fights to prove her innocence, but is the real killer closer to home than she thinks?

Entries.Title: MMA Cop
Entries.Description: When a beautiful journalist pursues a story on a child sex trafficking operation, she becomes hunted by assassins. Her only hope? A rogue, wisecracking detective with a penchant for violence.

Entries.Title: Hearts Around the Table: Kiki's Fourth Ingredient
Entries.Description: Kiki is overjoyed and then overwhelmed when she agrees to cater to a big wedding. She turns to Clay for support. Together, Kiki and Clay prove that they best ingredient is love.

Entries.Title: The Cinefile Siege
Entries.Description: AI short by Damon Packard based on the infamous Batman Forever cancelled screening that was due to take place at Cinefile Video on May 29, which made big news.

Entries.Title: ​Tell Me Something
Entries.Description: In an investigation into the inevitability of relationships, two people revisit the scene of a first date.

Entries.Title: The Corpse Grinders
Entries.Description: Landau, the young owner of "Lotus Cat Food", is struggling to keep the company alive as business is worse than expected. Landau is broke and down on his luck and can no longer afford to pay his employees. Because of this, he starts to kill one of his employees every couple of days. Gradually, more people disappear until the police become involved in the case. One of the missing persons, Frank, has an overprotective girlfriend, Tessie, who sets out in search for him. Tessie follows the leads all the way back to "Lotus Cat Food" and its sinister truths.

Entries.Title: Dolphin Summer
Entries.Description: Aspiring marine biologist, Sarah, seizes a chance to intern at the Abaco Island Marine Sanctuary. Sarah, her friends, and the town launch a live-streaming 'Dolphin Discovery' show to save the sanctuary.

Entries.Title: The Dream Machine
Entries.Description: A widow joins an advanced virtual reality program to cope with her loss, but her journey through simulated dreams takes an unforeseen turn that challenges her grip on reality.

Entries.Title: Secret Mall Apartment
Entries.Description: In 2003, eight Rhode Islanders created a secret apartment inside a busy mall and lived there for four years, filming everything along the way. Far more than a prank, the secret apartment became a deeply meaningful place for all involved.

Entries.Title: Ari Shaffir: America's Sweetheart
Entries.Description: Comedian Ari Shaffir tackles controversial topics like terrorism, gun violence, racism, and more in his stand-up special. With a darkly humorous approach, he explores unexpected perspectives on sensitive social and political issues.

Entries.Title: Meat
Entries.Description: After a night of drugs and debauchery results in the fatal overdose of an underage gay man, an innocent bystander is left to take the blame. Upon his release from prison, the guilty party becomes the focus of an eccentric killers revenge.

Entries.Title: Arman
Entries.Description: Feeling overwhelmed and isolated on the day of his wedding, Arman, a gay, closeted immigrant, has to lie to his family on the phone about his marriage in the U.S. Moments before walking down the aisle, he is uncertain how to move forward.

Entries.Title: The Mute
Entries.Description: When a high-school principal hears of an encroaching threat, an escaped convict who has been somehow silently breaking into teenage girls' homes in the night, he becomes overly protective of one of his closest students.

Entries.Title: Bloodstained Ivory
Entries.Description: In his final year of music school, an aspiring concert pianist goes to extreme lengths that slowly destroy his relationships and end in violence.

Entries.Title: Shari & Lamb Chop
Entries.Description: Shari Lewis was a dancer, singer, and magician but is best known as the ventriloquist behind sock puppets Charlie Horse, Hush Puppy and, of course, Lamb Chop. This lively doc charts the life, loves, and career hits and misses of this spunky perfectionist, who forever changed the face of children’s television.

Entries.Title: Why We Dream
Entries.Description: When a group of centenarian WWII veterans pilgrimage to Normandy, France to commemorate the anniversary of D-Day, we witness how these landscapes, scarred by war and frozen in time, unlock memories of the lives lost and lived thereafter.

Entries.Title: Get Lucky
Entries.Description: Tim and Cathryn are a couple in their early 40's. They haven't really gotten anywhere in life - no career, no college, no direction, no ambition and no kids... And now that the biological clock is ticking they have decided that the most important thing for them is to have a baby.  In a desperate bid to save their dream of parenthood, Tim secretly agrees to drive the getaway car for a bank robbery to raise the money for IVF. But chaos ensues when Cathryn calls demanding he come home immediately to try to conceive. Tim faces an impossible choice: fulfill his promise as the getaway driver or rush home to keep their baby-making schedule.

Entries.Title: Dark My Light
Entries.Description: Mitchell Morse's investigation into a serial killer in a sleepy beach town is complicated by a severed foot on the beach, his fracturing relationship with his wife, and his own slipping sanity.

Entries.Title: Adventure - Deep Water Solo
Entries.Description: Scale the craggy seaside cliffs of Mallorca, Spain, with world-class climber Kai Lightner as he makes a risky free-solo ascent on Cova del Diablo.

Entries.Title: Igniting the Spark – The Story of Magic: The Gathering
Entries.Description: A documentary exploring the influence of the world's most popular collectible card game and chronicling its history since the 1993 release.

Entries.Title: Title Fight
Entries.Description: When Avtar Bhullar immigrates to British Columbia, he faces systemic racism and physical intimidation—his answer: Kushti, a traditional Indian form of wrestling. Determined to protect his son from the same fate, Avtar trains a young Arjan Singh Bhullar in Kushti. Fast forward to 2021—Arjan, now a Commonwealth Games Gold Medalist, prepares to challenge Brandon Vera for the ONE FC World Heavyweight Title. But this is more than a fight—it’s a battle for identity, pride, and the hopes of two nations: Canada and India. Featuring exclusive commentary from Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, Ariel Helwani, Daniel Cormier, and Russell Peters, Title Fight is a deeply human story about heritage, resilience, and triumph.

Entries.Title: FEEL
Entries.Description: This avant-garde film is a stained glass window of emotion. 28 different people's feelings are woven into an emotional time capsule that will never exist again. A multi-dimensional bottle of feelings and time and art captured in a film.

Entries.Title: The Final Play
Entries.Description: A former pro basketball player embarks on a heartfelt and comedic journey to find love and fulfillment, discovering that winning in the game of life means facing his fears and making his ultimate final play.

Entries.Title: Medusa
Entries.Description: After a young Swedish perfumer is stung by a jellyfish in the South of France, an attractive older man comes to her aid.

Entries.Title: Haunted House of Pancakes
Entries.Description: On Halloween night an evil waffle maker transforms all the food in a sleazy diner into killer creatures out for revenge against the patrons.

Entries.Title: Lost Cause
Entries.Description: Actors workshop an allegorical and fictional new musical for an audience of one, who holds the fate of the play in her hands.

Entries.Title: Carrie Underwood: Reflection
Entries.Description: A showcase of Underwood's greatest hits from her nearly 20-year career as an award-winning artist, utilizing extravagant production elements like special effects, pyrotechnics, and state-of-the-art visuals and audio technology.

Entries.Title: Metallica: Polar Beach Party
Entries.Description: Recorded live at the Polar Beach Party, Tuktoyaktuk, Canada on September 3, 1995.

Entries.Title: 120 Days of Sodom Literally
Entries.Description: Experimental film that is literally 120 days long.

Entries.Title: John Bishop: Live From New York
Entries.Description: Latest Stand Up special from John Bishop recorded in New York at The Comedy Cellar on January 21st, 2025.

Entries.Title: Wait, Your Car?
Entries.Description: The friendship of four girls is put to the test after one of them claims her car is literally trying to kill her.

Entries.Title: Garbage People The Movie
Entries.Description: When Patches and Peel discover AI replicas have replaced them on their TV show, and the entire dumpster town of Trash has been taken over by artificial imposters, they embark on an epic journey to destroy the AI mainframe.

Entries.Title: Heartbreak, Coffee, and A Pack of Cigarettes
Entries.Description: An anthology film surrounding the fictional Lighthouse Diner, Heartbreak, Coffee, and a Pack of Cigarettes, explores the complications of love through various vignettes within the confines of a classic American diner.

Entries.Title: Miss You After Goodbye
Entries.Description: A downtrodden man decides to break away from a wife who doesn't love him and embark on a better life. As he plans his exit, she gradually realises just how much he cared for her.

Entries.Title: Memorizing Alison
Entries.Description: A man with an extraordinary but failing memory tries to solve the mystery of what happened to a woman killed by a hit-and-run driver.

Entries.Title: Shakey Grounds
Entries.Description: An aspiring musician coping with the death of his best friend finds purpose when a disgraced record label executive unexpectedly visits his hometown.

Entries.Title: Queerbait
Entries.Description: A precocious classics student piques the interest of his tenured professor. But when his mentorship starts to push boundaries, he's forced to make a choice: protect his academic future, or protect his dignity?

Entries.Title: The Street Avenger
Entries.Description: When a young girl being raised by a single father loses him to gang violence she turns to law enforcement but they are no help. She tries to take the law into her own hands and finds out being a vigilante

Entries.Title: Intravenus
Entries.Description: A young woman is trapped in a bizarre medical university that's run by a deranged eugenicist. With no memory of how or why she was even enrolled, her attempts to seek answers instead unearths a disturbed secret that is practically hidden in plain sight.

Entries.Title: Ralph Barbosa: Planet Bosa
Entries.Description: Ralph Barbosa shares his adventures in dating, controlling his temper, working on cars, and his views on current events.

Entries.Title: Abducted in the Everglades
Entries.Description: A college student disappears during Spring Break in Miami, her mother embarks on a desperate search. Aided by a local boatman, they brave the treacherous wilderness, facing unforeseen dangers as they urgently seek to unravel the mystery.

Entries.Title: Everything to Me
Entries.Description: A girl raised in Silicon Valley in the shadow of Steve Jobs' successful return to Apple, and his huge influence on her imagination, her aspirations and relationships.

Entries.Title: One Girl Infinite
Entries.Description: Two teenage girls, Yin Jia and Tong Tong, live together in this colour-drenched vision of Changsha, China. When Tong Tong drifts away and falls in with a drug dealer, Yin Jia’s love for her means she’ll risk everything to keep Tong Tong by her side.

Entries.Title: The Snitch
Entries.Description: After doing the right thing, a 10-year-old is cast as the snitch everyone’s hunting. Caught between guilt and defiance, she walks a tightrope of peer pressure and self-doubt in this semi-biopic of awakening.

Entries.Title: Three Bad Girls Who Find a Gun and Become Vampires
Entries.Description: In writer/director Christopher R. Mihm's ode to "teensploitation" films of the 1950s and the cinematic oeuvre of the Coen Brothers, three female juvenile delinquents obtain a firearm and, just for the thrill of it, start robbing the fine folks of New Berlin. Unfortunately, their crime spree takes an unexpected turn after they mug and nearly murder the gambling-addicted pastor of the local church—who turns out to be an immortal, blood-sucking creature of the night! Hijinks ensue when the vampiric padre hires a pair of hitmen to help him retrieve his stolen cash and seek revenge against the three bad girls responsible!

Entries.Title: I'll Be Home for National Margarita Day
Entries.Description: When a big-city developer threatens a town holiday tradition, exes Liz and Sam must team up to stop him.

Entries.Title: MAMA
Entries.Description: Leila, a 28 year old Syrian American woman, anxiously awaits the outcome of her mother’s immigration interview in a hotel room that is meant to be their meeting place if her mother is approved to enter the US.

Entries.Title: Death Letter Blues
Entries.Description: A priest with wavering faith investigates the puzzling death of a local legend known as "Feral Boy," discovering eerie links to his personal demons.

Entries.Title: UnBroken
Entries.Description: The daughter of a Holocaust survivor embarks on an international quest to uncover answers about the plight of her mother and her six siblings who, as mere children, escaped Nazi Germany relying solely on their own youthful bravado and the kindness of German strangers.

Entries.Title: Noah's Arc: The Movie
Entries.Description: Noah and Wade are expecting twins and must shift gears when each is offered their dream job, forcing one of them to assume the traditional stay-at-home parental role...only which one? What gift can life give the man who has everything? The answer is drama – and tons of it!

Entries.Title: The River of Lethe
Entries.Description: When an elderly man and his caretaker plant a sapling, a ghost of long-forgotten grief stirs. As the silence deepens between them, what’s left unspoken threatens to shatter the peace.

Entries.Title: President Trump the First 100 Days: The Interview in the Oval Office
Entries.Description: In his first broadcast interview marking 100 days in office for his second term, President Trump sits down with ABC News Senior national correspondent Terry Moran in the Oval Office.

Entries.Title: The Demon Car of Proctor Valley Road
Entries.Description: Out on their first date, high-schoolers Brett and Erica defy Erica's father's warnings about mysterious local legends, and take the infamous Proctor Valley Road shortcut home, risking their lives as they end up in a race for survival.

Entries.Title: Minding Your Business
Entries.Description: Desperate to get back to New York, Rachel Carver strikes a deal with her family's sworn enemy, business superstar Jacob Rush. However, their families' bitter rivalry threatens to derail everything.

Entries.Title: The Taming of Andrea
Entries.Description: This is an odd movie about a girl who is thrown out by her boyfriend. Her first night of being homeless attracts the attention of a kind stranger who earns her trust, and then a nightmare begins.

Entries.Title: Method
Entries.Description: On the chaotic set of Tapeface 3, visionary but unhinged director Derek Ryan is determined to make his masterpiece-no matter the cost. But when members of the cast and crew start disappearing, whispers spread that Derek and his brooding lead actor have taken their obsession with authenticity too far. As paranoia grips the dwindling team, cameras keep rolling-capturing a twisted descent into method acting at its most lethal.

Entries.Title: Project Barbeque
Entries.Description: Elly reunites with her high school best friend Zoe and stumbles upon a vibrant art space called PROJECT BARBEQUE, she finds herself drawn into a world of creativity and freedom-far from the rigid life her family has planned for her.

Entries.Title: A Night of Charade
Entries.Description: After his tenure in Los Angeles, a director returns to his hometown theatre to offer unsolicited advice to the new cast. After calling in the chaotic big guns, the production is overtaken and turned into a farce. Will the cast be able to band together and save the show or be forced to embrace the absurd? Starring the totally real Sandra Bullock and Zac Efron.

Entries.Title: Jean
Entries.Description: Della searches for Jean amidst a late night house party.

Entries.Title: Thank You for Calling
Entries.Description: In the anonymity of an increasingly automated city, a successful but socially  struggling man finds an unexpected emotional connection through a help desk conversation. Thank You for Calling (Met Wie Spreek Ik) is a short, magical-realistic film about Rens, a director of a music venue who is on the brink of a burn-out. After an emotional breakdown, he is unexpectedly called by Herman, an unknown man on a houseboat. What starts as an uncomfortable phone call, ends in an absurd musical journey.

Entries.Title: Jim Haggerty's Unnatural Causes
Entries.Description: When horror icon Vlad Eterno shuffles off the mortal coil, it seems a monstrous voice in the fright community has been forever silenced. But Eterno leaves a final dark gift to an unsuspecting world – his final tales of death…by Unnatural Causes!  Thrill as Vlad personally walks us through creepy vignettes of stalked housewives, portals to other dimensions used for revenge, and a betrayed murder victim resurrected to claim justice and comeuppance upon his destroyers.

Entries.Title: Thaw
Entries.Description: Follows three American women navigating hard choices about their biological clocks, and questioning what “choice” actually means in this era of eggs on ice.

Entries.Title: All the Strangers
Entries.Description: A mans life changes over the course of one night when he tries to tie up the loose ends of his late fathers nightclub business. He navigates a neon world of nightlife and strangers who aren't looking out for his best interests.

Entries.Title: Brother Verses Brother
Entries.Description: The twin sons of SF novelist Herbert Gold, filmmaker Ari and musician Ethan collaborate on this 'live cinema' musical drama, 'featuring The Brothers Gold and the People of San Francisco'. It begins with one extroverted brother running late to join his introverted counterpart for an audition of sorts at Vesuvio’s, across Jack Kerouac Alley from City Lights Bookstore. Soon accompanied by a third singer (Lara Louise), these quarrelsome siblings move on to a couple of equally famed local watering holes. They clomp up Telegraph Hill, engage in minor social intrigue, then finally visit Dad on Russian Hill.

Entries.Title: Taste of His Own Poison
Entries.Description: When Dylan is accused of killing his bully Sawyer, mom Courtenay is devastated, and she starts to wonder - could her son be capable of murder?

Entries.Title: The Mother's Eye
Entries.Description: A harrowing night unfolds when a woman realizes she's being hunted by a serial killer.

Entries.Title: Cannibal Mukbang
Entries.Description: Shy and looking for love, Mark quickly becomes smitten with the outgoing and mysterious Ash, who somehow, much to his surprise, reciprocates the attraction. But as his feelings for her intensify, so does his unexpected submersion into Ash's biggest love: the wild world of mukbanging. And with it, lots of bloodshed. Delving into a fascinating subculture while never losing focus on her characters, first-timer Aimee Kuge delivers a raucous and bold horror-comedy seeped in romance and gore.

Entries.Title: Frank Zappa: Cheaper Than Cheep
Entries.Description: The 1974 unreleased made-for-TV concert movie ‘Cheaper Than Cheep’ is finally being released 50 years later! This never-before-heard-or-seen two-hour concert reveals the most intimate performance ever captured from the 1974 Mothers line-up, direct from the lovingly resurrected and restored original vault audio and videotape masters.

Entries.Title: Fantastic Flowers
Entries.Description: Fantastic Flowers is a compilation of short silent films produced between 1906 and 1920, displaying amazing colours that were applied to each frame using the Pathécolor process, or other similar stencilling techniques. Bonsoir – La Fée aux fleurs (1906) / [Bloemenvelden Haarlem] (1909) / Les Chrysanthèmes (1907) / Le Chrysanthème, roi de l’automne (1914) / [Les Tulipes] (1907) / Les Fleurs dans les jardins (1914) / L’Après-midi d’une japonaise (1920) / The Beauty Thief ([1920]) / La Fée printemps (1906) / [Het schoonste uit de natuur] (1912?) / La Culture du dahlia (1911) / [Hollandse Tulpen en Klompen] (1920?) / Fabrication des fleurs artificielles (1911) / [Bonsoir tableau] (1906)

Entries.Title: Britain and the Blitz
Entries.Description: Documentary looking back at a Britain during the darkest days of WWII using stunning new archived footage and interviews with people who lived through it.

Entries.Title: In Whose Name?
Entries.Description: Over six years, 18-year-old Nico Ballesteros captured an unfiltered portrait of Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, offering unprecedented access into the private and public life of one of the most controversial figures in modern culture.

Entries.Title: Winter of Empires
Entries.Description: To avoid galactic war, the treatment of a frozen planet and it's people must be decided.

Entries.Title: Meet the Pickles: The Making of "Win or Lose"
Entries.Description: Discover how Pixar brought its first long-form original series to life. This behind-the-scenes documentary introduces the scrappy filmmaking team that drew from personal experiences to create this ambitious and stylistically unique series that follows a middle-school softball team, the Pickles, in the week leading up to the big championship game.

Entries.Title: Freak Off
Entries.Description: A rising pop star's dreams are shattered when a leaked sex tape threatens her career. She must fight back against betrayal and public scrutiny to reclaim her narrative and future.

Entries.Title: Affinity
Entries.Description: Chilean martial-arts star Marko Zaror is Bruno, an ex-SEAL struggling with PTSD. He lives a life in fear of his demons until one day when he discovers a beautiful woman with no past of her own. Together they begin to build a life, but when she disappears, Bruno must return to his violent past if he’s going to save her from a shocking conspiracy in this riveting, fast-paced sci-fi action film from director Brandon Slagle.

Entries.Title: American Wanker
Entries.Description: In the year 1994, a band of misfits, helmed by a frontman too eager to prove himself, undertake a tumultuous road trip to their first, and possibly, last gig.

Entries.Title: Atti-Tutor
Entries.Description: When Turquoise gets their first private dance student Aspen-Chloe, who is a nightmare, our insecure dance teacher must work with Aspen- Chole’s Attitude Coach, Rachel Kent to transform this spoiled, entitled child into a kind person. Is it the power of dance that influences Aspen-Chole’s behavior or maybe just the reward of a new toy? Might this encounter help Turquoise become the teacher they are meant to be!?

Entries.Title: L.I.M.B.O
Entries.Description: When Tom shows up late to an assessment, he’s thrown into an unexpected, surreal purgatory-like place called L.I.M.B.O. Trapped in this strange, bizarre state, he’s forced to confront his habits, face the consequences of procrastination  and find a way to move forward - or risk being stuck in L.I.M.B.O forever…

Entries.Title: Frank and Three
Entries.Description: Frank is a character in turmoil. Loss has reared its head in Frank's life. While in this state, he happens upon an unlikely companion: a paper towel dispenser. The viewer is invited into a story of acceptance and insight as the two characters navigate the road ahead.

Entries.Title: Trans Los Angeles
Entries.Description: TRANS LOS ANGELES is an anthology of four stand-alone short films and their unifying theme is that they all feature a Trans character in the lead and they all take place in a different part of Los Angeles. These stories are character-driven/slices of life and they demonstrate the rich diversity within the trans community.

Entries.Title: Buried Alive
Entries.Description: In pursuit of a gang of violent criminals, Officer Charlotte Briggs finds herself caught in twisted game of life and death. An abandoned missile facility deep in the Arizona desert becomes a labyrinthian house of horrors. Briggs must battle terrifying mutants and a sinister voice known only as the Overseer as she fights a life and death battle for survival.

Entries.Title: Honeyjoon
Entries.Description: Persian-Kurdish Lela and her American daughter June take a trip to the romantic Azores after a recent loss, both with polar opposite views about why they’re there, how to grieve, and the size of June’s tiny bikini. Amidst honeymooners, the Woman, Life, Freedom movement and their hot, philosophical tour guide, João, the pair find each other… coming back to life.

Entries.Title: Made from Leakproof Plastic
Entries.Description: As Sasha prepares to leave her newly sold home after her husband's passing, his presence lingers in his paintings of her. But an unrelenting fridge leak threatens to destroy them, forcing her to confront her memories. Blending animation and live-action, the film explores loss as a quiet, persistent presence - one that seeps through the cracks, demanding to be felt.

Entries.Title: Ghost Boy
Entries.Description: Martin Pistorius slipped into a coma at the age of 12. Three years later he woke up but was unable to communicate and no-one realized he was fully aware. This is the true story of his remarkable journey back to life.

Entries.Title: Affirmation
Entries.Description: When mantras, affirmations and wellness culture turns...unwell.

Entries.Title: National Theatre Live: Death of England: Delroy
Entries.Description: Unapologetically upwardly mobile and working as a bailiff, Delroy’s life spirals out of control on one surreal day as he races to get to the hospital where his girlfriend Carly is about to give birth.

Entries.Title: Kill Tony: Kill or Be Killed
Entries.Description: A bucket, a mic and one minute to win over Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests. This is stand-up at its most unforgiving — and unpredictable.

Entries.Title: For the Love of God!
Entries.Description: Celibate gay Christian Dennis Kieth, ousted from his youth pastor role for his sexuality, must reevaluate his place within a rejecting church and society.

Entries.Title: Girl in the Attic
Entries.Description: Kelsey honors her late mother by training for a marathon and sharing her journey online. Her posts attract Billy (Keenan Tracey), a grocery worker caring for his disabled mother, Debbie. Obsessed, Billy kidnaps Kelsey and hides her in their attic, controlling her for years. When Debbie discovers the truth, she and Kelsey must fight for survival.

Entries.Title: Blood Rush
Entries.Description: Four college students at a sorority house in Idaho find a mysterious mask connected to a serial killer named Bryan. However, when they put it on, they find themselves trapped in a nightmarish reality as they awaken a serial killer.

Entries.Title: Artificial Adventure
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Bozo Over Roses
Entries.Description: In a crumbly land, enigmatic, sweatsuit-clad figures broadcast the leftover bits of humanity by harnessing funnels of radiating dialog.

Entries.Title: Kids Like Us
Entries.Description: A diverse group of misfits in their early-twenties navigate the emotional waves of life as they seek to find their identities and meanings of life over the course of a night within the gritty backdrop of the underground techno culture.

Entries.Title: If I Run
Entries.Description: Casey Cox is a woman on the run after discovering her best friend Brent has been murdered—and she is being framed for it. Not knowing who to trust, Casey flees, using her intelligence and resourcefulness to stay hidden and the signs of divine guidance to help her in her journey. Meanwhile, Dylan Roberts, a war-weary veteran and private investigator with PTSD, is hired to track her down. As Dylan digs deeper into the case, he begins to suspect that Casey might actually be innocent and that the real story is far more complex—and dangerous—than it first appeared.

Entries.Title: The Great Fire of London with Rob Rinder & Ruth Goodman
Entries.Description: The duo relive the Great Fire of London through the eyes of both the rich and the poor.

Entries.Title: Syria After Assad
Entries.Description: Frontline examines Syria’s uncertain future under jihadist-turned-statesman Ahmad al-Sharaa. After the fall of Bashar al-Assad, correspondent Martin Smith travels the country tracing al-Sharaa’s rise to power and the emerging threats to the country’s stability.

Entries.Title: Bad Painter
Entries.Description: Albert Oehlen steps behind the camera to present a portrait of himself, in life and at work, albeit substituted by actor and similarly brazen iconoclast Udo Kier, with musician Kim Gordon as his inner self, interviewer and judge.

Entries.Title: The Last Battleship
Entries.Description: A crew of children and adults gets the battleship back into action and begin to fight the way home after being cut off from Alliance space by an unknown attacker. The only issue is that this threat is straight out of a person's worst fears.

Entries.Title: The Forest Through the Trees
Entries.Description: Chloe and her step dad, Ken are dealing with the disappearance of Kathy, Chloe's mother and Ken's wife. After a painful year, and with the help of Chloe's friend Ava, they investigate a clue that leads them to a terrifying demon cult.

Entries.Title: Out of Body
Entries.Description: Over the course of a muggy summer day in New England, two friends meander from place to place, getting high and avoiding the aftermath of a recent family tragedy.

Entries.Title: AEW Double or Nothing: The Buy In
Entries.Description: AEW Double or Nothing: The Buy In  (2025)

Entries.Title: Self-Tape
Entries.Description: An actor receives an impossible note. She devolves.

Entries.Title: Ocean's View
Entries.Description: Young Ocean is lost in a world of hurt and prostitution looking to find her way in life with a drugged out mother and a jailed father.

Entries.Title: Pools
Entries.Description: Kennedy has one day to get her shit together or get kicked out of school for good. Instead of buckling down, she rallies a ragtag crew for a midnight pool-hopping adventure through the lavish estates of her college town. But under the surface, Kennedy is searching for answers to the questions tearing her up inside in the wake of her father's death. As the secrets spill, this wild escape becomes a cathartic journey of self-discovery.

Entries.Title: Chet Bond: License to Chill
Entries.Description: After graduating from High Point University, Chet Bond, son of the legendary spy, utilizes his professional network (his dad's boy) to gain employment at intelligence agency, MI7. A surveillance team is deployed posing as a documentary crew to ensure that his antics don't compromise the safety of our nation.

Entries.Title: Uno vuelve siempre
Entries.Description: Five fans rediscover their love for Atlético Nacional during a glorious season. Blending fiction and documentary, the film shows how football can heal, unite, and transform both people and a club that goes on to win everything.

Entries.Title: Fame And Other Four Letter Words
Entries.Description: In a world where Instagram is dead and scientists are hot, one influencer must face her biggest fear: being irrelevant.

Entries.Title: Scones
Entries.Description: A young baker remembers where her passion was born by reflecting on her complicated relationship with her mother.

Entries.Title: To Die For
Entries.Description: Workers at the restaurant “Benny’s Bistro” find a world-renowned food critic dead, face first in his last meal. The workers recount where they were during the shift to uncover who among them is to blame.

Entries.Title: Appalachian Dog
Entries.Description: Appalachia, 1946: a seamstress welcomes home her tailor husband to find they are not the team they were. Trying to stitch their old life back together, time and again it threatens to fall apart - with each of them pulling at the thread.

Entries.Title: Unveiled: Daisy Bates and Johnny Cash
Entries.Description: "Unveiled" celebrates the enduring legacies of two of Arkansas's most iconic figures. Daisy Bates, who courageously led the fight for civil rights, and Johnny Cash, whose music captured the soul of America, are immortalized in bronze in the U.S. Capitol’s National Statuary Hall. Explore the profound impact of their lives on history, from their humble beginnings to their lasting influence.

Entries.Title: Blood of La Llorona
Entries.Description: Two friends find a poem written in La Llorona's hand, and the warning not to read it aloud. When curiosity wins, the house whispers with weeping, and the presence of a woman who isn't there. Now, the girls must confront the horror.

Entries.Title: Both Eyes Open
Entries.Description: Ally escapes an abusive relationship but hallucinates about her abuser. She receives cryptic messages suggesting he's nearby. As the messages intensify and her reality unravels, Ally realizes the truth may be closer than she thought.

Entries.Title: Lulu-Trailer (Wedekind)
Entries.Description: A trailer for Athina Rachel Tsangari’s theater staging of Frank Wedekind’s Lulu at the Salzburg Festival 2017. Above the stage: balloons on which eyeballs are projected. On the stage: human creatures wrapped in tulle, rolling, romping. A “monster tragedy” à la Tsangari.

Entries.Title: Paddy Chayefsky: Collector of Words
Entries.Description: A feature documentary profiling the most revered screenwriter in movie history, Paddy Chayefsky stands alone as the only writer to win three solo Academy Awards for Best Screenplay: for Marty (1955), The Hospital (1971) and Network (1976).

Entries.Title: Unholy
Entries.Description: Noa attends her family’s Passover Seder for the first time since being put on a feeding tube for a gastrointestinal disorder. There, she is confronted with pushy family members, malfunctioning medical devices, and a room of food she can’t eat.

Entries.Title: Motherland
Entries.Description: In an alternate present society where the state frees parents from the burden of raising children, a rule enforcer learns a shocking truth that sparks her rebellion.

Entries.Title: Ours
Entries.Description: After suffering a terrible loss, a woman struggles to get by on her own in her apartment.

Entries.Title: Las Tres Sisters
Entries.Description: Following in the footsteps of their beloved grandmother, three Mexican-American sisters take an adventure through Mexico to complete a traditional pilgrimage and repair their relationship.

Entries.Title: Seclusion
Entries.Description: Dr. Madeline Faye, a successful psychiatrist and best-selling author, seeks refuge in her wealthy father's beach house while she works on her next book. She begins to suspect that a former patient is stalking her.

Entries.Title: A Question Of You
Entries.Description: The visuals for Inhaler's song 'A Question Of You'.

Entries.Title: His House, Home
Entries.Description: Luke, a closeted young man caring for his father with MS, must confront his fears of coming out when a queer healthcare assistant enters their lives.

Entries.Title: Sins of the Father
Entries.Description: When a desperate kidnapper invades her church as she’s cleaning up alone after service, organist Mary must rely on her wits and her faith to save herself—and the young woman he’s taken captive.

Entries.Title: Incredicoaster | Disneyland Resort
Entries.Description: Get ready supers, because the Incredicoaster is a go for launch! Baby Jack-Jack is on the loose, and The Incredibles need your help catching him... fast! This high-speed Point of View ride-along rockets you into the action with a loop-de- loop, laser eyes, cookie smells, and a whole lot of heroics. Dash is boosting the speed. Violet's throwing force fields. And Edna? She's not impressed, yet. From the first countdown to the final drop, this adrenaline-packed experience delivers nonstop fun straight from the world of The Incredibles. It's superpowered storytelling at its finest and a thrilling part of the Disneyland® Resort 70th Celebration.

Entries.Title: Sugar Baby
Entries.Description: When her boyfriend lands in prison, Jade struggles financially and becomes a sugar baby to a wealthy older man. Upon her boyfriend's release, she must choose between her past love and her new lifestyle.

Entries.Title: Freshman
Entries.Description: Going to college is a day many people dream about, but for Andrew, it might not be as easy as he ever thought, specially during his first night away from home.

Entries.Title: Red Tops
Entries.Description: A shadowy figure stalks a homeless man in Uptown New Orleans, an event later exploited by a local tabloid magazine.

Entries.Title: The Eyes of Ghana
Entries.Description: Kwame Nkrumah was a towering figure of African history who inspired the liberation of the continent in the 1950s and 1960s after rising to serve as Ghana’s first President. A political theorist and prominent African leader, Nkrumah was even featured on the cover of Time magazine in 1953. Nkrumah was later toppled by a military coup in 1966, which was allegedly backed by the CIA, after he was cast as a dictator. As a result, the films made during Nkrumah’s time were ordered to be burned. Though his name is all but erased in the U.S., Nkrumah remains an iconic and revered figure across much of Africa.

Entries.Title: Jessica Kirson: I'm the Man
Entries.Description: Jessica Kirson shares her searing perspective on everything from TikTok girls to her bizarre time at a trauma center.

Entries.Title: TKO
Entries.Description: After reuniting with his estranged sons, a former boxer must step up as a father and a coach when his oldest begins competing in professional boxing.

Entries.Title: Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted
Entries.Description: Legendary musician Swamp Dogg, alongside housemates Moogstar and Guitar Shorty, has transformed his home into an artistic playground. Together they navigate the tumultuous music industry, and forge a unique and inspiring path across time and space.

Entries.Title: Conjuring Tapes
Entries.Description: While sorting through their late friend's belongings, two women discover VHS tapes showing them in haunting, unfamiliar scenes, each one drawing them into the grasp of a mysterious, malevolent entity.

Entries.Title: The Inquisitor
Entries.Description: In 1972, Congresswoman Barbara Jordan became the first Southern Black woman to join Congress, one of many firsts in her career as a trailblazing political leader. Looking at her life both in and out of the limelight, this insightful documentary explores how her voice still resonates today.

Entries.Title: Lee Soo Man: The King of K-Pop
Entries.Description: From the traditional town of Jeonju, South Korea came the man that changed the world with music. Lee Soo-man, the artist who became an innovator, orchestrated one of the most viral global phenomena, K-Pop.

Entries.Title: Hello Beautiful
Entries.Description: Hello Beautiful is a powerful and emotionally charged film that delves into the harrowing yet transformative journey of Willow, a successful model whose life is shattered by a devastating breast cancer diagnosis. Based on Christine Handy's bestselling novel Walk Beside Me, the film explores themes of identity, resilience, and the enduring strength of the human spirit in the face of unimaginable adversity.

Entries.Title: Omniscient
Entries.Description: While in Singapore, a spy is unknowingly sent on a suicide mission and hunted for a valuable device in his possession.

Entries.Title: Tonight's Special with Kareem & Johnny
Entries.Description: Kareem and Johnny are two comics in New York struggling on the circuit. In a last-ditch attempt to kickstart their careers, they decide to put together a comedy showcase, but the only place they will let them do it is Kellogg's Diner, an old-school joint in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.

Entries.Title: Iz It A Crime?
Entries.Description: Visual experience to Snoop Dogg's twenty-first album.

Entries.Title: Jokers Wild
Entries.Description: The Joker has finally captured Robin. Will the Dark Knight be able to save him in time, or will the Joker enact his most gruesome joke to date?

Entries.Title: To Use a Mountain
Entries.Description: Six rural American communities are marked as candidates for an unthinkable fate: their land, a burial ground for 77,000 tons of nuclear waste. Against the impassive logic of government analysis and archives, a people’s history of resistance and stewardship emerges through a visceral journey across the landscapes, ecologies, and personal histories of the candidate sites.

Entries.Title: Tiffany Blues
Entries.Description: When a clumsy scooter crash ruins her ube latte, a quirky trans woman and a charming stranger stumble into love, proving that sometimes the best things happen after a little mess.

Entries.Title: Caleb Hearon: Model Comedian
Entries.Description: ​In his debut stand-up special, actor, comedian, writer, and podcaster Caleb Hearon takes us back to his roots in Kansas City...where it all started. Newly 30, Hearon deploys his generational Midwestern wisdom to solve most of the world's problems: politics, internet trolls, learning we're not that different from our parents, and more.

Entries.Title: The Scars of Our Hands
Entries.Description: Kay, an ex-con recently released from prison for serial arson, and his estranged brother, Arthur, a sheriff in the Rocky Mountains, embark on a journey to find and apprehend Specter, Kay's old accomplice.

Entries.Title: Iamerica
Entries.Description: Erica Stateland; a Medal of Honor recipient, suffering from survivors guilt, is hired to coach Marc Beckham; a "cancelIed" actor to play a war hero in the comeback movie of his career. The unlikely relationship that unfolds is a testament to the equalizer that is grief. It's a story about being human and learning that the highest form of courage can come, not from what you've done, but who you choose to be as a result of it.

Entries.Title: To Novosibirsk
Entries.Description: During a sunny day at Coney Island, a father and son's bond begins to fracture when the boy reveals his mother's plans to take him back to Novosibirsk, cutting ties with his father and American life.

Entries.Title: Year of the Dragon
Entries.Description: A devoted immigrant mother sets out to deliver a birthday cake to her son, but as the day unravels, she is forced to confront the reality of her son’s situation.

Entries.Title: Homewrecker
Entries.Description: Megan is devastated when her mom can no longer afford to buy her a house, due to her stepdad's financial troubles. Megan hatches a plan to split them up by using deepfake technology to frame her stepdad for cheating.

Entries.Title: Wicked: Event Special
Entries.Description: Live event broadcast from the Peacock Theater featuring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and special guests in celebration of the Wicked: For Good release.

Entries.Title: Finding Faith
Entries.Description: Faith Mitchell, a loving wife and mother, struggles to keep her family together amidst financial hardships and personal loss.

Entries.Title: Interstice
Entries.Description: Kai, a brilliant young inventor, creates a device that allows him to journey through his own past. When his mother refuses to reveal the truth about his father, he travels back to the night he was conceived—only to uncover a secret that changes everything

Entries.Title: Superman: The Starlight Emperor
Entries.Description: The Kryptonian Epic reimagines the DC Universe as a single epic story, remixing classic stories with new ones, all from a lens of character-based humanism, focusing on the people behind the iconic heroes we’ve come to know, reinventing certain origins, dynamics and events in a new way.  The epic itself is a fan-made continuation of the world and characters of my DC comic series Superman: American Alien, and therefore exists in a strange philosophical gray space between canon and fan fiction.

Entries.Title: A Blind Bargain
Entries.Description: Set in 1970, A BLIND BARGAIN reimagines the lost 1922 Lon Chaney silent film of the same name. A desperate young man strikes a dark deal with an unhinged doctor, offering his mother as a subject for the physician's twisted experiments.

Entries.Title: Noi
Entries.Description: Revenge murmurs in his ear: Αt what temperature does blood boil in the snow?  When the older brother is killed by his favourite horse, the younger one has to decide -through nightmares and visions- whether to avenge the blood or forgive.

Entries.Title: Cliff
Entries.Description: A momentous cliff draws near a pained woman as she makes an offering to her former self.

Entries.Title: Queen of the Rats
Entries.Description: An emerging noise rock band in the 2000s music scene of Providence, RI tries to secure a gig at a local, nationally renown warehouse venue. As tensions flare and stakes rise, they become embroiled in a battle with the venue's owner, the mafia, and a Lovecraftian cosmic horror.

Entries.Title: New York Post Presents: Luigi Mangione Monster or Martyr?
Entries.Description: With insider access from the New York Post, uncover the polarizing Luigi Mangione and his alleged murder of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.

Entries.Title: Livestream
Entries.Description: A livestream unravels when toxic fandom, curated personas, and real-life danger collide. A chilling look at parasocial obsession and how the internet watches—but never helps.

Entries.Title: Reality of Wrestling Heart & Soul
Entries.Description: 👑 A tournament to crown the first-ever Glory Women’s Champion kicks off, featuring:  • Gigi Rey  • Monica Monroe  • Mia Friday  • Alejandra Lion  PLUS — The Reality of Wrestling Women’s Championship is on the line as Kiah Dream defends against Zayda Steel from WWE ID!

Entries.Title: Benny's Second Birthday
Entries.Description: When strangers arrive at her toddler's birthday party, an expectant mother confronts her son's unexpected popularity.

Entries.Title: Peeping Todd
Entries.Description: When his peeping passions become compromised, Todd decides he’ll do whatever it takes to continue stalking his beloved Claire. An obsessive HOA fleet and a dense boyfriend are obstacles Todd must dance around if he wants to sing his way into Claire’s heart. As Claire gets wrapped up in the lies of her fiancé and the web of her stalker, she must escape the two most toxic relationships she’s ever faced.

Entries.Title: Torment of the Witch
Entries.Description: A fashion model, shocked by her best friend's murder, finds a clue that spirals her into the ghostly world of an occult killer and reveals a secret too dangerous to imagine.

Entries.Title: When I'm Ready
Entries.Description: It's the end of the world. Seeking meaning and thrills in their last days alive, Rose and Michael embark on a cross-country road trip to see Rose's grandmother as a devastating asteroid threatens to wipe out life on Earth.  Along the way they encounter other lost souls, each with their own very different perspective on the impending doom.

Entries.Title: Murder at the Hotel
Entries.Description: During a snowstorm that strands her family at a hotel, attorney Megan runs into her high school sweetheart, Brad, sparking tension as her husband Jim disappears and her daughter Lisa vanishes. Cut off from the outside world and unsure who to trust, Megan must navigate a night of secrets, danger, and her own past to save her family before it’s too late.

Entries.Title: Epic Ride: The Story of Universal Theme Parks
Entries.Description: A 3-part series exploring Universal's film and theme park legacy through rare footage and celebrity interviews, leading up to Epic Universe's opening. Features exclusive archives and behind-the-scenes access.

Entries.Title: Into The Gravel Pit
Entries.Description: Miley, Carter, and Isaiah, best friends since childhood, share a bond and a love for exotic drugs. For years, they've pushed boundaries, experimenting with substances and chasing the next big high.

Entries.Title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
Entries.Description: At a “Christmas in July” sale, military widow Vanessa Mayfield (Kramer) crosses paths with antiques dealer Ben Miller (Hollingsworth). As Ben works in Vanessa’s hometown, their friendship begins to grow into something more. But trouble brews when Ben’s father unknowingly acquires a box of antiques containing Vanessa’s missing heirloom Christmas ring - a priceless piece of her family’s past. Planning to sell it, he has no idea of its true meaning. It will take a Christmas miracle for love, family, and the ring to come together.

Entries.Title: Highway to the Moon
Entries.Description: Follows the experiences of young Black men whose lives have been abruptly snatched away. Micah is a young man who finds himself in the Inbetween, a mysterious realm between life and death, after his life is suddenly cut short. As he journeys through this liminal space, guided by a group of other young men, they confront what it means to be a Black boy in today’s society, weaving together a narrative of resilience and self-discovery, in order to ultimately empower each other to embrace empathy, mutual compassion and self-worth.

Entries.Title: '98 Honda
Entries.Description: On a sunny day in 2004, a drug dealer with a secret gets stuck babysitting his girlfriend's 9 year old cousin.

Entries.Title: WWE Royal Rumble 2025 Post-Show
Entries.Description: WWE Superstars and analysts discuss the results from Royal Rumble 2025, including press conference highlights and reactions.

Entries.Title: The Reality of Hope
Entries.Description: Virtual reality creator Hiyu is facing kidney failure. His online friend Photographotter travels from New York City to Stockholm to be a live donor to Hiyu.

Entries.Title: Be a Good Girl
Entries.Description: A shy, obedient woman finds herself torn between the roles protector and aggressor when the man she loves abducts a teenage girl to replace her.

Entries.Title: Sarah & Duck On The Big Screen
Entries.Description: Sarah, a 7-year-old girl, and her best friend, Duck, go on a series of adventures around their local area in this gentle and reassuring children's animation, which compiles episodes of the popular TV series for thearical screening.

Entries.Title: Fucktoys
Entries.Description: Part-time sex worker, full-time chaos magnet, AP is convinced that the universe has it out for her… and she might be right. She decides on seeking a cosmic reset after a tarot reader floating in a swamp tells her she needs $1,000 and a sacrificial lamb to lift her curse. Armed with neither, she meets up with her long-lost kindred spirit Danni, and together the two moped off on a bizarre quest through Trashtown USA — a dystopian, neon-drenched sprawl of strip clubs and urban decay, stocked with a series of assorted oddballs, Tom of Finland cops, and some all-too-familiar type clients. Fucktoys is rude, crude, unhinged, girlypop middle finger to filmic convention, and a comedic calling card for anyone who finds themself asking the question: am I cursed???

Entries.Title: Clown-N-Out in Valley Village
Entries.Description: In "Clown n Out," a down-on-his-luck clown gets caught up in a dangerous criminal underworld and must navigate a treacherous maze of lies, deceit, and violence to survive.

Entries.Title: Bert Kreischer: Lucky
Entries.Description: Losing 45 pounds. Getting parenting advice from Snoop Dogg. Bert Kreischer knows he's the luckiest guy around — and he's recounting his blessings.

Entries.Title: ESC - The Countdow / The Aftershow
Entries.Description: The Countdown to the 69. Eurovision Song Contest live from Basel.

Entries.Title: The Mask: Gone Viral
Entries.Description: A struggling actress in Brooklyn finds the iconic Loki mask and goes on a wild, drunken escapade for the entire world to see, creating a new viral sensation.

Entries.Title: Ted Talk: Bad Channels
Entries.Description: An interview with Ted Nicolaou.

Entries.Title: Orcas - Life in Black and White
Entries.Description: Orcas are the rulers of the seas and are admired by many. But since they started attacking boats off Gibraltar, many people are asking themselves: Are they threatening us or are they just trying to play?  The voice of singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor gives the documentary a special depth.  The 2-part documentary shows the different hunting strategies and the social intelligence of the animals. But the emotional side of the whales also comes into play: how they mourn and how they have fun.

Entries.Title: Dark Secret
Entries.Description: When a couple takes in a new roommate, long-buried truths begin to fester, inciting a chilling game of manipulation and survival.

Entries.Title: Bloody Summer Camp 2: Red Horizon
Entries.Description: After being shut down for eight years, Camp Trustfall is reopened in 1994 by a new owner. The first summer has come to an end and the counselors are closing down the camp for the year when one by one, they start to disappear.

Entries.Title: AJ Goes to the Dog Park
Entries.Description: When AJ loses his favorite dog park, he must fight, fish, scrap, scrape, and sap to get it back.

Entries.Title: Rebel Royals: An Unlikely Love Story
Entries.Description: Go behind the scenes of Märtha Louise and Shaman Durek Verrett's relationship in the lead-up to their divisive wedding in Norway.

Entries.Title: An Evening with Rodney Ascher
Entries.Description: From the Director of Room 237, A Glitch in the Matrix and The Nightmare.  What drives your obsessions? What are your deepest, darkest fears? How far would you go to get Doris Wishman to direct a music video for your band? An Evening with Rodney Ascher is a one-of-a-kind cinematic supercut of original work, found footage, remixes and music videos that will melt your eye sockets. Featuring The S from Hell, Visions of Terror, Doris Wishman Directs a Music Video and Primal Screen.

Entries.Title: A Night at the Park
Entries.Description: A film sequel to Brandon Rogers' viral shorts A Day at the Park and A Day at the Beach.

Entries.Title: Lola Dust
Entries.Description: After attending an audition, an aspiring actress finds herself the subject of a deep fake campaign targeting the British Immigration minister. In her quest to expose the truth and find the perpetrators, she becomes the victim of identity theft and digital harassment which leads her to a world hidden in plain sight.

Entries.Title: Into The Poster
Entries.Description: Three teens enter an old film shop only to discover all isn’t well in the quaint store

Entries.Title: I Think I'm Alone Now
Entries.Description: A man seeks refuge in a secluded cabin nestled deep within the woods, hoping to evade the chaos of a cataclysmic societal collapse brought upon by the emergence of Artificial Intelligence.

Entries.Title: Crusty Fouler
Entries.Description: A couple in mourning set off on an impromptu sail, each with a dark secret in tow….

Entries.Title: The Big Sea
Entries.Description: Surfing is killing it. This $10 billion global industry – built on the dream of carefree spirits, crystal clear waters and an even clearer connection to the natural world – has never been more popular. Surfing has set out its stall as the champion of environmental issues. But surfing has a dirty secret… and people are dying.  From award winning filmmaker Lewis Arnold and critically acclaimed writer Chris Nelson comes this ground breaking and compelling documentary. Shot over three years in California, Louisiana, UK, Ireland, France, Spain & Australia featuring Belinda Baggs, Noah Lane, Sandy Kerr, Lea Brassy, Patch Wilson and more with insights from the likes of Jamie Brisick, Chad Nelsen, Chris Hines, Amanda Chinchelli and other industry insiders, this film is set to shake up and wake up the surf world.  The price of the perfect wave is greater than you think.

Entries.Title: Chhad Gyi
Entries.Description: Chhad Gyi is a Music Video by UmarJaum For his Latest Song Chhad Gyi

Entries.Title: Recollectors
Entries.Description: Two strangers work together to determine what is worth remembering while language, and memory, deterioriates.

Entries.Title: Twin Towers: Legacy
Entries.Description: In this follow up to Robert Port's Twin Towers, follow the journeys of NYPD Detective Joe Vigiano's children in their call to service in an effort to honor their father’s memory, first in the Marine Cops and then as sworn officers in the NYPD.

Entries.Title: Mr. Melvin
Entries.Description: Stripped of purpose and poisoned by corporate evil, the Toxic Avenger is turned against Tromaville. Now, in this definitive cut of Parts II and III, he must confront the monster he's become before his town and soul are lost forever.

Entries.Title: Sister Salad Days
Entries.Description: When an asexual double dutcher’s religious father forces her to get married, she enlists her friends and fiancé to stop the wedding and free her older sister whose soul is trapped on their father’s land.

Entries.Title: American Psychopath
Entries.Description: In the shadows of suburban of America, a mysterious tale unfolds as a girl from out of town becomes the prey of an unidentified serial killer. Making headline news, she must unravel the truth to regain her memory before he kills again.

Entries.Title: Zabriskie Point Re-imagined
Entries.Description: In 1970, Daria Halprin traumatized by Mark's death watches her father's villa exploding sending furnishings, books, and glassware drifting like fallen stars — arrives not as narrative payoff but as a transcendent metaphor for the spiritual unrest of modern America. A symbolic collapse of the American consumer dream. It’s less a filmic conclusion than a meditative act of annihilation, signaling a longing to dismantle civilization’s banal comforts. In today’s world, the slow-motion destruction might be reimagined as the intimate shattering of the invisible structures we live in: your social media profiles, your streaming queue, your cloud archives, your email inbox, your mobile devices — all blown into glittering, floating fragments against the black sky.

Entries.Title: Monk in Pieces
Entries.Description: Visionary composer and performer Meredith Monk overcame hostile critics to become one of the great artists of her time. In her seventh decade of creativity, she ponders how her unique work can continue without her.

Entries.Title: BMFD
Entries.Description: The all powerful goddess of feet showing off her very interesting, soft and thick assets to you in every way she can imagine, while the sounds of the rave club rage on.
