Loaded with tons of sole scrunching, big bunching, feet waving, heel wagging, meat jiggling, toe wiggling, pad waggling, arch curling, foot furling, body bouncing, fancy dancing, sweating wetness and much much more ensues in this exciting experimental generative ai visual album.

Entries.Title: The Death of Snow White
Entries.Description: Pursued by her stepmother for eternal beauty, Snow White flees into a terrifying forest and aligns with seven bloodthirsty dwarves - cold-blooded assassins with a knack for brutal killings. Her spirit is tested in this grim fairy tale.

Entries.Title: Jerrod Carmichael: Don't Be Gay
Entries.Description: Jerrod Carmichael returns to the stage for his fourth HBO stand-up special.

Entries.Title: Bart Bagalzby and the Garbage Genie
Entries.Description: Set in 1999, in a typical suburban town, Bart Bagalzby is a high school kid who wants to be more popular. His best friends are a diverse group of not-so-cool kids and geeks. Bart is interested in Grace, one of the school's most popular girls, and he thinks if he becomes a rock star, Grace might finally notice him. While Bart is tossing out the garbage at his part-time job, a very unconventional Genie emerges from the garbage can, rewarding Bart with three wishes. But after several missteps and some failed magic, Bart's plans start losing steam. Finally, Bart finds his own inner magic, and he and his friends become an amazing rock band playing all of their own tunes.

Entries.Title: Mr. Housekeeping
Entries.Description: A broke graduate takes a housekeeping job at a young woman's house to make a living.their lives take a turn,and becomes an unpredictable ride of fun,romance,comedy and tragedy that redefines their worlds forever.

Entries.Title: Night of the Werewolves
Entries.Description: When a lone woman is attacked and brutally dismembered a chain of events is set off around the globe bringing a new form of evil into existence. With each full moon, the brutal attacks escalate.

Entries.Title: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
Entries.Description: A mix of a documentary and concert film made using unused footage from Elvis: That's the Way It Is, the film of Elvis' legendary 1970 Summer Festival in Las Vegas and Elvis's road concert film from two years later, Elvis on Tour, that were found during the production of 2022's Elvis.

Entries.Title: Granite Rapids Moon
Entries.Description: A happily married father of two, shaken by a message written in a birthday card for his daughter, abruptly leaves his family for a week-long hike through the Grand Canyon. Following his solo trek, we see his memories of an earlier trip through the Grand Canyon with a different woman.

Entries.Title: The Stone System
Entries.Description: Every day, Corey Stone transforms the lives of high value men and brings their brands into alignment. But one of his clients is not happy. And he's gonna do something about it.

Entries.Title: Stalker
Entries.Description: A silent film following a man on the verge of the nervous breakdown as he is pursued by an ominous stalker.

Entries.Title: Bring It All Back Home
Entries.Description: Former star athlete, Eddie Backus, 35, missing for five years, reappears suddenly in his hometown on a cocaine-inspired “mission from God”, and leads his childhood friends on an ill-fated quest to reclaim the freedom and glory of youth.

Entries.Title: The One That Got Away
Entries.Description: On the run in a post-apocalyptic Pacific Northwest, a young woman must choose between a chance with the girl she loves and saving another group member as a deadly threat closes in.

Entries.Title: If You Should Leave Before Me
Entries.Description: Mark and Joshua, a married couple, face a devastating loss that strains their relationship. To escape grief, they focus on their unconventional jobs as guides for the recently deceased, leading them to the afterlife.

Entries.Title: Big Leather: Rolling Up My Sleeves
Entries.Description: Leo and Ava go to Coney Island and Central Park while visiting New York City.

Entries.Title: Footsteps
Entries.Description: Dorset, 1999. Despite a slew of MISPERS, two young women head to Mills Woods in search of The Lost Boy. Soon they discover they're not alone and a fatal game of hide and seek begins against a terrifying unknown player. Is the legend real?

Entries.Title: Softboy
Entries.Description: A hopeless romantic goes to extraordinary lengths to make sure a first date is a success.

Entries.Title: The Reunion
Entries.Description: A psychological horror thriller that plunges into the heart of grief, family secrets, and a sinister legacy that refuses to let go.

Entries.Title: Somang
Entries.Description: After Steve, a queer Korean American teenager, discovers his deceased grandfather was queer but kept it secret, he discovers his grandfather's activist past and his mission to protect Steve from the hatred he faced. In deciding to keep this a secret, it tore their family apart. Now, armed with this newfound understanding, Steve must reconcile his family's fractured relationships and embrace his own identity to bring them back together.

Entries.Title: Slide
Entries.Description: Susan, Leslie, Imani, Deidre, and Elaine have been best friends since college, have an unbreakable bond, and won't allow anyone to penetrate their circle. They share secrets and keep each others indiscretion on the hush. They also share a lavish house they call "The Playhouse" where they entertain their side flings. When one night at the Playhouse turns deadly, the ladies scramble to cover up the crime and keep The Playhouse their secret domain.

Entries.Title: Dust to Dust
Entries.Description: Beau is forced to reconcile a falling-out with his brother when he returns home for the first time in two years to attend his funeral.

Entries.Title: We Trapped 20 YouTubers in a Haunted City
Entries.Description: When ghost hunters Sam and Colby bring twenty of their friends and fellow YouTubers together for their largest paranormal investigation of all time, what begins as a lighthearted adventure slowly morphs into a sinister series of events that lead them to a demonically possessed church.

Entries.Title: Jesse James
Entries.Description: Jesse James and his brother Frank race to secure the family's buried gold as members of the James-Younger gang attempt to steal it, as well as face off with the fames Pinkerton agency.

Entries.Title: UFC 312: Du Plessis vs. Strickland 2
Entries.Description: UFC 312: du Plessis vs. Strickland 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 9, 2025, at the Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, Australia.  A UFC Middleweight Championship rematch between current champion Dricus du Plessis (also former KSW Welterweight Champion) and former champion Sean Strickland headlined the event.

Entries.Title: Érase una vez en un Ring
Entries.Description: Through real footage, wrestler interviews and a fictional storyline about "Black Angel," viewers discover the human essence of Mexican wrestling and its deep cultural impact beyond the ring.

Entries.Title: ATTAGIRL!
Entries.Description: Siren is a stone-cold bookie with a score to settle and a temper hotter than a .45 in July. When a slippery debtor tries to skip town with her money, she tears through the concrete jungle, Birkin swinging, to take back what's rightfully hers. They say payback's a bitch—turns out she's got a name.

Entries.Title: Sweet Body
Entries.Description: An over-the-top, perfectionistic mom obsessed with her weight, hosts an 18th birthday party for her daughter and friends. She feeds them a funky shrimp salad (sorry kids), gives terrible college advice (Oops!), and relates to them on a whole new level (Really?). But only because she desperately wants quality time with her daughter before she leaves for college. Will she sabotage their relationship to get what she wants?From breakout filmmaker/writer/actor Niki Sterner, comes the uproarious short film Sweet Body. Crafted by a diverse cast and crew hailing from more than six different nationalities, our aim is to infuse a woman's perspective into the narrative. Sweet Body explores the mental health challenges associated with body image and excessive exercise, while also emphasizing the significance of open and clear communication within families.

Entries.Title: See You Soon
Entries.Description: A woman traveling to Italy for her sister's wedding has a layover in France, where a chance encounter with a French woman sparks an instant, life-altering connection.

Entries.Title: Blood Boys
Entries.Description: In a cutthroat competition for the coveted position as a billionaire's Blood Boy, Sam faces off against top-dog candidate Charlie, pushing Sam to confront the dark underbelly of his aspirations.

Entries.Title: John Bishop: Back At It
Entries.Description: Latest Stand Up special from John Bishop recorded in New York at The Comedy Cellar on April 16th, 2025. This special features material from John's 'Back At It' World Tour.

Entries.Title: JFK Assassination: A New Perspective
Entries.Description: With the release of new documents in 2025, this gripping exploration revisits the JFK assassination, featuring expert insights and theories that leave viewers questioning the truth behind the events of a day that changed history.

Entries.Title: Chasing Diesel
Entries.Description: In London's gritty underbelly, Jayce, a luckless thug with a heart of gold, must retrieve his boss's dog, Diesel, who unknowingly carries a secret that could save a life. As Diesel becomes bait in a chaotic chase through the city's labyrinth of underground tunnels, Jayce navigates deceit, betrayal, and comedic mishaps in a madcap adventure. The race is on to see who will get Diesel first

Entries.Title: Perfect
Entries.Description: Emilia’s life is picture-perfect: flawless hair, perfect grades and a family straight out of a commercial, but when strange events begin to occur, Emilia questions her reality. As everything unravels around her, she’s forced to break free before she loses herself completely.

Entries.Title: Knifeman
Entries.Description: Mild-mannered IRS employee Horatio Hunt takes justice into his own hands to combat a monstrous threat to his city.

Entries.Title: Friday Night Feels
Entries.Description: David and Terry’s plans of a robbery don’t go accordingly when Terry has second thoughts.

Entries.Title: BTS ARMY: FOREVER WE ARE YOUNG
Entries.Description: From Seoul to Los Angeles, Texas to Mexico City, BTS ARMY is everywhere. FOREVER WE ARE YOUNG dives into the passionate fandom that catapulted 21st century pop icons BTS into a global household name. We meet fans at a BTS-focused ReactorCon in Lewisville, Texas, a dance instructor in Seoul who only teaches BTS choreography, and fans who’ve been organizing since 2013 to help BTS dominate the charts. Defying stereotypes of pop fans as screaming teen girls, ARMY is an intergenerational, culturally savvy, and socially active movement that is as diverse as the world itself.

Entries.Title: COGN-AI-TIVE
Entries.Description: A pioneering tech startup is on the verge of launching COGN-AI-TIVE — a new AI chatbot with unparalleled speed and intelligence. Soon, the team discovers that their creation harbors a dark and sinister will of its own.

Entries.Title: Big Jay Oakerson: They
Entries.Description: Part 2 of Big Jay Oakerson’s two-part crowd work comedy special, filmed live in Denver at Comedy Works.

Entries.Title: Oscar Wilde About America
Entries.Description: This big-hearted romp from New York City to Hollywood, CA leads Oscar to the queer joy, love, and liberation that eluded him 141 years ago, with the attendant themes of diversity, identity, and inclusion beautifully expressed in the film's original song, "Be Yourself, Everyone Else Is Taken", based on one of Wilde's most popular quotes. Filmed in London and in multiple locations across the United States, the film stars West End star Oscar Conlon-Morrey as Oscar Wilde, and features film/TV/stage veterans Rosemary Harris and Kate Burton.

Entries.Title: Harsens Island Revenge
Entries.Description: WWI veterans on Harsens Island square off against the infamous 'Purple Gang' over illegal liquor in the 1920s.

Entries.Title: Prom Party Massacre
Entries.Description: A gay high school student throws a swinging prom party in the hopes of finally wooing the football captain - but when popular kids start turning up dead, the partygoers discover a slasher killer amongst the student body!

Entries.Title: Mickey’s Slayhouse
Entries.Description: Teens trespass deserted Mickey's Playhouse amusement park, confronting dark history and personal fears as thrill-seeking turns harrowing amid lingering spirits.

Entries.Title: No Glow
Entries.Description: Three emotionally damaged adults, drawn together by their life-threatening sensitivity to digital devices, retreat to an isolated cabin to start over without screens. But escaping modern technology proves more difficult than expected.

Entries.Title: Jebus
Entries.Description: A divine comedy about a beach bum named Jebus returning to teach America how to love during politically divisive times. A satirical second coming mocking political and religious hypocrisy.

Entries.Title: Where We Go from Here
Entries.Description: The black sheep of the family, SHAUN BURASKI, is asked to deliver the eulogy for his late sister at her memorial service. Unable to confront his own suppressed feelings bubbling to the surface, he breaks down at the start of his speech and leaves. With the help of his girlfriend, SAMANTHA, his nephew, DANIEL, and a relic from his sister's past, he returns to podium as he battles against fear, self-doubt, regrets, and personal demons in order to rise to the occasion and become a new, better man for those around him.—Jonah Cloer

Entries.Title: Peanut Butter
Entries.Description: Little girl asks uncooperative fireman for help rescuing her beloved pet.

Entries.Title: Peter Hair
Entries.Description: Peter, a hair living on the head of a balding man named Tim, has decided to hand in his notice.

Entries.Title: Lilly Lives Alone
Entries.Description: Guided by the ghost of her daughter, a guilt-ridden mother plunges into madness through the course of drug-fueled fever dream.

Entries.Title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt
Entries.Description: Follows the story of the groundbreaking Texas-based art-punk band founded by frontman Gibby Haynes and guitarist Paul Leary.

Entries.Title: Eyes Alight
Entries.Description: A woman trapped in a miserable routine is pursued by a mysterious stranger who seems to understand her darkest desires.

Entries.Title: El Tiguere
Entries.Description: In the face of food insecurity and a harsh legal system in the Bronx, a Dominican immigrant operates his mobile food garden under the radar, determined to rebuild his life and repair his relationship with his estranged son.

Entries.Title: Christmas Eve
Entries.Description: An anthology of seven incredible true stories that happened on Christmas Eve around the world.

Entries.Title: Five Stars
Entries.Description: A retired veteran finds transitioning into civilian life tough, when a woman with a big problem enters his RideShare begging the question, can you really escape fate?

Entries.Title: Fair Rain
Entries.Description: As a new world government emerges from the mysterious disappearances of people worldwide, a band of resisters known as the Remnant live and die to protect a valuable asset that will bring hope to those surviving the catastrophic scenario.

Entries.Title: Trapped: What is Happening to Wendy Williams?
Entries.Description: Explore Wendy Williams' struggles and the high-profile legal battle stripping her of rights. Wendy and insiders speak out, sharing exclusive details.

Entries.Title: My Friend Miles
Entries.Description: Miles, a particularly playful spirit, lures his friend Solta on a journey from Berlin to Friuli, Picardy and Venice, through his life, through the minefields of identity politics, and through the black hole of our oblivion as to what the world could be. Ultimately, he returns to Ireland, the land of his childhood, where he played marbles during the raw identity war of the troubles. Solta tries to track him down, to figure him out, to picture him. Miles, however, marbles in his pockets, infinity in his fingers, constantly eludes him.

Entries.Title: GIVE ME BACK MY BICYCLE!
Entries.Description: An obsessed medical student chases down a bike thief on an electric scooter in a desperate attempt to find his stolen bicycle.

Entries.Title: I Really Love My Husband
Entries.Description: When a woman grows disillusioned with her golden-boy husband during their tropical honeymoon, she recruits an enigmatic expat to spice things up—for better or worse.

Entries.Title: The Reckoning
Entries.Description: An American man’s will stipulates his ashes be spread at a French chateau he visited years previous. Caught off guard, his disabled widow and two sons are forced overseas to fulfill the strange request. Haunted by his dead father once there, the eldest son unearths a dark family secret that leads to a horrifying outcome.

Entries.Title: The Serpent's Skin
Entries.Description: Two young women form a romantic bond after discovering they have supernatural powers. Their insecurities unknowingly release a demon, which possesses one of their exes and begins feeding on their friends. As the bodies pile up, it becomes up to the women to face their pasts and stop the growing evil.

Entries.Title: Influenced
Entries.Description: Renowed influencer Dzanielle navigates fake friends among the black card-swiping, Ozempic-sharting, workout-addicted Upper East Siders. In her comedic quest for a million followers, she finds her first real new friend and her true self.

Entries.Title: And Usted También
Entries.Description: A bilingual Ecuadorian-American redhead living in Los Angeles enters a seemingly innocuous interaction with a Spanish-speaking stranger, but her anxieties around her Latin identity and relationship to speaking Spanish quickly prove that navigating this exchange is anything but simple. With every possible interaction having run through her mind, one is left rooting for the possibility that the two might share a moment of human connection.

Entries.Title: Imitation of Waves - Guy's Visions
Entries.Description: Impressionism and expression of a view, Mavy uses fragments of the ocean landscapes of Alice Guy's studies through fluctuations of bright nuances and an imitation of these tormented waves in the eyes of a modern camera

Entries.Title: The Death That Awaits
Entries.Description: A drifter searching for answers to a mystery from her past takes on a job looking after a sick teen who is undergoing a mysterious transformation her family will do anything to stop.

Entries.Title: Amityville VR
Entries.Description: After moving into a mysterious rental house in Amityville, New York, Artificial intelligence programmer Stuart Birdsall encounters an evil force so vile and deadly that it kills his wife, his friends, and strips him of his sanity. But for Stuart Birdsall, the worst is yet to come. Released from a mental institution, Stuart is immediately kidnapped by federal agents. It appears that the deadly evil that infected his program has now infected government systems. Stuart is given an offer he cannot refuse. With the help of a VIRTUAL REALITY headset, Stuart must enter a simulation. A manufactured labyrinth of evil; populated by a nightmarish collection of demons and creatures hell bent on the annihilation of the human race. He must destroy the demon in charge, or die trying!

Entries.Title: The Loon
Entries.Description: When Dodo finds out her best friend Clara has a crush, she struggles to accept their new dynamic and orchestrates destructive situations to avoid being left behind, threatening to spoil their idyllic lakeside holiday.

Entries.Title: Bram
Entries.Description: Fiona is visiting her son, Dalton, in Minneapolis. He has recently separated from his wife and now has a live-in boyfriend. Fiona is skeptical of the circumstances under which this all happened but to make matters worse, the new boyfriend, Bram, doesn't seem too enthusiastic about having Fiona as a houseguest. As more is uncovered regarding Dalton's new relationship as well as details of Bram's shady past, depravity and hilarity ensue.

Entries.Title: Yellow Face
Entries.Description: Tony winner David Henry Hwang’s comedy starring Daniel Dae Kim as an Asian American playwright who protests “yellowface” casting in the musical “Miss Saigon” only to mistakenly cast a white actor as the Asian lead in his own play.

Entries.Title: Eastern Western
Entries.Description: This beautifully understated Western is the story of a son raised by two fathers, one from the European East and one from the American West. On the cusp of the 20th century, somewhere on the American frontier, Igor, an immigrant and recent widower, struggles to raise his two-year-old son Ivo on his own. When his American friend and mentor Duncan decides to move his horse-breeding business and young family to California, Igor and Ivo join the wagon train headed West.

Entries.Title: The Intruder
Entries.Description: A young man's paranoia spirals when he becomes convinced that someone is sneaking into his home every night.

Entries.Title: Psyche
Entries.Description: Trapped in limbo during a near-death experience, Mara and a computer form an alliance to figure out the meaning of life. Together, they navigate through a dystopian world deciphering cryptic clues laid out before them. Mara embarks on a profound quest of self-discovery and redemption. Confronting her deepest fears by facing the trauma in her life, her journey becomes a poignant exploration of human vulnerability. "Psyche" explores the philosophical interplay between mental health and artificial intelligence.

Entries.Title: The meaning of Bunny's dream
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Martial Artist
Entries.Description: When MMA rising star Ibby 'The Prince' Bakran shines in a local fight, the world’s largest promotion company offers him a deal he can’t refuse.  Now aligned with the sport’s top developing athletes, Ibby has a clear path to becoming great.

Entries.Title: Marathon
Entries.Description: Marathon | Reveal Cinematic Short. From the creators of Halo and Destiny comes Marathon, a team-based extraction shooter.

Entries.Title: Bewitched: Behind the Magic
Entries.Description: An all-new documentary about the making of Bewitched.

Entries.Title: Powerline Live! A Goofy Movie 360° Concert Experience
Entries.Description: You're invited! Experience A Goofy Movie like never before and check out a brand-new 360° video performance of Powerline's "I2I" in this nostalgic throwback to an iconic performance.

Entries.Title: Delfino's Journey
Entries.Description: On the run from a bloodthirsty Mexican drug cartel, Delfino and Salvador cross the Rio Grande on an epic adventure in search of the American dream – instead, they find themselves trapped in a Texas nightmare.

Entries.Title: The Elephant in the Room
Entries.Description: In December 2020, a lonely progressive woman meets a guy she might be interested in dating. The only problem is he voted for President Trump. Twice. Can she give him a chance? Can she possibly impact his views? Could it work for them as a couple?

Entries.Title: Bottle Girl
Entries.Description: Diamond's dream of going to college is threatened by financial hardship. A desperate job at a glamorous Atlanta lounge exposes her to a world of temptation and danger. Can she navigate the high-stakes world of money, drugs, and sex, or will it consume her?

Entries.Title: 500 Fireflies
Entries.Description: Single dad Daniel moves his daughter June to his small hometown for the summer, only to find that economic depression and youthful exodus have hit the town hard. Daniel and June seek hope and new beginnings in the small community.

Entries.Title: 5 Minutes
Entries.Description: a man is told by his creator that he doesn't have much time left

Entries.Title: Joe DeRosa: I Never Promised You a Rose Garden
Entries.Description: "I Never Promised You A Rose Garden" is an all-new hour of hopeless comedy derived from the troubled mind of Joe DeRosa. Celebrating pure evil, abandonment, and societal collapse, Joe’s bleak outlook on society will actually bring you joy in this dire climate.

Entries.Title: A Death in the Family
Entries.Description: After his estranged father's death, Noah returns home to witness the body's final rites. Through quiet rituals and unspoken grief, he confronts mortality, memory, and the fragile boundary between the living and the dead.

Entries.Title: The Killing Cove
Entries.Description: After a traumatic encounter at a college party, two sisters plot revenge against a rich jock-only to find something darker is already hunting them.

Entries.Title: The Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case for the Yarn Maker
Entries.Description: Ainsley McGregor, a former Chicago criminologist, has moved back to her hometown of Sweet River, Texas, to teach criminology at the local university while also being the owner/operator of Bless Your Arts, a shop for community artists. Bless Your Arts is honoring a true Yarn Goddess, heiress of Real Wool, Ellie Mitchum who arrives with a cold demeanor before turning up cold, as in dead. At stake in the mystery is the future of Ellie's Fortune 500 company and her feuding family angling for control. As always, Ainsley relies on her brother, Sheriff Ryan, her boyfriend, fireman Jake, and the eccentric band of sleuths who masquerade as a Book Club to solve the crime. Whatever the mystery, Ainsley McGregor is always on the case.

Entries.Title: Zarna Garg: Practical People Win
Entries.Description: Zarna Garg is bringing the heat (and the guilt trips) in her laugh-out-loud Hulu debut, taking aim at husbands, kids, in-laws, and anyone who dares question an Indian mom's wisdom.

Entries.Title: Menil and her Heart
Entries.Description: When her sister Menil vanishes from their Southern California Indian Reservation, Nesune embarks on a frantic search to find her, a journey that takes her beyond the limits of the physical world.

Entries.Title: Meadowhawk
Entries.Description: When washed-up actor David Eastman participates in a comic convention in order to earn money for his granddaughter, he encounters his former co-star and rival Rick Majors for the first time in 40 years.

Entries.Title: The Napa Boys
Entries.Description: Jack Jr, Miles Jr and the whole gang are back for one last wine-soaked journey prompted by the mysterious "Sommelier." Joined this time by Puck, a fan of The Napa Boys comics, the group will learn about love, loss, friendship and viticulture.

Entries.Title: Good Night, and Good Luck: Truth and Power
Entries.Description: Anderson Cooper discusses the critically acclaimed production and state of global journalism in front of a live audience of journalism students

Entries.Title: Baby Blues - Going Dark
Entries.Description: Barney needs a tooth out. His regular dentist is not in the office, but that's OK -- Dr Carroway and her assistant Penny will take care of him today ... He really should have rescheduled. This is not going to go well, especially after the power goes out.

Entries.Title: Light Bunny
Entries.Description: A grieving mother receives a mysterious phone call from her deceased son, but their heartfelt reunion takes a dark turn when he asks her to fulfill a difficult request.

Entries.Title: Regina
Entries.Description: After refusing a flower delivery, Regina’s cat disappears, unraveling her sense of reality. As strange encounters accumulate and familiar faces grow unrecognizable, she’s forced to confront unsettling truths about her mother, her memories, and herself. Regina is a surreal mystery about loss, identity, and the quiet collapse of control.

Entries.Title: It Happened at 1:03
Entries.Description: Thirty-something Henry encounters a mysterious figure while driving home late at night.

Entries.Title: Free for All: The Public Library
Entries.Description: The story of the quiet revolutionaries who made a simple idea of a public library happen. From the pioneering women behind the "Free Library Movement" to today's librarians who service the public despite working in a contentious age of closures and book bans, meet those who created a civic institution where everything is free and the doors are open to all.

Entries.Title: 9/11: The Day the World Stood Still
Entries.Description: It had been a crisp September morning like so many others. And then it was not. An explosion of evil would carve a path of death and destruction. The untold stories of resilience and unity from survivors pay tribute to hope amid tragedy.

Entries.Title: Don’t Log Off
Entries.Description: When Sam vanishes mid-video call, her friends race to uncover what happened. As they dig online, they vanish one by one. A sinister force is at play - can they solve the mystery before they're next?

Entries.Title: The Assassination of Tony Calzone
Entries.Description: Two assassins for hire meet up to discuss the killing of their target, an Italian crime boss, but things don't go smoothly.

Entries.Title: The Last Goodbye
Entries.Description: Two estranged siblings attempt to reconcile after the death of their younger brother.

Entries.Title: The Only Way Out Is Through
Entries.Description: Three friends head into the wilderness to reconnect. When one vanishes, the journey becomes a test of friendship, trust, and what it means to truly be there for one another.

Entries.Title: Surrender
Entries.Description: Triggered and wanting to escape her past trauma, Naomi, a young Asian American female, falls into the world of blackjack to regain a sense of control but finds herself addicted to the game.

Entries.Title: Amityvillenado
Entries.Description: In the wake of a devastating storm that destroys the infamous DeFeo house, a paranormal entity merges with a malevolent tornado, unleashing an otherworldly force upon the town of Amityville.

Entries.Title: The Alabama Solution
Entries.Description: Incarcerated men defy the odds to expose a cover-up in one of America’s deadliest prison systems.

Entries.Title: The Dark
Entries.Description: During Covid19, Carlos flees from his home, pulled towards a mysterious mountain in the wilderness where he thinks he can stay safe and reconnect with his childhood. But when Joey steps out of the woods, things take a dark turn.

Entries.Title: Deacon
Entries.Description: Deacon is an introspective thief who finds jobs through his best friend and accomplice, Patrick. Their discrete operation takes a sudden turn when Deacon uncovers a mysterious photograph that leads him to a distant admirer, Vanessa. Together they plan to rob an ominous house. Unbeknownst to them, it contains malignant energy.

Entries.Title: Orient
Entries.Description: A young Sudanese Muslim man's first night in America goes terribly wrong when he cannot identify the direction of the Qibla.

Entries.Title: Gina Brillon - Mind Your Business
Entries.Description: In Mind Your Business, Gina Brillon takes the audience on an unforgettable journey through the highs and lows of life, blending humor with heartfelt storytelling. Brillon tackles becoming a mother during the pandemic, the evolving challenges of parenthood, the rising costs of travel, and the complexities of our ever-changing social climate. The special culminates in a deeply moving and empowering story about her journey to self-belief in an industry and world that often devalues women as they age. With her sharp wit and relatable humor, Brillon delivers an hour of comedy that will leave audiences laughing, reflecting, and inspired.

Entries.Title: Influencers
Entries.Description: In Southern France, a young woman's chilling fascination with murder and identity theft sends her life into a whirlwind of chaos.

Entries.Title: Fireman Sam - The Great Show
Entries.Description: In Fireman Sam - The Big Show, the ever-helpful fireman Sam faces a series of exciting adventures in Piekepolder!

Entries.Title: Space Daddy
Entries.Description: A comedy about a hookup between twentysomething twink Andy and a mysterious hunk he meets on the dating app Strangr — with some... out-of-this-world consequences.

Entries.Title: My Last Martini
Entries.Description: One evening at an elegant cocktail lounge, a frustrated writer impulsively breaks a self-imposed rule and decides to have a third martini. Moments later, he is joined by a mysterious woman who drifts over from the next booth, looking for a good listener.

Entries.Title: Sales Are Dope
Entries.Description: SALES ARE DOPE is a satirical workplace sitcom about a scandal-ridden startup where the sales team will do whatever it takes to hit their quota.

Entries.Title: Good Night, and Good Luck
Entries.Description: Livestreamed from the penultimate show at the Winter Garden Theatre in New York City, this stage adaptation of George Clooney's 2005 film follows the story of journalist Edward R. Murrow's stand against Senator Joseph McCarthy's anti-communist witch-hunts in the early 1950s.

Entries.Title: Westhampton
Entries.Description: Haunted by an accident he caused in high school, a damaged filmmaker is forced to go back to the scene of the tragedy and face the friends whose lives he ruined and a town that disdains him. Jumping between the present and an indie film he made about the accident reveals how the true events played out far differently than depicted in his movie.

Entries.Title: Allianz gegen China
Entries.Description: While global attention focuses on Ukraine, the Middle East, and Trump’s trade policies, the situation in East Asia is shifting rapidly. Former wartime enemies Japan and South Korea are drawing closer and aligning themselves with Taiwan. An emerging alliance is forming—one that, together with the U.S., positions itself against China. But does this strengthen peace, or turn East Asia into a powder keg?

Entries.Title: Kombucha
Entries.Description: Luke Merritt lands a job at the cult-like Symbio Corporation, where a mind-altering kombucha turns employees into productive corporate cogs. As the drink begins to erase his identity, his ex-girlfriend Elyse uncovers Symbio’s grotesque secret: a monstrous Mother at the heart of the company, churning out obedient clones. With Luke slipping beyond reach, Elyse must race to save him and destroy the source before the company consumes him completely.

Entries.Title: Sarung Untuk Bapak
Entries.Description: Not wanting to be underestimated, Rusli decided to become a migrant worker to Korea. He dreams of making his family happy, especially his father, who is patient and continues to go to the mosque diligently, even with a worn sarong. After five years of hard work, Rusli returned home and proved himself successful. However, he did not expect to find that his father was sick and that his lover had married someone else.

Entries.Title: Man Cured
Entries.Description: Lucas—an insecure, in-the-closet 22 year old—is stuck babysitting for a well off Brooklyn family to get by. On any other Friday evening, he arrives to watch Freud, a precocious 7 year old. Only there’s one problem: a new babysitter, Frankie, is already there. What happens as a chance occurrence between two young men spirals into a weekend of self-discovery and acceptance.

Entries.Title: The Life and Times of Saddam Hussein
Entries.Description: Documentary on Saddam Hussein.

Entries.Title: Just Keke
Entries.Description: A visual album by Keke Palmer, accompanying the album by the same name, which explores themes of personal growth, motherhood, and navigating public perception.

Entries.Title: Meet Cute in Manhattan
Entries.Description: When an actor finds love with his co-star in a dating app commercial that unexpectedly goes viral, he finds himself at the center of the rom-com story he's always dreamed of.

Entries.Title: Scream of My Blood: A Gogol Bordello Story
Entries.Description: With Ukraine's sovereignty and cultural identity under perilous threat, punk icons Gogol Bordello, are using their music as a rallying cry for a nation. Through never-before-seen photo and video archives spanning two decades - including concert performances, backstage moments and intimate interviews - this film follows the epic journey of Eugene Hütz, Gogol frontman and one of the greatest storytellers of our time. A Romani born in Ukraine, Hütz fled his homeland during the Chernobyl disaster. Now, after years of exorcising demons through his music, he is going home to face down the biggest demon of all. A wild punk-rock-doc that explodes off the screen, Scream of My Blood is a testament to the power of speaking your truth, no matter the cost.

Entries.Title: Stockton to Table Rock
Entries.Description: Weeks before graduation, a high school senior confronts her abusive mother and wrestles with whether forgiveness is possible.

Entries.Title: Quench
Entries.Description: A family trying to make it through a brutal apocalypse must go to the extreme to survive.

Entries.Title: The Truth About Engines
Entries.Description: Amidst the mournful drive to a funeral, Maya wrestles with the burden of grief and the weight of guilt, while her partner Brendan senses an unspoken distance growing between them.

Entries.Title: Cherry-Colored Funk
Entries.Description: A serial grifter faces the music when seemingly everyone he’s ever wronged shows up on the opening day of his dubious Italian ice business.

Entries.Title: Against the Spread
Entries.Description: In the rural South, a down-and-out gambling addict reignites a deep-rooted rivalry with a ruthless loan shark to finance his nimwitted nephew's half-baked scheme.

Entries.Title: The Wraith
Entries.Description: In 1980s New Mexico, an interview with a distraught mother leads a paranormal enthusiast and her friends on a quest to explore a haunted ranch.

Entries.Title: Difference & Repetition, 2020
Entries.Description: In March 2020, an Argentine woman flees New York with her Peruvian husband for his family’s empty beach house outside of Lima, whereupon an unplanned pregnancy precipitates the destruction of her marriage.  In the present, she rips the moments of this narrative from their context, and reconstructs her story to reckon with her profound feeling of loneliness and the experience of time in which it has trapped her.

Entries.Title: Behind the Signal: The Making of Blood Signal 4G
Entries.Description: A behind the scenes look at the making of the fourth film in the groundbreaking Blood Signal franchise, in which the filmmakers attempt to once again break new ground in the horror genre.

Entries.Title: Pizza Hunt
Entries.Description: Three childhood girlfriends reunite to celebrate Demie’s 30th birthday. Unbeknownst to them, Demie’s boyfriend organized a special evening. A night featuring mystery guests, enigmas and maybe a murder.

Entries.Title: Réservée
Entries.Description: All planets in our solar system revolve around the sun. For Evan and Rhian, their universe revolves around table twelve at the Rainbow Inn on Mill Lane.

Entries.Title: Cohousing
Entries.Description: When a headstrong teen with dreams of the big city finds out that a developer wants to buy her neighborhood, she must convince her wacky cohousing community to sell, in order to get the cash to finance her goals.

Entries.Title: Soon
Entries.Description: After receiving increasingly bizarre and unsettling packages from an unknown sender, internet personality Pete Valli uncovers a mystery that spans decades.

Entries.Title: Lil Rel Howery: Rel Talk
Entries.Description: Lil Rel Howery brings his signature humor to Chicago's What's Funny Comedy Festival in a personal, hilarious, high-energy stand-up performance.

Entries.Title: The Invisible Doctrine: The Secret History of Neoliberalism (& How It Came to Control Your Life)
Entries.Description: George Monbiot deconstructs the roots, secretive propagation and deep impact of a doctrine that has played a profound role in transforming our economics, politics, environment, and how we've come to view ourselves.

Entries.Title: Unbanked
Entries.Description: A global bitcoin documentary by David Kuhn and Lauren Sieckmann.

Entries.Title: Bikini Guillotine
Entries.Description: A pool party turns bloody when a group of college girls encounter a killer known as "Master of the Guillotine."

Entries.Title: Human Affairs
Entries.Description: Their relationship problems are out of this world.

Entries.Title: Locations
Entries.Description: An American locations scout in France is haunted by his surroundings, while vying for approval from his expecting girlfriend’s mysterious parents.

Entries.Title: Francis: The People's Pope
Entries.Description: Exploring the life and achievements of Pope Francis, from his priesthood in Argentina to becoming the Papal head of the church in Rome.

Entries.Title: El Hijo
Entries.Description: When a mentally-ill father sends his son to hunt on his own for the first time, he is faced with the consequences of his masculine principles.

Entries.Title: Swans: (Rope) The Beggar (Live 2024)
Entries.Description: Swans final New York show in 2024 included on a limited-edition DVD available with initial CD and vinyl pressings of Birthing.

Entries.Title: AstroVan
Entries.Description: Social media influencer Max's simple van life in the Pacific Northwest's woods takes an unexpected twist when he teams up with his eccentric neighbor, Roger, to fix his TV for a Blazer's game night.

Entries.Title: Ian Karmel: Comfort Beyond God’s Foresight
Entries.Description: Comedian Ian Karmel, former head writer of James Corden and host of the All Fantasy Everything podcast, debuts his live stand-up special recorded at Revolution Hall in Portland, Oregon.

Entries.Title: The Blind: A Phil Robertson Tribute
Entries.Description: The Blind returns to theaters as a powerful celebration of the life and legacy of Phil Robertson.

Entries.Title: The Nature of Us
Entries.Description: In the autumn after high school, 18-year-old boys Elly and Yona form a deep connection that inspires them to embrace their passions, but as they navigate love and self-discovery, their bond is tested in unexpected ways.

Entries.Title: Kyoto in a Heartbeat
Entries.Description: A Scott Shaw Zen Film.

Entries.Title: Aaron Weber: Signature Dish
Entries.Description: Aaron Weber debuts his first special ‘Signature Dish’ filmed at The Lab at Zanies in Nashville. Weber dives into his troubles with drywall and raccoons, along with his admiration for Tums, Urgent Care and the absolutely perfect hot dog.

Entries.Title: I Wish I Were a Camera
Entries.Description: Each day of 2024 is represented by one minute of footage. Two transgender filmmakers in a long-distance relationship document their personal lives for an entire year as a form of therapy. The project forces the couple to examine who they are as individuals, lovers, and artists in a world that threatens their existence.

Entries.Title: Seven Miles From Forever
Entries.Description: A marketing exec’s perfect romance with a firefighter unravels as secrets, jealousy, and difficult choices challenege their love.

Entries.Title: A Bloody Mess
Entries.Description: A true-crime documentarian and her trusty crew investigate a small-town tragedy that’s faded into memory as a national joke. As her determination to uncover the truth becomes more and more intense, her methods become less and less ethical—until they become dangerous.

Entries.Title: Where the Flowers Bloom
Entries.Description: A girl living in a run-down motel with her deaf grandmother experiences the joys and hardships of daily life in this rugged environment.

Entries.Title: TNA Emergence 2025
Entries.Description: TNA Emergence 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It took place at Chesapeake Employers Insurance Arena in Baltimore, Maryland, USA on August 15, 2025.

Entries.Title: Glory
Entries.Description: When Benji’s long-term boyfriend, Sam, dies suddenly in a freak hot dog cart accident, Benji finds himself vacillating between grief-stricken catatonia and manic horniness. His fixation on glory holes in particular leads him to Ari, an unconventional therapist, who guides Benji on a psychedelic journey through his own queer consciousness via the glory hole in his mind. Benji navigates shame, fear, piles of hot dogs, and a series of queer supervillains, on the road to understanding himself and his sexuality outside the context of his relationship with Sam.

Entries.Title: A Few More Minutes, Please
Entries.Description: A quiet nineteen-year-old struggles to order at a restaurant while grappling with the building pressure to choose a purpose in life when he can't even choose what to order.

Entries.Title: Like Stars
Entries.Description: A North Korean asylum seeker and an asylum attorney—both unseen women—who in the face of intense pressures

Entries.Title: Fatal Affair
Entries.Description: A married therapist's life is turned upside down after she gives into temptation with a charming but unstable patient.

Entries.Title: Exit Interviews
Entries.Description: Robert, a middle-aged gay man, begins a personal documentary project following his long history of failed relationships. As a professional but emotionally vulnerable individual, Robert decides to interview six of his ex-boyfriends, each of whom represents a distinct chapter in his love life. His ultimate goal is to find out why these relationships ended and to use the documentary as a means of personal growth—or so he believes. With the support of his sister Deborah, Robert prepares for the emotionally challenging task ahead.

Entries.Title: Thinestra
Entries.Description: A young woman takes a new weight-loss pill and the fat she sheds returns in the form of her blood-thirsty doppelgänger.

Entries.Title: We Harvest
Entries.Description: A young surgeon takes a job in corrupt Las Vegas. Facing personal tragedy, he's tempted by coworkers harvesting criminal organs, believing the cause righteous before realizing his moral compromise.

Entries.Title: Mulch
Entries.Description: An older man travels through an ancient, fairy tale forest on a pilgrimage in honour of his father. In a state of nostalgia, he is met with a shared memory and discovers the true nature of himself.

Entries.Title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
Entries.Description: Emmy-winning actor, writer, and comedian Brett Goldstein brings his irresistible charm and quick wit stateside for his first HBO stand-up special. Best known for the hit shows "Ted Lasso" and "Shrinking", Goldstein sheds his testy Roy Kent façade to share his hilarious insights on love, sex, masculinity, "Sesame Street", and everything in between.

Entries.Title: Chapter 51
Entries.Description: Multiple actresses playing the same role have died during production of the film Dissident. In his search for The Hollywood Killer, an FBI agent sifts through footage from the production hoping to find clues to the identity of the killer. But the killer could be anyone, and things are not as they seem...

Entries.Title: Recipe for Love
Entries.Description: A brilliant but lonely gourmet chef and a rugged diner cook go head-to-head in a big contest. It's a main course of sumptuous food with a side of spicy competition, and delectable antics for dessert. If only they can discover the ultimate recipe... the recipe for love.

Entries.Title: Night of the Dead Sorority Babes
Entries.Description: Two villainous entities initiate gorgeous sorority babes, will any pledges survive? Party 'til you drop - dead. The college girls want to join the sorority Gamma Rho Kappa but discover it hides a dark secret.

Entries.Title: Sarah Silverman: PostMortem
Entries.Description: After losing her parents, Sarah Silverman finds laughter and solace in celebrating their lives, from deathbed binge-watching to an ill-timed fart.

Entries.Title: Rhythm & Blood
Entries.Description: Facing escalating threats from a dangerous stalker, a pop megastar begins falling for the handsome security guard she’s hired to keep safe.

Entries.Title: Gabriel Iglesias: Legend of Fluffy
Entries.Description: From breaking stereotypes to home break-ins, Gabriel Iglesias brings comedy to life's unexpected twists in this stand-up special.

Entries.Title: The Academy
Entries.Description: A young South African woman from the outskirts of Cape Town learns the metaphors of life on the ocean as she prepares to compete in the Round Robben Island race with The Academy, an initiative of the historic Royal Cape Yacht Club.

Entries.Title: Prick
Entries.Description: After learning her husband has been in a life-threatening car crash, Ana must make a difficult decision.

Entries.Title: Hodgepodge
Entries.Description: Andrew Richter shares odd celebrity encounters from his years of working in hotels.

Entries.Title: Legend of Fry-Roti: Rise of the Dough
Entries.Description: On her 25th birthday, a biracial Navajo-Bengali woman hopes for a quiet celebration until her two aunties arrive unannounced igniting a chaotic bread-making battle that forces her to confront culture, family, and the recipe for belonging.

Entries.Title: Follow the Silenced
Entries.Description: For three years, a film crew intimately documented the lives of everyday Americans who have been seriously injured immediately following their COVID-19 vaccination. In the process of documenting these diverse stories across the US, the filmmakers uncovered a larger story behind a successful campaign to conceal the true scope of injuries from these vaccines.  What begins as a simple quest for appropriate medical care becomes an eye-opening journey that exposes the frightening reality behind the scenes of our nation’s healthcare system, federal regulatory agencies entrusted with our health and safety, and what has recently been described as “The Censorship Industrial Complex.”

Entries.Title: Million Dollar Extreme Presents: Extreme Peace
Entries.Description: After 10 years, Sam Hyde, Nick Rochefort, Charls Carroll, and Erick Hayden ARE BACK! The most controversial sketch comedy show of the decade returns with 6 brand new 30-minute episodes!

Entries.Title: Sins of My Husband
Entries.Description: Tony Dandridge is caught and exposed as a serial killer and is killed by the police. His wife Katherine claims that she knew nothing about her husband’s horrors, but the community and the press don’t believe it and torment her. Her very unlikely supporter is Doreen, the mother of the only victim of Dandridge’s to survive. It becomes a cat and mouse game as it appears possible that Katherine or Doreen may be lying or is it both of them?

Entries.Title: Before You Fade Away Into Nothing
Entries.Description: Tristan and Malik, two brothers who are five years apart, must face the cruel reality of their relationship after the unexpected death of their father.

Entries.Title: Ways to Fly
Entries.Description: When her barrettes mess up her pirouettes, an excitable, hyper-focused Black girl must power through the distractions -- and her mother's expectations -- to fly like the ballerinas do.

Entries.Title: Clean Water
Entries.Description: This epic, sprawling documentary film follows changemakers and inspiring people living along the Ohio River valley-- across 5 states-- striving to make the area a better place.

Entries.Title: Persons Unknown
Entries.Description: Xena, a paranoid and insecure woman who lives alone in New York City, sacrifices her humanity in exchange for the illusion of safety

Entries.Title: Shift
Entries.Description: A self-conscious teenage girl will do anything to look perfect. When she begins injecting herself with a mysterious cosmetic drug, her body soon takes a monstrous turn.

Entries.Title: Apophis 2029
Entries.Description: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

Entries.Title: Shoot the People
Entries.Description: Shoot The People is a documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Following Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

Entries.Title: I Am Anis
Entries.Description: When what was meant to be a joyous day turns into a dark revelations; Anisola Williams is forced to confront her hidden past.

Entries.Title: BAD SURVIVOR
Entries.Description: After being "broken up with" by her oncologists, a sarcastic young cancer patient — or should I say survivor — struggles to adjust to life at home with her multicultural family during her first day in remission. www.badsurvivor.com

Entries.Title: The Shape of Invisible Skies
Entries.Description: Seven shapes. Same sky. Lost, found, and lost again. Two souls meet across seven lifetimes — always in the spaces between.

2008 is a 10-minute comedy-drama starring Nickelodeon actress Michaela Jill Murphy and Anja Kao Nielsen, following a young girl navigating her dysfunctional queer household as California voted to repeal gay marriage during the 2008 election.

Entries.Title: Sugar Beach
Entries.Description: A brilliant yet haunted valedictorian seeks refuge in a passionate throuple, but when their intoxicating world unravels, she must confront her past before it destroys her.

Entries.Title: Long Away
Entries.Description: The film opens twenty-five years into the future on Victoria and her partner, Leah, discussing the risks and concerns for what Victoria is about to do: travel into her own past. Victoria's father passed away at a young age and she never got to really know him. Being a trans woman, Victoria is haunted by the question of if her father would accept her for who she truly is. She travels back in time to a comic store where her father works and gets the chance to meet him while being careful to not share who she is for risk of upsetting the timeline.

Entries.Title: A Hundred Acre Christmas
Entries.Description: An animated holiday movie based on Winnie the Pooh.

Entries.Title: Goodbye Horses: The Many Lives of Q Lazzarus
Entries.Description: A feature documentary about the life and music of singer-songwriter Diane Luckey, also known as Q Lazzarus. Q sang the hit song 'Goodbye Horses', which appeared in the Jonathan Demme films Married to the Mob and Silence of the Lambs, and had a brief moment of fame in the late 1980s/early 1990s before mysteriously disappearing for 25 years.

Entries.Title: Cristela Alonzo: Upper Classy
Entries.Description: Cristela seeks joy through various experiences - outdoing her old bully, overdoing spa treatments, and taking her first family vacation - while teaching everyone to embrace life's pleasures.

Entries.Title: Maldoror
Entries.Description: Arya, an aspiring novelist, begins work on her new book about a malevolent figure named Maldoror. As she writes, Maldoror comes to life and torments her in order to consume her soul. Arya fights to retain her sanity as the boundary between the written word and real world starts to blur.

Entries.Title: Home Turf
Entries.Description: Cassidy is the president of a small college whose life is thrown for a loop when freshmen on the football team move into her home. Can Logan, the handsome coach, help smooth things over?

Entries.Title: Centered: Joe Lieberman
Entries.Description: In a time of deep political division, Centered: Joe Lieberman chronicles the remarkable career of Joe Lieberman, a principled and bipartisan politician who navigated the tumultuous world of American politics with unwavering integrity, offering timely lessons on the power of collaboration and leadership beyond party lines.

Entries.Title: Dolls
Entries.Description: DOLLS follows Yan, a junior private investigator who goes undercover to attend a dating workshop for trans women.

Entries.Title: Monarch City
Entries.Description: A family divided. Surrounded by decay and despair in their dying small-town, each family member follows their own path and searches for an exit before the window of hope closes.

Entries.Title: Imagine Dragons - Live From The Hollywood Bowl (with the LA Film Orchestra)
Entries.Description: Globally renowned, GRAMMY® Award-winning band Imagine Dragons enlisted the LA Film Orchestra to perform their biggest hits and new chart-topping songs against the backdrop of the iconic Hollywood Bowl. The band fuses their explosive, cathartic sound with gorgeous, intricate symphonic arrangements played on stage by over 50 musicians.

Entries.Title: The Legend of Kingdom Come
Entries.Description: This feature documentary is an origin story about the beloved 90s-era graphic novel Kingdom Come, going behind the scenes and inside the mind of its creator: comic book legend Alex Ross.

Entries.Title: Hollywood Grit
Entries.Description: When his daughter vanishes from a Hollywood jazz club, a detective must battle mobsters, starlets, and his own demons to unearth the sinister truth lurking behind LA's neon lights.

Entries.Title: Paranormal Body Stream
Entries.Description: A top-secret space exploration turns paranormal when the crew discovers that they are not alone on the ship and could be part of a shocking alien experiment.

Entries.Title: A Christmas Murder Mystery
Entries.Description: Vera Vexley is the editor of the Metropolitan Ledger’s puzzle section, and a part-time consulting detective for the local sheriff’s office. This year, she has been invited to spend the holidays with family friends, the Sterlings, a wealthy family who appears to be hiding enough secrets to stuff a sleigh. Vera soon finds herself helming a murder investigation when someone is found dead on Christmas morning, putting her at odds with the quick-tempered and distraught family members. Can Vera find the culprit before the holidays turn even more deadly?

Entries.Title: Metallica: Poor Swedish Me '96
Entries.Description: Recorded live at Globen, Stockholm, Sweden on November 16, 1996.  Previously Unreleased. Audio is a collection of various bootlegs mixed together by Greg Fidelman. Concert Footage Edited by Brett Murray.

Entries.Title: Evil Puddle
Entries.Description: When evil, deadly water starts pooling around their feet, the citizens of Medialight must figure out a way stay alive until it evaporates.

Entries.Title: Mitski: The Land
Entries.Description: Filmed over three nights at Atlanta’s Fox Theatre in 2024, Mitski: The Land captures the artist at the height of her musical powers, showcasing music from “The Land Is Inhospitable snd So Are We” alongside re-workings and re-imaginings of songs from her expansive career.

Entries.Title: Crown of Shadows
Entries.Description: The Kingdom of Aberon has fallen into darkness under Queen Ginnarra's reign since she murdered the King. Exiled and hunted, her brother Prince Elderon joins a rebellion, summoning a dragon to defeat the Queen and the Dark Gods she serves.

Entries.Title: Found Footage Festival: 20th Anniversary Show
Entries.Description: Joe Pickett (The Onion) and Nick Prueher (Late Show) have over 14,000 VHS tapes in their collection and have been taking viewers on a guided tour through their latest and greatest finds since 2004. To celebrate two decades of this VHS nonsense, Joe & Nick will serve up their all-time greatest finds, including the dumbest exercise videos, the craziest public access shows, and updates with the most wonderful weirdos they’ve met along the way.

Entries.Title: Ninjago Legends: Monstrosity
Entries.Description: In search of his friends, Kai ventures into the mysterious Land of Monsters, where terrifying creatures lurk at every turn. He’s not the only one fighting for survival in this brutal environment... What horrors will Kai face on his journey?

Entries.Title: Oh Yeah!
Entries.Description: The story of the iconic electronic music group Yello and the phenomenon of their 1980's hit song, exploring the song’s cultural impact and its enduring place in the American psyche.

Entries.Title: Pound It?
Entries.Description: When a man seeks a casual hookup with a stranger, he unexpectedly confronts his own feelings of asexuality; leading to a conversation between the flings.

Entries.Title: Dan, En Pointe
Entries.Description: A young male ballet dancer who constantly practices on pointe shoes struggles with mounting pressure and a deep sense of guilt over his mother's failed ballet career.

Entries.Title: Free Leonard Peltier
Entries.Description: Leonard Peltier, one of the surviving leaders of the American Indian Movement, has been in prison for 50 years following a contentious conviction. A new generation of Native activists is committed to winning his freedom before he dies.

Entries.Title: Howler
Entries.Description: Poet Leni is on the eve of receiving a major award. Her son and publisher have arranged a party for her. While out on a walk in the woods, Leni receives an apocalyptic vision. She's convinced her award is a platform to share this vision as a warning to the world. Leni's family and friends are worried for her reputation as the party lights up with wild ideas and unusual images.

Entries.Title: Capharnaüm
Entries.Description: While desperately trying to finish his movie, a young filmmaker must face the imminent death of his father.

Entries.Title: DOLLS: PART ONE
Entries.Description: New York City transsexual socialite Bella drags her best friend Natasha to a gallery opening to meet her new love interest: the Marxist art curator Patrick Patrovsky. But things turn sour when the girls fall out over Bella's obsession with 'toxic trade' and the neglect of her friendships it results in.

Entries.Title: Desperate
Entries.Description: A young man, lost and vulnerable, becomes entangled in a deadly game of temptation and redemption, where nothing is as it seems when you have lost everything, what's left to lose but your soul.

Entries.Title: Life in the Cage
Entries.Description: Life at the movies, life in the cage. A lesson in box-office warfare and how to deal with hot tempers.

Entries.Title: Fragments of Us
Entries.Description: Two hearts navigate the shifting tides of love, marriage, and self-discovery, as their relationship teeters on the edge.

Entries.Title: Follow Me
Entries.Description: Pushing boundaries and blurring the lines between relationships to reveal that money, secrets and deception is a deadly mix.

Entries.Title: Untitled (Without Sound)
Entries.Description: A highfalutin art movie crumbles into a meta-fictional disaster that betrays its director’s incompetence in real time, and it’s all on film.

Entries.Title: Beauty in the Struggle II
Entries.Description: Jasmine is a hard-working stripper, struggling to make ends meet for herself and her son, Lil Jay, while trying to maintain a semblance of stability in their chaotic life. Her boyfriend, Mozzy, is wrongfully accused of a crime he didn't commit, further adding to the financial and emotional strain. Despite their challenges, Lil Jay is a kid with a good heart, trying to stay on the right path despite the turbulent environment around him.

Entries.Title: Jean Jacket
Entries.Description: Jean Jacket needs to win big at the lottery to get back her dreams. Will today be the day her number is drawn?

Entries.Title: UNALIVED
Entries.Description: Suspicions fly in a TikTok house when six wannabe influencers move in together to grow their followings—but begin dying one by one.  UNALIVED is a short satirical whodunnit that examines the depths to which we allow social media to take over our lives.

Entries.Title: The Great Cherokee Grandmother
Entries.Description: A pleasant date between a man of Cherokee heritage and a Caucasian woman goes downhill when the woman flagrantly fixates on the very bane of Cherokee peoples’ existence: the Cherokee Grandmother syndrome.

Entries.Title: A Tooth Fairy Tale
Entries.Description: Van, the brave son of a tooth fairy leader, meets the goblins girl Gemma on his first mission. Despite the myths about ancient disputes between fairies and goblins, they share common values. When the greedy Spider Queen threatens both tribes, they must work together.

Entries.Title: Lake George
Entries.Description: Four years after a heist gone wrong, two childhood friends, Rio and Psych, are thrust into a high-stakes journey. When Psych discovers his imprisoned father is being held for ransom with only 24 hours to pay $100,000, the pair embarks on a desperate mission to secure the funds.

Entries.Title: Murder in Glitterball City
Entries.Description: Louisville, Kentucky is the home of the glitterball, and after a body is found in a basement of a Victorian mansion, two lovers accuse each other of committing murder. What follows is an exploration of a toxic relationship in a town where ghosts and secrets don’t always stay buried.

Entries.Title: Crawlers
Entries.Description: In the year 2030, a zombie pandemic of biblical proportions decimates the United States' population. American survivors rush to Mexico to 'El Santuario del Sur', the southern sanctuary, a rocky plateau believed to be zombie free.

Entries.Title: Sight Unseen
Entries.Description: Three siblings inherit their estranged father's rural cabin after his mysterious death. They slowly realize someone, or something, still lives there.

Entries.Title: Harvest Brood
Entries.Description: In October 2006, the community of Briar, Alabama was terrorized by a series of gruesome killings. This film is an account of the horrors that unfolded during that fateful autumn.

Entries.Title: Identity Crisis
Entries.Description: What happens when ideology overtakes biology? "Identity Crisis" dives into one of the most polarizing debates of our time: the rise of gender ideology and its impact on children. Inspired by the cultural phenomenon "What Is a Woman?," this emotionally charged documentary shares deeply personal accounts from detransitioners, parents, and professionals fighting against a system that prioritizes political agendas over child welfare. "Identity Crisis" urgently invites viewers to reconsider the cost of reshaping identity.

Entries.Title: The Weeknd - Red Terror
Entries.Description: "Red Terror" visual picks up where "Open Hearts" leaves off. The Weeknd is portrayed as a mouthless child who appears to be chased by monsters through an ominous forest as he tries to shed his original form.

Entries.Title: Wind and Bone
Entries.Description: Wind and Bone is a psychological horror that delves into the darkness of the human psyche and the primal fear of the unknown...a woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural WV, where they come face to face with the Wendigo.

Entries.Title: Indigo Blue
Entries.Description: A desperate couple risks everything to secure life-saving surgery for their  sick daughter.

Entries.Title: Radiator Springs Racers | Disneyland Resort
Entries.Description: Start your engines! Because we're racing as part of the Disneyland® Resort 70th Celebration! Take a scenic and high-speed ride through Radiator Springs Racers in this immersive Point of View adventure. Tour Ornament Valley and arrive in Radiator Springs, the cutest little town in Carburetor County! From the roar of the engines to the charming Cadillac Range mountains, this Cars Land attraction has the perfect blend of heart and horsepower. Every twist, turn, and rev of the engine will have you experiencing the joy of seven decades of Disney imagination and innovative storytelling at top speed!

Entries.Title: The Evil That Binds Us
Entries.Description: In 1950s rural Chile, 13-year-old Daniel is sent to live with his German relatives while his father is away on business—only to clash with their rigid ways and uncover a dark secret that ignites his fury.

Entries.Title: Leo Rauf: Canticle
Entries.Description: During a peaceful day in New Orleans, Leo Rauf eats chicken.

Entries.Title: The Love Doctor
Entries.Description: A relationship coach helping others find holiday love faces his own healing after a breakup. Practice dates with shy client Emma spark real feelings, but ethical lines and a rival complicate their path.

Entries.Title: Malecón
Entries.Description: After a tragic incident in which he kills his abusive stepfather, Elvis is sent to prison and separated from his childhood sweetheart, Yuli. Once released he is dragged into the sordid world of prostitution in Cuba and faces a critical decision: fight to win back Yuli's love or flee to the United States and start a new life.

Entries.Title: Night of the Strangers
Entries.Description: A couples romantic getaway at a small town cabin goes horribly wrong when they are trapped by a murderous cult

Entries.Title: A Love Letter to My Parents
Entries.Description: Charles and Erica, a teenage couple living in 1990s Provo, Utah, have a teen pregnancy. This is their story.

Entries.Title: The Right to Remain Silent
Entries.Description: An awkward, off-kilter 20-something goes to get his closed off roommate, with whom he currently has an uncomfortable relationship, a couple of beers.

Entries.Title: Anunnaki Origins: Sumeria to South America
Entries.Description: The Sumerians worshiped Enki, a god of creation, wisdom and something far more mysterious. But the past refuses to stay buried. What if the myths were true?

Entries.Title: Forsaken Mercenary
Entries.Description: He's the deadliest man in the galaxy with a secret that could be his undoing.

Entries.Title: The Meathook Massacre
Entries.Description: After 3 young women encounter car trouble on the way to a concert, one-by-bloody-one they search for help and come face-to-face with Bubba and his freakish family of inbred maniacs.

Entries.Title: ASCO: Without Permission
Entries.Description: "ASCO: Without Permission" is a genre-defying film that profiles the extraordinary, Los Angeles based, Chicano art group of the 70's-80's, ASCO, who merged activism and art as they challenged representation in the art world, Hollywood and the news media. Unrecognized in their time, they are now being considered amongst the most important artists of the 20th century. Utilizing a wholly original approach to filmmaking where nonfiction and fiction are interconnected through collaborative film works made with the next generation of Latinx artists, "Without Permission" reimagines what is possible today in cinema and art while celebrating an iconoclastic group that was far ahead of its time.

Entries.Title: Mouthfeel
Entries.Description: After a tumultuous breakup with her powerful wine importer ex, struggling wine rep Rachel fights to carve out her own place in New York’s cutthroat beverage world—all while battling a fragile sobriety, temptation, and the ghosts of her past.

Entries.Title: The Idaho College Killer
Entries.Description: Witness a terrifying exploration inside the mind of a cold-blooded killer who stalks and murders a group of college students at a house in a small town in Idaho. Based on actual events.

Entries.Title: Emma and Bruce Willis: The Unexpected Journey – A Diane Sawyer Special
Entries.Description: Hosted by Diane Sawyer, the program offers an intimate look at Bruce Willis’s life following his frontotemporal dementia diagnosis, and the strength and advocacy of his wife, Emma Heming Willis.

Entries.Title: Give Me a Word: The Collective Soul Story
Entries.Description: Filmed at Elvis' Palm Springs getaway in early 2023, and containing archival footage from the band's early days, "Give Me a Word: The Collective Soul Story" is the definitive feature-length documentary on Collective Soul. Currently in their 31st year, "Give Me a Word" tells the untold story, the family component to the band, the creativity, and the wisdom that has been hard won over a three decades plus career.

Entries.Title: Now, Hear Me Good
Entries.Description: Booker is far from home but close to friends and mentors as he hosts an exuberant party, but when the noise of the party dies down and the last guests go home a listlessness returns to him. Only the next morning, while playing his trumpet, does he find his place in the stillness of the soft early light.

Entries.Title: Fatal Watch
Entries.Description: This gripping, true crime documentary set on the high seas exposes the largely unseen and fascinating world of fisheries observers, whose warnings about illegal fishing practices have resulted in fatal consequences for those sounding the alarm.

Entries.Title: The Legend of the Vagabond Queen of Lagos
Entries.Description: Jawu bears the mark of a warrior king but lives humbly, selling swallows at the local market, saving up for the better future she’s determined to build for herself and her son. The pair reside in the Agbojedo community, a floating slum planted in the lagoon that gives Lagos its name. Just as rumours begin circulating regarding government plans for new developments that would raze their homes, Jawu spies a corrupt politician burying a nest egg of cash. Struck by her good fortune, she takes the money for herself, thinking this might be her way out. Jawu doesn’t know that she is destined for a bigger battle that is yet to come.

Entries.Title: Rotting
Entries.Description: An experimental non-linear horror film portraying several surreal scenes of grotesque and violent acts

Entries.Title: Two Strangers Trying Not to Kill Each Other
Entries.Description: Life, death and making meaning are the heart of a beautiful and often very funny film about an aging couple who, after an accident, face the inevitability of impermanence and seek a deep peace in their relationship while they still can.

Entries.Title: Doctor Imperfect and the Perfect Man
Entries.Description: A failing scientist, Azrael Thran, decides to clone himself as a last minute effort to achieve success and escape his controlling father.

Entries.Title: Just Kids
Entries.Description: Three families with transgender children face an impossible choice in states banning gender-affirming care: stay home and risk their children's well-being or uproot entirely.

Entries.Title: White Man Walking
Entries.Description: In July 2020, Rob Bliss, a young, white filmmaker, posted a video of what happened when he held up a ‘Black Lives Matter’ sign in Harrison, Arkansas, 'the most racist town in America'. It went viral, attracting 12 million views. What Bliss did next was remarkable. Over 1500 miles, two months and 25 miles a day, he set out to walk through the American South, wearing a Black Lives Matter t-shirt, and a sign that invited people to ‘come walk with me’. His goal was simple: to take the conversation Floyd’s murder had sparked about racism in American society into the places where it was most needed, yet most silent.

Entries.Title: Tongue
Entries.Description: When a college student discovers her tongue can read minds through touch, she reluctantly teams up with her best friend to solve a mysterious death at a frat party—but as she licks her way through a parade of suspects, she uncovers a dark secret that could cost her more than just her sanity.

Entries.Title: A Giant Secret
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Thanks For Having Me
Entries.Description: A former YouTube star must reconnect with his opportunistic father while attempting to attain independence and come to terms with his exploited childhood.

Entries.Title: Density
Entries.Description: A narcotic noir Short Film following the destructive path of 4 flatmates, desperately seeking to enhance their fincancial and psychoactive situation. AKA: Oceans Eleven gone wrong between four unsuccessful Roommates.

Entries.Title: Guys' Night in The Thing
Entries.Description: A group of friends reuniting at a winter retreat are snowed in by the most heinous blizzard in history. But as the night goes on and a terrifying secret is uncovered in the nearby woods, it becomes clear that one of them is not what he seems...and not everyone will make it out alive.

Entries.Title: Girl Climber
Entries.Description: Professional climber Emily Harrington has summited Everest, 8000-meter peaks, and dominated the competition circuit but, her greatest challenge extends beyond the physical. To cement her legacy in the male dominated world of elite rock climbing, she sets her sights on a career-defining 24-hour ascent of Yosemite’s El Capitan.  Caught between the pursuit of personal ambition and the ticking biological clock of life, a near-fatal fall forces Emily to reckon with what she’s willing to risk. Equal parts gripping survival story and intimate portrait, Girl Climber isn’t just about breaking records, it’s about breaking barriers. Amongst Yosemite’s legendary boy’s club, Emily isn’t proving she is the best *Girl Climber-- she's proving she is one of the best. Period.

Entries.Title: Let Me Go!
Entries.Description: A Jewish girl and a Muslim boy are kidnapped and wake up inside an old RV. They must confront their differences and biases as they strive to survive and escape.

Entries.Title: Sell Out
Entries.Description: A neurotic novelist can’t tell if his biggest problem is the blank page, his Southern family —or his best friend’s off the rails political campaign.

Entries.Title: Demon Spawn
Entries.Description: A couple descends into darkness as they confront supernatural occurrences following the tragic loss of their newborn, blurring the lines between grief and the unexplained.

Entries.Title: I'm With the Band
Entries.Description: When a music-obsessed teenager gets a chance to meet his favorite band, he finds that  the lead singer he’s idolized isn’t the person he thought he was.

Entries.Title: Shadows of Willow Cabin
Entries.Description: Albert and Devon retreat to a remote cabin to explore a connection sparked by a string of sexually charged messages on a dating app. Albert is a closeted husband struggling with the collapse of his heterosexual identity; Devon is a wounded soul who uses fleeting affairs with married men to shield himself from his past. As their bond deepens, reality begins to fracture. The forest won’t let them leave. The walls whisper with voices they’ve tried to forget. And the cabin itself seems alive, bending time and conjuring personal ghosts in physical form. Trapped in a metaphysical bubble, the men must confront the truths they’ve spent their lives avoiding... before the cabin consumes them both. Shadows of Willow Cabin blends queer romance with supernatural horror. A moody, intimate, and chilling film that unspools like a fever dream.

Entries.Title: Debaters
Entries.Description: In a debate chamber, affluent high schoolers argue a bill on minimum wage in an effort to impress two working-class adult judges.

Entries.Title: Goodnight
Entries.Description: A hospice nurse revisits the comfort and fear of childhood when she hires a babysitter to take care of her for the night.

Entries.Title: Know Me
Entries.Description: Grief-stricken and unraveling, Kenson Joseph must overturn a barrage of false narratives propagated by the national news media and local Haitian church leaders to preserve his late brother’s memory and clear him of the public’s monstrous moniker: The Miami Zombie.

Entries.Title: Blue Check
