Entries.Description: After Elliot, an eighteen-year-old obsessed fan sneaks into his idol Lil Gouda's latest concert, he soon finds himself in over his head as he is pulled into Gouda's orbit. Elliot soon discovers Gouda's true colors, and he wants more.

Entries.Title: The Price of a Used Car
Entries.Description: Dominik is trying to sell his car but he has one particular request.

Entries.Title: The Curfew
Entries.Description: As Ayaan cares for his frail grandmother, specters from a colonial past pierce the silence of their language barrier and unsettle his comfortably assimilated life.

Entries.Title: We were no longer five
Entries.Description: Martha, a mother who lost trace of her son in the fighting, receives the news that no bone match was found in the last exhumation in which she had taken part. Having exhausted the institutional options, she turns to a group of women who look into such matters where she meets Sandra, who tells her a rumour: "in a remote village in the plain, you can ask a dead person for a favour". With Sandra, the two set out on a journey in search of answers, blurring the line between the living and the dead. Mothers who look for their children, children who look for their mothers: two parts of a same torment come together in the quest for peace.

Entries.Title: Shaolin Avengers
Entries.Description: Martial Club defend their makeshift school again the ruthless Wolf Fang Clan and their leader, the Wolf Fang Killa.

Entries.Title: Girl Who Vanished
Entries.Description: After Emily returns home years after her childhood abduction, her sister Lily and parents are overjoyed. But unsettling occurrences make Lily wonder if the nightmare is really over.

Entries.Title: An Arm and a Leg
Entries.Description: After getting into her dream college, Jenna quickly realizes that the price of tuition is far more expensive than she can afford. In a desperate attempt to earn some extra cash, she starts working some side hustles that she believes are sure to make her some dough. However, as the odd jobs keep getting odder, Jenna will come to realize that the cost of attending college is more than just money.

Entries.Title: I Didn't Like You
Entries.Description: As Emilia and Maxine spy on their best friend's first date, they come to realize the chemistry might not be between the couple they anticipated.

Entries.Title: Echoes of Us
Entries.Description: Through the intimate lens of Silo, a Black queer woman, "Echoes of Us" captures the bittersweet journey of revisiting a past love that once felt like "the one." Now in a joyful relationship, Silo is unexpectedly pulled back into old memories, exploring how heartbreak, growth, and healing shape who we become.

Entries.Title: Ether's Paradise
Entries.Description: An American girl in Thailand has a secret romance at a hidden waterfall with a local fisherman boy. Her father rips her away from the boy, but 10 years later, she returns to Thailand in search of a person and a place she once lost as a kid.

Entries.Title: A veces muerdo
Entries.Description: After Victoria, a young woman with anger issues, attacks her best friend by biting off a chunk of his face, she must confess what happened to her mother in order to try to find a solution to her behavior, even if it forces her to confront a beast just as dangerous as she is.

Entries.Title: The Promise
Entries.Description: Former bartender George Batra awaits his lost love's return after 20 years, hoping to reunite at the bar where they met and parted. As he waits for their fated reunion, he uncovers what he left behind.

Entries.Title: Super Connected
Entries.Description: A fiercely independent, anti-Big Tech film drama told through a Radiohead-esque song-track, challenging our relationship to screens in every frame.  A family's encounter with addictions to technology and social media takes a dark turn when a new immersive product enters their lives. Tim Arnold's debut film drama is a self-scored sci-fi 'screen album'. A feature length silent film set to 12 interlocking songs from the nationally acclaimed album of the same name. An experimental satire about big tech’s colonisation of our lives.

Entries.Title: XG: Live at Coachella 2025, Weekend 2
Entries.Description: XG performs at the Sahara tent during the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in Indio, Calif., Sunday, April 20, 2025.

Entries.Title: Virgin
Entries.Description: A horror movie about the birth of Jesus Christ

Entries.Title: UFC on ESPN 72: Dolidze vs. Hernandez
Entries.Description: UFC on ESPN 72: Dolidze vs. Hernandez (also known as UFC on ESPN: Dolidze vs. Hernandez and UFC Vegas 109) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on August 9, 2025, at the UFC Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

Entries.Title: Memoria Obscura
Entries.Description: In a world where memory erasure is a legitimate industry, the underground black market known as Memoria Obscura serves as a hub for stolen and repurposed memories.

Entries.Title: Get Off My Lawn
Entries.Description: A sweet suburban couple is terrorized by a deranged teenager and his friends after they purchase his grandfather's sacred home.

Entries.Title: Into Reality
Entries.Description: A troubled man keeps seeing an image he can't get out of his head. The answers may be more than he realizes.

Entries.Title: Afterwards
Entries.Description: A young man receives advice from his deceased grandfather about the afterlife when he suddenly starts to see said advice materialize.

Entries.Title: I Love This Arrangement
Entries.Description: A romcom with some timely social issues layered in.

Entries.Title: Siren of the Wood
Entries.Description: The Cherokee legend of the "Deer Woman" comes to life in this Cherokee-language thriller.

Entries.Title: Pardon Me
Entries.Description: Pardon Me: The Bevelyn B. Williams Story is a bold and gripping new biographical drama that brings to light the harrowing true story of a fearless pro-life activist who paid the ultimate price for standing on her convictions.

Entries.Title: Run, Jamie
Entries.Description: Following a little league softball game, a family of four’s journey home is interrupted by disaster: Mark, the family patriarch, has to shit.

Entries.Title: The Moment Before
Entries.Description: In Dublin, a restless teenager and a mysterious woman cross paths by chance. What starts as an ordinary conversation soon reveals hidden truths, forcing them to confront their deepest fears and regrets. In a single, unexpected moment, their lives may change forever. The Moment Before.

Entries.Title: Remember To Enjoy The Light Before It’s Gone
Entries.Description: In this reflective short film, the Weeknd speaks to his younger self, encouraging him to ask questions about the future and remember the light before it's all gone.

Entries.Title: Naked Ambition
Entries.Description: Bunny Yeager, once heralded as the world's prettiest photographer, had a huge influence in 20th-century pop culture though few people know her name. Whether by popularizing the bikini, helping discover Bettie Page, shaping the image of Playboy or inventing the selfie, Bunny was a trailblazer whose work bucked against conservative 1950s America and helped pave the way for the feminist movement and the sexual revolution. Yet the very changes she helped usher in would soon render her a forgotten relic...till now.

Entries.Title: You Need This
Entries.Description: A revealing film about the vicious cycle of consumerism and the destructive power of hyper-capitalism. Can we break the grip of the system before it is too late?

Entries.Title: The Path of Paige Bueckers
Entries.Description: Paige Bueckers' story of overcoming injuries and losses to become one of the top players in women's college basketball and one of the biggest personalities in social media.

Entries.Title: Showcase
Entries.Description: An anxious man seeking distraction joins a tour group at an art gallery.

Entries.Title: The Splinter!!!
Entries.Description: Mark Normand attemps to remove a splinter from Joe List's foot. Will he succeed?

Entries.Title: Cornucopia
Entries.Description: Nearing a cult's prophesized cosmic exaltation, the founder and his son grapple with their diverging worldviews and life priorities.

Entries.Title: #RUNSEOKJIN_EP.TOUR in AMSTERDAM: LIVE VIEWING
Entries.Description: Starting in Goyang, and continuing through Japan, North America, and Europe, Jin embarks on a journey to connect with his beloved ARMY through his very first solo fan concert tour. Experience Jin’s one-of-a-kind music and performances from his August 9 show in AMSTERDAM - featuring tracks from his second solo album, “Echo”, along with his debut solo album, “Happy” - broadcast live on the big screen!

Entries.Title: Dream On – Ducati and Bagnaia’s Pursuit of Glory
Entries.Description: The documentary retraces the final three Grands Prix of the 2024 MotoGP season, allowing the audience to experience exclusive moments inside the garage, the paddock, and off the track. It again highlights Francesco Bagnaia’s determination, talent, and spirit while closely following the head-to-head battle between the rider from Turin and the newly crowned World Champion, Jorge Martín.

Entries.Title: Big Mountain Soul: Ski Africa
Entries.Description: Join the Big Mountain Soul group on an extraordinary journey through the breathtaking landscapes of Morocco, carving new trails in the world of Ski Mountaineering. On a mission to spread the message that the mountains are for everyone, the Big Mountain Soul group takes the emotional journey to motherland Africa. Challenging perceptions, redefining the spirit of adventure and cultural connection.

Entries.Title: Mike Vecchione: Low Income White
Entries.Description: Mike Vecchione’s “Low Income White” turns clean comedy on its head with a razor-sharp set that’s equal parts smart, self-deprecating, and relentlessly funny. With the gritty rhythm of the Northeast and the polish of a comedy veteran, Vecchione unloads a barrage of fast-paced, observational humor that hits on everything from aging and generational divides to the absurdity of modern life.  Navigating the world with sarcastic precision and deadpan charm, Vecchione doesn’t pull punches—but he doesn’t play favorites either. No one is safe, including himself. It’s clean comedy with an edge, and a masterclass in making the mundane feel hilariously high-stakes.

Entries.Title: Ouija: A New Beginning
Entries.Description: Molly Price is a woman on the run, but when her oldest daughter finds a Ouija board and attempts to communicate with her deceased father, she invites the spirit of an ancient witch into her soul and puts the entire family at risk.

Entries.Title: Heightened Scrutiny
Entries.Description: Amid the surge in anti-trans legislation that Chase Strangio battles in the courtroom, he must also fight against media bias, exposing how the narratives in the press influence public perception and the fight for transgender rights.

Entries.Title: Loulou
Entries.Description: Loulou is a coming-of-age story about Louie, a 17-year-old transgender girl struggling with her secret desire to live as a woman while being raised by a strict conservative father and insecure mother. Louie finds escape by developing a relationship with her homophobic bully, Tony.

Entries.Title: Paperweight
Entries.Description: Bill Walker faces a life-changing decision when he receives his draft card for the Vietnam War. Torn between his father's patriotic expectations and his mother's fear for his life, Bill must choose whether to answer the call or disregard.

Entries.Title: I Don't Like It Here
Entries.Description: A recently paroled outsider returns to his desolate hometown, only to find a community plagued by a disturbing darkness. As he grapples with his own past and the town’s sinister secrets, he becomes the prime suspect in a series of gruesome murders.

Entries.Title: The Fish Thief: A Great Lakes Mystery
Entries.Description: In the early twentieth century, a mysterious ecological crisis nearly wiped out the fish that most people cared about in the largest freshwater ecosystem on earth—the Great Lakes. The impact reverberated across the region, ruining local industries, damaging small town economies and indigenous communities, and destroying the livelihoods of people in the United States and Canada. With little reason for hope, a dedicated group of scientists, policymakers, and conservationists tackled the mystery.

Entries.Title: The Artist and His Canvas
Entries.Description: An experimental film revolving around how an artist perceives a man and a woman.

Entries.Title: Of Shadows
Entries.Description: A man named Ben wakes up with no memory and a gun against his head. Aster, a grizzly and mysterious man, offers Ben the opportunity to join him on the way to sanctuary. On the way to this sanctuary, Aster explains to Ben that the world that he may remember is gone and he must now live the rest of his life hiding from vampires who rule the world.

Entries.Title: RB&O Live 2025/26: Cinderella
Entries.Description: Stuck at home and put to work by her spoiled Step-Sisters, Cinderella’s life is dreary and dull. Everything changes when she helps a mysterious woman out...With a little bit of magic, she is transported into an ethereal new world – one where fairies bring the gifts of the seasons, where pumpkins turn into carriages, and where true love awaits.

Entries.Title: Other Side
Entries.Description: Activist Lynda Bluestein contemplates how to legally end her life - her landmark lawsuit made Medical Aid in Dying in Vermont accessible to anyone in the United States. This is an intimate portrait of finding a way to die peacefully in the U.S.

Entries.Title: Bobo in Bliss
Entries.Description: Bowen, a Singaporean teenager studying in an American boarding school is visited by her traditional parents and younger sister. While the visit includes the anticipated Annual Fall Dinner at her boarding school, it is evident that they may not have left on the best of terms; the tension is piercing. The dramatic central question: is Bowen able to reconcile the differences between their values and her affirming self-discoveries.

Entries.Title: Night Shift
Entries.Description: Unaware that a serial killer is stalking clerks at 24-hour convenience stores, Debra reluctantly takes the night shift at her minimum-wage gas station job after her co-worker disappears. What begins as routine shelf-stocking and floor-sweeping quickly spirals into a heart-pounding descent into paranoia, dread, and blood-soaked madness as the killer closes in.

Entries.Title: The True Beauty of Being Bitten by a Tick
Entries.Description: After a disturbing event, Yvonne drives down to her friend Camille’s bucolic new home for some time away. She’s welcomed by A.J. and Isaac, two new friends of Camille, who also maybe live there. The group promises a weekend of homemade meals from fresh, local produce and parlor games by candlelight.  But when Yvonne develops troubling symptoms from a tick bite, the rural paradise fades away revealing a breeding ground for a disturbing new life.

Entries.Title: Noseeums
Entries.Description: Fresh from her toxic relationship, a curious college student, Ember reluctantly agrees to a weekend trip with her roommate and wealthy white "friends" to a secluded lake house in the Florida backwoods. Once she arrives at this unsettling land, it becomes familiar as she unearths troubled spirits that owned it and seeks to reclaim it

Entries.Title: Say Who Die
Entries.Description: The tale of a set of twins whose bond is tested by secrets, family dysfunction, and choices that spiral into chaos.

Entries.Title: Laura Bozzo
Entries.Description: This documentary narrates the history of one of Latin America’s most influential TV divas, Laura Bozzo. With exclusive access to her intimate life, we’ll explore a thrilling, controversial, and unique story.

Entries.Title: The Bleeding Dark
Entries.Description: After a brutal assault leaves his wife dead and his teenage son traumatized, a single father must battle his grief and the destruction it leaves behind, as the darkness in their home begins to take on a life of its own.

Entries.Title: DISC
Entries.Description: The story of a hookup gone too far up.

Entries.Title: You, Me & Her
Entries.Description: On their first vacation after having a baby, Mags and Ash attempt to rekindle the spark in their marriage but can’t help arguing the whole trip. When Mags meets Angela, they have an instant connection that makes Mags seriously question her sexuality for the first time. Suddenly Ash and Mags start to reconnect over the idea of having a threesome in hopes that the excitement of the potential sexual experience will save their marriage.

Entries.Title: The Legend of the Happy Worker
Entries.Description: Follows Joe who battles to save what he and others have spent years building.

Entries.Title: SOURCE: It's Within You
Entries.Description: For the first time in history, an in-depth study has been performed that allows science to define what happens when we meditate. Following the same protocols for pharmaceutical studies, scientists from the University of California San Diego were able to extract data from thousands of people all over the world, using a Dr. Joe Dispenza retreat as their testing grounds. This documentary reveals never before seen data on how meditation shapes everything from our mind to the tiniest cell molecules in our body. You are asked to come along on a journey to see how science has proven how powerful we are as humans through thought alone. Heal, expand, and be inspired by the potential of humanity in this groundbreaking documentary.

Entries.Title: The House Was Not Hungry Then
Entries.Description: While searching for her estranged father, a young woman breaks into an empty house in the countryside where every visitor disappears. Now she must avoid the man posing as a real estate agent who lures victims inside.

Entries.Title: Outlandish
Entries.Description: A sheltered child ventures out of their safe house into a dangerous forest in search of their missing friend.

Entries.Title: Pulpitum
Entries.Description: Determined to find her missing sister, Claire investigates her small town’s mysterious church rituals and battles fragmented visions, cryptic encounters, ever-present surveillance, and a dangerously unorthodox society.

Entries.Title: Macabre
Entries.Description: Two women working in a gallery after hours are visited by an uninvited guest with a twisted flare for the arts and a nefarious agenda.

Entries.Title: Coldplay - Live In Ahmedabad
Entries.Description: Coldplay presents their iconic Music of the Spheres World Tour concert live from Ahmedabad, in their biggest ever concert.

Entries.Title: My Guardian Angel
Entries.Description: A hapless guardian angel's first day on the job.

Entries.Title: Tony Allen: The Grindfather
Entries.Description: This documentary chronicles Allen’s journey from his childhood in Chicago, to his collegiate career in Stillwater, Okla., to his time in Boston and finally his home in Memphis, showcasing the moments that defined the Grit & Grind era and shaped the Grizzlies and Allen himself.

Entries.Title: She's the He
Entries.Description: On the last week of school, Alex and Ethan pretend to be trans women to get into the girl’s lockers. It’s all a joke until Ethan realizes: she really is trans. Now Alex and Ethan must reckon with their changing friendship and the messy process of coming out.

Entries.Title: Portal to Hell
Entries.Description: After a debt-collector finds a portal to hell in a washing machine at his local laundromat, he’s propositioned into feeding it sinners to save his neighbor’s soul, maybe even at the expense of his own.

Entries.Title: Charliebird
Entries.Description: Al is a devoted music therapist at a children’s hospital in Texas. Charlie is the rebellious teen patient assigned to work with her. When Charlie reveals a secret passion project, and professional lines begin to blur, the two forge an unexpected bond that will teach them both how to live.

Entries.Title: Woman in the Sky
Entries.Description: Magda Salvesen met American painter Jon Schueler in Scotland in 1970. A few months later, he made a will leaving her the entire body of his work. A film about art, love, responsibility, legacy and the one-way march of time.

Entries.Title: La celebración
Entries.Description: Alejandra and her tow daughters buy groceries at the supermarket, to celebrate the end of the schoolyear. Since she can't afford all of it, she decides to steal a couple of things.

Entries.Title: TMNT: Evolution, Mutation, and Reboot
Entries.Description: The filmmakers behind Turtle Power return for another definitive deep dive into the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, focusing on how the Turtles evolved over time and adapted to new generations, yet retained the essence of what made them unique in the first place.

Entries.Title: Aaron Hernandez and the Untold Murders of Bristol
Entries.Description: An exploration of the unique circumstances in Bristol, Connecticut, that fostered a community intertwined with violence, focusing on three former high school football teammates who later became murderers.

Entries.Title: The Trees Were Spelling Love Backwards
Entries.Description: "During Covid, I was contacted online by a woman who lived in Berlin - a French-Caribbean singer and performance artist. She said she was a fan of my work and we started corresponding. These text messages turned into nightly Zoom calls which turned into a desire to meet in person. But travel restrictions in Germany and the US limited our choice to a handful of countries, one of which was England. She had a friend in London with an apartment that was going to be empty at the same time that my ex-wife was taking our kids to Maine for two weeks. So we decided to meet there. She wanted us to make a film together so I suggested we make a film about our relationship." - Caveh Zahedi

Entries.Title: Aladdin 3477: The Jinn of Wisdom
Entries.Description: In the year 3477, a resourceful Hong Kong thief's obsession with the Princess of India propels him on a globe-trotting odyssey, where he crosses paths with an enigmatic ancient sage.

Entries.Title: In The Light Of The Moon
Entries.Description: After losing the love of his life, Anton captures the woman who took her. Now he must find a way to save his love before it is too late.

Entries.Title: Witches' Rave
Entries.Description: When a sleep deprived office worker who keeps having nightmares of his mother when he was a child, him and his irritable coworker go on the search for the only piece of information connecting the dream to his mom; a mysterious, surreal place only referred to as the “Witches’ Rave”.

Entries.Title: All Alone Together
Entries.Description: As a tormented filmmaker reaches new levels of success, the horrors of his film start to creep into his life.

Entries.Title: Film and TV Charity 'Break the Cycle'
Entries.Description: Break The Cycle is our powerful new film that highlights the stressful reality for many industry workers – and how the Film and TV Charity is working to provide support.

Entries.Title: harmoe 3rd LIVE TOUR "ii’m here"
Entries.Description: 3rd LIVE TOUR "ii'm here" is harmoe's third live tour, and was performed in three shows on September 8th, 14th, and 16th, 2024. It primarily featured songs from radii.

Entries.Title: Sandra
Entries.Description: Jane's predictable life with her boyfriend is upended when she finds out that a mysterious and erratic woman has been living in her basement.

Entries.Title: Viva
Entries.Description: A clandestine operation for freedom faces collapse when a shocking betrayal ignites a fiery confrontation between two key revolutionaries on the morning of their planned uprising.

Entries.Title: Stuart Laws Has to Be Joking?
Entries.Description: Last year Stuart started telling the truth on stage and was diagnosed autistic: he got the best reviews he’s ever got and his show was a must-see. He's back baby! And has to lean into it further. It’s funny, it’s real, it’s immaculately structured and it’s a chance to see a comedian at the top of his game.

Entries.Title: 7 Days to Hell
Entries.Description: JJ has just made a deal with the Devil herself. He's tasked with an ominous goal: collect seven souls in seven days. With the clock ticking, there's only one thing that can stop him. Love.

Entries.Title: There's Something In My Eye
Entries.Description: Jenny spirals into paranoia when she discovers something in her eye. The problem is nobody else can see it but Jenny. Is it real, or just her imagination?

Entries.Title: Antidote
Entries.Description: An award-winning film that exposes the cost of opposing Vladimir Putin. FRONTLINE presents the stories of an investigative journalist and a political activist putting their lives on the line standing up to the Kremlin and the consequences.

Entries.Title: Night Bloom
Entries.Description: In the middle of a quiet but restless night, Hazel and her father Mackie find themselves confined to their respective corners of their Bronx apartment months into the pandemic. Unable to settle into sleep or find respite, Mackie suggests they go on a drive. With no destination in mind the pair aimlessly roam the empty streets and highways of the Bronx and Manhattan sharing pockets of silence, adrenaline and eventually arriving upon a confrontation with Mackie's past.

Entries.Title: A Girl Like Him
Entries.Description: In a small, close-knit town, lifelong best friends Lena Grey and Justin Beckett have always been each other's world. But both have been holding a deep secret from the other. As another summer comes to an end, the burden of those secrets starts to unravel.

Entries.Title: Redbird (Totsu)
Entries.Description: A Cherokee woman fights to protect her niece from an unlawful adoption by her white grandparents as she reckons with feeling distant from her own culture.

In this short coming of age period piece (if you will), three friends must navigate the ups and downs of their ever-changing adolescent friendship as they grow together and life takes them each in different directions.

Entries.Title: Young Steppas 2
Entries.Description: While living in the city of New Orleans with pimps, hustlers, drug dealers, killers and carjackers. One brother fights to live out his dreams of becoming a basketball superstar.

Entries.Title: Extremely Unique Dynamic
Entries.Description: Ryan and Daniel, two childhood best friends and aspiring actors, spend one final weekend together before RYAN has to move to Canada with his fiancé. Wanting to create one lasting memory, they decide to make a movie... about two guys making a movie.. about two guys making a movie. Along the way, they unpack their decades-long friendship and prepare for the next chapters of their respective lives.

Entries.Title: To Get Her
Entries.Description: NEW BET+ ORIGINAL MOVIE. A mother teams up with unexpected partners to rescue her daughter who disappeared abroad.

Entries.Title: Trainwreck: Mayor of Mayhem
Entries.Description: Rob Ford scandalized Canadian politics as the brash yet beloved mayor of Toronto — until an infamous video of him smoking crack sparked his downfall.

Entries.Title: Scariest Woman Alive
Entries.Description: Two friends retreat to a cabin in the mountains to reckon with their personal demons while attempting to lift each other's spirits.

Entries.Title: Faith in the Flames: The Nichole Jolly Story
Entries.Description: Nichole Jolly is a nurse at the town’s hospital, who begins her day as usual, only to face an unimaginable crisis when a wildfire rapidly engulfs the town. Torn between her duty to protect her patients and her desperate need to find her husband Nick, (Colin Moss) and children, Nichole discovers an unyielding strength within herself to save not only her family but countless residents from the encroaching flames. The film is a tribute to the indomitable human spirit and the unsung heroes who emerge in the face of tragedy.

Entries.Title: Exhibition on Screen: Caravaggio
Entries.Description: Five years in production, this is the most extensive film ever made about one of the greatest artists of all time – Caravaggio. Featuring masterpiece after masterpiece and with first-hand testimony from the artist himself on the eve of his mysterious disappearance, this beautiful new film reveals Caravaggio as never before. Multi-award-winning filmmakers David Bickerstaff and Phil Grabsky delve into the hidden narratives of Caravaggio’s life, piecing together clues embedded within his incredible art. The intriguing self-depictions within his works — sometimes disguised, sometimes in plain sight — offer a rare window into his psyche and personal struggles. Join us as we unravel the story of one of history’s most brilliant, complex and controversial figures.

Entries.Title: Pimple Patch
Entries.Description: A mutated patch of pimples manifests on Nathan's face right before an audition. Now, he must decide whether to make a bloody sacrifice to book the role.

Entries.Title: Cuckoo
Entries.Description: A malfunctioned pregnant robot escaped to a state where robots are banned. She now tries to untangle her fragmented mind before being terminated.

Entries.Title: Salome - Opera Ballet Vlaanderen
Entries.Description: Herod lusts after his stepdaughter Salome and insists on seeing her dance. Salome longs to kiss the mouth of the imprisoned John the Baptist – a prophet of doom who loses himself in hate speech.

Entries.Title: Blake Buried A Body
Entries.Description: After 12-year-old Charlie kills a kayaker, his troubled older brother, Blake, attempts to hide the evidence. As Blake grapples with overwhelming guilt, he faces the surreal and horrific consequences of his actions.

Entries.Title: WrestleMania IX: Becoming a Spectacle
Entries.Description: Follow the making of the Las Vegas WrestleMania in 1993 that paved the path forward for the WWF. From the chaos outside Caesars Palace to the action inside the ring, pull back the curtain on the "World's Largest Toga Party" with an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the event.

Entries.Title: Tether
Entries.Description: Three years after a school shooting that took his daughter’s life, a grieving father crosses paths with the clinically depressed ex-school resource officer who froze on the fateful day. As their paths collide and their downward spirals converge, what darkness will their encounter unleash?

Entries.Title: Hyde
Entries.Description: A dark comedy about a prisoner's last meal on death row.

Entries.Title: Hollywood Gala II - Award Night at the Symphony
Entries.Description: Music is a crucial element in every Oscar-winning film. In this album you will be taken on a musical journey through the sounds of the greatest Oscar winners of all time, from classics like Casablanca and Citizen Kane to monumental cinematic works like The Godfather - blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry in the darkness of the cinema.  The Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, solo singers and hosts are ready on stage to bring these classics and blockbusters to life with Music from Robin Hood, James Bond, The Mission, Apocalypse Now, Breakfast at Tiffany’s, Dances with Wolves and more.  We don't watch films with our eyes only, but also with our ears. Music elevates the story, brings the characters to life and draws us into the story, and often the notes resonate within us and evoke memories long after the film is over.

Entries.Title: The Nuclear Frontier
Entries.Description: Follows young advocates and business leaders as they fight to expand nuclear power in America. They must overcome the power source’s controversial past, as they tackle policy and financial challenges to unlock its transformative potential as a clean baseload energy source.

Entries.Title: Dinosaur Farm B&W
Entries.Description: Dinosaur Farm in black and white this time.

Entries.Title: Ruby Red Handed: Stealing America's Most Famous Pair of Shoes
Entries.Description: When a pair of Ruby Slippers from The Wizard of Oz is stolen, two small-town Minnesota cops must crack the case that makes headlines around the world.

Entries.Title: Bron Lewis - Probably
Entries.Description: With impeccable timing and fantastic observational humour. Bron Lewis talks about her family, attacking magpies, her hometown. A recurring theme is avoidance and how it, as a coping with life mechanism, is not perhaps a good choice. Better perhaps to aspire to be the 1980’s Chico Roll lady.

Entries.Title: Space Mutation
Entries.Description: The starship Cangqiong rescues the survivors of the Genesis during its return journey. However, during the rescue, they unexpectedly encounter an alien invasion. Faced with a battle of human nature and the relentless hunt of monstrous creatures, how will the crew of Cangqiong escape from this deadly space chamber?

Entries.Title: Dope Queens
Entries.Description: A fluorescent, action-packed romantic thriller where three undeniably remarkable friends move to San Francisco after meeting in protective custody. Despite being free, as a chosen family they find themselves locked in a prison of their own making.

Entries.Title: The Roots of To Your Eternity
Entries.Description: Take a deep dive into the fascinating creative journey of the beloved To Your Eternity series through exclusive statements from its manga and anime creators, including Oima Yoshitoki, Kiyoko Sayama, and more. With narration by Kenjiro Tsuda, this documentary features footage to illustrate the past arc to prepare the new adventure in the contemporary arc and beyond.

Entries.Title: Don't Be Long, Little Bird
Entries.Description: American-born teen, Rima the Lost One, unites with her great-grandmother, also named Rima, on a time-travel journey to 1930s Palestine. After clashing with her modern-ish Mom on vacation, Rima the Lost One finds herself warped through a portal that takes her to the present of her ancestors. Rima the Lost One must navigate her ancestral homeland, a place she’s never known. She desperately looks for a way home, aka the present, the place she originally desired to escape from.

Entries.Title: News Without A Newsroom
Entries.Description: As local newsrooms vanish, "News Without a Newsroom" explores journalism's uncertain future in the digital age. Through powerful stories and expert insights, the film examines the collapse of traditional media, the rise of misinformation, and the fight to preserve truth, trust and accountability in an era of disruption.

Entries.Title: Out of Plain Sight
Entries.Description: From Pulitzer Prize-finalist Rosanna Xia and Academy Award®-winning L.A. Times Studios, OUT OF PLAIN SIGHT is a cinematic exposé of an environmental disaster lurking just off the coast of Southern California.  Not far from Catalina Island, aboard one of the most-advanced research ships in the world, David Valentine discovered a corroded barrel on the seafloor that gave him chills. The full environmental horror sharpens into greater clarity once he calls Los Angeles Times journalist Rosanna Xia, who pieces together a shocking revelation: In the years after World War II, as many as half a million barrels of toxic waste had been quietly dumped into the ocean – and the consequences continue to haunt the world today.

Entries.Title: Milk Baby
Entries.Description: MILK BABY follows Kei’s journey, as her innocent entry into a maternity home blurs into a nightmare - leaving her the prisoner of a frightening reality.

Entries.Title: Big Jay Oakerson: Them
Entries.Description: Part 1 of Big Jay Oakerson's two-part crowd work comedy special, filmed live in Denver at Comedy Works.

Entries.Title: Em & Selma Go Griffin Hunting
Entries.Description: In the Depression-ravaged countryside of 1930s America, adolescent girls are expected to fulfill a long-standing rite in which they hunt and slay a mythical beast of their mother’s choosing.

Entries.Title: Alone in The After
Entries.Description: Matthew and his sisters have spent their entire lives on a secluded farm, far removed from the outside world. Following the passing of their father, they uncover a long-held family secret that thrusts them into a terrifying new reality.

Entries.Title: Couples Retreat
Entries.Description: A struggling couple invites their friends to a double-date weekend at an isolated cabin, but their plans for relaxation are thrown into chaos when one friend shows up without his girlfriend.

Entries.Title: Can You Hear the Sea?
Entries.Description: A young woman awakes to the soothing sounds of a guided meditation - only to find herself bound and gagged.

Entries.Title: Karunrung 1995
Entries.Description: In the heat of the traditional market in Makassar City, a gang of thugs led by Uli spread terror and fear. Until one day, a rich businessman, Hendra, offers him a dirty job with big pay, everything turns into a cruel massacre that not only takes lives, but also arouses anger from other realms.  A family of Burhan, Farida, his pregnant wife and their children, were sadistically massacred without mercy and justice was not only sought by the police or an ambitious journalist named Alana, assisted by her lover Andi, but also by the victim's spirit which could not rest. When guilt, fear and supernatural terror begin to haunt the perpetrators, one by one they begin to lose control.

Entries.Title: The Space You Need
Entries.Description: Sci-Fi Author Julian and Aluminium CEO Leo are in a slump in their relationship. So when Leo gets the chance to join the test flight of a new space travel company is it just the space they need to get back on track? The Space You Need is a unique queer romantic comedy set in the world of Dexter Intergalactic Endeavours, the world's first ever low cost alternative commercial spaceline.

Entries.Title: Night Shoot
Entries.Description: A college documentary project goes awry when a group of film students stumble on a strange, wooded homeless community, and slowly discover they’re the ones being watched.

Entries.Title: Hot Breath/Cold Air
Entries.Description: Fates align as a moody non-believer meets the woman of his dreams, and both of their groups of friends have to deal with the consequences.

Entries.Title: Don't Trip
Entries.Description: After getting fired from his assistant job, a young struggling screenwriter hatches a plan to befriend a powerful producer’s troubled nepo-baby son in order to sell his screenplay. But when the nepo-baby learns of his plan things go awry.

Entries.Title: and the heavens must have cried
Entries.Description: It's 1968 in Malibu beach: a year before the most infamous women of the Manson Family made gruesome national headlines. When follower Susan Atkins writes a vinyl record for the man she loves, it begins to spin out of her control.

Entries.Title: Avrio Vrady
Entries.Description: A man begins dancing in a restaurant on a quiet night to a tune that no one seems to be able to hear except himself.

Entries.Title: The line
Entries.Description: A security guard who also traffics drugs is forced to take on a trade at the museum where he works, but things get complicated when his clumsy sister shows up for the exchange.

Entries.Title: Everyone Is Lying to You for Money
Entries.Description: A scathing portrait of the world of cryptocurrency.

Entries.Title: The Raven of Baltimore City
Entries.Description: After a deadly encounter with a purse snatcher, a comic-book-obsessed man  sets out to become a masked superhero, putting himself on course to discover his inner villain in this darkly comic crime film.

Entries.Title: Kitsch
Entries.Description: When an overly tidy man moves into a new apartment, a remnant of the previous tenants threatens his control of the space and his grip on sanity.

Entries.Title: Disabled AF
Entries.Description: Jess is moving out, and her friends Marsha and Imani are down to help, until they realize they have a traitor in their midst.

Entries.Title: My Father and Qaddafi
Entries.Description: ​​When Jihan was six years old, her father flew to Cairo and never returned. Mansur Rashid Kikhia was the Foreign Minister of Libya, ambassador to the United Nations, and a human rights lawyer. After serving in Qaddafi's increasingly brutal regime, he defected from the government and became a peaceful opposition leader. Kikhia was obsessively loyal to his country but ultimately, his determination to reason with Qaddafi led to his disappearance from a hotel in Egypt in 1993.

Entries.Title: There Are Aliens in Phoenix
Entries.Description: Made for the Mountain Ridge Flim's, 2nd Annual 48hr Film Festival  Local slack-jaw conspiracy theorist, Cletus (Chrysan Martin) gets word of an abnormal event near him and drags his more level-headed friend Randall (Noah Lefley-Laurant) to find an alien.

Entries.Title: Between Borders
Entries.Description: In a crumbling Soviet Union, the Petrosyan family finds themselves as outcasts—wherever they go. Their Armenian heritage marks them for discrimination, first in their home country of Azerbaijan and then in Russia. After finding their eternal hope through a church planted by American missionaries, the hostility of everyday life pushes them to seek refuge in the United States. In the shadow of exile, hope became their home. Based on a riveting true story of faith and hope set amidst great oppression.

Entries.Title: Robbers
Entries.Description: Inspired by a viral theft trend, a wannabe musician schemes to afford studio time by convincing his bassist to burglarize a small business—but someone else might have the same idea.

Entries.Title: Take It Away
Entries.Description: The rise of Latin music is explored through the lens of the groundbreaking Johnny Canales Show, a pioneering television program that showcased the genre and became a microcosm of the Latino experience in America.

Entries.Title: Blood Weekend
Entries.Description: Witness the debut of a brand-new crazed masked killer, The Necrobutcher! Ingrid & her gal pals hike into the woods for a rustic bachelorette party at an isolated farm. Meanwhile, Professor Michelle Pleasant has let the crazed killer The Necrobutcher escape and must team up with psychic detective Graveyard John to track down this psycho. Blood and guts fly in Blood Weekend!

Entries.Title: Outsighter
Entries.Description: After witnessing a traumatic event, Jessie seeks the help of Don, a mysterious guide who offers the ability to transport people to either the past or the future. Desperate to escape her harsh reality, Jessie faces an irreversible decision and chooses to step into the unknown: the future, becoming an 'outsighter'

Entries.Title: Skrillex LIVE @ ULTRA MUSIC FESTIVAL MIAMI 2025
Entries.Description: After 10 years, Skrillex is back to Ultra Music Festival Miami.

Entries.Title: Weird Kisses
Entries.Description: Internet friends in Johannesburg, New York City, and Seattle explore intimacy in their offline lives.

Entries.Title: What She Doesn't Know
Entries.Description: The Film focuses on a group of high school seniors grappling with the reality of moving away to college. As if senior year couldn't be stressful enough, there is also a serial killer on the loose.

Entries.Title: Dog Fugitive
Entries.Description: A brutally honest dog psychiatrist, Dr. Fluffy, skips town when her patient is accused of killing their cheating husband and Dr. Fluffy thinks she's to blame.

Entries.Title: Risqué
Entries.Description: Fired from a strip club, a vengeful dancer masterminds a high-stakes heist with fellow strippers to take down the corrupt boss and the men who underestimate them.

Entries.Title: All The Real Boys
Entries.Description: A group of young incarcerated men are tested during an inmate litter pickup day.

Entries.Title: In Those Days
Entries.Description: In Those Days explores the experiences of the first wave of Afro-Caribbean immigrants who arrived in the UK to fill the labour shortage in Britain’s battered post-war economy. Charting their memories of home, their arrival in the UK and the lives they built here, In Those Days is a testament to the Windrush generation – told in their own words.

Entries.Title: Wednesdays with Gramps
Entries.Description: When a teenage boy visits his Gramps at a seemingly mundane boring assisted living facility, he comes to find that they have much more in common than he thought.

Entries.Title: Inside the Worlds of Epic Universe
Entries.Description: A must-watch special that invites viewers into the thrilling world of Universal's new theme park. Join Manganiello exploring five new worlds at Universal Epic Universe: Celestial Park, Ministry of Magic, Super Nintendo World, Isle of Berk, and Dark Universe, featuring cutting-edge rides and immersive experiences.

Entries.Title: How to Say Goodbye
Entries.Description: After their break-up, Mia has to return to her ex-girlfriend's apartment. This is going to be their very last moment together, before they say goodbye.

Entries.Title: Traveling Man
Entries.Description: A guy named Doug strikes a deal with a mysterious man he meets at the park.

Entries.Title: Aitana Needs a Gun
Entries.Description: When two reckless best friends get evicted from their apartment, they embark on a road trip with a pair of German immigrants attempting to trap them into green-card marriages.

Entries.Title: Night Mistress
Entries.Description: A woman becomes six different monsters in one to take revenge on her enemies.

Entries.Title: Take Care
Entries.Description: A self-destructive woman deliberately injures herself to be taken care of by an ER nurse she's grown attached to.

Entries.Title: Beti
Entries.Description: The journey of Neha as she comes to terms with accepting a great loss & the grief that follows.

Entries.Title: Forgotten Hero: Walter White and the NAACP
Entries.Description: While many consider the birth of the civil rights movement to be 1955, when Rosa Parks refused to give up her seat on an Alabama bus, the stage had been set decades before by activists of the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People. Some of the NAACP leaders are familiar, including W.E.B. Du Bois and Thurgood Marshall, but Walter White, head of the NAACP from 1929 to 1955, has been all but forgotten. With his blond hair and blue eyes, Walter White looked white; he described himself as “an enigma, a Black man occupying a white body.”  Like virtually all light-skinned African Americans of his day, White was descended from enslaved Black women and powerful white men. But he was Black — by law, identity, and conviction and spent his entire life fighting for Black civil rights.  Forgotten Hero: Walter White and the NAACP traces the life of this neglected civil rights hero and seeks to explain his disappearance from our history.

Entries.Title: Lost Joy
Entries.Description: Jane's getaway with her partner to the woods goes south when a stranger arrives and questions the integrity of their relationship.

Entries.Title: Saigon Saigon
Entries.Description: A shy, young man and a mysterious girl spend a night together in the city of Saigon. Their mutual attraction develops, and in the morning, they must decide whether their connection is worth pursuing, or if they will go their separate ways. Based on Dostoevsky’s short story “White Nights.”

Entries.Title: A Paw Patrol Christmas
Entries.Description: Plot unknown.

Entries.Title: Out of Pocket
Entries.Description: Danielle, a Type 1 Diabetic, plans to make contraband insulin with the help of Max, an experienced thief.

Entries.Title: A Spartan Dream
Entries.Description: An ancient-Greece-obsessed American travels to the land of his ancestors to sell his old family homestead. However, plans go awry when he falls in love with a beautiful Greek woman; he changes course to salvage the village and change history.

Entries.Title: Smosh Reads Reddit Stories LIVE!
Entries.Description: Celebrating Reddit Stories' 100th episode, Host Shayne Topp (33m) and his friends from Smosh share some of Reddit’s most wild stories, updates, and maybe a few surprises; Live from the Dynasty Typewriter

Entries.Title: Dog Moms
Entries.Description: A chaotic dog mom finds solace on a walk, which encourages her to release her fears about the future.

Entries.Title: Caregiving
Entries.Description: From Executive Producer Bradley Cooper, this is the story of paid and unpaid caregivers navigating the challenges and joys of this deeply meaningful work. Intertwining intimate personal stories with the untold history of caregiving, the documentary reveals the state and the stakes of care in America today. Narrated by Uzo Aduba (The Residence) and directed by Chris Durrance. Caregiving explores systemic issues in the US care system, where over 50 million provide unpaid care, and personal stories of caregivers for loved ones.

Entries.Title: Woke
Entries.Description: A vampire from over two centuries ago joins a clandestine 12-step program called Feeders Anonymous and attempts to recover from her supernatural addiction.

Entries.Title: Cosmic Dawn
Entries.Description: For over three decades, NASA and an international team of scientists and engineers pushed the limits of technology, innovation, and perseverance to build and launch the James Webb Space Telescope, the most powerful space observatory ever created. Cosmic Dawn brings audiences behind the scenes with the Webb film crew, and never-before-heard testimonies revealing the real story of how this telescope overcame all odds.

Entries.Title: Every Man in New York Is Named Andrew
Entries.Description: Margo has never been in a relationship, and she thinks she'd be great at being in one. But everywhere she looks, there's just another guy named Andrew.

Entries.Title: Killin' Jim Kelly
Entries.Description: The story of Jim Kelly, an African-American ranch hand and enforcer for legendary Texas cattleman Print Olive.

Entries.Title: An Almost Successful Dating App Love Story
Entries.Description: Determined to meet him dead or alive, a curious young woman attends the funeral of a man she matched with on a dating app.

Entries.Title: Steph Tolev: Filth Queen
Entries.Description: Bow down to the queen as fearlessly filthy Steph Tolev rules the stage with hilarious confessions, unfiltered dating stories and absurd observations.

Entries.Title: Goodbye Party
Entries.Description: Newly broken up with and over everything, Rowan throws himself a goodbye party before he blasts himself out of Brooklyn - literally.

Entries.Title: Happy Ending
Entries.Description: A couple attempts to revive their spark at a "happy ending" massage parlor, but they're trapped inside when a murderous client's obsession with a masseuse turns violent, thrusting everyone in the spa into a fight for survival.

Entries.Title: Brim
Entries.Description: "Brim" is a trans-generational drama exploring racial trauma, resilience, and legacy, as we follow a family from the 1940s into the 2020s. The narrative navigates the erasure of Blackness and how racial trauma impacts Alzheimer's disease and cognitive decline as the majority American identity reckons with race and privilege and their role in oppressive systems.

Entries.Title: Bidet
Entries.Description: A group of best friends are hunted by a possessed bidet.

Entries.Title: V13
Entries.Description: In Vienna in 1913, Hugo, a young man from a well-off Viennese family, is sent to see Sigmund Freud, the inventor of psychoanalysis. Hugo complains that he feels an impulsive revulsion tinged with hatred for Jews. Freud accepts him for an analysis. Hugo befriends a struggling artist obsessed with vegetarianism and German nationalism, Adolf. Filmed in contemporary New York City—particularly in the Bronx—V13 portrays the origins of the Nazi Weltenschaung. Alan Cumming gives an extraordinary performance as SIgmund Freud. The screenplay is based on a play by Alain Didier-Weill. His prior collaboration with the director, THE CALLER (2008), won the Made in New York Prize at the Tribeca Film Festival.

Entries.Title: Shivtown
Entries.Description: "Surrounded by dozens of soldiers like me, I was led by bus to a remote camp in the desert, a place I knew nothing about. As a military photographer, I collected fragments of moments in my photos, serving as solid evidence for me." Shivtown is the story of an ordinary soldier who, in an intimate and courageous act, revisits memories from his military service through the still images he captured with an analog camera.

Entries.Title: Rock Out
Entries.Description: In electric, personal, and historical ways, this riveting documentary explores whether there is, or ever was, a home for Queer in the hyper-masculine, black painted worlds of heavy metal, punk and rock & roll. Excavating the often-veiled queer lives of some of the greatest culture-defining disruptors and masterminds of music in the 1960s and 70s, Rock Out demands to know what unique value ‘gay’ brought to creating and revolutionising rock, punk, and metal – from the perspective of managers, producers, artists and fans – and why those contributions have been left buried for so long.

Entries.Title: Fanboy
Entries.Description: A young man seeking to embrace a perceived legacy unwittingly sparks a notorious chain of events while visiting his father's alma mater.

Entries.Title: Cameron James: Bangers
Entries.Description: Cameron James' full comedy special "Bangers" premieres on Grouse House YouTube 6 March 7pm AEDT!

Entries.Title: Just Beads
Entries.Description: An avid craftswoman is completely over her ex-husband through the power of beading.

Entries.Title: Et Tu
Entries.Description: A stage director is driven to madness during a regional production of Julius Caesar.

Entries.Title: Heat Pumps: Are They Really Worth It?
Entries.Description: Britain is undergoing a domestic heating revolution - heat pumps are replacing gas boilers and apparently everyone should prepare to put one in their homes. Alexis Conran investigates whether these devices live up to the hype, examining the pros and cons to help consumers choose the best option. Plus, tips on maximising savings.

Entries.Title: Hollow Ground
Entries.Description: At its core, Hollow Ground is a film during the 2009 U.S. recession about toxic masculinity and its impact on a broken family. Michael, our 14-year-old protagonist, enters the film as a lonely teenager who finds solace in talking trash to other gamers on XBox.

Entries.Title: Man on the Run
Entries.Description: Paul forms new band Wings after Beatles breakup. Archival home footage shows Paul's life with Linda, who influenced his music. Film follows Wings from formation through 1970s during which Paul wrote hit songs.

Entries.Title: The Space Between Attack and Decay
Entries.Description: A solitary sailing scientist, assigned to resurrect a drowning world, abandons his task in order to chase the enchanting allure of a shiny object.

Entries.Title: Paris Opera Ballet: GISELLE
Entries.Description: Encore screening from Paris Opera Ballet of 'Giselle', the ultimate romantic ballet.

Entries.Title: FoodFellas
Entries.Description: In pursuit of his dream of becoming a famous chef, a naive French immigrant unknowingly takes a job for New York's most powerful gangster. Both of their world's collide in this crime comedy

Entries.Title: Get-Together-ers
Entries.Description: Phil sabotages an intimate holiday gathering when he attempts to gift his childhood friend's fiancé something special.

Entries.Title: The Sink
Entries.Description: The Sink follows Princess, who recently lost her twin brother, Prince. She's been struggling to sleep and maintain a routine. Worse still, the kitchen tap has been leaking for a month, and the water bill is extremely high. She finally calls a plumber who offers an unexpected solution. A random conversation forces her to move on from her past.

Entries.Title: Python: The Documentary
Entries.Description: This is the story of the world's most beloved programming language: Python. What began as a side project in Amsterdam during the 1990s became the software powering artificial intelligence, data science and some of the world’s biggest companies. But Python's future wasn't certain; at one point it almost disappeared.  This 90-minute documentary features Guido van Rossum, Travis Oliphant, Barry Warsaw, and many more, and they tell the story of Python’s rise, its community-driven evolution, the conflicts that almost tore it apart, and the language’s impact on... well… everything.

Entries.Title: Snatched From The Crib
Entries.Description: Gabi's search for her missing pregnant stepsister takes a chilling turn when her sister's body is found, and the baby is gone. Determined to find the child and get justice, Gabi risks everything to unravel the truth behind the tragedy.

Entries.Title: Heart Strings
Entries.Description: Willing to do anything for money and fame, Lucky and Billie fake their love and eventually become a real couple, willing to sacrifice their dreams of success for real love and real life music.

Entries.Title: Asteroid
Entries.Description: A group of strangers take the risk of a lifetime to travel to a nearby asteroid for the opportunity to mine for wealth beyond their wildest dreams.

Entries.Title: Boomerang
Entries.Description: After using a mysterious hole to dispose of all his trash, a man faces unexpected consequences.

Entries.Title: Take No Prisoners
Entries.Description: Take No Prisoners offers unprecedented access to America’s top hostage negotiator, Roger Carstens, as he battles to free LA public defender Eyvin Hernandez from a notorious Venezuelan prison called “The House of Dreams.” The film captures the raw, emotional fight of Eyvin’s family as they pressure the president for action. With rare behind-the-scenes moments—from tense White House meetings to chaotic Caracas streets—this gripping documentary exposes the dangerous, high-stakes world of U.S. hostage recoveries, filled with setbacks, breakthroughs, and relentless determination.

Entries.Title: TMZ Presents: The Real Hulk Hogan
Entries.Description: Take a dive deep into Hulk's life in "TMZ Presents: The Real Hulk Hogan" ... looking back on how Hulk conquered the world. For all Hulk's massive wins, there were massive mistakes ... often involving his own family.

Entries.Title: Papercuts
Entries.Description: Papercuts is an animated memoir focused on the many trials and tribulations of a life in the arts. For over two decades, Eric Power has been working as an indie animator specializing in cut paper stop motion. Join him on a journey through all the highs and lows of a life spent in the arts.

Entries.Title: 17 Pages
Entries.Description: A scientific paper sparks controversy and congressional inquiry. Bias influences perceptions of evidence and testimony in the misconduct investigation, impacting future such probes.

Entries.Title: Apollo
Entries.Description: 15-year-old Angus considers the sacrifice he needs to make for the approval of his older brother's friends.

Entries.Title: Galaxy 360: A Woman's Playground
Entries.Description: In 2195, women rule the world and men dream of getting married.

Entries.Title: Peas and Carrots
Entries.Description: New York-based 16-year-old Joey Wethersby's parents were part of a 1990s one-hit wonder band. After encouraging her parents to start a new band, Joey finds herself traveling nightly to an alternate reality where everyone repeatedly says the titular three-word phrase.

Entries.Title: VR: A Digital Frontier
Entries.Description: Filmed inside the many worlds of virtual reality, this documentary dives into VR's history, usage, and future. Told through the many users and communities inside this digital space.

Entries.Title: It Needs Eyes
Entries.Description: Suffering from a traumatic event, teenager Rowan is whisked away from home and taken to her estranged aunt's oceanside home indefinitely. Racked with guilt and unable to enjoy a normal summer, she drowns out the noise with increasingly bizarre, violent internet content. Soon, Rowan comes across videos of a missing woman known only as Fish Tooth, who she believes is calling out through the screen for help. Despite a budding relationship with her camgirl neighbor, Alex, Rowan’s obsession with Fish Tooth will lead her to something sinister lurking at the bottom of this twisted internet rabbit hole, and uncover what lies her own family has been hiding...

Entries.Title: I Want to Feel Fun
Entries.Description: One day in Los Angeles in search of love, connection and Nicki Minaj.

Entries.Title: The Weeknd - Open Hearts
Entries.Description: The performance serves as a prequel to "Red Terror", ending with The Weeknd following a toddler version of himself out into the forest.

Entries.Title: Alan at Night
Entries.Description: An internet prankster documents the increasingly odd behavior of his new roommate, Alan.

Entries.Title: Franklin
Entries.Description: Franklin Scott is a gay adult entertainer whose work in the industry casts a long shadow over his aspirations of Hollywood stardom. Despite his charisma and ambition, he finds doors repeatedly closing in his face. As he struggles with rejection—from family, from the mainstream entertainment world, and from a society quick to judge—Franklin forms an unexpected personal connection that becomes both a lifeline and a catalyst for change. This bond forces him to confront the hidden trauma he's carried, face painful truths about himself and those closest to him, and reckon with a world that seldom sees—let alone accepts—his full humanity .

Entries.Title: Life of Mike
Entries.Description: Mike Smith, a thriving real estate tycoon, lives a life devoid of close friends or family. As his birthday unfolds, his wife Celeste makes a heartfelt attempt to show him love, setting off a chain of events that shatter his expectations. By day's end, Mike is confronted with the stark reality of who genuinely cares for him and who does not.

Entries.Title: Tripolar The Movie
Entries.Description: A washed-up 50-something with no filter enlists her daughter’s Gen Z friends to make a movie—and everything goes off the rails.

Entries.Title: Preserved
Entries.Description: For nearly 175 years, the Southwestern United States has seen civilizations rise and fall, leaving behind landscapes stripped by time and industry. Northern New Mexico’s 560,000-acre Vermejo is one such place—a land rich with history, from dinosaurs and early Indigenous communities to homesteaders, a conservation-minded grain baron, and Hollywood’s glitterati seeking outdoor recreation. But modern times took their toll, leaving it overgrazed and scarred by mining.  In 1996, Ted Turner bought the land as part of his work to restore and protect lands across the United States. A dedicated team began to work to heal the land, transforming it into a thriving sanctuary. Today, Vermejo Reserve stands as a testament to what’s possible: biodiversity restored, landscapes reborn, and a model for global conservation.

Entries.Title: Hearts Around the Table: Shari's Second Act
Entries.Description: Shari just moved back to D.C. after a breakup and hopes to start painting again. Inspiration hits when she meets Evan, a repairman who winds up actually being a gallery owner.

Entries.Title: Out for Delivery
Entries.Description: When terminally ill Joanna makes the difficult decision to pursue end-of-life options through the Death with Dignity Act, the systems set up to make her death peaceful and dignified yield the opposite.

Entries.Title: Shattered Ice
Entries.Description: High school hockey bruiser Will Mankus is more lost than ever following the unexpected loss of his best friend and star player, Danny, to suicide. As his alcohol consumption intensifies and his mental health declines, Mankus must lift himself up from rock bottom with the help of his small-town New England community to find hope and pursue his dreams of playing college hockey.

Entries.Title: ERROR
Entries.Description: In a world controlled by a powerful military conglomerate, the population is monitored through a global network known as "The Grid." Amid the glowing streets of a cyberpunk metropolis, a determined member of the resistance embarks on a dangerous mission that could change everything. As she races against time, her actions ignite a chain of events that challenge the very foundation of the oppressive regime.

Entries.Title: The Games in Black & White
Entries.Description: Centered around the inspirational friendship of icons Andrew Young and Billy Payne—the most successful Black and White partnership in the American South in the civil rights era—“The Games in Black & White” presents the first comprehensive look at Atlanta’s Olympics from bid to legacy and the city’s transformation that followed.

Entries.Title: Heirlooms
Entries.Description: Jaime’s quest for healing leads her to restore a family heirloom. But what begins as a therapeutic project, soon spirals into a battle against an ancient evil that has plagued her bloodline for generations

Entries.Title: 1000 Women in Horror
Entries.Description: Is horror a man’s world? You might assume so – but you won’t be thinking that way for long once you investigate the vast contribution women have made to horror movies for well over a century. In 2020, award-winning Australian critic Alexandra Heller-Nicholas released the definitive book on the subject: 1000 Women in Horror, 1895–2018, an encyclopaedic work celebrating the many women – filmmakers, actors, producers and technicians – who have shaped the genre since the moment cinema’s light first flickered.

Entries.Title: Meanwhile
Entries.Description: A groundbreaking, immersive, nonlinear cinematic journey where artists' expressions blend with historical and real-life footage, unveils the profound impact of white supremacy on our human connections. Led by a dynamic team including Jacqueline Woodson, Catherine Gund, Erika Dilday, Meshell Ndegeocello, and M. Trevino, this collaborative masterpiece weaves together diverse visions, poignantly revealing how race, racism, and resistance shape our shared breath, not just in moments of crisis, but in the enduring, pervasive legacy of that risk.

Entries.Title: We Should Make a Movie
Entries.Description: A young man and a young woman send video messages back and forth from afar, brainstorming a movie to make together in the future when they see each other again.

Entries.Title: Remaining Native
Entries.Description: Ku Stevens, a 17-year-old Native American runner, struggles to navigate his dream of becoming a collegiate athlete as the memory of his great grandfather's escape from an Indian boarding school begins to connect past, present, and future.

Entries.Title: A Figgly Christmas
Entries.Description: When Santa Claus crashes in the land of the Woodgies, Figgly has to help Santa and save Christmas.

Entries.Title: Not If I See You First
Entries.Description: In town for work, Kenny meets Aaron, who convinces him to extend his trip a few days to check out the famous sights of Chicago. But when Kenny's car explodes and Aaron gets selective amnesia, will their fledgling friendship lose its way?

Entries.Title: Crybaby
Entries.Description: In a utopian near future where crying has ceased to exist, an emotional young woman — the only person who can still shed tears — teams up with her protective older sister on a journey into the underground world of weeping.

Entries.Title: Dandelion
Entries.Description: In 1970s Los Angeles, rebellious queer teen Margaret gets thrown out of yet another foster placement and finds herself in the company of a mysterious social worker who's tasked with finding her a new home before the break of dawn. At odds and forced to travel the city together, Margaret realizes that running may not be her only option.

Entries.Title: The American Southwest
Entries.Description: The American Southwest is a feature length blue chip natural history film narrated by indigenous environmentalist Quannah Chasinghorse.  The movie journeys down the mighty Colorado River, examining the astonishing beauty and biodiversity of the region, while confronting the environmental destruction from dams and the perilous fate of the river.  The story is told through never-before-seen wildlife sequences such as beavers building wetlands, condors recovering from the brink, and the potential return of Jaguars to American soil.  The film beautifully advocates for better management of the river and increased wildlife conservation efforts in the iconic landscapes of The American Southwest.

Entries.Title: Power Slap 14: The Bell vs. Mena
Entries.Description: NEW ORLEANS TO HOST $VET POWER SLAP 14: THE BELL VS. MENA PRESENTED BY MONSTER ENERGY DURING UFC 318 FIGHT WEEK  FIRST U.S. POWER SLAP EVENT OUTSIDE OF LAS VEGAS  EVENT STREAMS LIVE AND FREE TO A GLOBAL AUDIENCE ON YOUTUBE ON FRIDAY JULY 18  Power Slap 14: The Bell vs Mena features three marquee title matches  Headlining Power Slap 14 at the XULA Convocation Center will be a heavyweight title match between current Power Slap Heavyweight Champion, Damien “The Bell” Dibbell (5-0, 3 KOs), and No. 3 ranked Heavyweight Wes “The Boom” Mena (4-0, 2 KOs).  Dan Hellie will call the action alongside former UFC fighter Alan Jouban. Charly Arnolt will handle reporting duties. The ring announcer will be Justin Bernard.

Entries.Title: Dead Fun
Entries.Description: A group of friends attend a house party. Waiting through the doors is a wild night, an ex-girlfriend, and n***a zombies.

Entries.Title: Krypto Saves the Day!: School Bus Scuffle
Entries.Description: Superman's dog Krypto chases after a pigeon.

Entries.Title: This Is Jan
Entries.Description: Set in the conservative world of the 1950s, Jan checks into a hotel seeking to escape the outside world. Once alone, they are free to shed the identity society has imposed upon them. Jan embraces the chance to explore who they truly believe they are. As they relish this new identity, a surge of confidence emerges, but they soon realize that not everything is as it seems. Faced with a choice between internal pressures and embracing their authentic self, Jan takes a bold step forward.

Entries.Title: If I Could Ride Again
Entries.Description: When a former equestrian champion returns home from college, she finds that her best friend is taking her place training for an upcoming competition. As she struggles with the injury that prevents her from riding again, the tension between the two mounts and their trainer encourages them to lean on each other, and their love of horses and racecars, to find strength, hope, and redemption.

Entries.Title: H2O: The Intelligence of Water
Entries.Description: Water is essential for all life on earth, but also holds many untold secrets. Join scientists, authors, and healers as they explore the relationship between water, people, and the rest of the world. These experts discuss its healing effects, how it can capture positive and negative energy, and the importance of conserving this precious resource before it's too late.

Entries.Title: Revelations
Entries.Description: Two married surgeons navigate a series of revelations about their partners past life.

Entries.Title: Ori Ade Fadaka
Entries.Description: ORI ADE FADAKA is a gripping Yoruba epic that delves into the drama, secrets, and power struggles within a royal palace. When a devoted princess sacrifices everything to save her ailing father, the king, betrayal and hidden agendas threaten the throne. With a selfish queen, a hypnotized prince, and scheming chiefs, the kingdom faces chaos and a fight for redemption. A tale of loyalty, love, and intrigue that will keep audiences on the edge of their seats!

Entries.Title: Rocky's
Entries.Description: After a shocking death, a group of old high school friends reconnect in the parking lot of a 24/7 deli to catch up ahead of the funeral.

Entries.Title: Spiral
Entries.Description: After her boyfriend leaves for the night, a curious  young woman is left alone to deal with the horrors of her mental health.

Entries.Title: The Rock Prophet: The Story of Link Wray
Entries.Description: The story of the almost forgotten man who started the rock revolution. The humble and talented Link Wray was a Native American. Born into extreme poverty, he invented the power chord and eventually a whole new genre of music with his song Rumble. Both Bruce Springsteen and Bob Dylan paid tribute to Link Wray after his death. Who was Link Wray and why doesn't the world know his name and story, even though his influence is undeniable? In the documentary, famous guitarists talk about Link Wray's influence on modern rock music. (The Rock Prophet: Link Wray. United Kingdom, 2023.)

Entries.Title: VISA
Entries.Description: Faced with deportation at the end of his work permit, an Asian employee tries to get hate-crimed to secure a green card.

Entries.Title: Kelsey Cook: Mark Your Territory
Entries.Description: A comedian shares hilarious takes on dating an older guy, health care adventures, family challenges, and life changes after relocating to Minnesota with her fellow comic boyfriend.

Entries.Title: False Profits
Entries.Description: Church girl defrauds community out of millions to fund her alternative lifestyle.

Entries.Title: One of One
Entries.Description: Founded in Tokyo in the aftermath of WWII, Naito Auto Engineering is a three-generation family business, renown for restoring high-value classic cars with artistry and precision.  Masao Naito, with his bold vision and rebellious spirit, took his father's local mechanic shop and turned it into a first-class company, whose services are coveted by top auto collectors the world over. For over 40 years, Masao has ruled the family business with an iron fist. Now, with his retirement on the horizon, cracks are beginning to show. Do the younger Naitos have what it takes to keep the family together, and carry the business forward?

Entries.Title: Harley Flanagan: Wired for Chaos
Entries.Description: From his harsh childhood in the burnt-out Lower East Side, musician Harley Flanagan burst onto the punk music scene at age 11 as drummer for his aunt’s band, the Stimulators. The founder of the Cro-Mags tells his incredible story, while interviews with hard rockers and icons like Flea, Ice-T, Henry Rollins, and Anthony Bourdain add insights. Featuring gritty footage of NYC’s downtown 1970s and ?80s music scene, this passionate film showcases Harley’s against-the-odds transformation from chaos to peace, driven by music, family, and personal growth.

Entries.Title: Alice-Heart
Entries.Description: Alice-Heart is an aimless college student residing in Philadelphia. She aspires to be a famous writer but drops out of school in her last semester of senior year on a whim. Immediately cut off from her disappointed Filipino mother and dumped by her studious boyfriend, she finds that she has to pay bills on her own for the first time. Distraught, she takes solace in her neighbor Tony, a self sufficient freelance photographer. Tony encourages her to pursue her passions and hold onto her friendships. With this in mind, Alice-Heart navigates the beginnings of adulthood and combats “adult baby” allegations along the way.

Entries.Title: George Lopez: Muy Católico
Entries.Description: George Lopez brings his reflections on aging, Latino family dynamics, and cultural quirks in his final stand-up special. He hilariously embraces the challenges of getting older and touches on generational clashes and Latino superstitions. Bold and personal, Lopez delivers his comedic voice to stories that capture both the humor and heart of his journey one last time.

Entries.Title: Smith Peaks
Entries.Description: In a city of factories, bare trees, and looming cell towers, a graduate student named Smith disappears from his home. His disappearance is reported to a crew of four former amateur ghosthunters, whose investigation uncovers a web of conspiracies.

Entries.Title: Absolution
Entries.Description: A Vietnam veteran's chance encounter with a brutal street gang sends him down a path of vengeance.

Entries.Title: The Non-Actor
Entries.Description: Elliot is staying with her ex’s new girlfriend while attending a medical trial for her recent, unexplained loss of hearing. As she reconfigures her relationship with her (sonic) environment and herself, an intimate connection sparks between the two women. With captivating performances by Victoria Pedretti and Maya Hawke, this loose adaptation of director Eliza Barry Callahan’s semi-autobiographical novel The Hearing Test captures the uneasy process of letting go and embracing change with sensitive warmth.

Entries.Title: Two in One: The Briscoe Story
Entries.Description: Mark Briscoe and the Pugh family share the story of how The Briscoe brothers built a dynasty over a 20+ year career filled with barbed wire, love, and tragedy.

Entries.Title: Scenes from Casablanca
Entries.Description: A reframing of a section of the Casablanca script. Made for a University assignment.

Entries.Title: Irrational
Entries.Description: After ten years of practice without much success, a high school senior competes in her final high-stakes pi memorization tournament.

Entries.Title: Blaze and the Monster Machines: Super Wheels
Entries.Description: When villains unleash chaos on Axle City, who can the monster machines turn to for help? Super Wheels Blaze! Blaze and friends transform into big-wheeled superheroes - with powers to keep the world safe from danger and stop evildoers in their tracks.

Entries.Title: Human
Entries.Description: It's past midnight and Dani Ferris is a woman all alone, away from home. A woman who's tired as hell, wanting nothing but a little tease of digital debauchery before shutting her eyes. A woman not even remotely prepared for the roller coaster of emotions she's about to ride with a front-row seat.  Sleep? Lol. Nope. Tonight is a night for friends, lovers, enemies, frenemies?, little guns, bigger guns, body parts, body fluids, body solids, love, hate, life, death, and things a hell of a lot more super than natural.  A night Dani will never forget. And neither will he.

Entries.Title: BIG STUDENT 学霸
Entries.Description: A grandfather`s unwavering determination to take the SPM examination in memory of his deceased grandchild, who tragically passed away before he could sit for his own exam.

Entries.Title: Worlds Apart
Entries.Description: While navigating the challenges of caring for his ailing mother and the relentless grind of day-to-day life, Dee finds himself thrust into a surreal ordeal when inexplicable events begin to unfold. Dee's already fragile world is shattered by encounters seemingly beyond the realm of human comprehension. Struggling to make sense of these strange occurrences, Dee must summon courage he never knew he possessed as he delves into the mysteries that threaten to consume him and his loved ones. Using the love for his mother as his guiding light, Dee embarks on a journey of self-discovery and survival, where he must confront the unknown and protect those he holds dear from forces that defy explanation.

Entries.Title: Ali Siddiq: My Two Sons
Entries.Description: Ali Siddiq tells true stories and breaks down the differences between his 'old son' and his 'new son', and spoiler, one of them is much better than the other.
