Entries.Description: A HOA turns out to be more troublesome than usual in this wildly amusing, FX-heavy freak-out about newly minted suburbanites unexpectedly forced to take part in a struggle against monstrous forces.

Entries.Title: Max Distance
Entries.Description: Stuck in endless droning Zoom meetings, a programmer daydreams about the stranger next door—until she finally gets a chance at love.

Entries.Title: Television
Entries.Description: A short film by Sebastian Sommer

Entries.Title: What the Heck Is Going On.
Entries.Description: Three people struggle to comprehend a rapidly evolving reality.

Entries.Title: She Island
Entries.Description: In the heart of the Caribbean, a mother and daughter confront a malevolent curse erasing identities of all the island's women, propelling them on a daring quest to reclaim their rich cultural heritage and triumph over the encroaching darkness.

Entries.Title: A Beach Read Murder
Entries.Description: Usually, best-selling novelist Jen only writes about murder, romance, and mystery, but when she retreats to her island bungalow for peace and inspiration, her own life soon becomes as deadly, steamy, and twisty as one of her beach reads.

Entries.Title: Lost to Time
Entries.Description: In the distant future, a cocky and corrupted CEO plans on changing the world at the cost of pushing away his family, friends and future.

Entries.Title: Nocturne
Entries.Description: A musical fantasia on religion and the nature of exploitation.

Entries.Title: Lowkey Adults
Entries.Description: A heartfelt and humorous coming-of-age story, Lowkey Adults follows Jaiye Funtua, who, reeling from heartbreak, makes a daring bet to win over her ex’s mysterious rival, Hamza Bello.

Entries.Title: Chiquita
Entries.Description: On a fateful night amidst the rugged Texan landscape, Charles(60s), a biker recovering from a painful divorce, crashes into a valley and there he encounters a mysterious little girl. What unfolds that night, sets Charles on an unexpected and transformative journey of self discovery. What could be such a powerful experience that changes Charles's perspective on life for good? Dive into the enigmatic tale of this life-altering encounter.

Entries.Title: Senior Assassin
Entries.Description: When a game of Senior Assassin adds on a cash prize, wannabe detective Oscar Horn must find the mastermind who's been picking off "The Teeth!"

Entries.Title: The Flavor of Cassava Leaf Over Rice
Entries.Description: A renowned novelist is stuck in a rut when he runs into an old flame at a bookstore and the two spend the weekend reflecting on their lives.

Entries.Title: Text As A Way To Exist
Entries.Description: Marta Raitses is one of the leading Russian playwrights: after 2 years of voluntary exile in totalitarian Russia, she returns to gather material for a new book. To tell her personal, tragic love story for the first time.

Entries.Title: A Brief History of Chasing Storms
Entries.Description: An episodic road movie, raising questions of memory, inequality, colonisation, climate change, and disaster capitalism as it examines legacies of weather within this area of the United States dubbed “tornado alley”.

Entries.Title: Land's End
Entries.Description: Hugo, Elise, and Yoon navigate familial tensions and harsh realities, ultimately finding their way into each other's lives in unexpected ways.

Entries.Title: The End of The Punchline
Entries.Description: Set in 2011, we follow a trio of high school boys, Nick, Edd, and Viggo, as their senior year of high school comes to a halt when a secret kept by a shady government foundation is exposed, turning our heroes' worlds upside down.

Entries.Title: Harvest Season
Entries.Description: Teenagers from a small town get attacked by a mysterious killer with a jack o’ lantern head.

Entries.Title: Daisy
Entries.Description: A war veteran rescues a tiny creature that he smuggles back to the states only to realize it is not what he thought it was. It must eat and he continues to feed it by committing horrific crimes that ultimately catch up with him and the creature,

Entries.Title: Ambitions As A Writer
Entries.Description: Ambitions As A Writer follows three teens as they explore the manchester graffiti scene. The documentary is a one off from Hall Productions and was done as a passion project to show their hobbies.

Entries.Title: Stranger's Pawn
Entries.Description: Two men face off over a game of chess—but every move reveals something deeper. Tension escalates as hidden motives and old wounds surface beneath the calm conversation.

Entries.Title: Drink and Be Merry
Entries.Description: At a struggling New York dive bar in the days leading up to Christmas 2019, Chet, a beleaguered bartender in a state of extended arrested development, must balance caring for his misanthropic, aging regulars — who have nowhere else to go, and rely on him for far more than pouring drinks — with his naive desires to muster some Christmas spirit.

Entries.Title: Wrong Guy
Entries.Description: Vince is a disabled dude and lately, people have been confusing him with some other disabled due they know. Vince would rather just let it go and avoid the interaction completely but...it keeps happening. So when someone mistakes him for the dude that starred in the hit 90s movie SIMON BIRCH, offering him a free vacation, Vince and his best friend Rosie decide they've had enough.

Entries.Title: Man Made Lake
Entries.Description: In the idyllic confines of a gated community in China, young Nita gets her finger bitten by a creature in the neighborhood's lake. Her French mother, Marie, is determined to find out what's lurking in the waters — igniting a series of cultural clashes throughout the community.

Entries.Title: Hi.
Entries.Description: On the banks of a coastal village, a pair of young adult writers, two teen lovers, and mentally ill parents intertwine in three tales of love and forgiveness during separate stages of life.

Entries.Title: Church
Entries.Description: A short film by Sebastian Sommer

Entries.Title: animal.
Entries.Description: animal. unmasks a century-long conspiracy of political, economic, and religious forces that have twisted our natural bond with meat-enslaving us to ill health and Big Pharma dependency. Through bold interviews, historical revelations, and groundbreaking science, it shatters nutritional myths and dares us to reclaim the ancestral diet that fueled our evolution.

Entries.Title: True Love Waits
Entries.Description: Anne mortgaged her house in order to give her son William a wedding, and because she couldn't pay off her debt in time, Anne's house was taken away. Anne went to find her son William, but her son's wife, Selene, drove her away. Anne saves girl Rebecca, Rebecca feels Anne's kindness, lets her and her father blind date, Anne and her father Leonardo Blind Date and success flash marriage. After her marriage, Leonardo stayed by Anne's side as she faced bullying from her son's family, relatives and ex-husband. then Leonardo is the boss of a top business empire! and Rebecca, is her long-lost biological daughter! After all this, Anne finally lived a happy life.

Entries.Title: Anders
Entries.Description: A little ditty of a wobbling man short in the North East.

Entries.Title: Your Opinion, Please
Entries.Description: As America enters the new millennium, listeners across Montana call into Yellowstone Public Radio to express their views on everything from state politics to the Iraq war, or the meaning of poetry.

Entries.Title: The Short Game
Entries.Description: Jeremy Avery is vying for a college golf scholarship, but his preparation and game are affected by family pressures related to his younger autistic brother Ethan. Jeremy’s path leads him on a journey of discovery both internal and of his brother’s savant like gifts, that if embraced can create an unstoppable pair.

Entries.Title: Immutable
Entries.Description: Students from the Washington Urban Debate League navigate the challenges of daily life while striving for excellence in competitive debate. Beginning at an annual summer debate camp during the final days of the COVID pandemic, the film follows a group of dedicated young debaters. They immerse themselves in research, critical thinking, teamwork, and performance, hoping these skills will not only help them win tournaments but also overcome the obstacles standing between them and their full potential.

Entries.Title: The Beta Project
Entries.Description: Four women are recruited into an organization that hunts the supernatural.

Entries.Title: Fragile Bond
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Broken
Entries.Description: One summer, one bucket list, one rule: No falling in love…  Rivals on the field. Fireworks off it. Can love survive the ultimate competition?

Entries.Title: stealing cars
Entries.Description: After his mother’s unexpected death, a teenage car thief, Matías, is sent to live with the abusive father that they ran away from thirteen years earlier.

Entries.Title: Another in the Fire
Entries.Description: On May 22, 1980, Michael Sinclair Walter was in a near fatal car accident in Redondo Beach, California. In a coma, paralyzed, blind in one eye, and with a million to one chance of survival, Michael battled back against doctors’ predictions. He not only overcame a horribly broken body, but he overcame addictions and personal behavior that were major obstacles to his eventual success.

Entries.Title: BITE
Entries.Description: After discovering the body of an eccentric businessman, a middle-class delivery driver finds himself wrestling with the moral and physical repercussions of eating a dead person's groceries.

Entries.Title: There's Something I Have to Tell You
Entries.Description: There's Something I Have to Tell You is the story of Anna, a reserved woman in her 20s who's temporarily living in a small town in the Bahamas to help her mom build a house. But beneath the surface, Anna is haunted by the memories of her past. During her stay, she struggles to release a devastating truth that has kept her and her mom divided for as long as she can remember.

Entries.Title: Slowly
Entries.Description: A tale of unrequited love told in front of the backdrop of modern technology.

Entries.Title: Out Of Tune
Entries.Description: A dedicated guitarist’s world unravels after he arrives late to rehearsal and learns he’s been kicked out of the band he helped build.

Entries.Title: Loki IRL
Entries.Description: After numerous losses, aspiring artist Bianca and her living cartoon demon, Loki, are called out online. To prove they're not idiots they had to beat up an influencer.

Entries.Title: Declan Sennott’s A Fair Trade
Entries.Description: In this black comedy crime epic, eighth grader Tommy Uris is pushed into a teenage drug dealing business run by his two classmates Frank Newton and Patrick Reynolds after walking in on a drug deal between them. As their business falls apart, so does their trust for each other, and they need to either resolve, or kill each other in the process.

Entries.Title: I Study People For A Living
Entries.Description: An obsessed serial stalker has his philosophies changed after a devastating discovery.

Entries.Title: Brain Rot
Entries.Description: Two video store employees discover a rare VHS tape contaminated with a bizarre mold that could hold deadly consequences.

Entries.Title: MYOPIA
Entries.Description: In this Greek Tragedy, A King named Myops is constantly plagued by horrific omens and decides to seek council from the Gods, only to soon discover that his past actions and hidden guilt, may have led him towards a gruesome fate once he forces the Oracle to enact a divination.

Entries.Title: The Heart of the Wood
Entries.Description: Prelude to the short film Visitant

Entries.Title: Too Soon
Entries.Description: A Second Shot at love comes sooner than expected for a young widow and widower who meet the day of their spouses' funerals.

Entries.Title: Skin
Entries.Description: Insecure about her appearance, Kanika visits a mysterious skin lightening center.

Entries.Title: New Schubert
Entries.Description: Three figures in a park in Rome are accompanied by Franz Schubert's late trio rearranged for digital and analogue synthesizers.

Entries.Title: Aliens Uncovered: Jesuit Secrets
Entries.Description: This thought-provoking documentary explores the intriguing intersection of faith, science, and the cosmos through the lens of the Vatican's involvement in astronomical research. Focusing on the Mount Graham International Observatory in Arizona, the film highlights how the Jesuit order, known for their commitment to education and scientific inquiry, collaborates with the Vatican to utilize advanced telescopes in their search for extraterrestrial life.

Entries.Title: Jonesing: When Love Is a Habit
Entries.Description: Simone is a young poet and college senior navigating love and self-discovery while witnessing the unraveling of her parents’ once-revered relationship. Her father, a world-renowned author whose words once defined a generation’s understanding of love, and her mother, a sought-after creative director celebrated for capturing the essence of intimacy through her lens, built a life shaped by passion, artistry, and devotion until the foundation began to crack. As their love story fades from the idealized lens of the public into the stark reality of divorce, Simone begins to question whether love is ever as real as it seems. Now in her final year of college, she stands at the crossroads between the creative world she was born into and the growing disillusionment in her heart. Just as she prepares to give up on the idea of love altogether, she meets Myles, a charismatic transfer athlete with unexpected emotional depth.

Entries.Title: Sakazuki
Entries.Description: Two agency assassins cross blades in an empty bar when they find they're on the same gig.

Entries.Title: Turtle Pleasure
Entries.Description: A turtle makes a couple of phone calls.

Entries.Title: Always Smile
Entries.Description: Two homeless brothers find themselves at the heart of an unexpected and dangerous journey when they witness a crime that shakes the foundations of the city’s corrupt underbelly. These resilient siblings discover the true meaning of family.

Entries.Title: DELHI GATE
Entries.Description: It's about an Love and Sacrifice

Entries.Title: Your Favorite Late Night Show's Favorite Late Night Show
Entries.Description: This movie follows the creation of an episode of “Late Stage Live”, an all-transgender political show hosted by Ela Yurman. It’s the last episode before the American elections, as well as the last episode produced.

Entries.Title: Cowgirlies 01: Pony Express
Entries.Description: The girlies plot to steal from the town saloon when sidetracked by a strange man asking for a favor.

Entries.Title: A Night in the Life
Entries.Description: A celebration of nyc nightlife culture in a more intimate setting. What happens before the gig, when you’re just having a pregame drink with the girls.

Entries.Title: Mission Santa: Yoyo To The Rescue
Entries.Description: An underdog elf, driven by his unwavering passion for the holidays, becomes the North Pole's only hope of saving Christmas from a vengeful hacker.

Entries.Title: The Edge of Possible: A Barkley Marathons Tale
Entries.Description: The Edge of Possible: A Barkley Marathon Tale takes you deep inside the legendary Barkley Marathons, the world’s most elusive and punishing ultramarathon.  Set in the unforgiving terrain of Frozen Head State Park, this film follows elite ultrarunner Harvey Lewis as he battles the course, his limits, and time itself. Halfway through, we meet Jasmin Paris, whose grit and endurance add another layer to this epic test of human resilience.  With insights from race founder Lazarus Lake, past Barkley finisher John Kelly, Gary Robbins and others, this documentary is an unprecedented look at the fine line between ambition and impossibility.

Entries.Title: Wild Swimmers
Entries.Description: Beneath the waters of the River Avon, something sinister stirs…Wild Swimmers follows a trainee journalist and a photography student as they investigate a series of disappearances among wild swimmers. Their search leads them upriver, where something far darker awaits.

Entries.Title: Engaged to the Enemy
Entries.Description: Follows Enny, a kind-hearted but strong-willed woman, and Daniel, a ruthless mafia leader who is as dangerous as he is irresistible. Their love story? Anything but ordinary.

Entries.Title: Beneath
Entries.Description: The two-person crew of a submersible descending into an ocean moon of Saturn become stranded and are at the mercy of strange lifeforms.

Entries.Title: On the Red Carpet Presents: "A Complete Unknown"
Entries.Description: A behind the scenes look at the making of "A Complete Unknown" featuring interviews with the cast and filmmakers.

Entries.Title: Katha Kamamishu
Entries.Description: The movie is about a family in a small town and how a small issue changes their relationships...

Entries.Title: The Show About the Show: The Final Season
Entries.Description: The epic conclusion to Caveh Zahedi's THE SHOW ABOUT THE SHOW

Entries.Title: Thick Trip
Entries.Description: Four friends facing life challenges take a summer road trip through Texas together.

Entries.Title: The Last Ones of Auschwitz
Entries.Description: A feature-length documentary that captures the poignant and powerful testimonies of the last remaining Holocaust survivors, particularly those who endured the atrocities of Auschwitz.

Entries.Title: Confessions of a Romance Narrator
Entries.Description: A romance audiobook narrator quarrels with her noisy neighbor, pines for her co-worker, and races to meet her deadlines, all while struggling to find her voice.

Entries.Title: Alfredo: The Movie
Entries.Description: When ghosts from his past resurface, a warrior is drawn back into the dangerous life he thought he left behind.

Entries.Title: The Story of Art in Alaska
Entries.Description: The Story of Art in Alaska is a documentary film exploring the Arts and cultural heritage of the cities of Hoonah, Anchorage, and Fairbanks.

Entries.Title: Memory Wars
Entries.Description: Can we trust our own memories? An American psychologist with expertise in the brain's ability to make up its own truths takes us into her fascinating field of research.

Entries.Title: Prima
Entries.Description: A bloody metaphor for the way women are treated in the entertainment industry.

Entries.Title: Miénteme
Entries.Description: One summer evening, Martin is forced to face his unresolved feelings for his best girlfriend’s future groom, whilst attending their engagement party.

Entries.Title: CBD Nation
Entries.Description: CBD Nation examines the real research and evidence surrounding one of the safest, most therapeutically active medicines known to humanity. The documentary features the world's leading experts in the field of cannabis scientific research, and follows the emotional stories of several patients who bravely took control of their own medical journeys - often in the face of powerful resistance - to significantly improve their quality of life.

Entries.Title: Los Angeles Canvas
Entries.Description: Los Angeles Canvas examines some of the lesser-known aspects of Los Angeles' social, political and cultural life through a study of its traditional outdoors murals. A tradition inspired by the Civil Rights Movement and the Mexican Mural Movement. These murals have historically advocated for social justice, representing under-examined narratives that contest mainstream history and conveying the community’s cultural identity.

Entries.Title: Lucy: The Stolen Lives of Elephants
Entries.Description: This is the FIRST documentary which exposes the cruelty of keeping elephants in zoos and the false narratives of conservation and education that zoos feed an unsuspecting public. This film follows several interrelated stories of individuals who are determined to expose the zoos as glorified prisons for elephants and their relentless pursuit to send zoo elephants to sanctuary.

Entries.Title: A Moment in the Sun
Entries.Description: As the solar eclipse of 2024 races towards Houlton, Maine - a township of approximately 6,000 people - they must find a way to host 40,000 stargazing strangers the only way they know how: with open arms and open hearts.

Entries.Title: Emma's World
Entries.Description: Emma, who lives in a small boring town, writes about her life and inner thoughts in her diary.

Entries.Title: American Football (Live in Los Angeles)
Entries.Description: American Football (Live in Los Angeles) is an intimate concert film celebrating the 25th anniversary of the band’s groundbreaking debut album. Featuring live performances and candid interviews with the band, Ethel Cain, Yvette Young, and M.A.G.S., the film highlights the band’s enduring legacy and their pivotal role in defining the genre.

Entries.Title: The Price of Desire
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Promise to Stronger Days
Entries.Description: Promise to Stronger Days connects two different, evolving storylines. The main storyline is about Adira’s internal struggle to hook up with Jerome — an attractive man who rescued her at her friend Keke’s birthday party — after months of having no sex due to her trauma. The other storyline is fragmented at first, but her truth is pieced together: Adira was sexually assaulted by her father after being left alone with him due to marital issues. Adira becomes increasingly frustrated with her inability to connect with others due to her trauma, until she decides to take her power back. After a few failed sex attempts with Jerome, she intentionally returns to her childhood flashbacks to kill her abuser.

Entries.Title: Your Presence is Requested
Entries.Description: Inside a facility that offers state-sponsored séances, one woman's desperation to reconnect with her late husband threatens to unleash a nightmare.

Entries.Title: Amen Break
Entries.Description: A crew of fixers working behind the scenes for a trendy New York City restaurant recap the morning after a deal gone bad.

Entries.Title: The Death Molester's Barn of Blood
Entries.Description: Two cretinous brothers begin to suspect that their cousin is a prolific necrophiliac who has been terrorizing graveyards across the state of Maine.

Entries.Title: A Deal With The Devil
Entries.Description: Jai Faustus, an overworked associate at Underworld Enterprises, finds himself face to face with his toughest client yet, Lillian Reithwin, the entitled and morally bankrupt corporate lawyer who storms in mere moments after the office closes. Desperate to protect her spotless legal record, Lillian demands a deal, but her outrageous requests leave Jai in a professional and moral dilemma. As Lillian's shenanigans ensue, he finds himself wondering which of the two is the real devil.

Entries.Title: Headlines
Entries.Description: A fading actress and her A-List husband confront the realities of their relationship after a recent tragedy.

Entries.Title: Hold Me, Softly
Entries.Description: 'Hold Me, Softly' follows the blossoming friendship between a reclusive video-game designer and her charming new neighbor. As they talk through the most profound tears and laughter along the curbside, their heartwarming story captures the essence of summer and the promise of hopeful beginnings.

Entries.Title: Crazy N' Luv
Entries.Description: Stephen, who has schizophrenia, falls for a beautiful woman named Camille during a rideshare—only to discover her dark side may lead to his downfall.

Entries.Title: The Pluto Theory
Entries.Description: Zeek, a sweet but timid young man, is struggling to deal with the disappearance of his life-long friend Presley, a cartoon-obsessed, narcissistic, control freak. Eventually, Zeek meets Keith, a confident, kindhearted guy, who shows Zeek what friendship truly means.

Entries.Title: Ice Cream Man
Entries.Description: A former internet star with a stunted film career struggles to find his place while working at an ice cream shop.

Entries.Title: Lesbian Vampire Seeking Jewish Lover
Entries.Description: In a small Catholic town, lonely vampyr Laura finds love in an unexpected place when a nice Jewish girl named Hannah materialises in her life.

Entries.Title: The Scissoring of Lydia Kollins
Entries.Description: Lydia B Kollins Black & White Ball elimination short film. If only she hadn't picked up those scissors.

Entries.Title: Baller State of Mind: The Philosophy of David Arquette
Entries.Description: David Arquette explains his fascinating philosophy.

Entries.Title: Mr. Buzzkill
Entries.Description: Years ago, the small town of Silver Grove witnessed a massacre like no other and the legend of Mr. Buzzkill was born. Today, a group of friends are about to meet the ultimate party crasher - and slasher.

Entries.Title: Shrouded Recursion
Entries.Description: A secret agent is tasked with an impossible task, until she learns that she is in a time loop. Can she figure out the puzzle before the situation gets even worse?

Entries.Title: Harvested 4
Entries.Description: A small town legend returns from the dead to serve vengeance on Thanksgiving night.

Entries.Title: Streamers, Steamers, & Struggles on the Krka
Entries.Description: Four kayakers (ab)use rafting as a means to catch fish on Slovenia’s chalk stream called Krka. Casting flies amongst castles and cattails, this became the arena for a gruelling competition that applied pressure of all kinds.

Entries.Title: Umpan: The Betta Fish
Entries.Description: After a boy goes missing in a peaceful yet superstitious fishing village, a teenager begins to experience haunting visions, forcing him to question his sanity.

Entries.Title: Office Worker
Entries.Description: Dennis is back in a whole new job, but things are about to take a turn for the worst.

Entries.Title: Move Aside! I’m The Final Boss
Entries.Description: In Move Aside I'm the Final Boss Movie, Kingsley is the secret King of King's Corps and the richest man on Earth, but when he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart brutally dumps him, thinking he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?

Entries.Title: Slash
Entries.Description: A group of friends are terrorized by a masked killer on Halloween.

Entries.Title: Mood Swings
Entries.Description: A coming of age drama about three different teen characters struggling to get by in their home town.  The first named Matthew is kicked out of his house and forced to find a job to support himself, the second named Noah is a hot shot basketball player who suffers an injury and can’t fulfill his scholarship to play on the college team, and the third named Eric is a party animal type who’s bad habits are leading him down a dark path that he may never get out of.

Entries.Title: Bela Belara's A Vampire
Entries.Description: A brassy young woman gets caught in the ploy of an underbelly vampire cult to kill other people.

Entries.Title: The Book
Entries.Description: Meet The Great Opticisioner. Bet you wish you hadn't, huh?

Entries.Title: Trump's Power & the Rule of Law
Entries.Description: FRONTLINE goes inside the high-stakes showdown between President Donald Trump and the courts over presidential power. Trump allies, opponents and experts talk about how he is testing the extent of his power; the legal pushback; and the impact on the rule of law.

Entries.Title: Minister Chucky
Entries.Description: As the specter of rising fascism looms, a queer couple celebrates their love with an unconventional Vegas wedding—officiated by Chucky, the killer doll—before making their escape to Canada.

Entries.Title: Limbo of Roots
Entries.Description: A burning room. Crawling vines. City bustling. Trees living and dying. Roots breathing. Nightmare.

Entries.Title: Faith (Short Film)
Entries.Description: One man goes through the same routine day by day with the responsibility of saving the world, but he will discover something that will question everything he's ever known.

Entries.Title: Comic Cash
Entries.Description: A underpaid teenager who works in a comic book store finds out that two of his comic books are worth thousands of dollars.

Entries.Title: Pick One
Entries.Description: It’s Danny’s wedding day, and he has a big choice to make. Cue the insanity. Pick One is a chaotic bisexual Italian wedding rom-com... with a porchetta.

Entries.Title: DCI 2025: Big, Loud & Live!
Entries.Description: Get your 50-yard-line seats to the Drum Corps International World Championship Prelims, broadcast LIVE from Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis! Marching Music’s Major League returns to the big screen as the top-15 performing corps compete for their shot at the 2025 DCI World Championship title.

Entries.Title: The Rabbit Hole
Entries.Description: Isaac, a neurotic tree-hugger, builds a god-like supercomputer in order to save the natural world. But, when the machine comes to life and his existence begins to crumble, Isaac is forced to choose between destiny and the person he loves most.

Entries.Title: Glory to the Nation
Entries.Description: A border control inspector’s morals are challenged after meeting a woman among countless war refugees.

Entries.Title: Scam To Horror
Entries.Description: After a life of scamming and murder, a young woman visits the cemetery for revenge and brings back the attention of an enemy she never attended to go to war against again.

Entries.Title: Girls Love Discarded Cigarettes
Entries.Description: Short film by Jaxon Ray.

Entries.Title: Trapped in Temptation
Entries.Description: In a tale of love, betrayal, and forbidden desires, a devoted wife grapples with loneliness and her unraveling marriage to her workaholic husband.

Entries.Title: Fingertips
Entries.Description: In the Henley Hillcrest community, A faceless killer known as “FINGERTIPS” terrorizes civilians, leaving cryptic, deadly patterns. As fear spreads and legends grow, no one is safe—and every twist brings the audience closer to an unpredictable, chilling conclusion.

Entries.Title: La Manuelita
Entries.Description: A young woman of Peruvian descent born in Spain learns about her grandmother's connection to a very special friend: a skull who called "Manuelita", who has helped protect and guide her throughout a tumultuous life.

Entries.Title: Power Slap 13: Dumpling vs. Da Hawaiian Hitman
Entries.Description: PRESENTED BY MONSTER ENERGY  During International Fight Week on Friday, June 27 at 6PM, catch the hard-hitting action of Power Slap 13: Dumpling vs Da Hawaiian Hitman.  Headlining Power Slap 13 will be a super heavyweight title match between current Power Slap Super Heavyweight Champion Dumpling (2-0-1) and No. 2 ranked contender Dayne “Da Hawaiian Hitman” Viernes (2-2). Dumpling aims to defend his newly won title for the first time after claiming the Power Slap championship following a unanimous decision over Layne “Da Crazy Hawaiian” Viernes at Power Slap 11 earlier this year. Da Hawaiian Hitman plans to make the most of his first opportunity at the belt and exact a measure of revenge for his brother’s loss against Dumpling and begin his reign as the new world champion.

Entries.Title: SWIPE
Entries.Description: She tries to swipe her way to happiness, but after an exhaustive body count, she resorts to assembling her dream boy from left over parts. Welcome to the Meet Market!

Entries.Title: Rickey Smiley: Fool-ish
Entries.Description: Family and fans gathered to celebrate not just Smiley’s return to comedy, but also his resilience. Fool-ish marks his first comedy special in over a decade and was inspired by personal growth and loss—including the tragic passing of his eldest son.

Entries.Title: Fields of Devotion
Entries.Description: When a devastating disease wipes out farmers’ fields, growers turn to scientists for help. Fields of Devotion follows the unique working partnership between New Jersey farmers and Rutgers plant biologists as they develop disease and climate-resistant food crops.

Entries.Title: Never My Love
Entries.Description: In a Berlin nightclub, a lonely man is seduced by a mysterious person, who then invites him to spend an unforgettable night together with their partner.

Entries.Title: Stolen Kingdom
Entries.Description: A look into the underground community of rule-breakers at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida and how their actions led to the disappearance of an Audio-Animatronic named Buzzy.

Entries.Title: brothers karamazov
Entries.Description: What terrible tragedies realism inflicts on people

Entries.Title: Los Vaqueros
Entries.Description: In the early 1990s in West Texas, three ambitious young men begin their ascent to notoriety within their small town crime organization as they navigate the treacherous underworld of drugs, gambling, and illicit deals. Their rise to power brings both wealth and danger, testing their bonds and morality in a world where trust is fragile and betrayal is commonplace.

Entries.Title: EVOL
Entries.Description: EVOL is a gripping tale of dreams, resilience, and love. Elijah, a Black British rapper, once tasted the sweetness of minor success but now finds himself living out of his car, clinging to the fragments of his ambition. Despite the hardships, his devoted girlfriend Lauren remains his anchor, encouraging him to pursue his passion for music. Together, they hatch a bold plan to leave the struggles of London behind and chase a brighter future in Atlanta, the vibrant heart of hip-hop. Will Elijah find his voice in a new land, or will the weight of his past hold him back? EVOL is a raw and intimate exploration of ambition, sacrifice.

Entries.Title: Dreadful Penny Dreadful
Entries.Description: “DREADFUL PENNY DREADFUL dares to violate every remaining shred of ‘good taste’ using the vehicle of Brecht and Weill’s much-abused ‘Moritat von Mackie Messer,’ aka ‘Mack the Knife.’ Over 200 versions collide, taking you from its origins in Weimar Berlin to the multiple travesties of Rat Pack Vegas and the many imitators of each on East Block TV and in cheesy Jersey nightclubs. Further stops along the way include Midwestern High School chorus practice and performances of ivy college a capella groups, not to mention jazz improvisation sessions, talent shows, and rockers doing high Kultur! A splendid time is guaranteed for all.” –Keith Sanborn

Entries.Title: I Hear America Singing
Entries.Description: Composer Robbie Doerfler’s world unravels as he and his friends Roger and Rose pull together the strands of his music and personal narrative for one final backer’s audition whilst hounded by a disdainful documentarian named Charon. Blending operatic, musical theater, and filmic conventions, music history, fantasy, and docufiction, themes of creativity, identity, and mortality, culminate in a poignant and thought-provoking question: “Where do we go when we go up — is it Heaven?”

Entries.Title: Stomachache
Entries.Description: A woman over works herself to the point that she begins overeating, but, after eating uncooked food, she becomes grotesquely ill and unable to work properly

Entries.Title: Sounds of Glass
Entries.Description: Enna works in a unique store where she sells bottled sounds to customers who wish to reconnect with their past through experiencing auditory memories. When a series of unusual clients cause her buried emotions to resurface, Enna must confront a painful memory she's tried to forget.

Entries.Title: Matilija
Entries.Description: MARTY, AN OBITUARY WRITER IN LOS ANGELES, AND HIS BROTHER GEORGE HAVEN’T SPOKEN SINCE THEIR FATHER’S PASSING IN THEIR YOUTH. NOW, NEARLY A DECADE LATER, DEATH UNITES THE TWO AGAIN WHEN MARTY RETURNS HOME FOR HIS MOTHER’S FUNERAL.

Entries.Title: Among Many
Entries.Description: Luigi, a cat rescued from the streets, lives in an animal shelter alongside other felines with troubled pasts. When he's adopted by a family, he believes he’s finally found a place to call home. But the unstable environment of the new household soon makes it clear that living with humans isn’t always a promise of happiness. Forced back to the streets, Luigi must once again face the harsh realities of survival — and discover where he truly belongs.

Entries.Title: Cupid
Entries.Description: A young woman dumped by her unfaithful boyfriend on Valentine's Day, seeks assistance from her witchy roommate to help heal her broken heart. They wind up summoning Cupid to enact revenge on her ex-boyfriend and his new partner in her honor.

Entries.Title: A Day
Entries.Description: A young boxer must confront his family's traumatic past when his estranged older brother is released from prison.

Entries.Title: Bad Ben 15: Poltergeist
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: American Scream
Entries.Description: Two would be killers get more than they bargained for when dead bodies turn up at a warehouse that they've never encountered before. As their work day drags on, they start questioning each other, and are driven to sci-fi madness.

Entries.Title: Nobody Cares
Entries.Description: Today, loneliness is the most common feeling in the world. Danny, living alone in his 30s and searching for connection, goes to the last place he thought he would end up - an orgy.

Entries.Title: Collisions & Damages
Entries.Description: On the morning of her sister’s wedding, dutiful Lyall Chan spirals after catching wind of the bride and groom’s plans.

Entries.Title: Teller's Camp
Entries.Description: A prospector and his son battle vengeful bandits over a disputed claim during the California Gold Rush.

Entries.Title: Crash Out
Entries.Description: A hot tempered college student crashes out on her quest for revenge after her nemesis steals her slides during a group presentation

Entries.Title: Silim
Entries.Description: Hayden Han is a grieving travel influencer with ten million followers and no one to call. With Christmas looming, he takes on a dodgy brand deal solely on the promise that it will take him far, far away from his lonesome home life--in this case, twenty-four hours on the white sand beaches of the Philippines. But Manila has its own plans for Hayden, and as day turns dusk (tagalog: silim) in the City of Sun, Hayden finds himself pulled into a roiling high-speed chase that brings him face-to-face with the man he's becoming.

Entries.Title: Lazybones
Entries.Description: After a devastating breakup, Moss Henry searches for a sense of purpose by volunteering as a dummy for a women's self-defense class.

Entries.Title: Mpobe & The Mysterious World
Entries.Description: In "Mpobe & The Mysterious World (Uganda’s first 3D  adventure film)," a skilled hunter named Mpobe embarks  on an extraordinary journey after he follows his dog,  Ddungu, into a mystical portal hidden in a dark cave.  Transported to a mysterious underworld teeming with  strange creatures and ancient secrets, Mpobe must  navigate perilous challenges, from dinosaur chases to  encounters with talking trees. His only hope of returning  home lies in finding the elusive temple of Walumbe, the  formidable king of the underworld. Along the way,  Mpobe discovers that survival requires not only bravery  but also wisdom, as he makes a pact with Walumbe to  keep the secrets of the underworld. But a moment of  temptation leads to dire consequences, threatening  Mpobe's return to his loved ones and setting the stage  for a battle between the realms.

Entries.Title: Reticent
Entries.Description: Sam is an emotionally reserved college freshman going through a very rough time. But when a tragedy occurs, he learns to express himself clearly.

Entries.Title: Eighteen
Entries.Description: It's the day before Grace Fitzgerald's 18th Birthday - aka the last day of her childhood. Desperate to have one last 'golden' day, Grace and her best friend, Bella, skip school to have an adventure.

Entries.Title: Frankie Teardrop
Entries.Description: Frankie lies. Frankie remembers an unfortunate event from his past and how it spiralled into the state he’s in now, with a little help from an old friend.

Entries.Title: How to Save the Immortal 2:  Elixer of Life
Entries.Description: Drybone the Immortal and Shieldmaiden Barbara are preparing for their wedding, but not all Barbara's relatives are happy about the union. Her strong-willed aunt, Queen Brungilda, believes her niece deserves a more suitable match. In a misguided attempt to stop the wedding, she unwittingly casts a powerful sleeping charm on Barbara. The Queen proclaims that the legendary Elixir of Life can save Barbara, but only a truly noble knight will survive the treacherous path to the Elixir, hidden in a perilous place where danger lurks at every turn. Drybone, known as a dark sorcerer, stands no chance in this noble quest, so he enlists Elijah, a true and valiant knight but clumsy and fearful, to join him. In a tale filled with action, magic, and humor, only a true hero can save Barbara and restore peace and joy to the kingdom.

Entries.Title: Literally Slay!
Entries.Description: A Grooks Spinoff series starring Angela Smith, a True-Crime influencer who attempts to solve crimes, from renowned director Carter Canfield

Entries.Title: Generation Well
Entries.Description: After a serious run in with the law, a young woman becomes obsessed with an officer who looks identical to her deceased father.

Entries.Title: Introducing the NeuraFridge Mark IV
Entries.Description: Infomercial about NeuraCorp's newest product: the NeuraFridge MkIV

Entries.Title: Confessions of a Parent Killer
Entries.Description: In 2023, Virginia McCullough was charged with murdering her parents. Speaking freely to arresting officers, Virginia confessed to killing her parents in 2019 and then living alongside their dead bodies for the next five years in the house they shared.

Entries.Title: Alone in Venice
Entries.Description: A young man who has fallen in love with a married director is waiting for her in Venice, Italy as she is raising funds to make a film in Italy. The longer he waits the more he thinks about what is love and the relationship between the director and himself. Finally they meet in the middle of a bridge above the canal to talk and resolve their conflicts as Venice is flooding in November.​

Entries.Title: Somewhere Below 14th & East: The Lost Photography Of Karen O'Sullivan
Entries.Description: In the early 1980s, Karen O'Sullivan made her way from where she grew up on Manhattan, NY's Upper West Side to the then-desolate Lower East Side to photograph the burgeoning scenes of hardcore punk and hip hop. "Somewhere Below 14th & East" is the first collection of Karen's photos, compiling over 150 images of artists as diverse as The Clash, Run DMC, Iggy Pop, Beastie Boys, Minor Threat, UTFO, Misfits, and Whodini, as well as the various characters and ne'er-do-wells brave enough to witness history in the making. With its combination of O'Sullivan's striking imagery and first-hand accounts by those who were there, "Somewhere Below 14th & East" chronicles an extraordinary time where boundless possibility and stifling desperation intersected to create one of the most vital and creative times in New York's history.

Entries.Title: Pascal
Entries.Description: In the intimate confines of their home, Pascal's birthday turns into a harrowing exploration of mental health and family dynamics.

Entries.Title: Screenplay: Tâsiân: Frames
Entries.Description: This film is an episodic look at the lives of artists who have been separated from their normal lives for nearly a century to create their works. And each time, they switch places with their lover; So that she can continue their unfinished path... Until the next separation comes, and the next, and the next...

Entries.Title: Rehash
Entries.Description: A coder beta tests a groundbreaking program after a breakup

Entries.Title: Tales From the Suburbs: The Solicitor
Entries.Description: A young man admires a cactus on his way home, much to the attention of something lurking in his neighborhood.

Entries.Title: Who I Thought I'd Be
Entries.Description: A frustrated Musician who’s struggled to find an audience is forced to return home to work at his sister's music school. He tries to escape the tedium by writing a new song but he’s struggling to find it amongst the constant distractions. When inspiration finally comes, he’s interrupted by a young student who is drawn in by what he hears. Through their unexpected connection, new music emerges showing that vulnerability can lead to beautiful things. A lighthearted exploration of the songwriting process, the transformative power of music, and what it means to find an audience. Featuring an acting debut and never-before-published music by acclaimed songwriter Jens Kuross and introducing actor/musician Jude Bentham, age 13.

Entries.Title: Beyond the Endless Light
Entries.Description: A priest with miraculous abilities has a crisis of faith.

Entries.Title: mnemonic
Entries.Description: Building thinks thought, has realization. landscape in translation.

Entries.Title: Brother Orange
Entries.Description: "Brother Orange" follows the story of Matt Stopera, a BuzzFeed founding editor, whose life takes an unexpected turn when his stolen phone, lost in a New York City bar, becomes the catalyst for a viral BuzzFeed article a year later. The article launched a viral feel-good story about a lasting friendship that transcends language and culture and has captivated the world with over 100 million views on social media, including over 70 million shares on Weibo, and traditional media such as NPR, Rachel Maddow, and Ellen while propelling Matt into instant celebrity status. As their 10-year friendship anniversary nears, this extraordinary true story showcases the power of personal connection between two ordinary people-one American and one Chinese-who look beyond political tensions to form a profound bond.

Entries.Title: The Fine Art of Gl'nage
Entries.Description: This piece gives the viewer a glimpse into the life and philosophy of Dale Egan who has been practicing the art of 'Gl'nage' for decades where he reclaims the artefacts of our disposable society.

Entries.Title: Supar Pilut
Entries.Description: Aliens kidnapped his dad, so now he travels the stars slapping every alien he can find.

Entries.Title: N.E.S.T.
Entries.Description: Two detectives discover series of leads to break a mystery code to rescue a victim from someone who existed back in time .

Entries.Title: Unlike You
Entries.Description: A discouraged video artist suddenly becomes obsessed with a woman appearing in his dreams. However, when he finally meets her, he makes a horrifying discovery.

Entries.Title: Secrets in the Sisterhood
Entries.Description: When a sorority president is murdered before rush week, her two Littles- Brianna and Chrissy- compete in an election to become her successor, but find themselves counting more than just votes as bodies pile up around them.

Entries.Title: The Orkney Assassin
Entries.Description: In 1994, a masked man entered the sole Indian restaurant in Scotland's remote islands, killed a waiter, and vanished. Years later, new evidence led to a shocking arrest in the community.

Entries.Title: The Quincy Avery Effect
Entries.Description: A game-changing story of grit and victory. From 1,000 nights of homelessness to coaching NFL's top Quarterbacks, Quincy Avery continues to break barriers, unlocking the full potential of athletes and reshaping the future of the game

Entries.Title: AN ANIMATED DOG READS JOHN BERGER, HARAWAY, AND KAFKA
Entries.Description: During the COVID-19 pandemic, 23 million American households adopted pets, reflecting the growing urge for animal companions. The evolving, yet complex bond between humans and animals lies at the core of Artist in Focus Matthew Lax’s AN ANIMATED DOG READS JOHN BERGER, HARAWAY, AND KAFKA which explores the complexities of human-dog relationships through cultural and philosophical lenses.

Entries.Title: Some Of Us Watch The Sunset, Too
Entries.Description: After a couple great dates, Gina falls hard for Matt. It seems perfect: they went to the same college, they like the same things, and the chemistry is hot! But when Gina meets his circle of friends, it becomes apparent why they never crossed paths in college: he's rich.

Entries.Title: Playin' Around
Entries.Description: Determined to buy the perfect gift for her little brother, a young woman must fight her way through crazed customers at a toy store turned madhouse.

Entries.Title: The Grim & The Dark
Entries.Description: When looking for a gift for his kid, Jon Heder (Napoleon Dynamite) is introduced to the world of Grimdark. In that moment he starts down a journey that will take him all over the world and through interviews with prominent Grimdark authors, game developers, and dedicated fans, he delves into the themes that define the genre—all in an effort to find the man who started it all: John Blanche.

Entries.Title: THIS IS NOT AN EMERGENCY
Entries.Description: A culmination of experiences from growing up in Georgia...

Entries.Title: Dive Tour Documentary
Entries.Description: The full tour doc, with all episodes combined & some unseen footage.

Entries.Title: Jenny Tian: Chinese Australian
Entries.Description: Chinese Australian is my second ever special. It's one big story about my start in stand up comedy and the inevitability of becoming a ~Content creator~ got more experimental with this one. hope you enjoy watching as much asI did performing :)

Entries.Title: Never One
Entries.Description: A young adult with a troubled history with alcohol meets his friends for a quiet night in, but their poor influence on each other coupled with growing intoxication leads to a night out of anyone's control.

Entries.Title: The Pigs Underneath
Entries.Description: Impoverished residents of a tight-knit dystopian community are forced to meet a brutal quota to survive. A young man and his mother are thwarted by theft, betrayal and the horrifying secrets of their desperate neighbors.

Entries.Title: Jack & Joker: U Steal My Heart! -  Special
Entries.Description: While Jack and Joke prepare for their wedding, an enemy from their past returns threatening to ruin everything.

Entries.Title: Exhaustion Lines
Entries.Description: After nearly crashing his car, a sleep deprived drifter decides to find a place to get some much needed shut-eye. But one outrageous obstacle after another keeps him wide awake.

Entries.Title: Dresses and the Struggles of Wearing Them
Entries.Description: When Iona finds the most beautiful dress in the world but it doesn't look right on her she tries everything she to look right and find her place in the world.

Entries.Title: Shattered Vows
Entries.Description: A honeymoon goes tragically wrong when new groom, Brendan, falls off a hotel balcony, leaving his bride, Sarah, devastated. When the autopsy points to murder, Sarah must quickly prove her innocence or risk a lifetime separated from her stepdaughter.

Entries.Title: On the End
Entries.Description: Tom, a curmudgeonly Montauk mechanic, unexpectedly finds love online with Freckles, a spitfire outcast diabetic like himself. Their newfound happiness comes under threat when Tom’s lucrative beachfront property and repair shop becomes the target of an unscrupulous real estate agent, whose underhanded tactics emboldens the gentrified community to turn on this established resident lowering their property values. Based on true events, On The End features outstanding performances from Tim Blake Nelson and Mireille Enos as the inspiring working-class couple fighting against the power, greed, and corruption of a changing community, giving hope to take on and endure the fight when there’s everything to lose.

Entries.Title: Spilled Milk
Entries.Description: What really happened to all the dads that went to get milk and never came back?  A father’s innocent errand leads him to an encounter with an enigmatic figure called 'The Milk Man', where things quickly go sour.

Entries.Title: The Thrilling Adventure of Amos Waters
Entries.Description: The Thrilling Adventure of Amos Waters is the story of a ten-year-old boy, Amos, filled with a childlike curiosity about the world and a craving to understand all aspects of life.  The film follows Amos' journey to understand his single, alcoholic father. He travels to a liquor store armed with his father's ID to buy alcohol, but no matter his determination to present himself as his father, everything keeps going wrong. Eventually, on his way home, he passes by a Sunday mass service and attends service to get drunk on the Communion wine. After tasting alcohol, meeting unlikely friends, and going on the journey of a lifetime, Amos has to decide whether or not he can find contempt in the incomprehension of his father's illness.

Entries.Title: TAKEN
Entries.Description: When of bunch of friends go missing, its up to three friends to solve the mystery.

Entries.Title: Plinko and Mark
Entries.Description: Plinko & Mark revolves around the antics of Plinko and Mark, long-time friends and current roommates that live in an early-nineties New-York-esque city. The duo’s drastically different outlooks and approaches to life lead to plenty of entertaining scenarios.

Entries.Title: Gold of Rio Bravo: Sheriff Kelly's Story
Entries.Description: 1874, East Texas. Sheriff Vernon Kelly and former General Ivan Turchin restore justice in small American towns on the border with Mexico. One of the skirmishes with cutthroats forces Sheriff Kelly to reveal to Ivan the secret of the "Confederate gold" stolen during the American Civil War.

Entries.Title: When Bruce Springsteen Came to Britain
Entries.Description: The film tells the story of how Springsteen and the E Street Band first arrived in the UK in November 1975 for a sold-out performance in Hammersmith, giving his new album Born to Run its European premiere

Entries.Title: Animal Math
Entries.Description: A HANDMADE, FANTASTICALLY DARK ANIMATED SYMPHONY.

Entries.Title: Pookie & Peanut
Entries.Description: When his beloved Pookie is kidnapped, Peanut will fight across the desert to get him back.

Entries.Title: Citizen Mickey
Entries.Description: An ode to appropriation. Mickey Mouse long the center of the copyright debate of free expression vs property rights was finally made a free mouse on January 1st, 2024.

Entries.Title: Nina
Entries.Description: Getting ready to go their own ways in life, an uncertain boy and his anxious girlfriend have to decide how to navigate their next steps.

Entries.Title: Only in This World
Entries.Description: When an empty nester loses her ability to summon her daughter back from the afterlife, she is forced to find help from the person she resents the most: her ex- husband's mistress.

Entries.Title: Noise: Reflejo
Entries.Description: Those aren't dreams, he is real, and he is coming after him.

Entries.Title: The Thirteenth Wife: Escaping Polygamy, Part 2
Entries.Description: Following a failed attack, Ervil’s rage reaches an all-time high and causes Rena to fear for her and her daughter’s safety. Determined to protect her daughter and break free from the horrific cult, Rena must navigate her way to safety without falling victim to Ervil’s paranoia or his violent followers. Against all odds, Rena finds the strength to break free from the cult’s grasps and escape with her daughter. Together, they begin a new life, determined to make amends for their role in the cult’s crimes. But will she ever really be able to escape the memory of Ervil? Part two of a two-part film.

Entries.Title: Majestic Flesh Faucet of Projectile Bile
Entries.Description: Majestic Flesh Faucet of Projectile Bile is the fourth entry in the Erotic Grotesque Nonsense series. A performance in blasphemy, apostacy, satanism, and mysophilia. Starring newcomer Regan Fox, along with her special talent of puking with no hands. This latest installment has all the fetish and gore you have grown to love, while also spitting in the face of God.

Entries.Title: Caiman
Entries.Description: A grieving widower documents his return to Vieques Island to hunt the creature he claims killed his fiance.

Entries.Title: Dance of Destiny
Entries.Description: A TNT Sports Original Documentary featuring 40+ head coaches who examine how to navigate the chaos and unpredictability of the Men's College Basketball Tournament

Entries.Title: Jo
Entries.Description: Jo; or The Act of Riding a Bike is Zefier's third film.

Entries.Title: Unknit the Ghost
Entries.Description: unknit the ghost is a live show exploring addiction and cycles of trauma. The show combines live performers choreographed by Charlie Jimenez with projections by video artist Autojektor.  Staged at PORTAL 002 - plantroom, Smeed Road, London - April 12th, 2025.

Entries.Title: Man From Shandong
Entries.Description: In a dark, gritty, city in China, an old, mysterious man gets captured by a dangerous mafia group, only to find out that the old man is not who he seems to be.

Entries.Title: The Monster
Entries.Description: A lonely doctor in a desolate castle creates a monster to cure his lonesomeness. When the monster discovers the means of his creation, their friendship dissolves into antagonism.

Entries.Title: Alien Contact: Government Coverup
Entries.Description: Explore the enduring mystery of the Roswell incident, where an alleged UFO crash in 1947 sparked decades of speculation and intrigue. Through eyewitness testimonies, expert analysis, and declassified documents, this documentary examines claims of extraterrestrial encounters and government coverups. Discover the cultural and historical impact of the event that ignited global fascination and ask: was it a weather balloon, or the greatest secret ever kept?

Entries.Title: Mommy's Perfect Match
Entries.Description: Monica was born into the darkness of abuse and forged in trauma. Once triggered, Monica embarks on a journey using her manipulative personality - filled with mistrust, fear, and a desire to be loved, to seek a mother figure who will love her unconditionally or die trying. Who says love doesn’t cost a thing?

Entries.Title: Shared Bodies
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Breaking 10
Entries.Description: Breaking 10 chronicles the pursuit of athletic excellence and personal growth as it follows amateur triathlete Justin Hibbert in his attempt to complete a full Ironman in under 10 hours, an accomplishment tried by many and achieved by few.

Entries.Title: For the Time Being
Entries.Description: Three Greek intellectuals gather for the Great Summoning, a mysterious phenomenon that may take days to manifest. While they wait, they attempt to figure out what to do for the time being.

Entries.Title: The Inheritance
Entries.Description: Two siblings go and have a look around the house they have inherited from their father, who has passed away. However, they have no idea about the terrors that await them inside the house.

Entries.Title: Jaws vs Mega Croc
Entries.Description: In a one-of-a-kind event, the great white shark faces off against the Nile crocodile in a CGI fight to the death.

Entries.Title: Women in Christ
Entries.Description: More than a documentary—Women in Christ is a call to every woman who’s ever wondered if her story matters. It does. Because when we see these women, we see the Savior.

Entries.Title: It's Dorothy!
Entries.Description: Since Dorothy Gale started her epic journey down the Yellow Brick Road over a century ago in THE WONDEFUL WIZARD OF OZ, she’s become a celebrity, a brand, and a beacon for marginalized voices across our culture. IT’S DOROTHY! brings to life her timeless adventures in Oz through those who’ve played her, from Judy Garland to Nichelle Lewis (THE WIZ), and the cultural icons (John Waters, Lena Waithe, Rufus Wainwright) who she’s inspired to hope and to dream. With a magical remix of archival and cinematic art, director Jeffrey McHale follows up his SHOWGIRLS documentary with another insightful look at a queer cultural touchstone.

Entries.Title: Hoagie
Entries.Description: A mysterious egg contains an impish creature who can grant great power, for good or evil. Brendan Bean, a kindly family man, finds himself face to face with the bizarre creature, and before long a friendship for the ages develops. Meanwhile, the depraved Benny Piazza leads his deranged militia on a violent quest to reclaim the magical homunculi.

Entries.Title: No Demands
Entries.Description: When a murderer named Killer DeWayne comes into a cop's life only to destroy her because of a shooting of his brother things get intense and she has to fight back after her sister is kidnapped.

Entries.Title: Debunking HDR
Entries.Description: Industry cinematographer Steve Yedlin (Star Wars: The Last Jedi, Knives Out, Looper) presents issues with the current implementations of and thinking around HDR in the movie business and gives potential solutions.

Entries.Title: The Rise and Rise of Girard eh Denique
Entries.Description: Girard eh Denique are the hottest french DJ duo. They've come to New York to become superstars...

Entries.Title: Palindrome
Entries.Description: Four friends take a hike through the forest for a weekend cabin getaway. However after stumbling across a rundown staircase leading apparently nowhere, Gabe, Charles, Alyssa, and Hannah must survive against a terrifying enemy that feels a little too familiar.

Entries.Title: Gatvės lenktynininkai: Tokijas
Entries.Description: Tokyo’s streets may seem calm and quiet at night. But in a suburban garage, the night shift is just beginning. Tires are fitted, engines tuned, and tension rising. As street racers prepare to hit the roads, the police show up, looking to shut it all down. At 2 a.m., Japan’s drifters roll out to hone their skills and chase the dream of a professional racing career. Lithuania's Vytautas "Ironvytas" Medineckas dives into the world of Tokyo’s underground drift scene, where neither cops nor roadblocks can stop the night riders.

Entries.Title: Idiots at the sea
Entries.Description: The next chapter in the lore of the ICU (Idiotic Cinematic Universe), which sees part of the group in Marseille swimming, hiking, scheming, murdering, and debating bad football opinions. They may or may not have known they were being filmed.

Entries.Title: Sherri Papini: Caught in the Lie
Entries.Description: The wife and mother at the center of one of the most sensational kidnapping cases ever speaks for the first time about the circumstances that led to her mysterious disappearance, why she lied to the FBI, and what the media got wrong about her story.

Entries.Title: Miss O'Dell
Entries.Description: Join Chris O'Dell, who became PA to The Beatles and managed tours for rock legends like The Rolling Stones, as she retraces her storied past.

Entries.Title: Crossroads
Entries.Description: Follows a group of friends in Texas navigating adulthood.

Entries.Title: SILENCE broken by SILENCE
Entries.Description: The city you experience everyday. Into the mind of a homeless man who shares the lack of help he got while being on the streets.

Entries.Title: Studs
Entries.Description: Two bitter exes must put their differences aside when they’re drafted into a government breeding program designed to help save humanity’s dwindling population.

Entries.Title: The Last Anniversary
Entries.Description: On the eve of the apocalypse, a couple hosts  their tenth anniversary at the abandoned hotel  where they were wed, forcing the guests from  their wedding party to confront the long-buried  truth about their missing maid of honor.

Entries.Title: Crusts
Entries.Description: A coming-of-age story about the first time you act against your true nature. Inspired by the old wives tale - eating the bread crusts makes your hair go curly - Paris explores and her relationship with her crusts, her best friend, and her hair.

Entries.Title: Beam Me Up, Sulu
Entries.Description: In 1985, George Takei helped a group of young Trekkies make a fan film—then the footage vanished. Nearly 40 years later, the search to recover it opens a window into Takei's extraordinary life, Star Trek’s legacy of inclusion and the ongoing fight for equality and representation.

Entries.Title: Black Canvas
Entries.Description: A young woman quickly discovers that she has unleashed something horrible after painting a canvas black.

Entries.Title: I am Perfectly Normal Director's Cut
Entries.Description: Denying his flourishing compulsive homosexuality, a forgotten celebrity confronts his incestuous obsession along the path of self-discovery.

Entries.Title: The Diddy Verdict
Entries.Description: For 25 years, Diddy's rise to stardom and power masked a darker reality. This documentary exposes the voices of those who were silenced-sharing allegations of abuse, manipulation, and career sabotage behind the scenes of his influential empire. It's a revealing look at the cost of fame and control in the music industry.

Entries.Title: Change, Not Charity: The Americans with Disabilities Act
Entries.Description: Change, Not Charity: The Americans with Disabilities Act tells the emotional and dramatic story of the decades-long push for equality and accessibility that culminated in the passage of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) in 1990. While curb cuts, ramps at building entrances, and braille on elevator buttons seem commonplace today, they were once the subject of a pitched battle that landed on the steps of Congress. Told through the voices of key participants and witnesses, the film highlights the determined people who literally put their bodies on the line to achieve their goal and change the lives of all Americans. A story of courage and perseverance, the film brings to life one of the great civil rights movements in American history, where ordinary people made their voices heard and Congress responded. A testament to the power of coalition building and bipartisan compromise, the passage of the ADA is a shining example of democracy in action.

Entries.Title: ANTS 1ST. EDITION
Entries.Description: Prison reform, prophecies, and an alien all have their moment in the new half-hour sci-fi romance anthology from Roman Arcadi.

Entries.Title: The Combination
Entries.Description: After an incident at their speakeasy, young bootleggers Isadore “Kid Cann” Blumenfeld and his brother Harry seek representation from esteemed defense attorney Hyman Mendow. Based on a true story.

Entries.Title: Night Ripper
Entries.Description: Scored by Girl Talk and produced by Junk Food Dinner, NIGHT RIPPER is a visual essay about a different time and place.

Entries.Title: Walking Distance
Entries.Description: Walking Distance uses footage of Mount Fuji from Quaintance’s personal archive. It combines this material with an exploration of the distances covered and locations visited during a period of research and production in Tokyo during April 2024.

Entries.Title: My Lake Erie Movie
Entries.Description: The footage in this movie was captured, without any intended purpose, between the years of 2008 and 2023 when the filmmaker visited her childhood home in Mentor, Ohio, a town that sits along the shores of the Great Lake Erie. Shot instinctively, haphazardly, gloriously with whatever devices were on hand, most notably multiple BlackBerry phones and a FUJIFILM X-T200, this kaleidoscopic film (perhaps) seeks to find out what Iris Murdoch meant when she wrote: “Time, like the sea, unties all knots.”

Entries.Title: Human Nature in Eleven Parts
Entries.Description: Short vignettes explore different facets of human behavior and social issues.

Entries.Title: Gator Girl
Entries.Description: Elle heads back to her home to rescue her younger sister, related but strangers after many years have passed. Connected through a shared legacy, we watch as they bond. The connection Elle thought she had lost, may not be dead and gone.

Entries.Title: Remote
Entries.Description: A remote worker experiencing an emotional crisis is offered the opportunity to participate in "work therapy" at a remote cabin overseen by her company. Upon arriving, her condition worsens and she begins to question her sanity and her company's motives.

Entries.Title: City Rush 4
Entries.Description: Surging crime, a virus and android assassins led by a mysterious gangster boss force special agents Ace and Nea into action.

Entries.Title: The Ground
Entries.Description: A man experiences a series of trials and tribulations.

Entries.Title: Wired
Entries.Description: Bruce, A young man with a rare condition where his hand has a mind of its own, struggles to get through his life after the unthinkable. His condition caused his brother’s death. He’s let off easy, but some think it’s an injustice to his brother, and others think Bruce is being tormented over something he can’t control.

Entries.Title: Backseat
Entries.Description: This queer short stars Jiz Lee and Robin Astera take a drive through the streets of Berlin, navigating trans masculine desire and liberation.  An homage to Homobiles queer cab service spearheaded by Lynnee Breedlove, the 1980's safer sex PSAs from Gay Men's Health Crisis such as “Car Service” taxi porn, and the dream of a world that is safe to travel freely.

Entries.Title: Stealing Sunset
Entries.Description: For the launch of ‘Operation Sunbird’, a new channel of inconvenient truths about Israel and Palestine, Indya Moore, Rain Dove and Heydon Prowse posed as real estate influencers to gain access to the Israeli realtors, hoteliers and developers making a killing from real estate and tourism on Palestinian land.  The documentary follows Rain Dove on their Aliyah journey from undercover filming at a New Jersey Property Expo to the Occupied West Bank. Aliyah is the right of anyone with Jewish ancestry to resettle in Israel. Rain doesn’t identify as Jewish, and the land isn’t in Israel (it’s in Palestine), but having a Jewish great-grandfather and a big deposit can make all those problems disappear, and qualify Rain for official tax breaks and special mortgage assistance from the Israeli government.

Entries.Title: Horseheads
Entries.Description: Horseheads is a comedy/crime short film that takes a wild spin on the classic buddy story. It follows Billy, a clueless young drifter searching for meaning, and Frank, a washed-up crook long past his prime. When Billy’s genius plan to rob the local chinese burger joint goes hilariously sideways, the duo stumbles into an unexpected journey of botched heists, unlikely friendship, and maybe figuring out what the heck they’re doing with their lives.

Entries.Title: Where Is Juan Moctezuma?
Entries.Description: Legendary 1970s Mexican horror film auteur Juan F. Moctezuma II reportedly influenced the work of mega-directors Guillermo del Toro, Robert Rodriguez, Sam Raimi, and more. But the last film Moctezuma made and his first in Hollywood, produced by Roger Corman, 1000 PATHS OF DEATH, was surrounded in mystery because it was shot in complete secrecy. And then he disappeared with the footage. Did his nemesis, the famous luchador Scorpion, sabotage his work yet again? Discover the truth in this fun film that delves into every level of the Mexican exploitation industry as it unfolds its obsessive tale.

Entries.Title: Door's Unlocked
Entries.Description: When night falls, Josh makes his way around town to meet with strangers and friends.

Entries.Title: Palace of Youth
Entries.Description: Countries appear and disappear— we could have just been one of them. Caught between visibility and obscurity, Kosovo’s underground music scene is the voice of a post-war generation grappling with isolation in a half-recognized nation.

Entries.Title: Saint Andrews
Entries.Description: A Chinese Jamaican teenager falls in love with a young Jamaican boy but the relationship is tested when her Chinese immigrant parents disapprove of the relationship.

Entries.Title: the view from where i see it
Entries.Description: A meditation on lockdown, isolation, and yearning.

Entries.Title: '05 Forever
Entries.Description: Was this one of the best teams ever? Paul Konerko, Mark Buehrle, AJ Pierzynski and more talk about the challenges of winning a World Series and the legacy of the 2005 Chicago White Sox.  A Paul Konerko grand slam, unlikely home runs from Scott Podsednik and Geoff Blum, Juan Uribe diving into the stands and Bobby Jenks closing out the four-game sweep – these are the moments fans remember forever. Hear the first-hand account and watch behind-the-scenes footage of the team that accomplished it all.

Entries.Title: Fool's Gold
Entries.Description: Would be thieves are foiled by a Cherokee curse.

Entries.Title: 5am
Entries.Description: A collection of solitary urban images intersect with each other.

Entries.Title: Dragons In Seattle
Entries.Description: In a decade long feat, the crew of "Lizard Boy" chart their journey from Seattle to Off-Broadway while discussing what it takes to make a musical worthy of the New York stage and beyond.

Entries.Title: Ricky Martin: A Loco Life
Entries.Description: The third time was the charm. Twice turned down by "Menudo" for being too short, Ricky Martin (born Enrique Martin Morales) joined the boy band at the age of 12 and emerged as a teen heartthrob. Five years later, he was on his own, singing in 5 languages, propelling Latin pop to mainstream music. There was Mexican theater, a TV show, and then an American soap opera and sitcom along the way. The child who began as a choir altar boy and sang fast food TV ads in Puerto Rico would transcend his "Livin' La Vida Loca" lyrics and reveal his true self as a gay man. A six-year marriage, 4 children by surrogacy, and divorce would follow. Some may call it "A Loco Life."

Entries.Title: Gambling Man
Entries.Description: A down-on-his-luck gambler wins the lottery, but his newfound wealth soon reveals that everything—even friendship—has a price.

Entries.Title: Immensity of Vacancy
Entries.Description: Andi and her mom, Cass, hold a strong connection through their love of astronomy. As Andi navigates life on her own, she carries her mom and their bond with her.

Entries.Title: Kienyeji
Entries.Description: Kienyeji tells the story of two university students, Cynthia and Charlie, from conflicting Kenyan communities who fall in love and plan to marry despite their families' opposition. The narrative explores tribalism and cultural differences as their attempts to unite face challenges, including a failed ruracio due to unpaid dowry, food poisoning at a second attempt, and ultimately, divorce pressured by Charlie's father. Amid exams, financial struggles, and personal setbacks, their journey unfolds with Ohangla and Mugithi music, raising questions about love and tradition. Will love triumph, or will societal pressures prevail?

Entries.Title: Super Ninja Neko
Entries.Description: Check out Ninja Neko in action!

Entries.Title: I'm Not Supposed to Be Here
Entries.Description: A behind-the-scenes look at the music industry reveals what artists must face when chasing their passion. Eddie, a Miami-based music artist and lead singer of the international band Toke D Keda, born in Puerto Rico, is determined to achieve success at any cost. When he is denied a rightfully earned recording contract with Sony Music, he must make some tough choices. Giving up is not an option. A relentless pursuit of a lifelong dream takes Eddie on the journey of a lifetime. He will travel to the ends of the world to find himself and his purpose, but at what cost? Eddie suspects someone is stealing money, but this is the least of his problems. As the band's popularity rises, just trying to keep them together may prove impossible.

Entries.Title: TinMan
Entries.Description: TinMan is a crime and drama film in which, Zach Richardson is a caring surgeon who is suspicious that a deadly pandemic is man-made.

Entries.Title: How to Operate a 35mm Film Camera
Entries.Description: A parody PSA discussing the inner workings of film photography and how to become a master photographer.

Entries.Title: The Oracle
Entries.Description: A prophecy uttered.

Entries.Title: The Mosaic Church
Entries.Description: In 2004, a routine prison renovation in Megiddo, Israel, led to an astonishing discovery—what is believed to be the oldest known Christian place of worship. At its center lies a mosaic bearing the first public inscription declaring Jesus as God. Narrated by Bear Grylls, this documentary dives into the site’s historical, theological, and political significance, featuring expert insights from historians and theologians.

Entries.Title: Monkey Man Tells a Joke
Entries.Description: Tell us a joke Monkey Man...

Entries.Title: Distort
Entries.Description: A musician recording an album in the woods finds mysterious cassette tapes being left for him. On them, a woman researching an urban legend was being terrorised by a man and his vicious dog. Now, those same things are happening to the musician...

Entries.Title: Frijoles
Entries.Description: A three-generation household prepares a pot of beans.

Entries.Title: Gram Chikitsalay
Entries.Description: The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realize it is he who will have do change before anything else.

Entries.Title: Old Man
Entries.Description: Lewis Segovia, a naive young director, abandons his film mid-production in search of "meaning." As pressure from his crew mounts, the line between fiction and reality blurs, forcing him to confront his broken past to complete the project.

Entries.Title: Joint
Entries.Description: When two best friends, Matt and Alan, smoke weed-laced cigarettes, things take a bizarre turn. Alan, high out of his mind, runs off in the streets of suburban Arizona. Left behind and still dazed, the anxious and reluctant Matt is forced to search for his missing friend.

Entries.Title: The Sentry
Entries.Description: A cheeky dismantling of spy tropes and a love letter to Cambodia, THE SENTRY follows a suave Western agent who thinks he's about to make another routine kill. But some stories refuse to be footnotes - and this particular guard isn't finished talking. A genre-bending tale about the extraordinary lives we're trained to overlook.

Entries.Title: Behind Closed Doors
Entries.Description: An anxiety-ridden teenager searches for connection at a high school party, until an unexpected connection finds him instead.

Entries.Title: Marriaginalia
Entries.Description: With signature wit, and Kayla Lorette and Rodrigo Fernandez Stoll’s own brand of performance sass, Hannah Cheesman takes a magnifying glass to married life, hilariously deconstructing a couple’s lived-in dynamic in three brilliantly concise acts.

Entries.Title: The Devil Whispered My Name
Entries.Description: A decade after a tragic ancestral ritual claimed her best friend's life, a young woman returns to her Argentinian mountain hometown, only to find the malevolent forces she thought she'd left behind are still hunting her.

Entries.Title: Strandead
Entries.Description: A man runs out of gas on the side of the road with a body in his trunk. As his mask of sanity starts to slip, he's gotta figure out what to do and do it fast.

Entries.Title: Raw File
Entries.Description: Following up on a questionable suicide, an investigator and her cameraman venture into an apartment complex looking for answers but instead find something terrifying roaming the corridors with them.

Entries.Title: Spilled Ink
