Entries.Description: Four college journalists begin to question everything when a bloody fairy tale, read around the campfire from a stolen journal, starts to come to life.

Entries.Title: Black Mako of the Abyss
Entries.Description: A mysterious and aggressive shark emerges from the deep off California's coast, sparking a race to catch it and reveal whether it's an enormous mako, a mutant or a great white-mako hybrid.

Entries.Title: Opener
Entries.Description: A queer musician returns to her hometown to encounter the strange masculinity of the music scene.

Entries.Title: In A Place Like This
Entries.Description: A day in the life of Horace, an outback isolationist who holds within him a dark and violent secret. This non-conventional approach to the slasher sub-genre offers a new perspective. Set against the backdrop of the Australian bush, "In a Place Like This" aims to deliver a visually captivating experience, appealing to both genre aficionados and casual viewers alike.

Entries.Title: The Idea
Entries.Description: A bored couple's fascination with spying on their younger neighbors blurs the line between curiosity and intrusion.

Entries.Title: Hard Hat Riot
Entries.Description: On May 8, 1970, construction workers violently clashed with students demonstrating against the Vietnam War in lower Manhattan. The workmen, who came to be known as “hardhats,” were at the cutting edge of a new kind of class war. With the war in Vietnam raging on, it was the sons of the working class who were doing most of the fighting. Workmen saw the protesting students as privileged “draft dodgers” disparaging the country and those who fought for it. On the other side, many student activists saw the workers as pawns, unwilling to see the changes that America needed. Hard Hat Riot tells the story of a struggling metropolis, a flailing president, a divided people, and a bloody juncture when the nation violently diverged ― culminating in a new political and cultural landscape that radically redefined American politics and foreshadowed the future.

Entries.Title: Arena
Entries.Description: After being the only survivor of an airplane crash, a young girl is convinced everyone dead during the incident is still alive and will fight to prove this feeling.

Entries.Title: Ghost Beaters
Entries.Description: Five ghost hunters try to avenge the death of their Great-Great-Great-Grandpa by expelling ghosts for their haunted clients. When things go wrong they must learn to overcome their differences to beat ghosts together.

Entries.Title: Nexus to Disclosure the Truth Is Classified
Entries.Description: A hidden network of female journalists and activists, dedicated to UFO disclosure, uncovers shocking truths about the government's knowledge of extraterrestrial phenomena.

Entries.Title: Traces
Entries.Description: After witnessing the brutal death of his soulmate, Owen becomes involved with anonymous lies, doppelgängers, the world of the undead and the brutal truth of stying in the past.

Entries.Title: The Inconvenience Store
Entries.Description: In 2064, Earth is plagued by toxic air and extreme weather. At a remote gas station in Nowheresville, California, shopkeeper Hiro, stranded traveler Tonya, and gruff trucker Ron clash in a heated altercation. When an emergency broadcast warns of extraterrestrial craft overhead—and a bleeding stranger stumbles in off the street—the group must decide whether to trust the approaching beings or prepare for a fight that could alter the fate of the universe.

Entries.Title: Dream Bigger
Entries.Description: The Adelaide Thunderbirds dream bigger in 2024, as they chase back-to-back Suncorp Super Netball titles in their new home, the Adelaide Entertainment Centre.

Entries.Title: Knight Life
Entries.Description: Meet the dedicated men and women who bring the Middle Ages to the present day, training for years to perfect their skills. They become expert horseback riders, learn to joust in full armor, and perfect intricate swordplay to thrill their audiences day after day. They endure bruises, broken bones, and heartbreaking losses all in pursuit of being crowned the champion of the Knight Life.

Entries.Title: Resurrection
Entries.Description: Filmed in J. Hood Wright Park located in the Washington Heights neighborhood of New York City, this film portrays the jarring reality of integrating back into society in a search to find “normalcy” after isolating and quarantining during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic. What was once mundane and routine may suddenly feel uncomfortable and unsettling, especially in navigating boundaries in both the public and private spheres. Nevertheless, this piece also seeks to provide a sense of hopefulness and optimism in that our communities will continue to be resilient and thrive.

Entries.Title: Max Payne: Darkest Days
Entries.Description: Max Payne questions his reality and searches for a deeper meaning, only to find a gun pointed at his head.

Entries.Title: The Ballad of the Sunset Kid
Entries.Description: A granddaughter struggles to care for her grandfather, whose fading memories and haunting hallucinations blur reality, in this poignant tale of love and communication.

Entries.Title: The Song You Sung
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: Lechuza
Entries.Description: When a family's camping trip turns into a nightmare, they must confront a sinister witch-turned-demon known as Lechuza, who seeks to tear them apart. Can they survive the horrors and break the curse, or will they become her next victims?

Entries.Title: Pain Through Lyric
Entries.Description: Set against the backdrop of the vibrant yet tumultuous streets, this romantic street drama weaves the lives of two artists; Lyric, scarred by a tragedy of the heart and Da Creepa, masked with the despair of circumstances that comes from displaced loyalty. They embark on a journey where bonds are forged, hidden pains resurface, and poetry serves as a bridge between hearts. Take this journey with these two artists as a chance encounter sparks a romance between Lyric and Da Creepa that neither were anticipating.

Entries.Title: Deadly Retreat
Entries.Description: Escape to a secluded cabin where laughter and terror collide in Deadly Retreat. This genre-bending comedy/horror film takes you on a thrilling journey that will leave you both screaming and chuckling in your seat. Follow a group of friends as their much-anticipated vacation spirals into chaos. Deadly Retreat masterfully blends sharp humor with spine-chilling suspense, creating a cinematic experience that is equal parts terrifying and hilarious. It’s designed for adults aged 18–45 who crave edge-of-your-seat moments, psychological tension, and the thrills of classic horror.

Entries.Title: The Final Cut
Entries.Description: Alan's life flashes before his eyes- but it's a sloppy sizzle reel. He demands a re-cut from God, a dizzy Hollywood producer, but God has trouble focusing

Entries.Title: Beyond Detention
Entries.Description: A group of delinquent boys are sentenced to a wilderness challenge on a remote island, but become stranded. As civilization disappears, their detention becomes a game of survival - with each other, and with the unexpected.

Entries.Title: Frozen Frames: Murphy's Yellowstone
Entries.Description: Photographer Tom Murphy has dedicated his life to speaking out for the wildlife of Yellowstone. In the dead of winter, Murphy treks deep into the Park to capture the lives and struggles of those who survive there. His remarkable photographs capture both the magnificence of Yellowstone and one man's tenacious dedication to protect what is still wild.

Entries.Title: Phantasmatapes
Entries.Description: Welcome to the 1980s TV horrorshow that never was. PHANTASMATAPES is a psychotronic VHS mixtape that reimagines THE REVENGE OF DR. X (a Japan-set creature feature that was written by Ed Wood) and THE BRAIN THAT WOULDN'T DIE (the savage body horror film that inspired FRANKENHOOKER) as a late-nite, home-taped double feature—complete with local TV commercials and a new synthesizer score from Taken by Savages (JUNGLE TRAP). Inspired by hazy memories of channel-surfing at the witching hour, this is a nostalgic and experimental art project from the minds behind Bleeding Skull.

Entries.Title: The Half-Finished Heaven
Entries.Description: You can't wake up when you are drunk and you still don't wake up in your dreams. Those people and things from the past, present, and future come and go in your ears until you smell the wine again...

Entries.Title: Surrender to My Professor
Entries.Description: College student Sylvia Parker finds herself in a dangerous love affair with Lawrence Calhoun, the last man she should want. He's hot, he's harsh -- he's her professor. As Sylvia struggles to survive in a cutthroat campus and toxic family, never has she thought her hero would be the cold, strict and sexy Professor Calhoun. As their connection deepens, a forbidden romance blooms, threatening to destroy everything if discovered.

Entries.Title: Binded by Fangs
Entries.Description: After a stranger begs for their help, a picturesque couple of detectives must solve a murder.

Entries.Title: The Wickywock and the JubJub Berry
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Hockey Star's Remorse
Entries.Description: After a night with hockey star Timothy turns out to be a bet, nerdy Evie vanishes. Years later, now a producer, she meets him again. He apologizes publicly and admits he's been waiting for her.

Entries.Title: Flamethrowing Wizz
Entries.Description: Young drummer, Dylan, finally gets his dream band. Only for his ego to put the band’s future into question.

Entries.Title: Modern Folklore
Entries.Description: Modern Folklore is a horror anthology that touches on aspects of native American folklore and modern-day terrors which will leave you questioning what is reality versus myth.

Entries.Title: Riverside: Live ID.
Entries.Description: Poland's prog masters Riverside recorded live on June 1st, 2024 at COS Torwar in Warsaw. 'Live ID.' marks the end of the 'ID.Entity' (2023) album cycle with a live rendition of 12 songs across over 110 minutes playing time. Containing thrilling performances of songs from Riverside's 2023 studio album 'ID.Entity', the performance also re-visits catalogue favourites '#Addicted', 'Panic Room' and 'Conceiving You'. Limited 2CD/Blu-Ray in 8-panel digipak with 24-page booklet. The Blu-ray comes with stereo and 5.1 audio options for the live-show, plus a special 'Behind the Scenes' feature.

Entries.Title: SCATTERBRAIN
Entries.Description: An unorganized writer named Levi convinces himself that there is a mysterious man living inside of his home, watching him. An unhealthy obsession begins as the man manifests into Levi’s work, all the while Levi struggles to prove that this stranger is real.

Entries.Title: Trump's Comeback
Entries.Description: FRONTLINE examines defining moments over Donald Trump’s life and career, his 2020 election loss, felony convictions and his historic comeback.

Entries.Title: For Venida, for Kalief
Entries.Description: Kalief Browder’s story unfolds in full when his life, and that of his mother, Venida Brodnax Browder, are tragically derailed by years of malintent from the justice system. Venida’s poems serve as a guiding thread through this emotional journey, blending archival footage and contemporary political movements to honor the Browder family’s powerful legacy, both within their community and beyond.

Entries.Title: Welcome to 190 Lorimer
Entries.Description: In a Brooklyn condo where walls are thin and lives overlap, seven wildly different residents navigate love, loss, awkward run-ins, and existential apartment crises — all in a hilariously tangled portrait of modern life, told one neighbor at a time.

Entries.Title: Serial Rabbit One
Entries.Description: A serial killer who wears a bunny rabbit outfit slashes his way across San Antonio before finally reaching the city's smallest rave.

Entries.Title: How the Mormons Conquered Utah
Entries.Description: On a beautiful day in the province of Dickersville, settlers roll into town trying to spread their religion. When the offer is turned down, things turn hostile. This is the "true" and "uncensored" story about how the Mormons became so prominent in Utah.

Entries.Title: A Flash Of Passion
Entries.Description: A deliciously dramtic telenovela short film. The 7th Tickle Gang film produced for a 48-hour film festival.

Entries.Title: Motel Matinee
Entries.Description: A writer struggling with addiction attempts to write a Western with the help of his brother.

Entries.Title: Why Not, Pat?
Entries.Description: A fifteen-minute black comedy depicting a night in the life of a lovesick stoner and his suspiciously perfect new love-interest.

Entries.Title: They Made You into a Weapon and Told You to Find Peace
Entries.Description: In a dystopian community, Aryan-looking children are subjected to strict rules and harsh indoctrination. Stripped of their past identities, they are trained to speak only in Esperanto, preparing them for adoption into new families. Eleven-year-old Joshua stands out as a nonconformist, defying the rigid norms by befriending a newcomer, Ĉiela. His bond with her stirs jealousy among the other children, especially from Pipro, the group’s eldest and self-appointed leader.  When Joshua is selected for adoption, he makes a daring choice to refuse it, unwilling to leave Ĉiela behind. This defiance provokes Pipro’s wrath, who manipulates the group into turning against the pair. Isolated and under increasing pressure to conform, Joshua and Ĉiela face a critical decision: surrender to the oppressive society or resist and fight for their freedom.

Entries.Title: Night of the Rats
Entries.Description: Horror B-movie about rat infestation

Entries.Title: A RAD Documentary
Entries.Description: The official documentary about the 1986 cult classic RAD. It features exclusive interviews with cast, crew and the BMX legends who performed the stunts, and revisits and explores iconic moments from RAD.

Entries.Title: The Tag-Along
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: CZECH HUNTER - PROMO
Entries.Description: CZECH HUNTER - E_DEATH. OUT EVERYWHERE, MAY 9.

Entries.Title: A Deeper Love: The Story of Miss Peppermint
Entries.Description: Drag Race star Peppermint takes center stage in this up close and personal documentary about her journey with fame, identity, and the art of drag. Sharing her story alongside a close network of trans individuals, one of the world’s favorite drag performers takes you inside her rise from humble beginnings to her current reign as outspoken trailblazer for the trans community.

Entries.Title: Fumble
Entries.Description: A series of lighthearted performative vignettes that explore the duality of immigrant and queer life— the longing to return to the familiar geographic, cultural, and bodily coordinates of one's past, alongside an equally compelling desire to assimilate into a new culture and identity. Through a collection of absurd scenes depicting both the attempts and failures to fit in, the film illustrates the felt incongruities of this experience in a hybrid form.

Entries.Title: The Scene
Entries.Description: A young filmmaker attempts to direct a scene with an inexperienced crew.

Entries.Title: Cuming Out
Entries.Description: Kennedy’s desire for a heteronormative experience sees her embark on a one-night stand. What could possibly go wrong?

Entries.Title: The Starlight Motel
Entries.Description: Three friends experience a terrifying series of events at an alien-themed roadside motel built atop a rumored UFO crash site.

Entries.Title: Subway Surfers in Brawl Stars!?
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: UFC on ESPN 71: Taira vs. Park - Prelims
Entries.Description: UFC on ESPN 71: Taira vs. Park - Prelims

Entries.Title: UFC Fight Night 249: Dern vs. Ribas 2 - Prelims
Entries.Description: UFC Fight Night 249: Dern vs. Ribas 2 - Prelims was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on January 11, 2025, at the UFC Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

Entries.Title: Violet
Entries.Description: An advanced AI with evolving emotions reveals a journalist's dark secrets during a high-profile demonstration, changing their lives forever.

Entries.Title: Everybody Wants to go to The Party
Entries.Description: A man struggles to get into a party after learning another man with his name is already in attendance.

Entries.Title: The End is at Hand
Entries.Description: After hours at a mobile repair shop, a routine fix takes a strange turn.

Entries.Title: Connor's Pizza
Entries.Description: A feature film about one man eating a pizza over the course of a single 24-hour period.

Entries.Title: The Last Train
Entries.Description: A diverse cross section of tired, drunk, disgruntled, joyous and riotous strangers, pushed together within the confines of the last train home.

Entries.Title: The Eternal Song
Entries.Description: Across sacred lands, Indigenous voices reveal both the deep wounds of colonization and the ancestral wisdom that guides us toward healing.

Entries.Title: Will Reeve: Finding My Father
Entries.Description: Will Reeve visits the places his father visited 30 years ago, and shares family home videos.

Entries.Title: Paisley & Willis
Entries.Description: When two incompetent gardeners accidentally derail a political fundraiser, they embark on a desperate struggle to prevent their sexy boss from finding out.

Entries.Title: The Golem
Entries.Description: A gothic Jewish fairytale. In 1840s Poland, Beulah cares for her leprous mother-in-law while seeking a divorce. With nowhere else to turn, she builds a Golem in order to protect herself.

Entries.Title: Growing Pains
Entries.Description: Two best friends reevaluate their friendship all while driving aimlessly in a car.

Entries.Title: Harvest of Horrors
Entries.Description: A group of teenagers are killed off one by one after renting out a cursed farm house.

Entries.Title: Shawn Mendes: Red Rocks Live in VR
Entries.Description: Shawn Mendes takes the stage at Colorado's famed Red Rocks Amphitheater.

Entries.Title: The Rendezvous
Entries.Description: Ex-MP Luke Burgos flees both law enforcement and mobsters while grappling with existential questions. His survival depends on finding a hacker who can unlock a flash drive everyone's killing for.

Entries.Title: How Did I Get Here
Entries.Description: Sardonic Cynthia walks us through a play-by- play of a recent "squicky" date, requiring her to confront some uncomfortable truths.

Entries.Title: Hurricane Katrina: 20 Years After the Storm with Robin Roberts
Entries.Description: Robin Roberts returns home to the Gulf Coast for a deeply personal look at the region 20 years after Hurricane Katrina.

Entries.Title: All Elite Wrestling: Double or Nothing
Entries.Description: AEW presents Double or Nothing - Live on from the Desert Diamond Arena in Glendale, AZ. The 2025 Owen Hart Foundation Cup Tournament Finals take center stage. Will Ospreay battles "Hangman" Adam Page in the Men's Tournament Final, with a coveted AEW World Championship match at All In on the line. On the women's side, the intensity is just as high: Mercedes Moné faces Jamie Hayter in the 2025 Women's Owen Hart Foundation Cup Final, and the winner will also earn a World Championship opportunity at All In. Plus many more.

Entries.Title: RABBITHOLE
Entries.Description: University student Alistair Liddell is attempting to write an essay late at night, when the idea to search for answers on Wikipedia comes to mind. Leading Alistair down a wondrous path of information. However, after being dragged into the screen and falling down the rabbit hole of information, Alistair soon realises the more disturbing nature of the internet and that the way out may not be as simple as it seems.

Entries.Title: Thirty-Three
Entries.Description: Film 33 is the most advanced film class in a community college where the entire class teams up to make a short film. In 2023 Spring, the 23rd short film is being made. This epic documentary details the highs and lows of the production of this short film, and all the dramatic events that occurred.

Entries.Title: The Banshee
Entries.Description: A young girl joins a nun's convent following her religious mother's death in a car accident. Only, the convent is run by a ruthless and sadist Father, who will soon drive our protagonist to an inescapable fate.

Entries.Title: Across the Aisle
Entries.Description: An idealistic congressman attempts to woo his colleague from the other side of the aisle.

Entries.Title: The ghost light of the Big Thicket
Entries.Description: Deep in the Big Thicket of Texas is a Ghost who roams the night holding a lantern .Some say he is a friendly spirit, while some who go in search of him never return.

Entries.Title: Good Eggs
Entries.Description: In 'Good Eggs', animal rescuers Katherine and Teresa open the gates of their sanctuary to a group of hens saved from a "free range" egg farm. What starts as a routine rescue quickly becomes something deeper, as the two women explore the uncomfortable truths behind one of the most misleading labels in animal agriculture. With quiet moments of care and connection, and the chaos that comes with any rescue, the film follows their journey, offering a rare glimpse into the lives of animals most people never get to see.

Entries.Title: The Time Capsule
Entries.Description: Four childhood friends reunite to dig up a time capsule after 30 years... and encounter some unexpected visitors.

Entries.Title: Funeral
Entries.Description: Eight individuals arrive at a funeral home for a wake at 7:00 PM, each unaware that they are the ones in the casket. As the night unfolds, they come to realize their true fate: they are dead and must now face judgment for their lives. In a gripping twist, they confront their past sins and virtues, determining their destinies in the afterlife. The evening becomes a suspenseful journey of self-discovery, reckoning, and the ultimate rapture.

Entries.Title: Put the Guns Down: A World Epidemic
Entries.Description: Exposes the harsh realities of gun violence in South Central Los Angeles. Directed by Terry C. Carney, Sr., and Eric Herbert, and produced by Ice-T, this documentary features raw interviews and exclusive insights from community figures like Spice 1 and Kokane. It sheds light on systemic issues fueling violence and serves as a powerful call for change.

Entries.Title: Zombie
Entries.Description: QP, a troubled young man with an affinity for lobotomies and finger puppets, confronts his own humanity after capturing his newest victim.

Entries.Title: The Immaculate Deception
Entries.Description: Three girls devise a plan to sneak out of their private Catholic school to help their friend have her first sexual encounter.

Entries.Title: New Brawler : Trunk's Origin Story!
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: Where the Lost Things go
Entries.Description: Andrés, a teenager marked by the absence of a loved one, enters a space suspended in time: the Place of Lost Things — a universe where forgotten objects wait to be found. As he desperately searches for something that might bring him a fragment of comfort, he is forced to confront emotions he had long suppressed.  To truly begin the process of healing, he must face not only his own grief but also that of his mother, who refuses to remember. Together, in this place where time seems to stand still, mother and son must confront what they lost… and what still binds them.

Entries.Title: Body & Soil
Entries.Description: A man comes back from the wilderness.

Entries.Title: Hive
Entries.Description: A woman finds herself in a room with humanoid bee people.

Entries.Title: In the Mouth
Entries.Description: A perpetual worrywart finds himself unable to leave his house after discovering a giant version of himself protruding from his front lawn.

Entries.Title: Dark water
Entries.Description: After inheriting a jar full of dark liquid, a girl grapples with the terror that ensues when she’s forced to open the lid.

Entries.Title: Réquiem para Moïse
Entries.Description: The story of an immigrant boy who finds hope for the future in Brazil and ends up being stabbed to death in front of a famous beach in one of Latin America's most expensive neighborhoods. The case exposed the racism and humiliation experienced by refugees of African descent in Brazil.

Entries.Title: Sniffin' 4 Cryptids: The Geezer Squeezer
Entries.Description: After six seasons of monster hunting, the "Sniffin' 4 Cryptids" team meets their match.

Entries.Title: Weird Space
Entries.Description: A strange apparition in a bathroom.

Entries.Title: Teacher's Pet
Entries.Description: A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her. Will she make it out of this relationship alive?

Entries.Title: TrainRec
Entries.Description: Two ambitious filmmakers get more than they bargained for when their entire project goes up in flames.

Entries.Title: RevPro 13 Year Anniversary Show - Day 1: Global Wars UK
Entries.Description: Global Wars UK 2025 was a professional wrestling event hosted by Revolution Pro Wrestling (RevPro) also featuring New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW), Ring of Honor (ROH), and Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL). The event took place on Aug 22, 2025 at the Crystal Palace National Sports Centre in London, England, UK.

Entries.Title: WrestleCon: Super Show 2025 - Mark Hitchcock Memorial
Entries.Description: Don't miss WrestleCon: Super Show 2025 - Mark Hitchcock Memorial - streaming live on TrillerTV+! The card is loaded — take a look at the full lineup below!  Matt Riddle vs Matt Mako Ninja Mack vs Mascara Dorada  Six Man Tag Team Match Flip Gordon, Hechicero & Michael Oku vs TMDK (Bad Dude Tito, Shane Haste & Zack Sabre Jr.)  Singles Match (Special Enforcer: Dan Severn) Minoru Suzuki vs Butterbean  Mickie James vs Maki Itoh

Entries.Title: WTO/99
Entries.Description: An immersive archival documentary that reanimates the clash between the then-emerging World Trade Organization (WTO) and the more than 40,000 people who took to the streets of Seattle to protest the WTO's impacts on human rights, labor, and the environment.

Entries.Title: Countdown to TNA Genesis 2025
Entries.Description: Streaming LIVE and FREE on TNA digital platforms, the action begins on Countdown To Genesis. Get ready for Genesis with exclusive matches and previews.

Entries.Title: Heads
Entries.Description: Come inside the head of NYC sculptor Jack Cox who makes heads from his head.

Entries.Title: Raindrop
Entries.Description: A journey by water from the highest peaks of the Alps to the vastness of the ocean. Hardly any element on our planet is more important than water. Where there is water, life thrives. But only very few people know what wonderful creatures master their lives every day in their native habitats by the water. Far from our eyes, true dramas and glories happen every day. Stories that hardly anyone gets to see. Stories full of adventure, tragedy, comedy and even love.

Entries.Title: FIGHTER
Entries.Description: A girl who’s tired of life finds refuge and passion within the gaming world. However, her will to fight only extends to her VR boxing matches, rather than the outside world.

Entries.Title: Call of the Ocean
Entries.Description: A woman finds a beautiful seashell on the beach, and then something unexpected happens...

Entries.Title: EXALTATION
Entries.Description: A young artist's struggle with faith and identity clash in this Eldritch Horror short film.

Entries.Title: Mis-Angel
Entries.Description: Mis-Angel is a love story between two people who will never meet. A transgender girl explores an overlap of gender and sexual fantasy as she recalls a brief interaction with a stranger at a bus stop.

Entries.Title: Mega Blood Moon: The Freelancer
Entries.Description: After arriving early to an empty workplace on his last day of work, a Freelancer discovers that he may not be alone. Under the light of the mysterious Mega Blood Moon, he'll find out that his last day is going to be a fight... to the death.

Entries.Title: Mr. Vegas @ Summerjam Festival 2025
Entries.Description: Mr. Vegas, stage name of Clifford Smith, is a stage animal who has been playing at the world's best reggae festivals since 1998. His fans are everywhere, from Europe to the United States to Japan.

Entries.Title: Someone to Steal Horses With
Entries.Description: A horse reflects on memory, disturbing the daily routines of citizens in Los Santos, San Andreas, during the press release for his new book “Someone to Steal Horses With.”

Entries.Title: Cure
Entries.Description: The Necro Virus has pushed humanity to the edge of extinction however, Dr. Julian Archer has found a cure and in order to get it mass produced, he must go through corrupt pharmaceutical executive, Ethan Drayden.

Entries.Title: Aloha Means I Love You
Entries.Description: Clara and Bertie have been friends for nearly 60 years, but when Clara wants to add a new man into the mix, Bertie's devotion to her friend is tested.

Entries.Title: Max Amini: Randomly Selected
Entries.Description: Max Amini’s comedy special is here, straight from the world tour—where the crowd was on fire, but his TSA stories might land him on a no-fly list.  In Randomly Selected, Max brings his signature charm, quick wit, and razor-sharp crowd work to screens from all across the globe. His unique blend of humor is on full display while reflecting on a career that’s put him in front of crowds on almost every continent. At Max’s show you see people from all backgrounds, colors and cultures it’s like being at the United Nations of comedy.  From chaotic travel adventures to family anecdotes and unexpected moments with the audience, this special is a celebration of everything that makes Max one of the most dynamic comedians of his time. Buckle up for laughs, surprises, and the one-of-a-kind storytelling that only Max Amini can deliver.  Randomly Selected is not just a comedy special; it’s an experience. Enjoy it!

Entries.Title: Interference
Entries.Description: A teenager struggles with paranoia and identity amidst the start of the AIDS epidemic in the early 1980s.

Entries.Title: Chasing the Party
Entries.Description: Melissa and Stephanie fantasize about becoming downtown "IT" girls , but their dreams come crashing down on them when the photographer they idolize is the one to lift the veil.

Entries.Title: Because I Love You
Entries.Description: After a career-ending injury, Dan Greentree and his wife find themselves at odds over their future. As tensions rise and painful truths surface, their love is tested like never before. But beneath the anger and uncertainty, one thing remains clear—they can’t bear to lose each other.

Entries.Title: STILLTHING
Entries.Description: A jaded psychologist makes a house call to treat a troubled teenager whose compulsive pen-clicking is driven by an eerie belief – that stopping will kill them all.  Written, directed, and edited by Zoë Gallagher.

Entries.Title: Florida's Death Beach
Entries.Description: Welcome to New Smyrna Beach -- Florida's spring break hotspot and the Shark Attack Capital of the World. Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante investigates to figure out why this party spot has become so deadly before more blood ends up in the water.

Entries.Title: The Spirit Lamp
Entries.Description: A limited-run performance of songs written by David Lynch and Chrystabell, with Chrystabell performing the material to tracks of David’s instrumentation, enveloped in the stunning organic images created specifically for The Spirit Lamp by internationally renowned experimental filmmaker David Gatten. The performance begins with three minutes of David Lynch’s voice, introducing Chrystabell in the form of a love story.

Entries.Title: War Is Murder
Entries.Description: In this short anti-war PSA, two friends are sent on a scouting mission with tragic results.

Entries.Title: Beach-O
Entries.Description: This 16mm short film is an homage to the campy beach movies of the 1960s, set within a late 90s time capsule. Shot in 1998 and completed in 2025, the music-driven film features performances by DC and Boston indie rock legends The Make Up, Victory At Sea, and The Wicked Farleys. The film follows Greg and Lesley as they enjoy a summer’s day at the beach. After they befriend a group of locals, their day takes an unexpected turn when everyone gets hungry…

Entries.Title: Spin the Bottle
Entries.Description: A short comedy about a socially awkward guy who must embrace the chaos of a "party" in order to finally open up.

Entries.Title: The Inevitable Return
Entries.Description: A short documentary film that explores the history of how military technology and atomic testing became entangled in contemporary surfing amongst the beaches of the San Diego area. Using vérité footage and animation, the film follows Shuuluk, a Kumeyaay surfer, who interacts daily with the resulting effects and complexities of occupation on his land and in his sport, and reclaims it as a practice of joy, play, and connection.

Entries.Title: Snake Oil
Entries.Description: Merchant of fine medicines, Reginald Foxworthy encounters many individuals during his selling of different products out west

Entries.Title: Loving Bing
Entries.Description: He was a Chinese refugee. She was a Danish immigrant. Bing and Ann fell in love in the 1950s, married, and had five children together… only to divorce in 2014 after 50 years of marriage when their youngest daughter, Dagmarette, confronted them with evidence of his affairs. Now, ten years later, Ann has asked Dagmarette to make a documentary about Bing’s life. But when Dagmarette goes to Montana to interview her estranged father, it starts the conversation they never got to have… and sets Bing on a journey of redemption, healing, and reconciliation.

Entries.Title: A Teenage Tragedy
Entries.Description: A teenage girl summons a demon to better her life, but it ultimately backfires, throwing her life and the lives of everyone close to her into absolute chaos.

Entries.Title: A Clockwork Tangerine
Entries.Description: Dowey and his droogs go out for a night of the good ‘ol in-out in-out.

Entries.Title: Marijuambies
Entries.Description: "Marijuambies" is a hilarious new comedy that follows the story of a weed dealer and his hippie friend who accidentally sell poisoned weed, turning their customers into zombies. As the duo realizes the dangerous effects of their tainted product, they embark on a wild journey to find a cure and stop the zombie apocalypse they inadvertently caused. Along the way, they encounter various challenges and eccentric characters, leading to a series of mishaps and adventures that will keep audiences laughing from start to finish.  Directed by Brian Foster.

Entries.Title: I'm Not Going Anywhere
Entries.Description: As he nears the end of his life, an old oak tree finds solace in guiding a young sapling - his own offspring - through the quiet truths of their spacious home and the rhythms of time.

Entries.Title: Heat Visions
Entries.Description: June Five and Johns Daniel are chilling and talking about something really weird that happened to June involving sunscreen and a vision of the end of the world. Their friendship is tested.

Entries.Title: The Drop Off
Entries.Description: Michael has a one night stand with his boss Geena and when trouble ensues.

Entries.Title: Any Sign at All
Entries.Description: Clutching at straws and running on fumes, a desperate young woman’s indecision about the future of her unborn child has her looking for signs from the universe. Stranded at a crossroads, will the future finally reveal its plan?

Entries.Title: Under My Skin
Entries.Description: Two brothers visit their childhood home after the death of their father. Accompanied by their wives, they are forced to face the consequences of their past and present circumstances.

Entries.Title: The Ramba Effect
Entries.Description: Guided by compassionate experts and a devoted team of volunteers, Ramba, an Asian elephant who endured 50 years of isolation in a Chilean circus, embarks on an extraordinary 2,550-mile journey to her new home at Elephant Sanctuary Brazil.

Entries.Title: Imago
Entries.Description: As Ana's mom transforms into an insect, their codependent relationship becomes unbearable.

Entries.Title: Movement
Entries.Description: A boy and a girl walk on a long desert road, each searching for something they cannot name. Along the journey, they find themselves haunted by the mysteries of one another and the silent landscapes they inhabit.

Entries.Title: First Night(s)
Entries.Description: Lily and her friends go on their yearly beach trip(s) amidst major life changes.

Entries.Title: Confession Before the End of the World
Entries.Description: As the world nears its end, Dante seeks forgiveness from Father Elias for his apathy during a recent tragedy. Elias's own demons, however, prove to be an adversary unraveling.

Entries.Title: Uncomfortable Encounter
Entries.Description: Shelly the digital snail assists in a social interaction.

Entries.Title: On My Way Home
Entries.Description: Alex McClinton, a world history teacher, takes a road trip back home over the summer to help his sister place their mom in a nursing home.

Entries.Title: Pesticide
Entries.Description: A pest control specialist is taken hostage by a serial killer.

Entries.Title: Better The Devil You Know
Entries.Description: Brady lives his life in a never ending, happy-go-lucky sitcom with his girlfriend, Becky. However, that all changes when he has reason to assume Becky is having an affair with their friend Jackson leading him to realize that his sitcom lifestyle may be more sinister than it seems.

Entries.Title: Becoming Vera
Entries.Description: In Miami, 18-year-old pianist Vera, a foster child aging out of the system, struggles to pursue her passion for Latin Jazz amidst poverty and exploitation. After landing a freelance job painting a music studio, she impresses Hector, the studio owner and music producer, who offers her a chance to compose. However, Hector exploits her talent, stealing her composition for his own gain. Faced with betrayal and self-doubt, Vera almost gives up her dream. But with determination and the support of friends, she finds her voice and takes one final step toward a future in Latin Jazz, proving that anything is possible with resilience and self-belief.

Entries.Title: DSLR
Entries.Description: Four young filmmakers struggle to finish shooting a short film before the end of summer. Many challenges plague the production, the most sinister being a conspiracy of an otherworldly nature.

Entries.Title: Immaculate Perception
Entries.Description: A young woman named Maggie - knows she isn’t crazy. She’s also not particularly motivated or skilled, but she is not crazy. She knows her body, and she knows that she is the next Virgin Mary. Except, her body is growing something that seems much, much more sinister. Can she survive a doubtful friend, a conniving nurse, and her own body - or will she succumb to her "baby"?

Entries.Title: A Grammy Salute to Earth, Wind & Fire Live: The 21st Night of September
Entries.Description: This once-in-a-lifetime musical event sees the legendary band perform at the Hollywood Bowl with the world-renowned L.A. Philharmonic. It will celebrate nine-time GRAMMY-winning group’s enduring legacy, cultural impact and timeless sound with hit songs and special guests.

Entries.Title: Give and Take
Entries.Description: A schoolteacher and an artist, two newlyweds, leave their lives in Hong Kong and wrestle with the promise of freedom in Canada.

Entries.Title: How the West Was Fun
Entries.Description: At a photography studio in a Wild West theme park, visitors masquerade as modern visions of the American West.

Entries.Title: Alt-Right-Tab
Entries.Description: A directionless twenty-something discovers through online gaming how to make friends, make it big, and become a real man.

Entries.Title: Camp Cabin Fever
Entries.Description: Alfred, James, & Ted have to go to a camp together, despite loathing each other. When they get lost in the woods and find a maniac with an axe, they have to put aside their hatred for each other and team up.

Entries.Title: Emotionless
Entries.Description: One day while doing "his thing," an emotionless killer encounters someone that unlocks something inside of him.

Entries.Title: Removal
Entries.Description: Under the supervision of their boss, two twin brothers prepare for a dangerous procedure.

Entries.Title: Resurrecting Sinistar: A Cyber-Archaeology Documentary
Entries.Description: Two-years in the making, SynaMax takes viewers on a journey into the extensive cyber-archaeology research involved with restoring the source code and documenting the development history to the 1983 arcade game, Sinistar. Featuring exclusive interviews with project lead and software engineer Noah Falstein, sound engineer Mike Metz, and video game designer John Newcomer, this video offers a very comprehensive glimpse into one of the most innovative video games from the early '80s.

Entries.Title: Frost
Entries.Description: In their final night together, a boy and a girl create a tender universe under their blanket fort, blissfully indifferent to the world outside that is slowly coming to an end.

Entries.Title: Handball
Entries.Description: When his girlfriend expresses interest in opening their relationship, Charley turns to a handball rival for advice.

Entries.Title: Don't Open The Door During Dinner
Entries.Description: Four close friends enjoy a nice dinner, until a greater threat comes knocking.

Entries.Title: Kherson: Human Safari
Entries.Description: Kherson, Ukraine's embattled city, has endured invasion, occupation, and liberation. On February 24, 2022, Russian tanks entered Kherson, leading to brutal occupation marked by violence. Despite being outnumbered, local defense forces resisted, and citizens protested under the slogan "Kherson is Ukraine!" An underground resistance formed, led by brave individuals like journalist Valentyna and others who risked arrest and torture to support the cause. After nine months, Ukrainian forces liberated Kherson, but Russian destruction left the city in chaos. Shelling and drone attacks became relentless, and in June 2023, a dam explosion flooded the city, causing further devastation. Despite these challenges, Kherson's spirit remained unbroken, with citizens embracing arts and resilience. By August 2024, drone attacks specifically targeted civilians, yet the city resisted, determined to rebuild and reclaim its identity, refusing to succumb to ruin.

Entries.Title: Canción para Valentina
Entries.Description: Director Valentina Riedel finds a recording of a song written by a friend of her father around the time she was born. The discovery prompts her to explore the life of "El Polaco"—a musician and rugby coach—who died a decade ago. Thus begins a journey of retrospective, healing bonds, in an intimate documentary that draws on interviews, family archives, and the filmmaker's own testimony.

Entries.Title: Pickles, Pickles, Pickles
Entries.Description: The Portland Pickles are upending the entertainment world without compromising the essence of America’s pastime.  As the #1 attended collegiate wood bat team in America, they draw fans from all walks of life with a bold embrace of local culture and community spirit.  Experience the beauty, excitement, and passion of local summer baseball with the next wave of MLB stars.

Entries.Title: A Flash in The Pan
Entries.Description: Curt Connerstone recreates his favorite movie scenes with his friends for fun. After posting them online, he very quickly blasts to superstardom. Now, the world is begging him to make an original film.

Entries.Title: Sweet Molly
Entries.Description: At 16, Molly, born and raised in the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints (FLDS) cult, makes a chilling discovery through her ability to astral project, leading to a life-altering event.

Entries.Title: wait lemme think
Entries.Description: up, down, wait. scritch, scratch, scream. smoke, yell, climb. wait, lemme think.

Entries.Title: Worship: Mission America
Entries.Description: The official documentary following Sub Focus, Dimension, Culture Shock and 1991 on their 2024 North America tour as WORSHIP.

Entries.Title: Lost in the Maze
Entries.Description: Lost in the Maze is story of two men navigating the Uraricoera River deep in the Amazon jungle, only to face a harrowing twist of fate when their boat capsizes in wild rapids. They are lost in the Maze.

Entries.Title: Public Pool
Entries.Description: A meditative, observational portrait of Hansen Dam Aquatic center – a public park with its own swimming pool.

Entries.Title: How To Make The *Perfect* Paper Airplane
Entries.Description: Edgy, entitled, spazzy content creator Violet Strom enforces paper airplanes as the topic of the next video she and her collaborators will upload, which just might be their last.

Entries.Title: The Murders of Whitney Manor
Entries.Description: After murdering his business partner Donald Whitney is haunted by his ghost. Ten years later a familiar priest gets stopped in the rain and seeks shelter in Whitney manor for the night.

Entries.Title: The Deal
Entries.Description: Two men arrive at Johnny's house for drugs, but one of them seems uneasy about the prospect. Inside, they get caught up in a game of distrust, murder mysteries and 70s film.

Entries.Title: Off School Property: Solving the Separation of Church and State
Entries.Description: Off School Property: Solving the Separation of Church and State explores the historic shift that removed the Bible from public education—and the lasting impact on students, schools and society. Featuring insight from cultural researcher George Barna and other respected voices, this thought-provoking documentary examines how we got here, what’s been lost and how a constitutionally sound solution is already bringing hope to communities across the country.

Entries.Title: Two Roads
Entries.Description: “Two Roads” reveals centuries of connection between African American and Irish culture.

Entries.Title: Cruel and Unusual Punishment
Entries.Description: Three strangers cause irreparable damage to themselves and others over the course of a seemingly normal weekend.

Entries.Title: Crawdaddy
Entries.Description: Gwynn, a pseudo-mythologist, liberates herself and her two friends from their restrictive, monotonous lives as they venture into a chaotic love triangle during the Covid-19 pandemic.

Entries.Title: Concession Boy
Entries.Description: Elliot has a secret.

Entries.Title: Silent Trespasser
Entries.Description: A Navajo student, Christina, finds a mysterious leather pouch after her night class in the midst of her constant college burnout.

Entries.Title: I Can Be Killed
Entries.Description: Not wanting to die in a body that repulses him, Lev, a trans college student, resorts to the most extreme measures possible.

Entries.Title: Abby’s List: A Dogumentary
Entries.Description: When 14-year-old Whippet Abby is given a short time to live, her human Mark whisks her away on an unforgettable cross-country road trip. From befriending a dolphin to peeing on the world’s tallest trees, Abby’s List is a heartwarming and hilarious adventure celebrating the bond between dog and human. But when the Universe has other plans, their three-week bucket list turns into a magical three-year journey of a lifetime.

Entries.Title: Darkstar
Entries.Description: A short narrative film.

Entries.Title: Chinatown Cookout
Entries.Description: Two runaway chefs risk everything they have to start a new life.

Entries.Title: Distress
Entries.Description: From Kwesi's opening stunts to Nyjah's jaw-dropping closing act, Disorder's unreal roster unleashes an all-out tear for its first full length.

Entries.Title: To Kill a Character
Entries.Description: When mob enforcer Gabriel is tasked with silencing former associate Frank, he has to make the difficult decision whether to let the man live or die.

Entries.Title: THIS MOVIE DOES NOT FUCKING EXIST
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: One Big Happy Family
Entries.Description: When a DNA test completely upends a woman’s life, she embarks on a hilarious journey with her eccentric mother to find out who she really is.

Entries.Title: Conspiracy Theories with Quin
Entries.Description: Throughout investigating his favorite conspiracy theories, Quin Breter realized most of them are not as far-fetched as he thought in this documentary.

Entries.Title: Search for the Truth: The Amanda Knox Story
Entries.Description: Knox discusses her decades-long battle to prove her innocence after being wrongfully convicted of her roommate’s 2007 murder. Premiering August 22 on ABC, it will be available for streaming the next day on Disney+ and Hulu.  Knox also talks about her involvement as an executive producer in Hulu’s upcoming limited series inspired by her story, The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox, premiering August 20. The ABC primetime special also interviews the creator, executive producer and showrunner of the Hulu series K.J. Steinberg, executive producer Warren Littlefield and Grace Van Patten, who plays Amanda.

Entries.Title: No sleep til Kyiv
Entries.Description: When American Peter Duke joined a convoy from Estonia to Kyiv to deliver critical aid to Ukrainian troops, he unexpectedly discovered a country echoing the spirit and unity of America's birth in 1776. Duke witnessed the people involved in this struggle up close revealing remarkable acts of selflessness and purpose that transcended borders and politics. It changed his perception of the conflict and himself. He returned home, impassioned and determined to do more. He shared his story with his friend Keith Ori, and it ignited a mission purpose for them both!

Entries.Title: Deliverance
Entries.Description: After receiving her last care shipment, a storm-battered hermit must brave an infinite blizzard representing her own mind in a coma to reach her family on the other side...

Entries.Title: Dead Ringer
Entries.Description: Two guys fall through a portal looking for a place to bury a dead body.

Entries.Title: LIVEwires
Entries.Description: A concert film for LIVEwires greatest hits! It was a pretty psychedelic scene: hundreds of colored lights, a disco ball, and two projectors shining onto the band--one projecting colored slides, the other showing Ben's 2025 experimental film "Twin Reverse Blowpop."

Entries.Title: Thunder Rush
Entries.Description: The Highland State Bulldogs, a Division 1 a College with a student population of 3,800 goes undefeated in it's own division and earns the qualification to compete for the national Championship against the Division 1 PAC 10 Powerhouse Southpoint Raiders. Led by Theismann Trophy Winner Quarterback Alonzo Scott looking to secure their 2nd Championship win. Do the Bulldogs of Kentucky have the Will and the Heart to knock off the defending champions Southpoint Raiders? Never in the history of College football has a Division 1 a team gone undefeated, moved up to Division One and defeated a Division 1 Juggernaut. How does it end?

Entries.Title: Mata Hari
Entries.Description: In 1975, television star David Carradine came up with a novel way to forge a relationship with his estranged daughter Calista: he would make a movie with her. "Mata Hari" tells the story of David and Calista's relationship through the lens of their unfinished, years-long film project, an epic telling of the life of the Dutch courtesan and spy, Mata Hari.

Entries.Title: An Inspector Calls Scene Recreated
Entries.Description: The Inspector presses Gerald on his relationship with Daisy

Entries.Title: Chicago Cafe
Entries.Description: In a small California town, a 100-year-old Chinese restaurant gets ready to close. As Paul Fong retires, this short film follows him and his wife Nancy beyond the headlines—through quiet moments, old family footage, and the slow process of letting go.

Entries.Title: Caught! Sharks Strike Back
Entries.Description: People have captured a record number of shark encounters on camera, from a hilarious moment when a shark slaps a fisherman in the face to an intense 10 minutes when a great white stalks a kayaker ... these are the craziest moments when sharks strike back.

Entries.Title: Like Us
Entries.Description: After the police officer Bob Stubbings was murdered by the mysterious Umbrella Killer, Bob's two partners Shawn, and David vow to take their revenge to defeat the Umbrella Killer. However, Shawn and David's plans change when Police Captain Donovan assigns the new officer Casey on to their case. Shawn and David must learn if Casey is truly Like Us.

Entries.Title: Baby Blues
Entries.Description: Baby Blues follows the sleep-deprived, frazzled new mom, MARTE (33), as she embarks on her very first walk alone with her newborn.

Entries.Title: Rap Dixon: Beyond Baseball
Entries.Description: Rap Dixon was a legendary African American baseball player who played in what were known as the Negro Leagues. This film chronicles his life and baseball accomplishments while exploring how racism and segregation affect how people are remembered in history.

Entries.Title: The Third Degree
Entries.Description: A college student suddenly wakes up in a random room. He begins to get interrogated about the murder of his girlfriend. As his story starts to unravel, Henry goes deeper and deeper into a spiral.

Entries.Title: the making of deeper well
Entries.Description: The creation journey ended up taking me to a mossy, windswept Iceland and so many unforgettable places in between.

Entries.Title: Coats
Entries.Description: A movie that’s set to come out in 2025 directed by Ty Guldeman.

Entries.Title: A Song For Imogene
Entries.Description: A sudden death and unexpected pregnancy force an impoverished woman to decide between freeing herself or remaining a relic of her drive-by Southern town.

Entries.Title: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad | Disneyland Resort
Entries.Description: Hold onto your hats and glasses because this here's the wildest ride in the wilderness! In this rip-roaring Point of View ride-along, climb aboard a runaway mine train as it tears through the dusty canyons, bat-filled tunnels, and creaky caverns of Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. You'll dodge falling boulders, race past blasting dynamite, and plunge through pitch-black shafts as the train barrels forward with a mind of its own. With every twist and drop, you'll feel the wind in your hair and the gold rush in your bones. As part of the Disneyland® Resort 70th Celebration, this thunderous adventure proves that some thrills can be powered by steam, speed, frontier luck, and Disney magic!

Entries.Title: Skateboard
Entries.Description: A short film by Sebastian Sommer

Entries.Title: Strawberry Sweet Killers
Entries.Description: On his first day of work, Lucas must confront his past while trying to stay alive.

Entries.Title: Lightning Bug
Entries.Description: When a family dinner spirals into theatrics, retired actress Lydia must take control of the situation.

Entries.Title: Say You're Sorry
Entries.Description: After 13 years, estranged sisters Isabel and Mariana return to their childhood home in rural Texas to care for their sick father. Determined to reclaim what was stolen from them and end his suffering, they secretly plot his murder. Desperate for revenge and an apology, they unknowingly summon a Duende—a sinister, elf-like creature that appears when someone in the family desires the death of another member.

Entries.Title: Echoes of the West End
Entries.Description: Echoes of the West End explores the transformation of a forgotten mining region in Southwest Colorado, where the scars of an industrial past are being reimagined as trails for the future. Led by the West End Trail Alliance, this documentary captures a community’s fight to stay rooted while forging a new path through outdoor recreation and resilience. It’s a story of grit, vision, and the quiet power of place.

Entries.Title: Por Fabiana
Entries.Description: A 41-year-old dairy farm worker in upstate New York, relies on toughness, solitude, and mistrust to survive long shifts of work. Then, a 21-year-old single mother forces her to reexamine what is important to her.

Entries.Title: Lost Between the Pages
Entries.Description: A writer must choose between love and career in the wake of an explosive argument.

Entries.Title: PIT
Entries.Description: A mysterious phone call leads a man down a path of no return.

Entries.Title: Before It Felt Like A Sin
Entries.Description: After the death of a close friend, two young religious men go on a journey to find out what heaven means to them. Together they navigate their relationship with each other, sin, and a conflict between feelings and faith.

Entries.Title: Birds in Maine
Entries.Description: In 2045, Ray drowns in guilt after failing to save trillions from The Doctor.

Entries.Title: There Is No Antimemetics Division
Entries.Description: Directed by Adria Lang

Entries.Title: Project Thorn: Reborn
Entries.Description: Reboot of the Project Thorn duology

Entries.Title: Memories Can Be Murder
Entries.Description: Jeremy's final hours of work are coming to an end as the clock winds down on another night. But tonight, there will be no leaving. As the doors seemingly lock themselves with an unsettling finality, he realizes he's been drawn into a web of his own making. Trapped in the quiet, echoing abyss of the restaurant, his mind drifts to the one he loves - and the memories that they made together.

Entries.Title: One Click Away
Entries.Description: An aspiring singer-songwriter with OCD, Catherine Victoire, soon becomes obsessed with the idea that she accidentally pissed off her favorite music podcaster on social media. Overwhelmed with anxiety, she turns to her best friend Alyssa to help her calm down and hopefully start seeing things more clearly.

Entries.Title: Rufus
Entries.Description: A man in the hood, Rufus, tells five disturbing dark stories about body horror to his family and friends against his wife's will.

Entries.Title: The Sounds Of Insanity
Entries.Description: The struggles of everyday life leaves Brian to self cope experiencing a significant mental breakdown.

Entries.Title: KAZE’S ORIGIN STORY! The first Ultra Legendary Brawler!
Entries.Description: The origin of Kaze, the first Ultra Legendary Brawler!

Entries.Title: Beyond the Deli Door
Entries.Description: A distraught deli worker takes a mysterious drug during a morning rush at his job and must escape another dimension he’s entered.

Entries.Title: The Sight Unseen
Entries.Description: In 1971, Sharon witnessed a glowing cross in her Bronx apartment, sparking belief and skepticism. "The Sight Unseen" explores her memories and Melvin Tapley’s writings, investigating whether the phenomenon was divine or a hoax.

Entries.Title: Sérgio Mamberti – Memórias do Brasil
Entries.Description: The documentary focuses on the memories of actor Sergio Mamberti, thus revealing a panorama of more than 60 years of Brazilian culture through the trajectory of this great actor, who also worked as a director and actively participated in our country's politics.

Entries.Title: Burnt Out 2: The Next Semester
Entries.Description: College students work in the same retail store as a toxic group project member.

Entries.Title: Mi amor
Entries.Description: Self love in all of us

Entries.Title: Permeate
Entries.Description: After murdering her art therapy tutor, Lilith becomes consumed with the anxiety of being seen for who she truly is

Entries.Title: Mad Bills to Pay (or Destiny, dile que no soy malo)
Entries.Description: Rico’s summer is a mix of chasing girls and hustling homemade cocktails out of a cooler on Orchard Beach, the Bronx. But when Destiny, his teenage girlfriend, crashes at his place with his family, it’s only a matter of time before his carefree days come spiraling down.

Entries.Title: The Big Fat Quiz of Everything
Entries.Description: Harry Hill, David Mitchell, Roisin Conaty, Sophie Willan, Josh Pugh and Fatiha El-Ghorri tackle Jimmy Carr's comprehensive quiz, from Henry VIII to the first meme and lots more in between.

Entries.Title: The Unfinished Film Of Steve Spiegel
Entries.Description: Steve Spiegel was an ambitious filmmaker, for his first feature he decided to do a one-take action thriller, but this project ended up being cut short by an unfortunate accident.

Entries.Title: The Shepherd's Last Hour
Entries.Description: Two FBI agents, Agent Whitney and Agent Mallory, set out to find a criminal mastermind who calls himself The Shepherd.

Entries.Title: The Night Before 19
Entries.Description: A short film by the students of Los Angeles Valley College  In a defining milestone for the Cinema Club, The Night Before 19 marks our very first fully-produced narrative short film. From casting calls and voted creative leads to a full pre-production and post pipeline, this project was a collaborative effort built from the ground up by emerging filmmakers.

Entries.Title: HAPPY NEW YEAR
Entries.Description: Liu, a young woman who has spent most of her life caring for her younger brother after the loss of their parents. One day, a mysterious photograph from a shoot begins to stir up fragmented memories and painful truths she thought she had buried. As New Year’s Eve approaches, Liu must choose between confronting the reality she’s been avoiding or remaining trapped in the sorrow of her past.

Entries.Title: American Criminals
Entries.Description: Chicago 1924. A prosperous city Thriving in the midst of racial and political turmoil. Two precocious wealthy teenage scholars, Nathan Leopold and Richard Loeb, kidnap and murder a fourteen-year-old boy, Bobby Franks.

Entries.Title: The Guardian
Entries.Description: Jack and Ryan, two roommates and best friends, have their Christmas taken for a turn when a tiny visitor lands on their porch. Ryan welcomes the new member of the family with open arms while Jack is apprehensive about their peculiar guest.

Entries.Title: Good Stories are Bad Lives
Entries.Description: After suffering heartbreak and loss of friendship, a person ponders their loss and their future.

Entries.Title: A Beat to Rest
Entries.Description: Late into his career, an elderly jazz drummer is forced to come to terms with aging after a bandmate suggests he retire.

Entries.Title: Cadence of Mind
Entries.Description: A young pianist must accept how to live with loneliness and laugh again after the death of his brother in a car accident.

Entries.Title: Guardian
Entries.Description: A widow discovers her recently deceased, loving, protective husband was actually a serial killer who made her an unwitting accomplice in hiding the bodies.

Entries.Title: 2 Sides to Every Story
Entries.Description: 2 Sides to Every Story

Entries.Title: Chrysalis
Entries.Description: Chrysalis follows the story of Renee, a troubled teenager torn between seeking closure from her alcoholic father and spending time with her high school friends for the last time before leaving for college. This short film grapples with the idea of what it’s like to grow up and leave your old life behind

Entries.Title: Threesome
Entries.Description: When a couple invites a Tinder rando over for a threesome, they're surprised to find out she's an absolute train wreck. But - she is hot..., so they're gonna go for it.

Entries.Title: Back To Back: Australian Open 2025 Tournament Film
Entries.Description: “Back To Back” is the definitive chronicle of Australian Open 2025, where Jannik Sinner etched his name in history with back-to-back triumphs, while Aryna Sabalenka fought to retain her throne in consecutive finals. Through raw emotion, unseen moments, and the relentless pursuit of greatness, this film captures the highs, heartbreaks, and defining battles that shaped a Grand Slam for the ages.

Entries.Title: You Don't Say!
Entries.Description: Hebert and Lilith are madly in love but too shy to tell each other-until they walk into a magical, musical bookstore. But what genre is best for honesty?

Entries.Title: In-Expresivo (Remake)
Entries.Description: A new version of In-Expresivo (2022) Alexa arrives at a strange and colorful place, where she is pursued by The Man in the Mask, who will use her memories and emotions to torment her.

Entries.Title: Land Uncharted
Entries.Description: In the 1930s a trio of unlikely adventurers set off to find a heretofore uncharted land. It has existed in stories and myths for centuries and is believed to be somewhere around the North Pole.  Hounded by an overambitious agent of the USSR, the explorers end up finding much more than they ever expected.

Entries.Title: Picture Me Better
Entries.Description: Marcus tries to fix his regrets, but his complications with staying in the moment taints everything.

Entries.Title: One Night in Brooklyn
Entries.Description: The lives of four strangers intertwine when a couple's anniversary night spirals into a whirlwind of bizarre run-ins, chance encounters, and a frantic search for baby formula.

Entries.Title: Under the Crystal Sky
Entries.Description: In the 1800s American Southwest, an Indigenous family witness an extraordinary extraterrestrial event. The family must confront their fear of the phenomenon while also fending off the encroaching American military.

Entries.Title: inDoctornated
Entries.Description: Step into the world where dreams are nurtured and aspirations take flight in inDoctornated, and follow three American Doctor Who fans who take to heart the show's messages of hope and kindness, to make  the world a better place. From a writer reflecting on his journey crafting stories for an inclusive theme park, to a scientist working to protect our environment, to an engineer building technology that saves decades of films, inDoctornated delves into the power of storytelling to ignite passions, change lives, and change the world. Through candid interviews, inDoctornated celebrates the universal theme of finding purpose and making a difference. It captures the essence of a supportive community bound by shared inspiration and the belief that each person has the potential to create something meaningful. inDoctornated invites audiences and fans of all kinds to reflect on the influence of media, the evolution of personal dreams, and the profound connections that unite us all.

Entries.Title: PORT OF ENTRY: A Short Film
Entries.Description: A short film inspired by Port of Entry, the immersive theater experience created by Albany Park Theater Project and Third Rail Projects.

Entries.Title: Eddie Pepitone: The Collapse
Entries.Description: A comedian's energetic tirade explores modern anxieties and self-analysis, covering various small topics while examining his own behavior and deep-seated insecurities.

Entries.Title: Shanmukha
Entries.Description: A police officer and research student explore an ancient Indian temple's mysteries, following scriptures and folklore to uncover secrets about a deity and treasure in a hidden forest location.

Entries.Title: Witness
Entries.Description: When a former kickboxing champion witnesses the murder of his best friend, he must do whatever it takes to survive and bring down the female crime Boss responsible for it.

Entries.Title: Disappeared
Entries.Description: This UCA MA Film tells the story of a photographer who becomes entranced with one of his subjects.

Entries.Title: Chiroptera
Entries.Description: A trio of friends drunkenly explores an abandoned school building. After breaking in, Dahlia dares Blair to go into the basement, where she stumbles upon a large bag with something bloody inside. Blair attempts to warn the others, but Foster's ego forces him to investigate. Soon, they realize they are not alone as a creature lurks in the shadows. Trapped, Dahlia and Blair are forced to fight the creature to survive. In the aftermath, Blair begins to feel something dark within.

Entries.Title: BLOOD STREET
Entries.Description: It's Halloween and monsters of all kinds come out of the shadows in the quiet town of Crystal Wood. Follow the locals as they survive the night of the Blood Street festival and the echoes of the neighborhood's eery past.

Entries.Title: Trick or Treat with Reed Richmond
Entries.Description: Join cult icon Reed Richmond (star of beloved b-movies like “Hell Ninja 4” & “Beverly Hills Graverobber”) on a jack-o-lantern–lit journey through history and mystery as he explores the origins of Halloween and the most memorable monsters it celebrates.

Entries.Title: After Alma
Entries.Description: In the Astoria housing projects of New York, a demanding single mother grapples with her daughter’s last day home, revealing her own fragility.

Entries.Title: The Volcano Manifesto
Entries.Description: Presented as a trilogy for the first time, Cauleen Smith’s The Volcano Manifesto brings together three recent films—My Caldera (2022), Mines to Caves (2023), and The Deep West Assembly (2024)—in a densely woven meditation on geological and cinematic time, on the wild abyss of volcanoes and the womb of mines and caves.” — MoMA Doc Fortnight

Entries.Title: Deadly Attraction
Entries.Description: After encountering a younger man who reignites her faith in true love, Ebony sees a jealous dark side in him and soon realizes it can turn deadly.

Entries.Title: Break A Leg
Entries.Description: An aspiring actor arrives at the audition of his career... only to find himself locked in the theatre alongside fellow auditionee and disgraced former child actress.

Entries.Title: Pedigree
Entries.Description: A father-daughter duo hatch a haphazard scam to pay rent, with mixed results.

Entries.Title: A Girl Dying of an Affliction Called Love
Entries.Description: Robin breaks up with Venus, leading to more dire consequences than either thought possible.

Entries.Title: Chaos. Murder. Despair.
Entries.Description: Chaos, Murder, and Despair have walked among humans for eons, tasked with sowing discord among them. However, the thrill of Earthly life has long faded, and with it, their power. Only one way exists to reclaim it: resurrect their long-dead sister.

Entries.Title: The Golden Apron
Entries.Description: A mockumentary that follows the 5 main contestants of The Golden Apron contest, a competition in search of "the greatest home chef in America", being held by a nefarious food manufacturing company with their own corporate agenda.

Entries.Title: Dollar Store Killers
Entries.Description: Dollar $tore Killers" is a chilling thriller delving into the dark side of internet fame and disaffected youth. A true crime documentarian is pulled into the orbit of masked killers who livestream their disturbing acts, all while using everyday items from a dollar store. As reality blurs with online notoriety, the line between observer and accomplice vanishes.

Entries.Title: Unholy Communion
Entries.Description: When Catholic priests with pedophile pasts begin turning up dead, a small town cop's investigation unearths buried secrets that begin to implicate an entire community.

Entries.Title: Vinnie-isms: The Story of the Cop Comedian
Entries.Description: Vinnie Montez spent his teenage years pursuing the dream of becoming a Cop. In 1998, he achieved his goal, becoming a Deputy Sheriff with the Boulder County Sheriff's Office. But after nearly ten years on the job, he began to suffer the effects of cumulative trauma

Entries.Title: Cameron Mitchell Gets His Face Smashed
Entries.Description: Through exaggerated tales of distant rumors, two frat guys speculate over a fight between their brothers.

Entries.Title: Blood Drive
Entries.Description: A harmless hunt they seek, but may only find in a steed of steel

Entries.Title: After the Rain
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: Entity
Entries.Description: A trio of filmmakers find themselves deep within the woods of upstate NY attempting to search for evidence of a local legend, only to find out some of the group are not all they are cracked up to be.

Entries.Title: She Said So
Entries.Description: Precocious 15-year-old Emerson is woken by her hysterical mother because her best friend Layla is unconscious and there’s an incriminating video found on Emerson’s iPhone from the night before.

Entries.Title: These Are My Friends!
Entries.Description: A comedy that follows various mid-twenties drifters over the course of one party.

Entries.Title: Lost In McDonaldland
Entries.Description: McDonald's is bringing the old mascots back for a brand-new animated short film.

Entries.Title: The Skull
Entries.Description: The Skulls is a dream come true. But Luke soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

Entries.Title: Asparagus Bear
Entries.Description: The residents of a quiet Mediterranean town are thrown into speculation overdrive with the unusual appearance of a bear in the midst of asparagus season.

Entries.Title: Sol
Entries.Description: A man living in a modern dystopian society, a cog in a large corporate wheel, who is content with his dull, meaningless life-until he experiences an unexpected discovery.

Entries.Title: Recurring Gig
Entries.Description: Jodie and Tyler are two commercial actors who land a gig with a New York-based creative firm to film a series of ads for an energy utility based in Seattle. The energy company is attempting to promote natural gas and fend off electrification in the region, and Jodie and Tyler make the perfect mother-son combo for their propaganda campaign. In between shoots at the studio, where they learn how to pronounce "Puget Sound" and extol the benefits of cooking on gas stove tops, Jodie and Tyler attempt to break out into new roles in their personal lives, from their relationships and identities to their dreams of being taken seriously as actors.

Entries.Title: Where It All Began
Entries.Description: A transgender woman arrives home for her mothers funeral and is faced with her past and the father she left behind.

Entries.Title: The Arapaho Covered Wagon Redux - Arapaho Days
Entries.Description: The film explores The Covered Wagon, an epic 1923 silent film with a new soundtrack, recorded by the Northern Arapaho Eagle Society led by Michael Ridgebear and the Boulder Symphony & Music Academy. The music retells the story from this Colorado tribe’s perspective and helps to reverse negative Native American stereotypes perpetuated over six centuries.

Entries.Title: God As My Witness
Entries.Description: Decades after losing his brother, a man begins to uncover dark secrets within the Archdiocese of New Orleans, exposing a generations-long cover-up. The quest for truth soon leads into one of the largest U.S. archdiocese bankruptcies, as survivors reveal their haunting stories of betrayal, sexual abuse, and corruption in the Crescent City.

Entries.Title: Black Israelite
Entries.Description: James Donald Forbes McCann stand up comedy special.

Entries.Title: Stand Together as One
Entries.Description: When drought hit Ethiopia in 1983, millions of people in the war-ravaged nation were denied food relief by a ruthless dictatorship. The treacherous war zone didn’t stop Kenyan photojournalist Mohamed Amin or his colleagues. Inspired by their historic global report, musicians chose to stand together as one. 40 years after the recording of "We Are The World", this film reveals what’s possible when creatives come together in a common cause.

Entries.Title: JANET
Entries.Description: Waking up bloodied and bound inside the headquarters of a sinister tech syndicate, Janet's only focus is finding her brother... and escaping.

Entries.Title: The Third Day
Entries.Description: As his son is drafted into the army, a father volunteers months later to serve in the same regiment, determined to protect him from the horrors of war — even if it means never coming home again ...

Entries.Title: TNA The Border Brawl
Entries.Description: TNA The Border Brawl - Zoneify show

Entries.Title: Forever A Never
Entries.Description: Two best friends, about to marry others, write wedding speeches for each other, reflecting on what it truly means to love and if they’ve been expressing it right all along.

Entries.Title: No Right Way
Entries.Description: Georgie, a brazen 13-year-old, has her life uprooted when she’s thrust into the guardianship of her half-sister Harper and torn away from her life in Las Vegas. Harper sees this turbulent time as a window of opportunity to pave a brighter future for her half-sister in Los Angeles, but Harper’s self-righteous attempts to protect Georgie only lead to exposing their paralleled childhood wounds.

Entries.Title: Oppressive & Crippling Demons
Entries.Description: A young Woman named Lilith begins to have haunting visions caused by a malevolent being. As these hauntings continue, she slowly loses more of herself.

Entries.Title: The Specter of Communism, or the Polarization Situation That Shook the Nation
Entries.Description: The highest officials of the United States Government are gathered together to do one thing. Find the communists among them.

Entries.Title: Tailless
Entries.Description: Diego Araya moves to Patagonia to photograph pumas and encounters a puma born without a tail. He had no idea how this puma would affect the rest of his life. This film details the events leading to his dedication to save Chile’s pumas.

Entries.Title: Clay Bodies
Entries.Description: Secluded at an artist retreat for the weekend, Grace finds a new source of inspiration.

Entries.Title: Afterglow
Entries.Description: A fifteen-year-old boy's first attempt at intimacy with his girlfriend spirals into chaos as the shadow of a dangerous secret consumes him.

Entries.Title: Peepo and The Worry Monster
Entries.Description: Follow Peepo, Goobi and The Worry Monster on an adventure through big feelings, hard talks and an unforgettable zoo trip.

Entries.Title: Transitus
Entries.Description: An atmospheric, contemplative visual impression set on a river at dawn. The scene, immersed in thick fog and the gentle light of the rising sun, reveals the rituals of everyday life and the silent presence of nature, in which a seemingly ordinary ferry crossing takes on symbolic meaning. The painting is filled with an atmosphere of mystery and elusive tension, with a subtle emphasis on detail – from the reels and rope, to the ferryman's tired hand and the glint of a silver coin.

Entries.Title: Damn Handy
Entries.Description: When plumber Roger Clark visits the remote farmhouse of two murderous sisters, he'll need a trick up his sleeve to survive.

Entries.Title: Lee the LemonMan
Entries.Description: Born from the dirt, Lee is a lemon-shaped man in a world that only wants his juice. Mocked and broken, his need to be understood curdles into violence. A surreal, bitter descent through art, pain, and pulp.

Entries.Title: De La Cruz
