Entries.Description: Yoli De La Cruz, wants revenge after being assaulted by Victor, the son of a corrupt police captain. Realizing she will never get the justice she deserves, Yoli decides to train with Lobo, a former bare-knuckle fighter/hitman.

Entries.Title: Scandalous
Entries.Description: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

Entries.Title: God & Buddha Are Friends
Entries.Description: A young boy finds himself at the crossroads of faith when his Buddhist mother goes head to head with a fiery Christian pastor.

Entries.Title: A Bear! ...or Something
Entries.Description: "A Bear! ...or Something" is a tightly contained and sharp-witted suspense short that unfolds in real time across two locations: a sterile emergency dispatch center and the pitch-black forest. With minimal visuals and a creeping sense of dread, the story builds tension through dialogue, sound, and the widening gap between those who seek help and those tasked with answering.

Entries.Title: A Whale Of A Time
Entries.Description: Charlie, a slightly overweight English teacher, has a rough week.

Entries.Title: Tom Hornets
Entries.Description: In the midst of a 90s housing crisis, ex-forensics photographer Tom Hornets seeks a new life working under the charismatic but elusive Curtis Dombroski. But as he digs deeper, Tom discovers that the horrors of his past are nothing compared to the monster he works for now.

Entries.Title: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win
Entries.Description: Three-part series for ESPN capturing the rise of Silvio Berlusconi from his humble beginnings to the very top – from cruise ship crooner to AC Milan owner to Prime Minister of Italy.

Entries.Title: Breaking & Egg-tering
Entries.Description: An eccentric burglar plans a heist to break into his friend's house in order to steal the most valuable treasure of all.

Entries.Title: Always Said
Entries.Description: Set in a quiet house filled with echoes of a past relationship, the story follows a boy and girl reconnecting one last time. Through shared routines, voicemails, and fragments of their history

Entries.Title: Heart of a Bull
Entries.Description: A concert film documenting a performance from the Houston artist Orpheus Von Doom.

Entries.Title: Freight: The Five Incarnations of Abel Green
Entries.Description: J. Alphonse Nicholson, who also directs, provides a powerful performance in this absorbing one-man play telling the five stories of Abel Green, a soul destined to keep coming back to the world because there is something his soul needs to learn.

Entries.Title: THE METHOD
Entries.Description: An aspiring influencer couple finds their relationship bizarrely tested by the casting process for a window cleaner commercial.

Entries.Title: Southern Fried Lies
Entries.Description: An Arkansas realtor sets her daughter up with the richest guy in town, but when he mysteriously dies, she’s accused of stealing his fortune; additional deaths and a web of lies ensnare the rural community, leaving a family destroyed.

Entries.Title: Dinner to Die For
Entries.Description: Hannah, a culinary photographer, and her friend Evan share a passion for true crime content. When Evan suggests role playing their own true crime scenario involving a killer meal and the girl next door, things take a twisted turn.

Entries.Title: I Think God Lives in Eastbourne
Entries.Description: Narrated by Eastbourne's resident pier tarot reader Jennifer, this film is a visual exploration of the cycles of life and death in a town that is both the sunniest place in the UK and one of the top 3 suicide spots in the world.

Entries.Title: Pikmin Plush Adventures R2
Entries.Description: 6 months after the events of Pikmin Plush Adventures R, Olimar and Louie are sent back to PNF-404 to collect treasure after they inadvertently plunge their company into debt, but upon returning, they find there’s more trouble than they left! It’s up to the PikMEN to collect treasure, stop evil aliens, and save the planet!

Entries.Title: The Bog Movie
Entries.Description: Friends Ben and Jack make a wager at the bog. This has dire consequences.

Entries.Title: Unraveling George
Entries.Description: An intimate documentary about Civil Rights leader, entrepreneur and Hall of Fame Coach George Raveling.

Entries.Title: Ghost Odyssey
Entries.Description: Jack Barto's paranormal misadventures to cross dimensions with the help of his partner, Chris.

Entries.Title: Sugar Babies
Entries.Description: A college student from rural Louisiana uses her social media to create an unconventional online business, aiming to break free from poverty and help her friends. Her ambition leads her down a risky path as she navigates new challenges.

Entries.Title: Hobby Hustle
Entries.Description: Billions of dollars are generated each year in the sports memorabilia and trading card industry, but who are the buyers and sellers? What is the actual value of what is being sold? Hobby Hustle follows three separate people who became involved in the polarizing obsession that changed their lives forever.

Entries.Title: I NEED MOVIEMAKING SOFTWARE
Entries.Description: Blisstopher gets some... illicit help on his journey to acquire software to make the movies of his dreams.

Entries.Title: The Tavern of Ruin
Entries.Description: The film created for "Tavern of Ruin"(Track from Mourners Project). captures an improvisation born on a Spring’s day from the depths of the terrain, where thought becomes gesture, and image merges with flow.  The process of filming and production unfolded two months after the recording of the album—a moment suspended between the trees of Lahijan, where an orangehead flowamidst spectra of rhythms and colors. In a spiraling movement, it shifts from one plane of flow to another—an endless becoming, a spiral voyage through layered terrains of sensation and perception.

Entries.Title: The Echos
Entries.Description: At a crossroads, a girl decides whether to remain in the past or focus on the future

Entries.Title: Are My Parents Watching?
Entries.Description: A polished and self-deprecating host presents various comedy sketches as he attempts to mask his personal struggles with his parents' indifference

Entries.Title: Conservation and Recovery of the Scarlet Macaw in Mexico
Entries.Description: The Scarlet Macaw, a vibrant symbol of the Mexican rainforest, is disappearing from the ecosystem. Conservation and Recovery of the Scarlet Macaw in Mexico explores the tireless efforts of Natura y Ecosistemas Mexicanos (NEM) to save the last remaining viable population of these iconic birds. Facing the constant threat of poaching, NEM works diligently to rescue hatchlings from vulnerable nests before they are looted. By forging partnerships with local communities, they have developed a network of dedicated individuals to locate and protect macaw nests. This compelling film showcases the resilience of both people and wildlife in a united fight to preserve a species that has long symbolized the beauty and diversity of the region's natural heritage.

Entries.Title: The Manhattan Project in Colour
Entries.Description: Made to mark the 80th anniversary of the first nuclear weapons being detonated over Japan in August 1945, this documentary uses colourised black and white photographs and reels of film capturing the project that developed the atomic bomb.

Entries.Title: Thunderstorm experimental short film
Entries.Description: an aggressive thunderstom reeks havoc outside

Entries.Description: Behind the Scenes Featurette for Mickey 17 starring Robert Pattinson

Entries.Title: Annie's Perfect Teeth
Entries.Description: A jealous sculptor obsesses over his girlfriend's teeth.

Entries.Title: Death and Life
Entries.Description: Rupert has a secret that no one knows, and he intends to keep it that way - but the hand of fate isn't always dealt how we'd like.

Entries.Title: Magic
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Hula Hoop
Entries.Description: Sophie and Brooke are two women hanging out at home, bored and listless. To break the monotony of everyday life, Brooke impulsively buys two hula hoops, much to Sophie's skepticism.

Entries.Title: arrival
Entries.Description: A psychological sci-fi drama about love, identity, and the unknown. After a mysterious encounter with an otherworldly light, Mia wakes up feeling unfamiliar in her own body and life. As she pieces together the events of the night before, she faces her partner, Haley, with a newfound sense of self—and a secret hidden behind glowing eyes. Is she still the same person, or has something else arrived in her place?

Entries.Title: Roy Wood Jr.: Lonely Flowers
Entries.Description: In this stand-up special, Roy Wood Jr. delves into the unraveling of society, examining how the growing lack of connection has fueled a culture dominated by guns, protests, rude employees, and rampant self-interest.

Entries.Title: The Last Minute
Entries.Description: After ignoring a text from his mom,  Danny gets a visit from the Grim Reaper.

Entries.Title: Haken - Liveforms: An Evening with Haken
Entries.Description: Progressive pioneers Haken spent 2024 celebrating their most recent acclaimed studio album, ‘Fauna’, in the most comprehensive way possible, as part of their ‘An Evening With’ run throughout the world. Playing two full sets each night, the band performed ‘Fauna’ in full, before returning to the stage to run through a selection of the best-loved cuts from their catalogue. In a homecoming of sorts for Haken, on the 21st September 2024 the band played London’s legendary O2 Forum, and the document of that special evening is what’s witnessed on ‘Liveforms: An Evening With Haken’.  1. Entries.Title: Jason Isbell: Live at the Capitol Theatre
Entries.Description: In celebration of the release of 'Foxes in the Snow', Jason Isbell played songs from his new album and more on a special night at the historic Capitol Theatre in Port Chester, New York.

Entries.Title: Dark Sanctuary: The Story of The Church
Entries.Description: The story of The Church, the infamous Dallas goth club, and the community of artists and outsiders that called it home.

Entries.Title: KISS-KA CALL?
Entries.Description: When mysterious calls disrupt Rocky's ordinary life, he's drawn into a cat-and-mouse game with a sinister force. As the calls escalate, Rocky's grip on reality falters and his darkest secrets begin to surface. Can he unravel the mystery behind the calls before it's too late or will the unknown caller destroy him forever?

Entries.Title: Damsel of the Doomed
Entries.Description: A horror host searching for fame reluctantly comes face to face with her magical past and ends up manifesting murder.

Entries.Title: Blackman's Reality
Entries.Description: Jaiye Thomas is accused of a crime he didn't commit but how can his word stand against the word of a young white woman in the UK.

Entries.Title: We Need Shelter
Entries.Description: In the high stakes of land-lording in Ontario one wrong move can cause bankruptcy. You can not afford to take chances; there is no help for landlords. Featuring interviews with top people  involved in the housing crises, this doc looks for solutions to help ease the burden on the system and decrease risk for landlords.

Entries.Title: Demursyncronosis
Entries.Description: The girlfriend of a confused gardener wants to move in with him. He's not too sure about it. He's not so sure about anything. One afternoon, he wakes up from a nap and begins suffering from a mysterious ailment.

Entries.Title: PARATUS A 20th Anniversary Special
Entries.Description: A look back 20 years ago, on the challenges Coast Guard air crews and rescue swimmers had to overcome in New Orleans, to successfully rescue thousands of people in need following Hurricane Katrina in 2005.

Entries.Title: Home No Return
Entries.Description: During a party at her house, when a young woman comes out to the backyard, a series of interactions with her friends leads her to question if she is making the right choice to go back to Iran to visit a dying family member, at a time of chaos and uncertainty.

Entries.Title: Dr. Seuss's The Sneetches
Entries.Description: As long as there have been Sneetches on beaches, the Star-Bellies and Moon-Bellies have lived separate lives. But when two young Sneetches form an unlikely friendship, they teach their communities that differences don't need to be avoided, they can be celebrated.

Entries.Title: Sonder
Entries.Description: The endlessly complex lives of several individuals as they converge across one day.

Entries.Title: The Zimmerman Effect
Entries.Description: The only thing stopping evil businessman David Zimmerman from destroying 7.47 acres is Stephen Lowke, he's no John McClane, John Wick, or John Rambo, but he is a Latin teacher.

Entries.Title: TNA Border Brawl
Entries.Description: “The Border Brawl” will stream live on May 25 from the Canada / USA border in Niagara Falls, Canada, exclusively for free on Zone·ify.  The event features wrestling icons Brutus “The Barber” Beefcake, “The Mountie” Jacques Rougeau, Barbie Blank “Kelly Kelly,” UFC’s Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, and many others

Entries.Title: The Wrong Man? 20 Years Behind Bars
Entries.Description: How Paul Denham, convicted of first-degree murder, fights to clear his name in the US.

Entries.Title: The Strangers’ Case
Entries.Description: In 1517, anti-immigrant riots broke out in London. Thomas More, then a deputy Sheriff of the city, intervened. Decades later, William Shakespeare wrote a speech for the play 'Sir Thomas More', in which More defended asylum seekers - 'the strangers'.

Entries.Title: How To Survive A Shark Attack
Entries.Description: Shark attack survivor Paul De Gelder attempts the unthinkable -- provoking sharks to attack him and rip off his limbs so that he can reveal what it takes to survive an attack.

Entries.Title: Simon Claw 2
Entries.Description: After the betrayal at the hands of Tim Cheese and the explosion that left Simon Claw barely alive, the story doesn’t end — it fractures.  Simon is pulled from the edge of death by Saimun-Klau, an ancient Egyptian ancestor and the keeper of forbidden portals. With reality bending and time shattering, they must journey across the Clawverse, hunting down alternate versions of Simon in a desperate attempt to stop what Tim is becoming.  But it’s not just about stopping a monster… it’s about finding what was lost — hope, purpose, and maybe even family.

Entries.Title: Saturday Night Inside Out
Entries.Description: A young man accidentally locks himself out of his apartment late one evening and must find a way back inside before potential disaster strikes.

Entries.Title: Banjo
Entries.Description: Isaac is thrilled when his friend offers him the use of his family's cabin in the woods to lose his virginity. But when his first time goes horribly wrong, he begins to believe it may be the work of a sinister circumcision cult.

Entries.Title: The Auntie
Entries.Description: After Breaking out of the Psych Ward to go searching for her son, Nicole finds out that her sister had adopted him and now she was Act as his Auntie. Nicole will do whatever it takes to get him back and she will hurt anyone in her way.

Entries.Title: Closing Credits
Entries.Description: A drama short film about a impulsive foot solider Alonso who after years of the work is fed up and wants to start a new life. His plan... rob his boss and leave town with the money but can he survive the day without them finding out.

Entries.Title: The Life of a Satire Influencer
Entries.Description: A Satire Influencer reflects on his career and the effect it has on his life and those around him. As he crumbles deeper into the facade, one question remains - how far will he go for fame?

Entries.Title: The Way We Get By
Entries.Description: A group of friends throw a party in celebration of their friend who died one year prior. Conflicts arise when people are unable to control their feelings.

Entries.Title: The Metaphor That Became a Room
Entries.Description: The Metaphor That Became a Room is a psychological drama exploring identity, communication, and the struggle for self-understanding. Divided into two parts, the film first delves into the protagonist’s frustration with the urge to persuade others, realizing that over-explaining only distorts meaning. A note from the past echoes a hard truth: “Someone’s unwillingness to understand will always outweigh your effort.”  In A Symphony of Unfinished Selves, the narrative shifts inward, revealing the protagonist’s fractured identity. Trapped in a metaphorical room built from illusions and contradictions, he reflects on his dual persona—the social facade and the hidden, lost self. The film questions how we see ourselves versus how others see us and whether true self-recognition is possible.  Through minimalist dialogue and layered symbolism, the film captures the silent tension between who we are, who we appear to be, and who we long to become.

Entries.Title: The Death Rally
Entries.Description: In the next installment of our wasteland series which began with The Mad Man of Miami and continued with The Seven Blood, the Guardian is captured by a tribe who plays deathly games in the wasteland and is forced to compete by the sadistic Game King leader.

Entries.Title: Peterson Moving Co.
Entries.Description: An amateur thief recruits two unsuspecting high schoolers to join his moving company as a coverup for his elaborate but outrageous heists.

Entries.Title: Java Jive
Entries.Description: A thirsty young man tries to resist a hot drink.

Entries.Title: Recurrent
Entries.Description: Welcome to RECURRENT, where people have the power.  Why give blood or plasma when you can just give electricity?  No pain, no needles!  What could go wrong?

Entries.Title: The Magic Hour
Entries.Description: Two brothers’ mission to fix their mom’s broken tablet, before she comes home, is met with a series of challenges.

Entries.Title: Can't Have It All
Entries.Description: Fashion stylist Ari balances a polyamorous relationship with Todd, her struggling partner, and Darnell, a charismatic newcomer. As feelings deepen and lines blur, she learns the price of wanting everything.

Entries.Title: What Happened To Our Vision?
Entries.Description: Elena has just been diagnosed with MSMDS, a condition which leaves her with permanently blurry eyesight. Although her brother, Noah, attempts to dissuade her from further pursuing her dreams of being a photographer, she stands resilient in her commitment to the art form she loves, and Noah finds that maybe he has something to learn from Elena himself.

Entries.Title: I Hitchhiked Across America
Entries.Description: We hitchhiked across America for 30 days with no money, no plan — just the kindness of strangers.

Entries.Title: Trailing Off
Entries.Description: A mom and her two young kids are separated on a hike. They react in much different ways.

Entries.Title: Every Living Breathing Moment
Entries.Description: During his daily commute, a man finds himself stuck in a rut, hiding from the world behind the safety of his polaroid camera and his street-photography obsession. It isn't until he misses the chance to meet someone special when he learns he must leave his shell and is forced to understand cherishing even the smallest moments in life.

Entries.Title: A Portrait of Healing
Entries.Description: Bringing a closure to his "Healing Trilogy," Bladde offers up a beautifully bizarre tale of overcoming trauma. Through grizzly depictions of a decapitated head and symbolic references to the River Styx and even Saltburn, viewers watch as his character, The Illusionist, takes back the power stolen from them and strips themselves of the turmoil caused by a deeply repressed sexual assault.

Entries.Title: Broken Boards
Entries.Description: After a group of skaters lose their friend, they deal with grief in different ways, tearing up the group.

Entries.Title: Drag Race
Entries.Description: Two rivals race each other in the confrontation of a lifetime.

Entries.Title: Montana
Entries.Description: While on a road trip on the coast of Lake Michigan, Montana breaks up with Henry.

Entries.Title: Efflorescence
Entries.Description: LaLa has turned vegan as an act of love to Johnny, the love of her life. But after binging rare greenery at a flower shop to stop her everlasting hunger, she finds herself turning into a flesh-eating human plant, same night she’s expected to meet her lover’s vegan posse.

Entries.Title: Clean Slate

Entries.Title: The Snake-Short Horror Film
Entries.Description: A Boy,Ted,Shows His “Friends”his dvd collection and picks out a dvd at random to watch,he instead decides to show them the opening of ghost ship.but,as we see,his friends aren’t actually around and he’s imagined them there with him,while he stares at his rubber snake,a stress reliever toy for ted,the snake bites ted in the face,killing him.When his “brother”(not actually but likes to think of him like that)Gangsta Beau Turns Up Unexpectedly, he examines the blood and tells the tale to the unseen coroner of the drama both men have been through such as Ted Selling Beau off to the police after a botched armed robbery job went wrong,Beau Framing Ted With Drugs,Ted and Beau getting into a Physical Altercation that almost ends badly,and finally,Beau Selling Ted To The Police Because Ted tried killing Beau.Beau Then Shoots The Killer,The Snake,but it ends up not doing much and the snake wraps around beaus neck,strangling him.

Entries.Description: After a beautiful adventure full of excitement and mystery, Ulysses and Frank head to Oscar's house to seek refuge. Though things don't go exactly as planned when the FBI show up.

Entries.Title: Like It Was
Entries.Description: A bitter couple has one last chance to talk, and one last chance to make things right.

Entries.Title: Endless Beauty
Entries.Description: The full-length video is dead. Everything online is fake. Pros are washed. Shut up, loser! Sci-Fi fixed all that when it brought Endless Beauty.
