Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: African Kung Fu Nazis II
Entries.Description: After the successful release of African Kung Fu Nazis part I; are you ready for the crazy whacked-out continuation in part II. This time hated villain Adolf Robotler reappears and wants to become President & Reichskanzler of Ghana with the help of his henchmen. But something seems off with Adolf; some think he is a robot, also In his way are local Kung Fu hero Addo (younger brother of Addae from part 1) and his sidekick Sek Tin. Together they embark on a quest to learn new Kung Fu styles, take out Hitler’s henchmen and finally face the master of evil himself. But the two heroes will encounter a “monstrous surprise”…

Entries.Title: Giovanna d'Arco - Teatro Regio di Parma
Entries.Description: France 1429. Giovanna appears as a prophetic figure while the French are in the throes of the 100 Years War against the English. After a dream, Carlo is inspired to seek a sanctuary near Rouen where he meets Giovanna, who predicts the end of France’s suffering. Her father, Giacomo, believing she is possessed, attempts to turn her over to the English. After her capture, Giacomo realises his mistake and frees her. Giovanna leads the French to victory but pays the ultimate price.

Entries.Title: Come Together: Untold Stories of Unity
Entries.Description: In 2006, the independent film "Dirty Laundry" emerged as a powerful collaboration between Black gay men and Black women, confronting homophobia within a Southern family in Georgia. This groundbreaking project served as a conversation starter addressing homophobia and HIV/AIDS in the Black community. "Come Together: Untold Stories of Unity" highlights the urgent need again for solidarity between Black women and Black gay men, showcasing their transformative alliance against systemic barriers and legislative assaults on LGBTQ rights. Amidst escalating anti-LGBTQ legislation and attacks on women's rights, this film underscores the imperative of collective action for liberation.

Entries.Title: Roulette
Entries.Description: Two hitmen, their lives on the line, decide a game of Russian roulette is the fairest way to solve their problem.

Entries.Title: The Rise and Fall of Terrorgram
Entries.Description: FRONTLINE and ProPublica investigate how an online network known as Terrorgram spread extremism and violence. The documentary traces the rise of a global community of white supremacists and the anonymous, loosely moderated platforms used to spread hate and promote terror attacks.

Entries.Title: The Journal
Entries.Description: An American veteran of the Vietnam War returns a precious keepsake to the daughter of an enemy solider, 50 years later. The film stars Elyse Dinh, a refugee of the war, and Brian Delate, a veteran of the war.  Directed, written, and produced by James Andrews.

Entries.Title: Morty
Entries.Description: After giving her little brother a stuffed animal that comes with an online counterpart, a teenage girl notices some sinister changes in his behavior.

Entries.Title: SCP: The Corpse
Entries.Description: SCP: The Corpse is a short film based on the SCP wiki.

Entries.Title: Unspeakable Acts of Cruelty
Entries.Description: A new and horrible gaming experience is announced

Entries.Title: Effigy
Entries.Description: A man wakes up in a small padded room disoriented, and with no memory of how he got there.

Entries.Title: All Good Things End
Entries.Description: A teen faces his mortality after an accidental dosage of the wrong medication.

Entries.Title: Implicit Design
Entries.Description: A tech company tests a new weapon on a man living off the grid.

Entries.Title: FACTORY RESET
Entries.Description: Two struggling brothers participating in a social experiment for money, soon uncover its hidden agenda as they are slowly abused and deprived from any form of emotion

Entries.Title: Too Little Too Late
Entries.Description: James "Honcho" Young II is a well-respected boss but his position is threatened by his ex-love, turned partner, Ryan "Rain" Mills who desperately wants to be next in line. Driven by jealousy, love and money, Rain sets her sights on taking what's hers, causing Honcho to lose more than just his position. Can she afford the cost to be boss?

Entries.Title: Deja Vu
Entries.Description: Two detectives are tasked with interrogating a suspect of a murder after the case went cold several years ago.

Entries.Title: Lamb To The Slaughter
Entries.Description: Based on a Roald Dahl Short Story.

Entries.Title: Primos
Entries.Description: A surreal birthday spirals into chaos when a cousin ends up dead. As lies unravel, the party becomes a darkly comedic descent into family, guilt, and denial

Entries.Title: Roadrunners
Entries.Description: Two childhood best friends, Leo and Adam, must travel across the country to deliver a ring to Adam's boss who is a ruthless and powerful drug lord. The only problem is...the ring is stuck inside of the stomach of Leo's six and a half year old niece.

Entries.Title: Caramel
Entries.Description: While this trilogy ends, does Will and Bran would too? The last chapter shows how Will handles his relationship with Bran.

Entries.Title: Mammoth
Entries.Description: A fragile young woman takes her lifelike doll out in public for the first time, but a visit to the natural history museum triggers a dark childhood memory, forcing her to confront reality and let go.

Entries.Title: Sangue de Lobo, Pele de Cordeiro
Entries.Description: The private investigator Sérgio Machado must help his colleague, Del. Ana C. Encantado, to find the true killer of Vovó! For that, they interrogate Lobo, caught in the scene of the crime, and Chapeuzinho Vermelho, granddaughter of the descended grandma…

Entries.Title: HEXX
Entries.Description: On the night of her senior prom, an amateur witch who has never experienced requited love, concocts a love potion to make the coolest guy in school fall for her.

Entries.Title: Sin
Entries.Description: Substance-dependent single mother Sin is trapped in a toxic relationship and must find a way to end it before it kills her.

Entries.Title: The House Among the Trees
Entries.Description: After three thieves break into a secluded house, they accidentally discover a small town's dark secrets.

Entries.Title: Enongo
Entries.Description: “Enongo” follows the music-fueled inspiring story of rapper/producer/Ph.D. candidate, Enongo Lumumba-Kasongo, a.k.a., Sammus. With her autobiographical and afrofuturism-inspired music, Enongo tackles various subjects including (but certainly not limited to) mental health, growing up, and relationships. Through a combination of actuality and animation, Enongo tells a universally-relevant, intimate, empowering story of identity, artistic creation, and survival.

Entries.Title: SICK
Entries.Description: Plagued by physical ailments, a troubled soul seeks help from an unusual facility.

Entries.Title: Pura Sangre
Entries.Description: Frankie and Lucky, two young artists navigating love and identity in New York City, cross paths again after years of separation. Their reunion in a bookstore triggers a flood of memories, reopening wounds from their past relationship. As Frankie revisits the apartment they once shared, the film delves into their tumultuous past—Lucky's struggle with trust, Frankie's desire for autonomy, and the emotional weight of unspoken truths.

Entries.Title: Woof
Entries.Description: Kevin, a recluse with a peculiar hobby, gets in a heated confrontation with his neighbor.

Entries.Title: Pick Up Lagbe
Entries.Description: This a Serious Romantic Drama From Bangladesh. Written By Dayal Saha. Acted By Yash Rohan & Tasnia Farin.

Entries.Title: Homecoming
Entries.Description: When their eldest son returns home from college after years apart, a family must confront the estrangement caused by his sexuality, unaware that their window for reconciliation may be closing.

Entries.Title: Expiration Date
Entries.Description: The end of an era looms as 4th-generation dairy farmer Ned nears a long overdue retirement. His adult son, Jacob, has chosen a different life path, effectively ending his family’s long history on the farm, a choice that prompts a new level of introspection from both father and son.

Entries.Title: Poisoned
Entries.Description: An investigation into the death of a young British man sparks a global hunt for the individual selling hundreds of young people lethal poison.

Entries.Title: The Apricot
Entries.Description: A 10-year-old boy and his mom spend a day working on his grandfather’s apricot farm. As a first-generation Mexican-American, his mom insists he embrace the family tradition and learn the value of hard work. Eager to prove himself, the boy quickly becomes discouraged when he sees how much faster everyone else is working. He scrambles to keep up, trying different ways to speed up the process. But as frustration builds, he learns that asking for help can be its own kind of strength — and finds an unexpected connection with his grandfather.

Entries.Title: Basi Bala
Entries.Description: Anxious overachiever Ben clashes with his carefree best friend Miguel when a birthday surprise gone wrong reveals their contrasting perspectives, forcing Ben to confront his fears and learn to embrace life's spontaneity.

Entries.Title: Dick Marshall 2 or The Existential Crisis of Toothpick Dick
Entries.Description: Toothpick Dick doesn't know his name.

Entries.Title: Checkpoint
Entries.Description: A talented coder creates a device that gives him the ability to create save points in time, he then tries to use this new found ability to get a date to his friends wedding.

Entries.Title: Life Together
Entries.Description: Follows a decades-spanning friendship between two school boys.

Entries.Title: Twisted Devotion
Entries.Description: R&B star Skye Williams' comeback is threatened when an obsessed fan’s admiration turns into a dangerous fixation. As she and her boyfriend vanish without a trace, Skye must fight to escape before his obsession turns deadly.

Entries.Title: MOTHER NATURE AND THE DOOMSDAY PREPPER
Entries.Description: In this quirky Fantasy Romance, Mother Nature will lose her job unless she convinces a fanatic Doomsday Prepper that there is hope for the planet.

Entries.Title: Unblinking
Entries.Description: A grieving young man seeks solace from his therapist after haunting visions of his dead brother, only to discover that a sinister entity with an unblinking stare is manipulating his mind.

Entries.Title: Boss Up, The Musical
Entries.Description: Get ready to boss up and break out in song! Boss Up, The Musical is the dazzling, laugh-out-loud feature film debut of viral sensation Tony Talks (Antonio Baldwin), bringing his beloved character Cassandra to life in a fabulous, larger-than-life spectacle. When high-powered executive Cassandra—flawless, fierce, and always in charge—suddenly gets fired, her world turns upside down. Stripped of her title and prestige, she embarks on a hilarious and heartfelt journey of self-discovery, proving that true confidence comes from within. Featuring original songs, show-stopping dance numbers, and side-splitting performances—including a scene-stealing turn by musical artist Ocean Kelly—this musical comedy is an instant classic.

Entries.Title: The Heist
Entries.Description: One cold and fateful schoolnight, friends Kasey, Lyn, Ry, Zane, & AJ attempt to steal Kasey’s stuff back from her ex, Kyle. What could possibly go wrong?

Entries.Title: Escort
Entries.Description: On her first night on the job as an escort, a young woman's unexpected encounter with an elderly man in his apartment sets off a chain of events that will forever alter the course of both their lives.

Entries.Title: Tom Dustin: Portrait of a Comedian
Entries.Description: Key West comedy innovator Tom Dustin gets his due in this documentary portrait, directed by Joe List. Set over the course of a single weekend, the film follows Dustin, a longtime comedian and the co-founder of Comedy Key West. The film celebrates the friendship of Dustin and fellow comedian List, as Dustin himself digs into his struggles with depression and drinking in his own routines—amid a generous array of stand-up performances.

Entries.Title: The Threshing
Entries.Description: The Threshing follows a young couple as they enter the world of regenerative farming. When they first arrive they revel in the bucolic bliss of their new mountainside home, but soon fall into the farm’s more sinister practices, descending from ritualistic animal slaughter to self-mutilation and cannibalism.

Entries.Title: DeBarge
Entries.Description: A portrait of the DeBarge family’s rise to fame, focusing on youngest sibling James—Janet Jackson’s first husband.

Entries.Title: Trompe L'oeil
Entries.Description: A young man with a clothing fetish pursues the dress of his dreams...

Entries.Title: Thoughts and Prayers
Entries.Description: Two host speaking to their podcast audience while a dark secret is yet to be revealed.

Entries.Title: 23rd Street: Back for Blood
Entries.Description: After being released from prison, the son of a murdered mob boss returns to take over his family's criminal empire and hunt down those responsible for his father's death.

Entries.Title: Amityville La Llorona
Entries.Description: A married couple, reeling from loss, are thrust into a nightmarish situation when a demonic entity invades their guesthouse.

Entries.Title: Jack Stryker
Entries.Description: Jack Stryker has been on the job for over 17 years, Along the way for an investigation towards arms dealer Bryan Bridgers he must confront his past, his future and who he is as a man and how his choices have lead him to become the man he is

Entries.Title: My Rookie Secret Agent Lover
Entries.Description: Rookie agent Ryan investigates CEO Vincent, accidentally kisses him, and accepts his proposal. Working undercover at Vincent's company, another is thought to be Vincent's lover. As feelings deepen, Ryan's true identity surfaces.

Entries.Title: Everything's Kosher
Entries.Description: A divorced, Jewish father from Chicago, finds himself living in Germany to be with his only daughter.  He won’t abandon her like his own father did to him.  He decides to open up a Jewish Deli in a small town known for Antisemitism and was a beehive of Nazi activity during WW2.  What could go wrong???  Along the way, he attempts to reconnect with family, friends and his faith.

Entries.Title: Blue Mirror
Entries.Description: 4 months after 17 year old Luca (June Vinette) is admitted into a behavioral facility in Broward, he embarks on an interpersonal odyssey through Miami alongside his older sister Tori (Faren Humes).

Entries.Title: Through the Keyhole
Entries.Description: A locksmith and a bum locked inside a church unlock an unlikely connection. Is God on their side? Who knows, but the church definitely isn't.  This film was created for the Detroit 48 2025.

Entries.Title: Down to the Felt
Entries.Description: In Columbus Ohio, Paul, a chronic gambler, and David, a haunted hitman, make a pact for Paul’s scheduled death in two weeks. However, once Paul begins to find something to live for, he begins to have second thoughts.

Entries.Title: The Ladder
Entries.Description: In the twilight of his life, an aging Alaskan fisherman contemplates restarting his life with the help of a mysterious scientific procedure.

Entries.Title: Breaking Into Beautiful
Entries.Description: The extraordinary story of Kim White as she faces a rare, aggressive cancer with unshakable courage. Through interviews, raw social media footage, and reflections from loved ones, the film captures her journey from despair to hope. Despite countless surgeries and setbacks, Kim’s faith in God, love for her family, and ability to find beauty in life’s messiest moments redefine perseverance. Her story is a powerful testament to gratitude, growth, and the enduring human spirit.

Entries.Title: Hey, Missy!
Entries.Description: Missy has a unique kink... luring men into a false sense of sexual bliss before brutally murdering them. She aims to rid herself of this disease, but when her past acts come back to haunt her, she’s forced to face her demons head-on.

Entries.Title: Good To See You
Entries.Description: Good To See You is a feature film about two people who recognize each other in Central Park —but can’t quite place how.

Entries.Title: Hats Off!
Entries.Description: Chris decides to switch up his style, but it comes with severe consequences.

Entries.Title: Ataraxia
Entries.Description: After a devastating freak storm, mutant bodies and other aberrations emerge from the floodwaters. This is the footage compiled from the disaster site...

Entries.Title: Fragments on Resistance
Entries.Description: Pavla and Levan meet in Sarajevo, documenting their journeys through photos and videos. After political unrest intensifies simultaneously in Serbia and Georgia, their reality begins to shift. Through reconstructed messages, we follow their journey from hope to uncertainty. Now, armed with cameras, they depict fragments of resistance, capturing a world in turmoil around them.

Entries.Title: I
Entries.Description: Surrounded by trees, a man’s craft unfolds in silence. The forest becomes both workshop and witness.

Entries.Title: The Relic
Entries.Description: A grieving mother begins to believe that her dead son is trying to contact her. She arranges a seance that accidentally unleashes evil forces into her home.

Entries.Title: Ron Holland: The Voyage of Discovery
Entries.Description: Explores the incredible life and career of legendary sailor and boat designer. It takes viewers on a journey through Ron’s life, from his difficult childhood in New Zealand to his early days as a sailor and his groundbreaking work as a yacht designer. Ron’s love of sailing and his natural talent for understanding the forces of wind, water, and shape led him to create some of the most innovative and successful yachts in the world, designe boats that have changed the face of sailing and helped usher in a new era of yacht design.

Entries.Title: Justice: The Movie
Entries.Description: Attorney Harry Franklin takes on the case of a man he's convinced is wrongfully accused of murder.

Entries.Title: Spell Defeat
Entries.Description: A resentful high school senior attempts to magically curse her academic rival in order to get a superior score on her SATs.

Entries.Title: Manikin
Entries.Description: Lola, a woman consumed by loneliness after losing everyone in her life, finds solace in reliving Christmas morning every day with her mannequin son, Leo. Trapped in a cycle of nostalgia and grief, Lola clings to the illusion of a perfect family moment, even as reality slips further away.

Entries.Title: Blue Monday
Entries.Description: Louise flees her apartment believing she is being pursued for suspicious activity after witnessing the announcement of a new, AI driven, crime prevention program.

Entries.Title: Bench Seats
Entries.Description: When an argument with her wife lands Dani at an emotional crossroads, she reflects on her memories of one transformational summer.

Entries.Title: The Courage to Suffer
Entries.Description: A surreal event makes Bloke's head spin. A man's courage, masculinity and suffering come into question in this bizarre tale, one that can only be told with a side of mash and a cold beer.

Entries.Title: The Movie Theater
Entries.Description: A normal day at the movies.

Entries.Title: Moving Day
Entries.Description: On the night before he and his mother move, Logan struggles to reconcile his relationship with his father as they attempt to watch a movie.

Entries.Title: the last thing he eats is himself
Entries.Description: super 8 and 16mm experimental horror

Entries.Title: All Us Animals
Entries.Description: At the dawn of a new decade, New Year's Eve 1959, the unexpected arrival of a childhood friend brings simmering marital tensions to a boiling point.

Entries.Title: Windward
Entries.Description: Filmed on Fogo Island, Windward unfolds across the landscape—its distinctive geological formations, climate, and austere beauty—through delicate portrayals of youth.

Entries.Title: Evicted
Entries.Description: When first-time landlord Maurice finds himself financially devastated after being legally barred from collecting rent during the respiratory pandemic “VID-219” quarantine, he and his childhood friends, Cody and Sincere take matters into their own hands. Together, they create “Evicted” — a secretive dark web app offering unconventional eviction services to desperate landlords. This dark comedy explores the unexpected consequences of pandemic housing policies while delivering laughs through its increasingly wild eviction schemes and the cat-and-mouse game between tenants and the amateur eviction crew.

Entries.Title: My Man
Entries.Description: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with the charming Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession. When Trina crosses a line, she becomes the target of a deadly game of cat and mouse. Betrayal, madness, and murder ensue as the lines between love, obsession, and survival blur.

Entries.Title: Video Barn
Entries.Description: In the small town of Kennedy, best friends Hannah and Julie spend their summer nights at the last video store, Video Barn, watching cult horror films. Jules finds a mysterious VHS tape labeled “Just press play!” and, days later, vanishes. Overcome with guilt, Hannah watches the tape and is horrified to see Jules trapped inside the TV, caught in a nightmarish loop of twisted nostalgia. Now, Hannah must uncover the truth and face the sinister force within the tape. "Video Barn" pays homage to 80s surrealist films, blending dark humor, friendship, and the pull of the unknown. Will Hannah save Jules or share her fate?

Entries.Title: You Can Go Home Whenever You Want
Entries.Description: A spate of local disappearances. A hill that may (or may not) be a conduit to the next life. A recluse, living off the grid, who hasn't been seen for years—until one of his high school bandmates shows up with a birthday cake.

Entries.Title: Before The Spotlight
Entries.Description: Behind every electrifying performance lies a story of sacrifice and passion. Before the Spotlight journeys behind the scenes of the dynamic Dauntless Movement Crew, diving into the lives of three of its standout members, Sienna, Chris and Manu. In a tough industry defined by fierce competition, fleeting opportunities and constant audition cycles, these performers are faced with uncertainty. To challenge them further, the risk of financial instability is significant in a high demanding economy. Yet, their passion grows stronger, fuelled by the support from the community. But what makes the risk worth it?

Entries.Title: Loveline
Entries.Description: The desire to be loved pulls four strangers through newspaper ads, drugs, and daytime television, as they place their fate in the power of “Loveline.”

Entries.Title: Izha
Entries.Description: Drama film about a sensitive topic.

Entries.Title: Seperation Station
Entries.Description: a young woman navigates her way through a wonderland-esque suburbia, coming across a number of quirky characters as she attempts to find her way back to the station.

Entries.Title: Her Night
Entries.Description: A deluded dance instructor drugs his troupe on the night of their final show, claiming the world will end at dawn. As the performance descends into a nightmarish hallucination, one dancer confronts buried trauma and the cult unravelling around her.

Entries.Title: The Hag
Entries.Description: A man on his nightly jog gets the uneasy feeling he isn't alone tonight.

Entries.Title: try again.
Entries.Description: Every setback is just a pause, not the end. Reset, refocus, and try again. Trust me, its worth it.

Entries.Title: Crazy Love
Entries.Description: A serial killer love story.

Entries.Title: Doing Business at the End of the World
Entries.Description: A guy named Cookie travels cross-country with a business proposition for his friend.

Entries.Title: Curtain Call
Entries.Description: An aspiring actor, after years of rejection, hangs his future in the balance in a set of auditions that could change his life.

Entries.Title: BB
Entries.Description: A man remembers blockbuster video before it closed down, forever.

Entries.Title: Faceless
Entries.Description: In the style of classic ‘80s horror/slasher films.

Entries.Title: The Last Breath of War
Entries.Description: From empire to ashes-Japan's rise, war, and reckoning. A gripping journey through ambition, conflict, and the cost of a nation's destiny.

Entries.Title: untitled minneapolis project
Entries.Description: A homeless man living in a encampment in Minneapolis tells his perspective on the ongoing crisis of homelessness.

Entries.Title: A Picture of Unhealth
Entries.Description: An upcoming psychological horror film, written by David Sark, wherein strange visions and harsh realities are discovered.

Entries.Title: PIEOWA: A Piece of America
Entries.Description: PIEOWA: A PIECE OF AMERICA celebrates the myriad ways pie is woven into Iowa’s culture, the lengths people will go to for a slice, and how this humble pastry can bake the world a better place.

Entries.Title: Luli & Goni Lemes
Entries.Description: The comedy road trip follows Goni and his mother Lemja, as they return from England to find a traditional Albanian bride. Their plans are hilariously disrupted by Luli, a naive character who unintentionally complicates their journey.

Entries.Title: Bandi-Man
Entries.Description: An overly obsessed comic book nerd is at odds with who he loves more: His girlfriend or BANDI-MAN

Entries.Title: Forest spirit
Entries.Description: Master Hughes shares evidence found thru years of Bigfoot expeditions all of it real. His expeditions to arkansas and Oklahoma may have proven Bigfoot exists.

Entries.Title: Looking For My Anchor
Entries.Description: Looking For My Anchor follows filmmaker Erica Jordan as she navigates her journey through grief after the loss of her mother, eviction from her home, the end of a long-term relationship, and her son leaving for college. Living aboard a small boat in a working-class maritime community on the edge of Marin county, she uses personal video journals and home movies to revisit moments of motherhood, loss, and longing, while confronting the uncertainty of life on the water. Her story intersects with the lives of three people living anchored out on the San Francisco Bay – the wise, self-described “anchor outlaw” battling health issues while struggling to maintain his boat; the young advocate fighting to save her community from displacement; and the artist whose untimely death underscores the fragility of their existence.

Entries.Title: Red Clay
Entries.Description: In early 2000s Atlanta, Nook struggles to define a future for himself, aside from the world perpetuated by his mother's addiction.

Entries.Title: Bros
Entries.Description: The bond between best friends Adam and Jake is put to the test when Adam makes a startling discovery...

Entries.Title: 8 Portraits, Scenarios: Death of Reality, Fiction, Truth & Lies
Entries.Description: A director attempting to create an unconditionally truthful film becomes obsessed with the topic of death. In an intrusive way he relentlessly pushes dark scenarios of death aimed at his portraitures, creating a tension ridden and emotional set, blurring the lines of experimental docu-fiction drama.

Entries.Title: Always Looking: Titus Brooks Heagins
Entries.Description: Always Looking explores the work of photographer Titus Brooks Heagins and the challenging questions his photos pose about the systemic neglect of society’s most vulnerable communities of color. Humanizing yet confrontational, Titus’ photographs document the overlooked: people who, through some intersection of poverty, race or gender/sexual identity, exist as outsiders.

Entries.Title: Red Storm Rising: The Struggle for the American Communist Party
Entries.Description: Red Storm Rising” looks at the rise and fall of the American Communist Party, examining its political context, its leadership, its appeal to the American public, and why it never became mainstream.

Entries.Title: No Service
Entries.Description: Pharaohplex Productions is excited to unveil "No Service," an exhilarating time travel adventure currently being shot entirely in the charming towns of Hamilton and Corvallis, Montana. This film will follow a young girl from the future who will find herself unexpectedly transported to the 1990s in a quaint town. With a storyline that blends futuristic thrills with nostalgic small-town life, "No Service" features the vibrant involvement of local community members who are helping bring this Montana-made masterpiece to life. Prepare to be captivated by a unique blend of past and future—"No Service" coming soon.

Entries.Title: ILL
Entries.Description: A girl battles a mysterious illness as green slime pours from her, desperately fleeing from doctors. Is it a mental struggle, or is the danger real?

Entries.Title: Short Life, Long Death: The Making and Un-Making of On The Silver Globe
Entries.Description: An exclusive talking head documentary about the film's production discusses how each aspect of the film was made and eventually halted.

Entries.Title: Sama Bella
Entries.Description: In diaspora, Bella, a Sama Bajau indigenous sea nomad transgender woman, reclaims her identity, livelihood, and mobility.

Entries.Title: Heaven Can't Hold Me
Entries.Description: A young and impassioned artist struggles to maintain her humility amid lofty dreams, encroaching deadlines, and a turbulent relationship.

Entries.Title: The TV Program
Entries.Description: At a prestigious film school where Film majors get all the glory, a scrappy group of underdog TV students fight to keep their production alive despite a nonexistent budget, a tyrannical dean, and their own chaotic dysfunction.

Entries.Title: Red April
Entries.Description: In 1876 Bulgaria, a desperate revolutionary must convince a room of suspecting Ottoman soldiers that he is innocent. Based on the history of the April Uprising -- a struggle for independence between Bulgaria and the immense Ottoman Empire.

Entries.Title: Runaway
Entries.Description: On the run, two bank robbers try to improvise their way out of a rock and a hard place.

Entries.Title: AFTERWORLD
Entries.Description: In a dystopian future where human genetics have evolved, a new breed of individuals—Variants—possess extraordinary abilities. However, the world’s leaders deem them a threat, unleashing an elite militia known as the Dark Hunters to hunt them down. Amidst this chaos, two sisters, Eve and Mia Levison, find themselves at the center of a brutal war for survival.  Captured by the ruthless Grand Huntress, Eve is held prisoner while Mia, a powerful Variant, launches a daring assault to rescue her. As Mia fights her way through the heavily fortified Sector Thirteen, Eve struggles against her captors, discovering the deep-seated hatred fueling Cleo’s crusade.

Entries.Title: Wrong Address
Entries.Description: Charleston White must come up with past due rent while being investigated by local detectives in Dallas.

Entries.Title: Unofficial Skyrim Patch | Down the Rabbit Hole
Entries.Description: When a group of modders band together to create the ultimate bug fixing patch for Skyrim, the popularity of the project draws scrutiny and backlash that only grows as time passes.

Entries.Title: Amethyst Window
Entries.Description: Through a plastic bottle of cleaner on the windowsill. Ambient sound.

Entries.Title: Dean's Last Ride
Entries.Description: A veteran Taxi driver struggles to find passengers in San Francisco and wages a spiritual war against his new self driving competitor, Waymo.

Entries.Title: Elephant
Entries.Description: When a guileless young man meets his girlfriend’s stoic father to ask for her hand in marriage, his attempt to honour cultural traditions goes awry.

Entries.Title: Avenged Sevenquads: Revenge of Hue Sevenfold
Entries.Description: Heavy metal band Avenged Sevenfold must reunite their quadbike based team to defeat their arch nemesis, Hue Sevenfold

Entries.Title: GAMBOA
Entries.Description: What are you willing to do to get back those you love?  Gamboa, a young man who has been a drug dealer for a long time, is determined to leave that life behind and win back his family’s trust. After settling his debt with his boss, he tries to negotiate his way out. But his boss won’t let him go so easily. One last job stands in his way, forcing him to risk his conscience in exchange for a chance at freedom.

Entries.Title: The Puppeteers
Entries.Description: The Puppeteers is inspired by real events, exposing the hidden world of transnational repression. What we see today is likely just the tip of the iceberg.

Entries.Title: Gettysburg
Entries.Description: A family melodrama wrapped up in an absurdist comedy punctuated by an American history lesson. Gettysburg is the simple story of a man who hates his grandma.

Entries.Title: It Doesn’t Get Any Better Than This
Entries.Description: This found footage horror film blends fact and fiction from nearly 20 years of archival video. Following a decades-long fascination with the horror genre, a married couple buys an abandoned duplex to use as a location for filming their low-budget scary movie. They soon notice that random strangers are drawn to the old building, but never approach it, merely standing outside and staring at it in a sort of trance. Delighted to find themselves embroiled in a real-life scary story, the two team up with an old friend and put their years of horror expertise, amateur ghost hunting, and paranormal obsession to use in the hope of discovering why this building holds such a strange power over people.

Entries.Title: Rat Boys
Entries.Description: Two miscreants set out for one last heist in order to avenge their friend in a stylistic, cartoonish burglary on the "Big Boss."

Entries.Title: HELP
Entries.Description: A man in need of help eventually receives it, whether he asks for it or not.

Entries.Title: 76 Days Adrift
Entries.Description: Steven Callahan gives a gripping first-hand account of his NYT bestselling novel "Adrift: 76 Days Lost At Sea." On the eve of February 4, 1982, in the middle of the night there was a loud boom as a whale collided with Steven's boat. Within minutes, his small craft was flooded with a rush of water. He grabbed what he could, heaved his life raft into the ocean, and snatched his emergency kit. Without food or water, for an incredible 76 days the inflatable raft was his home as he drifted across the entire Atlantic Ocean. Forced to come to terms with his own shortcomings and limitations, Steven finds a strength he never knew he had. This official documentary, executive produced by Callahan, brings the story to life with found 8MM footage, original stills of the time of the voyage, and first-person recreation. Still possessing many of the original artifacts, he takes us step-by-step through his harrowing and life-altering adventure.

Entries.Title: The Healing Animal
Entries.Description: A documentary about animal-assisted psychotherapy and the process of gender transition. The client we follow is Charlee, a 25-year-old transgender college student who moved to Colorado to escape gender persecution and seek legal rights to gender marker and name change as well as gender reassignment surgeries. The Healing Animal is unique in that it combines several topics into one story: actual psychotherapy sessions filmed over the course of a year, the legal, physical and emotional process of gender transition, LGBTQIA+ rights, and exploring the science behind animal-assisted psychotherapy.

Entries.Title: Sarah
Entries.Description: Chris Townsend spends his morning preparing for a meeting with his boss that could change everything. Wrestling with confidence and doubt, he rehearses his pitch again and again, searching for the words that will prove his worth. As the video call begins, Chris must finally confront what truly matters, challenging not just his ambition, but his sense of self.

Entries.Title: Drainage
Entries.Description: Don’t Forget To Clean The Pipes!! A Short Horror Film directed by Ronan Bird, as a homework piece for his Media Studies A-level Class.

Entries.Title: PFL 5: 2025 World Tournament Semifinals
Entries.Description: PFL 5: 2025 World Tournament Semifinals was a mixed martial arts event that took place on Thursday, June 12, 2025 at the Nashville Municipal Auditorium in Nashville, Tennessee.

Entries.Title: Black Castles
Entries.Description: Two years ago, Nissa Arnson's infallible interpretation of the future was challenged for the first time, and she spared a man's life. Now she investigates a new adversary with fewer Rooks and far more to lose, while Will Augustine fears for his future and struggles to maintain his integrity as an Alterer. As their paths cross again, long-hidden and terrifying secrets begin to come to light.

Entries.Title: Into the Jungle
Entries.Description: Amid ruins consumed by the jungle, a young woman awakens—memoryless, with no way out. As she drifts through a fractured sense of time, she stumbles upon a helpless infant. She nurtures it. She protects it.  But in the jungle, nothing is linear. When she wakes again, the infant is already a man. He calls her “mother,” yet his gaze suggests something else. Their bond grows ambiguous, disturbing.  As shadows and traces of other women surface from the landscape, she realizes the being she raised has become her threat. Confronted with this presence, she must make a visceral choice: sacrifice herself or break the cycle. The jungle demands no explanations—only decisions.

Entries.Title: Elk Country
Entries.Description: Unveil the untamed beauty and captivating stories of Pennsylvania's Elk in a cinematic journey through the state's wild heart.

Entries.Title: Final Conclusion
Entries.Description: After the death of gamer Matt Newman, a dark crime unravels throughout San Bernadino County-- that only one man can solve.

Entries.Title: More Beautiful Perversions
Entries.Description: It's good to get lost...

Entries.Title: Phantom Limb
Entries.Description: A recent amputee's desperation for autonomy over her own body takes a dark turn during an LSD trip with her boyfriend, resulting in a shocking act of violence that exposes the raw intersection of physical and emotional trauma.

Entries.Title: Deviation
Entries.Description: Give them pleasure. The same pleasure they have when they wake up from a nightmare.

Entries.Title: A Haunting Underground
Entries.Description: Some kids get lost in a tunnel underground and come across an entity.

Entries.Title: An Unquiet Mind
Entries.Description: Many people assume obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) revolves around excessive hand-washing, perfectionism, and flipping light switches. This simplified description barely skims the surface of this disorder. An Unquiet Mind sheds light on a sinister side of OCD that many sufferers are too afraid to speak about.

Entries.Title: Chad Daniels: For Reels
Entries.Description: Chad Daniels sixth stand up special.

Entries.Title: Fragments Destiny
Entries.Description: Hero, Midway through his search for the archetypal fragments occupying this fantasticaly impossible world is approached by The Lover, with a desire that intrigues Hero. The two follow the Lover's lead until they discover the fabeled Magician, known only as "Spades". With this discovery, their understanding of their world, their conections, their memories and their selves are not just questioned, but almost destroyed.

Entries.Title: The Bosses
Entries.Description: Mafia grunt Hubert is tasked with assassinating a rival boss. However, fate intervenes...

Entries.Title: G!
Entries.Description: When a talented pisonet gamer is scouted for an esports tournament, he must convince his disapproving father that his passion could pave the way to a brighter future.

Entries.Title: American Comic
Entries.Description: American Comic is a fake documentary that follows two up-and-coming stand-ups, who, despite being from opposite sides of the comedy cultural divide, are nearly identical in their shittiness.

Entries.Title: The McKinney Family Home Videos Volume 2
Entries.Description: Another tape is uncovered documenting the inner workings of The Church of the Holy Mother, it's leader Diana, and their God head Lilith.

Entries.Title: Derby
Entries.Description: In Derby, Kansas, summer is coming to an end, and nine-year old Percy is confronted with the harsh reality of his mother’s addiction.

Entries.Title: Death by Execution
Entries.Description: A confession, a consequence, and a severe lack of interest.

Entries.Title: The Bad Date
Entries.Description: She wants more than friends.

Entries.Title: Blood in the Snow
Entries.Description: The year is 2005. Three high school boys, Wilhelm, Pluto, and Josh, embark on an expedition to capture video evidence of an urban legend. After lying, manipulating, and using them, Wilhelm pushes his friends too far and faces extreme consequences.

Entries.Title: Colors of the Sky's End
Entries.Description: A Vietnamese-American photographer seeking inspiration in Sa Dec, Vietnam discovers an abandoned baby, sparking a controversial creative journey that threatens her relationship and tests her moral and creative boundaries as she prepares for her next exhibition.

Entries.Title: Neverwhen
Entries.Description: As a young lady prepares to leave behind her childhood home, a playful and enigmatic elf from her past invites her into a nostalgic game of hide and seek.

Entries.Title: Pudar
Entries.Description: In his monotonous daily routine, Anka, an ordinary office employee, is crushed by a series of problems. His days started the same way: waking up, brushing his teeth, sipping bitter coffee, then being scolded by his boss at the office. His personal life is no less bleak—his relationship has failed and his father is in critical condition. The feeling of disappointment continued to pile up, making him feel like the world was hostile to him. In the midst of the destruction, Anka was haunted by pain that never subsided. When everything felt hopeless, he sank into the darkest despair.

Entries.Title: I Spent 24 Hours At The Singapore Airport
Entries.Description: HELLO FRIENDS and welcome to another video!! Have you ever gotten stranded at the airport for extended layover and thought - wow this is really the **worst**? Well, it happens to us all the time. But we have been hearing for years about how amazing the Changi Airport in Singapore is, so while we were visiting Singapore and Malaysia this past summer, we had to go check it out and put it to a thorough 24 hour test - to see if it’s really worth all the hype.

Entries.Title: The Greatest Thing Ever: A Garden Cartoon Movie
Entries.Description: Embark on an enchanting journey with Lenny Lion and Lucy Lamb in their first-ever movie as they explore the vast Garden in search of "The Greatest Thing Ever!" There's just one catch The Boss never revealed what this treasure is! Could it be hidden treasure, a royal crown, cosmic adventures, or prehistoric wonders?

Entries.Title: RIWAJ
Entries.Description: Riwaj is a powerful and thought-provoking drama that highlights the struggles of women caught in the grip of oppressive traditions. At its core is Zainab (Myraa Sareen), a courageous woman who refuses to be a victim of triple talaq. Stripped of her dignity and abandoned by the law, she is left to fend for herself in a society that seeks to silence her. But instead of succumbing to despair, she rises-challenging deep-rooted injustices and fighting for her rights, freedom, and identity.

Entries.Title: 60th Annual Academy of Country Music Awards
Entries.Description: The 60th Annual Academy of Country Music Awards will be hosted by Reba McEntire on Thursday, May 8, 2025. The awards ceremony will take place at the Ford Center at The Star in Frisco, Texas

Entries.Title: Gage
Entries.Description: Gage's vigor for ministry grows sour after a series of demoralizing events reveal the truth about the organization he once held dear. What will he do when he is given the power to end it all?

Entries.Title: A fully furnished house is always easier to deal with... right?
Entries.Description: An accountant buys a house and becomes obsessed with purchasing the perfect boat.

Entries.Title: Whale the Moon
Entries.Description: A short film about an insomniac astrophysicist who tries to solve an earth-shattering event, but ends up confronting herself.

Entries.Title: Le Sault
Entries.Description: Through photographs, the director's grandmother recalls her childhood memories of a place: Le Sault. She spent all her vacations there and now lives there. The timeless essence of this place is charged with emotion and history. Still childhood memories give way to vivid shots, as if past and present come together to celebrate the permanence of beloved places. This little movie is a witness to the passage of time.

Entries.Title: TMZ Investigates: Liam Payne: Who's to Blame?
Entries.Description: TMZ is on the ground in Argentina to investigate Liam Payne's tragic fall from a balcony and why the incident is not what it seems.

Entries.Title: Backside
Entries.Description: Over the span of one racing season, the strikingly intimate Backside foregrounds the lives and actions of immigrant workers who look after prized racehorses at Churchill Downs barns in Louisville Kentucky — the site of the famous Kentucky Derby.

Entries.Title: Oculus
Entries.Description: Oculus is an experimental short film reframing mental illness through and escape room of the mind.

Entries.Title: HUFF
Entries.Description: A desperate man spirals into a chase to recover his stolen fix, stumbling into an office world filled with scrutiny, uniformity, and oppressive compulsions.

Entries.Title: The Dancer
Entries.Description: For Ahmad Joudeh, a stateless refugee from Syria, dance is not a choice, it’s a lifeline – etched onto his very skin with the words “Dance or Die.” Having defied war and family disapproval to join the Dutch National Ballet, Ahmad found sanctuary in the Netherlands, becoming a UNHCR and LGBTQI+ Ambassador. But haunted by the trauma of his past, he makes a perilous decision: to return to Syria for the first time since the war, risking everything to bring the healing power of dance to a community still ravaged by conflict.

Entries.Title: Osa Johnson: Queen of the Jungle
Entries.Description: A mini documentary about two of the world's earliest filmmakers that were forgotten by time.

Entries.Title: The Injustice of Justice
Entries.Description: Keith LaMar, a wrongfully-convicted Black man in The United States, teams up with world-renowned artist Molly Crabapple to share the story of how he was framed and sentenced to death following the Lucasville Prison Uprising at the Southern Ohio Correctional Facility in 1993. Keith has been fighting for his liberation from solitary confinement, where he has been held for over 30 years! Scheduled to be executed on January 13, 2027. Keith and his supporters intend to stop Ohio officials.

Entries.Title: Solstice - 5: Forgotten Archives
Entries.Description: What you are about to see, are the last remnants of the once-secret archives surrounding Solstice-5.

Entries.Title: Max Payne: Perdition
Entries.Description: Max Payne, a former NYPD detective, has avenged his loved ones but now struggles with suicidal thoughts and alcoholism. Hunted by a mysterious figure from his past, Payne has only one night to come to terms with his past and himself.

Entries.Title: Ryder Stone
Entries.Description: Ryder Stone is a secret agent with a simple retrieval mission that spirals into chaos.

Entries.Title: Janus
Entries.Description: A pizza delivery guy is invited into a stranger's house towards the end of New Year's Eve.

Entries.Title: Diamond Diplomacy
Entries.Description: Long considered America’s official pastime, ever since baseball was introduced to Japan in the late 19th century, the sport has become a mutual obsession between the two nations. A key factor in bridging the cultural gap between East and West, baseball has also been used as a way to combat anti-Japanese prejudices in the US from WWII to the present day. Documentarian Yuriko Gamo Romer (Mrs. Judo: Be Strong, Be Gentle, Be Beautiful) traces the long, shared history behind our mutual love of the old ballgame, from Japan’s embrace of Black players in the 1930s to Babe Ruth, Lou Gehrig, and their fellow all-stars playing exhibition games overseas to the era of contemporary MLB heavy hitters like Ichiro Suzuki, Hideo Nomo, and (of course) Shohei Ohtani. Diamond Diplomacy is a fascinating and definitive look at how nine innings changed the way two countries communicate across a great divide. Play ball!

Entries.Title: Nostalgia Is A Minds Trick
Entries.Description: Uncovering a time capsule reveals how we over romanticize our past

Entries.Title: Polk: The Trial Of Philip Polkinghorne
Entries.Description: Polk: The Trial of Philip Polkinghorne explores the case of a prominent New Zealand eye surgeon accused of the murder of his wife, Pauline Hanna.

Entries.Title: Best Of Joy
Entries.Description: Michael Jackson, a young and struggling singer, feels overshadowed by the world’s obsession with fame and perfection. When a masked supervillain named Spotlight and his twisted father, Gary Mayor, form the Spotlight Seven to terrorize Los Angeles, Michael must rise beyond his insecurities to stop them. Along the way, he gains unlikely allies: Brad, his witty and stoic bodyguard; Samantha Carpenter, his love interest;  and Goku, a misguided martial arts master. Together, they face trials, betrayals, and epic musical showdowns.  The journey culminates in a spectacular showdown against the Spotlight Seven, forcing Michael to prove that being a true star isn’t about the spotlight—it’s about the joy you bring to others.

Entries.Title: My Friend, Chevy
Entries.Description: When Chevy invites his friend Amber, a girl, over for guys' weekend, BJ is confused.

Entries.Title: Found In Translation: Local Shorts
Entries.Description: Translation is an imaginative process that shapes meaning and expands perception. As values, experiences, and aspirations are shared through cultural and geographical space, new opportunities to understand our present and our future emerge. As of 2019, around 2 million immigrants from Africa were living in the United States — a number that has tripled since 2000. African immigrants account for around 30,000 people across the state of Iowa and the city of Cedar Rapids, in particular, is a hotspot for immigration.  The ISLE storytellers documented families living in the Cedar Rapids, Iowa area who emigrated from multiple countries in Africa. In doing so, the storytellers discovered three key themes: family, faith and farming. From forging connections with religious communities in the area to establishing farming practices to fill a produce gap for African immigrants, these families have played a hand in irrevocably shaping Iowa’s culture.
A guy finds an unusual poster being handed out by a poster guy. Will he make the thing that it says on the poster his new year's resolution that it says?

Entries.Title: Air Jaws: The Hunt for Colossus
Entries.Description: A 20-foot great white breaches in New Zealand, launching a hunt for Colossus—the legendary high-flying shark that may lead to a hidden colony of great whites.

Entries.Title: Unraveled: The Kaitlyn Howard Story
Entries.Description: A deep dive into the creative mind of University of South Carolina student fashion designer, Kaitlyn Howard.

Entries.Title: Behind the Paint: The Story of Slaughtered Goat
Entries.Description: Retrieved from archival footage, this documentary details the most tumultuous moments in the history of the infamous metal band 'Slaughtered Goat'...

Entries.Title: The Mirage: Timothy Olson’s Race Against Time
Entries.Description: Ultra runner, Timothy Olson, aims to break the fastest known time on the Pacific Crest Trail. Braving record high temperatures and impending wildfires, he must outrun nature and reach the finish line before the birth of his daughter. Supported by his wife and kids, Olson has to average over 50 miles a day for 50 consecutive days.

Entries.Title: Rotten Apple
Entries.Description: After a heist goes completely wrong, the remaining crew members barge into a suburban home trying to figure out a way to escape from the growing police force outside, whilst trying to discover and eliminate the police mole among their ranks.

Entries.Title: The Dalai Lama's Gift
Entries.Description: In 1981, a Buddhist monk teaching at the University of Madison, Wisconsin, made the bold request of the Dalai Lama to come and perform a rare ritual, never before done outside of India or Tibet: the Kalachakra, among the highest of the Buddhist tantric teachings. In just a few months, with a team of dedicated students, and cameras rolling, they constructed a temple and organized an event for over a thousand spiritual seekers, in a cornfield outside Madison.  The incredible footage was tucked away in the Smithsonian vaults, until now. What unfolds is the story of a powerful ritual, its impact on the people that made it happen, and the meaning behind this ancient initiation.

Entries.Title: Key Lime
Entries.Description: After losing her job as a barista, Roni sets out to reinvent herself by starting a smoothie business. She recruits her well-meaning but clueless friends, Brett and Jared, to help make her dream a reality. But their ambitions spiral out of control when the trio stumbles upon the legendary Mr. Lime Cereal recipe. What begins as a simple venture quickly turns sour, leading to a tangled web of shady deals and moral compromises.

Entries.Title: They lost Ayodhya for a pack of Lights
Entries.Description: History repeats itself. Om and Subayya are beyond reconcile, as their maddened autocratic ways are obstructed by a group of rebels they are left to decide on how they want to solve this problem, leading to a tragic recreation of the past.

Entries.Title: Dendam Dalam Dosa
Entries.Description: In a village full of intrigue, the loveless marriage between Sofie, an Indo-Dutch woman, and Raden Sasmita, a rich, much older man, triggers a series of tragedies. Sofie loves Awang, but he is caught in a power play centered on a pendant inherited from his ancestors, which is believed to have supernatural powers. When his plan to poison Sasmita failed, he died mysteriously. Sofie's spirit returns through jelangkung, uncovers dark secrets and seeks revenge. In a supernatural battle, Ki Barlan faces Sasmita, Subrata, Nyi Gandasari, and Nyai Ratu Kerincing Wesi, ending the curse that haunts the village.

Entries.Title: Social Justice Jihadi
Entries.Description: 99 minute comedy special from Sammy Obeid's Ceasefire Tour of 2024. A ceasefire was called 10 days after filming it. Yes, he was responsible

Entries.Title: INERTIA
Entries.Description: A young man takes his grandfather with dementia for a final ride before putting him to rest – though he doesn't seem to be able to put the day to an end.

Entries.Title: The Streak
Entries.Description: In 1987, a team of outsiders attempt to break a hallowed baseball record in a desperate bid  for fame, fortune, and careers in the major leagues. Even if they succeed, no athlete can  play forever — and what comes after the death of a dream?

Entries.Title: Pas de Deux
Entries.Description: An ambitious ballerina resorts to sabotage when her best friend’s effortless success plunders her earned perfection.

Entries.Title: A Breath Away from My Unmet Husband
Entries.Description: Eller got flash-married to a billionaire he had never met, but he finds his new boss Lyon irresistible. Chemistry sparks between them, completely unaware they've been married to each other all along.

Entries.Title: Disposal
Entries.Description: On the eve of his proposal, a man must retrieve an engagement ring from the garbage disposal.

Entries.Title: Real Life
Entries.Description: A young filmmaker driven by nostalgia struggles to capture the reality of his life without losing himself in the process.

Entries.Title: The CEO's Wife Stole Her Life
Entries.Description: A struggling single mother unexpectedly lands a job at a luxury hotel, where she crosses paths with a powerful CEO - unaware that he is the man she had a one-night stand with nine years ago and the father of her son. As secrets, mistaken identities, and ruthless ambition threaten to tear them apart, she must fight to reclaim her life and her rightful place by his side.

Entries.Title: Coney Island Cousins
Entries.Description: Two distant cousins meet in Coney Island for a night out, but their moment is interrupted when they encounter a dead body with deep pockets which will forever change their lives.

Entries.Title: Lord Help My Poor Soul
Entries.Description: When nearing the end of his battle with cancer, a deformed man experiments with LSD in search of enlightenment. The resulting trip takes him on a harrowing descent into an acid-drenched hell.

Entries.Description: A sequel to the Short Film Ahai

Entries.Description: Mayaboti is a Romantic Drama. Acted By bangladeshi besh romantic drama actor Farhan Ahmed Jovan and Naznin Niha

Entries.Title: Dreams of a Southern Journey
Entries.Description: A woman travels away from her hometown to discover old memories and dreams.

Entries.Title: Falkner und die Linie im Sand
Entries.Description: He framed his predecessor, took over his company, and now delivers a fittingly humble speech at the 70th anniversary celebration. Everything's going perfectly for Paul Oberberger. Except for his employee Viktoria, who just won't give up and is looking for evidence against him.

Entries.Title: Michael Schenker: My Years With Ufo Wacken Open Air
Entries.Description: Michael Schenker is regarded as one of the greatest guitarists in hard rock. A virtuoso who, back in the 1970s, wrote anthems with the Scorpions and later with UFO that still resonate today. His melodic solos, unmistakable sound, and knack for big hooks made songs like Doctor Doctor, Rock Bottom, and Lights Out immortal. With the program My Years With UFO, Schenker travels back to that era when he ignited the British band with his German fire and left a defining mark on their music. This nostalgic trip is not just about the classics, but also about the story of a young guitar genius who took the rock world by storm. At Wacken, fans can look forward to a master reliving his own legends in full brilliance.

Entries.Title: The Devil Wears Pants
Entries.Description: When a real murder disrupts the play, Dharma, the actor cast as the killer, is blamed. As he exposes his fellow actors’ hidden truths, he begins to question whether he’s the villain after all.

Entries.Title: Chronobox
Entries.Description: Sandra Bonheur enters the timeshop to buy some time. She and a Timekeeper are trying to find out available options, and that leads to unexpected fact.

Entries.Title: The Kennel
Entries.Description: Two young criminals attempt to pick up money for their boss but their night takes a turn when their debtors refuse to pay.

Entries.Title: Love192
Entries.Description: As an online roleplaying game faces shutdown, two teens decide to transcend the pixels that once held them apart.

Entries.Title: Talk Me
Entries.Description: Pedro, an outsider trapped in a passionless marriage, secretly escapes through music. When he meets Kira, another outsider who shares his yearning for true intimacy, they begin a risky conversational affair.

Entries.Title: Mr. Bizarro's Coffee Shop
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: The Price of Loyalty
Entries.Description: In the world of organized crime, loyalty is everything—but at what cost? Salvatore Briganti, the son of a powerful crime boss, is given the opportunity to prove himself and secure his place in the family. A high-stakes job puts him and his brother Peter on a dangerous path, where trust is fragile, and betrayal lurks in the shadows. As tensions rise and alliances shift, Salvatore is forced to confront the truth about his family, his legacy, and himself. In a game where every move could be his last, he must decide: is loyalty worth the price?

Entries.Title: Underpass
Entries.Description: A couple who meet at various underpasses to dance together as part of an affair, realise it has to stop.

Entries.Title: an untitled self portrait archive film
Entries.Description: an untitled self portrait archive film with footage sourced entirely from Internet Archive

Entries.Title: Mary's Lake
Entries.Description: Mary's Lake brings the thrills, chills, and over-the-top fun of a classic 1980s slasher film to life. A group of carefree camp counselors arrives at the remote Camp Palmetto, excited for a summer of sun and friendship. But their plans are quickly derailed when a dangerous escapee from a nearby mental institution begins picking them off one by one. As the body count rises, the counselors realize their attacker isn’t just a man, he’s connected to something far darker and more supernatural. Packed with bloody kills, cheesy thrills, and a whole lot of campy fun, Mary's Lake is a wild ride straight out of a VHS-era slasher, perfect for fans of nostalgic horror and those who enjoy a good, dumb, bloody good time.

Entries.Title: Let's Make It a Blockbuster Night
Entries.Description: An experimental feature film.

Entries.Title: Nuku
Entries.Description: In the vibrant fringes of Montreal, Nuku emerges as the city’s exuberant party icon. Despite being the darling of the scene, he defiantly rejects societal norms, and embraces a lifestyle frowned upon by most. Instances of his daily escapades unravel the complex web of contradictions that shape Nuku's unique philosophy on life, and challenges our own.

Entries.Title: Gateway to the Goulash
Entries.Description: A private detective and his assistant try to solve a series of killer food combinations in the city of Beloit, Wisconsin.

Entries.Title: Into the Menstrualverse
Entries.Description: A magical talking vagina helps her trans woman best friend travel back in time in order to acquire a uterus - altering the entire multiverse in the process.

Entries.Title: I Like to Play *And Have Fun
Entries.Description: Offcanny's debut film!

Entries.Title: Balenciaga 54th Couture Collection
Entries.Description: Demna's final Balenciaga couture show was a dramatic farewell—sculptural silhouettes, streetwear edge, and a surprise runway moment from Kim Kardashian in full "Balenci Barbie" pink. Set to Sade’s “No Ordinary Love,” the collection closed a decade of disruption.

Entries.Title: All Who Wander
Entries.Description: In a divided city where humans inhabit the days and vampires roam at night Jenny hates her job as a servant for the vampire upper class. When her last customers stall, she is too late to leave the city on time before sunrise. Weakened, Jenny runs for her life while the day guards chase her when Gary, a happy go lucky shop assistant, snaps her off the street in hopes to convince her to turn him into a vampire. But Jenny hates humans even more than vampires and so the meeting turns into a hilarious tug of war while Gary persuades Jenny that life as a vampire is indeed wonderful.

Entries.Title: I Wish I Were a Star
Entries.Description: A narrator muses on why they want to be a cosmic star.

Entries.Title: Muted
Entries.Description: On a lazy weekend morning, a disconnected couple finds themselves in a heated argument. When they mute the TV to continue their fight, they find they’ve not only silenced the TV, but also themselves and the entire world.

Entries.Title: The Kiss of A Vampire
Entries.Description: A whirlwind romance leads to a wedding between a fragile young woman and a dashing doctor. The fairytale turns into a nightmare when the bride learns her husband is a 1,200 vampire who reigns terror over the town in which they live.

Entries.Title: The Bittersweet Truth About Parking

Entries.Title: No Surprises
Entries.Description: A war veteran is going through his normal nightly routine, but as police sirens rush past his house, PTSD strikes. He begins reliving his past.

Entries.Title: Love Birds
Entries.Description: In 1972, married biologists George Hunt and Molly Warner make an unprecedented discovery while studying seagulls on one of California’s Channel Islands. To their surprise, a great number of the nesting pairs they observe are both female. George and Molly’s research on “lesbian seagulls” quickly triggers both outrage and jubilation\ in a nation grappling with the rise of the LGBTQ+ rights movement, even as it threatens to tear apart their own relationship.

Entries.Title: The Time of Our Lives
Entries.Description: The Time of Our Lives is a science fiction film in the style of a sitcom.  In a domestic setting, moments from the lives of the couple V Sin and Wai King unfold through sequences beyond standardized clock time and linear chronologies. Drawing from theories of quantum mechanics and general relativity, the work uproots the concept of absolute time as a means to challenge assumptions about objective truth and consensus reality. [Overview courtesy of e-flux]

Entries.Title: A Man Buys A Dog
Entries.Description: 2 or 3 parallel meditations: light brighter than memory, doors not opened, and a simmering dissatisfaction.

Entries.Title: Valentina
Entries.Description: At the busiest US-Mexico border crossing, Valentina navigates parking tickets, odd jobs, and a precarious checking account balance.

Entries.Title: Life During the War
Entries.Description: Experience the resilience, challenges, and daily struggles of British life during World War II in this captivating documentary. From the devastating Blitz to the hardships of rationing, it takes you through the emotional and physical tolls faced by ordinary people. Through personal stories and historical insights, this film explores how citizens endured unimaginable hardships, adapted to survive, and found hope amidst the uncertainty of war, all while contributing to the collective spirit that helped define a nation's courage in the darkest of times.

Entries.Title: Matter of Time
Entries.Description: Charlie Fleck, a 29-year-old aspiring video game designer, is has the opportunity of a lifetime with a time-stopping device given to him by his friend, an eccentric Toy shop owner Gibbs. Challenges ensues, and hardships arise as he navigates world, and pursue his dreams

Entries.Title: Unsaved
Entries.Description: When productive order dissolves into subtle chaos, an office worker begins to question what holds her world together.

Entries.Title: Aki
Entries.Description: Set on Atikameksheng Anishnawbek (formerly known as Whitefish Lake), this visual art documentary follows the seasons in director Darlene Naponse’s home community in Northern Ontario.

Entries.Description: A tale of a wandering girl

Entries.Title: Slice
Entries.Description: Guy is having trouble sleeping when suddenly he hears a suspicious noise in the night.

Entries.Title: Blood Brothers: Life Harvest
Entries.Description: Brothers Enoch and Aaron fight to protect their family as a deadly rabies like virus spreads across the world. When one of them is bitten by a zombie, they must ask themselves the ultimate question: Is blood thicker than water?

Entries.Title: Hey, My Friend | A Dunces Burden Musical
Entries.Description: Special Footage

Entries.Title: Loving John
Entries.Description: In this quirky film about death and dying, John Godinet, an irrepressible Pacific Islander and ultra-runner, is living with his husband Peter in rural Maryland. He’s outrun abuse and discrimination, but now he has a new adversary: ALS. Fortunately, John has a survival strategy of humor and hilarity that has served him all his life. While life is a ticking clock, and nothing is ever simple, what matters most, ultimately, is the humanity that unites us all.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Description: Suffering from writer’s block, a filmmaker struggles to meet a deadline. Convinced by her husband to use an AI source, they unearthed more than they bargain for.

Entries.Description: A futuristic depiction of what's at stake. Crafted with Veo3 AI

Entries.Title: Chimp
Entries.Description: Haunted by a bloodthirsty beast from her past, a young woman must duel to decide the fate of her heart.

Entries.Title: KARMA
Entries.Description: A group of teenagers soon learn that what goes around comes around, in this horror film based on deadly revenge!

Entries.Title: A Body to Live In
Entries.Description: An intimate inquiry into the life and work of Fakir Musafar, an influential figure in the queer body-modification community. The film explores his outsized impact and the formation of the “Modern Primitive” movement through decades of archives and interviews with those close to him. Creative treatment of the archives presents them as living texts—photos and video are layered, inverted, and interpolated to bring them new meaning and texture. Angelo Madsen’s sophomore feature is supplemented by seamlessly interwoven personal accounts to craft an portrayal that is loving yet not afraid of critique, embracing both the joy of self-discovery as well as the complex spirituality Musafar came to represent. Through his life and work, the film gives rise to profound questions of bodily autonomy and the body’s relationship to our sense of self.

Entries.Title: Cement Grass
Entries.Description: Standing shots of different sad gravestones depicting the hopelessness of life.

Entries.Title: DEADRINGER
Entries.Description: Set in current day 2020's, a girl named Sylvia, whose haunted past manifests itself in her current day life. While not only navigating her mind, she has to navigate the horrors of the woods that encapsulates all that she fears.

Entries.Title: A Grammy Salute to Cyndi Lauper: Live From the Hollywood Bowl
Entries.Description: Filmed over two nights at the Hollywood Bowl as Lauper concluded her year-long Girls Just Wanna Have Fun Farewell Tour, this all-star concert celebrates icon's beloved catalog.

Entries.Title: Echoes of Pain
Entries.Description: An experience of anxiety.

Entries.Title: Sin Eater

Entries.Title: second 16

Stuck with his few friends, he experiences fragmented memories from the 1 side effect of the antidote: temporary memory loss. Upon this discovery Joel begins to learn more about his dark past and re-experience traumatic events.

Entries.Title: Central and Remote

Entries.Title: Your Friend Logan

To top it all off, he was a genuine and kind person, and was a true friend to everyone he knew. Learn more about how this incredible human being was able to maintain a youthful curiosity that affected his art, relationships, and perspective on the world, and how his influence continues to live on and inspire future artists.

Entries.Title: How Comedy Was Destroyed by an Anti-Reality Doomsday Cult
Entries.Description: Continuing our investigation into how our current comedy era got to be so wonderful. They say that power doesn't corrupt, it reveals. Once a guy like Joe Rogan, the Comedy Czar, grabs hold of the reins of power, he can wield his power in any number of directions. We examine humanity's innate instinct to migrate, and where we head when there is nowhere else to go. How can the nature of subjective reality be leveraged and exploited. The complex psychological mechanisms behind the current comedy era. The powerful cult behind the destruction of everything that was ever good. Hyperreality, classic reality. And the cycles.

Entries.Title: She Screams at Night
Entries.Description: A babysitter is tasked with taking care of a child with night terrors that make her scream incessantly, but she is told in very explicit terms not to check on the child.

Entries.Title: Troubleshooters 2: Roachbots

Guided by ancestors of the Beat generation and poetic kinships with radical female musicians—Patti Smith, Laurie Anderson, Cecilia Vicuña, Meredith Monk—Outrider celebrates Waldman's role as a visionary word-worker and a transcendent presence, singing out in the ancient, bardic tradition the thunderous power of poetry.

Entries.Title: I Still Am
Entries.Description: After the death of her younger sister Jaz, 21 year old Chloe reflects on their bond through voiceover narration and a series of emotional memories. From childhood games and private jokes to the painful diagnosis of leukemia, Chloe walks us through the highs and lows of their journey together. Through warm flashbacks and grounded present day moments, the film explores the lasting impact of love and the shadow that grief leaves behind. As Chloe revisits key moments, building forts, fighting with their dad, the hospital visits, and Jaz’s 16th birthday at the beach, we see how much she has held on. On what would have been Jaz’s 18th birthday, Chloe visits her grave. Despite the promise her sister once made, “Don’t be sad”, Chloe ends the film with a heartbreaking truth: “I still am.”

Entries.Title: Clearing the Air: The War on Smog
Entries.Description: In July 1943, dark, smoky clouds suddenly descended over Los Angeles, causing residents to complain of burning eyes, nausea, and difficulty breathing. People couldn’t see across the street and visibility was so bad that cars crashed. With World War II raging, many feared a chemical attack by the Japanese, but it soon became evident that no foreign enemy was to blame. The waves of pollution called “smog” — a combination of “smoke” and “fog” —  continued and the cause remained a mystery. It was the beginning of an epic struggle for clean air involving years of scientific investigation and civic pressure, bringing together people across ideological divides in a remarkable example of bipartisanship. Their work would lead to the creation of the Environmental Protection Agency and the Clean Air Act, which have had an enduring effect on the quality of air Americans breathe.

The evolution of the podcast. The shadowy nature of identity.  The cycles. Examining the tragic past and psychology that motivates its beloved Dear Leader: Joe Rogan.
