Entries.Description: What begins as an impassioned defense of empathy in children's programming takes Lindsay Ellis down a rabbit-hole to the likes of Ben Shapiro, Fred Rogers, and King Solomon, while finally leading us to a place of devastation and anger at the state of the world.

Entries.Title: Zeke
Entries.Description: In a Brooklyn barbershop, a respected owner's betrayal of a regular customer exposes deep-rooted tensions and unspoken truths within their tight-knit neighborhood.

Entries.Title: I Have Wings But I Cannot Fly
Entries.Description: n a retro-futuristic city where shapeshifter birds are persecuted and feared, Miriam, a struggling single mother, secretly brings her troubled son, Daniel, to work at the towering Bank of Avalon. When Daniel suddenly exhibits alarming signs of transformation, she’s forced to protect him before others discover his true nature.

Entries.Title: FROG UNLOCKED
Entries.Description: in a way, a stand up comedy special..  frog dissection. Live lockpicking. Handcuff escape. Tree of life. Larval transfer. Prayer.

Entries.Title: The Man Who Wanted Everything
Entries.Description: A musical short film that follows Amadei, an impulsive, selfish, and broke college student. After getting his proposal rejected by his girlfriend of two months, he sets off to win her over, but ends up on a journey of self-discovery.

Entries.Title: Leap: A Tale of the Last Days
Entries.Description: After reuniting with his high school sweetheart, Blake and his girlfriend go on the run from his own family as they await the Second Coming of Jesus.

Entries.Title: BLANK
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Incinerate ASAP
Entries.Description: A duo of young political podcasters seek to uncover governmental corruption.

Entries.Title: High Beam
Entries.Description: HIGH BEAM follows Genna, a 9-year-old gymnast who spends a day at work with her mother, a dedicated gymnastics coach. When it’s finally her turn to perform for her evaluation, she finds herself unable to execute the skill in front of the one person whose approval she craves most. Forcing her to question if this sport is worth pursuing anymore.

Entries.Title: My Little Pony: Twilight Sparkle Fights a Clown??????
Entries.Description: Since killing Apple Bottom's parents, Care Package has taken Apple Bottom into his home. When Apple Bottom expresses interest in joining in on one of Care Package's "hunts," the postal pony eagerly takes his cute little "pet" under his wing. But when Twilight Sparkle and friends find themselves to be the target of tonights hunt, all kinds of clownery ensues

Entries.Title: Hummingbirds of Hollywood
Entries.Description: Amid the glamour of Hollywood, a woman finds herself on a transformative journey as she nurtures wounded hummingbirds, unraveling a visually captivating tale of love, fragility, healing, and the delicate beauty in profound acts of kindness.  Meet Terry Masear, a retired UCLA professor who rescues the hummingbirds that descend on Los Angeles every spring in a seasonal frenzy of breeding. Wounded hummingbirds find their way to Masear as her mobile hotline rings off the hook from callers who find them and require her expertise. Among Masear’s diminutive patients are Cactus, Jimmy, Wasabi, Alexa, and Mikhail, whose lives are brought into sharp focus through breathtaking, beautifully detailed photography. The compassion and empathy that Masear shows her Lilliputian charges serves as a lesson to us all — the delicate beauty in profound acts of kindness.

Entries.Title: Ojakh, on the Other Side of Silence
Entries.Description: Erhan Arik, a young Turkish photographer, was born in Ardahan, a city located in eastern Turkey. he grew up in a house where Armenians once lived, driven out by the massacres of 1915. he had never really been interested in this episode of history…  one night, in a dream, a man's voice asks him: "Why did you turn into a barn the room where my wife baked bread, where my children played? ». Erhan wakes up suddenly without being able to go back to sleep. He gets up, leaves the house and walks in the night for hours until dawn…

Entries.Title: Straight Outta Melissa
Entries.Description: A kid wants to be a rapper, but his family kicks him out of the house. Out to prove he can spit bars, he joins the school's rap battle tournament.

Entries.Title: My Lillie
Entries.Description: A love-struck young man gifts his love with never-ending flowers, slowly destroying his garden and soon his relationship.

Entries.Title: Use At Risk
Entries.Description: On his lunch break, a man prepares his ready meal in the staff microwave; instead he discovers much more than a hot meal waiting for him inside.

Entries.Title: Badineries
Entries.Description: While their couple is falling apart, Baptiste and Violette, two students, discover a new passion that may revive their relationship: murder. Yet, it is not sure that Gabriel and Madeleine, their Catholic and puritan friends, are going to approve this process...

Entries.Title: LIFE
Entries.Description: In the year 3000, a young boy explores an enchanting forest, but his peaceful journey is interrupted by a stark reality: a desolate, war-torn landscape. "LIFE" is a poignant and visually striking short film that challenges us to reflect on the urgent need to save our planet.

Entries.Title: In an Instant
Entries.Description: Jake, a photographer, tries to fix his relationship with his girlfriend after she accuses him of cheating.

Entries.Title: Chicken House
Entries.Description: A reclusive man has just moved to the suburbs when he begins to receive visits from strangers dressed in homemade chicken costumes. When he discovers the truth about his new house, he must confront both the chicken people and his own trauma.

Entries.Title: One by One
Entries.Description: When a group of friends hit a custodian on the road, their consciences may get the best of them.

Entries.Title: Philadelphia by the Delaware
Entries.Description: In wake of the Joel Farabee and Morgan Frost trade, a fan comes to terms with their new reality during a journey to the sea.

Entries.Title: White Ladybug
Entries.Description: Two teenage boys run away to Los Angeles

Entries.Title: And it Begins
Entries.Description: In the wake of their father's death, Capomandameto ANGUS: SILAS and ALESSIO course through up keeping their father's legacy and the end of their adolescence. SILAS' path though gets interrupted by a poised and curious ANTONELLA.

Entries.Title: Canceled: The Paula Deen Story
Entries.Description: Filmmaker Billy Corben (Cocaine Cowboys) traces the history of celebrity chef Paula Deen and reconsiders the scandal that exploded her multi-million dollar empire.

Entries.Title: Motamot - Des mots pour les idées
Entries.Description: A minute and a half to recall endangered words. When the backwash of obscurantist thoughts seeks to overwhelm more enlightened ideas, our survival reflex consists – in this specific case of blacklisting words and therefore the ideas they represent – of declaiming their names loudly and clearly, whatever our language, in order to keep them alive and ready to operate, to resist. Would it be enough to remove the word "war" to eradicate conflicts ?

Entries.Title: Annie, wake up
Entries.Description: 'Annie, wake up' is a non-narrative, assemblage film that uses the device of a fictional protagonist, Annie, to reflect on feelings of home, both comforting and oppressive. The ten chapters explore meanings both domestic and communal. Home is a domicile, a community, a geography, and an ideology. The film collages heterogeneous media sources like 8mm home movies, stop motion, direct animation, and archival sound to construct layers of feeling within the frame and throughout the soundtrack. 'Annie, wake up' creates a reflective space that is sometimes brooding, sometimes miraculous, perhaps both.

Entries.Title: The Children of October 7
Entries.Description: The documentary shows emotional and honest conversations between social media activist Montana Tucker and Israeli children, who bravely talk about their experiences of trauma and survival as they try to cope with everything they’ve been through.

Entries.Title: The Santa Fraus
Entries.Description: A fraudulent Santa Claus and his trusted elf sidekick get into some funny business after attempting to rob the home of an innocent, young girl and her protective older brother.

Entries.Title: The Last Vendetta
Entries.Description: DEA Agent Keith Miller remains haunted by his wife’s murder. As his partner Stokes eyes retirement and their boss Marks vanishes before a crucial vote, a captured assassin’s secret leads to a dangerous conspiracy and a deadly showdown.

Entries.Title: UNSEEN
Entries.Description: A man has been hiding a strange creature from his girlfriend and finally decides to show her. In doing so, he begins to disappear before her eyes.

Entries.Title: AEW All Out 2025: Saturday Tailgate Brawl
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Life After Nathan For You
Entries.Description: This documentary explores the life of Jack Garbarino, best known for his lead role in the Nathan for You episode, The Movement. In the episode, Nathan helps Jack create a fitness book and movement based on the idea of getting fit by moving furniture—without ever going to the gym. But beyond his viral TV appearance, Jack has a story of his own.  An immigrant from the Dominican Republic, Jack is a staunch believer in the American Dream and an outspoken Trump supporter—an unusual stance for an immigrant, which led us to investigate his life post-Nathan for You.

Entries.Title: Spacetime
Entries.Description: The Dutch Black Hole Consortium is closely linked to plans to build a gigantic underground telescope that can measure gravitational waves, the Einstein Telescope.

Entries.Title: Da Rakstar \m/
Entries.Description: Biboy, a passionate young musician, chases his dream of making it in the music scene but his mother, fearing an unstable future, tries to steer him toward a safer path.

Entries.Title: Fever Ray | Live at Sydney Opera House
Entries.Description: More than two decades after reshaping electronic music as one-half of The Knife, Swedish avant-pop artist Fever Ray brought their radical sonic vision to Sydney Opera House at Vivid LIVE 2024 for their highly anticipated Australian debut.  From the spectral synth beats of The Knife to the shapeshifting pop soundscapes of their solo work, Swedish avant-garde alchemist Karin Dreijer – aka Fever Ray – carved a singular, uncompromising path through 21st-century electronic music. Following The Knife’s wildly successful third album, Silent Shout – named by Pitchfork as the best album of 2006 – Fever Ray released their 2009 self-titled debut, a modern masterpiece of haunting, left-field electro-pop. It was followed by 2017’s Plunge, which found Dreijer embracing their newfound queer identity through a set of irresistibly sensual, alien pop songs.

Entries.Title: Obey!
Entries.Description: After the tragic death of her viral dog, Max, a pet influencer is confronted by a vengeful spirit demanding an apology for a life of exploitation.

Entries.Title: Snow Day of the Dead
Entries.Description: A winter blizzard sparks independent reports of a zombie outbreak, though some remain skeptical.

Entries.Title: Operation: Laugh Track
Entries.Description: FBI agent Lucas Baker must go undercover as a bartender at a local comedy club. During his time behind the bar, he uncovers the secrets behind an underground criminal organization.

Entries.Title: Sloth
Entries.Description: A man wakes up

Entries.Title: Szypliszki
Entries.Description: Sam, a middle-aged man en route to a Polish village to romance the likely-imaginary woman of his dreams, spends an overnight layover in Queens with his niece and her girlfriend whose relationship is on its last legs.

Entries.Title: Miami girlsss
Entries.Description: Experimental short film by Lefty Korine.

Entries.Title: The Skipper Social Quarter Hour
Entries.Description: The Skipper is a television personality who likes to collect the strangest guests to talk to, from all walks of life. Creatures like The Mothman or Dick Cheney. In trying to contain a quarter hour of quality television, things go arise as his broadcast is interrupted by video commentators and a man who kidnaps everyone he suspects is a werewolf.

Entries.Title: The Gay Agenda 34
Entries.Description: In this anthology of shorts, the phrase "Gay Agenda" is reclaimed from the religious right and transformed into a celebration of gay culture. Sit back and enjoy "Glances," "Toska," "One More Please," and "Octopuses."

Entries.Title: Truth of Loneliness
Entries.Description: Upcoming short film by Chris Tull

Entries.Title: Todo nos traza
Entries.Description: Documentary about the childhood memories of the director captured by her family

Entries.Title: Sweet Talkin’ Guy
Entries.Description: A trans woman goes on three consecutive dates with straight men. As the men grapple with their fragile masculinity, their sexual identities unravel in frantic monologues ironically delivered to the object of their desires.

Entries.Title: Maralinga
Entries.Description: It's 1983. Deep in the Australian outback, Bill and Marsha Bundy are searching for a missing hitchhiker. Chasing a lead, they discover Maralinga - an abandoned nuclear testing site where a deadly threat waits in the fallout.

Entries.Title: Looking for Yadida
Entries.Description: With the establishment of the State of Israel, hundreds of Mizrahi and Balkan infants disappeared from immigrant camps. More than half were of Yemeni origin. Over the years, following public outcry, three commissions of inquiry were established, yet the fate of most of the children, including Yadida Jovany, remains unknown. The story of Aunt Yadida is a story of claustrophobia, of a dark, dusty storeroom that remained locked for years. Her living-dead presence hovered in the air of the family home.  The opening of the archives in 2016 and the release of over 200,000 documents offered a first opportunity for intimate acquaintance with her past. What color were the crib bars she lay in at the infant home? Did she hear the soft sounds of a lullaby from a kind nurse's lips, or did fluorescent silence fill her room?

Entries.Title: Stolen Lives
Entries.Description: The lives of Sunny Jacobs and Peter Pringle were torn apart when they were wrongly convicted of killing police officers—Sunny in the U.S, Peter in Ireland. Each were jailed for crimes they did not commit, only be exonerated after more than a decade each behind bar. In the aftermath of unimaginable hardship, by chance, they found one another and became the world’s only wrongfully convicted, death sentenced, cop-killer accused, exonerated and married couple!

Entries.Title: No Mean City
Entries.Description: Two workmen and an apprentice drive through the city at night, replacing old sodium street lights with LED. Beneath their glow, the city grapples with change, as progress marches on.

Entries.Title: A Season for Love
Entries.Description: Malik and Sam, two African Americans in their late 20s, find themselves at a crossroads where love, ambition, and life's challenges collide. As they pursue their individual dreams and face career obstacles, their deep bond is put to the ultimate test.

Entries.Title: Cloudcatchers
Entries.Description: A broken heart. A wooden horse. One woman’s rememberance at the water’s edge summons wild steeds to prove that true devotion never washes away

Entries.Title: Trashy
Entries.Description: When fourteen-year-old Naomi reunites with her estranged cousin, innocent curiosities lead to a night of drinking, debauchery, and betrayal in the shadows of a small Ohio factory town.

Entries.Title: Silk and Shadow
Entries.Description: As the rain pours, Theo, a disillusioned enforcer, encounters Elliot, a refined and self-possessed tailor. Their conversation wrestles with the nature of good and evil, complicity, and free will. But in their world, walking away is easier said than done…

Entries.Title: Tea Leaves
Entries.Description: A lonely uber driver picks up an unruly passenger from the bar.

Entries.Title: The History of the Carabiner
Entries.Description: Through a creative blend of mixed-media and charismatic narration balancing humor, sass and historical gravity, discover the queer history of the carabiner in this latest WaterBear Original, directed by Gianna Mazzeo and made in partnership with Nikon. Follow the carabiner’s story, from its humble 1911 climbing roots (thanks, Otto "Rambo" Herzog), to empowering butch mechanics and postal workers in the 60s, becoming a potent signal of identity and attraction in the 80’s (think Tinder, but with hardware) and as a TikTok fashion sensation today.

Entries.Title: Something Real
Entries.Description: Set in a near-future world where emotions can be programmed, Something Real is a dark comedy about intimacy and the illusion of perfect relationships-featuring Emmy-winning director Tamara Shogaolu.

Entries.Title: Baba I'm Fine
Entries.Description: When Sama’s girlfriend blows off their Friday plans, the teen copes with romantic rejection by blasting music in her room. When her dad suggests hanging out, she agrees. Their evening takes an unexpected turn as a message forces her to choose between authenticity and keeping up appearances.

Entries.Title: Un Rincón del Mundo
Entries.Description: When Eliza and Clara are invited to the party of the year, their friendship is tested by social pressure, ridiculous expectations, and the chaotic desire to grow up...whatever that means.

Entries.Title: The Amityville Lost Tape
Entries.Description: A trick-or-treater discovers a lost VHS tape revealing the final moments of three students investigating paranormal legends in Amityville, NY. From EVPs to Bloody Mary, their quest for proof spirals into a blur of reality and evil.

Entries.Title: Shock Value
Entries.Description: Confined to a 1960s testing room, a man assigned the name of "Teacher" by an unseen voice must conduct a tutoring session with a distant "Student." As the lesson unfolds, their cooperation strains — and a sinister truth surfaces through a series of shocking questions and irreversible choices.

Entries.Title: Homefield Atmosphere
Entries.Description: The film follows a feminine nonbinary individual as they make their way through an unfamiliar and unforgiving world. Along the way, she'll face environmental hazards, bootlicking looters, and risk losing her only friend.

Entries.Title: Lace Larrabee: Sparkle Baby
Entries.Description: America's Got Talent alumnus Lace Larrabee performs for a hometown crowd in Atlanta, GA and reflects upon her years in pageants, opportunities she's realized were missed when she was younger and alternative routes her life could have taken.

Entries.Title: Clean-Up On Aisle Roar
Entries.Description: A horror-comedy short film about a young woman whose past comes back to haunt her in the produce aisle.

Entries.Title: Fear Half Memory Refracted
Entries.Description: A psychedelic collage of found material relating to childhood fear.

Entries.Title: By the Rules of Meeple! - Brawl Stars Animation
Entries.Description: Introducing Meeple!  Welcome to Brawl Stars!

Entries.Title: The Ghost That Wouldn't Die
Entries.Description: Plagued rock star, Devin Crane, struggles to navigate her deadly affliction on tour.

Entries.Title: Under the Weight of a Waking Dream
Entries.Description: ‘Under the Weight of a Waking Dream’ is Zefier's debut swan song to the ending year. Comprised of poetry and endless enumerations is a diaristic film chronicling the lessons and contradictions found throughout the human experience.

Entries.Title: Cart Pushers
Entries.Description: Raymond, a maladjusted cart pusher at a dying grocery store, has a brief yet confusing romance with an underage cashier during the final months of a suburban New Jersey summer.

Entries.Title: What Hides in Us
Entries.Description: Looking to rebuild their relationship, Emma and Ben find themselves terrorized by what hides inside them.

Entries.Title: Lita Ford: Live at Wacken 2025
Entries.Description: Lita Ford is rock history personified. As guitarist for the legendary Runaways, she broke all the rules in the 1970s and paved the way for women in heavy rock. Her solo career produced true classics with hits like "Kiss Me Deadly" and the duet "Close My Eyes Forever." For decades, she has stood for uncompromising riffs, a rebellious attitude, and a voice that sounds like red-hot steel. Despite personal ups and downs, Lita has remained true to rock music and lives the lifestyle she sings about. When she takes the stage at Wacken, the hallowed ground gets its dose of pure rock power from a pioneer who still knows how to get an audience going.

Entries.Title: Hiker
Entries.Description: On a dark, isolated road, James, a retired truck driver, picks up Robbie, a young man walking alone. Their conversation starts innocently but quickly turns uneasy as James grows suspicious of Robbie's knife and the blood on his pants. As tension builds, it becomes clear that not everything is as it seems. What begins as an act of kindness twists into a deadly encounter, leaving unsettling questions about who the real danger was all along.

Entries.Title: Morgenkreis
Entries.Description: In an anguished yet refined triptych responding to life as a Palestinian in contemporary Germany, Basma al-Sharif connects a ghostly drift through Berlin to an interrogation by an unseen German official to a kindergarten classroom that descends into a colourful, unruly riot.

Entries.Title: To Be Pretty
Entries.Description: A young girl struggles with her self-image after being confronted by her own insecurities. What does it mean to be pretty?

Entries.Title: Deep Dish Dimples
Entries.Description: When Gio, a Black trans man, calls his best friend Lazette for help burying a body, the two are pulled into an unexpected confrontation with the past. As whispers of family wounds and unresolved trauma echo through the night, Gio must face a surreal encounter with his pre-transitioned self. What begins as a desperate mission transforms into a journey of acceptance, love, and self-forgiveness, reminding us that healing comes from embracing every part of who we are.

Entries.Title: People Watching in Washington Square Park
Entries.Description: The first waves of spring slap NYC awake like a shot of espresso to the face. And just like that, the freaks crawl out of their winter shells and flood Washington Square Park. Skaters carving the concrete like it owes them money. Shirtless soccer dudes playing like it’s the World Cup of Testosterone. Photographers lurking like paparazzi in the jungle. Dancers spinning truth on pavement. Smokers exhaling poetry. It’s not a park—it’s a stage. And everyone’s putting on a damn good show.

Entries.Title: The Night Shift
Entries.Description: After his final graveyard shift at a suburban convenience store, Eli expects to quietly slip into the next chapter of his life. Instead, the night unravels fast and nothing goes as planned. The Night Shift is a grounded coming-of-age story about disorientation, bad luck, and the strange clarity that comes when everything falls apart.

Entries.Title: Movie Theater Popcorn
Entries.Description: A death row inmate chooses his final meal on the eve of his execution

Entries.Title: Driven: The Freddie Freeman Story
Entries.Description: MVP first baseman opens up on his emotional journey, enduring consistency and deep ties to the game in new documentary; Exclusive interviews with Fred Freeman, Andrew Friedman, Dave Roberts, Mookie Betts, Justin Turner, Brian Snitker, Jason Heyward, Dansby Swanson and Tom Verducci, offer an intimate look into the star’s life

Entries.Title: RUN!
Entries.Description: A group of strangers find themselves preyed upon by a sadistic killer after awakening in a subterranean race track and soon discover there is only one way to survive: RUN!

Entries.Title: Desert Flower
Entries.Description: A stranger walks into a near-empty bar in a small town. But is he really a stranger?

Entries.Title: Baker's Dozen
Entries.Description: A man sees his life start to fall apart after his coworker takes a bit a little too far.

Entries.Title: Starved
Entries.Description: A woman ostracized from society does what she can to cope.

Entries.Title: Ways of Knowing: A Navajo Nuclear History
Entries.Description: The American Southwest holds a dark legacy as the place where nuclear weapons were invented and built. Navajo people have long held this place sacred, and continue to fight for a future that transcends historical trauma. This is their story.

Entries.Title: OG_Kush: Betting Shop
Entries.Description: Born around gambling, OG_Kush leads his journey to take down casinos by rigging games and stealing money. However, the casino has measures to get in his way.

Entries.Title: My Fortune
Entries.Description: Upon wishing to the universe, Quentin finds himself in a facade of events when he encounters a mysterious girl, whom he develops feelings for, despite the major factor of his friends denying the existence of this girl. Within his developing love story, unexpectedly, a tragic event occurs that changes him eternally.

Entries.Title: Tim Cheese 2
Entries.Description: After the fall of John Pork and the unraveling of old alliances, Tim Cheese and Simon Claw reunite to finish what they started—eliminate every traitor left in the shadows, including Marvin Beak. But when trust shatters, and history starts to echo, the real threat isn’t the past… it’s what Tim has become.

Entries.Title: Vicious Vixens: Dawn of the Vicious
Entries.Description: Vicious Vixens: Dawn of the Vicious

Entries.Title: Babushka
Entries.Description: A possessed Babushka doll unleashes a nesting chain of malevolent entities, forcing a mother and her young daughter to confront a legacy of generational trauma—unfolding through a narrative structured like the doll itself.

Entries.Title: A House of Forgotten Objects
Entries.Description: A documentary about the MorYork Gallery and Clare Graham.

Entries.Title: The Anxious Person + Returning Something to the Shop
Entries.Description: Millie buys some new boots at lunchtime and wears them back to the office - but they are too tight - and now she's worn them! Why did she buy them? her best friend June asks helpfully..... She nervously imagines what the assistant will say when she takes them back and how she will have an answer for everything ...

Entries.Title: Last Resort
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Things We Keep
Entries.Description: Forced into a caretaker position, Kate comes home to pack up her estranged mother’s house. While struggling to clear her mother’s hoarded possessions, Kate discovers the insidious nature of her mother’s illness lying behind the house’s walls.

Entries.Title: Tale of the Nameless
Entries.Description: Deep in the forest, a girl searches for her name as she’s pursued by a warrior who desires to help her and a foreboding beast who thirsts to consume her soul.

Entries.Title: Alien in the Train Tunnel
Entries.Description: An experimental thriller film by Ted McKean Newsom.

Entries.Title: Azul
Entries.Description: Struggling to cope with her sister's unexpected passing, 17-year-old Azul finds solace in an unexpected place: a lady lowrider car club.

Entries.Title: Baby Tooth
Entries.Description: Marina has enlisted the help of a stranger to get rid of either her baby tooth, or her boat, whichever he prefers.

Entries.Title: Followers
Entries.Description: A young man, unable to open up about his troubled past, is visited by an old family member, only to be faced with the most difficult decision of his life.

Entries.Title: Vote for Lola
Entries.Description: A high school perfectionist campaigns to win student council president as her best friend films her journey in this mockumentary comedy.

Entries.Title: Fresh Values
Entries.Description: In the near future, a struggling urban food co-op adopts AR technology to save their store. The strategy proves too successful.

Entries.Title: Briefcase
Entries.Description: A jogger encounters a masked stranger in the woods, who insists she looks inside his briefcase.

Entries.Title: Dreamland Awaits
Entries.Description: The film follows a police officer who must endure several days in an eerie house, completing tasks for a mysterious figure who has abducted his family.

Entries.Title: The Blessing and the Curse
Entries.Description: Closed-off to most of the world, the filmmakers were granted exclusive access to an isolated Jewish settlement in the Northern West Bank called Itamar which sits between two mountains- the Mountain of the Blessing and the Mountain of the Curse. On the night of March 11, 2011, two terrorists penetrated the security fence of the community, entered the home of the Fogel family, who were asleep in their beds, and brutally murdered the parents and three of their children, including a three-month-old who was nearly beheaded. THE BLESSING AND THE CURSE explores the aftermath of the crime and examines how the memory of that night still haunts the people of Itamar, and poses the question: Why would anyone choose to raise their family in such a dangerous place?

Entries.Title: A Bold Accusation
Entries.Description: A game night quickly goes south

Entries.Title: The Screen
Entries.Description: A surrealist film detailing my interpretation of the harms of technology and the looming impact it will have on our minds.

Entries.Title: The Barbie Movie
Entries.Description: Equal parts documentary, visual essay, experimental collage narrative, and parodic homage to and of all things Barbie, this caustic and exciting visual foray embraces the complicated terrain of feminist discourse, cultural criticism, and political rhetoric, as well as insights on gender, identity, and personal experience where all roads lead back to the phenomena that is Barbie.

Entries.Title: Moon Valley Quest
Entries.Description: In 1988, a video game geek and failed musician is recruited by a retired battle general to defeat an evil beast and his gang in order to restore the freedom of Moon Valley's citizens in this music driven fantasy action adventure.

Entries.Title: Rennie
Entries.Description: This voyeuristic look into a small town's Renaissance Festival delves into the lives of a motley crew of characters and what brings them back to their comfortless corsets, ballsack hugging codpiece tights, and sweltering animal pelts year after year. Through the twists and turns of personal exploration, our heroes and heroines use this time together to fulfill the most basic desire in life: to love, be loved, and belong as one's true self. Our beloved Rennies reveal that in a place centered around pretending to be something that you are not, everyone discovers who they are.

Entries.Title: Customer Service
Entries.Description: A couple celebrates their Anniversary at a special restaurant. Why?  The "Service!"

Entries.Title: Pretty Pretty Please I Don't Want to be a Magical Girl
Entries.Description: A story about a girl named Aika who, you guessed it, doesn't want to be a magical girl. She's fallen out of love with her work over time but gets the job done regardless. Will she be able to reignite her passion with the help of her magical sidekick, Hoshi and her new best friend Zira? Or will those pesky evildoers, Eclipse and Lady DeVoid continue to keep her down? Who knows!?

Entries.Title: Sands of Purgatory
Entries.Description: In the wasteland of Purgatory, a grieving Artemis sets out on a path of vengeance against the zealots who slaughtered her partner, Rhea.

Entries.Title: Bless Me Father
Entries.Description: The Shepherd Reclaims His Lost Lamb

Entries.Title: Three Words Three Times
Entries.Description: A lonesome young Colombian woman Claudia is left reeling in love with her former partner after he leaves her shortly after they move to the United States. She eventually devises an odd way to stay connected with him.

Entries.Title: YAPs
Entries.Description: Widespread closures threaten the very existence of live theater in America. A traditional career as an opera singer seems less and less viable. And yet: In spite of a system stacked against them, young singers continue to follow their calling, risking everything to gain entry into fiercely competitive apprenticeship programs.  In VHO’s searing, intimate new documentary film, 5 young opera singers across America share a year of their lives with unprecedented access. What is driving their ambition? Who will “make it”? And what does success even mean to the next generation?

Entries.Title: 산 MYO TEAMTAGE FOUR 산
Entries.Description: If they stan...

Entries.Title: It's Never Over Easy
Entries.Description: A young woman employs the skills of a private investigator to find a bunny. Made for Take48 2025.

Entries.Title: Play Pretend
Entries.Description: A down on her luck party princess is given one more chance to keep her job after a gig goes horribly wrong.

Entries.Title: Ruin
Entries.Description: Ruin is a tragic, mythic love story shot on unedited black and white Super 8.

Entries.Title: MAMALONACITAS
Entries.Description: A mother buys her teenage son a new pair of shoes from a mall.

Entries.Title: Remake
Entries.Description: The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. To what extent did his camera affect their relationship when Adrian was alive? To what extent does it define that relationship now that he is gone? Meanwhile, an effort to adapt McElwee’s first feature, Sherman’s March, into a work of fiction lurches along, giving the filmmaker another perspective from which to meditate on movie making and mortality.

Entries.Title: The Manipulation of Natalia Grace
Entries.Description: An emotionally unfit couple seek to adopt and care for a precocious child.

Entries.Title: Oh, Hello Again
Entries.Description: After a strange first encounter, Lila just keeps running into this same guy over and over until....

Entries.Title: AL-ONE
Entries.Description: Follow Samuel and Damien aboard the AL-ONE spaceship as they complete their daily reports. An unsettling sight forces them to investigate an anomaly on the ship. Watch them argue back and forth as they decide what to do.

Entries.Title: The Time I Almost Met Steven Seagal
Entries.Description: On the Toronto shooting set of 2001's "Exit Wounds", Steven Seagal almost got to meet Toronto legend Mike Wood. Circumstances kept it from happening, but the tale lives on!

Entries.Title: Playboi Carti - Live at Rolling Loud California 2025
Entries.Description: Playboi Carti performing MUSIC live at Rolling Loud California 2025.

Entries.Title: SexySweat
Entries.Description: Sanford Urethra visits Dr. Zabar.

Entries.Title: Imperial Green
Entries.Description: An auto-fiction drama about car trouble, metropolitanism, and Joseph: an emotionally reserved HVAC apprentice who harbors thinly veiled unrest with his relationships, namely his long-term partner Jen, and his father-figure boss, Daniel.

Entries.Title: A Short Film by Jim Jarmusch, Starring Beatrice Domond
Entries.Description: The Skateroom is proud to feature Jim Jarmusch's captivating works in our first skate art collection with the iconic filmmaker.  A nod to Jarmusch’s collage-making practice, the photographs have been featured on skate decks in seemingly random sets of threes. Whether their placement seems contrasting or connected is up to the eye of the viewer. The artist himself refers to the process as more dreamlike than logical, with the dark background of each board adding to the mysterious effect.

Entries.Title: Secret Motivations
Entries.Description: When Jack's drug dealer, Juan Uno, is taken out by a mysterious killer, Jack embarks on a convoluted quest for vengeance while trying to save his own skin from forces of evil. Can he make it out alive? And was Juan Uno more than just his dealer?

Entries.Title: No One Was Supposed to Be Home
Entries.Description: In the spirit of Christmas, Ted robs a supposedly empty home. Little does he know, Willis has a similar idea... Two robbers. One house. No brain.

Entries.Title: GLORY Underground
Entries.Description: The GLORY Underground event takes place on May 17, 2025, at the Betr Warehouse in Miami, FL, USA.

Entries.Title: Mystery Inc.
Entries.Description: When a string of murders begin to take place around the quaint town of Coolsville, four teenagers must come together and stop this sinister force, before it is too late.

Entries.Title: Light Off
Entries.Description: A story of a guy who loses light around him.

Entries.Title: Film Diary #10 (Eyefull Portraits)
Entries.Description: Brief, impressionistic portraits of many of Angerame’s friends and acquaintances who live in San Francisco. Set to Toney Merritt’s haunting sound design and superimposed with NASA images and footage of Angerame’s coming down the elevator at the Eiffel Tower, FILM DIARY #10 EYEFULL PORTRAITS is a descent into the depths of the subconsciousness, transforming into a complex, densely layered exploration of friendship, loneliness, city dwelling and the unknown.  – Kornelia Boczkowska

Entries.Title: Rebel with a Clause
Entries.Description: A grammar guru takes her pop-up grammar advice stand on a road trip across all 50 states to show that comma fights can bring us closer together in a divided time.

Entries.Title: Origin: The Story of the Basketball Africa League
Entries.Description: Showcases the importance of sports to the African continent's future as well as the complex relationship between America and Africa and how The BAL is a bridge between the two.

Entries.Title: Come Out, Wherever You Are
Entries.Description: Vernon Parrish, a retired mayor of a large suburb just outside of Chicago, had moved to the small town of Livingston, Montana, for peace and solitude and to get out of the public eye. After six years, Verne's past returns to haunt him, driving him into a self-imposed exile at his cabin in the woods, hoping to ride out the media storm. While he is away, a storm of a different form rolls in, drastically changing the world as he knew it, culminating in a tale of a man who is both a victim and a beneficiary of circumstance.

Entries.Title: Gripped
Entries.Description: Julian Young, a headstrong, rock climber is consumed by perfection. During an Olympic Qualifying competition, he is embroiled in a brutal controversy. One year later, Julian unpacks the day in a career-defining, podcast interview.

Entries.Title: The Bone Hunter
Entries.Description: Peace activist Takamatsu Gushiken, 71, searches for the remains of people who were killed during the Battle of Okinawa, one of the bloodiest chapters in the second world war. As the US seeks to bolster its military presence on the island, due to its close proximity to China, Taiwan and North Korea, we explore the multi-layered tensions that have haunted the people of Okinawa for 80 years

A man, uncertain whether his memories are real or mere illusions, seeks out someone from his past to uncover the truth. Together, they attempt a mysterious ritual to bring back the figure who lingers in their shared recollections—someone who may have never existed at all.

Entries.Title: The Victims (or 100 and some days in MAGA America)
Entries.Description: An exploration of the lives of six queer Michigan teens during the first 100 days of Trump's second term and the effect the Trump administration has had upon Michigan. The film also recounts Trump's first 100 days in office rally that took place within the state.

Entries.Title: The Death of Time as We Know It
Entries.Description: Daisy finds a mysterious amulet which she believes is altering her perception of time.

Entries.Title: Miss
Entries.Description: It's been four days since Sophie came out as trans to her partner Jess. Miss finds these two driving to a gas station in the middle of nowhere, so Sophie can take her first steps into society as a woman.

Entries.Title: i've been warned of your whole existence and your friend group
Entries.Description: ada stim lord

Entries.Title: Wild Party
Entries.Description: Inspired by the original poem, a wild night of drinking, love, and sin quickly becomes a deadly ballroom blitz.

Entries.Title: Seeikokan III
Entries.Description: Seeikokan III is a direct animation work using ephemera and excess 16mm footage from the production of Available Light.

Entries.Title: Leave Room For Leonard
Entries.Description: A young couple gets into a tiff one evening after returning home from a performance of one of their plays. As they duke it out, the two begin to unravel, slowly but surely.

Entries.Title: Adolescent Window
Entries.Description: While their girlfriend is on a trip, Harrison reminisces on his old apartment's bedroom window, one much higher up than his current one.

Entries.Title: Time Setters
Entries.Description: A group of time traveling vigilantes travel back in time and attempt to rescue Emmett Till.

Entries.Title: Abhaile
Entries.Description: Aimee, hailing from a lower class background, spends her summer volunteering at her beloved charity shop, Cabhair. She is suddenly tasked with training newcomer Donnacha. The pair make for a respectable friendship, however the stark difference in their respective socioeconomic backgrounds becomes a catalyst for conflict as Donnacha's blind ignorance becomes increasingly apparent.

Entries.Title: Palate Cleanser
Entries.Description: Bart Lewis, a young father desperate to pay for his daughter’s cancer treatment, finally lands an interview with a mysterious company offering excellent benefits (including much-needed health insurance) despite being vastly unqualified. Nervously fumbling through his lunchtime meeting with the intimidating Ms. Goodwin, he finds himself excruciatingly out of place, from his soggy sandwich to his lack of credentials.  Just as he’s about to be dismissed, a heartfelt plea about his daughter catches her attention. But instead of an opportunity, Lewis is faced with a chilling ultimatum – one that could secure his daughter’s future, but at an unimaginable cost.

Entries.Title: Burger with a Side of Vengeance
Entries.Description: A Man looses the thing most precious to him- his burger

Entries.Title: A Successful Woman
Entries.Description: Through moments of humor, tension, and vulnerability, Esther learns that true love isn't measured by wealth or status but by authenticity, self-growth, and unexpected connections. As secrets unravel and betrayals surface, she must decide: Will she embrace the life she truly wants, or succumb to the one others have chosen for her? This is a powerful story of healing, resilience, and the courage to redefine happiness on one's own terms.

Entries.Title: Deadbeat Beer Runners
Entries.Description: When Bud and Viv run out of beer, they embark on a strange adventure to find some more.

Entries.Title: Mayor of Lowell
Entries.Description: This short documentary chronicles the culture and arts of Cambodian Americans and the Lowell, MA community through the eyes of Sokhary Chau, the first Cambodian American Mayor in the United States. Chau immigrated to the U.S. at seven years old to escape the Khmer Rouge genocide. Through this unique story that showcases the best of Lowell—immigrant success, assimilation, history, and the development of the arts—we see a man born into a war-torn country who comes to America to be a first-in-the-nation leader.

Entries.Title: Estrela Kdente
Entries.Description: Once upon a time, there was a shooting star. One day, someone wished it would become human and come to Earth. In this short film, the shooting star feels the growing pains of turning into human.

Entries.Title: Kris Kristofferson: Life & Songs
Entries.Description: Celebrate Kristofferson in a 2016 concert featuring a multigenerational “Who’s Who” of country greats, including Dierks Bentley, Rosanne Cash, Eric Church, Emmylou Harris, Jamey Johnson, Alison Krauss, Lady A, Martina McBride, Reba McEntire, Willie Nelson, Jennifer Nettles, Darius Rucker and Hank Williams Jr. Go backstage for interviews with the artists who explore his enduring influence.

Entries.Title: Doc Albany
Entries.Description: Dr. Sheena Favors must choose between city life or staying in rural Georgia to provide vital maternal care, following Doc Hollywood’s real-life inspiration, Dr. James Hotz.

Entries.Title: Bright Future
Entries.Description: Stephanie must convince her boss that his son-in-law is not who he thinks he is. Her job and her sanity are at stake.

Entries.Title: Amity
Entries.Description: When Quinn realizes the briefcase she and her boyfriend found is valuable to a dangerous mob, she must act quickly to get the target off their backs

Entries.Title: Something Beautiful
Entries.Description: When Lloyd, a young film enthusiast attends a film he becomes friendly with a young girl named Julie, as they grow their bond Lloyd struggles with choosing between his friends and the girl he loves, however by the time he makes his choice it may already be too late.

Entries.Title: Thin Air
Entries.Description: In the distant future, an escape pod technician gets jettisoned from the mothership where she must come to terms with her inevitable fate.

Entries.Title: The Birds Tell Me All There Is To Know
Entries.Description: Two strangers quietly struggle to navigate their changing identities as the summer draws to a close.

Entries.Title: The Life of Silver
Entries.Description: When a silver statue wakes up from his long nap, he starts to embark on a series of adventures…

Entries.Title: Not a Fan of Farewells
Entries.Description: When a young man returns to his village to clean his grandmother’s house, a sudden power outage stirs something deep within him

Entries.Title: Year of the Cat
Entries.Description: Year of the Cat follows filmmaker Tony Nguyen on an extraordinary quest to solve the mystery of his father, lost in the chaos of the fall of Saigon 50 years ago. Told as an investigative home movie, this powerful documentary weaves together moments of humor and heartache, offering an intimate look at how the children of refugees are shaped by war and loss. As Tony delves into his family’s history, the film reveals the emotional lengths we go to in confronting the ghosts of the past—and the possibility of healing as we reclaim and transform our futures.

Entries.Title: Dream Walking
Entries.Description: Ben (Gabriel Moran) can’t shake the feeling that Selah (Kiara Torres) still lingers somewhere between his thoughts and the world around him. As time slips, so does his sense of what’s real.

Entries.Title: L'Essien
Entries.Description: The love behind the picture, a memory etched in time.

Entries.Title: That Teen: The Movie
Entries.Description: Four teens from around the world step off the path they were told to follow — and take the road less travelled.

Entries.Title: A Sojourn in the Necropolis
Entries.Description: Two trans women get high and (maybe) see ghosts. An assemblage of miscellaneous cemetery footage.

Entries.Title: Candy Darling
Entries.Description: Ron Link, Samuel Adams Green, Holly Woodlawn, and Jeremiah Newton delve into Candy Darling’s life, legacy, and the indelible impact she left on the world of art and culture.

Entries.Title: Those Who Long To Be Held Closer
Entries.Description: A chance encounter leads two former friends to confront their difficult feelings toward one another.

Entries.Title: Swinging Light
Entries.Description: An experience of a camera swinging in different gestures facing the optical distortion of the Sun. The last appearance of the smudge.

Entries.Title: BREACH
Entries.Description: A detective with a warrant stumbles upon a plan that he never saw coming.

When 16-year-old Pakistani-American Noori’s wish at 11:11 to be her crush’s type goes awry, she’s magically transformed into a white, blonde, blue-eyed girl — and must undo the wish before losing herself completely.

Entries.Title: SKIDS
Entries.Description: A group of delinquent young adults navigate a life of petty crime and rebellion, but tensions rise when their leader, Alex, pushes them toward increasingly reckless actions. "Skids" explores themes of manipulation, influence, regret, and the consequences of youthful recklessness.

Entries.Title: Hey Babe
Entries.Description: A couple argue about a mysterious bottle in their medicine cabinet.

Entries.Title: Apostasy Blues
Entries.Description: After a cult leader “raptures” alone with his followers’ donation money, two cult members reenter the secular world to embark on a manhunt for their swindler from rural Ohio to New York City.

Entries.Title: May the Soil Be Everywhere
Entries.Description: When filmmaker Yehui Zhao begins to film her grandmother, she embarks on an excavation of her family’s past and their long-lost ancestral village in the vast mountain range of Loess Plateau. She sets out to search for the story of her great-grandfather and, in the process, discovers the land that generations before her cultivated alongside the cave dwellings that they called home. Here she pays tribute to her family’s heritage, bearing witness to its relationship with the land, labor, and resilience. A shapeshifting and playful feature debut, the film is infused with performance, poetry, and animation as Zhao constructs a living archive of oral history and community theater. Summoning the past into the present, May the Soil Be Everywhere chronicles China’s history of war, famine, and rapid urbanization through the lens of four generations in one family.

Entries.Title: Alright
Entries.Description: After the death of his wife, a recently estranged father is forced to reconcile with his daughter through the unlikeliest of means: the Nutcracker.

Entries.Title: SIMONE
Entries.Description: While taking his routine beachside jog, Haitian immigrant Marcel Lambert gets a call from his mother about the death of her lifelong friend, Simone. Marcel is taken aback by the news. Unbeknownst to his mother, Marcel has kept a secret from her about Simone, which he confides in his therapist.

Entries.Title: Callbacks (PILOT)
Entries.Description: In an effort to compete with their high school's production, two best friends set out to make their own absurd play following a rejection from the senior year spring musical.

Entries.Title: Jimmy in Saigon
Entries.Description: Jimmy in Saigon is a documentary exploring the mysterious death of Peter McDowell's eldest brother, James, who died age 24 in Saigon. The film explores unspoken grief and family secrets, while honoring those lost long ago.

Entries.Title: We’ve Met
Entries.Description: Sad sack bartender can’t remember his customers so he takes part in a medical study for memory loss medication, only to suffer from its hidden side effects

Entries.Title: Yeni
Entries.Description: Driven by poverty and rejection, brilliant but broken Yeni misuses his only chance to escape hardship. When his actions bring disgrace and loss, he must overcome guilt and regret to reclaim his purpose—a moving story of fall, faith, and redemption.

Entries.Title: Noli me tangere
Entries.Description: An excavational inquiry through photographs, touch, and looking at times and places far from here and now, animating and conjuring a link between past and present.

Entries.Title: Supa Eleph
Entries.Description: Supa Eleph goes home to see his mother, while Mr Evil tries to kill him.

Entries.Title: Angelic Kitty Miracle-chan
Entries.Description: Alex's obsession with their favorite anime character Angelic Kitty Miracle-chan offers them a chance to experiment with their sense of identity, but things don’t go exactly as planned.

Entries.Title: DISINI
Entries.Description: About a father who sacrifices himself to save his son's life. The son, who has an emotional attachment to his father through photography, has to face the harsh reality of waking up from a coma and realising that his father is gone.

Entries.Title: Lotus
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: Demon
Entries.Description: Don't lie to your therapist.

Entries.Title: The Industry
Entries.Description: An aspiring actress is given the opportunity of a lifetime, only what she must offer in return may have sinister consequences.

Entries.Title: SOMETHING IS IN MY ROOM
Entries.Description: Something is in your room, and it won't leave you alone.

Entries.Title: Don't Shoot Me: The Snake Mirror Weekend Tour
Entries.Description: In June of 2025, the north Mississippi indie rock band, Snake Mirror, went out on their first tour through the state.

Entries.Title: Drained
Entries.Description: Truck driver Teddy's late night stop at a gas station takes a dark turn when he meets the mysterious hooker Katerina, leading to unexpected consequences.

Entries.Title: When a Flaming Stealth Banana Split The Sky
Entries.Description: "Alrighty, then ... picture this if you will.  10 to 2 AM, X, Yogi DMT, and a box of Krispy Kremes,  in my "need to know" pose, just outside of Area 51  Contemplating the whole "chosen people" thingy  when a flaming stealth banana split the sky  like one would hope but never really expect  to see in a place like this.  Cutting right angle donuts on a dime  and stopping right at my Birkenstocks,  and me yelping..  Like I woke up in Wonderland, all sort of terrifying And can anyone tell me why you all sound like Peanuts parents? Will I ever be coming down?"  The filming itself was essentially a visual improvisation, an exploratory performance by Tina YounesTabar in 1402 (2023). It was captured through images taken during dawn, at a time when a Banana was splitting the sky in two. In the editing process, these fragments were woven together to become the film you see today.

Entries.Title: Great White Reign of Terror
Entries.Description: After nine great white attacks off South Africa's "wild coast" leaves locals reeling, scientists Ryan Johnson, Gibbs Kuguru and Andy Casagrande race to uncover the cause before there's another fatality.

Entries.Title: The Choice
Entries.Description: Following a historic charter reform vote, this documentary follows two leading candidates as they run for Portland City Council in its first ranked-choice election.

Entries.Title: Headspace
Entries.Description: An office intern journeys through the bureaucratic mind of a depressed adolescense, desperately convinced that the root of the problem is somewhere hidden in the head.

Entries.Title: Dinner Scene
Entries.Description: Andrew Finch relives a dinner with the Fargo's, as his fragile memories make it challenging to uncover the truth about that night.

Entries.Title: Bowls
Entries.Description: An argument over loading the dishwasher threatens to destroy a marriage.

Entries.Title: Who is She?
Entries.Description: A short story that follows a young man as he is haunted by visions of a mysterious woman.

Entries.Title: The Fastest Boxer In The World
Entries.Description: BE YOURSELF. A one day shot-on-video odyssey in the life of Matthew Morales, the fastest boxer in the world.

Entries.Title: Canis Lupus
Entries.Description: At a parole hearing for his older brother, a young man struggles to reconcile memories of the brother he loved with the crimes he committed, questioning if he can ever forgive him.

Entries.Title: All Blurry Around the Open Flame
Entries.Description: A short film about the abstract processes of light becoming a physical form in the landscape.

Entries.Title: Goodbye, Mr. Stewart
Entries.Description: A woman attends her high school teacher's funeral as old memories and new feelings bubble to the surface.

Entries.Title: An Act of Love
Entries.Description: A loving wife is the primary caregiver for her blind husband who is confined to their apartment, while she is hiding a dark secret from him in plain sight.

Entries.Title: Maidenhair
Entries.Description: An awkward teen develops a crush on a salesman visiting her father's parish.

Entries.Title: Crag
Entries.Description: Natalie and Adam attempt to save their failing relationship through a climbing trip in the wilderness. It’s said that nature is healing, but love is the hardest climb of all.

Entries.Title: The Men From Down Under
Entries.Description: Two Australian gangsters attempt to have a peaceful picnic but they soon become suspicious of each others actions and the would be peaceful getaway plunges into total madness.

Entries.Title: Is Democracy In Danger: Dark Enlightenment And The Tech Elites
Entries.Description: A documentary exploring threats to democracy from the tech elites.

Entries.Title: A Sparrow’s Song
Entries.Description: Inspired by a true story, a widowed air raid warden in the midst of World War II struggles to overcome grief and rediscover joy in her life – until she finds a dying sparrow she hopes to save.

Entries.Title: Room Temperature
Entries.Description: Every year, a family home is turned into a haunted house. The purpose is not only to be as terrifying as possible, but also to create a spectacular attraction to draw the neighbors in. The situation grows increasingly complicated, broken and distressed as the family’s problems intercede in their plans and as their real lives become the film’s true and overriding scary haunt.

Entries.Title: Iam Visum
Entries.Description: An exploration of a distorted or wrong memory, and the dreamlike world that unfolds within it.

Entries.Title: Field of Screams
Entries.Description: A group of young people who are helping their friend clean out his his late grandfather's farmhouse are terrorized by a living scarecrow who has his own stake in his dead creator's property.

Entries.Title: To Fear a Spider
Entries.Description: Two friends learn to face their fears when they're confronted with a deadly spider, rabies, and many Oreo Cakesters.

Entries.Title: Drop Number 8
Entries.Description: A couple unexpectedly finds a briefcase with enough money inside to change their lives forever. With no one around to lay claims to their prize, they take it as their own. However, it seems someone else was looking for the briefcase and now they must avoid them at all costs or they fear the worst could happen.

Entries.Title: Petticoats & Promises
Entries.Description: Petticoats & Promises is about the relationship between two girls in a neo-western short film, it goes through how two characters try to keep one another in their lives until it's too late. It highlights the importance of first choices and different types of love. A glance into the life of Gracie Cameron. She wants to start a new life but there's one thing that's stopping her- Joan McCoy. She wants to bring her along but Joan can't help but want to say. Gracie doesn't have the guts to say how badly she wants Joan to come with her until it seems she's made her decision.

Entries.Title: Mannequin
Entries.Description: A misanthropic student who has an infatuation with mannequins catches the attention of Jason, who mourns the loss and mysterious disappearance of his friends

Entries.Title: N.O.A.H.
Entries.Description: Charlie doesn't want to be here. Stuck at his tyrannical Grandpa's house while his mom is away, he finds a secret passage in his dad's old room. Following it, Charlie finds a hidden link to his father.

Entries.Title: Live Show 8
Entries.Description: Live Show 8: Live on 2025

Entries.Title: Fading
Entries.Description: A boy is left alone after the disappearance of his parents.

Entries.Title: 6 Announcements
Entries.Description: Filmmaker Pierre Creton, one of the FIDmarseille festival's most loyal supporters, offers us 6 ads, a teaser imagined in the form of a micro-series, especially for FID. Drawing on this mysterious and bewitching work, designer Manon Bruet has imagined a new visual identity that also celebrates the moving image, developed on a daily basis with the invaluable assistance of Manon Forax.

Entries.Title: Chain Link
Entries.Description: When a quirky plumber arrives at a seemingly normal house for a routine repair, he soons finds himself tangled in a darkly comedic game of cat and mouse, leading to a deadly showdown at a nearby lake where the unexpected homeowner has more than a just a broken pipe to fix.

Entries.Title: So like, what are we?
Entries.Description: When LILA suspects her situationship's life might be in danger, she’s reluctant to go the cops because of their precarious relationship status and is forced to take matters into her own hands.

Entries.Title: The Wait Game
Entries.Description: Yolanda Hills, a woman deeply in love with her longtime partner Jonas Jones, has been patiently awaiting their wedding day. Their idyllic relationship takes a terrifying turn when a home intruder invades their peaceful sanctuary. Held captive in her own home, Yolanda is confronted with a shocking revelation that will forever alter the course of their lives.

Entries.Title: Echo Chamber
Entries.Description: An exploration in narcissistic desire, a kind of autoeroticopsis in being the subject of desire for yourself.

Entries.Title: Idol
Entries.Description: After facing backlash, Mark, a YouTuber, decides to stage his comeback by running a contest in which one lucky viewer will have the chance to join him in a video.

Entries.Title: The Spinner
Entries.Description: A mute girl working a redundant job as a sign spinner outside a restaurant finally gets a chance to ask out her crush, when she is suddenly set on a crash course with a local gangster.

Entries.Title: Fiddler’s Green
Entries.Description: At a rest stop bar in the middle of nowhere, a mysterious proprietor helps a guilt-ridden man reckon with his choices.

Entries.Title: The Wistman
Entries.Description: An ancient evil lurks in the wood.

Entries.Title: The Empty
Entries.Description: A panicked woman embarks on a quest for power.

Entries.Title: Mann's Sparks
Entries.Description: Ryland Walker Knight’s Mann’s Sparks is a hypnotic essay film that stitches together footage from Michael Mann’s iconic filmography with Beach House’s 2015 album Depression Cherry into an editorial masterstroke. As much as the film stands as a testament to Knight’s craft as editor, it also acts as a thematic dialogue between the dream pop band’s music and the images by one of cinema’s greatest auteurs, spanning Mann’s work from Thief (1981) to Blackhat (2015). It’s a mesmeric work, both visually and sonically, acting also as a document of Knight’s own development as an editor after suffering an injury and using Mann’s footage and the band’s album to relearn how to edit. Mann’s Sparks is a spellbinding celebration of cinematic language and how it can be reused, relearned, and reimagined into new possibilities.

Entries.Title: Cortes
Entries.Description: A man who found hair in his piggy bank, which led him into a trance through his memories and feelings.

Entries.Title: Until Morning
Entries.Description: Follow two groovy souls as they head to the disco underground and boogie on the dance floor of love.

Entries.Title: 继承权
Entries.Description: A reign of ruin.

Entries.Title: Beneath The Hat
Entries.Description: Two young men argue over work place etiquette and what is and isn’t appropriate to wear to work.

Entries.Title: Women & the Wind
Entries.Description: Shot over the course of 30 days at sea, filmmaker Alizé Jireh documents the group’s voyage across the North Atlantic—from moments of stillness and calm to the chaos of storms and setbacks. With an observational approach and an eye for the emotional and physical rhythms of life at sea, Jireh captures not just the external landscape, but the internal shifts that come with navigating the vast unknown.

Entries.Title: 2 Person
Entries.Description: Monica visits her daughter Ake in New York. The reunion does not play the way either of them had anticipated.

Entries.Title: Manor of Darkness
Entries.Description: A group of pretend filmmakers are stuck in a never-ending nightmare at the manor.

Entries.Title: Echo of existence
Entries.Description: Echo of Existence follows a young man planning suicide on the 16th day death ritual of his late uncle. Feeling like a burden, he isolates himself—only to be left at home with his separated sister’s son. As memories surface and generational pain echoes, he faces a critical choice: to end his life or break the cycle. A moving tale of trauma, connection, and the quiet power of presence.Through memory, silence, and unexpected connection, the film explores whether pain must be inherited—or if it can be broken.

Entries.Title: A Quarter Life Crisis
Entries.Description: Sam conquers superstitions and fate to win Dani's heart, embracing her true self and taking charge of her destiny in this heartwarming comedy.

Entries.Title: SCARECROW
Entries.Description: On his family’s farm, young Eli Miller uncovers a chilling truth that forces him to make an impossible choice.

Entries.Title: hello beautiful please follow back
Entries.Description: Her grandmother's relationship with an online romance scammer leads to a filmmaker's exploration into the ways in which we strive to connect through the internet.

Entries.Title: Blackboots
Entries.Description: A guilt-ridden bounty hunter, haunted by a massacre he unwittingly caused, partners with his manipulative father to track a vengeful outlaw, only to face a moral reckoning when their final standoff reveals the true cost of his past actions.

Entries.Title: HOW I GOT 100k VIEWS IN 3 DAYS USING THESE 5 SIMPLE HACKS
Entries.Description: A found footage film about a vlogger whose video is interrupted by something strange...

Entries.Title: The Five Steps of Irish Catholic Grieving
Entries.Description: After the death of his father, a teenager navigates the rituals of Irish Catholic mourning, only to grow disillusioned with its structured approach to grief.

Entries.Title: The Woman in the Bed
Entries.Description: An elderly woman awakes to discover she is unable to speak or move. Trapped in her bed, she soon realises that she is not alone.

Entries.Title: Della Can Fly!
Entries.Description: To preserve family history and rectify a family myth, an eccentric 80-something-year-old man needs to prove his long-lost sister can fly.

Entries.Title: Kiss Me Again
Entries.Description: One night, a protagonist finds themselves submerged into the sinister underbelly of nightlife. Music and drugs enhance a typical night out into a dreamlike state in which a series of nightmarish and murderous sexual transgressions unfold.

Entries.Title: September 10th, 1995
Entries.Description: A Simpsons superfan clashes with his roommate over his new hobby... building a time machine to September 10th, 1995, and winning the "Who Shot Mr. Burns" contest.

Entries.Title: In the Eye of the Storm: Shark Storm
Entries.Description: In the summer of 2024, dozens of cameras captured a rare outbreak of shark attacks along America's Gulf Coast; told exclusively through first-hand accounts of victims and eyewitnesses, nobody has seen all these perspectives unfold in real time.

Entries.Title: Abrahams Special Day
Entries.Description: A baby experiences family drama at a special celebration. This event takes a dark, mysterious turn.

Entries.Title: Don't Look Back
Entries.Description: Ava's 18th birthday goes wrong as terror roams the neighborhood. Can DeWayne save her?

Entries.Title: Uncaged
Entries.Description: A young NIL athlete confronts anxiety, identity, and survivor’s guilt in a symbolic therapy session, exposing the hidden costs of success and the mental toll of balancing pressure with opportunity.

Entries.Title: Dissidents
Entries.Description: An artist's sculpture is burnt down, a protester is charged with a criminal case, and a democracy movement is violently attacked. In the United States, three Chinese dissidents fight for democracy against a superpower through art, petition, and grassroots organizing, but not even exile is safe.

Entries.Title: All The Windows Are Closed
Entries.Description: Set in a mountain town in Mexico, the story centers on 11-year-old Cocoi, a curious and impulsive boy deeply attached to his older sister, Xiomara. With their father consumed by rigid traditions and a growing debt burden, Xiomara is Cocoi’s only source of comfort and guidance. Entries.Title: 63 Minutes of Great Comedy - A Stand Up Comedy Special

But between airport mishaps, sunset rituals, and a series of socially awkward moments, nerves start to creep in. With love, humor, and just the right touch of chaos, Bobo & Bibi in Miami is a hilarious, feel-good, and deeply relatable story that celebrates the kind of love that’s thoughtful, playful, and always shows up, especially when you need it most.

Entries.Title: The Straw Lady

Entries.Title: For The Dear Leader

Entries.Title: Markus Birdman: We Are All In The Gutter, But Some Of Us Are Looking At The Gutter
Entries.Description: We Are All In The Gutter, But Some Of Us Are Looking At The Gutter  About  In 2023, after 20 years of stand up, I did Britain’s Got Talent. People asked me, “why now?”. Up until that point I’d been very happy avoiding TV & fame - and in that sense, I’d been hugely successful! However, the year before, I’d also had a stroke and lost half my eyesight. I was now keen to talk about my experience, comedically, to as wide an audience as possible. I did quite well, got to the semi-finals & had my 15 minutes fame. Careful what you wish for! Who knew that talking about my experience would be so offensive? How dare I make jokes about my own strokes & blindness! “You nasty, awful man”.  This is a candid and hilarious new stand-up hour, talking about who I am, in an era where people are really keen to hear about who you are, so long as who you are, is something they want to hear about. Otherwise “you deserve your stroke”

Entries.Title: Ozzy Osbourne: Remembering a Rock God

Entries.Title: Brian Cox: Why black holes could hold the secret to time and space
Entries.Description: Black holes are forcing us to rethink everything we know about the very foundations and limits of physics. These mysterious objects challenge our understanding of time, space, and information. In this full interview from 2023, Physicist Brian Cox explains why black holes aren’t just theoretical endpoints, but could lead us to a deeper understanding of reality altogether.  What happens to information that falls into a black hole? Can space and time emerge from something more fundamental? And why did Einstein, Hawking, and generations of physicists struggle with the idea that these objects could even exi

When state regulators and inspectors threaten to shut down his farm for refusing industrial norms, he fights back with truth, courage, and a deep belief in God’s design for nature. At Polyface Farm, Joel’s innovative methods mimic natural processes to restore the land and raise healthier animals. Entries.Title: Gengus Ham

Born from blood, prophecy, and pork, Ham forged a brutal dynasty across the scorched earth, enslaving panthers, rats, birdfolk, and any creature who dared defy the Empire of Snout.  With his Bone Guard army at his command and the dark magic of the Bacon Priests behind him, Ham rises from obscure village runt to divine emperor. But as he conquers and consumes, an ancient curse stirs—one that threatens to tear apart his empire from within and haunt his descendants for generations.  GENGUS HAM is a sweeping, blood-soaked epic of war, myth, tyranny, and the twisted birth of a legacy. It's the untold prequel to the John Pork saga—where power is carved in bone, and destiny smells faintly of smoked meat.

On dry land, his son, Adrián, has just been born. Thirty years later, Adrián embarks for the Gran Sol, guided by those old recordings that his father filmed between networks, storms and dawns. In the solitude of the boat, with the engine vibrating in the chest and the wind hitting the deck, he tries to understand the distance that separated them. Recording his own journey, between memories and movement, he finds a way to approach, as if filming he could tell his father what he never dared to pronounce.

Entries.Title: Ride The Spiral To The End
Entries.Description: This film, in a way, sparked the very first glimmers of the Spiral Spectrum idea.  One night of the year 2023, , Amirhossein, feeling unwell, sat at the piano and played something—music that would later be used in the film. Soheil recorded an audio file that night, and the following day, while improvising with an old Panasonic Handycam, he played back the previous evening’s recording. The film you see is essentially a long, continuous one-take shot, captured through that process.  During the editing, additional sounds and textures were layered into the musical fabric— including the voice of Maynard James Keenan performing a live rendition of "Simultaneous," and sounds from conversations among astronauts during one of their exploratory missions.  In the end, it was after experiencing the final cut a few days later, once the editing was complete, that the essence of the Spiral Spectrum began to take shape in our minds.
I awoke to find that I had wandered from the straight path.

It’s a multi-billion-dollar industry.  Investigative journalist Steve Robinson sets out to reveal how Chinese mafia networks have quietly taken root in rural America—sometimes right next door.  This is a story you won’t hear anywhere else. And it’s high time to stop looking the other way.

After saving her life from thugs who try to attack her for having mafia money, Marcello moves Vanessa to his mansion against her will. As he continuously proves his commitment to keeping her safe from criminals, bullies, and his mafia family, Vanessa begins to develop feelings for him despite his player behavior and his murderous capacity. His gallbladder was removed, and though the operation was successful, complications followed. For three days, he stayed on oxygen, fighting not just for breath but for life itself. On the fourth day, something changed. He stood up. He walked. Against the odds, he was discharged. Now, he says it clearly. His stones are gone… but his life goes on. Stone gone. Life on.

Entries.Title: The MiG-21 Project

Also covered in the film is background on the MiG-21, including details about the plane used (decommissioned tail number 8971) and how MiGs’ presence in the Angolan Civil War ultimately hastened the end of white rule in South Africa. See historical footage and personal interviews, including the Polish pilot who flew tail number 8971 in the 1980s, a South African Border War pilot and the team of artists and craftspeople in Southern Africa and the United States who took on the huge task of covering the aircraft in tens of millions of glass beads.

Entries.Description: 'Surprise!' is a horror-comedy about a working class mum  who comes home to the worst surprise birthday party ever, organised by her infuriating husband and judgemental neighbours.

Entries.Title: Highway II
Entries.Description: A short film by Owen Patnaude.

Entries.Title: Chasing 100
Entries.Description: Cameron Balser had just returned home from his 12,000 mile run around the perimeter of the United States.  His home town running group, Meshingomesia Track Club, was hosting their annual last man standing/back yard ultra, "Prairie On Fire."  Prairie on Fire was going into their 3rd year as a race and they had yet to have anyone reach 100 miles. Cameron, who had won the race in 2023, was still recovering from his epic run, but, had made a promise to come back in 2024 to help achieve that milestone.

Entries.Title: The Intervention
Entries.Description: Blue comes home to find her three friends unexpectedly waiting for her.

Entries.Title: Apology
Entries.Description: An attempt at an apology

Entries.Title: Wargod
Entries.Description: A short documentary looking at an up and coming musicians goals and what made him choose the lifestyle he aspires for.

Entries.Title: SEISMA
Entries.Description: A group of scientists must excavate a gargantuan fossil.

Entries.Title: PHANTASMAPHOBIA
Entries.Description: After checking into Room 321 at the Marlin Hotel, David seems content alone in his new apartment writing scripts. Unfortunately for him, a ghostly presence is waiting for him there. Starring Jorge Gonzalez and Brandon Jimenez. Written and Directed by Jorge Gonzalez

Entries.Title: Roar
Entries.Description: A young alien takes us on a journey through his imagination and beyond as he defends the music box his father gave him.

Entries.Title: The Death of Scircle
Entries.Description: This concert film is an archive of the raw and unfiltered last performance in the infamous S-Circle apartment in Ithaca, NY.

Entries.Title: Bathed in the Night
Entries.Description: A girl and a cat wait out the apocalypse in a New York City apartment, until a lone light draws her out, leading her to face the darkest parts of the dystopian city belows.

Entries.Title: The Bike
Entries.Description: Blair, a quiet late-bloomer who has never been in a relationship, meets Robert, a charismatic hotshot. She finds herself swept up in their relationship and competing for attention with Robert's true love: his bike. As Blair tries to immerse herself in Robert's hobbies, she embarks on an unexpected journey of self-love.

Entries.Title: The Good Monkey Massacre
Entries.Description: When the boys go on vacation, they are soon met with a mysterious adversary: a man in a monkey mask who slowly begins picking them apart one by one.

Entries.Title: The Lost Boys
Entries.Description: The Lost Boys is an exploration of grief through the lens of film. It aims to stretch the bounds of what we think of the horror genre is capable and aims to tell a story that can only be told with the power of cinema. It's a picture with heart...and perhaps a tear.

Entries.Title: Out of Luck
Entries.Description: Two gunslingers and a corrupt sheriff meet for a final clash over an old-fashioned game of poker.

Entries.Title: Shorthanded
Entries.Description: A Hispanic hockey player battles through a shoulder injury as he tries to secure the last spot on a highly competitive team under the command of a coach with racist tendencies.

Entries.Title: Magdalena Bay: Live at Primavera Sound '25
Entries.Description: LA-based duo Magdalena Bay perform the entirety of their critically acclaimed sophomore album 'Imaginal Disk' live at the Primavera Sound festival in Barcelona, 5 June 2025.

Entries.Title: For the Love of Cats
Entries.Description: In the small mountain town of Barga, Italy, a group of four filmmakers speak with local cat lovers and immerse themselves in the unique world of street-trotting felines and Gattaras.

Entries.Title: Bad B*tch
Entries.Description: A relentless smalltown businesswoman takes on a ruthless local gang, seeking justice and retribution as she fights to rebuild her shattered community.

Entries.Title: Angst
Entries.Description: A man's disorienting experiences while he's being haunted by an unknown entity.

Entries.Title: The Pulsing Dark
Entries.Description: An alien organism blacks out all light and consumes the living.

Entries.Title: Blackpool
Entries.Description: After 30 years of too many downs and not enough ups on life’s rollercoaster, Billy embarks on a final lost weekend in the funfair of a town that is Blackpool.

Entries.Title: The White Elephant
Entries.Description: Inspired by the life of Queen Hnin Phyu Ma Shin (1821-1900) and the Massacre of the Mandalay Palace

Entries.Title: The Dark Room
