Entries.Description: Laura is moving into a new house. Daniel, who said he'd help, is nowhere to be found. And there's a mysterious light coming from under the basement door...

Entries.Title: PPP Queens
Entries.Description: The International PPP Queen seeks new recruits in the USA.

Entries.Title: The Cold Kill
Entries.Description: "The Cold Kill" is a tense short film that follows a maintenance crew as they head to a remote cabin in a snow ridden forest, to prepare the cabin for the upcoming season. As they navigate the chilling landscape, they stumble across a pile of dead bodies, realizing what's to come. Tensions rise within the group as fear and distrust emerge, forcing them to confront the threat of the killer "Smiley" but also their own instincts for survival even if it means leaving your friends behind.

Entries.Title: BEAMED
Entries.Description: Right before quitting his job, a ride share driver has an extra-terrestrial encounter.

Entries.Title: Days After
Entries.Description: A man who lost his family in a traffic accident and struggles to overcome his grief.

Entries.Title: Gloria
Entries.Description: Gloria, a Chinese woman in her 70s living alone and struggling with her memory, finds newfound purpose in teaching herself Spanish.

Entries.Title: The Elevator
Entries.Description: Donovan finds himself face-to-face with Paddy in a mysterious elevator that perpetually descends. With nothing else to do but talk, the two clash as Donovan searches for answers and Paddy refuses to give them.

Entries.Title: The Price of Hiding
Entries.Description: After escaping her dark past a young girl tries making a new friend to try and bring some normalcy to her life.

Entries.Title: New Brawler: JAE-YONG, the Karaoke King!
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: Dog in a Swimming Pool
Entries.Description: Magnum the dog has fun in his swimming pool on a hot summer day.

Entries.Title: The YoYo King
Entries.Description: Two young boys decide their fate to see who will become the next Yo Yo Master of their school. The only thing standing in their way is the legendary Yo Yo King!

Entries.Title: Just let me dream
Entries.Description: Ruben begins having blissful, heavenly dreams—but things take a dark turn when he no longer wants to wake up.

Entries.Title: ESTRELA
Entries.Description: In the light, art shines like glitter; in the shadows, it heals and saves. This documentary short follows two Drag stars, Lusea Star (Rodolfo Araujo) and Brigitte Bordô (Marina Espinoza), as they present their costumes and prepare for a performance. Along the way, they reflect on the powerful relationship they've built with their personas and art itself, revealing how these effects echo far beyond the stage.

Entries.Title: Dog Bone
Entries.Description: A kid by the name of "The Kiid" is living as a pet until a rag-tag-gang of kleptomaniacs bearing the name "The Piss Bandits" break into their domain, killing their keeper and kidnapping The Kiid in the process. The Kiid seeks revenge on the group of scavengers. In this harsh environment, only vultures of the wasteland survive.

Entries.Title: Tulsa
Entries.Description: Stereo photos of 1950s-era cocktail parties are transformed into an intense visual playland.

Entries.Title: Kings, Queens, and Jack Shit
Entries.Description: In a very low stakes gamble of Go Fish, J.J messes with his friend Charles by pulling an old joke that confuses the dealers name at a famous casino.

Entries.Title: Echo
Entries.Description: Michael is a young man caught in a downward spiral of drug addiction, plagued by insomnia and consumed by guilt over past mistakes. As he struggles to cope with his demons, a mysterious presence begins to haunt him - the ghost of his deceased mother. Unable to distinguish between reality and hallucination, Michael is forced to confront his innermost fears and with this, confront the ghosts of his past.

Entries.Title: Private Party
Entries.Description: A lonely woman lists her car for sale in the hopes of making some new friends.

Entries.Title: Tactile Light Diary
Entries.Description: Touch replicated through audiovisual means. Fabric structures exposed and magnified. Textiles dance over microphone and screen. Images burst to the forefront. First a beach, then an unclean pool. Summer slips into fall. Details are forgotten or misremembered. The retained memory of tactile objects. 8mm film presented with an asynchronous soundtrack.

Entries.Title: Carve
Entries.Description: After a couple arrives in a plaster workshop to order a custom made sculpture, the artist comes up with a different plan for them.

Entries.Title: Janete
Entries.Description: Cíntia works from home and lives alone, except for the company of Janete, her robot vacuum. Upon returning to in-person work, she confronts the exhaustion and the possibilities of her new routine.

Entries.Title: Is It Too Late?
Entries.Description: The world is ending, and two lost friends are at a crossroad between life and death. One has made up their mind, while the other must confront the spirit of their former friend to face this conflict.

Entries.Title: Preying Enemies
Entries.Description: When high-profile interior designer Kimberly Hightower goes missing while vacationing with friends, everyone is left searching for answers about her disappearance.

Entries.Title: NPP1P2, WAR PIG, Drawing Session
Entries.Description: 2 channel 16:9 color video w/ sound, duration: 16:50 min  An animated image flow of the absurd actions of male tyrants. Images of the world of male madness. The performance of drawing while in character was video recorded then later processed two separate times in collaboration with the machine, altering the range between the video recording of the performance and the written prompt – increasing and decreasing the hallucination.

Entries.Title: The Garden
Entries.Description: Sixteen-year-old Taylor Hill faces the turmoil of her parents' crumbling marriage, feeling responsible for their unhappiness. As her family's emotional distance grows, she finds solace in their once-beautiful garden, a symbol of better times. Struggling with guilt and longing for connection, Taylor embarks on a journey to understand her role in her family's strife, ultimately learning that love and forgiveness can bloom even in the most troubled seasons of life.

Entries.Title: Kiss Me Once
Entries.Description: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

Entries.Title: Lost.
Entries.Description: Short Film -  On a quiet night, a lonely man spends an hour engaging in his favorite activities, but soon he must face the consequences of his actions.

Entries.Title: Belladonna Museum
Entries.Description: “Belladonna Museum” is a short film that portrays a personal experience of a transgender woman in a tragic love relationship: it is a visual poetry that reinterprets iconic paintings from surrealism and post-impressionism to address themes such as emotional dependence, loneliness, objectification, the attachment and the abuse both emotional and physical.

Entries.Title: Bahala Na
Entries.Description: After learning to 'write what you know,' in film school, Half-Filipino and Half-White aspiring filmmaker Andrew Orticio travels back to his father's village in the Philippines to understand his mixed identity.

Entries.Title: 10s Across the Borders
Entries.Description: A documentary that tells the story of four trailblazers of the underground ballroom scene – an African American and Latino LGBTQ subculture that originated in New York City in the 1970s and ‘80s – who were the first to start this community in Thailand, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Singapore. We witness their journeys as they hold on to their found families, their dreams of connection with the ballroom culture’s American origins, and the growth of a flourishing community across Southeast Asia.

Entries.Title: Grievers
Entries.Description: Unsure of how to navigate a recent breakup, Penelope turns to a local community group for support. She soon discovers, however, that this eclectic mix is anything but normal, and everyone grieves in their own way.

Entries.Title: Johnny Cobweb
Entries.Description: In the humdrum suburb of Shillyville, Ohio, a feud is escalating between the generations-old Mortadelli Family Funeral Home, led by lazy patriarch Vincenzo Mortadelli, and the innovative new Johnny Cobweb Funeral Parlor, founded by eponymous upstart Johnny Cobweb. Each business vows to do whatever it takes to win more customers, even as an unprecedented string of murders rocks their cartoonish world.

Entries.Title: Gay Congress
Entries.Description: It's election season in Gay City, and three candidates prepare for Debate Night.

Entries.Title: Paypigs
Entries.Description: Veronica and Alessia, hosts of the Chemical X Podcast, go undercover for 24 hours looking for men who will be their Paypigs in a riveting, sometimes humorous but overall shocking social experiment.

Entries.Title: Toil and Spin
Entries.Description: Cast off from shore, into the dim, the dark. Away, away. Adrift in an oarless boat. Deep, deeper below the mirror surface. Then snap. Caught in eddies of regret, past slights, tasks undone, worries fresh and aged. Ever searching for a channel back to the elusive elsewhere. Toil and Spin uses the visual language of minimalism to describe sleep and sleeplessness.

Entries.Title: Funeral Rites
Entries.Description: A Steven Klein romance written by Madonna and presented by Carine Roitfeld and CR Fashion Book.

Entries.Title: Honeys
Entries.Description: A man recounts a vivid dream to his sleeping wife

Entries.Title: Sunflower
Entries.Description: In 2014, the University of Florida women's softball team was the best it's ever been - and it's all thanks to one young woman, Heather Braswell. Though not an official member of the team, Braswell, a cancer patient and huge Gator fan, was their heart and soul. Find out why the ladies still wear sunflowers on game day in their hair to this day.

Entries.Title: The Fencer
Entries.Description: An obsessive young fencer living under the shadow of her family's legacy contemplates the end of her career after receiving a life threatening injury.

Entries.Title: The Cowboy
Entries.Description: Ten years in the life of young cowboy Crowley as he comes of age in the vastness of Colorado. On his rocky path, he endures loss, separation, and shattered dreams.

Entries.Title: Whisper In My Ear
Entries.Description: As Paige and Roey tumble in and out of love, their relationship is viewed from the cosmos.

Entries.Title: A Forest Film
Entries.Description: Freeform shots of a forest layered on top of each other.

Entries.Title: As I Belong to my Life
Entries.Description: An exploration of the ways older bodies and psyches engage eros, gender, creativity, sexuality and desire. In a culture in which aging bodies are assumed to be sexless and considered neutered, what does it look and feel like to reclaim our erotic power?

Entries.Title: Game Over
Entries.Description: Two friends discover an off the market virtual reality game that turns deadly.

Entries.Title: Dewayne White: A Boy Named Shannon
Entries.Description: In his debut comedy special, Dewayne White tackles the issues that made him who he is today. From his parents' poor choice of names to his time in Iraq to his current role as a husband and father, Dewayne's energetic and irreverent style will have you roaring with laughter.

Entries.Title: Piggy
Entries.Description: A prison guard begins the precarious process of courting a woman who believes she is writing to a serial killer

Entries.Title: Emergence
Entries.Description: Made in response to Brakhage’s The Act of Seeing with One’s Own Eyes, Devereaux turns his camera on the gardens of Loring Park in Minneapolis, attempting with reckless abandon to capture every flower in sight. The film emerges as an impressionistic study of color and form—fragments slipping out of frame, dissolving into blur, or flaring into pure surface. These fleeting images converge into unpredictable patterns of sensation and meaning.

Entries.Title: Bedlam in Bethesda
Entries.Description: A heavy yet joyful documentary about a boy navigating the world

Entries.Title: Rongo, God of Peace
Entries.Description: A young Maori man is kidnapped by a Pākehā Doctor, who will stop at nothing to further his understanding of race relations in New Zealand.

Entries.Title: Dream Canyon
Entries.Description: A traveling sex worker named Dhalia becomes stranded in a small desert town in Idaho. She meets a group of locals willing to help, but only as long as she stays.

Entries.Title: Kampung Buah
Entries.Description: Brunei's first animated children's series, Kampung Buah follows Daniel the Durian—a spiky little fruit with a big heart—as he tries to make friends. Despite his prickly shell, Daniel learns that being different is what makes him special.

Entries.Title: Red Sands
Entries.Description: Along the El Paso-Juárez border, Mexican-American off-roaders forge their identity in the crimson dunes of the Chihuahuan desert. As they navigate their cultural legacy, their passion for adventure faces mounting challenges.

Entries.Title: Drainomania
Entries.Description: Unaware that her relationship is at a crossroads, lovable daydreamer Katie fails to complete a simple task at her girlfriend's request: to clean the bathroom. As a result, Katie finds herself swirling into a fever dream that could tear her apart or maybe bind them together forever.

Entries.Title: Pinch of Fantasy
Entries.Description: After a documentary he made about the death of his mother bombs at a festival, Dylan is sent on a path of redemption by a fellow film buff.

Entries.Title: Dan and Monty
Entries.Description: Dan and Monty are two rabbits waiting for their package. After an agonizingly long wait, they decide to take matters into their own hands.

Entries.Title: Free Solo: The Musical
Entries.Description: The official recorded film of "Free Solo: The Musical" by Kelly Reilly and Kyle Hancher.

Entries.Title: Aeterna
Entries.Description: A haunting reminder of the importance of self-acceptance and the ephemeral nature of physical beauty, urging the audience to reflect on the true essence of what makes us beautiful.

Entries.Title: My Fourth Wall
Entries.Description: Logan is an amateur musician about to go through with his first ever performance, but his awareness of the camera makes it quite difficult to practice.

Entries.Title: A Certain Kind of Quiet
Entries.Description: Sierra joins her ex and her ex's new boyfriend on a weekend trip. Some things are said, most aren't.

Entries.Title: Off Season
Entries.Description: Reeling from a recent tragedy, a couple finds life upended when a new family moves in next door.

Entries.Title: Greed
Entries.Description: An everyday average-joe named Steven gets an ominous wishing stone while gambling with a group of friends. The stone grants any wish, creating a slippery slope for its user.

Entries.Title: Street Fighter 8 (Finish Him)
Entries.Description: The final chapter. Balthasar turned all wimen on earth in to Merle and starts his conquest to rule the whole world. Nick and Luca the two only survivors of the deadly conflict angainst Balthasar, are trying to build a team that could stop the purple gigant from dominating the mordern world. Balthasar and the Boys are are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of Merle, Balthasar, the Boys and the future for even human beeing on earth.

Entries.Title: Legends of the Underworld!
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: I Stole an Alien Baby
Entries.Description: A group of friends go camping, hoping to have one last trip together before they have to grow up and join the scary world of adulthood. However, their trip is cut short when something crash lands in the woods.

Entries.Title: So Far All Good
Entries.Description: Following a stint in prison, a young man returns to friends and family waiting for him across New York. Except his girl has moved on, money ain’t what it used to be and this isn’t the same bustling city he left behind. It’s all good.

Entries.Title: The Story of a Rock
Entries.Description: When a young girl’s mother goes off to the Middle East for migration work and disappears she is confronted with unendurable circumstances of eviction, overdue tuition and a grocer’s ultimatum which forces her to become a house maid.

Entries.Title: The Company of the Wattersnip Corsairs
Entries.Description: The absurd adventures of two pirates and a cowboy on an endless riverfront.

Entries.Title: Visions Of Strangers
Entries.Description: A man attempts to process a recurring vision of two strangers on a beach.

Entries.Title: Click Click
Entries.Description: Fearing him suicidal after a breakup, Daniel Boyd rushes to check on his buddy John who's holed up in the sketchiest motel this side of the Raritan River. There they find their understanding of love, friendship, and the world tested by the barrel of a gun.

Entries.Title: BOYHOOD
Entries.Description: When an egotistical teenage boy is given criticism about his script writing from his friends he becomes bitter...which leads him into entering his own world of make believe.

Entries.Title: Guard's Worst Nightmare
Entries.Description: When a chemistry experiment goes wrong at a laboratory, echoes of screams are heard throughout the halls. It's up to lazy and loud-mouthed entry guard to investigate and stop whatever might be causing this.

Entries.Title: A Woman Without Clothes Tries To Sleep
Entries.Description: A woman, alone in her apartment, tries to go to sleep but is overwhelmed with a flash of memories and emotions.

Entries.Title: Down to Zero
Entries.Description: “Down to Zero” follows Kyle as he goes on an introspective journey after a harsh truth is delivered by his childhood barber.

Entries.Title: Amber Window
Entries.Description: Through a glass of beer on the windowsill. Ambient sound.

Entries.Title: My Best Friend Molly
Entries.Description: A timid college senior attends a party where she meets her polar opposite and makes a decision that alters her life permanently.

Entries.Title: Legacy
Entries.Description: Imagine that Drake, Kendrick Lamar, Beyonce and Cardi B all moved to Scandinavia. They played gigs at local clubs and toured school auditoriums all over their adopted countries, while finding partners and having children at the same time.  This did happen, just in a previous era. From the late 1950s up to the 1970s, some of the greatest African-American jazz musicians moved to Sweden/Scandinavia, making new families and a lasting musical impression on the country.  LEGACY is an account of their lives, their music and their families and their legacies. We follow their children, now grown, who share their stories for the first time: about growing up with a world-famous father, yet getting teased at school about their dark skin.  This film is as much a documentary about music as it is a portrait of how individual experiences of race, visions of society and artistic dreams intersect, giving rise to an entirely new musical experience.

Entries.Title: Angpao, diskarteng Badjao
Entries.Description: The story explores the life of three Badjao brothers, Diether, Rakmel, and Agi, who beg on jeepneys. This documentary captures the difficult realities the siblings face every day in the bustling streets of Manila, where they are often unnoticed and ignored by society. By speaking out and supporting initiatives to alleviate inequity,  Angpao, diskarteng Badjao encourages viewers to acknowledge these problems and take action.

Entries.Title: Up Close
Entries.Description: Created for Close-Up Cinema's 20th Anniversary

Entries.Title: Sew into You
Entries.Description: An older woman desires to explore her first relationship with a woman, with the help from her younger queer coworker.

Entries.Title: Songs Overheard in the Shadows
Entries.Description: Balanced on the edge of what is visible, everything comes from nothingness and returns to nothingness. Strands of consciousness trying to convene with each other. Forms of personal significance in a time of crisis, set free into random motion through chance operations. Recurring details point towards a center.

Entries.Title: Medium
Entries.Description: The medium is the message. A musical-comedy-thriller by the stalwart multihyphenate Ari Angkasa experimenting with the urgency of live performance as a medium for filmmaking in politically turbulent times.

Entries.Title: Before the Moon Falls
Entries.Description: In May 2024, news of a murder in the Polynesian nation of Samoa rocked the Pacific. The perpetrator, Sia Figiel, was a trailblazing novelist and poet who won international acclaim for being the first to write about the difficult realities Samoan girls and women face. The victim was her friend, who was also a poet.

Entries.Title: The One of the Girl
Entries.Description: Sue, a newly out nonbinary person, comes to terms with their situationship.

Entries.Title: Donor
Entries.Description: A grieving mother struggles to process her reality when she meets her stillborn daughter a year after her passing.

Entries.Title: In the Valley
Entries.Description: Lost in the vast Southern California desert, Josh wakes alone after a night with a mysterious Cowboy. As the landscape twists into a waking nightmare, Josh must uncover the truth about the Cowboy, the cloaked figures watching him, and his own forgotten past—before the desert claims him forever.

Entries.Title: The Ned Kelly
Entries.Description: A 20-something rebels against the stinking government!

Entries.Title: Conversation One Night
Entries.Description: Following the passing of his wife, a wealthy widower hosts an evening dinner. Amidst the festivities, his daughter's boyfriend prepares to propose, and in love, things are never guaranteed. Meanwhile, the culinary master struggles to comprehend the situation, and an unknown event occurs outside.

Entries.Title: The Sneeze: Part Two
Entries.Description: A comedic docu-essay looking at the legacy of "Fred Ott's Sneeze," one of the first films ever made. Official selection of The Indie Gathering International Film Festival.

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Besties
Entries.Description: After accidentally surviving an apocalypse, best friends Sam and Becky decide it's up to them to save and repopulate the earth. Step one: take out each other’s IUDs.

Entries.Title: FLEDGELINGS
Entries.Description: Four feathered childhood friends bond over their shared obsession with dinosaurs. One day, the pressures of growing up threaten to tear them apart.

Entries.Title: Rhino King
Entries.Description: James, a jobless husband, grapples with strained marriage as wife Sarah's career thrives. Left behind, he embarks on self-discovery journey, seeking purpose and worth amidst unfulfilled dreams and marital turmoil.

Entries.Title: QLC
Entries.Description: After witnessing a harrowing murder, three strangers are forced to rely on each other as they navigate a chaotic nocturnal odyssey.

Entries.Title: Surgeons
Entries.Description: Can two fake surgeons mend a real broken heart?

Entries.Title: As Told by a Corpse
Entries.Description: Nearly twenty five years after their birth, an entity embraces the end and rejects familial expectations.

Entries.Title: Sober by Monday
Entries.Description: After eating a drugged brownie, John's weekend slowly gets weirder and weirder as he tries his best to find a way to get sober by Monday!

Entries.Title: Love Me Bait Me: The Power of Queer Representation
Entries.Description: This feature documentary explores the historical relationship between Hollywood, television, and the authentic portrayal of diverse LGBTQ+ experiences over the course of more than a century. Interviews and archival footage provide a critique of the U.S. film industry that emphasizes the life-saving role storytelling plays in our collective imagination for a better future.

Entries.Title: Add Up My Love
Entries.Description: A coming of age story set in Colorado Springs, Colorado.

Entries.Title: A Call
Entries.Description: In the darkest hour even a call can summon light

Entries.Title: Parasocial
Entries.Description: A Model reckons with her role as being watched.

Entries.Title: Una Película Sustituta
Entries.Description: A fifteen meter Super 8 film arrives, with no sign of title or author, by mail to an archive. It does not show signs of having ever been passed through a projector. It gets lost before it ever has a chance of being preserved. This film, composed by means of a text, attempts to describe the now lost images contained in that reel.

Entries.Title: Embers
Entries.Description: Andy, a firefighter and dad, spends a day with his daughter as he creeps ever closer to a PTSD attack. After a fire gone wrong, Andy is left feeling responsible and crippled by his guilt. Divorced by his wife and distant from his daughter, can he come to terms with himself before it's too late?

Entries.Title: Going Pop
Entries.Description: After a “hot mic” blunder tanked her career, singer/songwriter Courtney is now attempting a comeback as a raunchy pop princess. Set on the chaotic day of her latest album release, Courtney and her oddball team reintroduce her to the world.

Entries.Title: Eyelashes
Entries.Description: A newcomer to London must choose between his Islamic faith and the opportunity of a lifetime.

Entries.Title: Blair witch:Lost Footage
Entries.Description: As the unknown cameraman investigates the woods of blair, he soon discovers all legends are true and has to survive the woods

Entries.Title: It's Different For Girls
Entries.Description: In the post–Roe v. Wade United States, scientists are on the cusp of a watershed moment in birth control, the introduction of new, viable male contraceptives. As we watch brave individuals fight to make medical history, Big Pharma’s reluctance to invest in these new products remains a maddening obstacle to the groundbreaking prospect of changing family planning and gender politics forever.

Entries.Title: Quiet as Kept
Entries.Description: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

Entries.Title: Audio and Visual Experiment 22
Entries.Description: The twenty-second in an ongoing series of collaborations between Gf Savages and various audio editors.

Entries.Title: Tales of the Diaspora
Entries.Description: Tales of the Diaspora is the debut film from xxiivanu productions, and was conceived as a love letter to Pasifika youth around the world, as they navigate the sometimes tumultuous waves of finding and retaining cultural identity whilst growing up away from their homelands.

Entries.Title: Sweet Dreams Are Made Of This
Entries.Description: Max is having trouble sleeping.

Entries.Title: A Farmer and the Killer
Entries.Description: The peaceful day of the farmer came to an end when the ruthless Killer trespassed onto his land, leading to a confrontation between the farmer and the killer.

Entries.Title: Lifeguard
Entries.Description: Caught between paranoia and boredom, an injured ballerina must choose to sacrifice herself or her only friend.

Entries.Title: Hockey IV
Entries.Description: Skateboarding’s toughest team’s got a new flick.

Entries.Title: Sean Lucy - Cinnamon Toast Crunch
Entries.Description: Stop motion animation music video for the song Cinnamon Toast Crunch by Sean Lucy.

Entries.Title: Bone Heist
Entries.Description: Two skeletons Fig and Tig are ordered by there master Rey two infiltrate a building and steal a relic called the crystal skull

Entries.Title: Gamle dager
Entries.Description: What happens if you get too hung up on the old days?

Entries.Title: The Actual Reason Japan Attacked Pearl Harbor
Entries.Description: From the Meiji Restoration to the Great Depression, from Japan's war of conquests across Asia, to the State Department and the negotiations between the two nations, from plans of Isroku Yamamoto to the attack on Pearl Harbor itself, join us as we take you step by step and chapter by chapter, of how the United States was drawn into the most deadly conflict in human history.

Entries.Title: Stillness Spreads
Entries.Description: There is a snuff film being passed around within a cult hiding a terrifying secret. Illusions, magic, and treachery fills the dreams of the elusive characters and their unreliable narrator.

Entries.Title: Puberty for Humans
Entries.Description: Puberty for Humans is perfect for your nervous health class students as they approach their inevitable cybernetic bodily changes. In this short educational video, Linus, an insecure prepubescent teenager, learns that everything will be okay… for everyone else.

Entries.Title: To See In The Dark
Entries.Description: Someone with a tragic background is being controlled by a larger than life group.

Entries.Title: Conditio Humana
Entries.Description: An elusive 16mm miniature from the legendary Friedl vom Gröller, Conditio Humana intersperses footage of the crumbling sandstone façade of Pavia’s Basilica di San Michele Maggiore with the returned stares of three performers.

Entries.Title: Kaju Katli
Entries.Description: Akshay, a Marathi-American teenager struggles to prepare kaju katli for the annual Diwali party, consumed by grief. He is forced to reckon with the true reason he is struggling to create this dessert, redefining his place in his culture.

Entries.Title: A Baleful Reunion
Entries.Description: Struggling to make ends meet, Reuben's desperation for money lands him in a cyber theft scheme that seems seemingly straightforward. Things take a turn when the victim turns out to be an old friend.

Entries.Title: A Suburban Night's Dream
Entries.Description: At a dinner party in quiet suburbia, a sinister plot is formed amongst a group of friends when one is late to arrive

Entries.Title: A Field, A Body, An Angel
Entries.Description: A lonely detective embarks on a surreal odyssey when dreams of a dead serial killer entwine with a bizarre unsolved mystery.

Entries.Title: Charlotte, Bloody Charlotte
Entries.Description: Charlotte takes revenge on the woman whose bullying led to her losing her eye.

Entries.Title: Envelope
Entries.Description: Two young girls search out their respective fates and futures in 60's Hollywood, amidst confusion from their personal lives and an envelope that shed light on destiny.

Entries.Title: The Making of LEGO Island
Entries.Description: Dive deep into the brick-by-brick construction of a digital paradise with this captivating documentary exploring the creation of LEGO Island. Featuring exclusive interviews with the game's developers, this film chronicles the journey behind the beloved 90s classic, offering a behind-the-scenes look at its origins, development challenges, and enduring legacy.

Entries.Title: CORRA
Entries.Description: When an injury breaks her body but not her will, a runner keeps pushing, chasing the edge until obsession overtakes reality. Haunted by fear and visions, she discovers the one thing she can’t outrun is herself.

Entries.Title: I'm Not A Hitman
Entries.Description: In the middle of a standoff, two men debate whether one of them might be a hitman.

Entries.Title: Palliative
Entries.Description: Low on money and time, free spirited Brian risks anything and anyone to get what he needs by the end of the day.

Entries.Title: The Redeemables Part 2
Entries.Description: A true events squatter comedy that focuses on New York City's landlord tenant laws. When his love interest invites suspicious people to move into his house a young man seeks out ways to evict them which includes hiring want-to-be mobsters

Entries.Title: Still Here
Entries.Description: Following a car accident, siblings Bryan and Casey are stranded at a nearby motel. What happens when there’s more to the room that meets the eye?

Entries.Title: The Good Times
Entries.Description: Vincent, now settled, recalls his past affiliations with the mob and the crime family he was initiated into.

Entries.Title: Wavelength / Abstracted
Entries.Description: Swirling lines of various colors, beams of light dancing in the darkness to the tune of ambient noise = Bill Bedford’s particular brand of cinematic magic.

Entries.Title: PBF #02, Milano
Entries.Description: This slideshow serves as documentation of a Super 8 cartridge filmed in the Anna Del Bo Boffino in Milan in July 2024. Under the same premise of the first film of the project, five people gather in a park, this time around a plastic chair, and exchange their favorite pocketable books. Summer activities such as throwing a plane make their way into the film. Moving images are brought to a stop in their final form as slides and, as is the case for an image in a book, the viewer is forced to imagine their movement. This is the result of a collaboration between PocketBookFilms and milano based artist collective, Hercole.  Participants: Davide Ausenda, Laura Salomoni, Martina Caruso, Margherita Piazza, Alexander Gabriel and Lucas Variz.

Entries.Title: Scarlett's Colorful Friends
Entries.Description: A mysterious government project known as Project: Mystic has been leaked by a whistleblower. It was an experiment about the effects of magic on the human body and was conducted on children. This of course begs the question: What happened to the children?

Entries.Title: The Recipe
Entries.Description: A short narrative film.

Entries.Title: Untitled Oliver Jukes Movie
Entries.Description: A bomb is counting down to explode while a man laughs every minute.

Entries.Title: Say My Name
Entries.Description: Mason Oliver Reed has an ear for music and a dark secret. When a mysterious doll appears on his doorstep, whispers grow louder, shadows creep closer, and one chilling demand echoes through it all: “Say my name.”

Entries.Title: The Finisher: Jasmin Paris and the Barkley Marathons
Entries.Description: In 2024, Jasmin Paris made history by becoming the first woman to finish the Barkley Marathons, widely known as one of the hardest races in the world and a defining test in ultrarunning and trail running. With over 100 miles of brutal terrain, cryptic course markings, and a near-impossible success rate, the Barkley has long been considered the ultimate challenge in endurance sports. The Finisher" chronicles Jasmin’s extraordinary three-year journey (2022–2024) to achieve this groundbreaking feat.

Entries.Title: Bee-Kept
Entries.Description: A swarm-hearted documentary on bees and beekeeping in Ireland. Bee-Kept is a documentary that feels like a visit to a secret apiary, or a conversation with a beekeeper-joyful, rambling, inspiring and packed full of information (and opinions!) about honeybees. Narrated by Alison Spittle. Ask four beekeepers a question, get five different answers-or so any beekeeper will tell you. Beekeepers are a curious species, and just like the bees they keep, the group is often more mysterious than the individual.

Entries.Title: Daddy
Entries.Description: A father and son take a stroll with the supernatural.

Entries.Title: My Little Pony The Movie: Shattered Harmony
Entries.Description: In a desperate final battle against Queen Chrysalis, Cadence must overcome her heartbreak and reignite the power of love before the world succumbs to darkness forever.  Will her shattered heart doom Equestria, or can she prove that love’s light can outshine even the deepest despair?

Entries.Title: Johanna Larsen's Super Duper Cool House Tour
Entries.Description: Johanna Larsen gives a very detailed tour of her house while speaking Español.

Entries.Title: In Pictures Did You Get It Right?
Entries.Description: A love letter to the first three months of the Coronavirus pandemic.

Entries.Title: Shelly
Entries.Description: Phillip meets with Shelly, a patient suffering from dementia, to ask her a series of question about her life. As the story unfolds, his questions and the truth of his identity are revealed. The narrative highlights the struggles faced by those with dementia and their loved ones.

Entries.Title: Desperate Measures
Entries.Description: A young couple seeking counsel heads to a remote cabin in the woods.

Entries.Title: Trinity
Entries.Description: An actress and a detective search for a missing friend, uncovering a path of transformation under the guidance of a mysterious spiritual leader.

Entries.Title: Titania
Entries.Description: In the most advanced underwater base in the world, Titania, something has been unleashed now a team of experts, will have to discover who or what is trying to kill them, a journey into the delusions of the mind that will surround the team.

Entries.Title: The Melancholy of Resistance
Entries.Description: From the Berlin State Opera comes the premiere of an acclaimed multimedia creation that blends opera and film: Marc-André Dalbavie and Guillaume Métayer's adaptation of László Krasznahorkai's allegorical bestseller The Melancholy of Resistance, boasting an all-star cast with Philippe Jaroussky, Sandrine Piau, Matthias Klink, and Tanja Ariana Baumgartner! A slowly decaying small town is thrown into disarray by the appearance of a bizarre circus that features an enormous whale and a three-eyed Prince — an arrival that ultimately leads the townspeople toward the chaos of rebellion, groupthink, and totalitarianism. All throughout, David Marton's canny direction allows us a multifaceted view of events, as onstage action is juxtaposed with parallel scenes projected live from a filmed set behind the screen.

Entries.Title: Open Mic
Entries.Description: A conversation Harper has with herself in her own head, interjected with the moments in which she is recalling. Some sort of event sent her into an existential state of mind, where she can't help but think about who she is, and how much control she really has over her life.

Entries.Title: Game of Catch
Entries.Description: With just a day before his prison sentence, a father does all he can to win back his son's love.

Entries.Title: Encuerados
Entries.Description: Encuerados chronicles the year-long involvement of seven Latino men in the leather scene, primarily focusing on the historical attainment of the first Latino man winning the title of Mr. Los Angeles Leather, Leo Iriarte. By showcasing the legacy of Leo, Encuerados takes a deep dive into the leadership of seven trailblazers, empowered to create representation in leather competitions such as MLAL, IML, and events, such as Up Your Alley, Folsom, CLAW LA, and Pride.

Entries.Title: Anything Can Change
Entries.Description: A depressed young man finds comfort in reliving the memories he had with a video game from his childhood.

Entries.Title: ...post
Entries.Description: An overly ambitious paperboy delivers newspapers at the dawn of the most important day in human history.

Entries.Title: Opposite Environments
Entries.Description: Filmed over five years across varied sites, Devereaux gives quiet attention to the shifting sensations of place. From rain and snow to beaches, mountains, and city streets, the film traces environments in contrast: rural and urban, water and land, summer and winter. These images, held in long takes, resist narrative flow, instead assembling a meditation on how landscapes provoke moods, memories, and ideas.

Entries.Title: Hope in High Water
Entries.Description: Trymaine Lee returns to New Orleans and the Mississippi Gulf Coast, where he first reported on Hurricane Katrina, one of the deadliest disasters in American history, as part of the Times-Picayune newsroom. Two decades later, this in-depth documentary traces the arc of recovery through the voices of those who never left: local leaders who have spent many years not only rebuilding but reimagining the systems that failed their communities long before the storm.

Entries.Title: Hold It Together
Entries.Description: While trapped in a meeting, the office scumbag must face the ultimate nightmare when realizing he needs to go to the ever awaiting bathroom... Really. Bad.

Entries.Title: Ai wa Tanken (Love is a Dagger)
Entries.Description: Amelia and Wes have had a falling out in Japan, a foreign land neither of them are accustomed to. While doing some soul-searching on her own, Amelia begins to notice that she's being stalked by a strange man. Wes pleads with her to come back for her own safety - but Amelia's about to find that sometimes the most familiar faces are the most misgiving.

Entries.Title: Beyond The Reach
Entries.Description: A behind-the-scenes documentary about the final year of production on Matty Thomas Taylor's short film 'The Reach'.

Entries.Title: IMAGE BREAKER 1970s CINEFEMINISMS
Entries.Description: Initially created for a new alternative distribution network, Miss Video 4U, modeled after the 1990's Joanie4Jackie video chain letter, IMAGE BREAKER explores the history of the Big Miss Moviola/Joanie4Jackie series to take viewers further back to the mid 1970s when another, less well known, feminist video exchange took place, International VIDEOLETTERS. Then 27 feminist media groups participated in a two year bi-monthly video exchange. After giving a brief introduction through clips and art work, this less than ten minute video quickly explores 13 other 1970s feminist media that are MISSING / UNKNOWN / UNSHOWN. Spunky and quirky, the work could evolve into a Feminist/Gender and Cinema Studies teaching tool and put some of this germinal feminist work back on the cinema history map.

Entries.Title: Finte
Entries.Description: On a rainy afternoon, three adolescent girls rehearse a dance that takes on a life of its own, somewhere between innocence and awareness.

Entries.Title: A Nice View
Entries.Description: A painter struggles with inspiration.

Entries.Title: Dive 2: The Journey Continues
Entries.Description: Vignesh, a skilled swimmer, thinks winning in the pool is all he needs for success. But when his teammate Aanya quits swimming to focus on studies, he starts rethinking his choices. Struggling with school and swimming, Vignesh feels lost until his mom encourages him to find balance. With hard work, he improves in both and learns that real success comes from giving your best in all areas of life.

Entries.Title: Meme Gods
Entries.Description: Meme Gods, directed by Sean Flax and Bryan Black along with executive producer Cedric the Entertainer, will take a deep dive into the world of internet memes and explore their origins, and comedic and cultural significance.

Entries.Title: Something About the Briggs
Entries.Description: "Something About the Briggs" is a Love, Marriage, and Family focused film.

Entries.Title: Single Blind
Entries.Description: In the near future, a man is selected to go through a memory program where his life is forever altered.

Entries.Title: Mount Mutombo
Entries.Description: A powerful chronicle of the extraordinary life of NBA legend Dikembe Mutombo. Through rare interviews with teammates, coaches, and family, the film captures Dikembe’s journey from his humble beginnings in Congo to his immense impact on and off the basketball court.

Entries.Title: REMNIRA
Entries.Description: After discovering a mysterious camera that transports him into fleeting moments of the past, a grieving photography student attempts to rewrite a painful history—only to uncover the blurred line between memory, art, and reality.

Entries.Title: A Source of Light
Entries.Description: An antisocial man deals with the effects of his long-term roommate moving away.

Entries.Title: The Sapphire Door
Entries.Description: After struggling to conceive, Rose and Arthur's once-solid relationship begins to unravel, forcing them to redefine love and family.

Entries.Title: Should Anyone Be Ashamed Of Their Nation's History? Should Anyone Be Proud Of It?
Entries.Description: A documentary exploring national responsibility, guilt and pride vs. shame in regarding one's history.

Entries.Title: Domestic Animals
Entries.Description: On the brink of their thirties, five longtime friends reunite for a farewell getaway, but their idyllic retreat turns sour when they lose their beloved dogs in the woods.

Entries.Title: The Invisible Mammal
Entries.Description: Against the backdrop of the sixth mass extinction, an all-woman team of biologists set out to save bats from a deadly fungal disease, but when the COVID-19 pandemic interrupts their work, they are sent down a path of discovery that illuminates the connections between bat conservation and the spread of infectious disease.

Entries.Title: Cars Land | Disneyland Resort
Entries.Description: Stroll through Cars Land in this cozy and colorful Point of View walkthrough of Radiator Springs.

Entries.Title: Small Town Spectres
Entries.Description: A crowbar-wielding serial killer makes a shocking comeback. Determined to uncover the truth and gain closure, Jessica Miller teams up with her cousin to document the killer responsible for her parents’ murder.

Entries.Title: Everything In This World Is Exactly What It Is
Entries.Description: As her memories begin to fade, a woman in the autumn of her life spends her days with a teenage girl, whose profound presence forces her to confront her memories and, ultimately, her sense of self.

Entries.Title: Spotify Presents: Addison - The Debut
Entries.Description: Go behind the scenes of Addison's debut solo performance at The Box in NYC. This intimate short film captures her creative process and the start of an exciting new chapter.

Entries.Title: Pinball Go to the Movies!
Entries.Description: A run-through of, art rock duo, Pinball's formation, discography, and all-around existence, with featured interview snippets from other musicians, record store owners, and visual artists.

Entries.Title: Orval
Entries.Description: Two friends get into a minor dispute over breakfast.

Entries.Title: Outstretched Hands
Entries.Description: Two young men embark on a seemingly normal night but are surprised with a tragedy in a suburban area.

Entries.Title: Faceless Characters
Entries.Description: A short film by Lucas Yap.

Entries.Title: Wired Differently
Entries.Description: A boy with ADHD struggles to connect with his brother, who resents his differences, until a heated argument and fight forces them to see their relationship in a new direction.

Entries.Title: TITAN
Entries.Description: Navigating the start of adulthood, a disillusioned twentysomething ventures into the forest in search of a monster. What they'll find will test their understanding of reality and awaken a longing for a childhood they hadn’t realized was coming to an end.

Entries.Title: The Seductress From Hell
Entries.Description: A Hollywood actress undergoes a horrific transformation after being pushed to the edge by her psychopathic husband.

Entries.Title: Rabbuní
Entries.Description: Amidst the turmoil and uncertainty, a testimony of faith emerges that defies the limits of reason. Rabbuni, the new documentary that follows the prayer workshops taught by Marian Reynoso alongside Fr. Juan María Solana, director and founder of Magdala, immerses us in an unprecedented spiritual journey. What began as a project to document these workshops in the Holy Land transformed into an experience of prayer in the midst of war, an unexpected conversion, and a reminder that faith can flourish in any circumstance.

Entries.Title: We Make the TV Glow
Entries.Description: A feature-length queer glitch art remix – or, "wave" – of Jane Schoenbrun's I Saw the TV Glow (2024), divided into 9 segments... each helmed by different editors.

Entries.Title: Somnia
Entries.Description: A tale of love, wonder, and dreams

Entries.Title: A Soldier Out of Time
Entries.Description: What year is it?

Entries.Title: Two Croissants
Entries.Description: Two croissants are confronted with the grim reality of human barbarism

Entries.Title: Audio and Visual Experiment 24
Entries.Description: The twenty-forth in an ongoing series of collaborations between Gf Savages and various audio editors.

Entries.Title: Ribbit
Entries.Description: A young boy named Alfie struggles to adjust to a new environment and inattentive parents, but finds solace in the company of a toy frog named Ribbit.

Entries.Title: Debut, or, Objects of the Field of Debris as Currently Catalogued
Entries.Description: The first feature-length film by Julian Castronovo follows a young filmmaker named Julian Castronovo who discovers a trail of clues related to the disappearance of a skilled art forger known as Fawn Ma.

Entries.Title: Pictures of a negative chair
Entries.Description: An account of a scientist trying to teach machines how to infer depth from two-dimensional pictures. A parable of a prince trying to resurrect his lover by fashioning a chair out of his lover’s things. A question about the need for human beings, and the things they are in need of.

Entries.Title: Lunette
Entries.Description: Shot at night in Paris through various magnifiers, this most iconic city becomes unfamiliar, and then somewhat familiar again.

Entries.Title: Toy Vlog Hunt
Entries.Description: Just a regular toy vlogger stalking the aisles of your local store as usual, beware.

Entries.Title: The Nucleus of Our Love
Entries.Description: An overzealous bureaucrat invades the sanctity of a nuclear family and their beloved bomb.

Entries.Title: Sukari
Entries.Description: A conservative Muslim man’s life is turned upside down when his wife demands an orgasm.

Entries.Title: Solitude...
Entries.Description: What once used to be his everlasting dream, only fills the vacant atmosphere of the resounding theater as Frank tells a story about how he met his love; Cecelia. Reminiscing through dances shared for two, Frank is raptured and beguiled into the fragment of his life.

Entries.Title: Bradlee
Entries.Description: The surreal, experimental story of an unseen serial killer.

Entries.Title: to write the ending
Entries.Description: When a street poet finds a typewriter that allows him to write the future, he uses it to try and find love.

Entries.Title: Holy G Thy Angel
Entries.Description: Holy G, the planet’s guardian angel, struggles to recover the Mo-Nad’s degenerating baby-form. Film 2 in the DIAPHANUS Tetralogy.

Entries.Title: Do NOT eat Doug's wiener!
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: The Dead Dog
Entries.Description: With the help of their best friend, a pair of siblings hold a memorial service for their dog who just died.

Entries.Title: Make No Change
Entries.Description: In pursuit of a perfect existence, a reclusive genius escapes into a simulated utopia of his own design, but when the program malfunctions, he must accept the painful truths he tried to erase or surrender his physical body forever.

Entries.Title: I Had The Weirdest Dream
Entries.Description: A story about Luna, girl that has no friends but her roommate Delilah, experiencing some really weird adventures.

Entries.Title: Project Eden
Entries.Description: In the summer of 1959, in the heart of middle America, three adventurous kids discover that boredom often leads to mischief. But when temptation beckons, they find themselves in deeper trouble than they ever imagined.

Entries.Title: It’s My Party
Entries.Description: On the night of his 25th birthday, Reggie experiences a supernatural phenomenon where he relives his worst memories and witnesses his greatest fears

Entries.Title: Within these Halls
Entries.Description: Lucy after waking up in a random building faces a mysterious figure looking to harm her. Will she escape in time before its too late?

Entries.Title: Not Today
Entries.Description: Eric tries to figure out how to help his friend Jaime after catching him doing something no one was supposed to see.

Entries.Title: Beauty Sleep
Entries.Description: Beauty Sleep is a retro futuristic short film about beauty, identity, and the dangerous pursuit of perfection.  Cosmetic enhancement is more extreme than our own. New boobs, butts and faces can be purchased, sewn on and bedazzled to your choosing. And the latest beauty trend? “Sleeping Beauty Makeovers”, created by a Mortician, where teens, for their Sweet 16, jump out of a sparkling coffin instead of a giant cake.

Entries.Title: The Sabbath
Entries.Description: Zack and Sam are discontented with one another.  Unbeknownst to the other, they have the same complaint: they're on their phones too much and not present with each other when they're together.

Entries.Title: The Hermit
Entries.Description: A young man’s journey unfolds through the surreal lens of tarot cards in The Hermit, dressed in Miu Miu and inspired by the surrealist cinema of the 1960s and 70s. From dreamlike landscapes to infinite spaces, the narrative explores themes of fate, duality, and transformation, combining eye-catching visuals with a mysterious, thought-provoking story.

Entries.Title: F Friendship
Entries.Description: "F Friendships" is a poignant exploration of the complexities of human connection, highlighting the fragility of friendship and the resilience of the human spirit.

Entries.Title: Put Your Clothes ON!
Entries.Description: No matter how unglamorous and dark the environment of a strip club can be seen, when Konstantina goes on stage to perform, the world disappears completely and its only her and her naked body left, indulging in an act of dance.

Entries.Title: The Greatest AI Commercial Ever Made
Entries.Description: DailyWire+ produced short film.

Entries.Title: Fog
Entries.Description: A lone figure drifts between reality and reflection, caught in stillness and searching for something just out of reach.

Entries.Title: Graffiti
Entries.Description: A short film by Sebastian Sommer

Entries.Title: John Shaw: Nuclear Winter
Entries.Description: A terrorist group embarks on a mission to bring a new world order under its control and leadership. The group conspires with government officials to manipulate Russia, Iran, and North Korea into joining forces and starting a nuclear war against NATO and other US-ally countries. The US military receives intelligence of the potential war on short notice and takes defensive and retaliatory actions to survive against potential attacks.

Entries.Title: Rise Up
Entries.Description: Rise Up! Igniting the Resurgence of Detroit. A story about a small group of Detroit-city-loving-zealots who pooled their resources together to try to be a small catalyst in the hoped-for turn-around of the once great city they so desperately love.

Entries.Title: Kiki & Dee
Entries.Description: Kiki & Dee is a sexy love story of a woman who suffers from the mental health disorder, agoraphobia, after losing the love of her life.

Entries.Title: David Spade: Dandelion
Entries.Description: With signature sardonic takes on the perils of flying, Travis & Taylor, charity auctions, and the evolution of porn, David Spade is sharper and funnier than ever.

Entries.Title: Where Then Shall We Go?
Entries.Description: In 2022, a family in one of New Haven’s poorest neighborhoods opened up their backyard for unhoused people to live in, aspiring to create an alternative to the overburdened shelter system as homelessness surges across the state.  For two years, Connecticut Public followed this experiment, as residents navigated the challenges of self-governance, addiction, and mental health—while running into regulatory hurdles with city and state law. Witness stories of joy and strength amidst hardship and struggle, as people experiencing homelessness build a neighborhood together.

Entries.Title: Dhruvathaare
Entries.Description: Parivartan, a heartbroken young man, struggles to heal from a painful breakup, while Apoorva tries to move forward from her past relationship. Their lives intersect on social media, sparking a beautiful romance. However, their newfound love soon faces an unexpected and formidable challenge.

Entries.Title: Don't Drink That!
Entries.Description: A group of international students at an American university can't agree on where to get a cup of coffee.

Entries.Title: KLiKFaRM
Entries.Description: KLiKFaRM is a satirical short form digital series about social media and online life.  A dark comedy with absurdist elements, this episode showcases sheep chasing digital validation cookies and addresses the theme of corporate greed.  If you enjoyed this, be sure to subscribe because there is more to come.

Entries.Title: 48 NOIDED MOVIES
Entries.Description: 48 NOIDED MOVIES, 2025  Single-channel video, color and stereo sound, duration: 3:26:32  Full HD, dimensions variable  Not for sale  48 NOIDED MOVIES is a derivative experimental film/edit in which 48 movies are layered, collaged, and animated simultaneously to extreme paranoid effect.

Entries.Title: Der Prozess - MusikTheater an der Wien at Kammeroper Wien
Entries.Description: ‘Someone must have slandered Josef K, for one morning, without having done anything wrong, he was arrested.’ This is the famous opening line of Franz Kafka’s novel Der Prozess (The Trial). Gottfried von Einem’s opera of the same name also begins with this mysterious arrest. Josef K. suddenly finds himself in a world he cannot understand, faced with an accusation of which he knows nothing but which seems perfectly clear to everyone else and yet remains inexplicable; with an absurd court case that nevertheless follows strict rules; with an arrest that appears to have no effect on his life yet still leads to his death. Is Josef K. the victim of a conspiracy, or is his belief in a conspiracy the only chance of explaining an incomprehensible world?

Entries.Title: Rocky Road
Entries.Description: On a brief but emotionally charged road trip, two sisters whose constant bickering threatens to derail their journey unexpectedly find their way back to the love that binds them.

Entries.Title: I Love You, You Know?
Entries.Description: A story of two sweethearts, separated by circumstances, meeting again in a coffee shop for the first time in many years.

Entries.Title: Operation: Pomme De Terre
Entries.Description: This short film, made for a 48-hour film festival, tells the story of a secret agent on a mission to save the world.

Entries.Title: O R I G I N S
Entries.Description: Acclaimed choreographer Alonzo King and his renowned LINES Ballet Company step up to the barre in this gorgeously photographed film that interweaves powerful personal stories and performance. The film follows King and his troupe as they employ their graceful and breathtaking artistry in service to a dance that poetically celebrates humanity. Weaving together King’s words and LINES’ striking movements, O R I G I N S creates a moving portrait of the language of dance and how the art forges connection, despite cultural barriers and personal differences. Director Drea Cooper delivers a stunning meditation on the meaning of life, the ties that bind us to each other, and hope for a brighter future.

Entries.Title: Heavenly Bodies
Entries.Description: A boy and a girl go on a date; after it though, the girl must decide if she'll follow her inner thoughts or go with what society expects of her.

Entries.Title: Forgotten Bloodlines: Agate
Entries.Description: Realistic CG documentary film focusing on prehistoric creatures of the Agate Fossil Beds during the Miocene, following Moropus and Daeodon, as they and other animals grow and adapt to the changing environment.

Entries.Title: How to Assassinate a Dictator
Entries.Description: Two young men take matters in their own hands, after an economic crises is caused due to the mismanagement of a Dictator.

Entries.Title: Middle Class Family
Entries.Description: A middle-class builder's son charts his own path in the construction world, finding love unexpectedly. As success nears, a family secret emerges that could demolish his carefully laid plans.

Entries.Title: Goodbye, Goodbye
Entries.Description: Follows the thoughts of someone going through a depressive episode

Entries.Title: Back from the Wing
Entries.Description: At the tail-end of his recovery from a severe injury, Amir struggles with self-doubt before a conversation with his cousin wakes him up, giving him the strength to get back to the game he loves.

Entries.Title: Despite Everything
Entries.Description: Despite being offered the role of a lifetime, a semi-successful actor grapples with his deteriorating mental health leading to an unfortunate pill addiction and disdain for his girlfriend.

Entries.Title: CHIMERA
Entries.Description: A bookish lab technician uses her access to a DNA database to find a date, but the ‘chance’ meet cute turns into something much more sinister.

Entries.Title: The King of Darkness
Entries.Description: A newly crowned king struggles with grief and the responsibilities of his birthright, driving him to disfigurement; a loss of his eternal beauty.

Entries.Title: Robotomy
Entries.Description: Convinced he’s a robot, a man desperately visits a doctor for answers he has trouble believing.

Entries.Title: LOL Live with Chico Bean
Entries.Description: Comedian and Wild ’N Out star Chico Bean seamlessly blends personal storytelling with sharp cultural commentary as he unpacks fatherhood, fame, generational differences, and more in this honest and hilarious new special from Executive Producer Kevin Hart.

Entries.Title: Haint
Entries.Description: When gentrifiers suddenly begin dying mysteriously, a Gullah Geechee handywoman who recently lost her home, must decide whether to use her ancestral knowledge to save them or leave the newcomers to their fate.

Entries.Title: An Interview with Eddie Nortan
Entries.Description: To promote the release of 'A Complete Unknown', an interview takes place. The trouble is, the real Edward Norton couldn't attend.

Entries.Title: Bitter Recrimination
Entries.Description: After her ex-boyfriend finds newfound stardom, Jade attempts to smear his image by exposing him for his addiction to cocaine. In the process succumbing to her own rage.

Entries.Title: Sweet Störy
Entries.Description: “Something every day needs to be sweet,” says Meg Ray in this charming feature documentary about a tiny café on a remote island in the Baltic Sea, at risk of closing down unless Meg and a small group of islanders can save it. Café Truten has very little running water or consistent electricity and with only days to open the cafe, we watch as Meg and her helpers are pushed to their limits and pull off culinary miracles. Sweet Störy is a reminder of what is possible when just a few people set out to make their small corner of the world a better place.

Entries.Title: Here at the End
Entries.Description: A 1930s jazz club. A medieval encounter. A dystopian future. Three stories in the mind of a writer who imagines himself as the protagonist, his wife as the heroine and his father as the villain. They collide in his mind as he searches for a happy ending, asking the question: Must art imitate life?

Entries.Title: Out
Entries.Description: When Tasha starts getting ready for an afternoon at the pub with her friends, she’s unaware of the obstacles lingering in the shadows. When these demons start to creep up on her, how long can she hold it together.

Entries.Title: STATIC!
Entries.Description: Ben Quarry is dead. When he wakes up in a daze he realizes he is still trapped in this mortal realm, the only problem is, no one can hear him.

Entries.Title: The Dreadful Place
Entries.Description: Nearing the anniversary of her father's tragic death, Willow finds herself trapped in a twisted nightmare she can't wake up from.

Entries.Title: Generational
Entries.Description: A single father wrestles with his responsibilities, past trauma, and being a present figure in his son's life.

Entries.Title: PCO JUSTICE
Entries.Description: It’s 2025, and let’s just say—things are not going great out there. Organized crime rules the streets, drugs and corruption are everywhere. You can’t even grab an ice cream cone without bumping into gangsters. Like the song says, we need a hero. Good news—he’s about to show up. An unexpected vigilante, back from the dead to take out the trash! Prophet the mobster and his gang better watch their backs.

Entries.Title: Heaven, Hell or Hoboken
Entries.Description: A young man spirals into anxiety and self-destruction after receiving a cryptic note at work

Entries.Title: ATTACK! Live At The Loco
Entries.Description: "Sell out warning! Attack Pro Wrestling returns to Bristol after a 5 year hiatus, transforming Loco Klub into a subterranean battleground of spandex and steel chairs. Featuring Welsh WWE titan Mark ‘Mandrews’ Andrews, Nino Bryant and Kid Lykos’s hotly anticipated title fight + metal maiden Rayne Leverkusen doing her thang. "

Entries.Title: The Human Supremacist
Entries.Description: To fight plant and animal cruelty, a vegan joins a cult and must harness photosynthesis before starving to death.

Entries.Title: SKAK
Entries.Description: A younger brother who learns the importance of controlling his emotions while playing chess against his older brother.

Entries.Title: The Night of The Mummy
Entries.Description: An archeologist stays in one late night to examine a mysterious ancient unidentified mummy

Entries.Title: DONOVAN 17: THE WEEKEND WARS
Entries.Description: While The Brilliant Brick was lost exploring in space, clone replacements were made... However there are now many clones at the house doing their own thing, until a new Donovan arrives, Donovan 17. Confused by the current state of affairs, he is guided by Cool Donovan who seems to have it all figured out, but a familiar face isn't very on board with the way things are being run...

Entries.Title: Budget Bike Battle Super Adventure
Entries.Description: Three friends undertake a long cross-country drive on motorbikes, heading from Spain down into the north of Africa.

Entries.Title: Sweet Santa Barbara Brown
Entries.Description: Inspired by actual events, four teammates of the Harlem Globetrotters confront the violent consequences of being Black in white America.

Entries.Title: The Bug
Entries.Description: A man lets himself go after the loss of a loved one, but he's pester by an insect that grows larger as the man's responsibilities grow on top of him.

Entries.Title: The Colour Orange
Entries.Description: A dive into the colour orange

Entries.Title: Florinda's daughter
Entries.Description: hija de Florinda is a poetic offering, meditating on the spiritual connection between protecting the land and protecting our children. Set in the Florida Everglades, a young Naomi learns from her grandmother how to nurture nature's grief through the ancestral practice of controlled burns. By integrating archival footage of Dominican farmer and abolitionist Mama Tingo (Florinda Soriano), this film invites us to mourn alongside Mama Earth as she calls upon all of her children.

Entries.Title: Puck
Entries.Description: Sorting a dispute on thin ice, Jamie and Taylor settle their differences while passing a hockey puck back and forth.

Entries.Title: Josh Gondelman: Positive Reinforcement
Entries.Description: Josh Gondelman navigates today's world, from trendy pastries to gender pronouns and retirement options, reflecting on changes since his 20th century upbringing.

Entries.Title: MUSH: Wife
Entries.Description: Susan becomes the perfect wife. MUSH is a series of absurdist and surreal horror\comedy vignettes

Entries.Title: Audio and Visual Experiment 21
Entries.Description: The twenty-first in an ongoing series of collaborations between Gf Savages and various audio editors.

Entries.Title: Point Me to Where It Hurts
Entries.Description: A wandering man is haunted by strangers who will not stop pointing at him.

Entries.Title: A Ghost Sonata
Entries.Description: A young woman completely shuts herself off from the outside world after a traumatic experience.

Entries.Title: Burt
Entries.Description: Burt, a 69-year-old musician with Parkinson’s, has his life turned upside down when a man from New York shows up claiming to be his son. Having always dreamed of being a father, Burt embraces Sammy and invites him to stay for the weekend, where he lives with his grumpy landlord.

Entries.Title: Faustbook (20th Anniversary Director's Cut)
Entries.Description: Inspired by Christopher Marlowe's The Tragical History of Doctor Faustus and Goethe's Faust, Faustus develops an obsession with his namesake, Johann Georg Faust. As Faustus delves deeper into man and legend, he enters a labyrinthine realm.

Entries.Title: A Tight Squeeze
Entries.Description: A desperate actor's callback spirals when an embarrassing mishap with the group's intimidating captain forces them into a secret pact.

Entries.Title: Squatters
Entries.Description: A calm day in the life of two amoral squatters and the woman whose house they inhabit

Entries.Title: The Photographers
Entries.Description: Two bumbling photographers are hired for a blackmail job—but their simple gig soon spirals into chaos and danger.

Entries.Title: Havana Libré
Entries.Description: Follows the effort to legitimize surfing in Cuba, chronicling the unwavering passion that keeps them going to the water despite all odds.

Entries.Title: SOIL!
Entries.Description: A worker's search for soil in a desolate world.

Entries.Title: Sometime, Somewhere, in Bellwood
Entries.Description: Sarah has just bought a ticket for the next bus out of Bellwood, her seemingly inescapable hometown. But when a quick stop for drugs with a mysterious dealer goes awry, she'll be faced with bigger problems than being late to the bus station...

Entries.Title: Angry Man Destroys Paradise 2
Entries.Description: Angry man destroys paradise again.

Entries.Title: How to Shoot a Basketball
Entries.Description: Mason Crawford gives a detailed lesson on how to shoot a basketball accurately.

Entries.Title: What’s Yours Is Mine
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Final Girls
Entries.Description: Juliet, Lindsey and Charlotte all have one thing in common… a mutual grudge against men. At their first sleepover, the three girls bond over their breakup horror stories. Charlotte shares the story of her last boyfriend who cheated on her. Lindsey jokingly suggests these men should die for their actions. Juliet takes this idea a bit too seriously. The three decide to form a plan to kidnap and murder their exes so no woman has to ever deal with their shit again.

Entries.Title: Boys Night
Entries.Description: Buckle up, baby, cause tonight ain’t just any normal night. It’s Boys Night. It’s the last night for the Boys to hang out before high school is over. And if you think these are just any old boys, you’d be wrong, since these boys are actually BAD boys. And BOYS NIGHT is the NIGHT for BOYS to be BOYS. And these five sure are going to be BOYS on this night. Cause of course, it’s the NIGHT for the BOYS, also more commonly known as BOYS NIGHT. BOYS NIGHT! It’ll make you say “HELL YEAH! BOYS NIGHT!”

Entries.Title: Operation: Sunrise
Entries.Description: When a team of elite vampire hunters is ambushed during a routine raid, their leader, Jesse Ross, must join forces with a now reclusive Dr. John Basil to survive the night and stop Paliematch Finnegan Vornak III — an ancient vampire queen determined to plunge the world into eternal darkness — before sunrise becomes a myth.

Entries.Title: The Consequences of "The Premiere of "The Making of "The Lumberjack's Daughter"""
Entries.Description: A movie premiere gone awry leads to an equally chaotic trial to determine the fate of four amateur filmmakers.

Entries.Title: Dinosaur Farm
Entries.Description: A political assassination leads to division and chaos.

Entries.Title: Collectors
Entries.Description: Bounty hunters are preparing to return an escaped prisoner when they encounter the unknown

Entries.Title: The Tensile Strength of Air
Entries.Description: After witnessing a suicide in public, Lauren re-evaluates herself in relationship to friends, family and career. Fantasy and reality blend as she assesses her identity and reasserts herself differently in the world.

Entries.Title: Sunset and the Mockingbird
Entries.Description: The love story of Gloria Clayborne and jazz pianist Junior Mance as they face Junior’s diagnosis of dementia.

Entries.Title: Are You Still Watching?
Entries.Description: Drawn to a mysterious online phenomenon, an isolated young man finds himself tethered to an on-screen entity that may or may not be trying to harm him.

Entries.Title: El Bar de Hernando
Entries.Description: Yiyo, a shy and goofy bartender, falls in love with one of the girls that frequents the salsa bar. He needs to get out of his comfort zone and invite her to dance before the night ends.

Entries.Title: Power Manual
Entries.Description: The power is in your hands. An associative meditation stitched together from my last 10 years of iPhone videos.

Entries.Title: Taste of India
Entries.Description: Nighttime. Patrick has just lost his job. On his way home, he vents to his mother on the phone, but after walking into a deserted alley... he immediately gets mugged. Dave appears with his knife. Patrick hands over his wallet but not his cell phone (no one hangs up on their mother, right?). After a few moments, however, Carlos appears too. And so does his gun. The two robbers begin an argument over who has the right to rob poor Patrick. And between threats, small talk, cooking tips, and a mother on the phone... who will rob whom?

Entries.Title: Kielbasy Heaven
Entries.Description: Now on their fourth generation, the Kowalonek's family has maintained their Kielbasy Shop in Shenandoah, Pennsylvania for 114 years, serving the community through thick and thin.

Entries.Title: SPIRIT
Entries.Description: Haunted by a familiar ghost, Trevor's sleepless night turns into a never ending chase for his best friend.

Entries.Title: Cambalhota (ou uma egoísta tentativa de parar o tempo)
Entries.Description: A reflection on memory and photography.

Entries.Title: Deformelody: An American Nightmare
Entries.Description: This horror satire tells the story of a pop culture-obsessed serial killer who terrorizes L.A. Through his Manifesto entries we discover his mission, to bring Americans together by killing everyone equally and confronting the ‘final boss’ - a man simply known as ‘Freddy’. A gleefully warped odyssey, through the psyche of America itself.

Entries.Title: Hurting
Entries.Description: Anna, a lonely oddball, and Michael, her businessman father, deal with the implications regarding a recent paranormal encounter in their home - a sighting of the apparition of Anna's deceased mother.

Entries.Title: Reverb
Entries.Description: A dance troupe must endure a grueling practice the night before a performance.

Entries.Title: The Last Chapel
Entries.Description: Mid-wedding at a Vegas-style chapel, a celebration comes crashing to a halt when the iconic, deceased pink poodle Poolvis Poodle’s greedy Estate steps in and shuts it down.

Entries.Title: Vitam Aeternam
Entries.Description: In over their heads, a group of William & Mary seniors have to decide if unveiling a real secret society, Vitam Aeternam, is worth risking their lives.

Entries.Title: Poppy: They're All Around Us Tour (Live from Chicago)
Entries.Description: Join Poppy live from her sold out show at The House of Blues in Chicago during her "They're All Around Us" Tour, performing songs from her sixth studio album "Negative Spaces."

Entries.Title: ΑΠΙΤΣΕ
Entries.Description: APICE is an idea born from the creative mind of Francesco Ruggiero and the editorial direction of Lorenzo Crippa . We wanted to explore how lost things are directly interconnected with consumerism with a witty and honest twist , after all  l'Apice del consumismo e l'offerta nei parcheggi .  We're not here to wax lyrical about human connections or lost memories. Instead, we're pulling back the curtain on the messier side of our relationship with stuff—how it comes to be lost and what that says about the throwaway culture we're all part of. The book itself is a lost thing among others , so don't hesitate to treat it as such

Entries.Title: Through the Void
Entries.Description: A young couple visit a medium to conduct a séance after the death of their child.

Entries.Title: In the Gray
Entries.Description: A young detective in 1950’s Los Angeles comes to terms with their identity while tracking down a serial killer targeting the city’s top detectives.

Entries.Title: Find the Funny
Entries.Description: A documentary following the lives of stand-up comedians during the COVID-19 pandemic and the ways in which it impacted their careers.

Entries.Title: Vail Trip
Entries.Description: Four college friends reunite for a weekend birthday trip, illuminating old emotions and igniting new connections.

Entries.Title: At Your Service
Entries.Description: A down-on-his-luck waiter stumbles into some money...with unforeseen consequences. At Your Service won 2nd place for Best Film at the College 48 Film Festival. It also won Best Editing, Best Score, and Best Lead Actor.

Entries.Title: Mary and Julius
Entries.Description: A jaded survivor forms an unlikely friendship with an eccentric drifter in her efforts to survive post-apocalyptic Earth.

Entries.Title: Everything Dies Out Here
Entries.Description: n a barren, oil-soaked wasteland after global catastrophe, a man clings to the last flower on Earth. As danger mounts from unforeseen forces, his connection to the flower proves a window to the past.

Entries.Title: Mute
Entries.Description: Monette, a middle-aged traveling book salesman (his first name is never given), goes to confession. When the priest asks him what sin he has committed, Monette admits that he believes he has sinned in some way but is not entirely sure exactly what he is guilty of.

Entries.Title: Ian MacKaye & Kevin Seconds - In Conversation
Entries.Description: Kevin Seconds and Ian MacKaye “In Conversation” April 15th, 2025 at Braindead Studios in Los Angeles California to celebrate the 7Seconds release of New Wind/ Change in My Head on Trust Records in partnership with BYO Records.

Entries.Title: The Portal
Entries.Description: When Greg's girlfriend, Kathleen, disappears into a mysterious portal in their apartment, he embarks on a surreal journey to rescue her—only to find she has crowned herself queen of a magical realm. As Greg navigates enchanted taverns, reluctant sidekicks, and his own creative insecurities, he’s forced to confront a painful truth: sometimes the people we love most are on a different path.

Entries.Title: Christmas Elegy for a Summer Day
Entries.Description: A film letter for the filmmaker's grandfather. Twelve years after his death, his family celebrates Christmas.

Entries.Title: The Gift
Entries.Description: A film by Matt Shlosberg and Studio Gelis

Entries.Title: The End Of The Massive Youtube Iceberg Explained
Entries.Description: A finale to a 29+ part series diving deep into the world's most popular video sharing site, which looks at everything from the most popular viral videos to obscure avant-garde short films and forgotten ARGs.

Entries.Title: In Communication
Entries.Description: Three former high school friends reconnect years later, each carrying the weight of their broken dreams and unresolved tensions.
