What begins as an awkward reunion in a cramped apartment turns into an intense confrontation. As the night unfolds, old wounds surface, leading them to confront their failures and the fragile bond that still ties them together.

Entries.Title: Jim Pork
Entries.Description: In a world where legends fade into myth, one pig sets out to rewrite history.  Years after the mysterious disappearance of viral icon John Pork, his son — Jim Pork — refuses to believe the story is over. Determined to uncover the truth, Jim teams up with the sharp-tongued but loyal Agent 5.5, and the unpredictable ex-felon Marvin Beak, on a journey that defies time, reality, and the rules of the lore itself.  Their mission: to find the elusive Architect, a powerful figure said to hold the key to resurrection. But as the trio dives deeper into a fractured world of forgotten legends and hidden truths, they begin to realize that some stories were buried for a reason…

Entries.Title: Buster!
Entries.Description: A student races to deliver an attendance sheet to the main office while competing with a no-nonsense hall monitor and an aggressive bully, all to impress another student for whom he is head-over-heels.

Entries.Title: And I Arise (Reprise)
Entries.Description: Music video for Shrine Maiden.  To the west I rise  To the east I sleep  I pull the tides - And again, repeat  And Again repeat - And again repeat  I fall, i rise - like this reprise - And again - And again - And again i rise  And again i rise - And again i rise  No need to speak - a loop, a vow - and slow repeat - And again  And again  And again - I fall  i rise - like this  reprise  And again we rise  I wax, I wane - I fall, i rise  like this refrain - Just the same  And It’s just the same  I fall, i rise - like this reprise - the night replies - and all we are - is this disguise - is this disguise  So Rise and fall  Again - with me  Again with me

Entries.Title: Formosa
Entries.Description: A girl from Hainan recounts her youth in a seaside village she couldn't leave.

Entries.Title: Red Pocket
Entries.Description: A magical Red Pocket interrupts an anxiety ridden family dinner.

Entries.Title: Let's Play
Entries.Description: A young girl is left home alone. Free to do whatever she pleases, she ventures up to the dark, mysterious attic. What fresh horrors await?

Entries.Title: Kill 'em Now
Entries.Description: A Bounty Hunter must help a culturally stagnated and hysterical group of Town Folk muster whatever they have to defeat a band of dangerous thugs to earn an undisclosed payday of a lifetime. But will a hidden sibling rivalry stand in the way of the reward and jeopardize everyone's lives?

Entries.Title: Augmented
Entries.Description: AUGMENTED is an experimental non-fiction short, shot completely on 16mm, that analyzes the commonalities between medical augmentation and Transgender alignment. We are frightening because we're the future.

Entries.Title: Interview With Celebrity Andrew
Entries.Description: In a stark contrast to his interview with Celebrity Enrique, the iconic Celebrity Andrew now gets a turn in front of the camera.

Entries.Title: Russell Hicks: Happy To Be Here
Entries.Description: Russell Hicks heads out on his first tour, but not his first rodeo. (Warning: This is a stand up show. NOT a rodeo.) Russell Hicks is here to stay and he really is happy to be here. So, why don’t British People believe him?

Entries.Title: Garden Valley
Entries.Description: Garden Valley revolves around two friends consumed with Heavy Metal, partying, drugs, alcohol and their roller coaster love lives. Setting takes place on April 14, 1988, among the ruins of Garden Valley trailer park, located in the Southside of San Antonio, Texas.

Entries.Title: Call of the Dolphins
Entries.Description: Dive into the fascinating world of wild dolphins. Dolphins have long captured the imagination of humans with their intelligence, complex social lives, and playful antics. But what else draws us to these captivating animals? Narrated by Academy-Award® winner Mary Steenburgen, Call of the Dolphins invites audiences on an unforgettable journey into the fascinating world of wild dolphins, revealing the profound connection we share with these highly intelligent animals. Meet the dedicated researchers uncovering the mysteries of dolphin behavior and follow a team from the IFAW Dolphin Rescue Center as they help give stranded dolphins a second chance. Their stories reveal the deep bonds between humans and dolphins forged over centuries and will inspire a new sense of wonder and appreciation for these amazing ocean dwellers.

Entries.Title: God Please Save Me
Entries.Description: or just noise..?

Entries.Title: THE Student Film
Entries.Description: An Idealistic student director struggles to bring his vision of a perfectly, unique to life with an "incompetent" crew and limited resources, all while competing to outdo his artistic rival.

Entries.Title: Magic with small apparatus
Entries.Description: Super 8 stop motion, south London style.  Includes feats with cards and ropes, legerdemain, sleights of camera, a perky river, and rare insights into the activities of a local magician-ventriloquist from the 1930s.  A companion piece to ‘Magic Explained’ (which probably means this is part two of a trilogy), and similarly lively.

Entries.Title: Duality: The Concert Film
Entries.Description: Few artists embody boundless creativity quite like Lindsey Stirling—and now, she brings her visionary seventh album Duality to life on one of the world’s most iconic stages.  Filmed from the legendary Royal Albert Hall, this one-night-only event is more than a concert: it's a full-scale live production, a cinematic homage to the sonic and emotional journey of Duality. Known for her genre-bending virtuosity on electronic violin and high-octane choreography, Lindsey conjures an immersive experience that fuses music, dance, and storytelling.

Entries.Title: The Vixen
Entries.Description: A short thriller film.

Entries.Title: Hold Me Close
Entries.Description: A chronicle of the power and complexity of the relationship between Corinne and Tiana, two Queer Black women who experience cycles of life’s joys and pains together in the home they share.

Entries.Title: Identity
Entries.Description: Identity is an experimental short film about gender fluidity, memory, and transformation.

Entries.Title: There Goes The Bride
Entries.Description: A bride's wedding day takes an unexpected turn for the worse just moments before she says "I do."

Entries.Title: Glampire
Entries.Description: When hyper-assertive Jess trespasses into a vampire’s lair to thrill and satiate her loyal social media followers, the lifeblood of her being, she encounters the 2000-year-old vampire, Count Vicardi, whose millennial-spanning appetite for human blood and savagery knows no bounds.

Entries.Title: Hoy no se fía
Entries.Description: Christmas Eve, two friends, clerks of a mini supermarket, spend the night shift with games, beer and jokes, until their day is interrupted by a mugger willing to do anything for the money in the cash register.

Entries.Title: From Rodeo to Polo: The 1st HBCU Polo Team
Entries.Description: The first Black-collegiate polo team at Morehouse College chases national USPA certification, training a rag-tag team of charismatic cowboys who’ve never played the sport into tournament-winning polo stars.

Entries.Title: KCSM 91.1: The Bay Area's Jazz Station to the World
Entries.Description: As America’s only original art form, the cultural relevance of jazz is at risk of being forgotten, if not for the dedicated announcers at KCSM Jazz 91.1.

Entries.Title: Platinum Princess: The Story of Seka
Entries.Description: Join us as we revisit the life of the adult film star best known for fighting the system and paving the way of the adult film industry. The first to gain popularity in both the taboo underworld and the world's mainstream stage, Seka's name was so big in the adult entertainment world that her name above the title was not enough-her name had to BE in the title!

Entries.Title: The Dark Crusader
Entries.Description: Stockton superhero The Dark Crusader must battle his ego while watching his girlfriend, Ratwoman, achieve major stardom. Can he get his life on track or will he be doomed to work at the amusement park and perform at open mic night forever?

Entries.Title: Heard
Entries.Description: After not speaking for months, Sabrina reconnects with Alex and Olivia, her best friends since childhood. While they each try to mend this damaged relationship, outside factors keep finding their way into their dinner, until things reach a boiling point, for everyone to hear.

Entries.Title: Red Lights and Blue
Entries.Description: The WSAP Theater Club is thrown into turmoil when the recently fired JROTC instructor, Sergeant Murphy, begins co-teaching the club as a last ditch effort to save his job. As the winter recital creeps closer, Murphy must put aside his anti-theater biases in order to get along with the club’s seniors and co-teacher, Ms. Austen, before he’s fired for good.

Entries.Title: Inventing Paradise
Entries.Description: Life for a happy couple is turned upside down after their young son is tragically murdered.

Entries.Title: Oblivium
Entries.Description: Sky just wanted to avoid her estranged grandmother with Alzheimer’s—but when she finally visits, she uncovers a haunting mystery. Surrounded by ghostly figures that vanish from memory the moment they’re unseen, Sky and her friends find themselves trapped in a terrifying cycle of forgotten horrors.

Entries.Title: How Not To Rob A Bank
Entries.Description: In this epic Mockumentary, a crew of three robbers band together to pull off a bank heist. But will they succeeded? Probably not...

Entries.Title: Acoustic Rooster and His Barnyard Band
Entries.Description: A talented young guitar-playing Rooster comes to the Bebop Barnyard to join Jazz Greats Duck Ellington, Mules Davis, Ella Finchgerald, and Lil Herdin. Even though he's a star on solo guitar, he must learn new skills to play together in a jazz band.

Entries.Title: Those That Go Unnoticed
Entries.Description: This is a short film about two childhood best friends who have always been inseparable. As they now embark on a new chapter of their lives, they are forced to confront hidden truths about their friendship, and the emotional echoes of memories.

Entries.Title: When That Thang Get Ta Thang'n
Entries.Description: Matt Mathews’ first-ever comedy special, When That Thang Get Ta’ Thangin, was filmed LIVE at the legendary Alabama Theatre in Birmingham, AL, and let’s just say… the networks couldn’t handle it! So instead of waiting around, we’re giving it directly to the people—uncensored, unfiltered, and unapologetically.

Entries.Title: Tiger
Entries.Description: A portrait of award-winning, internationally acclaimed Indigenous artist and elder Dana Tiger, her family, and the resurgence of the iconic Tiger T-shirt company.

Entries.Title: Operation Wandering Soul ////////// Ghost Tape Number 10
Entries.Description: At a seance, an American war vet upset over his daughters suicide is tricked by con artists who end up playing him a tape of his own war crimes, triggering him to take his life.

Entries.Title: TITANS AWAKENING
Entries.Description: In the year 2012 a powerful Kaiju attacks a city killing an engineer's family. After his grievance, Hans Wrench uses his skills to build a machine capable of fending off this beast to avenge his family and save the city from future devastation. In a fierce battle of monster vs mech everything relies on Hans' skillset and the Titan's strength.

Entries.Title: My Next Guest
Entries.Description: An awkward high school student named Jimmy pretends to be a talk show host to socialize with people. Can he maintain his persona after asking out Chloe, the captain of the volleyball team?

Entries.Title: Gotchi
Entries.Description: A frantic young woman orchestrates a daring heist to rescue her best friend, a Tamagotchi, before time runs out.

Entries.Title: Not Another Sob Story (Seriously)
Entries.Description: Three friends Elektra, Harold, and Alicia all decide to get their acts together and save up enough money to film a reality television show titled 'Across The Pond', in Europe. Alicia decides to take a more conventional route to earning and saving money, while Harold and Elektra do not. Will they earn enough money in time to travel 'Across The Pond'? Will they do so with minimal tears?

Entries.Title: Shoot
Entries.Description: A veteran professional wrestler must put his faith in his young rival after a sudden injury threatens to derail one of the biggest matches of their careers.

Entries.Title: The Seas Between Us
Entries.Description: In the mid 1960s a young girl who has never seen anything but rural Trinidad has her eyes opened to the world when her adventurous auntie from India comes to visit.

Entries.Title: Chiasm of Lament III
Entries.Description: Chiasm of Lament is an audio-visual response to the transitory and transformational age we find ourselves in, where technology and generative information has been given spiritual and existential power. The title refers to crossing of paths that are melancholic in nature, a sphere of ambiguous transactions and embodied transformations that move in alternate or opposing directions.

Entries.Title: My Little Pony The Movie: Infection
Entries.Description: Soarin is haunted by a fragment of his alicorn magic he thought he had sealed away. Twilight and Soarin are tasked by Princess Celestia to find this fragment which had taken a physical form, and kill it before all of Equestria is drained of its magic.

Entries.Title: For Archie
Entries.Description: Michael reflects on his relationship with his friend Archie

Entries.Title: It Happened Here
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Going Dark with Earnest Sweetgrass: Or A Comprehensive Guide on How to Die
Entries.Description: Earnest Sweetgrass spends his 21,000th birthday thinking big thoughts about what it means to be nobody.

Entries.Title: Donuts
Entries.Description: Scored by Detroit hip-hop legend J Dilla and produced by Junk Food Dinner, DONUTS is a visual essay about xenochrony, circles, and very long telephone cords.

Entries.Title: Stitch
Entries.Description: May falls apart and puts herself back together.

Entries.Title: Ready or Not
Entries.Description: A coming-of-age story with a twist, revealing the greyness we create to make sense of the world. Katie is the only child of two loving parents.  Katie is cheeky, funny, and wants to be one of the boys. Her housing estate is small and is filled with young families who make up the maisonettes, flats, and houses. The transition to teenage life brings Katie and her friends to places they did not expect when they push the boundaries of their circle and try on a maturity they are not yet ready for. A bursting coming-of age story with a twist, revealing the greyness we create to make sense of the world, rooted in deep friendships they hope can stand the test of huge change.

Entries.Title: One Over Another
Entries.Description: A troubled young man finds himself trapped in a mind-bending situation during a bizarre meteorological event.

Entries.Title: Sport Star
Entries.Description: An aging black high school football star, living a quotidian life and married to his high school sweetheart in a small town, reminisces over a long-lost lover - a man he once shared the football field with.

Entries.Title: Serenity
Entries.Description: The end of a relationship becomes a search for serenity.

Entries.Title: Diorama
Entries.Description: A young woman recalls a childhood memory of the first signs of her grandmother's Alzheimer's, yet as the narrative unfolds, it becomes evident that all the members of her family share a fear of forgetting the past.

Entries.Title: Sarah's Getting Married
Entries.Description: Sarah's getting married, and it's time to meet the parents!

Entries.Title: The Ballad of Tony London
Entries.Description: On the night of May 24th, 2025, world-famous fighter Tony London faces his greatest opponent yet.

Entries.Title: Jimmy Two-Shoes
Entries.Description: Lucifer hires Heloise to blacken Jimmy Two-Shoes' heart after consistent ruining his schemes.

Entries.Title: HITMAN
Entries.Description: A retiring hitman must convince a normal guy to take his place for his boss. Little does he know, this "average joe" has an agenda of his own.

Entries.Title: The Attic
Entries.Description: When a fearless exterminator is called to clear rats from the attic of an old farmhouse, he quickly realizes something else is lurking in the shadows- something far darker, something that even he cannot face without fear.

Entries.Title: Wednesday Night Tennis
Entries.Description: After dropping out of her dream college course, budding musician Alice joins a local tennis club to try escape a creative rut.

Entries.Title: Grave in the Clouds
Entries.Description: Jacob Zalman, a middle-aged Jewish man married to a non-Jewish woman, is shaken when he discovers that his teenage son has written an essay denying the Holocaust.

Entries.Title: Selling Out
Entries.Description: Reginald, a very serious candidate for school president, is stuck between two options: keeping with his principals and winning the presidential race or getting 30 whole bucks

Entries.Title: Winona
Entries.Description: Short film created for the song Winona by Deafheaven

Entries.Title: American Dendrite
Entries.Description: Following a road trip alongside the Mississippi River, everyday Americans are asked to talk about what’s on their minds right now - with their only prompt being to listen to what the person before them has shared.

Entries.Title: I'm Not Racist
Entries.Description: In a world where racism is reversed a white teenager navigates through the harsh reality of discrimination.

Entries.Title: Ashes In The Alley

Entries.Title: They Have to Hear Us: Canada’s Duty to Consult Inuit
Entries.Description: Through interviews with Inuit across Nunavut, and documentation of a three-year community hearing process during the COVID pandemic, award-winning filmmaker Zacharias Kunuk explores what meaningful consultation in the 21st century means within the context of a large-scale mining expansion on Baffin Island.

Entries.Title: Ray O'Leary: Your Laughter is Just Making Me Stronger
Entries.Description: Every time Ray does stand-up comedy and people laugh he gets a little bit stronger. Soon he will be the most powerful man in the universe.

Entries.Title: Does that hurt the fish?
Entries.Description: “Does that hurt the fish?” is an experimental short film centered around a mundane exchange between a regular client and a paid affective laborer at an aquarium during an impending pandemic, but just before businesses are officially closed. The film aims to capture the complexities of specific kinds of affective labor—specifically sex work—under the landscapes of U.S. capitalism and healthcare. It highlights the enduring sexual micro-economies that defied the dire, apocalyptic warnings of the pandemic. [Overview courtesy of Dahlia Bloomstone]

Entries.Title: Arrythmia
Entries.Description: Two strangers, both connected to one another through a mutual past with the same girl, meet for the first time at that girl's grave. Over her headstone, and through violence, and love, unspoken secrets are brought to light, which none of the parties involved could've ever possibly predicted.

Entries.Title: Girlfriend Girlfriend
Entries.Description: "Holy homophobia Batwoman, we better use the scissor symbol to assemble the team!"  A queer woman's mind is blown by her new coworker's bold question in this experimental short film.

Entries.Title: What Remains
Entries.Description: A young woman is taken and bitten by a vampire, only to be forgotten.

Entries.Title: Orange Cheesecake
Entries.Description: Joe is invited for dinner at his estranged father's house. He brings orange cheesecake and is greeted by his dad's new girlfriend, but throughout the night tensions rise as his dad's true intentions are revealed.

Entries.Title: The Healing Revolution
Entries.Description: A group of dedicated medical professionals known as "Doctors Within Borders" provides care and support to people without housing as a beacon of hope for Miami's most vulnerable communities.

Entries.Title: The Last 24
Entries.Description: A valet mix up initiates a fight for a cannabis grinder encoded with the elemental presentation of a botanical super formula worth millions of dollars.

Entries.Title: Click

Entries.Title: Into the Well: The Making of Animal Well
Entries.Description: In Second Wind's first premium documentary project, we sat down with Billy Basso to tell the story of the development of his critically acclaimed game, Animal Well.

Entries.Title: Running

Entries.Title: Of Pentacles
Entries.Description: Two young adults project their ideals (and, in turn, their problems) onto each other

Entries.Title: Locked In
Entries.Description: A student short film.

Entries.Title: Fragmentation
Entries.Description: Vinny's night is interrupted by strange screams coming from somewhere in his house. As he searches for the source, he finds himself face to face with something terrifying that feels disturbingly familiar.

Entries.Title: BORGLESQUE
Entries.Description: A greedy burlesque club owner hires a mad scientist to resurrect his most profitable girl, but this she-borg refuses to be an object of men's desires.

Entries.Title: The silence after echo
Entries.Description: Echo Penrose has just learned she’s terminally ill. Instead of retreating inward, she escapes to the countryside, where time slows down and life quietly unfolds, as hers gently fades.

Entries.Title: Sparks
Entries.Description: Fumiko is a young girl with a vivid imagination and a heart full of dreams. Everything changes when she receives a special toy, a red panda named Chima, who becomes her best friend and source of joy. However, as time passes, Fumiko must face great challenges that shake her spirit and her relationship with Chima. As hope begins to fade, Fumiko embarks on an emotional journey to rediscover the meaning behind her dreams. In her search, she finds more than just inspiration, she rediscovers a part of herself that was once lost.

Entries.Title: Icebreakers
Entries.Description: For a sport that revolves around expressiveness, romance and a hell of a lot of sequins, the world of figure skating has a startlingly archaic stance on sexuality and gender. Same-sex pairs and gender bending are strictly forbidden in elite competitions – but once every four years, a parallel skating universe appears. At the Gay Games, an intergenerational group of skaters pushes the boundaries of their sport in the hope that mainstream skating will one day encompass a richer spectrum of the human experience.

Entries.Title: Betty
Entries.Description: A struggling teenager, torn between a summer fling and his long-time love, recalls fond memories of his former girlfriend, Betty, as he faces the consequences of his actions and his lingering feelings for her.

Entries.Title: In a network of lines that interlace
Entries.Description: A world full of Image Makers erodes the objective power of the kino eye. If everyone can capture a moment on video, one angle implies the existence of infinite possible perspectives. This convergence of distinct representations distills any given moment to an impression, a painting, a memory.

Entries.Title: I Love You, Baby
Entries.Description: A young black man's struggle with identity, sexuality, and abuse are explored in a series of vignettes.

Entries.Title: You'll Lose a Good Thing
Entries.Description: A movie with Jimmie Falls, Sean San Jose, and Emmy Newman.

Entries.Title: Dracula Citgo
Entries.Description: dracula needs more blood for his race car

Entries.Title: The Memo
Entries.Description: In 2017, Steve Harvey drafts a memo demanding not to be disturbed while his show staff unknowingly plan him a surprise birthday party.

Entries.Title: Hostile
Entries.Description: Four Soldiers are escorting an arrogant Lieutenant on a dangerous mission through the fields of Belgium. Can they complete their mission before the team falls apart? Or will the Lieutenant's actions cause the downfall of their company.

Entries.Title: Red Herring
Entries.Description: A local actor turns to detective to solve a murder in the harbor.

Entries.Title: Acronymity
Entries.Description: When a man wakes up in a sterile world he doesn’t recognize, his only hope of recovering his memory is to decipher a cryptic acronym: CCNEN.

Entries.Title: memory consolidation 01
Entries.Description: memory consolidation 01

Entries.Title: The Documents!
Entries.Description: In March 2020, an ambitious tabloid reporter cooped up in quarantine must look into rumors of leaked UFO documents to keep her job, but she gets swept up in a conspiracy that could make or break her career.

Entries.Title: Steve Schapiro: Being Everywhere
Entries.Description: Witness the fascinating story of a photographer and photojournalist’s entire career in his own gentle and humble words. After taking some of the most classic photographs in Hollywood history, Steve Schapiro set his sights on something that he felt was significantly more important: documenting the civil unrest that was happening in Black America. Shapiro provided America with iconic images to magnify the voices of James Baldwin, Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr., and many more. His stories are remarkable not because they’re his alone, but because of the selfless dedication to public service he pursued in his own distinctive way. Being Everywhere honors the legendary photographer’s remarkable career, his unparalleled ability to capture defining moments in history, and his unique fortune to be present at key moments of social change, revealing his deep empathy and unwavering commitment to documenting the human experience.

Entries.Title: Brother Sister Keeper
Entries.Description: When her brother goes missing following a painful breakup, a cynical young woman enlists the help of his ex in order to find him.

Entries.Title: Hillside Cacti
Entries.Description: Leaving isn't easy, but sometimes all it takes is a simple reminder of what you had to show you that home is always there, no matter how far away...

Entries.Title: The Swastika and the Cross
Entries.Description: The conflict between church and state dominates much of the 2,000 years of Church history. But nowhere do we see this demonstrated as clearly as in Germany, where in the 16th century, Martin Luther sparked the Reformation, but in the 20th century, the same country forced the world to grapple with the horrors of Hitler’s Germany. It is often said that history repeats itself. As you watch the vignettes in this film, consider what lessons we can learn from the past to avoid making the same mistakes?

Entries.Title: WWI Chronicles: Against All Odds
Entries.Description: Witness the fierce early battles of WWI-Liege, Mons, and the grueling retreat-where bravery clashed with chaos in a fight for survival against all odds.

Entries.Title: Falling from Grace
Entries.Description: In Falling from Grace, three lifelong friends—Nathan, Jason, and Derek—attend a Civil War reenactment, but a tragic accident leaves one of them dead. The film follows the two remaining three months later, and how they each deal with the loss of their friend.

Entries.Title: Love Is Real
Entries.Description: After a breakup, an unusual young couple try to reconnect with society, confronting the tangled nature of sex, power, and alienation.

Entries.Title: Small Town Showdown
Entries.Description: A church and a strip club in a small town have a rivalry.

Entries.Title: The Roads We Travel
Entries.Description: Torn between her family and her dreams, Tamara must choose which path she'll choose. An encounter with an old classmate shows her the two may not be as different as she imagined.

Entries.Title: Unwanted Waters of Lethe
Entries.Description: A short film about the fear of losing memories.

Entries.Title: The Hot Dog
Entries.Description: A peculiar young man becomes obsessed with the iconic New York Hot Dog.

Entries.Title: The Slip In The Program
Entries.Description: An understudy is on tonight.

Entries.Title: The Worst She Can Say
Entries.Description: Sylvester, a young man in his 20s, faces a challenge from friends that forces him to confront his fears and insecurities. Along the way, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery, learning to embrace his individuality, find peace in solitude, and appreciate the value of self-love and genuine connections.

Entries.Title: Apple Music Live - Central Cee
Entries.Description: The UK MC, Central Cee, who released his debut album, Can't Rush Greatness, earlier this year, performs a homecoming concert in London.

Entries.Title: The Analysis of Mind
Entries.Description: The film begins with two crowds dressed in black, either  walking left or right. Suddenly, a young person dressed in  orange (symbolic of curiosity) enters the frame, with a  question mark visible on the back of their clothes. After  surveying the crowds, the orange figure decides to follow  their path briefly, before turning away – revealing a  lightbulb on the front of their clothes. Proceeding forward,  the orange figure notices a space full of white blocks. They  initially inspect them, before starting to build a small wall.

Entries.Title: Triple Trouble
Entries.Description: Triple Trouble begins as a classic sitcom about Jake and his two ninja-sword-fighting, love-potion-concocting, pizza-devouring college roommates.  All is well until a commercial break goes wrong and Jake realizes he is trapped in his own home, surrounded by a black void. As Jake uncovers more of his own reality, he must decide between playing the part he’s always played or going off-script and risking his life.

Entries.Title: The Death of Summer Cicada
Entries.Description: Suddenly losing her voice for years, director Chen Zhen (30, female) returns to her hometown to find actors for her film. A traditional ritual plunges her into a greater crisis, mirroring the confusion in her own directionless work.

Entries.Title: Lobster Hunt
Entries.Description: Four contestants compete to bring a lobster to the finish line in an intense gameshow with a $1,000,000 cash prize.

Entries.Title: Geeky In Pink
Entries.Description: Beverly has a secret. And it’s not that she’s hopelessly geeky or obsessed with 80s movies, those are obvious. Beverly has a crush on her best friend, the catholic guilt-ridden Mina. When Mina is asked to the prom by hunky quarterback Jason Collins, Beverly is forced to put her fantasies aside and find the courage to tell Mina how she really feels- even if it means losing her forever.

Entries.Title: The Wages of Sin
Entries.Description: Two Brothers attempt to rob a rich doctor's house to get a large sum of money in a short amount of time.

Entries.Title: Repetition
Entries.Description: A man is stuck in an unfamiliar environment reliving the same moment.

Entries.Title: The World's Worst Therapist
Entries.Description: An unorthodox, unethical Therapist promotes his services and displays his work.

Entries.Title: Boy Mom
Entries.Description: Ms. Bird was a major Hollywood star in her prime. Now a four-time divorcé who hasn’t worked in years, she attempts to claw her way back into the limelight, leveraging her ill son.

Entries.Title: I Hate My Love Life
Entries.Description: Married for more than 25 years, Dave (Reggie C. Hayes) and Angie Turner (Terri J. Vaughn) have hit a rough patch in their relationship. Listening to bad advice from their friends, the internet, and podcasters has them believing life is better in the streets.

Entries.Title: The Distance Between
Entries.Description: After his mother’s death, a boxer struggles with grief and a strained relationship with his father, who coaches him in the ring but remains distant outside of it, forcing him to fight both opponents and inner demons.

Entries.Title: Flesh of the Unforgiven

Entries.Description: This magnum opus from visionary non-fiction filmmaker Peter Mettler (Gambling, Gods and LSD) is an innovative, intimate, intercontinental epic that embraces coincidence and elevates the film diary to new heights.

At its heart is the Survivor Model—a transformative approach that decriminalizes prostituted individuals while imposing strict penalties on pimps, traffickers, and sex buyers.

Entries.Title: The Clique
Entries.Description: A group of friends in high school decide to go camping in a remote location deep in the woods. What they don’t yet understand is that someone (or something) is watching them. The group begin to slowly notice mysterious happenings throughout their campsite. Things go missing, and slowly, one by one, the people do too.

Entries.Title: TAPE OF '25
Entries.Description: In the final week of college, a tight-knit group of friends unravels when an AI-generated sextape throws them into a spiral of paranoia, jealousy, and identity crises. Especially Jack, whose girlfriend appears in the video with a mysterious but confident outcast.

Entries.Title: Thiruttu Dhum
Entries.Description: திருட்டு தம் follows a boy sneaking a smoke in the bathroom while his strict father sleeps. When his father knocks, he panics, trying to flush the cigarette bud, but it keeps on floating. In desperation, he grabs it with his hand and exits, only for his father to enter. In the final frame, smoke escapes the bathroom fan, revealing the father is also secretly smoking.

Entries.Title: Nothing To Lose
Entries.Description: A short documentary of Quentin and Graham driving across America.

Entries.Title: Marcie's
Entries.Description: Marcie has a dream: to own Ed's Tavern, where she's bartender and den mother to a devoted small-town community. But when a developer sets his sights on Ed's wooded land, Marcie's future is upended. As she rallies her people, she finds that an endangered bird may hold the key to preventing the loss of the tavern and saving her community.

Entries.Title: First Ladies
Entries.Description: A strugguling exotic dancer who finds hope in a new relationship in an electric U.S-themed strip club, only to risk losing it to self sabotage.

Entries.Title: Bar

Two parts competition,  one part the camraderie of teachers and learners served over ice  with a dash of spiritous history, this film will whet your interest in  and appreciation for what goes into serving a great drink well

With the help of his ex-wife, they visit a clinic where they encounter a couple facing their own health challenges. As their paths intertwine, each character grapples with personal struggles and the search for hope.

Entries.Title: The Hidden Lives of Pigs
Entries.Description: We know pigs as bacon, ham, or ribs - but is there more to them than this? Pigs have their own hidden lives, which will surprise you.

Entries.Title: Spiderman Homeless
Entries.Description: In an alternate universe, a homeless superhero must navigate the harsh realities of society while battling the growing homelessness crisis in Australia, fighting for justice in a world that has abandoned him.

Entries.Title: Contemplation
Entries.Description: Alan Saber, a 22-year-old screenwriter, wants to get his screenplays greenlit. However, he's met with rejection and negative criticism, leading to him doubting his capability of writing screenplays. He does get back on track and builds some resilience after having a thorough conversation with five other transparent versions of himself. Screenwriting isn't easy but it's also not impossible.

Entries.Title: LIMBO
Entries.Description: A narrator wanders the empty and surreal digital landscapes from video game worlds

Entries.Title: The Beginning of the End
Entries.Description: SCP The Beginning of the End follows Alex Carter, a divorced father eager to spend the day with his daughter, Lucy. As dawn breaks, he prepares for their long-awaited picnic, savoring a rare moment of normalcy. But after a tense phone call is cut short by screams and static, his world begins to unravel. The city around him descends into chaos-emergency broadcasts, abandoned streets, and something unnatural lurking in the shadows. Racing against time, Alex fights to reach Lucy, unaware that the true horror has only just begun.

Entries.Title: Absorption
Entries.Description: While on a walk in a field, a man's car refuses to unlock and mysterious soundwaves emanating from the distance cause him to suffer a extreme headache and pass out. Awaking later that night still in the field, his car unlocks and he drives home. On his way remembering strange visions coded in a blue hue of him being experimented on by a unknown entity. Later that night, he soon realizes that whatever caused him to pass out may have followed him home.

Entries.Title: dodger

Entries.Title: I Want My D&D
Entries.Description: A found footage exploration of the Dungeons & Dragons witch hunt.

Entries.Title: Sierra Vista, AZ

Entries.Title: Memories of Los Angeles
Entries.Description: Take a dreamy journey through L.A.’s vanished icons, crumbling theaters, hidden oil wells and empty movie palaces. Told through personal memories and urban exploration. Memories of Los Angeles drifts between nostalgia and discovery, weaving cinema’s lost landmarks with intimate reflections on how a city’s past shapes its vibe today.

Entries.Title: Charge
Entries.Description: Charge is ultimately an investigation of light as a source to transform the future.

Entries.Title: A Night To Remember
Entries.Description: An awkward boy and a shy girl meet on a bench, what awaits is a night they will remember forever.

Entries.Title: Hanging Up the Hat
Entries.Description: The film follows Carson Pedaci, a college senior preparing to step away from not just one, but many defining roles—as a leader, a performer, and a symbol of tradition. Through intimate storytelling and striking visuals, Hanging Up the Hat is a heartfelt reflection on change, letting go, and discovering who you are beyond the roles you’ve always played.

Entries.Title: life of the party
Entries.Description: On their seventeenth birthday, a young teen stands at the threshold of time, grappling with the bittersweet realization that their childhood and the world they once knew are slipping away.

Entries.Title: Toward a Course Bend All
Entries.Description: A night of tortured and solitary sleep, in which fears unfold and a bell tolls.

Entries.Title: Shearling - May 24, 2025

Entries.Title: Quiet Apocalypse: Day One
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Once Upon a Wetland
Entries.Description: As restrictions tighten across the country, Durham, North Carolina preps for the annual Beaver Queen Pageant a campy, un-beaver-lievable celebration of LGBTQIA activism, environmental conservation, and outrageous critter cosplay.

Entries.Title: SOME KIND of GUILT
Entries.Description: a woman goes to meet someone in the city

Entries.Title: Let's Eat (,) Seabass
Entries.Description: A student, Henry, overhears a fellow classmate, Declan, saying that he wants to eat another class mate named Seabass. Henry decides to take matters into his own hands.

Entries.Title: Saint Vegas
Entries.Description: A young woman, Anastasia, escapes far from home to work as a non-sexual escort in Las Vegas in an attempt to suppress her feelings after losing her mother. On one particular night she meets an older woman, Carmen, who tests her emotional boundaries and opens the floodgates to Anastasia’s grief. In the face of her deepest fears, Anastasia decides to head back home to confront all she’s left behind.

Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth: Hatching a New Era
Entries.Description: Journey into the film with Scarlett Johansson, Jonathan Bailey, Mahershala Ali and the rest of the cast and filmmakers. Dive into the ocean sequence and learn about the challenges of shooting on open water, the one-of-a-kind gimbal used to toss around the Essex and Mariposa, and the VFX wizardry that brought the Mosasaurus and Spinosaurs to life. Follow the cast and crew’s footsteps as they navigate the challenges of shooting in exotic jungles, beaches, and tall grass fields that become home to the Titanosaurs. Brace for a T. Rex encounter that’s different than anything experienced before with a nail-biting river chase recreated from Michael Crichton’s original Jurassic Park novel. Soar into the Quetzalcoatlus sequence as the cast trains for and shoots their cliff rappelling scenes. Go inside the heart-stopping third act and witness the process of crafting sets that allow the movie’s mutant dinosaurs to step out of nightmare-inspired designs and stop on an exhilarating rampage.

Entries.Title: One Valentine's Day in Edinburgh
Entries.Description: Valentine's Day 1993 the first Irish Women's International Rugby team ran onto the pitch to face their Scottish counterparts in Edinburgh and together they made history.

Entries.Title: Body Motion
Entries.Description: Dancer Dana uncovers her partner Yan's voyeuristic obsession with their neighbor, Lotta, igniting a silent gender power battle for control, self-expression, and the reclamation of her agency.

Entries.Title: VOIDBOUND
Entries.Description: An astronaut and her robot must escape from the bottom of a black hole.

Entries.Title: Reflection

Entries.Title: Mountain

Entries.Title: Monster

Entries.Title: Deductibles
Entries.Description: Young and inexperienced, Parker lands the role of a production assistant on The Virtua Paradox, a chaotic student film helmed by its director, Sidney. But when the two inevitably clash over an insurance dispute, Parker begins to question her role—and whether the world of filmmaking is truly where she belongs.

Entries.Title: Alien Dan & Spaceman Steve
Entries.Description: Alien Dan, a weird and wacky alien, gives a tour of his home world along side his buddy Spaceman Steve, an astronaut hailing from mother earth.

Entries.Title: Matter of Mind: My Alzheimer’s
Entries.Description: Matter of Mind: My Alzheimer’s is an intimate portrayal of three families confronting the unique challenges of Alzheimer’s and how this progressive neurodegenerative disease transforms roles and relationships. Whether it's a partner caring for a loved one or an adult child shifting into being their parent's caregiver, these stories show how families evolve when a loved one is diagnosed.

Entries.Title: Dinky and The Muffin Mystery

Entries.Title: Le Cosmos

Entries.Title: fíodóra
Entries.Description: fíodóra, named after the Irish word for weaver, offers an intimate portrait of award-winning textile artist Lara Pain, as she invites us into her London studio to experience the ancient magic of handweaving.

Entries.Title: A Dish Best Served Cold
Entries.Description: Lucas, a death row chef is already down on his luck when a new order comes to his kitchen, and it's from the man who murdered his son. He's left with an ultimatum: cook the meal or lose his job. Tempers run hot, but revenge is always a dish best served cold.

Entries.Title: LearX
Entries.Description: David Ehalt is the latest contestant in the 24 hour Basement Challenge.  The rules are simple you must stay in the scary basement of the late serial killer Mr.LearX for 24 to win the 100k 24 hour Basement Challenge . When creepy and mysterious things start to occur in basement will David have enough bravery to stay the course or will he give up. LearX promises to be the most realistic found footage horror movie of 2025. Are the stories of the late serial killer true? Join David in this horror found footage masterpiece but be careful and just one question, who is that behind you while your reading this?

Entries.Title: MY PHANTOM LIMB
Entries.Description: The making of this film harks back to a time when the ideas of Spiral Spectrum were still taking shape. It was shot with an old JVC Handycam, during a autumn sunset when the sun spilled its deepest crimson hues over the leaves...  During that period, a live version of Swans' track "I Am Tower" was playing—an echo that accompanied the filming process. The cinematographer listened attentively, striving to find a portal into another realm of perception, amidst the rhythmic dance of music, light, and leaves.

Entries.Title: The Real Cian Stanley
Entries.Description: Irish Content Creator Cian Stanley, reflects on the highs and lows in his life to figure out what truly defines him.

Entries.Title: CO Woods (Found Footage)

Entries.Title: Unfiltered Naari

Entries.Title: Jackson Avery Steele's Machinal
Entries.Description: Adapted from Sophie Treadwell's radical play, "Jackson Avery Steele's Machinal" is an intense and deadly exploration of a woman's suffocating existence. Helen Jones is an average woman, but what she does to escape that suffocation is anything but average.

Entries.Title: Phobophobia
Entries.Description: An unnamed character is walking home one day, and they see an unconscious body, once they decide to leave it, they start to gain this subconscious guilt. When they begin to confront this guilt, something uncanny comes with it.

Entries.Title: and Yesterday and Today and Tomorrow
Entries.Description: Sam adjusts to living at a mental health residential facility having just been given new diagnoses and coming out of a major depressive episode.

Entries.Title: Starstruck!

Entries.Title: Long Live Lennon
