Lennon unites with his professor Tolliver and marijuana connoisseur Thunder, to help grow the empire. The companions decide it's time to take a stand in this war and they're not going to lose.

Entries.Title: Junior
Entries.Description: A college freshman joins his school’s Filipino club, only to discover that they’re specifically looking for good dancers.

Entries.Title: Swollen Creek
Entries.Description: The day Gina's life went down the toilet.

Entries.Title: O SWEET AMERICA!
Entries.Description: A hitchhiking artist travels back to his home town.

Entries.Title: Lisa Dahl: Blessed By Grace
Entries.Description: After the tragic loss of her son Justin, chef Lisa Dahl found solace and purpose in Sedona, Arizona—where the stunning red rocks, long revered for their spiritual energy, became the backdrop for her transformation. What began as a tribute to their shared love of cooking has grown into a legacy of six beloved restaurants that helped shape the region’s culinary identity. This heartfelt film explores how one woman’s faith, strength, and devotion turned unimaginable loss into lasting beauty—and how every dish she creates and every guest she serves keeps her son's spirit alive.

Entries.Title: A Warm Welcome
Entries.Description: Maggie takes the train to her grandparent's house.

Entries.Title: One But Many
Entries.Description: One But Many reveals how the escalating global crisis of Human-Wildlife Conflict is being weaponized against the very people and animals it affects most. This unflinching documentary exposes the deep ties between the trophy hunting industry and policy decisions driven by both the U.S. and African governments, leaving communities and wildlife in peril. But in parts of Kenya, where trophy hunting has been banned for decades, extraordinary models of coexistence are not only emerging—they’re thriving. With raw truth and radical hope, One But Many dares to reimagine how humans and wildlife share space in an increasingly complex world.

Entries.Title: Oh Happy Day!
Entries.Description: Oh Happy Day! follows CHRIS, a timid little guy smitten by a sweet soul named JAZMYN. Though he lacks the confidence to tell her how he feels, he tries in his own way to get her attention. But after many failed attempts, he decides to risk it all during his Easter speech.

Entries.Title: Our Hero, Cadet
Entries.Description: Cadet, a bright-eyed third-grader, dreams of going to space. While being held inside for detention, she is rescued by two strangers who need her help.

Entries.Title: The Tulips
Entries.Description: In a rural southern town, young Dolores discovers a girl who's been buried alive in her local graveyard. She wrestles with whether or not to reveal her buried friend Tulip and give up the only friend she's ever known, while her older sister Lucy becomes increasingly worried that Tulip isn't real at all.

Entries.Title: Hysteria
Entries.Description: A young woman finds herself lured by her own dreams and, in a desperate search for escapism, she has to choose between reality and fantasy.

Entries.Title: War Cry
Entries.Description: A skateboard video featuring Justin Figueroa, Jonno Gaitan, Nick Pope, Tanner Cribbs, Richie Belton, Collin Provost, Jake Hill, Cody Moyles, Evan Dineen, Kyle Walsh, Riley Hawk & Jake Braun.

Entries.Title: kid with a pearl earring
Entries.Description: Obsessed with forgiveness, a filmmaker builds a self portrait through two relationships with men and the objects they left behind.

Entries.Title: The Mysteries of Stonehenge
Entries.Description: In a new Channel 4 series Mysteries of Stonehenge explores the strange and unknown details of three iconic sites and phenomena, starting with Stonehenge.

Entries.Title: PUPPET-PEOPLE-PUPPET-SCENE
Entries.Description: a pop-up ad takes us down a path that leads to a Czech UFO religion, Robert Mitchum and enlightenment.

Entries.Title: Batashe Premer Ghran
Entries.Description: Batashe Premer Ghran is a romantic Drama

Entries.Title: Angel
Entries.Description: A young up and coming actress who is entangled with drugs and alcohol finally gets the audition of her dreams, until she realises the role she is playing, is her life

Entries.Title: Bitches
Entries.Description: After three influencers spend a weekend living off tequila and tainted meat tacos, their behavior starts to change inexplicably.

Entries.Title: Marvel & DC's War on God: Stan Lee, God, and the Devil
Entries.Description: When people think of Marvel Comics they often think of Stan Lee, the iconic, friendly, smiling face of Marvel Comics. However, many are unaware that Stan Lee purposely set out to repudiate God's goodness and diminish His power. Lee not only sought to paint God as an inept and uncaring being but, driven by his own infamous ego, sought to exalt himself and his plethora of comic gods and superheroes above God. Did Stan Lee have a dark and nefarious agenda? Did Stan Lee seek to distort God into a bumbling creator unworthy of worship? Did Stan Lee and Marvel Comics portray Satan as the real hero or savior of humanity? Journey with us as we discover more troubling insights in Part 3 of Marvel and DC's War on God series to discover how one of comic's most prolific creative leaders, as well as his well-known associates Jack Kirby and Steve Ditko, continues to indoctrinate and perpetuate Satanic lies to hundreds of millions of young people among his unsuspecting fans.

Entries.Title: Period
Entries.Description: Trapped in a nightclub, a trans man must brave the women's bathroom after an invasive visit from that time of month.

Entries.Title: Don't Fret
Entries.Description: 8-year-old Noah was sad bored during summer break. All his friends are on holiday, which leaves him lonely alone with his busy parents. Until one day, something very strange happened...

Entries.Title: NARROWS
Entries.Description: NARROWS is a hand-drawn animated thriller about a frog dad and his two tadpoles, trying to survive against the odds in a hostile canyon.

Entries.Title: Love Chaos Kin
Entries.Description: An Indian immigrant mother helps her adopted twin daughters reconnect with their White birth mother and estranged Native American father, exposing raw class divides while transforming their understanding of identity and belonging.

Entries.Title: Cockroach
Entries.Description: A black transgender man plans to exchange sex for top surgery money with an older gay man until his night hook up turns into a hunt for a cockroach who inspires him to open his heart and conquer his fears.

Entries.Title: A Broad in England
Entries.Description: A hopeful yet timid American girl moves to England with big dreams of university and a new life, told as a musical through a blend of theatrical aesthetics.

Entries.Title: WICKET
Entries.Description: A feature documentary that chronicles the rise of legendary Bboy Wicket, famed for his explosive power moves and seamless footwork that redefined breakdancing. From San Francisco's Renegade Rockers to learning from East Coast icon Flomaster, Wicket fused styles into a groundbreaking form. But behind the fame, Gabriel Jaochico grappled with hiding his identity as a gay man. Featuring electrifying '90s battle footage and candid interviews, the film explores his dual journey—dance stardom and personal liberation. It's a powerful, joyful tribute to self-expression, resilience, and the courage to live authentically.

Entries.Title: Candeleda
Entries.Description: First track released from Max Cooper & Rob Clouth EP '8 Billion Realities'. Video was made by Brandon Eversole after Max discovered his talent and contacted him.

Entries.Title: Gingerale
Entries.Description: Ginger fears her inner child has been recently murdered, and it's up to Detective Mulch and his Bearded Dragon sidekick, Globio, to guide her in capturing those feelings once more.

Entries.Title: performance
Entries.Description: BAN ANIMAL TRAPPING.

Entries.Title: PARAQUAT
Entries.Description: A series of paraquat poisonings draws two detectives into a tense and chilling investigation.

Entries.Title: Orphans and Other Children: Live
Entries.Description: A concert film featuring entirely improvised music.

Entries.Title: Pictures
Entries.Description: A teenage girl and her older sister fight over their late mother's camera, and who has the right to remember her.

Entries.Title: The Wallet
Entries.Description: A man finds a lost wallet and decides to keep it. But strange events begin to unfold - unsettling coincidences, eerie encounters, and a creeping sense of paranoia. The wallet isn’t just an object; it seems to draw misfortune and mystery. As reality starts to blur, he’s forced to return it, only to realize that some things are never truly lost...

Entries.Title: D R E A M S I C L E: The Interview
Entries.Description: Maren Morris invite us to witness a therapy session where she discuss details of her new album, D R E A M S I C L E.

Entries.Title: I'm Not Nominating Anyone -The Reda Cut-
Entries.Description: Two guys have a fateful encounter in a parking lot near an AMC movie theater.

Entries.Title: Luke Combs: Dive Bars to Country Star
Entries.Description: Despite Luke Comb's humble start, his deep, soulful sound would blend traditional country with a modern pop twist and earn him 16 number one hits. He was twice voted CMA's Entertainer of the Year. Luke clearly proved the experts wrong.

Entries.Title: Saimun-Klau
Entries.Description: In an ancient alternate timeline, the legendary warrior Saimun-Klau rises in a land of pyramids, myths, and war. The empire is ruled with an iron hoof by Timmond Chese, a corrupted demigod mouse, and Gengus Ham, a brutal warlord pig who burns kingdoms for sport. With darkness looming over Egypt, Saimun must uncover his true destiny and stop them before they awaken eternal chaos. But the end is only the beginning — as a portal opens to another realm… one ruled by someone far more sinister: Simon Claw.  This is the origin story.  This is the war before the timeline broke.  This is Saimun-Klau.

Entries.Title: People of Comedy
Entries.Description: Kenny Robinson's legendary comedy showcase has influenced Canadian comedy for 30 years, with performances by Russell Peters, Hassan Phills, Crystal Ferrier, Mr. Lewin and others.

Entries.Title: Be the Creature
Entries.Description: Over the course of a high-pressure day, a struggling dancer must contend with the entity who haunts her.

Entries.Title: Night With a Nice Guy
Entries.Description: A nerdy, socially awkward man takes a woman on a disastrous first date, leading to a dangerous encounter when his “nice guy” persona turns sinister.

Entries.Title: Piñata Prayers
Entries.Description: Breaking down the colonial tradition of piñatas, this personal film probes into a loss of faith while retracing a family history.

Entries.Title: Threads of a Revolution
Entries.Description: When artist Janet Biehl fell in love with radical American philosopher Murray Bookchin in the 1980s whilst editing his ground-breaking opus “The Ecology of Freedom”, she could never have imagined that it would one day take her halfway across the globe. Now, over 40 years later, Janet travels from America to the Middle East to witness something remarkable - how Murray’s ideas have ignited a female-led revolution in North-East Syria, where society is being rebuilt in the wake of victory over ISIS.  Janet meets the women who are turning her late partner’s political theories into a modern reality, creating a grassroots communal democracy. Janet draws what she sees, and her illustrations capture the humanity of ordinary people in their struggle to self-govern. Now, at this critical moment for Syria and with this revolutionary project under renewed threat, "Threads of a Revolution" reveals a possible way forward for those prepared to fight for a new way to live.

Entries.Title: Characters Disappearing
Entries.Description: New York City, 1971. As the Asian American Movement intensifies in its battle for equality, collective paranoia rises as those within its orbit begin to vanish without explanation.

Entries.Title: Trash Baby
Entries.Description: Stevie is stuck at home for yet another sweltering summer in Pine Park. She soon crosses paths with wild not-so-child, Edie, and finds herself grappling with the natural desire to grow up and the reality of what we lose when we do.

Entries.Title: Have You Seen Him?
Entries.Description: “Have You Seen Him” is a gripping short film that takes you on an emotional roller coaster, leading to an ending you’ll never see coming.

Entries.Title: Thanks, Babs!
Entries.Description: Meet Babs, an optimistic octogenarian speed-racing through life, one five-year plan at a time.  Like a modern day Maude from Harold and Maude, Babs moves through life at breakneck speed. She spars with her ex over her 5-year plan for relationships, admitting to a reputation for always having her vibrator. She lap-dances at a party celebrating the 41st anniversary of her 39th birthday, threatening to kick anyone who says “80” out the door. A trip to the AIDS memorial grove on the heels of aquacise class at the Jewish Community Center sparks a glorious rumination on a possible afterlife.

Entries.Title: The Dax Flame Show
Entries.Description: Comedian Dax Flame decides to host a show of some sort

Entries.Title: A Faith Under Seige
Entries.Description: In a region once celebrated as the post-Soviet "Bible Belt," a rapidly growing community of Evangelical and Protestant believers becomes a prime target under Russia's expanding occupation.

Entries.Title: Machines For Living In
Entries.Description: An LSD-laced Internet ritual leads a young person into contact with a mysterious digital entity.

Entries.Title: Tur De Zur
Entries.Description: Three best friends learn life-changing lessons at an awful house party.

Entries.Title: A Cry In Secret
Entries.Description: Struggling to connect with his dad emotionally, DJ is faced with molestation from a close friend of the family. Everything unfolds after a tragic accident.

Entries.Title: Say as I Say
Entries.Description: During Shabbat service at a synagogue, a woman sorting canned goods for a food drive receives a disturbing call from a stranger.

Entries.Title: In Limbo (Working Title)
Entries.Description: A story of two Detectives during two different periods of their time together as work partners told simultaneously. As we follow their stories it becomes clear that all is not as it seems.

Entries.Title: Hanabie - Live at Wacken Open Air
Entries.Description: Hanabie is like a kaleidoscopic storm. Colorful, loud, and unpredictable. The young women from Tokyo blend metalcore with J-pop melodies, rap, and kawaii aesthetics to create a sound that oscillates between sweet comic-book worlds and brute sonic power. Live, this mixture explodes in a wild firework of colors, fast breakdowns, and irresistible hooks. Hanabie. represent boundless energy, nonconformity, and the freedom to rain glitter even on the hardest metal. At Wacken, Japanese pop culture and Western hardcore collide, and the result is a show that overwhelms all the senses.

Entries.Title: Sea, Swallow Me
Entries.Description: As two friends attempt to make the most of Claire’s last few days in Florida, they discover a pair of seemingly supernatural conch shells leading their final days together to spiral into something surreal.

Entries.Title: Daughter of The Dark
Entries.Description: When an ominous new painting the Figlia Dell' Oscurita is brought into a museum, no one can predict the carnage that ensues.

Entries.Title: The Final
Entries.Description: A girl, shocked after receiving her mark on the final is put through a lot of stress, and she might be seeing her best friend, everywhere?

Entries.Title: One In The Chamber
Entries.Description: Wealthy Socialite Julian Livingston has been murdered, his fiance seeks out a lone Detective Liam Grisby, whose taken an interest in Gretchen to solve the mystery of the ominous stalker that has made a threat on her life. Will Grisby be able to put the pieces of the case together in time?

Entries.Title: Night of 1000 Eyes
Entries.Description: Elliot’s fragile mind fractures when his roommate, Cassie, unknowingly discovers his latest drawing. As he grows increasingly paranoid about what she sees in it, his fear twists reality around him, leading him down a path he can’t escape.

Entries.Title: Adephagia
Entries.Description: After years of suffering from an eating disorder, a young woman tries to eat a sandwich without repulsing herself and falling back into bad habits.

Entries.Title: Ode to liberty
Entries.Description: Short documentary consisting of archival footage and movies that depict the birth of the United States of America, from the Boston tea party to the Spanish American war

Entries.Title: Boy Friends
Entries.Description: As seen through the raw digital lens of a Canon XL2, Boy Friends exposes four young men's desperate yearnings for connection and meaning within the loud city of Los Angeles.

Entries.Title: BREACH: PART ZERO
Entries.Description: A corrupted computer system explains its reasoning for taking over control of the world.

Entries.Title: Chappell Roan: Lowlands 2025
Entries.Description: Chappell Livestream From The Lowlands Festival in The Netherlands 2025

Entries.Title: The Monster Part 2: Hunting the Hunted
Entries.Description: A chilling sequel to the blockbuster hit The Monster (2025)... Edye Dunn and her loyal sidekick, Elijah Jitterman, venture out into the haunted warehouse next to RASOTA. The two set out on their grueling quest for vengeance, aiming to capture and kill the cruel yet mysterious Monster.

Entries.Title: I Fear Goodbyes
Entries.Description: I don't know wether I want you to live or die - all I know is - I Fear Goodbyes

Entries.Title: Amityville Sasquatch Vs Kreepy Klown
Entries.Description: Two titans of horror collide on the screen for the first time.

Entries.Title: Walang Masulingan
Entries.Description: The two-channel video installation captures scenes from the Manila metropolitan area, home to over 12 million people. Since July 2022, Ferdinand Marcos Jr. – son of the former dictator – has governed the Philippines as its president, alongside Vice President Sara Duterte, daughter of Rodrigo Duterte. The collaboration between Kiri Dalena and Ben Brix incorporates aerial images to reveal the city’s dynamic activity from above, while ground-level shots follow individuals through various aspects of daily life and diverse social and urban spaces: They go to school, drive to work, attend cultural events or church services, paint protest posters, play music, or do domestic chores. Many scenes capture spontaneous moments, while others were reenacted with participants, blurring the lines between documentary and drama.  - Michaela Richter, Berlin

Entries.Title: Me and Mr. Merhige
Entries.Description: A documentary about film school student Miguel Alejandro Marquez and his reasoning for liking the work of Auteur film director E Elias Merhige.

Entries.Title: Neal Morse - Live at the Cavern Club
Entries.Description: Neal Morse performs Beatles covers at the Cavern Club in Liverpool, England on June 2, 2025.

Entries.Title: A Walk Down Broad St.
Entries.Description: A film about the celebration of the Eagles Winning Super Bowl 59.

Entries.Title: Cries from the Cotton Field
Entries.Description: Feature-length documentary saga of Italians who were unscrupulously recruited to work cotton fields in the American South, after the Civil War, and their resilient journey of hope, hardship and faith. Told in first person by parish priest Father Pietro Bandini, a "Moses-like" figure expelled by the Jesuits, who led his flock out of death and despair, to a new beginning in the Ozark hills. The Italian enclave Bandini founded, Tontitown, still thrives in Northwest Arkansas. Arkansas PBS broadcast September 2024. Streaming venues fall 2024. https://vimeo.com/794374250

Entries.Title: home
Entries.Description: On a cold night in NYC, after missing curfew at a shelter, T-a homeless queer teen-searches for a way to get off the streets. But as the night gets colder and he's exhausted all options, he makes a tough choice for his survival.

Entries.Title: Broken Stranger
Entries.Description: "BRokeN StRangER" introduces us to Marlow on the ledge of a high-rise apartment building as he prepares to jump and commit suicide. His tremendous despair is caused by untreated bipolar disorder. But before he can end his life, Marlow is discovered by a visiting filmmaker, Josh. Their honest interaction reveals that Josh has a good friend, Chase, with the same condition. And that the right medication can transform emotionally crippling mood swings and delusional thoughts into a satisfying and productive future. Marlow is ready to learn more and his life is instantly saved.—David Rabadi

Entries.Title: Cutlery
Entries.Description: After a worldwide surge in plasticware sales, someone—or something—sets out to save the world using any means necessary.

Entries.Title: When the Ringlights Dim
Entries.Description: A famed content creator is kidnapped. Unable to involve the police, a group of influencer friends attempts to solve this twisted mystery the only way they know how: through social media sites, dating apps, and content house contacts.

Entries.Title: Aliens in the Hood
Entries.Description: The hood politics of the neighborhood become even more complicated after the arrival of aliens! When one man in the neighborhood is blessed with superpowers, he and the other warring factions are headed to war over control of the current drug trade.

Entries.Title: Name of the Game
Entries.Description: Independent Documentary exploring the lives and history of male exotic dancers in South Central Los Angeles and how it intersects with the origins of hip hop, gang culture, and kung fu assassins.

Entries.Title: 67 Bombs to Enid
Entries.Description: From Executive Producer Errol Morris, 67 BOMBS TO ENID is an intimate, character-driven documentary about survivors of nuclear weapons testing in the Marshall Islands who relocated to rural America. The film presents intimate access to characters with first-hand accounts of bomb blasts and their descendants who speak to the generational impact these perverse weapons of war have had on humans.

Entries.Title: Pranks
Entries.Description: After an outbreak of PRANKS targeting teachers (including his dad) Harry launches an investigation to find out who is responsible and why they are doing it.

Entries.Title: Darkroom
Entries.Description: A photo obsessed recluse develops pictures in a darkroom in hopes of uncovering an unknown subject.

Entries.Title: We Live Here Now
Entries.Description: Abandoned by the roommate she'd been expecting to live with, Caroline finds herself stuck in a new city alone, in an apartment and neighborhood she can’t afford.

Entries.Title: The Rewind
Entries.Description: Josh is desperate to get back his wife, Nina. He turns to a new technology that allows users to re-live a difficult moment in hope of learning important lessons. Impatient for results he soon discovers that Rewind therapy is not the magic fix he hoped for and there are those who would put this tech to a more sinister use?

Entries.Title: Philia
Entries.Description: Milo, a lonely high school boy struggling to fit in, finds companionship with a mythical creature he meets in the woods.

Entries.Title: Rezbotanik
Entries.Description: After nights of heavy partying, a trans performer goes to the Botanical Garden of Lisbon to get sober again.

Entries.Title: Nothing Beside Remains
Entries.Description: Follows a day in the life of a down-on-her-luck fortune teller trying to sort out her increasingly dire future while predicting the destinies of her clients.

Entries.Title: Welcome to Starr Park!
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: Crying On Command
Entries.Description: After nailing an audition that might make her career, Jordyn has one last obstacle in her way: the director wants to see her cry.

Entries.Title: True Crime
Entries.Description: When a classmate gets in her way, a true crime-obsessed teenage girl goes to extreme lengths to create her very own true crime.

Entries.Title: Gay Jesus
Entries.Description: The Last Supper, The Crucifixion, and The Second Coming. Three iconic moments from Jesus’ life as he fulfills his God-given purpose – or at least, tries to. In his short time on earth, Jesus faces persecution, religious bias, and homophobia.

Entries.Title: Axel
Entries.Description: Axel is a happy 2-year-old. As long as mommy is near, the world brings something exciting every day. But one day, mommy leaves, and Axel is left to find new meaning.

Entries.Title: The Last Hour
Entries.Description: A protagonist wakes up with a time bomb on his chest, visibly ticking toward zero. Over the course of the film, he grapples with various emotions, confronting deep questions about human morality and legacy.

Entries.Title: I Killed Osama!?
Entries.Description: An absurd political satire of post-9/11 American ideology.

Entries.Title: Peaks to Prairie: A Holistic Regenerative Approach
Entries.Description: How can we harness the power of mushrooms to fight climate change?  In the American West, wildfires spread fast.  To slow the flames, forest managers are thinning the forests. Cutting down trees.  But where does all that wood go?  Nearby on the agricultural prairie, soils sit degraded from generations of traditional farming. The soil lacks the organic matter they need to thrive.  Could these two challenges provide solutions to each other— with a little help from Mother Nature?  Peaks to Prairie is a short film about nature-based climate solutions and how mushrooms can play a key role.

Entries.Title: Creamy, Not Crunchy
Entries.Description: When Craig makes a simple but puzzling grocery request, his roommates become perplexed and hesitant to learn his true motivations.

Entries.Title: Tzar
Entries.Description: Four friends leave to volunteer in the Israel-Lebanon conflict, emotions are high strung after not only themselves but their families have to deal with the ever growing mental and physical actions of one character. We witness breakdowns, relationships tested and the truth is revealed

Entries.Title: Crimson Resurrection
Entries.Description: Imagine you've just rented a horror movie from Blockbuster Video in 1992...

Entries.Title: Piety's Hands
Entries.Description: Marie-Franc, a young girl who struggles with her beliefs, seeks out help to find truth in religion.  After being denied help several times, she turns to the Church of the Gods and their three Cardinals for help.

Entries.Title: The Five Stages
Entries.Description: When her best friend, Jenna, suddenly dies, Daphne takes it upon herself to prove that she is grieving, even if she may have played a part in Jenna’s death.

Entries.Title: My Brother's Keeper
Entries.Description: On the morning of a relative's funeral Charlie (Kai edwards) goes on a walk to blow of some steam and clear his head but after his brother, Dennis (Tommy Smith), shows up everything is not as it seems and Charlie must face the emotions he has let build up inside of him.

Entries.Title: Liz Trades Carrie: Tattoo Rendezvous
Entries.Description: Two teenage girls, Liz and Carrie, engage in a routine trade of cigarettes for temporary tattoos.

Entries.Title: Where Is My Home?
Entries.Description: Japanese-American filmmaker Kenji recalls his struggles with juggling life in Albuquerque, New Mexico & Japan.

Entries.Title: Wishing on Stars
Entries.Description: Mare, a graduating high school senior, must navigate the bittersweet complexities of leaving her hometown for her dream school while grappling with her growing romantic feelings for her best friend, Jules.

Entries.Title: Don't Follow Me
Entries.Description: A woman alone in a farmhouse suffers from unusual dreams and visions.

Entries.Title: IN MY HOUSE OF DREAMS
Entries.Description: Using various pieces of footage compiled over filmmaker Jesse Keel's 3-4 year filmmaking hiatus. He reflects on art, creative dry spells & his fading adolescence.

Entries.Title: The Modern Interview
Entries.Description: Jaren sits down for a job interview with only one particular company policy in mind.

Entries.Title: Ian Aber: Big Santa
Entries.Description: Ian Aber drills down on his experiences growing up in Myrtle Beach, being married to a doomsday prepper and a very special movie scene to the delight of crowd in Charleston, SC.

Entries.Title: Nowhere to Be Found
Entries.Description: Two sisters go on a senior trip to Mexico, led by Ava's boyfriend Trent. Meanwhile, journalist Jessica Vandross is going to the same Mexican town in search of her sister's killer after escaping a sex trafficking ring. These stories collide, in a thrilling fight for their lives.

Entries.Title: The Box Paradox
Entries.Description: A man tries to uncover the source of a noise coming from an empty wooden chest in his home.

Entries.Title: The Last One Standing
Entries.Description: A short film directed, shot, and starred in - completely alone in less than 24 hours

Entries.Title: Father Son
Entries.Description: One rainy day, London-based artist and musician Jesse Kanda observes his father Kasuhisa make a big block of homemade I tofu. Son helps strain seawater, Father slices the curd with deliberation. Newly fermented, a smaller block of tofu is mixed with shoyu, ginger, green onion, and nori. Dirt on feet and body, on a hammock, lying on a bed inside a fanned room: two people from two generations and cultural upbringings, and their two different aftercares.

Entries.Title: ZONE 34º03'N 118º16'W
Entries.Description: Set in LA, this raw and unfiltered vérité documentary follows three struggling addicts through a single day of survival.

Entries.Title: Creep 16
Entries.Description: In 2016, a young Raymond St. Pierre takes on ghouls in his house...or so it seems.

Entries.Title: Deepak Chandran: Technically Funny
Entries.Description: Deepak Chandran hits the stage with clever takes on tech culture, corporate absurdity, and Singapore's quirks in this razor-sharp stand-up comedy special

Entries.Title: SPUR CANDY
Entries.Description: Two outlaws find themselves at a blood-red impasse as they passionately conflate arguments with homoerotic violence.

Entries.Title: Locks & Lies
Entries.Description: What begins as a playful costume party quickly becomes a nightmare when a group of friends realizes they're locked in the house. As they race to solve clues, paranoia spreads, and they begin to wonder if danger is coming from within.

Entries.Title: Dr. Rooney's Office
Entries.Description: On the cusp of adulthood, Anthony Raskin must confront the inevitable end of his childhood through his final visit at Dr. Rooney's Pediatric Office.

Entries.Title: Angler
Entries.Description: Following the recent death of her sister Ivy, Violet cleans out Ivy’s apartment with the hope of finding some peace. She gets more than she bargained for when a mysterious camera reveals to Violet that Ivy’s troubles were more complicated than they initially appeared, suggesting that someone…or something… may have been behind her untimely end.

Entries.Title: THIS PERSON DOES NOT EXIST
Entries.Description: A bored student clicks on a website called "ThisPersonDoesNotExist.Com", but soon gets an unexpected surprise.

Entries.Title: Landscaper
Entries.Description: An old landscape painter loses his creative vision as industrial infrastructure corrupts the world’s beauty, forcing him to confront his art.

Entries.Title: LAUNDRY DAY
Entries.Description: A transgender filmmaker comes out to her mother through cleaning laundry together.

Entries.Title: Inspection 02
Entries.Description: A continually pendulating perspective of a tree on a sunny day.

Entries.Title: On The Edge: The People and Polar Bears of a Warming Arctic
Entries.Description: Churchill, Manitoba, the polar bear capital of the world, draws tourists, photographers and scientists from all over the world. But community members of this awe-inspiring destination are on edge as the warming Arctic endangers polar bears and residents' way of life. The WCCO Original documentary, "On The Edge: The People and Polar Bears of a Warming Arctic," brings you up close to polar bears in the wild with behind-the-scenes footage and unforgettable polar bear encounters. Discover how climate change in this small Canadian town is a warning for us all, and what we all can do to ensure the future of polar bears and northern communities.

Entries.Title: Dreams Unpainted
Entries.Description: A budding young artist's dreams clash with his Chinese immigrant mother's wishes; they later seek reconciliation.

Entries.Title: Hoodie Girls Gang
Entries.Description: Kayla's boyfriend Jamal is jailed and needs $10,000 bail. Desperate, Kayla and her friends plan an armed robbery. However, the heist goes wrong, and the police are on their trail. To make matters worse, Jamal's boss, Sean, demands payment for the drugs Jamal was transporting. Kayla must now free Jamal and escape town before both the police and Sean catch up to her.

Entries.Title: CHÄIR
Entries.Description: Carl just wanted to sit down. The chair had other plans.

Entries.Title: Red Dream
Entries.Description: Floating through a fever dream of grief, a woman is visited by a series of witches while traveling in her own mind.

Entries.Title: The Gores - Punk Band Documentary
Entries.Description: A documentary following the Huntsville based punk band The Gores.

Entries.Title: Mafioso
Entries.Description: DIRECTED BY PETER FREDERICK BURKE  Mafioso is a mockumentary that follows the story of Louie Lafonzo, a wannabe gangster lost in the delusion that he’s involved in the Mafia. His behavior causes concern among his friends and family, who decide to step in and help him out of this strange situation. As Louie’s delusion deepens, they’re forced to take increasingly drastic measures to scare him out of a life of crime.

Entries.Title: Ferryman
Entries.Description: A lost soul wanders through a purgatorial forest, following the summoning pulse of a light that guides his way. Can he rid himself of this self-inflicting limbo?

Entries.Title: Lost Artists of Lawrence
Entries.Description: A young filmmaker has meetings with lost artists from his hometown who pass their ideas onto him.

Entries.Title: A Couple Lives Together
Entries.Description: A man and woman spend time with each other in their apartment. Presented as ten vignettes.

Entries.Title: Midnight
Entries.Description: The night before an important audition, Laney misses the bus home. Trying to make it to her audition, Laney encounters a cast of increasingly strange and whimsical characters.

Entries.Title: Am I The Main Character
Entries.Description: Guy #2 storms into the war scene with Jerry, but realizes that this war might be a movie scene, and to ensure his survival he needs to know if he is the main character.

Entries.Title: TELL ME I'M DREAMING
Entries.Description: A pregnant young couple gets into a car accident and state law prevents them from receiving the correct medical care.

Entries.Title: Blind Desire
Entries.Description: A man parades through New York City, feasting his wandering eyes on various women. After passing an eerie hidden garden, he enters at the sight of a mysterious woman named Erinyes. He progresses deeper into the garden with no sight of Erinyes or a way out. Helpless and haunted, the man realizes too late that he has become prey to a supernatural force, bent on his suffering.

Entries.Title: Bear
Entries.Description: When Bev, a small-town grandmother, reluctantly takes her dog 'Bear' to the vet to be put down, she encounters a fanatical animal lover who questions her decision.

Entries.Title: A Storm at Sea
Entries.Description: My God, Divine Creator! Don't let me find a watery grave!

Entries.Title: Sea Star
Entries.Description: Personal tragedy prompts an elderly Black man to take his first swimming lesson in Tyler Mckenzie Evans’ profound observation of the Herculean strength needed to move through grief in the face of unshakeable fears and generational trauma.

Entries.Title: Eron
Entries.Description: Neglected at home by her hypercritical parents, Kimaya follows peculiar creature, Eron, into the forest, where she is influenced by a strangely welcoming group of eccentrics to leave her home forever.

Entries.Title: The Cheese Rush
Entries.Description: Cheese is illegally being sold on the streets. Nothing good can come from that...

Entries.Title: INFINITY IN BOTH DIRECTIONS
Entries.Description: An avant-garde short film accompanied by a "radio edit" of PRPL PPL's free jazz album “Facial Recognition." The album served as the soundtrack for a gallery installation of the same name inspired by David Lynch's  "Six Figures Getting Sick," and featured 35mm footage by Beck Simon. This short was produced at the David Lynch Graduate School of Cinematic Arts, and is dedicated to the memory its late namesake.

Entries.Title: The Jobber
Entries.Description: A Naive Luchador dreams of one day winning the championship belt like his father but is stuck wrestling as a racist gangbanger persona; he must now choose between pursuing the belt or staying true to his lucha libre roots.

Entries.Title: Star Signs
Entries.Description: A psychic goes to a house party and is pressured into using her abilities to read people's star signs. When a Gemini joins in, she envisions horrors that leave her speechless.

Entries.Title: Far Away
Entries.Description: Two friends hold space for each other in a moment of need.

Entries.Title: Tranniversary
Entries.Description: Jess celebrates a milestone in her life in this short, very serious film.

Entries.Title: How to Kill Your Husband?
Entries.Description: Chyna endures a with Mark. Her sisters plan to seek revenge, but Detective Rivera intervenes. With the support of her friend Adriana, Chyna gains the confidence to finally leave Mark for good.

Entries.Title: SURRENDER | The Go One More Ultra
Entries.Description: On the weekend of May 24th, 2025, we welcomed 132 runners from across the globe to the hallowed grounds of Bare Ranch for the inaugural Go One More Ultra.  Situated on a 4.2 mile loop that must be completed every hour on the hour until only one runner remains.  Creating a story and race that gripped the world.

Entries.Title: Penis Cat: The Movie
Entries.Description: Broke, unemployed, and recently dumped, YouTuber KoreanBF attempts to shoot a feature film about his titular "Penis Cat" YouTube video in order to make enough ad revenue to pay rent for his NYC apartment.

Entries.Title: Wild Clothing: TV Advert
Entries.Description: Follow a group of teenagers who explore the depths of Wild Clothing for new wardrobes of outfits.

Entries.Title: A Theory of /Cloud/
Entries.Description: A remix of James Benning's Ten Skies

Entries.Title: If An Owl Calls Your Name
Entries.Description: Mending the wounds of forced assimilation, Indigenous elders, healers, and activists from the Esk'etemc, Gitxsan, and Wet'suwet'en territories share a legacy of resilience and ancestral wisdom.

Entries.Title: Pastime
Entries.Description: Told through the first-person lens of first love, this film follows Crosley, a theater worker stuck in nostalgia for a time when life felt full—surrounded by friends, pursuing dreams, and in love. As memories of youth haunt him, Crosley must confront a quiet crisis: is it better to chase passion, or simply hold on to what once brought joy?

Entries.Title: Every Kind of Fruit Bearing Tree
Entries.Description: Frustrated Emma is circling the drain of forty, and life isn’t quite how she imagined it would be.  Something needs to change, but if you’re doing your best and nobody appreciates you, what more can you do?

Entries.Title: A Century After Nanook
Entries.Description: An ambitious documentary focused on the drastic environmental and cultural changes that have occurred over the last 100 years in the Inuit village of Inukjuak, the location where Robert Flaherty filmed Nanook of the North from 1920-1921. From the recording of interviews to filming daily life, much of this new documentary was produced by members of the community.

Entries.Title: The Life We Have
Entries.Description: What would you do if death felt just steps away? For Rob Shaver, who has faced multiple stage four cancer recurrences over the past two decades — death has felt like an ever-present shadow. The Life We Have captures Rob’s resilience, wisdom, and deep appreciation for life, as he navigates his latest battle with the disease.

Entries.Title: Moon Boy
Entries.Description: A  grieving sci-fi nerd receives an other-worldly transmission which he believes to be a deep space message from  his late father.

Entries.Title: A PARANORMAL INQUIRY
Entries.Description: a group of college students put their paranormal skepticism to the test across two infamous British locations

Entries.Title: Dr. Sanjay Gupta Reports: Animal Pharm
Entries.Description: Xenotransplantation, or transplanting animal organs into humans, could be on the precipice of a breakthrough, and Dr. Gupta is speaking with the doctors, geneticists and ethicists on the cutting edge of this groundbreaking research. Dr. Gupta follows the journeys of patients making medical history as some of the first people in the world to receive gene-edited pig kidneys, including an extraordinary look inside the operating room during these historic procedures.

Entries.Title: Mediums
Entries.Description: A brother and sister gifted with the power to see ghosts. When the bond breaks, the brother is drawn into a haunted house where the spirits may not be the only things waiting.

Entries.Title: Gina 3000
Entries.Description: A grieving father attempts to relive the past with the help of AI. But while he may think he is in control, the past has a funny way of catching up with you.

Entries.Title: Hotel Visitor 2
Entries.Description: Sequel to Hotel Visitor (2021) short film

Entries.Title: Caught in 4K
Entries.Description: Someone is captured in 4K, high definition, caught red-handed on the internet. ​Eleven-year-old Ava is home alone. She skilfully presents herself online. Takes Selfies. Dances. Puts on make-up. TOM_X12 likes this.

Entries.Title: One Last Game of Chess
Entries.Description: As death appears at an old man's door, the man has a simple request; One Last Game of Chess

Entries.Title: Seth: The Running Mayor of Franklin
Entries.Description: This documentary highlights the triumphs and challenges of individuals who have found strength, purpose, and camaraderie within their running community. The heartfelt message resonates far beyond the world of running, making it a must-see for audiences of all kinds.

Entries.Title: The Threshold
Entries.Description: In a world populated entirely by puppets who are unaware of their condition, a young couple finds themselves aimlessly wandering through an amusement park, yearning for excitement. He is a workaholic, consumed by his job, while she is on the brink of motherhood. Little do they know that their lives are about to be forever transformed.  In a secluded corner of the park, they encounter a group of actors led by a peculiar plague doctor. Together, they embark on a mesmerizing musical journey through time and space. Along the way, their perception of reality is shattered, leaving them to question the very essence of their existence. This extraordinary odyssey not only changes the course of their lives but also sets a new destiny for their future child.

Entries.Title: The Birth of Venus
Entries.Description: A meditation on the eternity of nature serves to mirror a young girl's ascension to Heaven. (1/3)

Entries.Title: Bullet
Entries.Description: A young photographer regains passion for his craft after befriending a homeless jazz musician.

Entries.Title: It All Began with a Melody
Entries.Description: Over the course of one fall day in Western Massachusetts, two long lost lovers find themselves on the brink of reconnection.

Entries.Title: Inshore
Entries.Description: A commercial fisherman finds love.

Entries.Title: The Special Affect
Entries.Description: Expecting mother & artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

Entries.Title: One Step Ahead
Entries.Description: A quiet suburban man reports his neighbor to the police, convinced he is a serial killer. However, the suspect is released due to lack of evidence. The man begins to fear that the neighbor will find out who told the police...

Entries.Title: He Woke Up to Deflating News
Entries.Description: A pensioner wakes up to discover his local council are turning him into a coffee shop.

Entries.Title: Giant Crush
Entries.Description: A playful short film following the story of a mech operator and his new co-pilot who remotely operate their mech using DDR-style foot controls. While facing off against a kaiju, they learn they have a deeper connection.

Entries.Title: The Inner Ramblings of Alan Grey
Entries.Description: A man's chaotic inner ramblings trigger a chemical reaction on a painting.

Entries.Title: Pickles
Entries.Description: Tobias, a recluse, wakes up one morning to the sounds of an intruder in his home.

Entries.Title: Elora
Entries.Description: Elora, a young woman, reconnects with her estranged lover.

Entries.Title: Truth Untold
Entries.Description: A cynical podcaster claiming to be seeking "truth and justice" for a 20 year old crime interviews a former suspect and quickly finds herself in over her head.

Entries.Title: Mayanagari - City of Dreams
Entries.Description: An illustrated poem about being a youthful soul lost in the ceaseless bustling crowd of a major metropolitan city, highlighting the irony of the moniker 'City of Dreams (Mayanagari)' when in fact the reality is quite to the contrary.

Entries.Title: Ugetsu
Entries.Description: Jazzy Psychedelia

Entries.Title: Iron Lung
Entries.Description: NORMA PEÑA (57), a polio survivor, faces mortal danger when a storm destroys their backup generator, cutting power to her iron lung. The iron lung is a horizontal mechanical ventilator that breathes for her. Without it, she only has a few hours before her body gives out.  LUISA PEÑA (59), Norma’s sister, is her caretaker who keeps the iron lung running. Luisa quickly ascertains they have no power, they’re isolated due to the flooding, and emergency services are useless.

Entries.Title: I Am Nothing
Entries.Description: A Dancer performs in front of an audience of passing cars.

Entries.Title: Message in a Bottle
Entries.Description: After the passing of their estranged biological father, Finneas pushes his half-sibling Jane to come to terms with their loss in fruitless ways.

Entries.Title: RB&O 2024/25: Die Walküre
Entries.Description: On a stormy night, fate brings two strangers together, unleashing a love that has the power to destroy entire worlds. Meanwhile, in the realm of the gods, an epic battle erupts between the ruler Wotan and his rebellious daughter Brünnhilde.

Entries.Title: Something to Call Our Own
Entries.Description: "Something to Call Our Own" is a compelling documentary that delves into the origins, obstacles, and evolution of modern CHamoru dance. From the small island of Guam to the international stage of FestPAC, the documentary showcases the inspiring story of cultural revival, resilience, and the ongoing journey to reclaim and preserve a tradition that belongs to the CHamoru people.  Once silenced by colonization, the CHamoru people rise—through song, chant, and dance. At the heart of this revival stands Master Frank Rabon, who dared to reimagine a lost tradition, giving it back to the generations who longed for it. From the shores of Guam to the world stage of FestPAC the CHamoru people reclaim their identity, their language, their pride. Through every movement, there’s a dance and with every dance they declare: We are still here and this is Something to Call Our Own.

Entries.Title: Mother Story
Entries.Description: A filmmaker's latest project threatens his closest relationships.

Entries.Title: Bad Intent 2: Sweet Beams
Entries.Description: A young 'Tim Thunder' develops superhuman abilities and eliminates his grandmother, before visiting an underground arcade and continuing his manic rampage alongside the evil tent that he created. Expect barking, howling and lots of lightning!

Entries.Title: Anticipation: The Sludgelung Summer Tour
Entries.Description: In May of 2024, Sludgelung went on a short tour throughout the southeast United States. This was the first time in over twenty years that a band from Starkville Mississippi has been on tour. After a last-minute decision, the tour was set and organized in just a couple of weeks. With no experience, the band set out to tour through six cities across four states in under a week. Knowing the trials and tribulations, the band sought to prove that it could be done.

Entries.Title: Overthought & Overplayed
Entries.Description: A man expels all his woes until his roommates shine a light on the real issue.

Entries.Title: Cycle
Entries.Description: The narrative of police violence in the United States is shaped by viral videos, hashtags, and a cycle of profiling and abuse, followed by law enforcement immunity. The killing of Racine"s Ty’rese West pushes this narrative forward, exposing the truth behind unchecked police reports when incidents aren’t captured for the world to see. CYCLE investigates this systemic whitewashing and gives a voice to the countless victims whose names have yet to be heard.

Entries.Title: Understanding Jarbani
Entries.Description: Alexander Joni Ramen, once a dead man, wants to make a comeback in the music business by rebranding himself as Jarbani Shaham!

Entries.Title: On the Ground
Entries.Description: A man grapples with the trappings of the modern world and refuses to conform to the system, man.

Entries.Title: BOND®: The Movie
Entries.Description: BOND® is on the case again, in a race against time to stop the escaped evil villain PACCO arrested for “taco fraud.”

Entries.Title: Imaginary Enemy
Entries.Description: A shy photographer agrees to one final interview. But as the questions dig deeper, fractures between the past and present begin to surface.

Entries.Title: A Complex History of the United States
Entries.Description: A Complex History of the United States explores America's wild history covering its rise as a global power starting at the Spanish-American War, to World War I, and onto the eventual fallout from the Treaty of Versailles. The documentary focuses on key historical figures such as Smedley Butler, Herbert Hoover, and Charles Lindbergh, as well as analyzing the rise of domestic extremist movements of the era.

Entries.Title: Can you escape Finx!?
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: Mary Blair's Pigments of Imagination
Entries.Description: The film showcases works from the special exhibition, Mary Blair: Mid-Century Magic, at The Walt Disney Family Museum, paired with corresponding, iconic Disney scenes. It includes interviews with Disney artists and experts, along with home video footage of Mary never previously shared with the public.

Entries.Title: Please, Not Yet
Entries.Description: A boy revisits his past after taking a bottle of pills in an act of suicide

Entries.Title: Devolution / A.K.A. Rest In Peace
Entries.Description: A short film edited in 2 halves. Devolution was edited by Austin Smith. A.K.A. Rest In Peace was edited by Milan Morris-Gibson.

Entries.Title: I Dare You 2
Entries.Description: In search of enlightenment, 2 dudes do crazy dares. It escalates.

Entries.Title: M
Entries.Description: In this psychosexual film, two women explore power dynamics in their new relationship.

Entries.Title: CLOSE ENCOUNTERS OF THE THIRD KIND: Full Disclosure
Entries.Description: You’ve heard the stories… You’ve seen the footage… But what if everything you thought you knew about UFOs and aliens was a LIE? The government won’t touch it. Scientists won’t admit it. Even the UFO community won’t face it. Why? Because this truth is too dangerous, too shocking, and too convicting to accept. A cosmic deception is unfolding before our eyes and it will soon ensnare the entire world. But there IS a way to unmask their true identity. Once you see it, you will never be able to go back. The book of Revelation reveals their hidden agenda—their grand plan of lying wonders that will march the whole world into the enforcement of the mark of the beast that will decide the fate of the souls of men.

Entries.Title: Peace
Entries.Description: Thade wishes for some peace from the boredom.

Entries.Title: My Battle with Blue
Entries.Description: My Battle with Blue is the story of Luna, a young woman who has a tantalising addiction to the colour blue. So much so that she hasn't left her home in months out of fear of the other colours in the real world. That is until her boyfriend Reggie convinces her to go to the place she's been dreaming of going for so long, the ocean.

Entries.Title: The Beast of Bray Road
Entries.Description: “The Beast of Bray Road” (2025) is a horror comedy film set in Elkhorn, Wisconsin directed by, written by, and starring 4 young men from the same town. It follows Ben and Zach, two amateur YouTubers, and their friends Eddie and Alex, who will do just about anything for internet virality. This time though, the group takes on more than they can handle as a prank gone awry awakens a dormant Elkhorn legend set on giving them exactly what they wanted… in all the worst ways.​

Entries.Title: this too will pass
Entries.Description: A movie about two lovers splitting paths.

Entries.Title: Freak Job
Entries.Description: An aspiring actress must do the scariest thing she’s ever done: audition for a haunted house. Not because of the spooky stuff. Because it’s depressing.

Entries.Title: The Other Place
Entries.Description: A man seeks passage to the afterlife from a guide who claims to have visited once before. They share one last conversation about their lives and regrets before one of them must take a fatal journey to the other place.

Entries.Title: Mondegreen
Entries.Description: While on a rural retreat, a sound artist obsessed with eerie sounds in her recordings unravels when a conspiracy theorist warns that she’s provoking dangerous paranormal forces.

Entries.Title: Charles Grodin: Rebel With a Cause
Entries.Description: Documentary about the life of Charles Grodin

Entries.Title: Misfire
Entries.Description: Two men wielding guns must fight to the death.

Entries.Title: All That You Love Will Be Carried Away
Entries.Description: Adapted from the Stephen King Short story of the same name.

Entries.Title: Gwenpool Saves Her Existence
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: In The Window Display
Entries.Description: As a mannequin is dressed in different clothes and placed in different window displays, she transforms into four unique characters and tells their stories.

Entries.Title: Recognition: A Band Under Observation
Entries.Description: A short film depicting the NY & DC band The Radio Relics

Entries.Title: Blurred Lines
Entries.Description: An independent filmmaker reflects on the many challenges of working with temperamental actors and pursuing “the art life".

Entries.Title: In Our Nature
Entries.Description: In a time of rising loneliness, disconnection, and division, this is the story of how nature - and those who teach with it - are helping us find our way back to each other.

Entries.Title: Paranoia
Entries.Description: With their backs to the wall, cousins Lucas and Austin find themselves in debt to a ruthless crime boss who seeks repayment in blood. They must try to navigate this new criminal life with their own lives intact.

Entries.Title: 2 Drinks Stored
Entries.Description: Two drunk college students find an old video game system from their childhoods. What could go wrong...

Entries.Title: Ree's Destiny
Entries.Description: Ree Ree, a 43-year-old social worker and single mother of three, pursues her lifelong dream of being a rapper despite backlash from her fierce teenage daughter, Destiny. Over the course of a long day, Ree Ree tries to win her daughter over before she steps up to the mic in front of her community.
