Entries.Description: A young African woman is drawn into a high-stakes manhunt that could compromise her fragile American dream.

Entries.Title: ROLETA
Entries.Description: Three friends gather for a fun night, but things spiral as drugs are shared and a game of Russian Roulette begins—turning fun into fear. As lines blur between thrill and threat, one unexpected moment fractures the illusion—leaving only smoke, silence, and something irreversible.

Entries.Title: Twinkhood
Entries.Description: What happens when a chronically horny twink gets a crush?

Entries.Title: A Tough Pill to Swallow
Entries.Description: Tempted by her desire to maintain her heterosexual facade, a lost 25-year-old must decide between taking life-altering gay conversion pills or accepting her love.

Entries.Title: Summers Day
Entries.Description: After nearly getting hit by a car, Abigail Summers finds her reality is no longer as it seems

Entries.Title: El Hada De Las Gallinas
Entries.Description: A short film  by Jimena Monteoliva

Entries.Title: One Year Later
Entries.Description: One year later, things look the same.

Entries.Title: Light-Headed
Entries.Description: A writer falls into her own void as her friends try to get her out of it.

Entries.Title: Challenge Of The Dargon Egg
Entries.Description: Two Enforcers Have Been Given A Job To Break Into A Man's House And Steal A Box Which Contains The Powerful And Mysterious DARGON EGG!

Entries.Title: Barefoot Labyrinth
Entries.Description: In a dystopian world, women are vanishing into a portal that has appeared in an abandoned industrial building outside of Los Angeles. This is a video document of the horror and ecstasy of what lies inside the barefoot labyrinth.

Entries.Title: Leopold Linus Alexander
Entries.Description: Everything signals sure that Leopold Linus Alexander is dead.

Entries.Title: The Ninth
Entries.Description: Some encounters were never meant to happen. Shadows lead Gladys into a journey she never planned. But shadows don’t always come from the light. Amid the trees and the air that grows heavier with dread, Gladys must decide… does she still want to keep moving forward?

Entries.Title: Dracula Revamped
Entries.Description: A theatre class gets together and makes a Dracula movie

Entries.Title: Touching the Sky
Entries.Description: Touching the Sky takes the viewer on a voyage of human powered flight like never before  - following wingsuit base jumpers in the European Alps, and a paragliding team across the Himalayas in Pakistan.

Entries.Title: Twin Shot
Entries.Description: Ezra, determined to solve the case of The Swedish Mafia Twins, goes undercover to put them to a stop once and for all but soon has to face the consequences of such a risk.

Entries.Title: KCW: Enter The Double Dragon
Entries.Description: To mark the announcement of the new KCW Tag Team Championship Title, KCW returns to the Hairy Dog in Derby for it's first ever tag tournament to crown the new champs.

Entries.Title: The Can Paradox
Entries.Description: Take a sip from the can at ANY TIME for a chance at BETTER POSSIBILITIES!

Entries.Title: Babka
Entries.Description: In the heart of Hasidic Williamsburg, Brooklyn, a newly blind Jewish Orthodox baker forms an unlikely friendship with a Queer Catholic Latino guide dog trainer.

Entries.Title: Strangers in the Night
Entries.Description: A man is followed by a stranger

Entries.Title: Las Cosas Que Brillan
Entries.Description: When a trans Latinx mermaid defies her mother’s warnings, she is forced to confront the violent legacies of colonialism, environmental destruction and the danger of being desired in the human world.  The BlackStar Philadelphia Filmmaker Lab is presented with support from Independence Public Media Foundation, William Penn Foundation, and Wyncote Foundation.  This project has been supported by The Philadelphia Independent Media Fund administered by Scribe Video Center with funds provided by the Independence Public Media Foundation and the Wyncote Foundation.

Entries.Title: A Little Regret in Helsinki
Entries.Description: A Chinese girl returns home to Helsinki, with a desire to reassess her feelings about home, perfection, friendship, and regret. A tender dialogue is raised between father and daughter.

Entries.Title: Metamorphosis
Entries.Description: Antonio is at the verge of dead. Finally encountering what could be his last interaction

Entries.Title: Chicken Little: ReHatched
Entries.Description: A young Chicken Little panics himself into thinking the sky is falling. As a result, a creative adventure ensues to bring the truth to his town.

Entries.Title: Brad's Big Day
Entries.Description: Brad, a twenty-year-old growing up in the early ages of the internet, meets the girl of his dreams on a video game messaging site.

Entries.Title: Before the Party
Entries.Description: A weekend getaway turns into an emotional battleground when Jay, struggling to come to terms with his bisexuality, faces the repercussions of his honesty with his girlfriend Julie, as their friends’ own biases and misunderstandings come to light.

Entries.Title: Cake
Entries.Description: Petra wasn't invited to Mona's birthday party, so she lies and says she went. She will come to regret this decision.

Entries.Title: I Know the End
Entries.Description: Centering around the world's end, we follow Margot, a young woman attempting to find closure in ruptured relationships. A slow unraveling of time, of closeness, and of what’s left unsaid. Less about the end, more about what lingers.

Entries.Title: Occupied
Entries.Description: Haley spends the weekend house-sitting, and things get pretty weird at night.

Entries.Title: 60bpm
Entries.Description: A short film by conservatory students.

Entries.Title: Jack Reeves
Entries.Description: The story of Jack Reeves, a man decided to kill his old mafia boss to avenge the assassination of his family.

Entries.Title: Susana
Entries.Description: A middle-aged American tourist finds herself alone in Mexico City. When she encounters a group of young Americans, she jumps at the opportunity for a little adventure.

Entries.Title: Napalm Dreams
Entries.Description: Vietnam, 1969. Napalm Dreams follows a platoon of American soldiers—each harboring a troubled past—as they confront the brutal realities of combat and the psychological toll of their secrets. Bound by shared trauma and dark humor, the men struggle to hold onto their humanity as the war—and the truth—close in around them.

Entries.Title: The Lab Incident
Entries.Description: Sep. 13, 2010 (found footage)

Entries.Title: The Last Song
Entries.Description: When two girls buy a record player from a charity shop, things start to go wrong.

Entries.Title: Hobbit Interview
Entries.Description: Have you ever wanted to hear The Hobbit story from Bilbo Baggins himself? In this amazingly executed interview, Bilbo gets interrogated and asked about his journeys to defeat Smaug.

Entries.Title: REFUSAL OF A CENTURY
Entries.Description: An experimental film about the the impressionistic dread of memory and paranoia, comprised of 16mm and standard definition video.

Entries.Title: Ski
Entries.Description: Downhill skiing has been a big part of my life both growing up and as a parent; whatever problems it raises (and there are some!), the way in which it facilitates being in the mountains in the winter as a joyous immersion in beauty, friendship, athleticism, and family is profound. This film captures something of my experience of skiing as witnessed through a homemade camera built for making it.

Entries.Title: The Afterparty
Entries.Description: A timid highschooler, Dan, is dragged along a vicious journey by his audacious friend, Barry, to impress their class at a Prom afterparty.

Entries.Title: Death by Digital
Entries.Description: Death by Digital is a short documentary that examines the fading legacy of film photography in Sri Lanka through the eyes of those who lived it. Featuring candid interviews with a veteran photographer and a longtime color lab owner, the film traces the industry’s transition from analogue to digital, revealing the quiet disappearance of an art form. With poetic visuals and a reflective tone, the documentary invites audiences to consider what is lost when tradition gives way to convenience—and whether film still has a place in a digital world.

Entries.Title: To the Edge of Hell
Entries.Description: Helia is forced into a terrifying situation when she learns her father's friend has stolen her private photos and videos. With no other choice, Helia accepts the man's evil request and enters his home, a place where his special fantasies and dark secrets becomes a living nightmare.

Entries.Title: Grandmaster-level baddie Sam Campbell being ‘somewhat’ foolish @ Bill Murray comedy club
Entries.Description: A pretty unprepared set. Oh well. I made this as a test to show to some men.

Entries.Title: From Afar
Entries.Description: Observation of landscapes and architectures surrounding the six deportation centers of Belgium combined with testimonies of imprisoned people raises questions about the limited perception that the Belgian government allows one to have of its violent border and immigration policies.

Entries.Title: Manny
Entries.Description: An adult sister stays home to babysit her little brother. Anxious to move out, but after her brother's mysterious concussion, she closely surveils his changing behavior and recurring hallucinations of an outlaw.

Entries.Title: Romy Melhem – Zero Gravity
Entries.Description: Experimental short movie from 2025

Entries.Title: Survivor's Guilt
Entries.Description: The voices of modern Kings echo in the cold nuclear fog of the wasteland they left, and a young man is torn between survival and his obsession with beauty.

Entries.Title: Ua 'ike au
Entries.Description: I have seen  I have heard  I have felt  The splendor  Of the rain  The shimmer  Of the mist  I’ve gone to  where only cloud and sea are seen

Entries.Title: I'll Leave You Words
Entries.Description: A Cambodian escort in Kuala Lumpur offers intimacy through stories, slipping between languages to soothe her clients—until a lonely Korean man’s longing for the past forces her to confront the silences in her own story.

Entries.Title: Salvation Mountain Leonard Knight
Entries.Description: A portrait of Leonard Knight and his visionary monument, Salvation Mountain. Painted with 18 coats of donated latex paint, Salvation Mountain, was created over many years, and shows how one man's determination and faith can make for quite a majestic achievement.

Entries.Title: Lucia & Nicole
Entries.Description: On the cusp of adulthood, Lucia finds her childhood friend Nicole living on the street. Houseless after coming out, Lucia’s mother Ximena invites her into their home. However, Nicole’s re-appearance into their lives raises questions about their own daughter’s identity and how to respond to Lucia and Nicole’s re-connection.

Entries.Title: Shift.
Entries.Description: A frustrated office worker finds himself unable to escape his workplace.

Entries.Title: Ashes of Conviction
Entries.Description: Burr tried to endure Hamilton, but they ended up with the most famous duel in history.

Entries.Title: Lock Step: An Ode to Us
Entries.Description: In a time before cultural arts education was being policed, a small community of student creatives was taking their hometown by storm. Comprised of archival footage from Anya Dillard's time as a student at West Orange High School, Lock Step is a film that commemorates the diversity, talent, and cultural impact of cultural arts organizations -- particularly the Ab-Salute Step Team, Nu Theta Omega Girls Step Team, and Jubilee Choir of West Orange High School.

Entries.Title: Why Do Civilisations Collapse?
Entries.Description: A documentary covering the reasons for the collapse of human civilizations of the past, while warning about potential threats to the existing civilization.

Entries.Title: Our Land: Israel's Other War
Entries.Description: A documentary, told through the stories of an Israeli settler and those of a Palestinian family, that offers insight into the hostile reality of life in the occupied West Bank.

Entries.Title: Mount Analogue
Entries.Description: A live performance by Charlie Jimenez & Sioul Blaphate hosted as a pre-show to Rebel Reel CineClub's 'A Most Unholy Christmas' - a screening of Alejandro Jodorowsky's The Holy Mountain (1973) at Rio Cinema, 17th December, 2024.  The performance is a live-theatre and dance piece loosely inspired by Jodorowsky's film and its influenced source Mount Analogue. Through dance, masks, and live-theatre, Mount Analogue navigates a procession of ascension through transforming bodies and shapes.  A primordial place of transformation, magic, and symbols.

Entries.Title: The Crepe Creep
Entries.Description: 10 year old Shelly helps her father run his French creperie, drawing in her sketchbook to while away the time. When a menacing stranger unexpectedly arrives at the cafe, Shelly takes it upon herself to handle the situation in this surreal fish out of water tale.

Entries.Title: Straw Man
Entries.Description: After a night of tickle fights and pickle fights, Max wakes up on the floor to find his best friends have no idea who he is.

Entries.Title: Corduroy
Entries.Description: A delusional young man breaks into his ex’s bedroom, convinced that a nice corduroy suit and a bouquet of roses will win her back.

Entries.Title: The Talk
Entries.Description: An unconfident Julia's courage to break up with her wandering boyfriend, Charlie, is compromised by the sound of his voice.

Entries.Title: MascLooking
Entries.Description: After two friends discuss the pros and cons and gay dating apps, one starts to get ominous messages from a potential hookup with the handle, MascLooking. And MascLooking is getting close…and closer…

Entries.Title: Vending Machine
Entries.Description: Wolf and Deer get a soda.

Entries.Title: IMYSM
Entries.Description: A reflective short film exploring the themes of grief, mortality, and the transcendence of human (and animal) connections featuring the music of PIAO.

Entries.Title: Minor Problem
Entries.Description: A minor problem leads a anxious former Eagle Scout, his love interest, and his friends into an increasingly illegal and potentially fatal scenario.

Entries.Title: Mystic Springs
Entries.Description: A grief-stricken detective investigates a ritualistic crime in a quiet Midwestern town, uncovering a shadowy cult that blurs the line between faith and reality—and threatens to consume him entirely.

Entries.Title: Be Not Afraid
Entries.Description: When a celestial entity begins following him, a guilt-ridden and frantic young man must either confront his religious fears of immorality, or succumb to the grim fate of eternal damnation that awaits him.

Entries.Title: Necessary Trip
Entries.Description: Necessary Trip is about a hay-day of vice in Mansfield Ohio when it used to be called Little Chicago.

Entries.Title: Don't Ever Get Married
Entries.Description: Jay, a cynical womanizer, bets his friend he can make his fiancée cheat before their wedding. Confident in his charm, he sets out to seduce her, unaware of the emotional turmoil he'll cause. As his plan spirals, Jay faces the consequences of his actions and the possibility of redemption.

Entries.Title: 6 More Weeks of Winter
Entries.Description: Music video/short film for "6 More Weeks of Winter", the outro track of Monger's 2025 project, "LEFTOVERS" the video follows a boy as he navigates life without a father and becomes dependent on technology to be his father figure.

Entries.Title: Becoming a Rose
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Jog in the Park
Entries.Description: A lonely man meets his ex-girlfriend in the park to help him pick out new shoes. But, it turns out he was only watching a virtual reality ad utilize the likeness of his loved ones to sell him stuff!

Entries.Title: Tell Me You Love Me
Entries.Description: Follows the final week in the life of a young girl as she realizes she is being followed.

Entries.Title: Something Sweet
Entries.Description: Ziora, a successful business owner in her 40s, falls in love with Leke, a young man in his 20s and opens the door for noise in her otherwise quiet life.  Does she give up on a chance for love to fit societal norms?

Entries.Title: One Punch
Entries.Description: Evan, a young man, faces ridicule for being a virgin and never having been in a fight. After a particularly humiliating incident, he decides to confront one of these challenges-but it won't be losing his virginity. Instead, he takes to the streets, offering random strangers ten dollars to punch him in the face.

Entries.Title: Yannis Pappas: Property Owner
Entries.Description: Yannis Pappas brings the story of a new father of daughters who moves from the city to the country—and gets a crash course in rural life. Along the way, he discovers that most of our political divides are really cultural—city vs. country—and they actually make sense. What we need is a little more understanding of each other.

Entries.Title: Re: Spanish Smartphone Revolt
Entries.Description: Spanish parents are turning against the tyranny of the smartphone! Starting in the Barcelona neighbourhood of Poblenou, a group of parents want their children to have an adolescence without devices, judged better for their mental health and online safety: And the movement is growing across Spain.

Entries.Title: Take Me to Dinner
Entries.Description: A woman who'd soured on love finally meets the man of her dreams, but is driven on a murder spree when he stands her up for a dinner date.

Entries.Title: The Revenge of Quinton Griggs
Entries.Description: Years after the fall of Quinton Griggs, Timm Slimm is now the crime boss but hiding in the shadows are much sinister forces at play.

Entries.Title: The Hit List
Entries.Description: Marcus is a ladies' man until he meets Nia, the woman of his dreams. However, Nia's brother has a psychic ability that threatens to expose Marcus as the player he is, leading him to extreme measures with deadly consequences.

Entries.Title: Chrysanthemum & Esperanza
Entries.Description: Set in the year 2005, Chrysanthemum is ready to leave New York City but must first relieve any doubts or anxieties with her best friend Esperanza. They have a lot to talk about and some gifts to share before they part ways.

Entries.Title: Sugary Showdown
Entries.Description: In the Annual High School Senior Baking Competition, the finalists, Ben and Jenny, try desperately to win the bake-off - which happens to not be the only competition they are finalists for.

Entries.Title: La Laisse autour du cou
Entries.Description: Portrait of a modern-day misanthrope.

Entries.Title: The Rock: A Puppet Parable
Entries.Description: Set to "The Rock" by Harry Chapin, a puppet village ignores the warnings of a young boy who insists that a massive rock on the hill above their town will one day destroy them. A haunting folk tale about denial, complacency, and inevitable disaster.

Entries.Title: Sorority Girl Massacre: Black Static at the Moment of Death
Entries.Description: A masked killer stalks a group of sorority girls as they find themselves facing a death ritual that pushes them beyond reality.

Entries.Title: Hobo Hustle
Entries.Description: The Grimble challenges Vagabond Vince, the strongest hobo on the streets.

Entries.Title: A Portrait of William Blake
Entries.Description: A short documentary about the life work and philosophy of William Blake featuring an interview with John Higgs.

Entries.Title: Bin Glitter
Entries.Description: Bin Glitter captures Midge's attempt to hold onto the memories she made with her best friend Sue in their final week together. This coming-of-age story explores female sexuality and feminine identity against the backdrop of the super eight film Midge and Sue decided to create together.

Entries.Title: No Pictures with My Father
Entries.Description: Over 40 years has passed and a son embarks on a journey to take his first picture with his father. Heightened emotions that have blockaded the opportunity for personal freedom and growth are surfaced as a sit down conversation ensues between father and son.

Entries.Title: Hooyo Macaan
Entries.Description: Samira is a recent college graduate and a current disappointment to her mother. Despite her poetic way with words, she can't seem to find the right ones to stand up for herself against her mother's constant dismissal. This results in a dance-off, the massive consumption of goat meat, and a kid figuring out how to want herself.

Entries.Title: Bedrooms & Trees
Entries.Description: A diligent young photographer stresses over a new photoshoot in the midst of struggles with a neglectful stoner boyfriend and the counsel of her overly honest best friend. A dream unlocks even more uncertainty.

Entries.Title: HOCO
Entries.Description: The Homecoming Queen, Maddie, is visited by a ghostly individual who calls her past into question.

Entries.Title: The Last Eagle
Entries.Description: Vignette's into the artist E'than Kootenhayoo's life, art, pain, and dreams.

Entries.Title: Magpies
Entries.Description: A depressed man, dressed as a gorilla, performs a stand-up comedy set.

Entries.Title: The Mother
Entries.Description: After her child passes away, a young woman takes in a runaway boy, a decision that will have disastrous consequences.

Entries.Title: The Sugarcane Massacre
Entries.Description: Short film compiled of real footage from the Sugarcane Massacre of 2019.

Entries.Title: Edgefield Road
Entries.Description: Down on their luck ghost hunters invite an influencer to one of their haunts in the hopes that her platform will get them the attention they need.

Entries.Title: Milgram
Entries.Description: In the shadow of grief, obedience and morality clash in a chilling exploration of family, power, and horror.

Entries.Title: Border Dwellers
Entries.Description: A mosaic portrait of people who live along the US/Mexico border. Each of the fourteen channels represents one of the many crossing towns from Tijuana on the left to El Paso & the Rio Grande on the right.

Entries.Title: Blind Man’s Film
Entries.Description: Composed of various images from Shkodër and Ulqin in the summer of 2024, with the intent of giving the audience glimpses of beauty with an underlying sense of longing for return.

Entries.Title: Grinners
Entries.Description: Marley is a moderately successful horror cooking show host. Her life gets flipped upside down when she crosses paths with the voyeuristic possum mask. Marley has to survive the night as she is hunted down through the eyes of a possum.

Entries.Title: Hunting Grounds
Entries.Description: In a semi-post-apocalyptic world, chaos reigns after the sudden and mysterious death of the president, leaving the nation in shambles. Military factions, once unified, splinter into rogue groups, each pursuing their own agendas in the absence of leadership. Society collapses into pure lawlessness as civilians are forced to fend for themselves, grappling with food shortages, territorial disputes, and the looming threat of violence. Urban areas become battlegrounds of desperation, where survival hinges on cunning and strength, and trust is a dangerous gamble.  This gritty, high-stakes setting explores a world where the balance of power has disintegrated, leaving behind fractured alliances and a population struggling to navigate the moral ambiguities of survival. Themes of betrayal, conspiracy, and the fight for purpose in a broken system drive the tension, as individuals confront the harsh reality of what humanity becomes when order dissolves into chaos.

Entries.Title: SpaceShip
Entries.Description: Four spacemen aboard the Star of Rumbek starship get into some trouble on a seemingly boring day of space travel...

Entries.Title: MJ Lenderman Live at The Fonda
Entries.Description: Singer-songwriter MJ Lenderman takes the stage to perform standout tracks from his solo discography, featuring songs from his critically acclaimed 2024 album "Manning Fireworks". Recorded on MiniDV Tape on 2/16/25 by Shambling History (www.shamblinghistory.com)

Entries.Title: Group Six
Entries.Description: When David Lynch is hesitant to star in his upcoming movie, Stephen Spielberg must send top-tier production team, Group Six, to go retrieve the last bag of Cheetos on Planet Earth.

Entries.Title: A Long Night Out
Entries.Description: A chronic alcoholic recalls the events of the night prior to his roommate after he discovers that there's a dead guy in the house.

Entries.Title: What's My Sign Again?
Entries.Description: When a science geek discovers his crush obsessively worships astrology, he sets out to build a device that would alter the position of the stars in the sky to make them truly compatible.

Entries.Title: Rabbit Rabbit
Entries.Description: Carson reinvents himself in Philadelphia to escape a violent past, while ignoring the disease that has followed him.

Entries.Title: Fixation
Entries.Description: A struggling musician becomes horrifyingly fixated on a bell while practicing a song.

Entries.Title: KLLR: 108.7
Entries.Description: When a small town's killer strikes again, the town's sheriff works with the premier radio show host to find the killer.

Entries.Title: Being Friends With Rocks
Entries.Description: Samul Jeeorge is back and learns a valuable lesson: who can you really trust in the end?

Entries.Title: Our Times Away
Entries.Description: "Our Times Away" is the story of former friends Grace and Sarah reuniting under mysterious pretenses. Has college proven to irrevocably split the two or does their bond go beyond the space between?

Entries.Title: We Cool?
Entries.Description: A charismatic gay parrot navigates a series of disastrous dates and misadventures during one increasingly chaotic night in the city.

Entries.Title: Horse Healing
Entries.Description: After losing her beloved horse, a grief-stricken girl retreats into guilt until her father brings her to an equine auction. There, an abandoned baby Percheron with eyes reflecting her pain becomes the key to healing her broken heart.

Entries.Title: Unorthodox Education
Entries.Description: Why tens of thousands of Jewish schoolchildren graduate from ultra-Orthodox high schools without the legally mandated education they need to become independent adults.

Entries.Title: Book of Suffocations
Entries.Description: Torn between faith and desire, a young Arab man at a religious facility must confront his queer identity as he navigates the path to salvation and the allure of forbidden love.

Entries.Title: D8DDY
Entries.Description: The story of the first journalist on OnlyFans.

Entries.Title: Vienna Philharmonic: Spring in Paris
Entries.Description: The Vienna Philharmonic present a star-studded evening in celebration of the 150th anniversary of the world-famous opera house Palais Garnier in Paris. Featuring some of the biggest names in opera - bass-baritone Sir Bryn Terfel, tenors Juan Diego Flórez and Rolando Villazón, and soprano Sonya Yoncheva - this special concert is full of classical treats, with music from Bizet’s Carmen, Verdi’s La Traviata and more. Completing the line-up is the ever-charismatic pianist Yuja Wang, with a performance of Tchaikovsky’s Piano Concerto No 1.

Entries.Title: The Garden Live at Outbreak Fest 2024
Entries.Description: The Garden performs live at Bowlers Exhibition Centre as a part of Outbreak Fest 2024.

Entries.Title: Two Body Problem
Entries.Description: Andy has something strange in the trunk of her car.

Entries.Title: A Real Genius
Entries.Description: Bill is a wannabe student filmmaker. When he sets out to make his own short film to impress a girl, he crosses paths with the most popular filmmaker in school, Gus Sanders.

Entries.Title: Chasing Shadows
Entries.Description: Determined to prove himself at work, Miles Miller slips between reality and a noir dreamscape, chasing a mystery that may reveal a truth he’s not ready to face.

Entries.Title: The Empty Room
Entries.Description: A girl finds herself locked in a stranger's bedroom with a message telling her she's not alone.

Entries.Title: The Calling: A Medical School Journey
Entries.Description: "The Calling: A Medical School Journey," a new documentary directed by Asako Gladsjo, follows the intellectual and emotional journey of a group of students at Albert Einstein College of Medicine in the Bronx. Captured through verité scenes and personal video diaries, the film offers a rare inside look at America’s health care system through the eyes of these aspiring practitioners as they learn what it takes to become a doctor in one of the country’s most underserved communities.

Entries.Title: Herman 2
Entries.Description: A short horror film.

Entries.Title: Woman of Ink
Entries.Description: A young author attempts to write his “dream woman” into existence. His fantasy world of domesticity backfires, however, when the woman begins to reclaim her story, breaking the author's predetermined narrative.

Entries.Title: Beargoat
Entries.Description: Three friends document their search for Beargoat, the crossbred spawn of a bear and a goat.

Entries.Title: Your Own Flavor
Entries.Description: After being stood up on a date, Renee is grateful to find solace in an unexpected friendship with one of the good guys: a seemingly harmless puppet named Chompers. As their bond deepens, Chompers takes a chilling turn that forces Renee to wonder if she was ever his friend or if she was his prey.

Entries.Title: Remain In Light
Entries.Description: A college freshman finds herself unable to fit in with everyone else, then gets inspired by David Bowie to change her persona constantly until she finds the right one.

Entries.Title: The Secret Of The Djinn 2
Entries.Description: Paulo Constantino in O Segredo Dos Djinn 2 (2025)  A team of archaeologists return to the mountains of Kaf and find a medallion, which will cause the Guardian of Wishes to return to our world, to take his revenge on the ones who imprisoned him.

Entries.Title: Ayer Te Vi
Entries.Description: A young musician struggles to finish a song as grief, memory, and a mysterious presence begin to blur the line between the real and the surreal.

Entries.Title: sunday market tape 1
Entries.Description: not the first sunday market, but the first tape of it

Entries.Title: No Strings Attached
Entries.Description: When the baggage of her past takes the form of an indestructible balloon, Faith must face her past and learn to let it go, or risk living forever with a balloon attached to her wrist.

Entries.Title: Roads of Fire
Entries.Description: The lives of a human smuggler transporting refugees to the Darién Gap, an asylum seeker in New York City, and frontline humanitarian volunteers interweave in a harrowing examination of the global migration crisis.

Entries.Title: Trip of a Lifetime
Entries.Description: TRIP OF A LIFETIME is a unique family footage film, Tammer being handed (in 1988) some unwanted 16mm. footage shot in 1950-51 of a seemingly ordinary older couple, as they travelled the world and recorded the sights they saw and the people they met up with. Stunningly restored by Tammer to a pristine high defintion, this is a heartfelt and exquisite film, honouring the existence of the people we see on screen, even if no-one (including Tammer) now knows who they are. A film one watches with awe and wonder.

Entries.Title: Malls
Entries.Description: Lou and Noodles are consumers. Adrift and empty, they are separate from each other and from the world. Ruled by desire and uncontrollable drives to excess, they spend their solitary hours in spaces both real and unreal. Occasionally, they are in the same part of the mall.

Entries.Title: All You Can Eat
Entries.Description: All You Can Eat is a brief yet captivating short film that highlights the hungry moments shared between Brylee and his partner as they enjoy a sushi date together at Trapper's Sushi.

Entries.Title: -Where we Came In?
Entries.Description: On a dying afternoon, two friends and a bruised young woman slip between idle chatter and a story that folds in on itself, where fiction and reality blur.

Entries.Title: Sheltered: A University Experience
Entries.Description: A brief look into the student housing scene in Lancaster, exploring the challenges faced by both students and landlords with rising demand and notorious conditions.

Entries.Title: Adi the King
Entries.Description: A heartfelt and humorous Documentary coming-of-age film that follows Adi as he approaches one of the most significant milestones in Jewish tradition: his Bar Mitzvah. A tribute to family, friendship, and the joyful journey of growing up.

Entries.Title: Super Mario Adventure: Crackerjack Caper
Entries.Description: It was a picture-perfect day in the Mushroom Kingdom, until the Mario Bros get an unusual letter. Suddenly, robots invade the land in a surprise attack! Now, it’s up to Mario and Luigi to enter a new world, get to the castle, and save the day! If only it were that simple…

Entries.Title: Hint
Entries.Description: What Happened to Cora?

Entries.Title: The Danziger Studios Story
Entries.Description: A fascinating look at the history of the prolific British film and television production company founded by the Danziger brothers and the studios they established to create features and series. With contributions from Francis Matthews, Trader Faulkner and more!

Entries.Title: Concorde
Entries.Description: Lifelong friends, James and Michael, are forced to confront their relationship to each other and their hometown, Portland, as Michael gets ready to move to New York.

Entries.Title: Ester Steinberg: Schmear Campaign
Entries.Description: Ester Steinberg pushes boundaries with a hilarious retelling of her childhood as the daughter of an unsuccessful politician. She shares witty jokes about being a mom of two boys, tackling a mommy makeover, and her bold ideas for a sex tape. With sharp humor, she also delves into the challenges of raising kids in the digital age, trying to protect them from the chaos of the modern world. Ester's blend of personal insights and laugh-out-loud moments makes for a must-watch special.

Entries.Title: 34 Days in 2018
Entries.Description: 13-year-old Anderson Cefola documents his month-long grounding in 2018 with an old handheld camera he kept.

Entries.Title: Make Newark Cool Again
Entries.Description: A film about Newark City Council Candidate Demetri Theodoropoulos.

Entries.Title: MĀHŪ: A Trans-Pacific Love Story
Entries.Description: A documentary that explores the Native Hawaiian concept of gender fluidity by interweaving intimate interviews with a multimedia stage performance featuring hula, chant, and contemporary music. The film centers on the artistic collaborators of the show—all acclaimed Hawaiian transgender artists—offering a powerful reflection on identity, culture, and expression.

Entries.Title: nerdynotlive: THE COMPLETE SECOND SEASON
Entries.Description: Funny shitshow. Episodes 12-22.

Entries.Title: Maybe Blue
Entries.Description: Somewhere in the waters of equatorial Asia, shrouded in a veil of timelessness occasionally pierced by the intrusions of modernity, an ascetic has set forth on a dawn-to-dusk process imbued with sacred ritual—the hunting of a shark. But is it the animal’s flesh he seeks to consume, or its soul? With sublime music and a striking graphic sensibility, Zhou Qian’s vivid, hypnotic short film introduces a director to keep an eye on.

Entries.Title: El Cubano 2
Entries.Description: When the crypto wallet of a local billionaire is stolen, El Cubano is drawn into a web of violence and deceit, from which he will have to examine his own soul...

Entries.Title: The Last Warlord of Mongolia
Entries.Description: A documentary about Baron Roman von Ungern-Sternberg.

Entries.Title: A Still Life
Entries.Description: In the cozy backrooms of a local art store, a lazy and reclusive employee's boring daily routine is interrupted by an awkward, eccentric customer who DEFINITELY has no romantic intentions.

Entries.Title: My Eden
Entries.Description: A collection of familiar images that constitute my own private Eden.

Entries.Title: Vic Bradshaw: Action Man
Entries.Description: An immature young man, obsessed with stunts, action heroes and Nun-chucks. Attempts to win over the love of his life and honor his father by jumping off a bridge - and sticking the landing

Entries.Title: Mystery Seeds
Entries.Description: After thousands of mysterious packages sow the seeds of a xenophobic conspiracy, we track its growth through local news, internet detectives, and your online shopping history.

Entries.Title: Stick-Up
Entries.Description: In the closing hours of a quiet bar, a chance encounter between a bartender and an old acquaintance turned would-be robber takes a shocking turn, leading to a deadly confrontation that reveals long-held grudges and secrets.

Entries.Title: Steen
Entries.Description: A scenic and visual experience of cells and the small organisms that we live amongst. Through vibrant images of cells and rhythmic music that work cohesively viewers are encouraged to visualize an infinite world we cannot see with our own eyes, to explore the unknown structure of nature.

Entries.Title: Where the Hell Is Everybody?
Entries.Description: Dale, a teenage boy who constantly forgets to check his phone (despite the nagging of his mother) wakes one morning to find he is the last person alive on Earth. The film highlights the mental toll such catastrophe would have on an individual, exploring a dive into animalistic, savage behaviour as a result of his solitude.

Entries.Title: Walter
Entries.Description: The grief of a newly widowed man is disrupted when the harassment of local youths pushes him to seek justice.

Entries.Title: Checklist From Yesterday
Entries.Description: A young woman finds a mysterious checklist while waiting for a train.

Entries.Title: No More Work
Entries.Description: A man, depressed by his day-to-day life, ventures into the woods. Events ensue.

Entries.Title: Steak Dinner
Entries.Description: Casey's attempted surprise dinner date gets derailed when Taylor, her girlfriend, reveals she has brought home a strange, wounded creature she intends to nurse back to health.

Entries.Title: André Rieu's 75th Birthday Celebration: The Dream Continues
Entries.Description: André Rieu celebrates his 75th Birthday! The King of the Waltz invites you to a boat party with him and his beloved Johann Strauss Orchestra as they sail through his hometown of Maastricht.  This brand-new cinema special is a tribute to André's childhood dream of one day forming his own orchestra and travelling the world. The film features a selection of André's favourite and most spectacular global performances along with some of the finest moments the Maestro and his Johann Strauss Orchestra have shared during their many decades together.  Most of the concerts featured in this film – The Dream Continues - have never been shown on the big screen before. To mark this amazing milestone, this is your chance to see these iconic André classics for the first time. Come aboard and celebrate André’s 75th in style at your local cinema!

Entries.Title: A Savage Art: The Life & Cartoons of Pat Oliphant
Entries.Description: Patrick Oliphant was a giant slayer, bravely taking on presidents, popes and the American corporate class with his mighty pen. An Australian transplant, Oliphant became America's most renowned and feared political cartoonist for five decades. With his biting wit and masterful drawing skills, Oliphant attacked individual and institutional corruption, collusion, greed, hypocrisy and arrogance, no matter the size or status of his targets.

Entries.Title: Dies Irae
Entries.Description: Semi based on real events...

Entries.Title: Drew Lynch: The Stuttering Comedian
Entries.Description: Drew creates new hour long special on youtube with material that is to answer any questions might you have about his stutter, his injury, its impact on his life and the recovery he went through. He also talks about his wife (who actually makes an appearance in this one), speech therapy, softball, depression, and a journey to McDonald's.

Entries.Title: The Silver Lake
Entries.Description: A couple traverses through a national park sand dunes as they discover a newfound hatred for each other

Entries.Title: Limp
Entries.Description: When an old friend drops by with a broken heart, Max rises to the occasion… sorta.

Entries.Title: American Mamas
Entries.Description: Following the results of the 2024 US Presidential Election, three Connecticut mothers discuss their fears but also their outlook for the future with trans-activist Tony Ferraiolo. For anyone feeling helpless or scared right now, this discussion is meant to be a source of hope.

Entries.Title: Niagara Falls
Entries.Description: Niagara Falls is located on the border between Canada and the USA. While the falls are primarily known for their breathtaking beauty and as a tourist attraction, they also provide a habitat for numerous animal species. However, their conservation poses a major ecological challenge. In the documentary "Niagara Falls – Power of Nature," scientists and naturalists explain the ecosystem of the world-famous Niagara Falls.

Entries.Title: Ann Be Cloud
Entries.Description: A teenage girl tries to keep her best friend Ann, who has turned into a drifting cloud, from disappearing, while also fending off ghosts haunting her house with the help of an old friend.

Entries.Title: I Eat Glue
Entries.Description: Asparagus is a very normal 20 year old girl who chronicals an average week in her life building up the courage to ask out her crush to the big dance on Friday. Will she succeed in the battle field of love or come out short?

Entries.Title: Seratus
Entries.Description: Journey of a 100 Ringgit bill

Entries.Title: Tick
Entries.Description: A young man has to learn how to add more excitement to his monotonous schedule.  Nominated for Best Picture and winner of Best Sound Design in the 2025 BYU Public Domain Film Festival.

Entries.Title: Pre-game
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Milk & Honey, Blood & Tears
Entries.Description: "Milk & Honey, Blood & Tears" is a powerful feature-length documentary that explores the profound impact of the October 7th attack on Kibbutz Be'eri. This film captures the resilience, unity, and strength of individuals who have endured unimaginable horror and are now striving to rebuild their lives and community. Through intimate portrayals and personal narratives, the documentary delves into the themes of survival, healing, and the enduring spirit of a community transformed by tragedy.

Entries.Title: Liminality
Entries.Description: In 2006 Berkeley, amidst the throes of first love, queer teens Nina and Jay grapple with understanding Jay's uncharted trans identity. Nina's well-intentioned but misguided efforts to assist push them apart.

Entries.Title: Nowhere To Go
Entries.Description: Kidé is a NYC kid with a camera, whose neighborhood photos begin to resonate online. It's a whole new world of opportunity, but not everybody is happy about it.

Entries.Title: We'll Carry On Alright
Entries.Description: This film focuses on the friendship between Mabel Hampton, an African American, lesbian, and activist, and Joan Nestle, a white, lesbian and Jewish professor who is 40 years her junior. Ms. Hampton cared for Joan as a child, and roles reversed when Joan cared for Ms. Hampton at the end of her life.

Entries.Title: All Cowgirls go to Heaven
Entries.Description: A showdown takes an unexpected turn.

Entries.Title: Come Home Now
Entries.Description: While out by herself, Carrie receives a foreboding text from her mom that simply reads "come home now". Her phone dies before she can respond, leading her to worry about what the message could possibly mean as she tries to find her way home.

Entries.Title: LEAF Plays the Portland House of Music
Entries.Description: Young Portland, Maine-based band LEAF plays their biggest show yet at the Portland House of Music. This short documentary follows them through the hours before, during, and after the show.

Entries.Title: Additional Works
Entries.Description: Compilation of experimental short films completed in June 2025.
Some 25 year-olds captured on a camera.

Entries.Title: Lita Albuquerque: Dust to Dust
Entries.Description: Lita Albuquerque reflects on her creative practice and its influences, from her childhood in Tunisia, to her role in the Light and Space movement in Los Angeles, to her overarching fascination and connection with Earth and cosmos.

Entries.Title: diluent
Entries.Description: Full of liquor and shame after a messy night out, Jaz has an unexpected encounter with an old friend.

Entries.Title: Absolutely No Sexual Favors
Entries.Description: Filmmaker and new media artist Tong Xie’s debut short probes the unease, confusion, and obsession experienced by the body as it crosses the urban physiognomy. Set amidst the shadowy loneliness of Paris at night, Absolutely No Sexual Favors je pense à toi 吾想汝顯 depicts the psychological and corporeal marginality of queer identity and desire through perpetually displaced figures.

Entries.Title: Sundown to Eleven
Entries.Description: A 99-year-old World War II veteran embarks on a quest to solve a missing-in-action case from 1944.

Entries.Title: Songs of Black Folk
Entries.Description: Songs of Black Folk unites top Black musical talent on one Pacific Northwest stage, launching a powerful new tradition and era for Black artists against the meaningful backdrop of Juneteenth.

Entries.Title: Fishing for Kills
Entries.Description: A man is enjoying a quiet day of fishing... but is it too quiet? Someone is with him in the woods and will stop at nothing to find him.

Entries.Title: Feri Resham Filili
Entries.Description: When Resham wins the US DV lottery, village tensions rise. Stranded before reaching America, he reunites with unreliable friend Hariya. Both chase dreams amid lies, jealousy and survival challenges.

Entries.Title: Embla
Entries.Description: Created from wood and bound by love, Embla is her maker’s masterpiece, until she mars her perfection by burning herself, turning devotion into destruction.

Entries.Title: The Britto Doc
Entries.Description: His art adorns products, galleries and collector's walls worldwide, yet who is the man behind the name? Meet Romero Britto - the painter who rose from Brazil's favelas to become a global sensation. Alongside a star-studded cast, discover the extraordinary story of a man who transformed pain into a colorful empire that today brings happiness to millions.

Entries.Title: The Mexia Incident
Entries.Description: A short documentary covering the horrific events behind the Mexia Supermarket which took place in 1999.

Entries.Title: New York Manhattan
Entries.Description: Emotions run high as a young mother abandons her son at Grand Central Station with just a cell phone in hand. The boy’s only hope? Answer the call and get a job! All while navigating a place beyond your wildest imagination… a place known only as: ‘New York Manhattan’

Entries.Title: Deal Broken
Entries.Description: From AKA Studios comes a rom-com following four roommates in their hilarious search for love before Valentine's Day. Follow the girls as they endure awkward hellos, pine after uninterested men, become victims of recently returned missionaries on the hunt, and fend off freaky first dates. You'll cringe, you'll get triggered, you...probably won't swoon.

Entries.Title: Kerb
Entries.Description: Two brothers talk for the first time in a while, as they are lost on the way to their brothers wedding.

Entries.Title: nerdynotlive: THE COMPLETE FIRST SEASON
Entries.Description: Funny shitshow. Episodes 1-11.

Entries.Title: It's There For You
Entries.Description: An elderly woman reflects on her complicated relationship with music and playing piano.

Entries.Title: Replay
Entries.Description: 30 years after a humiliating TV appearance from his childhood, a man hatches a plan for redemption in this docu-comedy.

Entries.Title: How I Will Reach You
Entries.Description: A short film about cell phone towers and lonely creatures of the internet in love over far distances.

Entries.Title: The Wrong Man
Entries.Description: In the wake of a devastating loss, a widowed mother is left to navigate the complexities of life with her two children. She is determined to provide stability and find love again. New love is sometimes not what it seems.

Entries.Title: SURVIVAL OF THE FITTEST
Entries.Description: TWO FEMALE FRIENDS TRY TO WIN THE HEART OF ONE MAN.

Entries.Title: DANCING TEXTURE
Entries.Description: The creation of this collection began when the IM MEN design team encountered the work of ceramic artist Shoji Kamoda, who aims for unique beauty in form. This collection is the result of our single-minded pursuit of giving form to the pure desire to wear his creations as clothing. The sensations evoked through repeated quiet dialogue with Kamoda are amplified and expressed in the form of clothing.

Entries.Title: The Story of Macross II - Lovers Again
Entries.Description: A documentary on the initial American release of 'Macross II -Lovers Again-'.

Entries.Title: Sunburst
Entries.Description: A hypochondriac must reckon with his decidedly fleeting mortality

Entries.Title: Neal Morse & The Resonance – First Expedition
Entries.Description: The first full Neal Morse & The Resonance gig took place on March 27th, 2025 in New Life Church, White House, TN (the recent venue for Morsefest USA).  Ahead of their performance at the Cruise To The Edge Pre-Cruise party, the band played the full No Hill For A Climber album to an audience of friends and fans – plus as a bonus, the show ended with Wind At My Back.  It’s an incredible performance for a debut gig and was specially filmed and edited by Chad Horner and team, and mixed by Nathan Martin as the 20th Anniversary Neal Morse Inner Circle release.  Track List  1. All The Rage 2. Thief 3. Eternity In Your Eyes 4. Ever Interceding 5. No Hill For A Climber 6. Wind At My Back

Entries.Title: Buscando a Maga
Entries.Description: A short film about a man looking for his wife.
