Entries.Description: Searching through Alex's videos reveals the secrets of his mental health...

Entries.Title: The Guest
Entries.Description: A man wakes up in his apartment to find a stranger.

Entries.Title: Insignia
Entries.Description: Insignia follows Quinn, a young detective struggling with the torment of a tragic past, must face what she has been avoiding in order to move forward in her life and solve the homicide case she is assigned to along with her boss, Freya. The path she must take will not be easy, will Quinn be able to break the cycle of guilt she imprisons herself with? Or will she fail to become better?

Entries.Title: Vital
Entries.Description: Vital depicts a black birthing person’s first prenatal visit.

Entries.Title: VBS
Entries.Description: An unlikely romance sparks at a Vacation Bible School for the adults of an eccentric church.

Entries.Title: Bambino
Entries.Description: A pair of freshman baseball players, desperate to prove themselves to their new team, get roped into a long-standing prank: stealing their rival school's beloved mascot. But as the night drags on and tensions rise, what seemed like a simple initiation turns into an unpredictable, high-stakes mess.

Entries.Title: Medeia - Love, Betrayal and Revenge
Entries.Description: Betrayed, silenced, underestimated. But she still holds the power of speech — and of destruction. Medea is the dark face of wounded love, in a confrontation where there are no winners, only survivors.

Entries.Title: Fraternal
Entries.Description: The story of two twin brothers and their journey of either becoming free from their own personal struggles or losing it all to save the other.

Entries.Title: Path of the Plume
Entries.Description: Nuclear weapons are instruments of mass destruction that exact a devastating toll on human life. In the heart of rural Utah, the Lovell family recounts the harrowing tale of nuclear testing’s shadowy legacy and impact on innocent civilians

Entries.Title: "BUDKA" by George Alshevskij-Jones
Entries.Description: Shot entirely on a webcam and guided by the Imperfect Cinema philosophy, this film captures the drunken drift of a man reaching for connection in a cold, indifferent city. What unfolds is either a dream, a dying vision, or both. Then — reality returns with a quiet whimper. Life moves on. Raw, lo-fi, and unapologetically rough, this is a meditation on how easily the world forgets. Meaning is left open; interpretation belongs to the viewer.

Entries.Title: Are You a Dancer?
Entries.Description: Dreams and memories mesh in a series of visions projected in the sky.

Entries.Title: The Forest for the Trees
Entries.Description: A short experimental film by Alison Johnson. A reflective journey of the forest and of the mind, carving a path between the physical world and the internal world. Words and phrases of a personal poem written by the filmmaker act as guide throughout the journey. This piece was filmed on super 8mm through various forests of California and New Mexico. Experimentations with digitally layering, sculpting, splicing, and distorting of film and sound create a kaleidoscopic and meditative effect.

Entries.Title: TUNNEL
Entries.Description: one thing stands between a humble brit and his hawaiian pizza

Entries.Title: PEE PEE PANTS PALACE
Entries.Description: A Man Returns Home From A Roadtrip With A Full Blatter But Finds The Task Of Peeing May Be Tougher Than He Once Thought. As He Climbs The Stories Of The Palace He Faces Increasingly More Difficult And Odd Occurrences Await Him.

Entries.Title: Inspo in "Lowe" places
Entries.Description: A struggling painter takes DMT to get over her artist block

Entries.Title: Dream On
Entries.Description: A man tries to reverse his fate after dreaming about his own death.

Entries.Title: Shapeless Variations
Entries.Description: A condensation of a handful of sunsets with various visual moods. Red and blue as opposites that still find a way to cohere. Concrete silhouettes over an ever-changing, expanding canvas. Every movement is collective, molecular. Over an invisible horizon, a chance presents itself to meditate on the “speed” of water (and the sea) and also for a more fluid kind of editing.

Entries.Title: Upfield
Entries.Description: Chronicling a walk to the end of the line on Super 8 film — from the heart of the inner city to the outer suburban station of Upfield in Melbourne’s North.

Entries.Title: Unique Pieces
Entries.Description: Mei and Tristan reminisce about their now past relationship as he returns a gift that she bought for him while Mei notices that Tristan still has a token of her love which he wears on him, always.

Entries.Title: Channel 5
Entries.Description: An avid television viewer finds himself trapped in a disturbing loop between reality and a mysterious TV show that blurs the line between watcher and watched.

Entries.Title: Midwestern Cowboy
Entries.Description: After The Fall, a lone Cowboy wanders the apocalyptic winter landscape to achieve his sole mission- survive.

Entries.Title: Shadow
Entries.Description: Shadow tells the story of Mirage, whose love for his family deepens after a tragic incident injures his parents. Years later, their bond is tested when hidden truths emerge, throwing Mirage into inner turmoil

Entries.Title: The Scorpion and the Frog
Entries.Description: A frog agrees to help a scorpion cross a river despite the frog's suspicions.

Entries.Title: Replacements
Entries.Description: Harry, an undercover police officer finally catches notorious gangster, Flint and he is in the middle of interrogating him

Entries.Title: Something Was in the Tunnels Vol. 1
Entries.Description: The film follows Danny Feather, his older brother mysteriously died in the murder tunnels. Named after that because of a serial killer that murdered people in those tunnels. The weird thing is that the killer is serving a life sentence.

Entries.Title: The Traveler & The Troll
Entries.Description: A short film following a lost and weary traveler as they come face-to-face with the monstrous warden of the cursed woods and a deadly bargain with which they must contend.

Entries.Title: Butter Bean - "Belly Ache"
Entries.Description: A lactose intolerant individual regrets their recent dietary choices.

Entries.Title: Titanic: The Final Voyage
Entries.Description: On April 15, 1912, the Titanic's ill-fated journey ended in disaster. Explore the events leading to the tragedy, revealing the lives, choices, and the unforgettable legacy left by the ship's final voyage beneath the cold, unforgiv...

Entries.Title: The Body on Stage
Entries.Description: A documentary made by students, for students

Entries.Title: Phantasm
Entries.Description: Enter, if you dare! Artistic duo Lior Borochov Hutchings and Kat Willrett invite you to witness their world of the weird and wonderful, bizarre and bemusing in this surreal dance work. Watch fantastical scenes unfold through the eyes of peculiar characters, set against the gritty backdrop of urban Berlin. Bursting with movement, music and striking visuals, “Phantasm” leans into theatrical absurdity and queer aesthetics to explore the tensions between monotony and whimsy, and the notion of existing as an “other”. With fantastical characters and poetic visuals, “Phantasm” explores otherness, alienation and taboos. Curious, unapologetic and oftentimes humorous, this work breaks boundaries and basks in its weirdness.

Entries.Title: JESTER
Entries.Description: Jester is about to perform and seems to struggle with a deep and personal insecurity. As the moment deepens, we watch a quiet moment of emotion, mystery, and self-expression unfold.

Entries.Title: The Soup
Entries.Description: After the arrival of a world renowned critic, the fate of a restaurant and its staff hinges on a single dish: a simple bowl of soup.

Entries.Title: Coming Attractions
Entries.Description: In the days before home video killed the theatrical market for erotic cinema, movie trailers were a mainstay of the gay porno theatergoing experience. Viewed now, they provide a fascinating—and often very entertaining—look at the way these films were marketed and sold, filled with lurid taglines, false promises, personal messages from the stars, and surprisingly creative editing. This collection of original trailers has been newly preserved in 2K from rare 16mm materials and features previews for films by such auteurs as Tom DeSimone, Joe Gage, Fred Halsted, William Higgins, Wakefield Poole, Toby Ross, and Steve Scott, plus a surprise or two. And don’t forget—as one trailer notes, “It’s Rated X, so come with a grownup.”

Entries.Title: Bottled Up
Entries.Description: Eleanor returns home where she reunites with her childhood best friend, Camilla, who have both been away at college on opposite coasts. This reunion floods Eleanor with the feelings she has for Camilla, such as her appreciation of their friendship, but also the romantic feelings she’s been attempting to keep bottled up. When a game of spin the bottle ends up with them kissing, she’s left even more lost.

Entries.Title: Sheet Talk
Entries.Description: At a crossroads in their relationship, Oscar and his ghoul-friend must decide what the next step in their relationship is.

Entries.Title: If the Sun Exploded Today
Entries.Description: A fable about a Black deity that rises out of the soil and delivers the souls of Black children to The OtherSide when they die too soon.

Entries.Title: Myself Two Seconds to Cry
Entries.Description: The digital presence left by people I knew who died young has vanished.  Songs they’ve uploaded, photo albums, public diary entries, all deleted and all that’s left is generic obituaries.  When I think of these people, I think of a place. With two cameras, I’m capturing the outline of a memory we shared there in present and in past.

Entries.Title: Claustrophobia
Entries.Description: A young man attempts to complete a drawing as the world around him spirals into the nightmarish and surreal.

Entries.Title: Goodbye, Crescent Moon
Entries.Description: An outsider from the future gets hold of a lost archive, sending us on a journey following associative clues in the movement of infinite yearnings.

Entries.Title: Cow Four Minutes
Entries.Description: Short film involving a 4 minute shot of a cow.

Entries.Title: The Wilde Girls
Entries.Description: In the year 1932, in the heart of the great depression, two clueless socialite heiresses with zero survival skills are tricked into moving to Washington State from millionaire's row Manhattan. After accidentally killing a hit man sent after them, they find themselves lost in the wilderness with a price on their heads. An unenthusiastic alliance with a misanthropic mountain man with a dark past may be their only chance for survival.

Entries.Title: Toward a Fundamental Theory of Physics
Entries.Description: Shot on 16mm film using a handcrafted Time-Slice camera with 293 lenses—a modern reinterpretation of the original device built by Tim Macmillan in the early 1980s—this experimental (3D) short offers a unique, tactile exploration of time and light as the raw materials and fundamental paradoxes of cinema. Created during an artistic residency at Art Cinema OFFoff in Ghent, Belgium.

Entries.Title: Creep
Entries.Description: Two filmmakers must resort to dire measures in order to save their film after the hard drive with everything on it breaks.

Entries.Title: How to Love a Palm Tree?
Entries.Description: A Ukrainian filmmaker-refugee's exploration of Californian reality unfolds through a dialogue between the author and his wife about the palm tree, both as a biological species and a historical symbol.

Entries.Title: Malpaís
Entries.Description: Government conspiracy abounds when a mountain appears from thin air in 1940s New Mexico.

Entries.Title: Shambles
Entries.Description: A fallen star. A broken home. A most regrettable evening.

Entries.Title: Space Chasers
Entries.Description: A telescope, a camera and a dream. One doctor's ambitious quest to journey across the globe to meet and image with the world's greatest astrophotographers, and all while trying to pull off the impossible in Times Square.  'Space Chasers' is an action-adventure travel documentary that takes viewers on an exhilarating journey through the captivating world of amateur astrophotography. Dr. Steven Swancoat, an Ob/Gyn turn filmmaker, travels the globe meeting and imaging with some of the world's greatest astrophotographers and all while trying to pull off an impossible "Astro Imaging" mission in Times Square New York.

Entries.Title: The Farmer's Daughter
Entries.Description: The Farmer's Daughter is a documentary telling the story of Tara Barrett a successful news anchor. In the 2000's tragedy struck her family and she was left with the difficult decision to continue her career or save her family's legacy.

Entries.Title: Ashes to Ashes
Entries.Description: Every person handles grief and loss differently. This film reveals the experience of three sisters with care  and a little laughter as they deal with death.

Entries.Title: AMERICAN NIGHTMARE (short)
Entries.Description: NICKY BLYTHE is a paperback writer. His latest novel tells the story of a gunslinger who wins the heart of a piano player, but she has history with an outlaw - who tries to throw our gunslinger out of town.  The story is true. But there are some secrets Nicky won't tell.

Entries.Title: Fancy Hotel
Entries.Description: A man, played by Isaac Carlton, is in a hotel room, when mysterious things begin to happen. Isaac thinks he's being watched.

Entries.Title: You Know What They Say
Entries.Description: After a date, a couple returns to their dorms, where casual conversations with their roommates spark unexpected doubts. Caught between conflicting advice, they struggle to hear what was never spoken.

Entries.Title: Iggy Pop - Live At Montreux Jazz Festival 2023
Entries.Description: Iggy Pop’s ‘explosive performance’ (NME) at the revered Montreux Jazz Festival in 2023 is now available to see and hear in all its ‘vital and dangerous’ (CLASH) glory as Iggy Pop ‘Live at Montreux Jazz Festival 2023’ is released everywhere today in both physical and digital formats.  On July 6th, 2023 Iggy Pop returned to the iconic event backed by a seven-piece band (including horn section) and thrilled a capacity Stravinski Auditorium crowd. The career-spanning set includes tracks from his time with The Stooges, his Idiot and Lust for Life albums, New Values leading up to his recent release Every Loser (which reached Top 10 sales charts across Europe).

Entries.Title: Hermit
Entries.Description: Two stranded campers encounter a mute hermit who leads them through the darkening woods. As her unsettling behavior fuels their unease, they must confront the terrifying uncertainty of whether she is their savior or a malevolent predator.

Entries.Title: Zari
Entries.Description: American teen Neelu feels like a fish out of water amidst preparations for her sister's wedding in Delhi until she forges a brief and unexpected connection with Zeyb, a quiet sari store clerk who moonlights as an internet drag queen.

Entries.Title: Dragged to Nowhere
Entries.Description: Late Bloomer, a Native drag queen, has an unexpected nightmare on their trip back home. Caught in a relentless cycle of dislocation and danger, Late Bloomer must navigate a world of shifting realities and sinister forces. Will they find their way back?

Entries.Title: Cyrus and the Mountain
Entries.Description: A curious German shepherd spends the day exploring his home mountain and learning the meaning of family.

Entries.Title: Save: The Katie Meyer Story
Entries.Description: Katie Meyer was a standout Stanford goalkeeper, NCAA champion, and aspiring law student whose life ended tragically in March 2022, just three months shy of her graduation. Through archival footage, her own words, and emotional interviews with her family, the film explores the psychological impact of a sudden disciplinary charge from Stanford’s Office of Community Standards, the wrongful death lawsuit her parents filed, and the advocacy that led to the introduction of Katie Meyer’s Law.

Entries.Title: Cowgirlies 02: Escort the Lover
Entries.Description: A distressed southern belle asks the girlies for help smuggling her across town.

Entries.Title: SOFIE ANDERSON
Entries.Description: In this idyllic neighbourhood there is no time to lose. Every minute serves the ultimate goal: to be the best version of yourself. Sofie Anderson follows the routine guidelines from her community, until an object appears in her way and an irritation starts to grow inside her.

Entries.Title: tiK ToKk is Cinema History4
Entries.Description: An experimental short film to show more of the public how not only is Tiktok (Pre ban/control from the US government) cinema but it will be apart of cinema history, and future.

Entries.Title: Vulture City, Wyoming
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: Get Away
Entries.Description: A getaway driver considers his future.

Entries.Title: Blood Moon
Entries.Description: A moment in eternity

Entries.Title: Last Night
Entries.Description: On a first date, a serial ghoster meets his match.

Entries.Title: Beyond Norms: Exploring Identity - Masc vs. Masc
Entries.Description: Uncovering the diverse LGBTQ+ relationships, addressing societal shifts and internal stereotypes. This film dives into the subcultures, urging vulnerability and challenging norms in the queer dating and hookup culture.

Entries.Title: Vector: America's First Supercar
Entries.Description: A small town kid moves to California to build America's first supercar meant to compete with the likes of Ferrari and Lamborghini. The 50 year history of Vector is told through interviews and never before seen photos and videos.

Entries.Title: Turn to the Right
Entries.Description: When the engine stops in the middle of the desert.

Entries.Title: Interstice: Let There Be Light
Entries.Description: Her dad died and now she's thinking about him, art and movies

Entries.Title: A Rough Start
Entries.Description: How hard could it be? One dark night, a masked assailant with a very large knife stalks and attacks a young couple. Only once they come face to face do predator and prey discover that the massacre won't proceed as planned. What happens next is a series of unfortunate events.

Entries.Title: Eight on Eight
Entries.Description: The stories of 8 individuals & the lasting impact the late Kobe Bryant had on their lives.

Entries.Title: tiK ToKk is Cinema History1
Entries.Description: The first of Jojo/Lilys experimental short films to show more of the public how not only is Tiktok (Pre ban/control from the US government) cinema but it will be apart of cinema history, and future.

Entries.Title: Last Year's Calendar
Entries.Description: Two queer artists document their personal lives for an entire year to make a movie. One minute from each month of 2024 is represented in this twelve-minute short adaptation.

Entries.Title: The Last Departure
Entries.Description: A man finds himself in between two different realities when he is forced to make a choice while faced with his worst fear.

Entries.Title: Stag
Entries.Description: A stag party that goes too far.

Entries.Title: Great White Sex Battle
Entries.Description: Great white male and female sharks battle each other in a series of contests to prove which is the superior sex.

Entries.Title: TMG Live 2024 - Still Dodging the Bullet
Entries.Description: ​​The craze is back! The final performance from the first national tour in 20 years, which captivated the audience with its unchanged rock spirit and quality performance, is recorded in its entirety! Fans are eagerly anticipating the release, ready to relive the magic and energy that defined a generation. This performance promises to reignite the passion and excitement that made the tour a landmark event in music history.

Entries.Title: Transformers: Terminal
Entries.Description: Aidan, an awkward fanboy, finally leaves his mother's basement to meet Sierra, a bubbly vlogger fresh off a break up who needs help filming a new video series at Comic-Con.  What happens when the orbiter gets promoted to co-content creator?

Entries.Title: Lucía, the Woman Without a Face
Entries.Description: Javier is haunted by a recurring nightmare - he's trapped in a strange house with something waiting for him in the basement. Despite his mother's reassurance that they're only dreams (solo son sueños), he can't shake the growing sense that an ominous presence is getting closer.

Entries.Title: Memories
Entries.Description: A boy reminisces about a time when he was on a cruise, but his memories blend with dreams.

Entries.Title: AMNESiAC
Entries.Description: After a car crash that takes his memory, an amnesiac gets lost in the snow but also finds himself the further he explores

Entries.Title: The Home In Which I Tried This
Entries.Description: 400+ repurposed screenshots sourced from the Jackass TV show removed from context and void of people. The images are arranged into a montage of hazy, digital noise oscillating between form and abstraction. The images function as non-spaces; liminal conduits which serve no purpose but transition between focus.  The video drudges at a glacial pace, images distort and amalgamate into one another through staggered crossfades, a humming visual dirge aglow.  A digital spectre haunts the language of memory; the ubiquity of cultural landmarks like MTV would be echoed through the  early digital spaces. Programs like Jackass would not only be replicated physically, but so too the videos themselves - through perpetual iteration, compression artifacts and digital distortion would increasingly become indivisible from the image of culture. The aesthetics of virality and memetics were tethered to the digital, visual memory indivisible from the screen-based contexts which perpetuated it.

Entries.Title: Milestone No. 3
Entries.Description: Milestone No. 3 is a documentary following three lifelong friends as they travel across the country to California for the very first time. Armed with doubts and anxiety about continuing his filmmaking career, director Nicholas Dapolito enlists the help of friends and family to examine why he creates, and if this path is truly right for him.

Entries.Title: CANDLE BEARER
Entries.Description: Elly, a former artist, and Dej', a troubled musician, find themselves locked in a fragile and tense dynamic as they navigate, or rather fail to navigate, the weight of Dej's addiction. On a cold night in the studio, the band find themselves in a familiar, but ever so painful, situation. Dej's constant intoxication and Elly's ongoing denial push bandmates to leave, cause songs to be abruptly cut short by drunken mishaps, and lead to empty promises being tossed around amid incomprehensible antics. Elly must decide whether taking a step forward, no matter who she might leave behind or how difficult that might actually be, is the right thing to do - if there even is, or ever has been, a 'right' thing to do for her. The internal struggle unfurls as Elly's night becomes one that could either mark a new beginning, or bring everything to an end.

Entries.Title: The Princess of Coyote Palms
Entries.Description: In 1964, a woman desperate to join her friends in the ranks of motherhood prays for a miracle under the critical gaze of a sardonic narrator in the sleepy desert town of Coyote Palms.

Entries.Title: Fate of Succession: A Star Wars Story
Entries.Description: When Ex-Jedi Erik Candor is found by his old turned-evil-master, Bruce Singru, he must fight for his life or succumb to the dark side of the force.

Entries.Title: Eye of the Beholder
Entries.Description: After an oblivious young man ineptly tells his date that she looks like a Picasso painting, an eccentric art curator attempts to teach him the true meaning of art.

Entries.Title: The Happiness Shop
Entries.Description: The Happiness Shop is more than just a retail shop in the streets of Vietnam - it’s a beacon of empowerment and inclusivity. Founded with a unique mission to provide meaningful employment opportunities for women with disabilities. Through their work crafting souvenirs from recycled materials, these remarkable individuals not only earn livelihoods but also gain a sense of purpose and independent. The Happiness Shop values fostering a community where everyone is valued and given the chance to thrive.

Entries.Title: The Life of a Crayon
Entries.Description: Two crayons, Dilaw and Lila, ponder outside the box, as they figure out the question: what is the color of life?

Entries.Title: The Sphinx
Entries.Description: A locksmith’s date night becomes a waking nightmare.

Entries.Title: AMMA
Entries.Description: In the days before meeting his long distance girlfriend for the first time, Dev attempts to get his overbearing mom to leave the apartment.

Entries.Title: Rolling Into You
Entries.Description: Lia and Tata reunite in the rhythm of nostalgia.

Entries.Title: There Will be Womanly Wiles
Entries.Description: What do you do when you come home to find your partner in a VR headset and nipple clamps?

Entries.Title: Christa Funk: First In, Last Out
Entries.Description: While in the Coast Guard in Hawaii, Christa Funk discovered surf photography. Inspired by her late father, she’s pushed herself into wild lineups to capture the ocean through her unique perspective.

Entries.Title: Unmasking
Entries.Description: After years of going through special needs school, Adrian faces his greatest challenge yet: masking his autism in high school

Entries.Title: The Freaks of Laurel Creek
Entries.Description: The Freaks of Laurel Creek (TFOLC) would be a half-hour young adult animated fantasy dramedy that follows three dysfunctional teens who must learn to work together and embrace their inner "freak" as they investigate the mysterious cryptids plaguing their quiet Appalachian town.

Entries.Title: Xolo
Entries.Description: Late one night, a hungry little Xolo named Skippy searches his home for food and his missing owner, Maria. He finds her lying motionless on the couch just as the Aztec god of death, Xolotl, enters through the front door. Realizing that the god has come to take Maria, Skippy leads him on a heartfelt tour of the house, showing the small, loving moments that defined their life together.

Entries.Title: We Are Here Until We Are Not
Entries.Description: Whilst on a trip to Paris, a 15-year-old named Praz realizes how close death feels, and creates this film in case he dies. Shot on vintage digital cameras, it is a personal, fragmented portrait of life, meaning, and the absurdity of the world.

Entries.Title: Chirp
Entries.Description: After months of searching, Tyler finally finds a roommate online, but when he moves into the apartment, his new roommate Jim is incredibly annoying, and Tyler suspects he may not be what he seems...

Entries.Title: Crumbs
Entries.Description: A mechanic father and his son grapple with understanding each other, their relationship hanging by a thread of movies & junk food.

Entries.Title: The Crossbow Murders: The Killings That Shocked Britain.
Entries.Description: Uncover the chilling true story of Kyle Clifford, a 26-year-old ex-soldier whose brutal murders of Carol, Louise, and Hannah Hunt shocked Britain. This documentary delves into the heinous crimes that led to his life sentence.

Entries.Title: The Great Mandrake
Entries.Description: The Great Mandrake Magic Convention explores India’s magic tradition, blending performance, culture, and philosophy to reveal magic as both art and a spiritual gateway.

Entries.Title: Warp Weft Water Weeds
Entries.Description: Elizabeth Bradford draws inspiration for her paintings from a profound connection to nature through direct observations while hiking or kayaking primarily in the Appalachian Mountains and foothills where she resides.

Entries.Title: Soothing Family Landscapes
Entries.Description: A family live stream is repeatedly interrupted by its own sponsor's inappropriate marketing.

Entries.Title: Dick Van Dyke: 100th Celebration
Entries.Description: With rare behind-the-scenes stories, never-before-seen moments, and classic clips from The Dick Van Dyke Show, Mary Poppins, Chitty Chitty Bang Bang, and many more, Dick Van Dyke takes us on a heartfelt journey through his legendary career. Beloved co-stars and friends share personal memories and hilarious anecdotes, including Mary Tyler Moore, Carl Reiner, Chita Rivera, Michele Lee, Tim Conway, Rose Marie, Morey Amsterdam, Betty White, and Derek Hough. And Dick Van Dyke himself offers stories he’s waited 100 years to tell.

Entries.Title: The Seven Relics of Ill Omen
Entries.Description: In ancient times, a mysterious substance descended upon Fengzi Ridge. Capable of parasitic invasion, it twisted the human heart and lured its host towards evil. Now, these relics of omen have reemerged, unleashing a series of bizarre and gruesome murders.  Five ordinary yet passionate young people — Luo Ren, Mu Dai, Yi Wan San, Yan Hong Sha, and Cao Yan Hua —are drawn into this crisis through their own fateful encounters. They form the "Phoenix Squad" and embark on a perilous quest to subdue these seven omens. Amid life-and-death trials, Luo Ren and Mu Dai heal each other's wounds and form a genuine bond that transcends friendship. Through a long and arduous journey fraught with danger, the five overcome relentless challenges, and their friendship is tested and deepened in the fires of adversity.

Entries.Title: Suki Waterhouse: Superbloom
Entries.Description: Suki Waterhouse’s set at Superbloom on August 31st 2025

Entries.Title: The Painter
Entries.Description: After the untimely death of her mother, Casey Miller inherits a painting from her mom. Casey becomes increasingly distressed as she begins to notice subtle changes appearing in the painting while a sinister presence closes in on her.

Entries.Title: Studies for a Close-Up
Entries.Description: Matteo, a young and extravagant aspiring director, is working on his new short film. The unexpected gift of an old Super 8, pushes him through the streets of Rome in search of faces and stories to tell. In front of his eyes, an intricate map of faces opens. What does our face tell the world about us?

Entries.Title: The Unseen Light
Entries.Description: A film that offers a harsh look at love, drawing on personal experiences and those of friends.

Entries.Title: Polska with the Idiots
Entries.Description: 5 buddies create an unforgettable experience in Poland.

Entries.Title: Together / Apart
Entries.Description: All around the world schools for the deaf are closing, depriving deaf children of the benefits of having a sign language comunity. One school in Mexico City remains steadfast in giving the deaf comuniy a space to learn and comunicate in sign language, and shows extrordinary results in it´s aproach.

Entries.Title: The Doppelgänger
Entries.Description: A boy gets haunted by a personal demon of his.

Entries.Title: My Tía during an Eclipse
Entries.Description: At 94 years old, Margarita Elms has a pretty solid routine and a lifetime of memories. Is there space for a total solar eclipse?

Entries.Title: I Remember
Entries.Description: A high school student faces uncertainty when presented with the thought of growing up. As he delves into his memories, he uncovers the blissful childhood that once was.

Entries.Title: The Quest for Something Sweet
Entries.Description: A group of fairies are in search of something that pleases their sweet palates.

Entries.Title: And So My World Ends
Entries.Description: In the second part to a conceptual short film trilogy about the death of a young girl, her childhood best friend dreams of a day they had spent together many years earlier, depicted as a striking and surreal elegy. (2/3)

Entries.Title: Quest for Beauty: The Life and Art of William Schickel
Entries.Description: Quest for Beauty is a film documentary on the life and prolific art career of William Schickel who was a prominent 20th century Catholic artist. Schickel had a very prolific art career spanning sixty-plus years; he produced a large body of mostly commissioned work in painting, sculpture, stained glass, and architectural design. He is most well-known for his renovation of the Abbey of Gethsemani in Kentucky, where he worked personally with Thomas Merton. His works can be found in numerous private collections and museums, including the Vatican Museum. The film explores his Quest for Beauty and the challenges he faced, and his vision for the Church and his heart for unity in the Body of Christ.

Entries.Title: Purple Rain (ATMOS)
Entries.Description: Prince shattered all expectations and made music history when he released the album PURPLE RAIN in June 1984, followed by the hit movie of the same name weeks later. The 9-track LP went on to win two Grammy awards ("Best Rock Performance by a Group" & "Best Album of Original Score Written For A Motion Picture"), two American Music Awards, a Brit Award, and an Academy Award for Best Original Song Score. This is a brand-new audiophile Blu-ray featuring 2024’s Dolby ATMOS mix of the iconic album, as well as Prince’s original 1984 stereo mix in high-definition 24bit / 96kHz audio.

Entries.Title: On My Road To Dharma
Entries.Description: A monk who has been teaching meditation for ten years in California prisons shares his story and motivation to practice in such a way.

Entries.Title: The Burning Truth
Entries.Description: After a spontaneous meeting, Vicki and Noah create a close bond that meets a bitter end.

Entries.Title: Mirror Lake Monster
Entries.Description: After an unsuccessful attempt at studying for midterms, a group of brave UConn students must band together to defeat the Mirror Lake Monster and get their leader's dog back. Cycling through plans, libraries, and failures, the team valiantly fights the monster with their wits, power, and physics knowledge. Through friendship and triumph, anything is possible.

Entries.Title: Reunions in Heaven
Entries.Description: We follow people's lives, their deaths, and, most importantly, their first moments in heaven reconnecting with the loved ones that passed before them.

Entries.Title: Point Nemo
Entries.Description: What happens when laziness become a matter of life and death? On a world where absurd is the accepted norm, we find three slackers who are so lazy, they'd rather risk their lives than exert themselves. Their travels are marked by the presence of an unlikely entourage, consisting of a priest grappling with doubt, a policeman torn between duty and despair, a toy seller sowing joy and cunningness, and a mysterious individual clad in a fiery red suit.

Entries.Title: St. Marie, Montana
Entries.Description: In 1978, 10,000 people resided on the Glasgow Air Force Base. According to the 2020 census, only 373 remain. These are the people who call it home.

Entries.Title: Dormilón
Entries.Description: Dormilón lovingly cares for the abandoned cinema he’s made a home. Every night he records his dreams, in which he is the star performer of the theater, rather than its former-janitor. On a stormy night, Dormi’s carefully crafted life is challenged when his nightmares accumulate and confront him. Dormilón will have to overcome his fears and embrace his insecurities to be a more complete version of himself.

Entries.Title: Greetings From The Absence
Entries.Description: While clipping newspapers for her assignment, Ara finds out the truth about her father that her mother had hidden during the New Order era.

Entries.Title: The Sound of Drums
Entries.Description: A five minute short animated film focusing on the lasting effects of war.

Entries.Title: Endolife
Entries.Description: Endolife is a short, hybrid documentary that combines the experiences of over 120 people with endometriosis into a single, scripted narrative. Instead of focusing on the medical aspects of the disease, the film illustrates how it affects daily life. Isolation, depression, and grief, but also transformation and hope, are key themes.

Entries.Title: The New Guest
Entries.Description: A woman is sent to a remote cabin by her therapist, as she finalises her treatment on recovering from an abusive relationship. Her therapist has also sent another client there at the same time. Their tasks are unclear. After several days, they are joined by their best friends. The woman's ex partner seeks out her location by any means necessary. He joins forces with the other client's abusive ex, in a bid to descend on the therapy session.

Entries.Title: Max Midnight: Full Charge
Entries.Description: In a city of shadows and secrets, hardboiled detective Max Midnight is tasked with his most absurd case yet: finding his roommate’s missing phone charger. But as the investigation unravels, Max discovers a tangled web of danger, deceit, and power.

Entries.Title: Mafia's 90-Day Bride
Entries.Description: After insurance denies coverage causing her father's death, Gigi offers a mafia boss $10k to kill the CEO. He counters with a 90-day marriage deal. Their relationship evolves as she helps him face his cancer and cynicism.

Entries.Title: ALETHEIA
Entries.Description: A girl embarks on a journey to a mysterious destination—a place where people can start a new life. She sets out with the guidance of a man who takes people there for a living. Yet, halfway through, she gets cold feet.

Entries.Title: orlando.
Entries.Description: The discovery of his twin brother’s body pulls Nick into a web of memory, illusion, and regret.

Entries.Title: Old Girl in a Tutu: Susan Rennie Disrupts Art History
Entries.Description: When Susan Rennie retired from academia, she returned to her first love – photography. With humor and wit, Rennie’s photographic interventions offer a feminist critique of the conventional canon of art history, and an unabashed embrace of her elder, queer identity. The results are juicy, eye-opening, and often hilarious.

Entries.Title: Cuff
Entries.Description: A daughter throws a tantrum when her mother doesn't give her the birthday present she wants.

Entries.Title: Star Sword: The High Table
Entries.Description: Walter's live podcast interview with a vampire uncovers the hidden battle between mankind and ancient supernatural forces, and the role he is destined to play in the fight.

Entries.Title: Terra: Reignition
Entries.Description: In the distant future, the human race has lost their home planet and is now ruled by an alien empire from an alternate dimension. On the capital planet of Vyrkeln, a human searching for their family is pulled into a conflict decades in the making by an underground resistance, while the empire's deadliest agents hunt them across the planet.

Entries.Title: Anadromous
Entries.Description: A meet-cute between two fish in an aquarium sparks an accidental musical journey of self discovery.

Entries.Title: Marble Man
Entries.Description: A man with his marble

Entries.Title: The Dance Is Not Over
Entries.Description: Celebrating the life and career of dancer, performer, choreographer, LGBTQ+ and publicly HIV-positive activist Patrick Scully, whose Patrick’s Cabaret was a South Minneapolis fixture for decades. His work in MN, New York and Berlin, expresses his passion for life, and touches on subjects that are often controversial and profound.

Entries.Title: The Big Scoot
Entries.Description: Scooters are for joyrides not cross-country treks. Try telling that to 182 riders who signed up for the tenth running of Scooter Cannonball. On wheels the size of dinner plates, they attempt to cross America in eight days on back roads. THE BIG SCOOT follows along as riders face scorching desert heat, rutted mountain passes, and even wild animals. Crashes and camaraderie become their constant companions as they learn that the true reward lies in the ride itself-if they can survive it.

Entries.Title: Goodbye Stranger
Entries.Description: After a botched scam, a seasoned con-man faces a moral crossroads: abandon his 10-year-old daughter or risk her following in his footsteps.

Entries.Title: The Good News According to Jesus: Episode 3: “I Am He”
Entries.Description: Jesus gathers his disciples and begins his ministry, before announcing himself as the Messiah.

Entries.Title: La Mirage
Entries.Description: The routine of a motel housekeeper quickly disintegrates upon losing her cleaning glove. Now trapped in a surreal purgatory, she sets out to vanquish the perilous forces that haunt each room.

Entries.Title: Odd Fellows
Entries.Description: Under the staunch rule of Odd Fellows Academy, two students navigate friendship, truth & identity in a world where all forms of art and creativity are banned.

Entries.Title: 18 Months
Entries.Description: The powerful true story of Pete and Dan — a gay couple who found an abandoned baby in a New York subway and spent the next 18 months fighting to legally adopt him.

Entries.Title: The Intern: A Rusty Lake Film
Entries.Description: Step into the shoes of an Intern working in the Rusty Lake Office as he prepares a special 10-year anniversary surprise in the form of a new free-to-play Rusty Lake adventure - The Mr Rabbit Magic Show.

Entries.Title: LESBIAN VAMPYRES FROM OUTER SPACE
Entries.Description: When a hungry vampire stumbles upon a bands performance, she must choose between her draw to the enchanting lead singer and her otherworldly desires.

Entries.Title: Fishwoman
Entries.Description: Mild-mannered Eliza narrates the story of how she went from a nervous young number-cruncher to a fishlike monster.

Entries.Title: 127 Seconds of a Door
Entries.Description: A door opens for 127 seconds

Entries.Title: Congrats!
Entries.Description: A high school senior graduates, feeling lost on what she wants, seeking a false escape in drugs at the graduation party of someone who knows what they want, and it’s not her.

Entries.Title: Boyfriend Killers
Entries.Description: Shay runs a salon that doubles as a hit squad for scorned women - until one job exposes secrets that hit too close to home.

Entries.Title: Shoot my Heart, My Mafia Boss
Entries.Description: When the ruthless mafia boss Sable crosses paths with Daymond, a compassionate and determined doctor, their lives collide in an unexpected journey of obsession and unlikely affection. What begins as a tense power struggle slowly evolves into mutual respect. Together, they take on their enemies—and in the process, discover a love neither of them saw coming.

Entries.Title: Sabbatical
Entries.Description: A diary film comprised of images from 2024 and voicemails from 2011-2016. It is a film about regrets and isolation from those who used to be near and dear to me. The footage I can stare at, it's not from all that long ago. Those voices I can listen to now. But the faces who spoke those words I won't meet again.

Entries.Title: Glow Street
Entries.Description: Four friends' plan to control Glow Street falls apart when one kills the wrong person. Cut off from their boss and hunted by an ex-con, they struggle to survive and keep their dream alive.

Entries.Title: now and then
Entries.Description: after DYK-4b

Entries.Title: Chronotope Earth 1985 to Future
Entries.Description: In 1938, the Russian literary theorist Mikhail Bakhtin coined the term 'chronotope' to describe the role time and space plays in literature. In 1985, the American astronomer, Carl Sagan testified before congress on the threat of climate change to life on Earth and the need for the world's governments to work together to address the issue. What if Bakhtin's literary theory applied to scientific discourse, and the natural environment from 1985 into the future were the time and space of the story?

Entries.Title: The Last Days of Gene Hackman: ABC News Special
Entries.Description: A look at the mysterious, final weeks of Gene Hackman's life and their aftermath. How did the Hollywood icon die, alongside his wife and dog, far from the eyes of the world, not to be discovered until many days later?

Entries.Title: Shakersss.mov
Entries.Description: In this self-documented piece, Solange offers a diaristic, devotional, inward gaze, presenting the film as a moving liturgy of praise expressed through reverence for self, God, and the exalted mother Yemaya, emphasizing our profound connection to water and its vital role in existence.

Entries.Title: State Organs: Unmasking Transplant Abuse in China
Entries.Description: When two young people mysteriously disappeared in police custody in mainland China, their families began a 20-year dangerous search for them within the communist state. What they encountered was merciless rejection, a shocking state crime, and eventually, a sense of hope as a renewal of traditional faith emerged in China. The atrocity of state-sanctioned forced organ harvesting in China is comparable to the holocaust in World War II, with tens of thousands of victims, but the difference is: it is still going on. From Peabody Award-winning Filmmaker and Emmy Award-winning Composer.

Entries.Title: From Sidney, with Love
Entries.Description: Convinced that she is Sidney Poitier's daughter, a 9-year-old girl from an otherwise all-white town in North Yorkshire runs away to London to meet her father at a screening of his new film, TO SIR, WITH LOVE.

Entries.Title: Millie in Cis Hell
Entries.Description: A trans ghostwriter and a slippery bombshell retrace their steps from a San Francisco wrap party where actress Harmony Hall was murdered. Neither of these women killed her, but only one of them believes it.

Entries.Title: A Boy Named Choo Choo
Entries.Description: A Boy Named Choo Choo is a story about a boy who serves as a human transit service in a dystopian world where people are turned into fleshy currency. After his handler steals all his schmeckles, a tragedy occurs and Choo Choo seeks revenge.

Entries.Title: pansies
Entries.Description: After Caleb is almost caught in the back of a pickup truck with Logan Balfe, he has to keep things quiet while driving Logan home.

Entries.Title: The Horologist
Entries.Description: As a broken, middle-aged horologist undertakes a secret project, his actions begin to unravel his marriage. With both spouses harbouring secrets, will they be able to confront their hidden truths or will their bond be shattered forever.

Entries.Title: SCHIZM
Entries.Description: Hijinx ensue when Pinky, an ambiguous foreigner, seeks human connection in the streets and recreational grounds of Fulham, London.

Entries.Title: Honey Lemon
Entries.Description: When an aspiring theatre director meets his "muse," he sets out to write and direct a one-woman show based on the very true story of her extravagant life.

Entries.Title: Aftershocks
Entries.Description: A fractured family comes back together following a tragedy, finally dealing with trauma from the Christchurch Earthquakes.

Entries.Title: Tick-Man
Entries.Description: Teenage Carter Carson must battle The Grey Gargoyle to protect the forest he calls home.

Entries.Title: A Walk From My Home to the End of the Railroad Tracks
Entries.Description: A dusk time walk from Elaine's house to the railroad tracks nearby.

Entries.Title: Ambil Alih
Entries.Description: On their way home from vacation, Rafa and Rena accidentally hit a cat, whose color and size reminded them of their cat who had died... because it was hit by someone. Rana insisted on burying it on the side of the road, against Rafa's proposal, who wanted to take the foreign cat's body home, to bury it in the yard. When she got home, Rena began experiencing incessant strange events, which ended in tragedy.

Entries.Title: You Know You Wanna Stay
Entries.Description: A freshman girl sneaks out to counsel her senior friend. His actions make her question the boundaries of "friendship."

Entries.Title: High Sugar
Entries.Description: A police officer has a fever dream after having too much sugar.

Entries.Title: Intimate Sketches 1-6
Entries.Description: A series of personal vignettes set to the music of Kurt Cobain.

Entries.Title: ASLEEP
Entries.Description: A depressed girl daydreams of being abducted by aliens to escape her mental torment.

Entries.Title: MY LITTLE PONY THE MOVIE: OUTBREAK
Entries.Description: A strange infection is spreading across Equestria. Mysterious cloth-like ponies have appeared and any pony they touch becomes a mindless husk. As the disease threatens Ponyville Princess Celestia sends Twilight Sparkle and her friends on a desperate mission to meet up with an old friend of hers, Shadow Tempest, to have a cure made. At the same time, Apple Split begins to uncover a secret Soarin has been hiding from him. What Care Package had done to him during Operation Lost Cause.

Entries.Title: The Executioner's Tears
Entries.Description: a strange figure reappears cyclically, leaving a trail of death and hope

Entries.Title: Sun On The Wall
Entries.Description: The story of Paul, 17, in his senior high school years.

Entries.Title: A New Wave: The Revival of The Beach Theatre
Entries.Description: An original documentary by Lunar Speedboat Productions that captures the extraordinary journey of bringing the beloved St. Pete Beach landmark back to life.

Entries.Title: RAGE
Entries.Description: As Julie Mac and her gang of Sharpies fight their way through their turbulent teenage years, Julie reflects on the unexpected bond between herself and the Italian tailor who crafts her iconic ‘Connie’ cardigan; a symbol that will firmly establish her within the Sharpie subculture and strengthen her sense of identity.  RAGE is a snapshot of the Sharpie subculture in 1970s Melbourne, a time when running from the cops, avoiding the ticket inspectors, drinking, spewing and rooting were all in a night's work.  Inspired by the book RAGE: A Sharpie's Journal, Melbourne 1974 - 1980 by Julie Mac.

Entries.Title: The Water Of The Womb
Entries.Description: A young photographer, haunted by his memories and fears, is driven to reconcile his loss and move forward when he learns he is about to go blind.

Entries.Title: DEAD END
Entries.Description: A spirited teenager tricks her older sister into joining her on a deceptively simple outing.

Entries.Title: Above The Clouds
Entries.Description: An ambitious owlet yearns to fly above the clouds despite his shortcomings but keeps falling short, only to find that all he needed was an unexpected glide down the mountainside.

Entries.Title: He's Definitely Dead
Entries.Description: After discovering her dog is dead, a childlike woman is stuck in the denial stage of grief -- playing pretend he's still alive.

Entries.Title: Out of Focus
Entries.Description: A young woman, on the cusp of moving out of her childhood home, discovers that the photos on her old cell phone can send her back in time.

Entries.Title: Keep It Kayfabe
Entries.Description: "Speedball" Mike Bailey pulls back the curtain on the artistry of pro wrestling while fighting his way through a busy week of independent shows.

Entries.Title: The Magical, Musical, Magnificent Moving Library of Montgomery and Margaret
Entries.Description: Discover the "magic of reading" with Montgomery Charlotte (Lotta) and Margaret LaRue (Rita) as they bring their dream of a traveling library to life, despite the schemings of the extremely boring Daryl Dull and his sidekick, Felicity. Narrated by Phineas Teller, this short film explores the first of many chapters of a magical, musical, magnificent moving library.

Entries.Title: Clown Hunters
Entries.Description: Watch Jack and Connor face the consequences of their actions as an old foe reemerges with a new face in this mind-bending investigative psychological horror-thriller drama created by the minds behind "Gnome Hunters" and "A Christmas Carol"

Entries.Title: Shroommates
Entries.Description: Two roommates high on mushrooms must sort out their differences when one of them brings home a severed head.

Entries.Title: Vessel 2024
Entries.Description: Marcus Surgeons has the ability to allow the spirits of the recently deceased to enter his body in order to obtain closure before moving on. He does this for financial gain, leaving his body, soul, and spirit open to an unwelcome entity with a hidden agenda.

Entries.Title: Pillow Talk
Entries.Description: A series of bad morning-afters. Inspired by true events.

Entries.Title: Operation Silent Extraction
Entries.Description: Special agent Richard Willis must sneak into the Maryland School and retrieve a special notebook to secure the safety of the International Project Operative Department.

Entries.Title: Inside Damanhur - A Hidden World
Entries.Description: Inside Damanhur - A Hidden World

Entries.Title: Creative Reasoning
Entries.Description: A grieving comic artist, struggling to cope with the loss of her child, is visited by a mysterious young girl who helps her to confront her past and process her trauma.

Entries.Title: Holy Rollers
Entries.Description: A grumpy, cynical priest and his young, naïve apprentice work out of a beat-up van. Called to perform an exorcism, they find the man's wife more concerned about her image and the neighbours' reactions. Things don't go as planned...

Entries.Title: Drone Runner III
Entries.Description: On a remote planet at the galaxy’s edge, a fragile truce between humans and autonomous drones is hanging by a thread. Recent events have revealed deep-seated conflicts and shocking truths that threaten to dismantle the delicate peace that has been maintained.

Entries.Title: Creeper in the Woods
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Errand
Entries.Description: On the precipice of a life-changing event, Hayley is faced with the cost of letting go as she struggles to complete the final errand that will close the door on her past and force her to embrace an uncertain future.

Entries.Title: THE HOTTEST BRAWLER EVER!
Entries.Description: This music video was made for the song 'A song of fire and ice... AND METAAAL!!'.

Entries.Title: Learning to Fly
Entries.Description: Aisha McAdams, a former competitive runner turned photographer, embarks on a journey to document the triumphs and struggles of famed ultra trailrunners, including Jim Walmsley and Eszter Csillag. Traveling to mythical races—the Western States Endurance Run in the mountains of eastern California, the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc in the French Alps—the film marvels at athletes who maintain their intensity as they run 100 miles of mountain trails while climbing thousands of vertical feet.

Entries.Title: Lurkers
Entries.Description: "Lurkers" is a short horror film following the sexual exploits of a young couple, Maya and Fei, as they dive deeper into suburbia and bite off a bit more than they can chew...

Entries.Title: Guarita
Entries.Description: A one-roll 16mm film that collages the multiplicity of guard houses in São Paulo city. A few remain active with freelance guards still working paid by the community, but most of them are carcasses, abandoned due to the rise of digital surveillance.

Entries.Title: Drifter’s Highway
Entries.Description: A lonely man walks through a desert landscape, searching.

Entries.Title: Ghost in the Machine
Entries.Description: Music contains in its essence a glitch, a conceptual puzzlement, a great riddle. The arrangement of notes on a piano is considered a crime against God, nature, and science by some and musical perfection by others. But who determines what a good sound is, what perfection is? Who has the correct answer to this musical puzzle? This is a history of science and music tale of music’s dirty little secret.​

Entries.Title: Like an Angel's Kiss in Spring
Entries.Description: A film that centers around people riding on ATVs and the nostalgia of spring.

Entries.Title: Rye Bread
Entries.Description: Music video for "Rye Bread" by Capyac

Entries.Title: I Am Not Invisible
Entries.Description: Yuki York’s self-reflexive documentary is a personal essay, shot in an impoverished district of the Philippines, deemed “invisible” by York’s on-screen text. Tracing York’s roots, I Am Not Invisible asks local residents innocuous questions about their lives to better understand them, in turn offering to better understand York’s own Filipina grandmother.

Entries.Title: Chance on Devlan
Entries.Description: Devlan, a man struggling with mental health is exploring the possibility of taking his own life. However, his view on life is altered when he is faced with someone significantly closer to the edge.

Entries.Title: The Wolves Are All Gone
Entries.Description: A folk horror retelling of Red Riding Hood.

Entries.Title: nosebleed
Entries.Description: i had a nosebleed

Entries.Title: It Must Be Because I Decided to Leave
Entries.Description: A dreamlike, fantastical drift around a fractured identity, with dazzling visual inventions. Like a diary that visually conveys a state of being between two worlds.

Entries.Title: Bye-Bye Guy
Entries.Description: A washed out old superhero argues with his soon to be bride. (48 Hour Film Competition | Superhero/Single Room)

Entries.Title: L'OEIL DE LA CHANCE
Entries.Description: Experimental short film on the theme of "luck." This short film won an award.

Entries.Title: Nicole Byer: An Evening of Crowd Work - Part Two
Entries.Description: I did two shows at comedy on state in Madison Wisconsin and this is the second one. It's fun and a treat 💜

Entries.Title: Bloody Clueless
Entries.Description: John, worried about his friend's recent strange behavior, makes a visit to Robert. Slicked back hair, Pale skin, Sharp Fangs, and Victorian clothing meet him, along with a laundry list of odd actions. Clearly, there's nothing wrong with him.

Entries.Title: Hello, Goodbye
Entries.Description: A girl and her dead best friend set out on a quest to complete their pre-college bucket list, coming to terms with growing up, grief, and finding closure along the way.

Entries.Title: What Sits Between Us
Entries.Description: After pulling into an empty barn, a couple is forced to confront the consequences of infidelity and jealousy.

Entries.Title: Hypothetically, the End
Entries.Description: On the brink of the Y2K bug scare, two best friends scramble to get married in the last 5 minutes of 1999 with the help of their eccentric friend.

Entries.Title: Something in the Water
Entries.Description: Five water justice advocates discuss how Milwaukee’s Black communities are disproportionately being lead poisoned, and the debilitating effects it has on residents' health, with hopes to see equitable change that will heal the water and Black resident’s relationship with it.

Entries.Title: The Farm: A BMX Film
Entries.Description: The Farm follows a group of BMXers as they build their own private BMX training facility.

Entries.Title: Shadow to Stage Left
Entries.Description: The night before opening, a theatre sits silent — except for one man. The director. Alone. Or so he thinks. Shadows move. Lines are spoken. His cast returns, but not as they were. They mock, they question, they twist beneath the stage lights. What begins as rehearsal slips into ritual. Time fractures. Ego bleeds. And in the dark, he’s forced to watch his own mind turn against him.

Entries.Title: Frontier
Entries.Description: A recently-released mental hospital patient attempts a one night stand with a bull riding enthusiast.

Entries.Title: Bears
Entries.Description: Following the death of a young writer, her estranged friends gather to grant her dying wish: performing a play about their last days together.

Entries.Title: SQUAT
Entries.Description: A couple lets a delivery driver into their home and they get more than they bargained for.

Entries.Title: Hidden
Entries.Description: a short message saying don't forget all the black people who suffered because of hate and violence

Entries.Title: She's on the Run
Entries.Description: A teenage girl tormented by severe anxiety, depression, and hallucinations, finds herself unable to manage her overwhelming emotions. Escaping into an 80s-inspired altered reality born from obsession, she becomes determined to end her life. With a six-shooter tucked into her back pocket, she hurtles down this dark destructive path, searching for escape. The angels in her life desperately try to pull her back from the brink, but lurking in the shadows, a sinister beast relentlessly urges her onward, determined to ensure she completes her tragic quest.—Jacob Stieneker

Entries.Title: Three Meals
Entries.Description: When her brother’s health worsens, Yasmin returns from living abroad to convince her mother to turn off his life support machine.

Entries.Title: Touch Faith
Entries.Description: Grieving the death of his loving mother, fashion designer Khamron Hines will discover what it means to open his heart…

Entries.Title: Sound Spring
Entries.Description: Unfolding in a series of eight vignettes, Sound Spring explores the history ofYellow Springs, Ohio over hundreds of years, as narrated by its residents incomical scenes: one interviewee rollerblades and reads the village's water meters, another stands on his head in a breakdancing freeze. The villagers describe American history-their ancestors' settlements after slavery, a friendship with Coretta Scott King, and Ohio's Trail of Tears- among other more personal details of village life. The wording of their recollections is imperfect, unsure-in fact they are all re-stagings of their previous audio interviews. Through performing their own previously recorded media, villagers uncover layers of time and storytelling.

Entries.Title: Paper Vengeance
Entries.Description: Nathan barely escaped Carbyn Inc. with his life, but he wants revenge. Only the perfect plan and the perfect team can pull it off, and assembling this team won't be easy. In a world of distrust and double-crossing, he will need to put everything on the line to get this job done. Revenge always comes at a cost. And for Nathan, it could cost him everything.

Entries.Title: the SCRIPT
Entries.Description: With less than 9 hours left, a writer struggling with writer's block must find creative inspiration before it's too late.

Entries.Title: Jay Light: My Wife Hates These Jokes
Entries.Description: Jay Light: My Wife Hates These Jokes – the first special presented by Roast Battle League!  In this new special from Jay Light (Roast Battle, America's Got Talent) he jokes about his new marriage, going to weird weddings, being a sober enabler, looking like every true crime villain, and more. His wife hates these jokes but I promise you'll love them. Filmed live at​⁠ ‪Dallas Comedy Club‬.

Entries.Title: Walking With The Dogs
Entries.Description: Two strangers unwittingly cross paths as they both deal with money making schemes gone wrong. As tensions build and they come face to face, a dramatic climax ensues.

Entries.Title: Midnight Prowlers
Entries.Description: Fast machines and stone cold iron bullets. Pretty tough pussycats wrapped in leather & chains. Led by Ivy, these lunar vixens prowl through the sleazy streets at night and strut the streets of 6101 Hollywood Blvd by day. Rory, new to the gang is shocked by bloody transformative visions of the moon which she must keep secret from the gang. These girls lure the local bar goons using thrilling action until easy action turns into hard luck. Entries.Title: Virgin Atlantic
Entries.Description: It is a Modern Love Story. A modern love story that takes place in the Atlantic Theater. The love story takes place in their hearts, their tiny little minds, they are the center of the world, the planet is in turn the center of The Universe. The house revolves around them as it continues to spin and they don't know. What does it mean to be at the center of your own Universe. There are two, a couple. But there is only one main character. In the background the two women are doing their jobs. Isn't it funny how they have Private Lives as well as Occupations? Their uniforms signal duty. Their hand motions signal purpose and authority. Their facial expressions tell a different story. What happens when it all blows up? Can we still do our jobs? Do we continue to act it all out in the Atlantic Theater, as the world keeps spinning, or do we Break In Case of Emergency?

Entries.Title: CARNAL

Entries.Description: Award-winning filmmakers Dean and Rebecca Sills, a father-daughter duo, embark on a journey inspired by the legendary Laurel and Hardy as they explore Yorkshire in 'Laurel and Hardy's Yorkshire Adventures.'

Entries.Description: When a young man named ScumWillie learns a shocking truth about his home, he is forced to choose if he should leave all he's ever known, or brave the world outside

Entries.Title: Almendra
Entries.Description: Overall, "A Estos Hombres Tristes" by Almendra is a song that encourages listeners to find meaning and purpose in life and to embrace their creative potential, even if it means deviating from societal norms. It also recognizes the difficulty of living in an overcrowded, impersonal city and urges listeners to find ways to connect with each other and the world around them.

Entries.Title: The Unlovable
Entries.Description: A summer coming-of-age film following Saf, a nineteen-year-old girl, as she finds true friends. Saf starts the summer by acquiring a job at a local museum. It is there that she meets Karina, who eventually introduces her to Peter, Felix, and Ivy. Saf and Karina start dating. The friend group have magical adventures together, but as the summer goes on, Saf grows tired of being Karina's secret.

Entries.Title: Iron Gun: Final Vendetta
Entries.Description: Millie Montgomery, a special agent, is on a mission to investigate the Iron Gun. In an attempt to explore her only lead, she’s paired with Braden Dunn, who happens to be closely related to what she’s searching for. Together, they must beat Valerie, an evil supervillain, in finding the Iron Gun and evading her long-standing vendetta against Braden.

Entries.Title: TORN: The Israel-Palestine Poster War on New York City Streets
Entries.Description: After Hamas kidnapped 251 people from Israel on October 7, and as Israel’s war in Gaza unfolded, a conflict thousands of miles away erupted on New York’s walls. TORN captures the emotional fallout of the now-iconic “KIDNAPPED” poster campaign - a grassroots act of solidarity that quickly became a flashpoint, igniting fierce confrontations between pro-Israel and pro-Palestinian New Yorkers. Through the voices of artists, activists, and hostage families, the film unpacks the motivations behind those putting up and tearing down the posters, exposing a complex proxy war fought in stickers, slogans, and torn paper. By revealing how a distant war fractured daily life in one of the world’s most diverse cities, TORN forces a reckoning with identity, free speech, and empathy in an age of polarization.

Entries.Title: Webslinger: Shattered Hero
Entries.Description: Betrayal leads to the hasty downfall of the webslinging vigilante Peter Parker.

Entries.Title: wunsch drei(3)
Entries.Description: wunsch drei (3) is about the quiet alchemy of repetition. folding laundry, staring at the ceiling, seeing the same 3 people every single day.. smoking a cigarette in the same spot at the same time. it’s about submitting and worshipping chewy rubbery summer days, transmuting, spilling out and becoming one, going inward until you come out the other side.  the film adopts an online mode of creation, drawing from the rhythms and logic of digital life. it assembles a collage of footage where meaning emerges not from linear narrative but from the friction and resonance between fragments. these relations could only arise within an internet-native experience, precisely in relation to making sense of the offline “irl” world. wunsch drei (3) is an internet coming of age in the 21st century.

Entries.Title: couch.
Entries.Description: a short film from the perspective of a couch. and the people who experience life with it.

Entries.Description: After Flawless's reality tearing fart opens a pathway to another dimension, multiple universes are thrown into absolute chaos. Entries.Description: A masked vigilante armed with a clothes iron and the ghost of a slain detective attempt to stop a ruthless gang of devil worshippers from resurrecting a demon.

Entries.Description: Aboard a secret Weyland-Yutani vessel, Colin and Naomi are trapped in a small maintenance room, hiding from a terrifying organism that has torn through the crew. Their only chance at survival is to escape confinement and reach the escape bay before it’s too late. But something is hunting them… and it’s not human.

Entries.Title: The Voice - Horror Short Film
Entries.Description: A young man spends a quiet evening alone in his small flat, the world outside muted by darkness and rain. At first, the night is uneventful, he makes tea, scrolls on his phone, and idly flicks through television channels. The only sounds are the hum of the fridge and the ticking of a wall clock. But in the middle of that stillness, something changes. From somewhere far away, soft enough to be mistaken for imagination, he hears his name.

Entries.Title: Crises on the Comeback Trail: Hokkaido's Endangered Birds
Entries.Description: Hokkaido in Japan’s far north is a paradise for wild birds. Some endangered species of large birds in Hokkaido have benefited from conservation efforts over the past few decades, but new threats are putting that momentum at risk. Diseases and collisions with vehicles, power lines, and wind turbines are just some of the challenges. This documentary shows how veterinarians and researchers have developed initiatives to help the birds grow in number.

Entries.Title: Silvesterchlausen
Entries.Description: Silvesterchlausen is a mysterious tradition that takes place every New Year’s Eve in Switzerland’s Appenzell, the most conservative part of the country. Groups of six men dress in ornate costumes and engage in wordless, polyphonic yodeling and rhythmic bell clanging. The ritual has been performed for at least 500 years, but nobody knows how or why it began.

Entries.Title: Mercedes
Entries.Description: Spend a day in pre-pandemic San Francisco with Mercedes Weatherford, a quirky woman in her 70's who still works full-time. Entries.Title: Death of a Child Star

Entries.Title: Red Bull Valparaíso Cerro Abajo
Entries.Description: The world's largest urban downhill race returned to Valparaíso in Chile for the 21st time to celebrate the best mountain bike riders from around the globe. There were hair-raising feats in the steep, narrow, twisty streets as they competed in the second stop of the three-part series to determine the ultimate Red Bull Cerro Abajo winner.

Entries.Title: What’s Left Of Us
Entries.Description: She gave so much of herself, now Mariam is determined to find herself again and exercise her agency in spite of the weight of tradition, religion and duty.

Entries.Description: It's New Year's Eve in Brooklyn and Annika doesn't have anything to wear to the party that her best friend Beccs is performing at and her ex is hosting...because nothing fits. Throughout her night she undergoes the push and pull of trying to be okay with herself and her surroundings.

Entries.Title: Forward, Ever
Entries.Description: “For the Love of the Game” is a phrase that is thrown around easily, but for the players on the Birmingham-Southern College baseball team it’s a lifestyle. Far from the money driven world of big-time college athletics and NIL contracts, these are true student athletes that are chasing a dream without scholarships or the perks that come with playing for a major program.  Following years of financial difficulty post-Covid and a rollercoaster ride dealing with the state legislature to secure funding, Birmingham-Southern College is out of options and is forced to announce they are closing down. Despite the crushing news and now facing uncertain futures, the BSC Panthers respond with an improbable winning streak that secures a spot in the postseason and lifts the spirit of the BSC faithful. The eclectic collection of players and their inspirational coach are pursuing a legendary playoff run that continues after the demise of the school they play for.

The film was worked on for over 4 months and multiple shooting weekends. Working with Southworks and Home Owners, Calyn Fisher and Cathie Simpson, in Ithaca, NY,  to film in two incredible locations

Entries.Title: Cowboy Boots

Cowboy Boots explores the intersection of accepting one’s sexual identity and trying to find the community in which it can reside. It is at once a dive into the longings and desires of a young, rural gay man and the realities of being a newcomer in a world that he doesn’t know or understand. While the story is queer in nature, the themes of finding one’s place, and the discomfort that comes along with doing so, are universal.

Entries.Title: No Leg Power

Entries.Title: Assembly

Invited to stage a show at New York’s Park Avenue Armory, he reclaims the space from its white military past, transforming it into a Black queer utopia. Joined by global collaborators and Being—an AI ‘digital griot’—Newsome’s creative journey unfolds in this immersive documentary. Through striking visuals and storytelling, the film celebrates community, resilience, and the power of art to heal, unite, and spark liberation.

Entries.Title: Gay Men’s Book Club
Entries.Description: A table of gay men with diverse ages, races and backgrounds gather in a Los Angeles bookstore to discuss Olufemi O. Taiwo’s book Elite Capture and the co-opting of identity politics (queerness especially) by hegemony. What follows is an unscripted conversation between the participants, including Matthew Lax as facilitator alongside founding member of the Radical Faeries, and Jungian psychologist, Dr. Don Kilhefner as co-facilitator.

Entries.Title: Pauline Boty: I Am the Sixties
Entries.Description: The first TV documentary about pop art sensation Pauline Boty, tracking the artist’s original contribution to British art, her feminism and her unique take on the nascent celebrity culture of the 1960s.  Ahead of her time in so many ways, Boty’s story ends with her tragic early death at 28 in 1966 and the subsequent revival of interest in her work in the last decade.  Packed full of original photographs and art work, the film calls on an array of family, friends, art critics and famous fans to lead us through the Boty story. Contributors include pop art titan Sir Peter Blake, comedian and artist Jim Moir, critic Kate Bryan, best friend and print designer Natalie Gibson MBE, pop singers Corrine Drewery and Tanita Tikaram and TV presenter Ronnie Archer Morgan.

Not so far away, elsewhere, where time passes, has passed, will pass, on the horizon of time...  The image glides on its path, a paper cargo ship, daughter of oblivion, free of history. It passes like a cloud, a dead leaf...  A few stones remain, marked by vague eternity.  A voice passes, from time to time, from distant memory... An ancient traveller?  A distracted vagabond?  It stands far away, in the rolling of time,  silent.

It’s an honour to be included and celebrated in this way. And really, it’s a celebration of all of us. Even you! Because without your little choices – as little as buying toilet paper – none of this would have been possible.  Our short film shares the powerful story of Antoinette, a sanitation worker in Nairobi who’s changing lives through clean toilets and community hygiene education. Her work — alongside our partners at Fresh Life — shows the incredible impact your toilet paper choices can have.  #WhoGivesACrap #BBCStoryworks #BBC #FreshLife #Sanitation #Toilets #SocialImpact #BCorp”

Entries.Title: Light
Entries.Description: As the night drags on and it's time for bed, the Man(played by newcomer Zachary Smith) longs for darkness. However, every time he attempts to turn off the basement light, it stubbornly flickers back on, no matter how many times he flips the switch. With each cautious step down the stairs, he grapples with unsettling thoughts and the growing possibility that every step down may be his last. Is the persistent glow an omen, echoing the deepest fears lurking in his mind? Will this relentless light yield, or is something far more sinister lurking in the light? Despite his efforts to extinguish the troublesome light, the Man is trapped between a malevolent beam and the soothing darkness he craves.

Entries.Title: Language Decay
Entries.Description: A broken camera and three rolls of film, two daylight and one tungsten, capture days with Eva. The version of the woman on celluloid is more foreign to her than to me, and the version of herself speaking these languages is more foreign to me than to her, but both are not fully in our grasp and slip away and decay. They do not belong to either of us but to time—much like how languages are imperfect and adapt to the needs of those who speak them.  Time causes disintegration, wherein different variations and versions emerge. Because of physical separation, my grandmother slowly forgets her native tongue and the languages she spoke as a child, mirroring the movement and transformation of living languages. The act of remembering brings back these decomposing versions of past selves, selves that never were or briefly were, then hidden away but not discarded. The film intentionally chooses to leave all sequences unsubtitled.

While on the road, the tour was caught in the middle of two historic winter storms, but it wasn’t a complete disaster because this run saw some of the band’s most iconic performances. Even though the band dealt with record snowfall and historic low temperatures, they were able to make the most out of it.

Entries.Title: Homme-Sick

Made up almost entirely of archival footage - both found and from the artist’s own family archive - this film questions the relationships between toxic masculinity, family, the home, and transness, thus creating precarious spaces in which the voyeuristic impulses of the viewer are toyed with.
