Entries.Description: A casting director has one day to find the leads for a community theater production of Romeo and Juliet. But what seems like a simple task proves impossible when the pool of actors includes extreme method actors, performers who just don't know what to do with their hands, and one particular woman who may or may not think she's a cat. This hilarious comedy will bring you to the last place you'd ever want to be...behind the doors of a casting session.

Entries.Title: Post-Atlantic: The Art of Dewey Crumpler
Entries.Description: POST ATLANTIC explores the visionary world of legendary African American painter and philosopher Dewey Crumpler as he connects the slave trade to modern globalization and demonstrates what it means to be a working artist with a conscience in today’s society.

Entries.Title: The Power of Fire
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Stagnation
Entries.Description: A man chasing hollow ambition in his stop-and-go life has a profound revelation when he comes across a blinking yellow-traffic-signal that doesn’t tell him what to do.

Entries.Title: Beelzebub
Entries.Description: “Beelzebub” metaphorically reflects through historical and visual contrast what could be spirituality in opposition to shame, violence and fear.  A child wakes up from a violent dream to an unusual day in her life, forcing her to prove to herself if she could face the lonely journey of an apostate looking for a spiritual path.

Entries.Title: Club 13
Entries.Description: A group of women meet for an online book club. Pretty standard, right? There's definitely nothing odd about it.

Entries.Title: Dillans Night In
Entries.Description: Spend a night with epic YouTube star Dillan.

Entries.Title: Stick Em Game
Entries.Description: Struggling to launch her social media career, Elise decides to switch to viral pranks. When one prank on an old acquaintance goes terribly wrong, a local gang leader is out for revenge. With her best friend's help, Elise must fight for her life to survive.

Entries.Title: Darling Henry
Entries.Description: On his first shift of the 24 hour news cycle, Henry McCance makes it a five minute news struggle.

Entries.Title: Hunting Confessions
Entries.Description: "This project consists a visual fluidity of construction, harmony and thoughts taking colors and length from this body of autonomy. Different images between figuration and abstraction are created by meaning and phenomenon letting the decoupage revealing a piece of a strange underworld. I built it like a window opened to the fresh air of improvisation by familiar landscapes, those exact moments articulating a connection between light and movement."

Entries.Title: The European Civil War
Entries.Description: Third short documentary made from archival footage that explores the great war, how it started and ended

Entries.Title: The Thesis
Entries.Description: A college student working on a thesis gets a mysterious phone call regarding his subject.

Entries.Title: Such Good Friends
Entries.Description: A recovering people pleaser struggles to break free from her old habits when she becomes entangled with her ex-best friend's family, testing her resolve and personal growth as she navigates complex relationships and boundaries.

Entries.Title: Sanibel
Entries.Description: Initially an offbeat comedy exploring the quirky, seashell-obsessed culture of Southwest Florida, six weeks into filming, Hurricane Ian — one of the most destructive storms in U.S. history — devastates the region. As waters recede, the crew return to find a transformed landscape and story. What was once lighthearted now grapples with a deeper question: will the community's love for shells and the coastline survive the weight of its overwhelming grief, or will it find a way to heal and rebuild?

Entries.Title: Friendlyship
Entries.Description: A group of friends find their happy-go-lucky chumminess challenged after a minor inconvenience snowballs into a massive problem.

Entries.Title: Extinction
Entries.Description: A fantasy story took place in an unknown futuristic time, after many wars and deadly pandemics that lasted for decades, an expedition from outside the planet is trying to find the living remains of the human race on planet Earth, the inevitable message of these kinds of stories is well known and anticipates the end of humanity. A SOLAV STUDIOS PRODUCTION WRITTEN BY:  KHALIL SAEED RIZQ AND MAHER ASAAD BAKER PRODUCED BY:  FUAD AL-QRIZE ANIMATION SUPERVISOR:  YAZAN MAHER BAKER DIRECTED BY: MAHER ASAAD BAKER

Entries.Title: World Over
Entries.Description: World Over is a film by Ed Tullett (Lowswimmer) that explores his experience of live touring with Novo Amor. Intended to show a more realistic side of touring compared to the usual hand-picked and finessed exciting moments, the film explores the monotony of its constant travel, the repetitiveness of playing the same show over and over, and the disorientation of being in ever-changing, unfamiliar places for a day or two at a time.

Entries.Title: MY LITTLE PONY THE MOVIE: Big Mac Goes to College
Entries.Description: When the Apple family finds a college acceptance letter addressed to Big Mac in the mail, they suspect something must be wrong because members of the Apple family are really stupid. Princess Celestia confesses that the reality of the situation is that Big Mac has been chosen to go on a top secret mission alongside Twilight Sparkle, Rarity, and other select ponies where they must infiltrate a certain campus and bring a certain individual back in handcuffs.

Entries.Title: Estramia
Entries.Description: Benji, a young man in his early twenties, learns to make money in a post-apocalyptic landscape after coming to terms with the murder of his father.

Entries.Title: The Devil's Road
Entries.Description: When two friends embark on their yearly winter road trip, old memories come back to haunt them.

Entries.Title: The Last Days of an Escort
Entries.Description: Kitty, a struggling escort, agrees to be documented for a film. Her roommate, Star, a more successful escort, reluctantly joins. A new client, Earl, changes their lives forever when he asks to see Kitty and Star together. Kitty's world becomes increasingly dangerous as she navigates the dark underworld of escorting.

Entries.Title: Time Keeps Marching On
Entries.Description: An undocumented immigrant explores his and his family's immigration trauma while grasping hope through a voicemail.

Entries.Title: Elton John: Touched By Gold
Entries.Description: Elton John’s life has been touched by gold in fascinating ways, both on and off the stage. Hear his story, in this new exclusive access documentary.

Entries.Title: Fatal Detour
Entries.Description: A demented tech genius lures unsuspecting influencers into his nightmarish mansion by hacking their luxury electric vehicles. Once trapped inside, the group faces the monstrous brute MOFF and his sadistic master. Two ordinary girls, Donna and Laren, who stumble upon the mansion, must fight to survive as they uncover the horrifying secrets behind the EV death trap.

Entries.Title: LOST TREASURES OF ARABIA: THE NABATAEAN KINGDOM
Entries.Description: Lost Treasures of Arabia: The Nabataean Kingdom  In ‘the Lost Treasures of Arabia: The Nabataean Kingdom’ episode, we will look at Hegra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, that was the principal southern city of the Nabataean kingdom, famed for its spectacular monumental tombs. Although Hegra is lesser known to the general public, it’s an important place to understand this highly advanced Nabataean society.

Entries.Title: Presenting... Serenity
Entries.Description: A short, feverish film made up of recent footage taken by Jacob Polak, which tells a hidden story through its words and symbolism.

Entries.Title: Slightest Pretense
Entries.Description: Inspired by a text by legendary Japanese writer Ryūnosuke Akutagawa, and the “scintillating scotoma” that precedes a migraine, Eri Saito’s Slightest Pretense is a wordless, Super 8 near-narrative that feels like a lost oddity that could have washed up on a shoreline.

Entries.Title: El color del amor
Entries.Description: This short documentary explores the intimate and unconventional life of my grandmother and her relationship with magic and with the love of her life. With nearly 40 years between them and a union that never reached the altar, the story unfolds in a time when social norms and life expectations collided with their own desires and decisions. The documentary follows my grandmother’s life from her early youth to her maturity, through the responsibilities of motherhood, her craft, and love in its most unexpected forms.  Through interviews, family memories, personal belongings, and the narration of key moments in their life together, this portrait seeks to explore the nuances of love and the complexities of building a family outside traditional structures.

Entries.Title: Fool Me Once by Keo & Them
Entries.Description: When Keo & Them gets screwed over by a shady venue owner, the band takes it into their own hands to get the money they earned for their show. What do they do with it? Throw a killer party, of course.

Entries.Title: There Is Something In The Attic
Entries.Description: An entity moves through the dark rooms of an Attic.

Entries.Title: Morph
Entries.Description: A group of young adults plan a staycation for their friend who recently lost a parent. At their most vulnerable, personified fears shape-shift to pick them off one by one. Face them, but with which face?

Entries.Title: Tarrare
Entries.Description: Tarrare, a showman with an insatiable appetite, is being studied in a hospital in eighteenth century France. The head doctor believes all is going well until an infant disappears and all signs point to Tarrare.

Entries.Title: Minor Setbacks
Entries.Description: Summer after junior year, four friends realize age is gaining on them. Racing to achieve their own milestones of adulthood, they slam face first into the messy and harsh reality of being a kid in an adult world.

Entries.Title: a summer day
Entries.Description: day in the life of a boy

Entries.Title: Dooni
Entries.Description: Dooni is the eulogy, voiced by actor Timothy Johnson, of the American soul singer and disco legend Sylvester (1947-1988) as delivered by the gospel singer and preacher Walter Hawkins.

Entries.Title: Act Black
Entries.Description: A first year black actor who is deeply inspired by black cinema is traveling through a journey of understanding what it takes to become a successful actor in moment of time where gigs, jobs and opportunities are not provided for him during the hot, humid summer set in a urban city Newark.

Entries.Title: Requiem
Entries.Description: As the orchestra choir settles into the church choir, the trombonist blows into his instrument as a warm-up. Mozart's name appears at the top of the score to be performed, whose title is also that of the film: Requiem.

Entries.Title: Letters To Hanna
Entries.Description: A young man suddenly loses his beloved wife, moves homes, and needs to sort through her belongings to decide what to keep and what to let go of while he goes through grief.

Entries.Title: ALIVESTREAM
Entries.Description: A young livestreamer girl living through the zombie apocalypse fights through a hoarded mall to get the last pair of limited edition sneakers!

Entries.Title: TATTERS
Entries.Description: Meet Marvin: A silly puppet who learns a big lesson after he is diagnosed with a terminal illness.

Entries.Title: Baggage
Entries.Description: When a night out takes a dark turn, Anna reaches out to her best friend Lydia for help.

Entries.Title: Steal My Girl
Entries.Description: Amidst the anxiety of their impending graduation from UW, 2 best friends must decide whether to take a chance on something new blossoming between them.

Entries.Title: Sleepwalker
Entries.Description: Detective Parker Sullivan must investigate a string of murders occurring outside of his New York apartment. With the help of his superior, Sgt. Landon Andrews, he discovers that the killer is not who they seem.

Entries.Title: A&E, Adolf & Eva / Adam & Eve, Mother
Entries.Description: 16:9 color video w/ sound, duration: 45:26min  Adolf Adam and Eva Eve are under a dead pine tree. Eva Eve’s back is against the tree. Adolf Adam lays on the ground, his head in her lap. Adolf Adam is the buffoon boy child. Eva Eve is the mother. She feeds him with her mouth like a bird.  She leaves him in the dirt.

Entries.Title: Our Shadow
Entries.Description: Emily moves into her first dorm room in hopes of hiding from her traumatic past, but it follows her in the shape of a shadow that haunts her at night. With the help of her best friend and Nana, Emily navigates her traumatic past and confronts her darkness.

Entries.Title: First Date
Entries.Description: Kami and Jessie haven’t seen each other since they shared their magical one night, or at least that’s what they thought. Due to unexpected events, Jessie becomes the blind date bidder for Kami’s sorority Valentine's event. With nowhere to run and hide, Kami plans to get answers to Jessie’s ghosting, while Jessie may have to face the consequences. Will she be satisfied by his answers? Will he be able to keep running from his past? What could go wrong? It’s only their first date.

Entries.Title: Breakups Suck
Entries.Description: Luca fears for his life while preparing to dump his girlfriend Ruby, who may or may not be a vampire. He quickly realizes, leaving her may not be as easy as he thought...

Entries.Title: PLUMP
Entries.Description: An unhappy girl's mind and life are being eaten away by her burdening eating disorder.

Entries.Title: Basement
Entries.Description: Tensions rise when Kyle brings his friend Rashad to his cousin's UFC fight watch party.

Entries.Title: The Rock-Hunter
Entries.Description: The Rock-Hunter takes us through a long, brutal journey through the wilderness to hunt down a devious enemy, a rock.

Entries.Title: If I Could Take Your Face, I Would

Entries.Title: Daydream #1
Entries.Description: A kinky, experimental dream of transexual cannibalism. The first of the Daydreams series.

Entries.Title: One Minute Remaining
Entries.Description: ONE MINUTE REMAINING follows three families with incarcerated loved ones from across the US, intimately capturing  the emotional journey of each family leading up to and through their release, and highlighting the chaotic impact of incarceration on families and, in particular, on women. Central to the story is Julie Magers, who fought for her ex-husband’s Multiple Sclerosis treatment throughout his 20-year sentence. Together, these families reveal the consequences of incarceration on millions of American families.

Entries.Title: WKLO85: The Last Stop
Entries.Description: Vince is the last man on Earth. He's the host of his own radio show. He has everything he'd ever need. Besides people. But maybe, just maybe, that will change.

Entries.Title: Lucidity
Entries.Description: A man starts having bizarre dreams, changing his view of recent events in his life.

Entries.Title: Outtakes

Entries.Title: Behind the Art: Patricia Shistle

Entries.Title: Mother Clay

Entries.Title: Once Upon a Winter Wonderland
Entries.Description: While brothers Arthur and Theodore figure out what to do with a surprising gift, friends Gabriel and Christian look for the criminal stealing from their town. Their paths cross unexpectedly, all in a race to save Christmas.

Entries.Title: NEXUS
Entries.Description: “We are all connected, sometimes without even knowing it. Three strangers, three different lives, one resonance. Through the video of a teenager who transforms his blog into a diary, Nexus explores these invisible links that unite us. What if our words, our thoughts, our dreams travel further than we can imagine?”

Entries.Title: The Bucket Wish
Entries.Description: Join Ericka Nicole Malone in 'The Bucket Wish,' a documentary that follows her personal quest to live the life she always imagined. This film captures her journey as she revisits her dreams and confronts the fears that once held her back.

Entries.Description: Amelia and Abigail meet up for a nice day out as friends, but unable to hide their feelings for each other any longer they discover its not that simple

Entries.Title: The Path of Puma-36
Entries.Description: A young mountain lion’s treacherous odyssey through Northern California. Monitored with a tracking collar and trail cameras, P-36 travels over 1,400 miles in just 16 months, making his way through a mosaic of human-developed land and wild spaces as he searches for a territory of his own.

Entries.Title: Moments After a Duel to the Death

Entries.Title: Coffee Is Important
Entries.Description: A pair of long lost friends re-discover the power of friendship, the quaint traditions of a small town, and the importance of coffee.

Entries.Title: Destroy All Humans
Entries.Description: Destroy All Humans is a documentary exploring AI’s rise in art and media through an existential, experimental lens. At its center is HOVERBORG, a fictional band whose AI-generated music sparked questions about creativity and authenticity.  Through interviews with musicians, artists, and media professionals, the film reflects on the unsettling shift toward hyperpersonalized media and asks: In a world shaped by algorithms, will we still recognize ourselves in the art we consume?

Entries.Title: Heads or Tails
Entries.Description: Two friends agreed to meet every 9th of January during their village festival, but as time passed, there were things they can’t say to each other.

Entries.Description: A short film by Kathir Mack-Dev and Nico Listi

Entries.Description: When Elliot, a young artist, locks eyes with the enigmatic Ana, he's swept into a night of emotional sparks, pancakes, and unexpected vulnerability. But as their whirlwind encounter blurs the lines between inspiration and manipulation, Elliot must confront the painful gap between love as he imagines it and love as it really is.

Entries.Description: When a late night movie turns into a horrifying loop, a boy tries to escape a theater where he is haunted by not just the screen, but an unexpected visitor seeking revenge.

Entries.Description: A young girl must unlock her late father’s final message by beating a humanoid AI in a game of chess, learning life lessons along the way.

Entries.Description: A couple is having dinner in a super-luxurious restaurant. In fact, they’re the only customers. A fish dish that is incredibly overpriced. But they can afford it. An alert for the extinction of animals.

Entries.Description: Vidura’s newest hour of standup. It involves many anecdotes from his childhood, an ego-death in the desert, and a parable featuring a talking clay pot.

Entries.Description: Marlena, a bisexual woman, is the victim of biphobia as she is outed by a gay man. Seeking support from her girlfriend, Diana, she musters the courage to confront the man who outed her in this exploration of biphobia within the LGBTQ+ community.

Entries.Description: Daniel's list of past sexual partners falls into wrong hands. A hitman targets eliminating them. Daniel and friends race to stop the killer from harming his fiance Kristina and others on the list.

Entries.Description: In starting his college career, Felix meets his new room-mate Montgomery. But after the two spend time together, their friendship may be something else.

Entries.Title: Faded Memories (27 Years)
Entries.Description: Short film compiled of 27 years worth of home movies.

Entries.Title: WarKings: Live at Wacken Open Air
Entries.Description: Warkings hit Wacken 2025 with full force, bringing their epic power metal straight from the halls of Valhalla to the festival stage. Since their founding, the band has portrayed themselves as a warrior collective from times long past, bringing their tales of crusaders, Vikings, and legends to musical life. Their current album, "Armageddon," is a storm of thunderous riffs, anthemic choruses, and dramatic theatricality, always accompanied by the mystical voice of Morgana le Fay. Those who appreciate monumental hooks, fierce pathos, and a touch of fantasy will find Warkings a show that oscillates between headbanging ecstasy and battlefield atmosphere, loud, proud, and with swords raised.

Entries.Title: Knight In Service To Her Majestys Bloodied Knees
Entries.Description: A White Gardenia Fairytale.

Entries.Title: Jason and Shirley Revisited
Entries.Description: A radical revisitation. This updated version of Stephen Winter’s 2015 film unearths the ghosts of Jason and Shirley, restaging the volatile 12-hour shoot of the 1967 documentary Portrait of Jason—held at the Chelsea Hotel—which blurred the line between subject and storyteller. Jason Holliday, a sharp-witted Black gay man, whose identity splits between personas–performer, hustler, muse, provocateur–is once again in the room with Shirley Clarke, the Oscar-winning filmmaker who insisted on framing his life. Now, with newly unearthed footage, the director returns 10 years later, not to resolve the contradictions, but to reopen them. What was once a document becomes a haunting, a conversation with what was left outside the frame. Time folds. Power shifts. And Jason, still impossible to contain, speaks back.

Entries.Title: Summer Tour
Entries.Description: Few American demographics are more easily caricatured than Deadheads, those swirling, dosing, hippy-dressed vagabonds. But in his infinitely sweet and wise documentary, director Mischa Richter offers us the Deadheads as complex, self-aware and resourceful members of a wandering commune, one that’s admirable for its kindness and care.

Entries.Title: Melting Glacier of the Himalayas
Entries.Description: A popular YouTuber from the Philippines is invited to Everest Base Camp in Nepal to find out about the beautiful Himalayan Glaciers, the origin of freshwater to billions of lives.

Entries.Description: A "tragic" look into the life of a young man named Jerry, struggling to open up to his girlfriend about his deepest, darkest secret.

Entries.Title: 20005 - A Livestream Experience for ‘Blush’
Entries.Description: BLUSH - A feeling of connection, and real-time communication, offering shared experiences that feel immediate and interactive. Hear songs from the new album. A digital celebration full of music, fan energy, and direct artist connection. Devan Manley as your MC. Love Spells as your spirit animal. Blush.

Entries.Description: A music video based on 'Ernie the fastest milkman in the west' by Benny Hill

Entries.Description: A lone survivor of the Mortuus Strain outbreak scavenges his new reality, narrowly escaping the infected casualties still walking the earth.

Entries.Title: Entitled Karen Insulted Her and got her Fired from her Job !!

Having no where to go, Joana with her only daughter, was forced to do the unthinkable. WATCH NOW: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C5kflWRCrvI

Entries.Title: Oh Be a Fine Girl Kiss Me
Entries.Description: A soul waits to be reincarnated while reflecting back on her past life as a nun, who worked at the Vatican Astronomical Observatory in early-20th century. There, she took part in the “Carte du Ciel” — an ambitious international project to map the night sky, earning the early title of “computer” as a result of processing repetitive calculations. Disillusioned with her previous existence, she considers becoming a coder in her next life, amidst the wave of economic optimism awaiting her reincarnation in 1990s Portugal. Shot on 16mm film and smartphone, "Oh Be a Fine Girl Kiss Me" blends historical fiction and autobiography in a meditation on life’s choices and constraints, as well as on the systems and categories that shaped modernity.

Entries.Title: AccepTance
Entries.Description: An experimental documentary looking at the transgender experience around the world over two hemispheres, three continents and with four interviewees. The film employs limited B roll shots or edits during the interviews, instead opting to have the interviews mostly uncut, with the goal of creating both a level of sincerity and a conversational narrative between any one of the interviewees and the audience.

Entries.Title: Mitthe Premer Golpo

Entries.Title: Our State
Entries.Description: 'Our State' is a sci-fi suspense thriller revolving around an anxious citizen whose monotonous life is interrupted by strange sounds in the midst of a nationwide lockdown.

Entries.Title: The Rejected Luna Is the Alpha
Entries.Description: Athena's world shatters after losing her pack and mate. A year later, she regains her powers and demands a divorce from Victor, who brings his lover Selene to claim Athena's pack. With Alpha King Cassian's help, Athena fights back. As Victor and Selene's wedding implodes, Athena exposes Selene's lies and alliance with vampires. After a fierce battle, Athena reclaims her honor, restores her legacy, and finds love again with Cassian.

Entries.Title: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband

Between steamy misunderstandings, family drama, and sweet chaos, love may just find its way—on and off the screen.

During his attempt for closure, Sean finds himself becoming overly-attached to his now-dead best friend's mother. After being romantically-rejected by her, Sean spirals down and finds himself in an ever-lasting manic episode.

Entries.Title: A SHOT IN THE FOOT
Entries.Description: A SHOT IN THE FOOT depects hectic nocturnal routines of a young woman who works as an assassin. She is a quick and innovative killer, efficient at her job. But she grows careless as she parties hard and gives in to the thrill of money, exposing herself to the dangers of LA’s underground. She gets sloppy, but the jobs keep coming, and there is no one except herself to clean up the mess she leaves behind.

Entries.Title: Age Group Winner
Entries.Description: In 1980 Jay Helgerson shocked the world, becoming the first person to run a marathon a week for a year – each race completed in under three hours. For the last ten years, his daughter, filmmaker Alexandra Helgerson, followed him with a camera in order to understand the eccentric man who raised her. What she gets are his projected anxieties, his struggles with physical age and emotional distress, all while he endlessly trains for the Boston Marathon. But as Jay trains, the film is nearly derailed by Alexandra’s encounter with a life threatening illness. Ultimately, AGE GROUP WINNER is an affirmation of the will to live.

Entries.Title: That Orchestra with the Broken Instruments
Entries.Description: A broken string, fractured echo chamber, rusting valves. 100 musicians meet for four days of rehearsals. They speak different languages. Their instruments are broken.

Entries.Title: Ollie, The King of Starr Park - Brawl Stars Animation
Entries.Description: Ollie is here!  Welcome to Brawl Stars Ollie!

Entries.Title: Kenji vs. Dark Lord Spike - Brawl Stars Animation
Entries.Description: A Brawl Stars animation.

Entries.Title: KARMA (IS A BITCH)
Entries.Description: Multiple tenants of a certain unit in an apartment building are haunted by a previous resident with a troubled past.

Entries.Title: Discount Doug
Entries.Description: When Douglas Buckles, aka Discount Doug, falters during his biggest job of the year, more than just his career is called into question.

Entries.Title: Berry
Entries.Description: Rebekah, a young girl occupied by her personal life and job, disregards a failing relationship with her grandmother, who she'll eventually have to feel the absence of and learn how to live without.

Entries.Title: Grima - Live at Hellfest 2025
Entries.Description: Grima plunged Hellfest into an icy torpor, draping festivalgoers in their atmospheric black metal. A performance carried by the dark melodies of the album Nightside, released in 2025.  Grima's music is as cold and fatal as the land where it was born: Siberia. Formed in 2014 around twin brothers Morbium and Vilhelm Sysoev, the band has since crafted a unique universe, fueled by pagan imagery and sounds that are both brutal and hypnotic.  Filmed on June 21, 2025, at the Hellfest Open Air Festival, Clisson.

Entries.Title: Our Precious Autumn
Entries.Description: Our Precious Autumn follows Ami, a young manga artist struggling with burnout. After several sleepless nights, she collapses and awakens in a dreamscape, facing three encounters that help her rediscover her reason for drawing.

Entries.Title: Woodwards
Entries.Description: A young woman struggles with living a life wherein her identity is still tied to the abuse she experienced as a child. One night, she falls victim to an episode triggered by her PTSD and is forced to confront her struggles through two strange but poignant interactions with strangers.

As The Time For TJ To Move Out Comes, The Boys Plan One More Movie Before One Of Them Leaves Forever. However, Things Go Awry When A Dark Figure From Their Past Threatens Everything. Can Spencer, Sean, TJ And Travis Save The Day One More Time With The Smallest Casualties possible? Hell Nah.

Entries.Title: They Call Him Mordecai
Entries.Description: Nez and Dr. Tam meet a mysterious contact. After some tense negotiations, and some foreboding warnings, they continue to prepare for their journey to Champ Island.

Entries.Title: L'Homme triste.
Entries.Description: This man is sad, he surely don't know why...

Entries.Title: Night in West Texas
Entries.Description: Forty years after a gay Apache man is framed for the brutal murder of a closeted Catholic priest, a police chief uncovers long-buried evidence that shakes up the small, oil-rich West Texas town that imprisoned him.

Entries.Title: Abans de la vida
Entries.Description: "What was there before life?" a child asks his mother. The answer is a story. A story the mother tells, illustrated with a series of beautiful and deliberately imperfect prints. And between its cracks, those of the landscapes and images, life emerges. After "They Only Thrown Away," Adrià Pagès and Pepa Catalá move into short form with a fable that is also an ode to motherhood.

Entries.Title: Escape From Your Sight
Entries.Description: A man makes a startling discovery while attempting to call his Mom

Entries.Title: it is now tomorrow
Entries.Description: The different ways a single Vietnamese mother loved her three daughters comes to fruition when Junie, the middle child, reunites with her sisters in their childhood home on their mother’s death anniversary.

Entries.Title: The Stained Bastions
Entries.Description: A song is played in reverse as we tour sepia-drenched abandoned buildings.

Entries.Title: ROGATKIN
Entries.Description: Mullet, no visor, fired up and spinning like a top. Nicholi Rogatkin is a rider like no other. His fearless approach and innovative tricks have redefined what is possible in mountain biking. Nicholi has been competing for over 20 years, and he's still on the rise. He's the ultimate hype man and a valuable energy source at slopestyle mountain biking events.

Entries.Title: Strands
Entries.Description: Husband finds out he's not the biggest fan of wife's shedding head, as he confronts her over and over, the strands of hair don't become fan of him.

Entries.Title: Catawamptiously Chawed Up
Entries.Description: A sheriff is faced with a difficult challenge after an outlaw moves into town

Entries.Title: Childish: A Me-umentary
Entries.Description: Watch a journey about Growing up, Nostalgia, and Toys. Learn about a kid who never wants to grow up. A kid who wanted, and still wants to make his mark on the world with his art. Whether it's Trains, Cars, Action Figures, or super hero's. Learn what it means to be... Childish.

Entries.Title: A Tired Dog is a Good Dog Parts 1 & 2
Entries.Description: One of Matthew Lax’s most personal works merges two complementary explorations of canine and human relationships. Drawing on his upbringing as a quadruplet in a dog-breeding family, the film weaves original footage with family archives to examine animal husbandry, canine behavior, and the human tendency to mimic dogs through kink. In its second phase, it expands its inquiry into pack behavior and the dynamics of dominance, submission, trust, and consent—both in human-dog relationships and within pup play. Love, bonding, and personal loss underpin the narrative as Lax reflects on his intimate connections with the dogs he has loved and lost.

Entries.Title: Ascending Beyond Shadows
Entries.Description: "Ascending Beyond Shadows:" is a documentary about rock climbing. This documentary follows Tristin as he uses rock climbing to deals with hardships in his life in a positive way through this hobby.

Entries.Title: the longest baseball game ever
Entries.Description: the longest baseball game in American history was a AAA game between the Pawtucket Red Sox and Rochester Red Wings. It lasted 33 innings and began in McCoy stadium, the night before Easter, April 18 1981.  But what actually happened that night? What keeps a man playing basball that long continuously? What happens when the game of baseball is stretched to its very limit?

Entries.Title: TIGUERONAS
Entries.Description: After ending an abusive relationship with her narcissistic boyfriend, Aaliyah and her friends hatch a bold plan for revenge on a girls’ night out, igniting a journey of self-empowerment and sisterhood.

Entries.Title: Litlle White Lies
Entries.Description: The head-over-heels teenager Janson pretends to be interested in romance novels to impress his bookworm crush Lucy.

Entries.Title: STRIKING
Entries.Description: Striking follows the main protagonist (Karter) as he turns a normal day into a wild adventure after escapes the clutches of some baristas, then as he stumbles his way onto a film set and encounters a passionate director who's word on set, is law.

Entries.Title: The Selkie
Entries.Description: A lighthouse keeper is awoken to the sound of women singing on the shore; a group of shape shifting creatures known as selkies have come to shore to dance under the full moon. He catches the eye of one of them on the beach, and they begin a passionate romance. After they are married, a series of increasingly disturbing events and the isolation of living at the lighthouse have The Selkie discomfited. When she becomes pregnant she begins to remember snippets of her old life in the sea, and realizes her husband is not the gentle man she presumed him to be.

Entries.Title: Egg Mama In "Carbon Cowboy"
Entries.Description: A dark, dank journey into the fetid alleyway of the fetish phantasm chicken soup soul. Starring everyone's favorite anthropomorphic egg Creep/Satanic doll maker, Egg Mama! Wherein Egg Mama encounters sordid sadists, disassociated divas, balding krautrock enthusiasts in bondage, yolky thugs and more! An accidental trip to an abandoned factory begets the ineffable cosmic cycle of life and death that our huevo heroine must tackle headfirst. Fun for the (w)hole family!

Entries.Title: Tainted Love
Entries.Description: A former couple are forced to work together one last time. As sparks  start to reignite, their mission turns into a deadly reckoning with the past.

Entries.Title: Get Fatter Now
Entries.Description: Aliens Nico, Gilly and Franny accidentally get involved in a hit and run involving loving father William Denning. Shenanigans ensue as they try to revive him while keeping the cops from suspecting them.

Entries.Title: Camp Baloney
Entries.Description: “Camp Baloney” is a raunchy, campy, over-the-top horror-comedy where camp counselors’ late-night escapades turn deadly as they are stalked by the Knob Goblin, a disfigured, vengeful worker transformed by a radioactive silicone accident in a dildo factory.

Entries.Title: Lavender Rot
Entries.Description: In 1953, two men grapple with their relationship's future as a mysterious presence lurks outside their motel room.

Entries.Title: Post Truth
Entries.Description: Post Truth is the first feature-length documentary generated entirely using artificial intelligence. It explores our relationship with technology and examines how we arrived at a world where truth and reality no longer matter. The film, documents an era of endless information overload and cultural dissonance, using the very language of the era it reflects. Self-reflexive by design, it invites viewers to critically reconsider their perception of reality.

Entries.Title: A Farewell to Francis
Entries.Description: As the world mourns Pope Francis, Mary Kennedy explores his journey from Argentina to the Vatican, examining the key themes that shaped his papacy.

Entries.Title: What A Day
Entries.Description: Adam has had a long day and wants to go home.

Entries.Title: The Monkey’s Paw
Entries.Description: Mr. White and his son Herbert are given an ancient deity that can grant 3 wishes, each having one consequence.

Entries.Title: Bron Lewis - Obviously
Entries.Description: Lewis is a natural storyteller, and ‘Obviously’ is packed to the brim with Bron’s hilarious anecdotes of times when she has found herself stumbling through moments of complete confusion with her fingers crossed and a smile on her face.  From joining a mother’s group and sitting next to the patchouli mum to being held hostage in Africa by a man with a plastic police badge, Bron is no stranger to pretending everything is under control. Because obviously it is.  Never shying away from an act-out, Lewis’ comedic physicality and formidable stage presence brings every story to life, and ‘Obviously’ will be an hour of laughter you don’t want to miss. Obviously.

Entries.Title: Marvin Beak
Entries.Description: Marvin Beak was the most precise hitman in the sky. A war veteran turned silent killer, he laid down his rifle for a quiet life in the city, with only one true friend — John Pork. But when Timmond Chese forged the Bubonic Blade and slaughtered John, Marvin came out of retirement.  Now framed for a crime he didn’t commit, hunted by governments and guilds alike, Marvin’s only way out is through. With nothing but a custom-built sniper rifle, a tattered photo of John, and rage burning in his hollow bones, Marvin is gunning through kingdoms to bring cheese to justice.

Entries.Title: GLARE
Entries.Description: An FBI agent rebelliously seeks revenge on his wife's killer.

Entries.Title: Backlash: The Murder of George Floyd
Entries.Description: Five years since the murder of George Floyd – the police killing that set America on fire with rage and sparked a wave of protests around the world, director Kwabena Oppong's film explores one of the most important and defining events in modern history.  Featuring ground-breaking interviews with members of George Floyd’s family, the Minneapolis Police Chief who took the bold step of testifying against one of his own officers, Boris Johnson’s advisor on race Samuel Kasumu, and Sal Naseem the former Regional Director for London at the IOPC, as well as cultural figures Che Lingo, Nathalie Emmanuel, broadcasters Andi and Miquita Oliver and Munya Chawawa.

Entries.Title: Wishbones & Cherry Tomatoes
Entries.Description: Anna gets invited to her childhood best friend’s wedding. She hesitates to go but wants to rebuild the friendship that she misses dearly. Yet only after revisiting their tradition of breaking a wishbone is she able to remember what the relationship means and they both put in the effort to reconnect.

Entries.Title: Racing the Storm
Entries.Description: Defending champions of the Master's league in the US Adventure Racing Nationals, team Odyssey sets out on the thirty hour race while facing ruthless weather conditions.

Entries.Title: I cannot seem to remember
Entries.Description: In a phantasmagoric landscape of beauty and catastrophe, an amnesiac's dream is realized through mid-century found celluloid.

Entries.Title: Trail Mix
Entries.Description: A 2,000-mile journey from Georgia to Maine, which uncovers the personal struggles and healing of hikers seeking solace, purpose, & transformation. The film reveals how nature becomes a powerful path back to wholeness.

Entries.Title: Hitman²
Entries.Description: Joe Pottery, Sh-t. sh-t. sh-t.

Entries.Title: The Prospect
Entries.Description: When high school senior Jerry Vanetti gets rejected from every college he applied to, he hatches a plan to pose as an elite baseball prospect in order to trick a school into giving him an athletic scholarship…despite the fact that he’s never played a sport in his life.

Entries.Title: Curfew: Sins of the Father
Entries.Description: Former police captain Thomas Cooper, once a respected figure, finds himself entangled in a dangerous deal with a notorious crime boss. His involvement leads to a love triangle and ultimately a betrayal. Now, haunted by his past, Thomas must confront the consequences when his son, Christian, becomes a target of the crime boss's revenge.

Entries.Title: Night
Entries.Description: A short film about being lost at night.

Entries.Title: Friend of the Year
Entries.Description: When high school senior Julia brings her new friend Naya to a party, she’s quickly sidelined as Naya falls into the spotlight—forcing Julia to confront jealousy, betrayal, and a harrowing moment that changes everything.

Entries.Title: Brothers After War
Entries.Description: Jake Rademacher reconnects with his brothers and soldiers he embedded with in Iraq. He creates a unique “then and now” journey into the toll of war and a never before seen look at war fighters and the veterans they become.

Entries.Title: KARAPATAN
Entries.Description: In a school, a quiet one is always bullied  student A classmate of his suddenly showed kindness,  but because of this, he also started to be laughed at and judged by  others, because of the wrong story that will destroy his classmate. Therefore  his classmate was angry with him (bully).

Entries.Title: Is Someone There?
Entries.Description: A lonely man late one night suddenly receives phone calls from strangers. Some of them eerily warning him to stay in the light and another taunting him about someone coming to take him away. He at first dismisses these stranger's warnings but as the night and the calls relentlessly continue, his apartment lights begin to go out, one by one.

Entries.Title: The Green Impact
Entries.Description: A frustrated young man, who suffers from alcohol addiction finds an abandoned plant on a sidewalk. He starts to take care after the plant and without realising, after himself too.

Entries.Title: Money For Will
Entries.Description: A manipulative bookie goes double or nothing with the murderous gambler who holds him hostage.

Entries.Title: Motion Pictures are Your Best Entertainment
Entries.Description: Television was invented as a result of scientific and technical research. Its power as a medium of news and entertainment altered all preceding media of news and entertainment

Entries.Title: Little Frog Man
Entries.Description: The absurd story of an appropriately named little frog man and the path of havoc he leaves behind him. Watch as his shenanigans catch up to him in Little Frog Man.

Entries.Title: Soul of a Nation
Entries.Description: Soul of a Nation is an inspiring and eye-opening film that delves into Israel's most perilous chapter in recent history-a period defined by profound internal divisions, political unrest, and external threats that pushed the nation to the brink of collapse.

Entries.Title: Verónica
Entries.Description: In the midst of gender transition, Verónica runs away from home in search of a new beginning and finds refuge with her cousin Alex. As she navigates her new life, actress Israel, who plays Verónica, faces her own personal journey during filming.

Entries.Title: Home Again
Entries.Description: Rolland, a 70 year-old man, exiled by his family due to his sexual orientation, makes peace with the past by finding himself in a small ghost town in the western part of Jalisco, San Sebastián del Oeste. Almost 40 years later, he wants to go back to his hometown, try to regain his daughter's love and be a part o his granddaughter's life.

Entries.Title: DEMO
Entries.Description: Zach and Tyler, two minimum wage workers for the Department of Energy and Matter Organization, embark on a mission to save the Universe when their outdated equipment rips a hole in time-space. Before the end of the day, they must set everything right or risk Universal destruction in a reverse Big Bang.

Entries.Title: Bleak Week
Entries.Description: Seven vignettes showing a week in Texas.

Entries.Title: Summer Hit Machine
Entries.Description: A boogie-punk band’s quest to record a cult hit spirals into surreal chaos as their label boss battles ghostly Elvis visions, a scheming alter ego, and a fame-obsessed team bent on sabotage.

Entries.Title: A Second Goodbye
Entries.Description: An unexpected school call pulls Janet into a tumbling afternoon with her eight-year-old stepdaughter, Charlotte—one that gently deepens their bond despite the tensions of blended family life.

Entries.Title: A Tale from the Wastelands
Entries.Description: On a dystopian world where the goverment has turned beautiful lands into soulless wastelands, Colt, a lonely ranger in search of redeeming himself, goes to an abandoned farm to put an end to all of his internal suffering, encountering an old figure of his past that'll confront him til' they face each other on the arena.

Entries.Title: Almost
Entries.Description: In a dimly lit apartment, two people exist in a world of half-lit gestures and unspoken desire. Touch is fleeting, hesitance lingers, and the space between them is charged with longing.

Entries.Title: Black Cats
Entries.Description: Black Cats is a grounded and realistic superhero movie that delves into the struggles faced by everyday Americans and the broader human family. Set in Chicago, the film follows a group of determined locals, known as the "Black Cats," who unite to take on corruption at every level-within government, corporations, politics, and even street gangs.

Entries.Title: This Land
Entries.Description: In 1974 a group of Mohawk Indians occupied a defunct girls camp in New York's Adirondack mountains and established a community they called Ganienkeh. Aiming to practice a more traditional lifestyle, and asserting aboriginal title to the land, they stayed for three years, having occasional violent clashes with the local residents. In 1977 they negotiated a (somewhat complicated) land swap with the State, and agreed to move to a permanent home near Plattsburgh, New York, where they remain today. Ganienkeh is one of the only examples of an indigenous people successfully reclaiming land from the United States, but it may not be the last.

Entries.Title: Tragedy
Entries.Description: Mick meets a girl who changes his life.....but not in the way he thinks. A sequel to Meadows' "14".

Entries.Title: Whole
Entries.Description: A sex doll learns what it means to be a woman and how to become whole.

Entries.Title: Black Box
Entries.Description: In the 1960s, a village in Java held a tradition they firmly believed in: the blessings of the land and its harvest depended on a sacrifice chosen fairly and lawfully by the black box. Each head of a household would draw a slip of paper, and the tension rose as one name was revealed. When night fell, the sound of gamelan and the chanting of prayers echoed through the village. There was no denial, no hesitation, for the black box had already decided who must be sacrificed.

Entries.Title: 25 questions to understand yourself
Entries.Description: A poem about personality, love and most importantly you. Written and directed by the poet and videographer illneas.

Entries.Title: Forest Haven
Entries.Description: A young woman is given a mission by the spirit of her dead brother to save the life of another and free his soul.

Entries.Title: Ugly Kid Joe: Live at Wacken Open Air 2025
Entries.Description: Ugly Kid Joe are living proof that humor and heavy rock go together wonderfully. With their mix of hard rock, metal, and funk, the Californians created a sound in the early 90s that turned "Everything About You" and their cover version of "Cats in the Cradle" into international hits. They loved poking fun at convention while simultaneously celebrating the great guitar solo. After a few years off, the band returned in 2010 and has since demonstrated that their blend of groove, melodic vocals, and ironic self-irony is timeless. On stage, Ugly Kid Joe come across as a fun-loving gang, celebrating a loud, sweaty party with their audience, and that's exactly what we expect for Wacken 2025.

Entries.Title: Carnipellis
Entries.Description: After exposure to contaminated water, Juniper’s body begins attacking her from within.

Entries.Title: Help Is on the Way
Entries.Description: Maintenance-bot CALUM learns to help someone in need despite his original programming.

Entries.Title: Hand
Entries.Description: A man experiences a psychotic break and secludes himself in the woods with his inanimate lover.

Entries.Title: Thirsty Thursday
Entries.Description: Desperately needing a break from bombed midterms and the confusion of the Valentine's Day season, three best friends decide to go out on the infamously named “Thirsty Thursday." But when their drinks become too much to handle, they're forced to confront the problems they are trying to escape in a blackout that tests their friendship and the dangers of letting loose at a frat party.

Entries.Title: You Sick Fuck
Entries.Description: You Sick Fuck is a documentary about local deathmatch wrestling. It details the hard work and passion behind the wrestlers and organizers of UWF and WTW, two local wrestling organizations. This film is a near 4 hour long age restricted messy fun experience, with many matches and interviews with amazing athletes. ENJOY!

Entries.Title: The 64th Square
Entries.Description: An intense chess match between two men who become increasingly judgmental on the inside.

Entries.Title: SK8 SP25
Entries.Description: One day skateboarding with Kevin, through the streets of São Paulo.

Entries.Title: Greatest Fear
Entries.Description: Norman gets called to his bosses office where he is asked something important

Entries.Title: Al Coda
Entries.Description: A student at a prestigious music academy struggles to recreate a piece of sheet music stolen by an egocentric professor. After given just 2 hours to complete this task, he experiences the highs and lows of this process as it alters the way he thinks about the creation of art itself.

Entries.Title: Mike and Dave and Ingrid Goes West
Entries.Description: Alex, Rodda and Sean return for more silliness. This time, with a film society in tow in the sequel to the award winning Mike & Dave Need Quinnie Dates!

Entries.Title: Shotgun Baby
Entries.Description: A personal documentary questioning the ways in which family imposed narratives force us into roles that we spend our lives either rebelling against or conforming to.

Entries.Title: The Breakfast Betrayal
Entries.Description: Detective Benjamin Rook investigates the murder by muffin of a rich business man.

Entries.Title: Mosh
Entries.Description: Desperate to reconnect with his teenage son, Otto takes Lobo to a concert for his birthday, hoping for a night that will bring them closer. But as plans fall apart, Otto finds himself forced to confront the real barrier between them: his own unresolved struggles and the uncertain future of their family.

Entries.Title: First Light
Entries.Description: Thirty-six layers of water aligned to create a perfect circle. 1 of 2

Entries.Title: Armis
Entries.Description: When Venus send an attack for Cupid and his wife, Mars must talk to Venus about the consequences of her actions.

Entries.Title: Ghost out the campground
Entries.Description: Three girls. One's it. The rest will hide. Simple as can be. DON'T. GET. CAUGHT.

Entries.Title: Stride
Entries.Description: A high school varsity runner must reconsider his professional aspirations when a hereditary medical condition creates complications.

Entries.Title: Dirty Sole
Entries.Description: After being accessories to murder, a pair of brand new sneakers must traverse New York City without getting dirty, or they’ll face the same fate as their predecessors.

Entries.Title: Retro Rampage: Dance Of '82
Entries.Description: When bitter science teacher Dr. John Bazil unleashes a zombie invasion at prom, teen Robbie Ross must save his classmates—and the entire high school—before the night turns undead forever.

Entries.Title: Files of Lars
Entries.Description: Short film music video made up of character vignettes each set to a different song. Files of Lars marks the debut of Payton Talbott's original music, blending visuals and sound through chaotic scenes that drift between masked characters with fleeting connections.

Entries.Title: Saint James
Entries.Description: In the aftermath of a failed suicide attempt, a young man becomes obsessed with becoming a sailor.

Entries.Title: Style: A Seattle Basketball Story
Entries.Description: The untold, storied history behind one of America's most elite youth basketball programs and its humble beginnings in Seattle's Central District.

Entries.Title: Passion
Entries.Description: A woman stands to watch a film and is moved to tears by its message.

Entries.Title: Spectrum Syndicate
Entries.Description: In the fictional country of Magorigan, where autistic people have just been segregated from society and the workplace, a creative autistic individual named Sora Altair must join a group of special secret agents to save the world from a bomb.

Entries.Title: Good Time Charlie
Entries.Description: Ben Sinclair stars as Charlie, a middle-aged country rocker turned real estate agent who clings to his dreams of stardom in the California desert. When he is asked to show a listing at an abandoned homestead deep in the Mojave, a mysterious encounter leaves him bitten and bewildered, forcing him to confront the reality of his dreams.

Entries.Title: Underwater Speculations
Entries.Description: A retired cynical actuary reconnects with his granddaughter, a naive and detached artist, to retrieve his savings that were stolen from his locker. She's completely unaware that the video-art she's making on the pool is a cover for a detective investigation. Together they'll realize that Above the water is not what lies beneath. "The Pool" is a Woody Allen style comedy, with a tone of absurdity as in "The Manhattan Murder Mystery" and a sense of rhythm and style of "Snatch".

Entries.Title: Dog Hair Sticks to Everything
Entries.Description: A touching story about finding permanence in impermanence, and how the love of a pet can transform and anchor one's life.

Entries.Title: Batman: The Owl's Hollow
Entries.Description: A Batman fan film set after the events of Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths (2010) created by LampLeg and released on YouTube.

Entries.Title: Subhuman Services
Entries.Description: A reflection on personal and systemic failures woven into an analysis of The Department of Human Services hold music utilizing archival footage of Jimmy Buffet, Duran Duran, Steely Dan, Paula Cole, late night cable erotica, and more.

Entries.Title: Lord, Forgive Me
Entries.Description: A movie about making a movie.

Entries.Title: AngryGynoPhiles
Entries.Description: A documentary about the Kent-based queercore band AngryGynoPhiles, documenting their band practices leading up to their first gig.

Entries.Title: Campfire Stories
Entries.Description: A group of teenagers gathers around the fire to tell some scary stories.

Entries.Title: Meeting My Grandad
Entries.Description: Elliott, a lonely young man with no family, learns of a deceased grandfather he never knew. Feeling robbed of such a connection, he decides to hire an actor, Frank, to play the role of his Grandad in his daily life.

Entries.Title: PISS: The Movie
Entries.Description: A behind the scenes look at the biggest names in bathroom acapella you’ve never heard of...yet

Entries.Title: World of Dogs
Entries.Description: Follows a young aspiring singer who enters an isolating relationship with a man who violently robs her of her sacred voice, leaving her scarred and silenced.

Entries.Title: The Invalids
Entries.Description: In a dystopian future where disability is exploited for sport, two disabled women wake up trapped in a brutal competition - to survive, they must outwit a system built to erase them.

Entries.Title: Kaatrukku Traffic Signal illai
Entries.Description: Composed, written, and passionately performed by Ashoksaravanan and his team, Kaatrukku Traffic Signal illai "காற்றுக்கு டிராஃபிக் சிக்னல் இல்லை..." is a thunderous tribute to the bravery, sacrifice, and indomitable spirit of India’s soldiers. The song’s title metaphorically declares that just like the wind cannot be stopped by traffic signals, a warrior’s courage knows no limits.  With powerful vocals, stirring lyrics, and an energetic composition, the song paints the life of a soldier as an epic saga of heroism—where the sky becomes their path, the earth their camp, and their uniform’s stars narrate untold tales of freedom. From the freezing Himalayas to the scorching deserts, the lyrics honor their unyielding vigilance, comparing them to eagles in the sky, tigers in battle, and volcanoes of unshakable resolve.

Entries.Title: Who Killed Shireen?
Entries.Description: Zeteo is proud to present an original documentary investigating who killed acclaimed journalist Shireen Abu Akleh in 2022, the first Palestinian-American journalist to be shot dead by Israeli forces in the Occupied West Bank.

Entries.Title: The Phalanx
Entries.Description: Letters from the Ceresco community trace the fragility of harmony, the dream of life in association. Members of the phalanx drift apart, lingering in private corners, suspended in speculative time.

Entries.Title: Capsule
Entries.Description: Former party animals return to their hometown for a class reunion, only to find their wacky antics haven't died out.

Entries.Title: Velella Velella
Entries.Description: A cameraless film in the tradition of Stan Brakhage's "Mothlight," which takes celluloid as the medium for an encounter between the moving-image, and the materiality of San Diego's shoreline ecosystems.

Entries.Title: Rancho Battle 1.0 - Vila do Conde
Entries.Description: The Sanjoan folklore groups of Vila do Conde – Rancho do Monte and Rancho da Praça – tell their stories, traditions and, above all, rivalries, in a very contemporary and unusual way: through a ranch battle.

Entries.Title: At See
Entries.Description: A group of visually impaired travelers navigate a commercial cruise ship with the help of their guide dogs.

Entries.Title: The Family Dinner
Entries.Description: One night, One house, Eight deaths.  Sarah, mother to seven, plans to spend her relaxing evening like always. Cooking. Cleaning. All for those ungrateful brats. Her whole world shifts upside down when a single argument leads to the love of her life. Now how will she cover up the growing death tally?

Entries.Title: Retreat Into the Swamp
Entries.Description: Retreat Into the Swamp is an independent, experimental animation documenting the slow collapse of a stump into a swamp. By combining LiDAR scans of the stump taken over the course of a year with analog animation techniques, the film creates an assemblage of both documentary evidence and a translated, subjective experience of decay.

Entries.Title: Joe List: This is Gold Folks
Entries.Description: Here’s a compilation from 5 hot shows in Atlanta of the riffs, goofs and whacky moments

Entries.Title: The Slave in Your Backyard: The Local Reality of Human Trafficking
Entries.Description: The Slave in Your Backyard exposes the hidden reality of human trafficking in everyday communities. Featuring survivor Heather Pagán and former trafficker Bruce, this documentary sheds light on the fight to end trafficking.

Entries.Title: The Lost Child
Entries.Description: In the forests of Fobbia, Claudio spends his days obsessively carving wood. Years earlier, his son disappeared in those same woods. The only thing of him left was the red shirt he was wearing, found under a pine tree. Ever since then, Claudio has been felling trees and carving them, convinced that his son must hide in there somewhere. Between truth and fantasy, Claudio’s story is intertwined with the tale of Pinocchio, here turned upside down.

Entries.Title: Renewal of Man
Entries.Description: After a harsh breakup a confused teenager Michael discovers what it is to be a man in 2025

Entries.Title: Beartooth - I Was A... LIVE
Entries.Description: “I Was A... LIVE", Recorded and Filmed on January 18th, 2025 at The Schottenstein Center in Columbus, OH

Entries.Title: Venus
Entries.Description: Amid a missing persons investigation in the mod scene of 1965, an eccentric Catholic schoolgirl's downward spiral leaves her best friend grappling with haunting guilt and unearthed secrets.

Entries.Title: Not your valentine
Entries.Description: Not your valentine is a short story with interweaving narratives of two thieves trying to escape a robbery gone wrong and a couple fighting on valentines day, this was scripted, shot and edited in 3 hours

Entries.Title: High Lonesome Plains: A Hayden Pedigo Documentary
Entries.Description: High Lonesome Plains is about Hayden Pedigo - a musician, performance artist, politician and model from Amarillo, Texas. Homeschooled from an early age, Hayden found community and inspiration in avant-garde music and art online as a teenager. Influenced by figures like performance artist Chris Burden, guitarist John Fahey, and director Harmony Korine, Hayden’s persona often blurs the lines between reality and performance.  In his directorial debut, photographer Bob Foster channels his fascination with Americana, people and place, combining Bruna Manfredi’s sensitive editing with an atmospheric soundtrack of Hayden's music to capture a journey of artistry and identity, shaped by the landscapes of the Texas Panhandle.

Entries.Title: YOU'RE MY MATE.
Entries.Description: After destroying his best friend’s rehearsal dinner, a man in shambles races to gain control of his life in time for the wedding.

Entries.Title: White Box
Entries.Description: The Boy and the White Box

Entries.Title: SCRATCH THAT!
Entries.Description: Performed by the Royal Exchange Young Company; We follow a group of college kids who create a generative AI company within the winnings of a single lottery ticket. In their adulthood, they realise the devastating impact their company causes has on their environment.

Entries.Title: A ROOFTOP
Entries.Description: Rooftop is a 1-minute experimental short film that captures the final summer night of a young boy as he confronts the silence before his suicide. Set entirely on a rooftop, the film explores themes of isolation, emotional stillness, and the quiet unraveling of the human spirit. Through minimal dialogue and expressive visuals, Rooftop offers a poignant meditation on fleeting time and internal struggle.  Starring Kamran Ahmad and directed by Hosh-e-Ruba (Kamran Ahmad) and Khwaabgari (Khizer Zaman), with story by Khwaabgari, the film is set to Max Richter’s haunting composition On the Nature of Daylight.

Entries.Title: Abysse
Entries.Description: Félix is ​​Matthieu's childhood friend; he has returned to the Bordeaux region so they can spend the summer together. However, one evening, Matthieu disappears, and Félix will never see him again. Félix then sinks into incomprehension and silence, on a senseless quest to regain this stolen friendship.

Entries.Title: The Spectacular Spider-Man - Fan Film
Entries.Description: Peter Parker is torn between his responsibilities as Spider-Man and the personal life he’s constantly forced to sacrifice. In this emotionally driven fan film, witness a reimagined origin of Electro, and explore the cost of being a hero when the mask begins to consume the man beneath it.

Entries.Title: Ku Utuskan Duka Lara
Entries.Description: A woman tries to rekindles her love to a man who lost his love to cinema

Entries.Title: Chiasm of Lament II
Entries.Description: Chiasm of Lament is an audio-visual response to the transitory and transformational age we find ourselves in, where technology and generative information has been given spiritual and existential power. The title refers to crossing of paths that are melancholic in nature, a sphere of ambiguous transactions and embodied transformations that move in alternate or opposing directions.

Entries.Title: Barm 2: Barmed and Dangerous
Entries.Description: BARM learns the meaning of love when garm is kidnapped by the evil Mr. Ab. A story about a family coming together and learning how to love.

Entries.Title: Forget-Me-Not
Entries.Description: A group of literary charcaters refuse to be forgotten and decide to take matters into their own hands. A whimsical look at literature and the power of story.

Entries.Title: Malignant Practice
Entries.Description: MALIGNANT PRACTICE is an animated short film based on the medical misfortune of a young woman whose breast cancer was missed by a doctor and a mammogram. This true story emphasizes the flaws within our healthcare system and the importance of being one’s own healthcare advocate.

Entries.Title: Floor Jansen Live at Wacken '25
Entries.Description: When Floor Jansen takes the stage, that rare moment of absolute presence arises. Tension fills the air even before the first note is played. Known as the exceptional voice of Nightwish, she has cemented a firm place in the music world outside of the band with her solo debut "Paragon" and songs like "Fire" and "Storm." Her voice combines power and grace, opera and rock, vulnerability and determination; it is an instrument that transforms emotions into sound and then back into emotions. Those who experience her live immediately sense that this isn't just a singer, but an entire story unfolding in music. Her setlist includes tracks by Nightwish and After Forever.  Setlist: Wolf and Dog, ⁠Noise, ⁠Invincible, ⁠Storm, ⁠Spider Silk, ⁠Amaranth, ⁠Energize Me, ⁠7 Days to the Wolves, While Love Died, ⁠Face Your Demons, ⁠Nemo, ⁠Fire.

Entries.Title: Nacre
Entries.Description: When presented as a sacrifice to an elusive sea monster, Maggie must find her strength or be condemned to a dreadful fate.

Entries.Title: Improvements
Entries.Description: Alice learned from her Dad.  The first rule of renovation is to start small: Pick one room and move out from there. Make lists. Check them off. Begin again.

Entries.Title: Fate vs. Elena
Entries.Description: Fate vs. Elena is the story of a jaded millennial psychic who doesn’t believe in fate until a premonition turns her life upside down….

Entries.Title: Rojo Žalia Blau
Entries.Description: A companion piece to her stunning NYC RGB (TIFF ’23), with Rojo Žalia Blau, Austrian artist Viktoria Schmid employs the principles of three-strip Technicolor to recast natural landscapes in Spain, Lithuania, and Austria in a dazzling play of colour and shadow.

Entries.Title: The Ballad of Cory Ligouri
Entries.Description: Cory Liguori (a money obsessed young man) has luck with Jimmy Blackbeards pirate coin and suddenly becomes extremely wealthy. In the process of gaining all this wealth, Cory ignores and thus enraging Ian (Cory's best friend) pushing him to his breaking point...

Entries.Title: Spooners
Entries.Description: Lydia, dreaming of a "Prince Charming," grapples with adulthood and loneliness, ultimately connecting with Matt, who offers paid hugs.

Entries.Title: Bullshark Showdown
Entries.Description: American bull sharks throw down with Ozzie bulls in a wild competition to determine which one is superior. Paul De Gelder provokes his Australia bulls to perform against Craig O'Connell and Florida's fiercest bull sharks.

Entries.Title: Goodbye, Charlie
Entries.Description: With his brother's ghost still lingering, Benny must confront the depths of his grief and find a way to move forward without leaving his brother behind.

Entries.Title: tiK ToKk is Cinema History5
Entries.Description: An experimental short film to show more of the public how not only is Tiktok (Pre ban/control from the US government) cinema but it will be apart of cinema history, and future.

Entries.Title: DE4TH DRIVE
Entries.Description: After a celebratory drink goes wrong, Looney accidentally kills the lead singer of his band. He must pull his bandmates into a cover-up before it is too late.

Entries.Title: Biombo: VAMPIREO (Pilot)
Entries.Description: In a hot day of summer, the Unresolved Bizarre Investigations (UNBI), are on a chase to stop the vampire criminal: El Conde Kelvin across Old San Juan, Puerto Rico.

Entries.Title: Paperback
Entries.Description: Diane, a total introvert, is obsessed with lurid crime-romance paperbacks, longing for passionate, dangerous love to sweep her off her feet. One day, she gets her wish when Razor appears—a tattooed, cigarette-smoking butch who seems like she walked off the pages of one of her novels. Soon, Diane must decide whether she really wants her fantasies to become reality.

Entries.Title: Waltz With Luna
Entries.Description: A young woman re-lives her past relationship through a series of silhouettes in the night's sky.

Entries.Title: Ender
Entries.Description: Documented through the lens of his best friend’s DV camera, a skater grapples with life and mental health in the interior and exterior.

Entries.Title: The Sycamore
Entries.Description: Two weary travellers seek out shade and sustenance from an idle tree. Based on the fable, "The Travellers and the Plane Tree" by Aesop.

Entries.Title: Bheegi Billy
Entries.Description: Not-so-good detective Nirmal Narayan and his apprentice Avi find two clients, who don't know each other but happen to be looking for the same missing cat.

Entries.Title: Schwanensee
Entries.Description: Short film about a lake.

Entries.Title: This Time Together
Entries.Description: A documentary film celebrating 25 years of a life-changing arts camp in New Hampshire called Creative Arts at Keene.

Entries.Title: Red Buckets
Entries.Description: A child’s failure leads to a deeper understanding, maybe

Entries.Title: CI: A Biography of Light
Entries.Description: An epistolary look into the daily ecology of Coney Island by one of it's many residents.

Entries.Title: 52525.mp4
Entries.Description: When a housemate is accidentally awake at 5:25am on 5/25/25, and unfortunate series of events occur.

Entries.Title: 73 Procent
Entries.Description: Journalist Max Arian retells his experience as a survivor of the Holocaust in the Netherlands while contemplating on why more Jewish people were deported from the Netherlands than from any other Western European nation.

Entries.Title: El Sofa
Entries.Description: Working at a porn cinema isn't as exciting as it seems. Go behind the curtain of El Sofa in Benidorm, Spain, and learn the ins and outs of the business.

Entries.Title: Samar
Entries.Description: Lost in the blur of becoming, a soul learns that what fades is not always gone, but merely waiting to be seen anew.

Entries.Title: Time's Arrow
Entries.Description: A tentative teenager, entering her formative years is confronted with her own sense of mortality when faced with an otherworldly time warp.

Entries.Title: Playing the Palace
Entries.Description: A star-studded look at Broadway’s iconic Palace theater and its 30-ft rise above Times Square. Hosted by Frank DiLella, it features the team behind the lift and Broadway legends like Joel Grey, Bernadette Peters, Heather Headley, and more.

Entries.Title: It's Not Me, It's You
Entries.Description: A couple's dark fantasties about one another play out during an awkward date.

Entries.Title: Limerence
Entries.Description: Love, lust, and hate. All it takes is one action, person, place. When reality and delusion bleed into the other, an obsessive and all-consuming desire for reciprocated affection starts to redefine you.

Entries.Title: Songbird
Entries.Description: A jazz singer’s powerful voice and revolutionary lyrics capture the hearts of 1930’s Harlem, but also, the attention of the FBI.

Entries.Title: Gnomed
Entries.Description: Awoken to find himself turned into a garden gnome, Nate must retrace his steps to find out what happened last night.

Entries.Title: tiK ToKk is Cinema History3
Entries.Description: An experimental short film to show more of the public how not only is Tiktok (Pre ban/control from the US government) cinema but it will be apart of cinema history, and future.

Entries.Title: L'Empreinte
Entries.Description: The plot is unkown at this time.

Entries.Title: Where We Once Roamed
Entries.Description: After re-releasing free-roaming buffalo to their native lands after centuries of absence, the Blackfeet Nation has set off on an unprecedented path towards cultural and spiritual renewal of their people, the land, and the buffalo species. Through Ethan Running Crane and Ervin Carlson’s eyes, we understand the hard work that each generation is undertaking to restore this sacred animal.

Entries.Title: 8 BUCKS TYCOON
Entries.Description: When down-and-out painter Li receives a magical magic wallet, he went from living in embarrassment to becoming rich overnight, and instantly stepped into a luxurious world of wealth.

Entries.Title: Dear Jane,
Entries.Description: Isolated in his fallout pod within Zone FF, days blend together as Thomas longs for any contact with the outside world, until he "meets" Jane.

Entries.Title: Harriet
Entries.Description: The moment, at the end of life, when the soul is ripped from the human body. (3/3)

Entries.Title: Leaving Channel 2
Entries.Description: When CEO John Anderson receives a mysterious invitation from a new intern at his office, his daily grind is disrupted by the discovery of something cosmic

Entries.Title: Paradise
Entries.Description: PARADISE follows an iconic mountain man, Joe Hollis, who has lived off the grid for fifty years at the foot of the highest mountains in the East. Creating what he calls a "paradise garden", his land boasts over a thousand different species including many that can't be found anywhere else in the country. As health problems arise, Joe struggles to ensure his land and legacy survive into the future.

Entries.Title: BOBCBC
Entries.Description: A meditation on time, process, and the evolving role of video in skateboarding. Filmed entirely at Toronto's Simcoe Park (Sept. 13 - Nov. 25, 2024), it tracks Bobby de Keyzer lost in the timeline. Shot by Tomas Morrison with original music by Barrett Avner, this quasi production contemplates the value of skate videos in an era where documentation is both disposable and timeless.

Entries.Title: The Consequences of Carelessness
Entries.Description: When two friends (Ted and Paul) accidentally overdose their buddy during a reckless day of partying, they scramble to cover their tracks and hide the body. In a desperate bid for help, they turn to their dangerous drug supplier (Vincent), only to find themselves ensnared in a web of chaos that forces them to confront the true cost of their choices.

Entries.Title: Beneath the Scar: A Story of Resilience
Entries.Description: A raw, gripping documentary on Deuntay Diggs' journey from hardship to triumph, tackling abuse, faith, love, sexuality, and race.

Entries.Title: ERASED
Entries.Description: A thought-provoking dystopian short film, “ERASED” follows a woman trapped in a world under constant surveillance, where silence is LAW and even the smallest act of resistance could COST her everything.

Entries.Title: Shalabham
Entries.Description: A struggling artist going through a creative block rendering his mind void of inspiration.

Entries.Title: Evolution by morphing selection
Entries.Description: A shape-shifting alien crash-lands on Earth and explores the different forms of life across many ages. But after a meteor strikes and buries it for millions of years, it awakens to a world it doesn't recognize. Now it must navigate a future full of new dangers, so unlike anything it once knew.

Entries.Title: The Wait
Entries.Description: A student rushes to collect an important package.

Entries.Title: White Gardenia's John Calvin and Other Excerpts From The King James Bible
Entries.Description: White Gardenia's John Calvin and Other Excerpts From the King James Bible features selections from the underground horror project "White Gardenia: The King James Bible" (from the filmmakers/ creators behind "A Dream of Virtual Perfume In the House of Chanel"). Featuring segments and contributions from Daniel Valient, Vivian Kay Quintero, CoffinBirth, Marian Dora, Blucifer, Brock Bones, Christian Michelsen, Nathanael Johns, Sierra Gallagher, Bridger Tone, Bill Cate, Peter Lankston, Shio Motarasu Mono, Wayne Coyne, Jacob B Green, Daniel Zander, and Cory DeAn Cowley.

Entries.Title: Final Pill
Entries.Description: When the end of the world is near, a couple argue over the last prescribed suicide pill.

Entries.Title: She Walks At Midnight
Entries.Description: Five years after a tragic accident took his wife’s life, Mark Cohen has shut himself off from the world. Concerned for his well-being, his family pushes him to find an outlet, leading him to late-night drives on empty roads. Just as he starts to feel at peace, a figure from his past that he’s too familiar with crosses his path, sending his grieving process spiraling into mass paranoia. As reality and his memories begin to blur together, Mark’s mourning shifts into a psychological nightmare.

Entries.Title: LAMBS
Entries.Description: In a desolate world, the struggle for survival and supremacy reign. As two inhabitants sit bound and gagged at the gape of a dark and ominous tunnel, they are under the control of Salem. She sends them forward to peer into the eyes of their destiny and to meet their eternal fate.

Entries.Title: The Fight
Entries.Description: A young Boy and his sister come face to face with the thing that he is fearing the most

Entries.Title: Eurydice in the Underworld
Entries.Description: Restaging Kathy Acker’s volume of the same name, this 16mm essay renders scanned landscapes and burning light leaks to contemplate the social isolation, psychosexual crisis, and interior reckoning precipitated by terminal breast cancer.

Entries.Title: The Full Fungus
Entries.Description: Embattled LA private eye Chino Diamond is hired to track down Wilt, a mysterious man on the run with a set of fabled jazz tapes from late jazz legend Mink Fungus. As Chino navigates the seedy underbelly of Los Angeles, he finds himself dodging the ruthless henchmen of Koviak, a powerful mobster who wants the tapes for his own sinister plans. From dive bars to back-alley sushi joints, this animated noir romp blends wild characters, dry humor, and unexpected twists through a city as strange as its inhabitants.

Entries.Title: Fragmented
Entries.Description: From the shores of Malta, a pioneering journalist from Gaza, Qassem, contemplates his experiences as a political prisoner and his painful decision to leave his homeland.

Entries.Title: Clara's Fruit
Entries.Description: A principal lovingly reflects on the 90-year legacy of Mohammed Schools of Atlanta, the first Muslim private school system in the country.

Entries.Title: Densho
Entries.Description: Electronic artist Shigeto explores his family’s history and the lasting effects of WWII internment, weaving together personal reflections, archival footage, and music.
