Through conversations with his mother and grandmother, he uncovers how their shared past and cultural heritage have shaped his identity, resilience, and artistry.

Entries.Title: RealitiQ
Entries.Description: A patron travels through an absurdly abstract experience as they slowly progress through the queue of a movie theater.

Entries.Title: Sight Gag
Entries.Description: SEEING IS BELIEVING

Entries.Title: The Beerio Kart Wii Invitational Tournament
Entries.Description: A group of twenty something college students get together to get hammered while playing a children's video game on a live broadcast

Entries.Title: Dumb Rich Sluts
Entries.Description: Patty and Sandra have the perfect Los Angeles day planned but when they're suddenly phone-less, they have to rely on their wits to navigate the City of Angels and make it to their appointment with neighborhood-renowned psychic, Mrs. Ynez.

Entries.Title: The Wanted Part I
Entries.Description: Two brothers, Owen and Ethan Carter, thought they had their lives figured out. Owen is on the verge of adulthood—ready to graduate high school and head off to college. Ethan, just thirteen, is preparing for the start of his middle school journey. But their plans come crashing down when they are falsely accused of a brutal murder that shakes their small town to its core. Forced to flee the only home they've ever known, the boys must rely on each other as they navigate betrayal, fear, and the growing rage of a town determined to see them brought to justice. As the manhunt intensifies, the truth begins to surface—but will it be too late to save them?

Entries.Title: Spicy Noodles
Entries.Description: Two chill queers spend their evening deeptalking and potatoing on their couch. Food cravings lead to a spicy bet until ultimately a hot secret is spilled. Even a package of soothing cold milk can't wash away the thrill of burning a messy friendship.

Entries.Title: Faiez's Car
Entries.Description: A group of friends talk in a very reliable vehicle.

Entries.Title: Absent
Entries.Description: What remains when something or someone disappears? A meditation on absence, memory, and the unseen forces that linger beyond perception.

Entries.Title: COLUMBIA COLLEGE CHICAGO
Entries.Description: A busy day in the life of an acting major at a Chicago art school.

Entries.Title: Shanti Rides Shotgun
Entries.Description: On Manhattan's jam-packed streets, NYC's most iconic driving instructor prepares students for the road ahead.

Entries.Title: The Red Piano
Entries.Description: Inspired by Edgar Allan Poe's works; a narcissistic pianist is faced with his consequences when he begins to hear things.

Entries.Title: ZAIPER MAN THE LAND WARRIOR
Entries.Description: This is the Ugandan Commados movie from the director Professor Artman Kalourz of Zaiper man. Casts company 'Iron Borne Stars' Watch out Trapped Under Mission.

Entries.Title: Kid Vampire
Entries.Description: Count Papa sends Kid Vampire off to human school. In search of blood, he discovers something even sweeter along the way - friendship.

Entries.Title: Love Bound
Entries.Description: A tormented man abducts a woman to force his dream of love, sparking a fiery clash that bares their souls and wounded hearts, forging a searing bond in this 27-minute 4K short.

Entries.Title: Immortals
Entries.Description: Built from the audio tracks of dubbed vampire films and footage from home movies, Les immortelles is a video collage in four chapters that places mother-daughter relationships at the heart of a tale on immortality. As they come together and grow apart, the floating, recombined bodies seek to coexist between life and death. Featuring members of my family, this film explores the traces of the memories that we carry within us, and that, ghost-like, prolong our lives outside of ourselves.

Entries.Title: Whiplash 2
Entries.Description: The electrifying sequel to the 2014 drama.

Entries.Title: Novi Mi
Entries.Description: A metaphysical odyssey of the Individua members as they grapple with mysterious masked figures and the imminent waiting for them at the end of the snowy forest.

Entries.Title: Confidence Man: Live From 3Olympia Theatre, Dublin
Entries.Description: We join Confidence Man at the 3Olympia Theatre, Dublin for the final night of their sold-out UK and Ireland tour.  Taking place on 10th December 2024, the show rounded out what was a monumental year for the Australian dance-pop duo, celebrating their third album 3AM (La La La).

Entries.Title: In Another Time
Entries.Description: Two boys meet in one room, but something is strange.

Entries.Title: PSA FROM THE VOID
Entries.Description: PSA FROM THE VOID was created for a BGSU 48-Hour Film Festival.

Entries.Title: Mimaroğlu Remix Project
Entries.Description: A collection of 8mm film reels from İlhan Mimaroğlu’s archive—once tucked away in whisky boxes—has found new life through art. Curated by director Serdar Kökçeoğlu and producer Dilek Aydın, the project brings together visual artists and musicians to reimagine these long-lost images. Over thirty artists transformed the footage into fifteen distinct audiovisual pieces, blending experimental soundscapes with contemporary video art. The project concludes with a special highlight: the first-ever screening of Mimaroğlu’s silent short film about a street jazz festival, accompanied by Erdem Helvacıoğlu’s dark jazz score.

Entries.Title: Obscurum
Entries.Description: Two sisters are left home alone together in their mountain lodge. An unfortunate sequence of events lead them to the basement where they come face to face with something they could never understand.

Entries.Title: Golden Years
Entries.Description: A mischievous couple spices up their retirement by breaking into wealthy people's homes and throwing themselves parties. But as pressure mounts from their families and the authorities, the good times may be about to end.

Entries.Title: Everybody’s Work: Healing What Hurts Us All
Entries.Description: A deep dive into the hidden disease plaguing healthcare in the United States: systemic racism. Through the lens of fearless nurses, this exposé uncovers the biases that dictate disparate healthcare outcomes based on skin color and the negative impact it has on both patients and the nurses who provide care.

Entries.Title: Terra
Entries.Description: A being alien to our own emerges from the water and spends the night roaming Miami.

Entries.Title: Ground Zero
Entries.Description: In the year 1970, a protest goes wrong, leading to many deaths. Five soldiers must enter The Walters Research Center to find survivors and discover what happened. However, they soon realize that whatever research was going on here will quickly lead them to the fight for their lives and the question becomes can they survive?

Entries.Title: Diana and Roma's Magical Mermaid Tales!
Entries.Description: Diana and Roma dive into the Silly Sea to meet a mystical mermaid! She teaches them how to transform into merpeople, and Diana becomes a Mermaid Princess. Plus, more seaside adventures!

Entries.Title: Red Light Green Light
Entries.Description: A mysterious man is pressing green and red buttons. He continues to press them quickly, going back and forth between the buttons. It is revealed that the buttons are for a traffic light, which a frustrated driver yells expletives at when the light quickly changes from green to red.

Entries.Title: It's All Light: Laraaji at Nine Orchard
Entries.Description: A concert film from musician Laraaji featuring visuals by Liquid Light Lab. Filmed 18 October 2023 at Nine Orchard in New York City.

Entries.Title: Hunger
Entries.Description: The life and death of cattle at the hands of a rancher.

Entries.Title: Shrieek
Entries.Description: Suzanne, a young housewife isolated to her life on a farm and stuck in an abusive relationship with her husband, finds herself lured into the forest by a supernatural being and forced to face her deepest desires for escape.

Entries.Title: Trapped in Memory
Entries.Description: A man goes insane as he struggles to move past a violent end to a relationship

Entries.Title: 7 Years a Centrifuge
Entries.Description: Special Agent Lou Santellino comes face to face with a mysterious A.I. Entity, however he soon discovers it is slowly upgrading into something else entirely.

Entries.Title: In The Bleak Midwinter
Entries.Description: Winter landscapes captured in black and white.

Entries.Title: Awesome Party at My Dad's Bar
Entries.Description: An awesome movie about an awesome party at my dad's bar.

Entries.Title: The Visitor
Entries.Description: After the traumatic loss of his daughter, Rudd, a heartbroken father, decides to take matters into his own hands and find a way to speak with her again—no matter the cost.

Entries.Title: The Piano Player
Entries.Description: A teenage girl decides to sabotage her best friend's piano performance as a response to her jealousy.

Entries.Title: New Year, New Me
Entries.Description: Home from college, Alex reconnects with his sibling Sam to work through an anxiety attack on New Year’s Eve.

Entries.Title: Guinness Punch
Entries.Description: The story of a Jamaican immigrant family in London - a growing artist, Mary, pays a surprise visit to her disapproving Mother's home.

Entries.Title: O Gato da Varanda
Entries.Description: Amid the pandemic lockdown, a mother and her daughter find themselves forced to confront a claustrophobic reality. The arrival of an enigmatic cat triggers a series of unsettling events, blurring the line between reality and imagination, and unveiling a tense interplay of psychology and emotional fragility

Entries.Title: Glutton
Entries.Description: As her paranoia, OCD, and graphic nightmares eat away at her, Molly grows suspicious that her partner, Lou, might be a cannibal.

Entries.Title: Standing On End
Entries.Description: Harry waits for his date to arrive, accompanied by his friends on a group chat.

Entries.Title: All Things End
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Hurry Up & Wait
Entries.Description: A frantic young woman's disastrous morning spirals out of control, proving that no matter how fast she moves, life always finds a way to trip her up.

Entries.Title: El retrato
Entries.Description: Valentina, a young painter who takes care of her sick father, receives the visit of death, who announces that her final time has arrived. In an attempt to get more time to take care of his father, he proposes a deal: Portray her to prolong her life.

Entries.Title: Dosh ta Kar
Entries.Description: Dosh ta kar is a bangladeshi telivision Drama. Main Protagonist is Arosh khan.

Entries.Title: Hiccups, Please Hold
Entries.Description: A frazzled IT worker develops an untimely case of hiccups. With only 5 minutes before her shift resumes, she embarks on a frantic quest to cure them using internet-sourced remedies.

Entries.Title: A Treatise on Clear-Sightedness
Entries.Description: A soul captured by cameras but rejected by life, Maria embarks on a melancholic journey through love and emptiness—where poetry and tragedy intertwine in letters to the sea and fingerprints that are no longer her own. Dressed in white, she dissolves into the waves, leaving behind a love letter written with hands that were never truly hers. But even the ocean refuses to keep her

Entries.Title: The Long Road Ahead
Entries.Description: Two friends are on the way to visit one's sister when their car breaks down, leading to one of the world's most awkward carpools.

Entries.Title: Clement Gasa
Entries.Description: Clement Gasa, a 52 year old domestic worker, takes us on a journey into his life, his loves and impossible dreams in post Apartheid South Africa. An intimate portrait of a man who has been in the 'service' of the same family since he was 15 years old.

Entries.Title: Love Is Merely a Madness
Entries.Description: Unique dance-documentary hybrid explores the challenges of finding romantic connections among the gay community in the digital age.

Entries.Title: Million Dollar Extreme Presents: ALEX-BOT: A Stand-Up Special By Alex Schultz
Entries.Description: Stand-Up special from Alex Schultz of MDE & Be Nice To Me Productions.

Entries.Title: Mindscapes
Entries.Description: The canvas of the mind, where an artist's inner visions and emotions are painted into existence.

Entries.Title: Highest Treason
Entries.Description: Two hooligan mates are sent on a wild goose chase as they bid for entry into a notorious underworld gang. Will their friendship stand the tests that await them in this unknown world?

Entries.Title: Jie Jie (姐姐)
Entries.Description: A story about a girl on Lunar New Year.

Entries.Title: Enci - A Mosasaur View
Entries.Description: "Our' earth shows its bowels at an open-pit mine. In this quarry near Maastricht the First Dutch Cement Industry -ENCI - exploited marl out of St. Pietersberg since 1924. Because of the negative environmental impact they had to stop mining in 2020. It has become a unique natural reserve these past years.  Gazing down the huge hole in the earth we’re also looking back in deep geological times. Layer upon layer of stone, until a period 66 million years ago, the age of mosasaurs (giant sea lizards). In those days this part of the globe was a tropical sea. Fossil remains of this large marine reptile were found for the first time in the limestone at Maastricht in 1766, and helped shape thoughts on evolution and extinction."

Entries.Title: My First Day at the Beach
Entries.Description: Forced to enter a new reality, a little girl navigates the remnants of her childhood.

Entries.Title: The More Naked We Dare to Be
Entries.Description: Danish auteur Jon Bang Carlsen takes stock of his life's work, the art of cinema and life itself in a film that stretches from the west coast of Denmark to the red desert sands of Arizona.

Entries.Title: The Buried River
Entries.Description: A short horror film.

Entries.Title: TWICE: Live Performance at the TMElive International Music Awards
Entries.Description: In a dazzling showcase of global pop excellence, TWICE takes center stage at the 2025 TMElive International Music Awards, held at the iconic Galaxy Arena in Macau. This electrifying concert film captures the full essence of TWICE’s artistry, charisma, and connection with fans as they deliver a high-energy setlist featuring hits like “Fancy,” “TT,” “What is Love?” and their 2025 anthem “This Is For.” With stunning visuals, synchronized choreography, and heartfelt talk segments, the performance blends spectacle with sincerity—offering an intimate look at one of K-pop’s most beloved groups at the height of their powers. A must-watch for ONCE and music lovers alike, this cinematic experience celebrates TWICE’s global impact and the magic of live performance.  Genres: Music, Documentary, Concert  Language: Korean (with multilingual subtitles)  Runtime: Approx. 35 minutes  Release Date: August 22, 2025  Location: Galaxy Arena, Macau SAR, China

Entries.Title: Return to Tanya
Entries.Description: A love story told like a ghost story: two lovers touring their new apartment see visions of their life together in the apartment as well as the inevitably demise of their relationship.

Entries.Title: Face Jumping
Entries.Description: Two strangers' eyes catch in an elevator — what transformational powers does that moment hold? Face Jumping is an interactive VR short that uses eye-tracking technologies as both muse and platform to explore the impossible desire of seeing through another’s eyes. Visitors navigate a journey of rebirth and evolution by meeting the gaze of other characters and swapping perspectives – including those of birds, rocks, delivery bots, ghosts, cowboys, and clouds.

Entries.Title: The Last Sitting
Entries.Description: When a visitor silences a painter's mysterious noise machine, the evening spirals into the surreal.

Entries.Title: The Rookie
Entries.Description: Solaria has a trainee and she's not happy about it. After saving her rookie from potential disaster and disposing of a villain called Zorkath, the two heroines hunt down a batch of solenite, a fluid that powers up any human. As per the intel received from Zorkath, the solenite and two thugs are at the location. One of the thugs is also in training, and Solaria has a history with the other. The heroines engage, but it quickly becomes clear the thugs have already ingested the solenite and, early in the fight, ingest another dose. The heroines are on the ropes and find themselves defeated and on the receiving end of devious sexual scenarios. The only exit strategy is if both thugs cum, disposing of the solenite out of their systems. Can the heroines manipulate the situation, or will they end up in defeat?

Entries.Title: Light Upon Light: A Documentary On Hijab
Entries.Description: Light Upon Light: A Documentary on Hijab is an intimate and deeply personal exploration of the diverse, raw, and untold stories of hijabi women. Through open and vulnerable conversations with 7 women, the film dismantles stereotypes, highlights the challenges imposed by society, and celebrates the profound beauty of the hijab beyond a mere clothing choice. It captures the individuality of each woman’s story—how they came to wear the hijab, the struggles they’ve faced, and the strength they’ve found in it. More than just fabric, the hijab is a journey, often misunderstood, and influenced by the way the world perceives it. By amplifying voices that are often unheard, the documentary creates a space for empathy, challenges misconceptions, and invites a deeper understanding of what it truly means to wear the hijab; inspiring everyone to see hijab in a new light.

Entries.Title: Home Made Hollywood: The Life and Films of Nick Millard
Entries.Description: Documentary about the life and films of Nick Millard.

Entries.Title: Three of Cups
Entries.Description: 3 vampires go on a hunt to recover their cups from a museum, but first must evade an overzealous security guard.

Entries.Title: Temptation of Influence
Entries.Description: Temptation of Influence is a filmic collage and an essay exploring how architectural ideas are passed down, reinterpreted and – inevitably – misread across generations. Centred on Irish architect Shane de Blacam, it begins in his Dublin study, where Palladio’s plates frame Louis Kahn’s sketches. From Inishmaan to Rome, from Veneto to New Haven, the film follows a path of conversations, buildings and landscapes – tracing the uncertain mechanics of architectural inheritance. Contributors include Kenneth Frampton, Níall McLaughlin, Sheila O’Donnell and others.

Entries.Title: The Frisbee
Entries.Description: The Frisbee is an animated short featuring a dog and a frisbee which may or may not belong to the dog. The director was contacted for a comment, and he stated that it was meant to be ambiguous.

Entries.Title: Death of a Chef
Entries.Description: Preparing for his date, amateur cook tries to make the best meal he can, haunted by the presence of his dead chef friend.

Entries.Title: Brylluppet
Entries.Description: A comedic short film about unexpected confrontations during a wedding ceremony.

Entries.Title: Noctuary
Entries.Description: A story of three seemingly random stories that occur throughout Chicago one fateful night.

Entries.Title: Tashweesh
Entries.Description: Khaled, a Saudi young man, travels to Kyrgyzstan to study medicine. After contracting an illness, he begins seeing a child that no one else can see. Accused of kidnapping children by the state, Khaled must race against time to prove his innocence.

Entries.Title: SEE
Entries.Description: A 70’s inspired psychedelic horror film about how body dysmorphia makes people see features about themselves that aren’t reality, and the consequences of those delusions.

Entries.Title: China, der Riese erwacht - TikTok, die mächtigste App der Welt
Entries.Description: TikTok’s explosive success isn’t just the triumph of a single company. The video platform also holds major political significance for its country of origin—China—challenging the United States’ long-standing dominance in the digital sphere. In this new power struggle between the two global giants, the battle centers around the collection and use of personal data...

Entries.Title: Vanilla Sky Habibi
Entries.Description: The players of the Berlin women's football team Türkiyemspor are not only a close-knit community on the soccer pitch. At night, the young women even meet in a shared dream...

Entries.Title: Blind Spot
Entries.Description: "The bird chirps so loudly while I try to forget your face".

Entries.Title: PARA
Entries.Description: A fan attempts to meet his favorite artist.

Entries.Title: The Treatment
Entries.Description: Trapped in a sterile labyrinth, a patient fights to reclaim her fragmented identity as the lines between guidance, manipulation, and reality blur.

Entries.Title: TAPS
Entries.Description: When Max unknowingly summons a demon on Grindr, he must do whatever it takes to survive.

Entries.Title: Berdad
Entries.Description: A photojournalist confronts the unchanging truth hidden in his lens.

Entries.Title: Static Insomniac
Entries.Description: An experimental horror short shot on camcorder. Imagery of a typical bedroom conveys the feelings of  a nightmare and the childhood fear of the dark.

Entries.Title: BRRRP
Entries.Description: Are you having fun? Dive headfirst into a bombastic exploration of fun with BRRRP. Witching hour in the club, fruity beauties, an unhinged gymnastics class, a virtual fighting pit or an out-of-control after party: this film brings it all to the big screen by covering various types of fun such as authenticity, energy and thrill. Don’t even try to keep up, darling!  Prepare yourself for a bombastic interplay of DIY film and a hard techno soundtrack. It’s sexy, it’s glam, it’s wild, it’s fun, it’s BRRRP.

Entries.Title: Life Eternal
Entries.Description: After Isaac's (Griffin Puatu) long-term girlfriend, Ava, (Ashley Bell) is killed, he struggles to continue. Months later he is visited by Ava in a dream, who takes him on a journey reliving their relationship, leading him to the realization that she lives on in the time they spent together and the relationship that they built.

Entries.Title: Love Is a Dog's Best Friend
Entries.Description: Lily, an event planner, fosters a mischievous dog, whose chaotic antics lead her to new friendships, love, and self-discovery while preparing for a gala alongside Shane, a dog trainer who helps her rediscover love in her life.

Entries.Title: Swan
Entries.Description: I invite you to dance.

Entries.Title: Maika.
Entries.Description: Maika sends a love letter to The Toolbox Butcher, a local serial killer, hoping to form some kind of connection with the masked man

Entries.Title: The Shady Movie
Entries.Description: Shady Now Gets His Own Film!!

Entries.Title: Grave Digger: The 45th Anniversary Show
Entries.Description: For 45 years, Grave Digger have stood like a rock in the surf of German heavy metal. Founded in 1980 by Chris Boltendahl, the Teutonic metallers have made history with albums like "Heavy Metal Breakdown" and "Tunes of War" and continue to perform tirelessly to this day. Their songs sound like battle cries full of pathos, power, and unmistakable riff violence. For their 45th anniversary, they bring the full load of Grave Digger myth to Wacken: a journey through almost half a century of metal, featuring all the anthems that have shaped generations. On the hallowed ground, they celebrate themselves – loudly, proudly, uncompromisingly – and demonstrate that true heavy metal is timeless and hasn't slowed down one bit.

Entries.Title: The Rise and Fall of Starboy
Entries.Description: An aimless, adrift video store clerk jumps at the first opportunity to become someone new - a chance to transform, to step into the spotlight, to become a STAR™. As he immerses himself in the role of STARBOY, he loses a self that he didn’t even know existed. It's about being an outsider, someone who never fits in, finally being given the opportunity to become someone who does.

Entries.Title: What Lies in Eden
Entries.Description: A post-apocalyptic world caused by the fall of humanity due to its own self destructive tendencies. A world left now to fend for itself, Jackie and Lucas now left there too. An unsuspected meeting and a strange welcoming into a community that feels off-putting.

Entries.Title: Red Bull Hardline UK
Entries.Description: For 2025, Red Bull Hardline returns to Machynlleth in Wales, UK, for what is one of the world's toughest downhill mountain bike races. Riders push their limits to conquer what is known as one of the world's toughest part-downhill, part-freeride mountain bike races. 32 riders will push their limits to conquer a brutal course with massive jumps, drops and technical challenges.  Since its inception, world-class trail builder Dan Atherton has levelled up the jumps, gaps and sections, creating a more intense and extreme track for the riders to tackle year on year. Unlike any other MTB course, the Red Bull Hardline UK track borrows elements from motocross and BMX, so as well as speed and stamina, riders will lean heavily on their freeride, dirt jump, and big air skills (think the iconic Road Gap, and over 55ft of airtime).

Entries.Title: American Primitive Guitar
Entries.Description: When three men meet at a roadside motel, the love triangle they've found themselves a part of becomes what tears them apart.

Entries.Title: DOA Queen of Thorns 2025
Entries.Description: DOA Queen of Thorns 2025

Entries.Title: Manta Dreams
Entries.Description: A woman had a childhood dream to explore the world. Now she has grown up to be an overworked waitress living in a small apartment.

Entries.Title: It Will Come Back One Way or Another
Entries.Description: Images of the landscape and the road start to melt and peel off on a drive from one city to another.

Entries.Title: Ladybug
Entries.Description: Molly Oran dates a life-sized stop-motion animated rose bush in the music video for her single, Ladybug.

Entries.Title: Alexirrhoe
Entries.Description: A cat sprints through a blinding white box, pursued by flashes of light, shifting spaces, and fleeting images. Soundscapes and droning textures propel this hypnotic run into the realm of the wild and the uncanny.

Entries.Title: Charlotte and the Seven Frat Brothers
Entries.Description: Charlotte's senior year goes sideways when she's placed in a frat house due to full dorms. Amid parties and pranks, she develops feelings for Chase, the charismatic frat president.

Entries.Title: Tomorrow Can Wait
Entries.Description: A young man's emotions spiral on his way to a date, turning every worry into a worst-case scenario. Made in 48 hours.

Entries.Title: Great White Assassins
Entries.Description: Alison Towner and Dickie Chivell investigate how killer whales hunt great whites, with Dickie diving disguised as an orca in New Zealand.

Entries.Title: METAL ASS
Entries.Description: A woman becomes the center of attention for all the wrong reasons when meeting her best friend's new friends.

Entries.Title: Wishbone
Entries.Description: As the college football season looms on the horizon, fans can delve into the remarkable story of how the triple-option offense rescued three of college football’s biggest brand names—Oklahoma, texas and Alabama—and fundamentally altered the sport’s history.  It’s a tale of desperation, rivalry and friendship, and it vibrates with irony and intrigue.

Entries.Title: The Red Frame
Entries.Description: When a census taker mistakenly receives a snuff film on his doorstep, he must risk his life to uncover a network of political corruption.

Entries.Title: Touching of Grass
Entries.Description: N.E.A.T and Hatsune Miku enthusiast, Guy Wumpus is addicted to league of legends. When greeted by his old friend, friend, he's told he needs to go outside.

Entries.Title: Acceptance Beyond Celluloid
Entries.Description: A documentary about Queer cinema and the pressure local Queer Art students face in the South

Entries.Title: A Divine Comedy: What the Hell
Entries.Description: Dante's classic Hell is falling into oblivion. Charlotte, a sharp-witted Harpy, navigates the chaos and sets out despite the odds for a new life and destiny. On the way, she gets stuck in an elevator with her fuccboi ex, Asterion. Living in the end-times, he won't stop at anything to try and win her back. Will she survive this journey through Hell? Will the weighing of hearts lead to their complete annihilation?

Entries.Title: Death Finds Life
Entries.Description: When Death grows tired of his job, he embarks on a journey to find the opportunity of a lifetime.

Entries.Title: Chat Pile - Hellfest 2025
Entries.Description: Chat Pile - live at Hellfest 2025.

Entries.Title: This Is Not
Entries.Description: When Ty attends his friend group's annual costume party, he becomes the target of mind games and humiliation from Trey, a charismatic newcomer with an underlying darkness.

Entries.Title: Prehistoric Island of Bark
Entries.Description: When a recruiter brings 4 people onto an island to gain their trust and get some investor money, something goes horribly wrong resulting in fatalities of both dinosaurs and humans... But who will come out on top?  Watch the full movie for free on YouTube

Entries.Title: The Bite
Entries.Description: “We all have it, we use it daily and don’t really think about how much of human contact, self-expression and weirdness comes with it. The intention of my film is to show how interesting and disturbing the human mouth is, its teeth, tongue and gums. I hope you’ll find it as fascinating as I do.” - Anna

Entries.Title: Another Night at Gomez's
Entries.Description: The illustrious Gomez invites six fellow businessmen to his manor only to find that amongst them is a killer. Who? He must find out.

Entries.Description: i made an overlapping series of clips of the road along with the other vehicles

Entries.Title: Tranter-Man: Episode 4 - Mec Tueur Strikes Again
Entries.Description: With Alex the Awful defeated, Tranter-man flees from a much more fearsome opponent; Mec Tueur, and he's back for revenge. with the rising conflicts, In steps a new hero to stand in defiance: Poo Bag Man.

Entries.Title: The Arrival
Entries.Description: The Arrival explores how profound the immigrant experience can be by delving into the emotions associated with being uprooted from one world and transplanted into another.  Drawing from Masoomah's journey of culture shock, bewilderment and fascination upon arriving in Australia from her family farm in Afghanistan, feelings are evoked through a rich tapestry of ethnic motifs.

Entries.Title: Divine Soldiers
Entries.Description: Unleash the Inner Power, Rise as Legends

Entries.Title: Horse Heaven
Entries.Description: Robbies horse gets eaten by a dinosaur and its his duty to go to Horse Heaven and get it back!

Entries.Title: PAPER CUT
Entries.Description: Paper Cut is a short film that explores the struggles of a student who faces unexpected challenges while trying to complete his college. Set within the familiar environment of classrooms and college, the film highlights themes of pressure, friendship, and perseverance. As tensions rise, small moments reveal deeper conflicts and emotional layers.

Entries.Title: Lightlessness
Entries.Description: A short experiment involving the kinetics of sound-reactive LEDs, electricity, and light, recorded in 2023.

Entries.Title: What Tomorrow Brings
Entries.Description: Clara is entering her senior year of high school - a time in life that should be carefree and filled with anticipation for the future - but her mom's mental health issues will alter Clara's plans and her sole priority will become protecting her younger sister, Ruby. Over the ensuing three months, Clara spirals to the breaking point.

Entries.Title: Talk
Entries.Description: A university student named Jared is trying to make a short film with his friend Josh and some other students. Thinks take a turn for the worse when Josh's crush Sophia suddenly appears and the crew begins falling apart by losing focus of the assignment.

Entries.Title: The Good News According to Jesus: Episode 2: “This is My Son”
Entries.Description: Jesus is baptized in the waters of the Jordan, beginning his ministry. First, he must be tempted by the Devil.

Entries.Title: To Detective Samuel
Entries.Description: A aging detective hires a new recruit.

Entries.Title: Costco vs The Supermarket: Who Does Bulk Buy Better?
Entries.Description: Costco's success is based on encouraging customers to buy in bulk. This documentary looks at the corporation's rise and how supermarket chains responded.

Entries.Title: Sinkhole
Entries.Description: There was a plan to build a cinema in the cliffs – it might have been here. Sinkhole is a poetic response to the archive and oral histories of Tyneside Cinema, an independent cinema in north-east England which has faced many waves of crisis. Through imagined vignettes, Sinkhole meditates on grand visions and being near to collapse.

Entries.Title: When Butterflies Scream
Entries.Description: This 20 minute short film consists of one singular shot of a library window displaying a tree blowing in the wind on one side and a view of the sky and clouds on the other. "When the Music's Over" performed by The Doors begins to play. When the song ends the view begins to change.

Entries.Title: Amentalio
Entries.Description: A young man struggles to preserve his memories of a fling, trying to write every detail in his journal. However, the more he tries to hold onto these memories, the more he realizes they may have had different perceptions of their time together.

Entries.Title: From This Flesh - A Cattle Decapitation Story
Entries.Description: The official studio documentary of the making of 2023's "TERRASITE". Almost 2 years in the making, this nearly 2 hour epic fly-on-the-wall deep dive studio report canvases much of the bands' history from its humble beginnings to the end of the recording of our latest album "Terrasite". Filmed during the 2.5 month recording session with Producer Dave Otero, the film focuses on each individual instrument's recording process with interviews from each member contemplating the work once the album was wrapped up. All the stress, frustration, comradery, laughter, intensity and passion for the work is on display here and its a must-watch for any Cattle fan of every era.

Entries.Title: Stone Birds
Entries.Description: Aimless 20 somethings Payton and Morgan attempt to navigate their interpersonal relationships following a tragic accident.

Entries.Title: Haunt
Entries.Description: A man, suspecting he's being haunted, attempts to haunt the ghost back.

Entries.Title: Chandan's HunturxHuntur
Entries.Description: The barberious story of stalin, moon knight, draken, kigo and chanzoo

Entries.Title: From This Day Forward
Entries.Description: A testimonial from author Wendy Haller about her life with chronic pain caused by psoriatic arthritis.

Entries.Title: The Rise and Fall and Rise Again of Colin Carrier
Entries.Description: Colin Carrier, a young and chipper guy eager to run for his high school’s student leadership team, finds himself suddenly voted in after a video he stars in goes viral. Will all this newfound fame go straight to his head, or will the lessons of servant leadership hold strong?

Entries.Title: Waterfall
Entries.Description: A young adult woman leaves her home in Spokane, Washington for a better life but is stopped along the way by the leader of a minor drug cartel.

Entries.Title: Voices of Deoli
Entries.Description: This timely and deeply resonant film sheds light on a nearly forgotten chapter of history in which around 3,000 Indian Chinese were unjustly imprisoned after the 1962 Sino-India war. As immigration policies and narratives around national identity continue to evolve, both in the U.S. and globally, the film offers powerful insights into how the past still echoes today. What happened in the past can happen again, and often does.

Entries.Title: Stood-Up
Entries.Description: A slice-of-life, single-shot glimpse into modern romance, loneliness, and unspoken connection.

Entries.Title: Room to Move
Entries.Description: Choreographer and performer Jenn Freeman has always possessed the gift of movement. From a very early age, she simply had to dance… all the time. But with that ever-present need to jump, leap, shake and squirm came a struggle to exist harmoniously in a world that seemed to assault her senses and sense of equilibrium at every turn.

Entries.Title: Bye Bye Bobby
Entries.Description: A young woman hires a sketchy guy to get rid of her abusive boyfriend, but it goes farther than she could've ever imagined.

Entries.Title: we good?
Entries.Description: On the advice of counsel, a nebbishy tech executive visits a woman he had an awkward one-night stand with fifteen years ago to make sure she won’t threaten his impending IPO.

Entries.Title: Ice Cream, Ice Queen
Entries.Description: Lost in the lonely life of New York City, a middle-aged Chinese woman wrestles with the complexities of her unexpected bond with her son’s lesbian violin teacher.

Entries.Title: Trillion Cut: Diamonds of Resilience
Entries.Description: Trillion Cut: Diamonds of Resilience" paints a vivid portrait of six transgender aging women in Los Angeles who find strength and support within their "Diamonds" group. The film delves into their individual struggles, from battling societal prejudice and accessing essential resources to forging meaningful connections. Despite the pressures they face, their resilience shines through, making this a powerful tribute to their determination.

Entries.Title: Project Penelope
Entries.Description: Grieving the tragic loss of their young daughter Penelope, scientists Jonas and Elizabeth delve into the world of artificial intelligence to recreate their beloved child. As they work diligently to assemble Penelope's essence from fragmented memories and precious mementos, their relationship is tested. Elizabeth becomes increasingly doubtful about their likelihood of success, while Jonas conceals a haunting secret.

Entries.Title: Weird
Entries.Description: Drifting from her reality on the streets of Mexico City, a woman's chaotic thoughts spill into verse in short film Weird - directed by Flavio Morales and Nicolas Corvino. Overwhelmed by the routines and structures that direct her day-to-day, she questions the nature of love, life, death and existence itself, undergoing a metamorphosis as an uncanny feeling takes hold. Playing with visual effects makeup to evoke the image of a fish, Morales and Corvino enlisted makeup artist Feña Acuña to center their protagonist's dissociation, exploring the depths of her mind as she becomes immersed in thought.

Entries.Title: Holding Back the Years: 40 Years of Simply Red
Entries.Description: Filmed live in Santiago, Chile across two sold-out nights, presented in stunning 4K and immersive surround sound. The film features the live performance as well as exclusive interviews with the band.

Entries.Title: Project U Move
Entries.Description: Popular music artist CG5 vanishes after a New Years livestream, leaving behind nothing but a color of red. Meanwhile, around the world, a mysterious VHS tape is causing chaos by using him to entrance people with a bright and intoxicating red glow.

Entries.Title: Soundscapes of Self
Entries.Description: Soundscapes of Self is an immersive audio documentary exploring the intricacies of gender and voice, told through voiceover, designed sound elements, and interviews with Canadian transgender people and speech professionals. Using the medium of audio, listeners are able to be uninfluenced by appearance and learn the ways that they are subconsciously performing and interpreting gender through their own voices.

Entries.Title: Touring the Lakefront with Geoffrey Baer
Entries.Description: Geoffrey Baer is back to traverse the length and breadth of Chicago’s world-famous “front yard” to explore everything from beloved birds to submerged secrets along Chicago’s lakefront. A fascinating journey from the history of Jean Baptiste Pointe DuSable to modern-day hikes on Northerly Island, fishing for lake trout, and snorkeling on a prehistoric reef, Touring the Lakefront with Geoffrey Baer Geoffrey takes viewers on a journey to discover how our lakefront was envisioned, built, and defended, and how it has evolved over the centuries.

Entries.Title: Sound of Silence
Entries.Description: A young girl realises that there is peace in embracing the silence

Entries.Title: Region of oN 2
Entries.Description: The Magnus Opus oN Region, a teamtage of clips with every sniper throughout their favourite games.

Entries.Title: Source to Sea down the River Thames WITHOUT Leaving it (Part 4)
Entries.Description: I’m attempting to travel from the source to the sea down the River Thames. That’s 210 miles of wading, swimming and kayaking along Britain’s busiest waterway. And to make things harder I’m doing the whole thing alone and self-supported.

Entries.Title: THE CHICKEN SANDWICH FROM THE GAS STATION HAD AN EVIL WORM IN IT THAT WANTS ME TO DIE AND SPREAD VIOLENCE
Entries.Description: A Man Contracts An Evil Worm From A Chicken Sandwich He Got From The Gas Station That Tells Him To End His Life.

Entries.Title: Heavy is the Head
Entries.Description: Heavy is the Head is a short experimental film that navigates the journey of a Black boy coming of age in America. The story is an exploration of identity and the expectations that weigh on a boy learning to navigate a world that often sees him before he truly sees himself.

Entries.Title: The Listening Party featuring Redman & Xzibit
Entries.Description: Redman and Xzibit sit down to play new music, react to each other’s tracks, and share untold Hip-Hop stories. From their first rap influences to competing with guests on their records, this is an unfiltered look at their creative process, career wisdom, and legendary journeys.

Entries.Title: You're on Your Own
Entries.Description: A woman reflects on her wedding decision, lost in thought as she unwinds in a warm, candlelit bath. - Lyric video for Alicia Rose's "You're on Your Own"

Entries.Title: But...You're A Dolphin!
Entries.Description: Can interspecies communication give us enlightenment to mysteries yet unseen? Dolphins have been known to be one of the most intelligent creatures on the planet. What do they know that we don't? In this short film, a dolphin tells Sarah a secret of the universe. Inspired by the research of John C. Lilly.

Entries.Title: Leg
Entries.Description: This film is a collaboration between musician and animator. The musician received a silent film and composed a score with no direction from the animator. In turn the animator created new visuals inspired by the music. Energy is built up and chaotically released but the leg eventually finds its footing.

Entries.Title: The Shops With Annie
Entries.Description: Annie goes on a leisurely trip to the shops.

Entries.Title: London, KY
Entries.Description: A filmmaker journeys back to the significant places of his Kentucky upbringing to preserve the memories they still hold.

Entries.Title: Patio Cigarette
Entries.Description: A group of friends are having a smoke when one of them spots a guy looking for a light.

Entries.Title: Herbie
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: Puppy Bowl XXI
Entries.Description: In this annual event, shelter dogs "compete" for various prizes in a special meant to encourage animal adoption.

Entries.Title: The Walker
Entries.Description: A older man in physical therapy refuses to use his walker to exercise to rehab his knee, and he spends his days living in depression and frustration until one night an intruder breaks into his house.

Entries.Title: Just Wait
Entries.Description: In a suburb near Tampa, ALYSSA braces for an approaching storm. She organizes valuables and essentials, including her dad’s old speargun. On the phone with her mom, Alyssa opposes her husband Tanner’s decision not to evacuate. When TANNER gets home, she fails to voice her concern.

Entries.Title: The Mustache Mob
Entries.Description: Ambitious kid tries to join the legendary "Mustache Mob" gang and will stop at nothing to be accepted.

Entries.Title: Beauty of Life
Entries.Description: A story about an international student, Diego, coming to Utrecht to study and make new friends. He quickly finds himself overwhelmed with his new life, and cant seem to fit in. However, with the help of some friends and his loving mother, he finds the confidence to try again and this time succeed in his new life.

Entries.Title: AEW Stories: Nigel McGuiness - The Road Less Traveled
Entries.Description: Nigel McGuinness reflects on his decision to retire and take the road less traveled in a new mini-documentary released by AEW.

Entries.Title: Appreciating
Entries.Description: When the diary journal of an appreciative teen, Jim, randomly gets lost, he begins searching for a solution and living his life to its fullest in order to not have the journal’s absence bother him so deeply.

Entries.Title: Terms & Conditions
Entries.Description: Logan is an 18-year-old caught in a dilemma; hide her true self to secure her future or risk everything to live authentically.

Entries.Title: Invisible Machines
Entries.Description: Bringing together histories of feminized labour with ethnographic scenes of stenographers captioning for d/Deaf students in the classroom, this experimental film considers how captioners and their clients make sense of demands for invisibility, neutrality, and access. Formally, by interrupting the normative coherence of sound and image, the film reflexively undermines the fluency of its own audio track to make palpable the nuanced interpretive work that goes into transcribing across modalities.

Entries.Title: Love is the Drug
Entries.Description: Bringing together a trove of archival materials from first wave harm reduction and syringe exchange on the west coast, this archive is not a scene of redemption, but rather, a cinematic apparatus that can teach us about durational love.

Entries.Title: The Satan Sellers - Beatrice Sparks and the Birth of the Satanic Panic
Entries.Description: While the Satanic Panic reached its peak in the 1980s and 1990s, its origins go back a decade earlier, with a backlash against the Age of Aquarius, fear of RPGs and heavy metal, and a series of hysterical books led by a grubby work of fiction masquerading as a true memoir, written by a shameless fraud.

Entries.Title: Divine Intervention
Entries.Description: Late one night, a man and a woman are each sitting alone at a bar. Evelyn notices Joe and gives off signs of interest. Joe is mutually interested but chickens out from taking any action and Evelyn leaves. There’s nothing new about this scene. It has happened thousands of times and will happen thousands more.  But what if we could see the potential opportunities we cut off from ourselves when we chicken out of taking action? What if there was the possibility of a do-over? On this night, for Joe Montgomery, there is. An angel visits Joe and informs him how Evelyn would be a great match for him. Evelyn returns; and with an angel that only he can see as his wingman, Joe gets a second chance at a beautiful opportunity.

Entries.Title: La Dispute – NOWDTC documentary by Martin (CHAPTER III – Returning To The Womb)
Entries.Description: La Dispute – NOWDTC documentary by Martin (CHAPTER III – Returning To The Womb)

Entries.Title: A Color I Named Blue

Entries.Title: Fingerbib
Entries.Description: Tim Schwochow abandons his finger puppet web series, disheartened by the fact that no one is watching.

Entries.Title: Essence of Yourself
Entries.Description: In a moment of turmoil, stress, and overwhelmment, Celly, the brain cell, escapes her body seeking excitement in the outside world, unaware that her body is in grave danger, if she doesn't take a break.

Entries.Title: Soup!
Entries.Description: God makes soup. The soup is (somewhat) intelligent life. Existential chaos ensues.

Entries.Title: i love bottle caps
Entries.Description: teenager Sheryl is passionate about her love of tin bottle caps

Entries.Title: Paranoid Android
Entries.Description: Four people awake in a mysterious room. In front of them is a gun and a note: Kill the Android. Will they find the mechanical menace? Or will they devolve into pointless paranoia?

Entries.Title: When Everything Went Still
Entries.Description: A young man struggles to find a balance between holding on and letting go.

Entries.Title: Sylvia's Stone
Entries.Description: A disillusioned woman on vacation with her boyfriend discovers a mysterious stone that triggers an eldritch metamorphosis, forcing her to choose between mundane comfort and radical self-reinvention.

Entries.Title: Joy and Torment
Entries.Description: A writer becomes obsessed with creating the greatest novel.

Entries.Title: Munchies
Entries.Description: After lighting up and getting the munchies, a group of vulgar teenage girls stumble into a botched robbery at their local convenience store.

Entries.Title: Ghana Here I Am
Entries.Description: Nathan Pelle takes viewers on a captivating journey through Ghana's capital, Accra; known for its rich history, bustling markets, colorful traditions and evolving urban landscape, Accra blends the old with the new.

Entries.Title: Yonsei
Entries.Description: Feeling stuck in her acting career, Rachel decides to write and star in a film about her mother, who was a struggling Japanese American actress in 1980s Hollywood. But as she tries to adapt her mother’s story, and digs deeper into her grandmother’s history being sent to and falling in love in a Japanese American incarceration camp during WWII, she is torn between exploiting her family and friends to create a compelling narrative and honoring their privacy.

Entries.Title: What's Going On?
Entries.Description: ​The audience is taken through a range of years through archival footage exploring the ups and downs of our lives and the thing that connects us all, love. Seven interview subjects: a philosophy professor, a film professor, a humanities professor, a retired lawyer turned archivist, a volunteer, a dance student, and a fashion student, explore their backgrounds with religion, their current personal philosophies, whether or not they believe we have a purpose, or if the things we do have any meaning at all. Eventually everything wraps back around to love.

Entries.Title: Unveil
Entries.Description: Clouds, darkness, and fire.

Entries.Title: Pá!
Entries.Description: A dance video with original choreographies by Lucas David, Aura Guimarães and Paulo Montorio. The pieces were inspired by Baby Bobolete, a comedic queer clown from Brazilian television.

Entries.Title: Dallas, 2019
Entries.Description: A cross section of life in Dallas the year before the pandemic hit, as fault lines emerge between those who follow, make, and battle the law. This five-part series follows the harried lives of city workers, community organizers, and diverse citizens as they confront natural and human-made disasters, a struggling school system, and cycles of incarceration. What will the future of Dallas look like?

Entries.Title: i was never the siren
Entries.Description: This film is the first installment of the audio-visual performance work, Harana for the Aswang. Harana is a Filipinx serenade form rooted in courtship and grief rituals. The project reimagines and centralizes the narratives of various shapeshifting, mythological, animist, folkloric, “evil” spirits and creatures in Filipino folklore through the lens of their queer and trans descendants. Re-mything the Siren archetype, this film is in honor of sacred transsexuality and queerness through all timelines, a place for us to be swooned. To be seen in the defiant (im)possibilities of love and all that died in order for it to exist.

Entries.Title: Jokes On Us
Entries.Description: A young woman whose harrowing report of seeing a baby stranded on a highway sparks a nationwide response. As police, volunteers, and well-meaning strangers mobilize to search donations flood in, and a GoFundMe  campaign takes off, the public is swept into a wave of hope and empathy.

Entries.Title: Return
Entries.Description: An emigrant returns home after years.

Entries.Title: Live in Five
Entries.Description: After a terrible tragedy strikes across America, hotshot news anchor Lyle Rooker gets into a fierce argument with the producer of his news show, Allen Erickson, over how to accurately cover the story.

Entries.Title: The Concept of Her
Entries.Description: A storyteller with wild imagination writes about her dreamy relationship, but gets stuck inside her head and is forced to face the fact that her stories might not be real.

Entries.Title: Dancing Animals
Entries.Description: A woman with a smart phone tries to make friends.

Entries.Title: Modern Psalms
Entries.Description: Kings Kaleidoscope brings their pioneering alternative-gospel sound and ‘modern psalms’ lyricism with a deconstructed ensemble performance.

Entries.Title: Oh Paulo
Entries.Description: Riveting firsthand contemplation of image-making, aging, and interpersonal intensity as told through the filmmaker-photographer’s impressionistic recollection of his young muses’ beautiful gestures and projected interiority.

Entries.Title: Bloodmaker
Entries.Description: Join Ram, the moronic barbarian, as he belligerently hacks and slashes through zombies, skeletons, and other mystical horrors to save his kingdom from an evil sorcerer.

Entries.Title: The Royston Club: Live at Reading Festival
Entries.Description: Fast-rising Wrexham band The Royston Club play the Main Stage.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man Day

Entries.Title: Will You Come With Me?
Entries.Description: Maya, a teenage girl, must choose between staying on earth with her family and friends or leaving with her extraterrestrial boyfriend to his planet.

Entries.Title: Feeling Blessed
Entries.Description: An average, ordinary man must summon higher powers in order to battle the funky Captcha on his browser so he can rise above mediocrity and update the status on social media.

Entries.Title: Parallel of Dreams
Entries.Description: A young woman fights for her life as she navigates five terrifying realms of reality

Entries.Title: window at night
Entries.Description: window at night august 11, 2023

Entries.Title: becoming (in two parts)
Entries.Description: An exploration of coming out as both a dance and a ghost story — one where your present sense of self coexists with the ghosts of selves past and future. Are they lingering uncomfortably? Have you expelled them? Or are you inviting them all in?

Entries.Title: Wandering Horse
Entries.Description: A wandering horse leads to a wandering mind through the extraterrestrial beauty of New Mexico. An experimental microfilm made while an artist-in-residence at The Parador, Santa Fe. Animation experiments including oil pastel palimpsest, replacement animation, compositing, and stop motion, contained within a diorama inspired by the many silly horses of New Mexico.

Entries.Title: The Crusaders* Fake Movie Trailer
Entries.Description: Watch Historical Blasphemy's worst film ever made The Crusaders*

Entries.Title: Spring Comes By Itself
Entries.Description: Stranded in the U.S. due to visa issues, two siblings perform a Buddhist ritual dance at a secluded temple to honor their late mother, under the watchful gaze of a silent observer.

Entries.Title: Crackers: Folie à Trois
Entries.Description: The Crackers return for one final outing. Will they win? Will they survive? We genuinely don't know.

Entries.Title: Cat Town, USA
Entries.Description: In this feel-good doc expanded from a 2019 short, filmmaker Jonathan Napolitano snuggles up with Bruce and Terry Jenkins, an aging Floridian couple who've decided to spend their last days running a retirement home for senior and aging cats.

Entries.Title: Fourth Date
Entries.Description: A young woman sends a risky text.

Entries.Title: Notturno fluviale (meditazione sul rumore)
Entries.Description: A study of the concept of noise intended not only as an unpleasant sound but also as a visual artifact. The so-called high sensitivity in digital cameras allows us to see in the dark by adding an artificial grain to the video, sacrificing its quality. In these night shots, noise is not avoided but rather enhanced, thus creating abstract, hypnotic images that pulsate slowly.

Entries.Title: Karma Bums
Entries.Description: Fed up with modern American living, two vagabonds rob a psychotic drug dealer and decide to flee the country, taking a road trip and beholding the beauties of the great American West, en route for Canada where they plan to start new lives.

Entries.Title: the days we'll look back on
Entries.Description: A story about 6 kids who grew up together and stayed together, once strangers, then friends, now family. Both a video diary and a travelogue, this coming-of-age film explores the fleeting moments of youth, reflecting on nostalgia, connection, and the bonds that endure as we grow older. A chapter in the story we've been writing since we were kids, these are the days we'll look back on.

Entries.Title: Countdown to Slammiversary 2025
Entries.Description: Streaming LIVE and FREE on TNA digital platforms, the action begins on Countdown To Slammiversary. Get ready for Slammiversary with exclusive matches and previews.

Entries.Title: Experiencer
Entries.Description: A powerful documentary that takes viewers into the lives of those who have witnessed the unexplainable—whether it’s mysterious lights in the sky, encounters with extraterrestrial beings, or otherworldly phenomena.

Entries.Title: Misfortune
Entries.Description: A mysterious fortune cookie thrusts two friends into a reocurring crime scene, forcing them to decide who ends up the victim.

Entries.Title: The Gay Agenda 35
Entries.Description: In this series of shorts, the phrase "Gay Agenda" is reclaimed from the religious right and transformed into a celebration of gay culture. Sit back and enjoy "Boundaries," "Before You Go," and "I Am Not Afraid."

Entries.Title: Nate Craig: Married To It
Entries.Description: Live in Las Vegas, from Brad Garrett's Comedy Club. This latest full length special is all about America and parenting my son and trying to be a good husband to my lovely wife and also our awful politics and a bunch of other stuff. AI and the internet which is not real. Bots and misinformation are pitting us against each other and thank you for watching a live human being do something.

Entries.Title: Bomb Vylan
Entries.Description: Two rogue cops have about six hours until high-grade explosives detonate in a highly populated area of the city. With the culprit restrained in their makeshift interrogation room, there's only one thing on their minds... how do they make him talk?  A short film created for the 54 Film Fest's yearly 54 hour film challenge, 2025.

Entries.Title: The Art of Violence: Inside CZW's Tournament of Death
Entries.Description: This is Deathmatch at its most raw, real, and legendary.  Every summer, in a dusty field far from the spotlight, the toughest, most fearless fighters in the world gather for one purpose — to leave a piece of themselves behind in the ring. This is CZW’s Tournament of Death, the most revered Deathmatch wrestling event in America… maybe the world.  This documentary is a front-row seat to the mayhem — and a deep dive into what makes this blood-soaked tradition so powerful. Featuring in-your-face footage, unfiltered interviews, and behind-the-scenes access, it captures the violent beauty and chaotic brotherhood that defines TOD. From underground icons like Mad Man Pondo, Mickie Knuckles, and Judge Joe Fred, to global deathmatch stars like Big Joe, Danny Darko, and Joel Bateman, this is where legends are carved in glass, wire, and fire.

Entries.Title: Sonic Racing:  CrossWorlds - The Animation
Entries.Description: Shadow the Hedgehog competes in a CrossWorlds race.

Entries.Title: A Great Big Secret
Entries.Description: Dutch-born Holocaust survivor and retired teacher Anita Magnus Frank narrates her story from childhood trauma to adult healing, when she finally opened up to the world as one of World War II’s “hidden children,” dramatized with a collage-like combination of interviews, archival footage, and animation.

Entries.Title: The Norwin Band 2024 Season Documentary
Entries.Description: Details the traditions of the Norwin Band and the marching season of their 2025 show "Running Rampant."

Entries.Title: Cabeça de Boi
Entries.Description: In a rural Brazilian town, the ox's head symbolizes both power and stagnation. Upon arriving in the region, a stranger unravels the local mysteries through the centuries-old story of a cursed lot in the main church square.

Entries.Title: Pafos FC: Against the World
Entries.Description: An official documentary chronicling Pafos FC's historic victory in the Cypriot Cup, which took place on May 18, 2024. The documentary captures the club's journey from underdog status to winning the cup, featuring exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, interviews, and the atmosphere of the winning day. It's a story of determination, passion, and the pursuit of greatness.

Entries.Title: Don't Turn Off the Light
Entries.Description: Two people find themselves trapped in a living room when the radio provides one simple — albeit in their scenario, challenging, — instruction: to stay out of the dark until sunrise.

Entries.Title: The Killing of the Sheriff
Entries.Description: After nearly dying in a shootout, an old sheriff is forced into retirement by his young deputy. Desperate to prove his worth a nd keep his badge, he sets out to arrest the notorious thief that almost killed him - no matter the cost.

Entries.Title: The Duality Of My New Summer
Entries.Description: A nervous yet excited teen has a perplexing feeling about having a summer job.

Entries.Title: The Colin Theory
Entries.Description: Torn between a life of hedonism and acceptance, Colin makes the ultimate sacrifice for what he knows to be true

Entries.Title: The Book of Paradise Has No Author
Entries.Description: In this eclectic spin on the concert film, Ross Lipman transforms footage of one of his celebrated live documentary performances into a new video essay that's at once an archaeological dig and a riveting history. Its underlying subject is the origin of civilization - as comprised entirely of media clips. In the summer of 1971 Philippine dictator Ferdinand Marcos announced the discovery of a tribe of primitive cave dwellers who had lived in complete isolation for thousands of years in the rain forest of Mindanao. The Tasaday indigenous group represented a chance to witness firsthand the roots of our culture, and to explore the very essence of humanity. They also-as we learn-offered Marcos and his cronies a unique political opportunity.

Entries.Title: TEAR
Entries.Description: An agent that wears a suit and tie with shorts, must investigate a threat in the building.

Entries.Title: Hocheti Pocheti
Entries.Description: Amid the wild beauty of the Val di Mello, Luca and Niccolò tackle an unexplored granite face, forging a deep bond with the rock and a life guided by the timeless rhythm of nature.

Entries.Title: LOL Live with Chinedu Unaka
Entries.Description: In his debut special from Executive Producer Kevin Hart, actor and comedian Chinedu Unaka effortlessly weaves together stories about growing up with strict Nigerian parents in South Central LA, his previous career as a Special Ed teacher, and more.

Entries.Title: In My Dreams
Entries.Description: Surreal animation made with CGI and AI-generated imagery.

Entries.Title: All My Buddies
Entries.Description: All My Buddies follows the four protagonists of a beloved sitcom named all my buddies and how they deal with the turmoil and drama amongst each other on camera and how that escalates

Entries.Title: Breve como la infancia
Entries.Description: A quiet house in the mountains stuck in the 90s holds memories of the past, as a voice reflects on nostalgia, growing up, and the fear of what's to come.

Entries.Title: The Websim Movie
Entries.Description: In a world where the internet bends to imagination, Websim.ai becomes the gateway to an ever-evolving realm of virtual exploration. From nostalgic recreations of lost websites to surreal digital playgrounds, this experimental documentary dives deep into the minds of indie creators and digital artists reshaping the way we experience the web. Blending tech history, retro aesthetics, and interactive storytelling, Websim movie is both a love letter to the early internet and a bold look at the future of simulated webspace.

Entries.Title: Conversa com Miau
Entries.Description: Acclaimed journalist visits the University of Brasília and interviews students.

Entries.Title: Toy Hospital
Entries.Description: In the heart of Leith, Edinburgh, a unique sanctuary exists where cherished childhood toys are given a second chance. This short documentary delves into the Toy Hospital, a heartwarming haven where Kiaz, the dedicated "toy doctor," works her magic. Through meticulous restoration, Kiaz brings old, worn-out toys back to life, rekindling precious memories for their owners.

Entries.Title: Quiescence
Entries.Description: Lace finds a box, inside it something she doesn't recognise. She gives it to her friend Mal, to find out what's inside. Unfortunately for Mal, the contents of the box is banned in the current world order.

Entries.Title: Castle
Entries.Description: When the objects in her home start to act with a mind of their own, Alana learns to build a new space out of the chaos as a means of escape.

Entries.Title: Oneiro

Entries.Title: Let My Blood Spill Without Blame
