Entries.Title: Monster Slayers [Press Start]
Entries.Description: A girl cleans her room with the help of her friends.

Entries.Title: Soflty spoken from the other room
Entries.Description: Based on childhood recollections, the narrative unfolds within a fabricated house, unknown passages and rooms within. Acting as a search, following the distortions and errors that appear as memories fade, ultimately questioning the unreliable nature of memory itself.

Entries.Title: Birthday Video
Entries.Description: Syd has a hard time recording a birthday video for her friend's grandma.

Entries.Title: Paws and Tail
Entries.Description: A spider lady takes her pug child for a walk.

Entries.Title: Come Back
Entries.Description: Anaya, new to university, goes through a super-natural transformation.

Entries.Title: WE ARE THE MOST BEAUTIFUL PEOPLE
Entries.Description: A groundbreaking documentary film that challenges societal norms, exploring the profound themes of ableism, racism, intersectionality, and the distinction between Disability Rights and Disability Justice.

Entries.Title: Kintsugi Angel
Entries.Description: Filmmaker Lukas Huffman crafts a haunting visual poem featuring the wearable sculptures of Erika Senft Miller.

Entries.Title: Rubatosis or Liberosis
Entries.Description: In a tale of grief and rebirth, a young woman, paralyzed by the overwhelming weight of emotions, confronts the heart-wrenching choice between numbing her pain forever or embracing the agony to rediscover the beauty of feeling alive.

Entries.Title: Hustle City
Entries.Description: Three friends take on the Cartel but one of them is playing a deadly love game with an old fling he must survive war to get her back.

Entries.Title: MAYA
Entries.Description: Burned out and barely getting by, Maya stumbles through another tough day—until an evening encounter in the college library changes everything. As reality twists around her, she’s forced to see how small actions can have big consequences. What does she do now, forms the remaining crux of the story

Entries.Title: Please Stop Watching Me
Entries.Description: A young woman spirals after realizing you are watching her.

Entries.Title: My Neighbor Ed
Entries.Description: An isolated and aging man devotes himself to the futile task of building a time machine, while his next-door neighbor grows increasingly worried for him and wary of him.

Entries.Title: Trash Talk
Entries.Description: Two local park trash cans clash in a territorial dispute.

Entries.Title: The Director Movie
Entries.Description: A director fails to fund his passion project and brings together a rag tag group of scallywag's to bring the impossible to life, a commercial.

Entries.Title: There is No Dream.
Entries.Description: As a mysterious silhouette wanders through a dreamscape, a strange blue light begins to follow him.

Entries.Title: Valle Lindo
Entries.Description: After the rain, a walk to the park.

Entries.Title: Meta Take One
Entries.Description: An obsessive young director & his crew plunge into a frantic night long odyssey of desperation to finish his film no matter the cost.

Entries.Title: Terror in the Valley
Entries.Description: On a cold desert night, a drifter and his dog make camp — but eerie sounds stir the dark, and ancient creatures crawl from the shadows.

Entries.Title: Trae Crowder: Trash Daddy
Entries.Description: In this new comedy special, rural Tennessee's Trae Crowder brings his uniquely erudite-yet-trailer'y perspective to life, fatherhood, and America in the 2020s. From his experience as a displaced hillbilly in Hollywood to the love-hate relationship rednecks have with aliens, and everything in between, Trae promises to make you laugh...and not just at how he talks.

Entries.Title: Lone Mountain
Entries.Description: A prospector struggles to find his way home.

Entries.Title: Mallrat
Entries.Description: A dude attempts to convince others to join him in hanging out at a dying mall.

Entries.Title: A Bunch of Questions With No Answers
Entries.Description: A Bunch of Questions with No Answers (2025) is a 23-hour film by artists Alex Reynolds and Robert M. Ochshorn. Compiled entirely from questions posed by journalists at U.S. State Department press briefings between October 3, 2023, and the end of the Biden administration, the work removes the officials’ answers, leaving only the unresolved demands for clarity and accountability.

Entries.Title: Changing Tune
Entries.Description: Phil Mercer is a dreamer, a musician who thinks he can defy the odds of today’s ever more precarious music biz to emerge successful.  His path is reliant on his wife Becky whose emotional and financial support keeps the dream alive.  But Phil’s ambition is blind and his passion becomes poison. Now it’s the couple’s relationship as well as Phil’s dream that risks being broken.  A wake up call beckons.

Entries.Title: Arizona 3095
Entries.Description: Tara and June navigate a world that left them behind.

Entries.Title: Happy Monday
Entries.Description: Jessica has a lot on her mind before the work week begins.

Entries.Title: Crawlers of Doom
Entries.Description: The mysterious death of a jogger and other victims lead a sharp reporter to investigate the cause of these persistent happenings, With the aide of the local sheriff, wildlife biologist and nuclear specialist, they discover a radiation leak from a nuclear power plant caused mutations of the worm population of a nearby forest. Monstrous creatures are created with a taste for radiation and human blood. Can these abominations be stopped before they reach the power plant and cause a meltdown spreading radiation everywhere?

Entries.Title: Mistress for Hire
Entries.Description: Skylar works as a professional mistress hired by women for divorce leverage. When she finds herself falling for her target, Eric, she questions her career and her motives. But when Eric's wife, Octavia, won't allow Skylar to destroy her plans, and a dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with love and survival on the line.

Entries.Title: ALL AMERICAN BABY
Entries.Description: SHOT ON A IPHONE.  A high school student’s resistance to learning Spanish turns the classroom into a battleground of frustration, humor, and unexpected breakthroughs. Struggling with his teachers' traditional methods, he remains stubbornly stuck—until a new instructor arrives with a different approach. Through patience, unconventional teaching, and a refusal to give up, the student begins to see language learning in a new light, even as his own temper threatens to stand in the way.  Blending sharp comedy with moments of genuine growth, this film series explores the challenges of mastering something unfamiliar—without ever feeling like a lesson. It’s a story of perseverance, perspective shifts, and the unexpected ways we learn beyond the classroom.

Entries.Title: From the Grove to Graduation
Entries.Description: A documentary covering the History of Lake-Sumter State College, Johnson Junior College, and the Leesburg/Lake County area.

Entries.Title: Vane
Entries.Description: Vane is a psychological sci-fi short film that explores the consequences of a small yet significant action—turning off a fan. A student, about to leave his classroom, suddenly finds himself trapped in a mysterious time loop, reliving the same moment repeatedly. As frustration builds, he begins to question reality, searching for a way out. The answer, however, lies in the simplest of acts—switching off the fan. Through its surreal and mind-bending narrative, Vane delivers a thought-provoking message on energy conservation, proving that even the smallest choices can break the cycle and make a difference.

Entries.Title: Student at Law
Entries.Description: Bill Casey (Sam Wlezien), a self-proclaimed "student-lawyer," must defend his peer, Nick (Alex Liang), a student-athlete accused of cheating on an essay by his history teacher, Mr. Thompson (Eric Song). As the two prepare for the trial, Mr. Thompson's past secrets come to light while Bill crafts a defense for Nick.

Entries.Title: What Happened at Auschwitz
Entries.Description: Marking the 80th anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz-Birkenau, journalist Jordan Dunbar meets survivors of the holocaust and travels to visit the camp.

Entries.Title: Zane Lamprey: Medium Club
Entries.Description: Amazon Prime original stand up special from Zane Lamprey.

Entries.Title: 38 Jump Street
Entries.Description: After police officers Jenko and Schmidt prove themselves successful in undercover missions at schools, they get their most ultimate challenge yet: taking down a drug ring at a dance academy, As teachers!

Entries.Title: Crassa
Entries.Description: A short film focusing on a man pushing a tired women over the edge due to his messy eating

Entries.Title: The Unnamable
Entries.Description: A cryptic young creature takes the train from Dublin to Sandycove, confronting ideas of a splintered self-image, loneliness, and being seen in a fundamentally blind world.

Entries.Title: Mike Cannon Presents: A Day Out With Thaddeus Lockwood
Entries.Description: On October 7th, 2024, the worst interview of all time was filmed.  This footage has been released to the public for their amusement.

Entries.Title: The Wings
Entries.Description: In the isolated, absurd stage of the Penalty Box, two aging hockey players discuss their sport, along with the world itself –– both of which seem to be leaving them behind.

Entries.Title: The Bitch Got Stabbed
Entries.Description: Heather, a typical popular valley girl in the 1980s, struggles with understanding her queer identity, causing her to end her relationship with Christine. Hiding away her true identity in hopes it will all be forgotten, but the consequences of her actions are not too far away.

Entries.Title: Anemoia
Entries.Description: When a despondent girl tells her emotionally absent father about her intentions to move away from Hong Kong, conflicting feelings and internalized emotions from her upbringing boil to the surface.

Entries.Title: Blank Canvas
Entries.Description: Dealing with troubling friends, a toxic home life and minimal motivation, Bryan (Bolanos) remains stuck in a lifeless cycle with no end in sight. That all changes once he takes a leap of faith outside of his comfort zone, when a new friend Bianca (Prokuski) shines a light at the end of the tunnel and introduces him to the world of art.

Entries.Title: Quiet
Entries.Description: Two paramedics are awoken on the overnight shift for a 911 call unlike any other.

Entries.Title: Afterimage
Entries.Description: When his boyfriend Elliot disappears without a trace, Jesse is left to question everything he thought he knew about him.

Entries.Title: Baby Gay
Entries.Description: Desperate to finally prove her bisexuality, Stevie Lee bluffs her way into a lesbian threesome thinking she'll "figure it out" when she gets there. She does not figure it out when she gets there.

Entries.Title: Hostages
Entries.Description: Two young women meet up in a coffee shop to discuss the end of their relationship and return each other’s belongings.
In a dystopian world where soldiers are reduced to numbers, #45 begins to question his march toward an uncertain fate and must choose between obedience and freedom.

Entries.Title: The King In Yellow
Entries.Description: Based off the novella of the same name, Ezra Roscoe's "The King In Yellow" is the tale of the unknown, and what can happen if one is unprepared to experience it.

Entries.Title: SWEETIE
Entries.Description: When drugs are the only way for Oliver to sleep, he starts to realise they control his life much more than he would like.

Entries.Title: Forever Blooming
Entries.Description: A proud photographer who works for a stock photo company is pushed to his breaking point when a new employee’s natural talent quickly outshines his own.

Entries.Title: Edmonton To Milan
Entries.Description: Exploration of the human souls desire to move, and needs for safety.

Entries.Title: When A Doveweed Blooms
Entries.Description: A witch brings a doveweed into the office of an irate plant doctor for a checkup. They both get more than they bargained for; the checkup goes awry, and the two discover they're tethered together more than they knew.

Entries.Title: The Dam
Entries.Description: A woman encounters a man attempting to kill himself.

Entries.Title: The Demolition Lovers
Entries.Description: The story of a man, a woman and the corpses of 1000 evil men. Based on the My Chemical Romance album Three Cheers for Sweet Revenge and the song Demolition Lovers.

Entries.Title: A Series of High School Short Films
Entries.Description: A clown interviews Trump supporters, a couple struggles to find the perfect gift for their anniversary, a group of clowns hits the club, and a clown pies someone in the face. (man there are a lot of clowns for some reason)

Entries.Title: Bandida
Entries.Description: An EMT confronts human trafficking at her home.

Entries.Title: Second Bedroom
Entries.Description: Over the course of a day, 12-year-old Agnes goes apartment hunting in Brooklyn with her dad Peter, and struggles to come to terms with her parents’ separation.

Entries.Title: Mackerel-man
Entries.Description: A messenger receives a letter every time he delivers a package for the Kabbalah Man. One day, he finds him working at an ice cream stand by the road.

Entries.Title: Siren
Entries.Description: After Raven grows apart from her husband, the haunting presence of a mysterious stranger ignites her unspeakable desires.

Entries.Title: Freedom By Fire
Entries.Description: David, a college graduate, tries to earn his former best friend Arliss' forgiveness through an unusual request: he must go to Arliss' childhood home and clear out his parents' ghosts.

Entries.Title: Pop!
Entries.Description: A strange man encounters a small, peaceful paper planet. Unimpressed by his discovery, he begins to amuse himself by making a sound that has grave consequences to the paper planet and its inhabitants.

Entries.Title: The Shroud

Entries.Title: Beyond The Black Live at Wacken

Driven by Jennifer Haben's powerful voice, they combine orchestral elegance with hard riffing and anthemic choruses that immediately catch the ear. Their songs speak of inner strength, longing, and the power to continually reinvent themselves. Live, they radiate an energy that inspires both dancing and dreaming—a perfect blend of metal thunderstorm and magical storytelling. Beyond the Black prove that big emotions and grand gestures still have a place in metal today.

Entries.Title: Batti, batti
Entries.Description: In this lesbian operatic video performance of Batti, batti from Mozart's Don Giovanni, Sophia Zuzga explores the ecstatic and erotic dimensions of pain and trust through BDSM staging. Inspired by Annie Sprinkle’s playful merging of pleasure and performance in Sluts and Goddesses Video Workshop (1992), Ron Athey’s radical bodily extremes in The Judas Cradle (2004), and well as Florentina Holzinger's landmark staging of Sancta (2024), she pushes classical opera into queer, post-porn territory. Using 90s DIY video aesthetics and embodied impact, this project reclaims and queers a controversial aria through empowered kink.

Entries.Title: Fury of the Heart
Entries.Description: Aurora (Vanessa) embarks on a dangerous mission to face the ruthless villain, Wulfgar. Determined to prove herself, she defies the warnings of her devoted girlfriend, Verdra (Ophelia), a powerful warrior heroine who fears Aurora is not yet ready to face such a formidable foe. Despite Verdra’s concerns, Aurora reassures her that she is prepared—yet neither of them knows the true extent of Wulfgar's power. Wulfgar harbors the terrifying ability to transform into an even stronger entity, a force far beyond even Verdra's strength.  As Aurora confronts Wulfgar, her powers prove useless against him, and she quickly finds herself outmatched. Desperate, Verdra rushes to her side, only to realize too late that defeating Wulfgar in his current form will only unlock his full, unstoppable potential. Transformed into the indomitable Titus, Wulfgar becomes a nearly invincible force, far stronger than either heroine could have anticipated.

Entries.Title: The Revelation: How I Was Struck at No. 29 Parrocchia Street
Entries.Description: A loudspeaker broadcasts an irreversible announcement: Judgment Day has been brought forward. No one responds. No one seems to be listening. Authority has been emptied of pathos, the voice has become a function, liturgy has been transformed into procedure. Shot on expired black-and-white Super 8 film, with an old digital color video camera and archival sound material, the film traverses a fragmented and opaque reality, where the substance of the image is consumed along with the world it is supposed to represent. The film presents itself as a damaged liturgical object, a magnetic relic that still transmits, but from an elsewhere already emptied of grace. A fragment of the end, caught in the act of its stalemate.

Entries.Title: CARO Vapor II - qual a forma de pagamento?
Entries.Description: CARO Vapor II is an exercise in imagination and a redefinition of what Brazilian popular music can be nowadays. From Rio’s samba jazz transported to the streets of Conjunto São Pedro in Fortaleza to Baião meeting the productions of the Neptunes, the artist understands old musical proposals as dreams of possible futures, pillars in the construction of a country whose work remains unfinished. Digging through these ruins and working their echoes in the present, he dares to envision another future. The exercises of imagining the past that haunt us have been exhumed and rebuilt. While this unfolds sonically, Don L’s pen reinforces: the Global South is what matters. Don scrutinizes the aspirations of what it means to be Latin American nowadays, in a world where virtually all experiences are heavily filtered by the internet and those in power. Territorial construction is also mental, provoking the listener by repeating, in new terms, the question: how much of your dreams was advertising?

Entries.Description: The patriarch of an old-fashioned Southern family investigates the death of the prized family gold.

Entries.Title: Puncture
Entries.Description: A documentary about the piercings of love and ink, based in Nottingham, UK

Entries.Title: Ruthless Atonement
Entries.Description: Driven by rage and regret, Xavier embarks on a journey to avenge the murder of his wife and son. By any means necessary.

Entries.Title: Pining
Entries.Description: A salty, millennial gay wars with a spunky, Gen Z female he considers a threat to Fire Island Pines’ already crumbling shore while attempting to seduce the optimistic influencer who brought her.

Entries.Title: nightmare
Entries.Description: A young boy fights to stay awake fearful of what may happen if he falls asleep

Entries.Title: Prompt
Entries.Description: Science fiction film starring Lilly Bell.

Entries.Title: Wallflower
Entries.Description: Two People. One Crowded room. A moment that changes everything - without a single word

Entries.Title: Last Call in the North
Entries.Description: A town fights to survive being virtually cut off from the world for 2.5 years. While most communities reopen after covid lockdowns, Skagway, AK is stuck as cruise ships, the town’s only economy, do not sail and Canada locks its borders—trapping the town’s 1,000 locals and throwing their lives into chaos. After years of building the town as a northern paradise, families who’ve staked it all must decide if they’ll stay or go and what will be left behind—if there’s anything left at all.

Entries.Title: Mootation
Entries.Description: A group of aliens abduct and mutate a cow. But the leader's greed causes everything to fall into disarray.

Entries.Title: The Max Headroom Pirate Incidents
Entries.Description: A found footage exploration of incidents that occurred on November 22, 1987.

Entries.Title: Worth the Fight
Entries.Description: Follows boxing legend Steve Canton and his mentoring of ten fighters. Their compelling journeys reveal how boxing's discipline builds character, proving the most meaningful victories happen outside the ring.

Entries.Title: What We Owe to Ourselves
Entries.Description: On the day that Maeve arrives at Will's apartment to finalize their divorce, they relive the moments that brought them together and the moments that tore them apart.

Entries.Title: Jeb Rex Memorial Video
Entries.Description: Memorial for Jeb Rex, the presidential candidate for the Dinosaur Farm whose life was tragically taken from him.

Entries.Title: I'm Not Into Golden Showers!
Entries.Description: A fresh look at the FBI's investigation into the 2016 Trump Campaign and its many contacts with the Russians. What triggered the investigation, and what did it find? And why - apropos of nothing - does Donald Trump keep bringing up that salacious rumor about Russian prostitutes in a Moscow hotel? Narrated by Stormy Daniels, star witness at the 2024 trial that resulted in Trump being convicted of 34 felonies. —Joe Ayella

Entries.Title: Bad Therapist
Entries.Description: A therapist discovers she has far more in common with her client than she would like to.

Entries.Title: Training Video
Entries.Description: Bob Harrington Jr. attempts to revitalize his father’s costume shop business through a series of layoffs and implementation of new marketing strategies. However, he’s met with pushback after a disgruntled ex-employee, Paul,  barges into his shop and forces Bob to face his past mistakes by threatening him with fatal consequences.

Entries.Title: Harimau Merah: Resolusi
Entries.Description: Hakin continues his mission as agent PDRM collaborating with Wan, a former convict, rises as the mastermind behind a counterfeit money syndicate through his casino business. Using his new identity, Hakin investigates crimes committed by Wan. Alok from Harimau Merah instructs Saki, Waris, and Bobbi to investigate the counterfeit money flow.

Entries.Title: The Martian Newsletter
Entries.Description: When Simon receives a message that wasn't meant for his species, Arnold must use what he knows about humans to remedy the situation.

Entries.Title: Bouya Rage Bomb
Entries.Description: In the quaint town of Summersville, 19-year-old Bonnie is consumed by his idolization of WWW wrestler Nicolas Rage. When word come out about a possible meet and greet with the wrestler, one thing is for certain. Bonnie. Must. Go. With his loyal friend Bonzo by his side, Bonnie dives into a whirlwind of risky ventures in pursuit of ticket money. Despite brushes with the law and crushing disappointments, Bonnie soldiers on, fueled by a desperate determination.

Entries.Title: A Synonym for Art: Andriniki
Entries.Description: Andriniki Mattis reflects on the complexities of their identity and how they’ve navigated a world where they didn’t always fit in. Through their journey of gender exploration, Andriniki views their tattoos as markers of their path to wholeness and symbols of their emerging self. For them, tattoos become a unifying thread, tying together the evolving story of their body, identity, and sacred connection to self.

Entries.Title: The Sky Was on Fire: Ballet & War in Ukraine
Entries.Description: "We need to understand that this war will not end if we just watch it on the TV and then talk about how bad it is somewhere in the kitchen." To make art amidst war is a difficult choice. Are you helping your country survive, and reminding them that there are still beautiful things to fight for, or are you utilizing escapism to ignore and, in turn, help others ignore what is happening around you?

Entries.Title: When It Hits
Entries.Description: Two siblings clash while navigating their journey through grief in polar opposite ways.

Entries.Title: Thanatosia
Entries.Description: After committing a senseless killing, Peter Dolen is questioned by an enigmatic detective.

Entries.Title: Lily & Lolly: The Forgotten Yeats Sisters
Entries.Description: Imelda May explores the legacy of Susan and Elizabeth Yeats, two sisters who played a significant role in the revival of Irish literature in the 1920s.

Entries.Title: Take Me Drunk I'm Home
Entries.Description: It's 5 o'clock here. As a town descends deeper into their cups, one man tries desperately to ascend his stairs to bed.

Entries.Title: A Static Channel
Entries.Description: A couple tune in to a supposedly non-existent TV channel on a vintage B&W TV and enter the twilight zone.

Entries.Title: Demon Twink
Entries.Description: Dante is a lonely, middle-aged, gay man in 1991. He came out later in life, so he missed out on the experience of being young and queer, along with all the love and lust that comes with it. When he finally works up the courage to make up for lost time, he is rejected and condemned.  At his most desperate, Dante hears laughter echoing within a gay nightclub gloryhole. As he nears the fluid-drenched stall door, he quickly finds himself transported to the lair of a demon, who is ready to offer him eternal youth and beauty. Although Dante seeks more than just sex, he nervously accepts this unrefusable offer.  It doesn’t take long for the demon to reveal the strings attached–to keep his new body, he must kill his hookups every full moon, “when the gays are their most feral.” It turns out Dante is pretty good at being a killer, that is until he falls in love with one of his victims.

Entries.Title: The Abnormals
Entries.Description: A trio of superheroes, Astroknight, Cryptid Kid, and Showstopper, go on a mission to save the world from evil in a retro comic book inspired adventure.

Entries.Title: The Dark Road To Mr. Olympia: The Story Of Samson Dauda
Entries.Description: He faced near-career-ending setbacks and financial hardship, but Samson Dauda refused to break. Fuelled by fierce determination and the unwavering support of his wife and coach, Mel. Now Samson is determined to face the challenge of winning the Arnold Classic.

Entries.Title: A Tuesday Morning
Entries.Description: A weekday morning in a quiet house, from 5:19am to 7:31am, in one take.

Entries.Title: Dear Black Umich,
Entries.Description: A community documentary highlighting the intersectionalities of the Black experience at the University of Michigan, divided into 6 sections: Black Beauty, Black Love, Black Arts, Black Academia, Black Struggle & Perseverance, and Black Joy.

Entries.Title: Tim Loulies: Sugar Glider
Entries.Description: In his debut special, Sugar Glider, Tim Loulies delivers a wildly entertaining performance, balancing personal stories with sharp social commentary. Known for his unapologetic wit and larger-than-life stage presence, Tim opens up about retiring his signature fat jokes, weaving humor into reflections on health and aging. His comparison to a 'beloved infomercial salesman' is just the beginning of a series of unexpected yet hilariously relatable insights. As Tim takes aim at the ironies of life, he pokes fun at fitness culture, all while admitting he himself is far from judgment-free. Shifting gears, Tim delves into pop culture, and sharing the hilarious irony of being a bill collector. With Sugar Glider, Tim Loulies seamlessly blends personal growth, pop culture critique, and sharp observational comedy. His dynamic storytelling and fearless approach to humor will leave audiences laughing, thinking, and eager for more.

Entries.Title: Korban Jatuh Tempo: Pinjol
Entries.Description: Migrant children from Medan and Bangka who are struggling to pay off the PINJOL debts of deceased people so that their boarding houses are not confiscated. A series of ghostly terrors come when the former suicide boarding room is reopened.

Entries.Title: Blue Valley: Police Inquiry
Entries.Description: The first part of a series investigating the death of Andrew Jones in the small town of Blue Valley.

Entries.Title: APART - A PART
Entries.Description: “The title itself contains a Buddhist-like koan. Fascinating how breaking ‘apart’ the word brings us into coherence as ‘a part’ of nature. A linguistic mystery visualized, eyes wide open. This must be the footage from the Amazon(?) you mentioned some months ago that you recalibrated to provide a POV experience of merging with the rowboat paddling through the jungle grasses, bringing us into kinship with the riverway. I loved seeing the wildlife cam footage of the bear and the mountain lion…your stewardship of the land merging with the travel footage. And the fire sequence resembled a flaming flower!” — KATHLEEN SWEENEY, Eco-Artivist

Entries.Title: In the Realm of the Sturgeon
Entries.Description: Evan Evers investigates and attempts to stop the terror of the lake sturgeon, a murder-hungry fish bringing trauma to the Midwestern area surrounding the St. Croix river in IN THE REALM OF THE STURGEON.

Entries.Title: Hiawatha
Entries.Description: Two long-distance lovers search for a way forward (or backward) when the bedrock of their twenty-year relationship cracks. A midwestern rumination on loving across space and time.

Entries.Title: VAC
Entries.Description: A simple household chore.

Entries.Title: Cupcake
Entries.Description: Once Upon a Time at the 21st birthday party of the pompous birthday princess Julianna, an enthusiastic young girl named Delani is sent off to pick up cupcakes for the party. While out on her journey to get the cupcakes, she brings back something sinister along with her.

Entries.Title: Last Minute
Entries.Description: An aspiring director wants to submit his own short film to his school's media festival. With less than a month left to participate, he has yet to begin production on the film. His procrastination leads him to decide between making the project he's most excited for, or coming up with something else for the meantime.

Entries.Title: Frankenshark
Entries.Description: Shark expert Tristan Guttridge and his mad scientist team use CGI to build the ultimate "Frankenshark." Pulling from a variety of shark species, they build the deadliest, weirdest shark on the planet.

Entries.Title: PSYCHO KILLER 2
Entries.Description: A strange guy continues to stalk a girl who is ready to fight back.

Entries.Title: Dead Man's Game
Entries.Description: Following the death of Charles Verrot, his sister, Helen, and two daughters, Caroline and Ellie, argue their side of the story to the family lawyer, in the hopes of receiving the money in his will.

Entries.Title: Emergency Exit
Entries.Description: 'Stnic' - a band from Iowa City - boards a train in St. Paul, MN, en route to Portland, OR. They plan to perform on the train, as well as in America's 'weird' city. All thanks to the booking-work done by the band's leader.

Entries.Title: What happened to the brit crew? Part 2
Entries.Description: In Part 2 of what happened to the Brit Crew, we explore the complexities of putting your relationships online for the world to see. How this benefited the Brit Crew in helping them grow, but also how it affected them when life inevitably gets in the way.

Entries.Title: TCB - The Toni Cade Bambara School of Organizing
Entries.Description: TCB – The Toni Cade Bambara School of Organizing is a biography of the influential writer Toni Cade Bambara, whose literary works and film collaborations were a catalyzing force in 20th century cultural and political movements. The documentary is made up of stories shared by friends and colleagues including Toni Morrison, Nikky Finney and Haile Gerima.

Entries.Title: Hypnosis Lacking Diagnosis
Entries.Description: A man experiences a bizarre drive home from the park after believing he is being followed by a sentient Tennis ball. A Techno based experimental short that is inspired by Noir visuals.

Entries.Title: Porchè
Entries.Description: "Porche" is an American short musical documentary directed by Joe Redmond and Luis Angeles, based on the album of the same name. It follows the journey of two small-town rappers, JRGRETZKY (Joe Redmond) and Margiela Sorcerer (Luis Angeles) over several years as they attempt to find their sound and create an album with the help of their friends, fellow rapper CashStarChris (Chris Gnos) and filmmaker Jamdry (Jamdry Rodrigues). The result is a kaleidoscopic odyssey, a 30-minute long visual album examining the boundless limits of adolescent creativity and ambition.

Entries.Title: Gun Safety with God
Entries.Description: Listen to Pastor Pete as he explains the wonders of gun safety with verses from the Bible. Watch as his sidekicks, Monty Mouse and Sammy Snake, learn these lessons and have fun doing so.

Entries.Title: Hungr
Entries.Description: When Gavin feels like his partner, Jaime, gets more attention than him in their open relationship, he decides to switch bodies with Jaime to reap the benefits.

Entries.Title: Childhood
Entries.Description: A former child soldier living in Ireland reckons with his trauma as his son reaches the age he was when he was first captured.

Entries.Title: BKFC Fight Night Parker Porter vs Dillon Cleckler
Entries.Description: The evening's main event features Parker Porter vs Dillon Cleckler, closing out the fight card with an explosive showdown.

Entries.Title: As The Decay Encroaches
Entries.Description: A nuclear researcher and radio jockey's paths intersect in a shared struggle.

Entries.Title: Lilies
Entries.Description: On the morning of her wedding, Marie is confronted by Lisa, her father's wife & her old classmate. She delivers information that could strain their already broken relationship to the point of no repair.

Entries.Title: A Terrible Plan
Entries.Description: An aspiring thief tries his hand at cat burglary…with mixed results.

Entries.Title: Old Gods of Atlantis
Entries.Description: On life in the death of empire; what remains of a place that once was.

Entries.Title: Mayhem Rising: Miami Style
Entries.Description: Miami in the 1940s is hot and sultry, but Lin Finity, from the Fringes of Infinity series of novels, is always a cool and classy dame. Portrayed by Lexy Monty, Lin tends to her cocktail in a swanky joint while sharing some of her tales of broken hearts and broken bones. She recalls the confusion and calamity of her unstoppable power-her Mayhem-as it rose back up on its own after she'd kept it buried for years. People got hurt. People got killed. And when she felt infinity calling her, Lin had to split minutes before her boyfriend could offer a shiny rock for her finger. And through it all, even with her deadly Mayhem Rising, Lin had style-Miami Style.

Entries.Title: My Mate Sean
Entries.Description: A young man struggles to adapt to a life without his best friend.

Entries.Title: Michael The Gnome
Entries.Description: A guy goes crazy thinking a gnome is following him, turns out, he's right.

Entries.Title: A Tribute: To My Fallen Family
Entries.Description: A tribute to my fallen family. No one’s legacy should be forgotten

Entries.Title: Frontman
Entries.Description: Tensions escalate as a local DIY band's lead singer grapples with pre-show jitters and post-breakup anxieties in the hours before their song's debut performance.

Entries.Title: Kappu Bilupina Naduve
Entries.Description: Good defeats evil when a cursed being's supernatural reign of terror empowered by social media is ended by human connection

Entries.Title: The Other Hurley
Entries.Description: From the shadows of his own family to the pinnacle of college basketball, including personal struggles he reveals in exclusive and candid interviews, the ascension of UConn Men’s head basketball coach Dan Hurley is examined in a new edition of ESPN E60.

Entries.Title: We Know What We're Doing
Entries.Description: Three friends discover the body of an invisible creature.

Entries.Title: Self Destructive Damaged Killer
Entries.Description: A disturbed individual, Nathaniel is in jail for murder. No one knows that there was a reason behind things he did...

Entries.Title: NEVERMORE - The Imaginary Life & Mysterious Death of Edgar Allan Poe
Entries.Description: Delightfully dark, heartbreakingly comic, and playfully grotesque, NEVERMORE – The Imaginary Life & Mysterious Death of Edgar Allan Poe is a whimsical and chilling musical fairytale for adults journeying through the life of one of literature’s most prolific figures. Bizarrely beautiful and wonderfully witty, NEVERMORE uses haunting song, poetic storytelling and surreal imagery to explore the events that shaped Poe’s career and ignited his lifelong battle with “visions dark and sinister.”

Entries.Title: Kaiti Drosou: Memory Box
Entries.Description: Kaiti Drosou (1922-2016), poet and journalist, was known for her intense resistance activity during the Occupation, where she also met her husband, writer Aris Alexandrou. Her life, which was connected to important historical events (Occupation, Civil War, exiles), is reflected in her poetry, with honesty and an anti-heroic perspective. She died in Paris in 2016.

Entries.Title: The Good Ol' Days?
Entries.Description: A man named Michael wants nothing more than to go back to his childhood and abandon his burdening life, after dreaming about it for so long, were they really the good ol' days?

Entries.Title: Purgatorio
Entries.Description: You can't win a game you don't know how to play, but you also can't lose.

Entries.Title: Murder, From a Point of View
Entries.Description: When one man is shot, and there are two sides to the story, who do you believe? There is only one man for this job: Detective Jack Callahan

Entries.Title: Fine.
Entries.Description: A comedy short film.

Entries.Title: Scream: Love Birds
Entries.Description: On Valentine's Day, Tatum seeks dating advice from her friends, only to become the target of a sinister game when a masked killer lures her into a deadly trap.

Entries.Title: Love Seduces Innocence, Pleasure Leading Her On, Remorse Follows
Entries.Description: On the run,  slipping between dreams, two drifters lose themselves across the South of England.

Entries.Title: Lorelei's Lament
Entries.Description: After a cold evening of fishing, a man hears the enchanting song of the Lorelei, a mythical siren who traps him in her deadly spell. Unwittingly used to lure and kill other fishermen, he only remembers his horrifying actions through fragmented dreams and flashbacks. As the police investigate the growing body count, he battles to uncover the truth—unsure if he’s the killer they’re hunting or a victim of the Lorelei’s curse. This haunting anima

Entries.Title: Prey for Our Planet
Entries.Description: Lured in by mysteriously sweet temptations, a girl ventures deeper into the woods only to uncover a bitter end.

A group of paranormal investigators enter the same Oregon wilderness where Reed Commo vanished months earlier. As they delve deeper into the forest, they uncover a disturbing tape that reveals dark secrets about the forest, and Reed's disappearance.

Entries.Title: The Unforeseen
Entries.Description: Tobi and William are two amateur ghost hunters, stumble upon an old, abandoned house rumoured to be haunted. Despite warnings from locals, they decide to spend the night investigating.

Entries.Title: NOWHERE
Entries.Description: A group of government-employed paranormal investigators head into the countryside to investigate a string of disappearances, only to find themselves dealing with a supernatural threat like nothing they've ever encountered before...

Entries.Title: Come Home Monkey Boy
Entries.Description: Chris Klemmer, Nick Turani, and Kyle Bauer uncover The World Famous Monkey Boy.

Entries.Title: Heavy Metal Cannibals
Entries.Description: Follow the adventures of a college town heavy metal band as they become flesh eating cannibals!

Entries.Title: The S.O.S.S.B.U
Entries.Description: 3 Cornell students are broke and left with no money, they must come up with a plan to seek their way into wealth. Will they succeed?

Entries.Title: MATCH OR: THE ODD MELANCHOLY OF ONE SEYMOUR
Entries.Description: Seymour tries his best to make his date as perfect as humanly possible

Entries.Title: Anto Attempts
Entries.Description: Social media content creator and Actor, Anto Sharp tries to survive in the wild using nothing but Internet how to videos. Starting a fire, finding food and building shelters in the British wilderness. Will Anto survive and reach the finish line?

Entries.Title: Obelisk: Bunker to Beacon and Back (and admiration for Paul Rudolph's Mental Health Center)
Entries.Description: A place is an obelisk, reaching to the sky; down again to a point in the ground. Not a solid point, but a hesitant, mysterious one (some say always shifting). Ripples of life arch out from its base in unexpected ways. The obelisk series is an informal collecting of time and place haphazardly documented by two perambulating filmmakers.

Entries.Title: Villain
Entries.Description: The main character's second attempt to escape the narrative is thwarted by a mysterious camera.

Entries.Title: Wild Hope: Pangolin Protectors
Entries.Description: Pangolins are unique, bizarre, adorable creatures, but due to the demand for their scales on the illegal market, they’re also the most trafficked animal in the world. To turn the tide, wildlife veterinarian Elias Mubobo knows the solution rests in the hands of the local community — many of whom have never seen a pangolin in the wild.

Entries.Title: The Whalers
Entries.Description: This film delves into the history, impact, and lasting emotional connection forged by the former NHL team, the Hartford Whalers, in both Hartford and beyond.

Entries.Title: Outtakes from Jo
Entries.Description: Outtakes, commentary from Zefier's third film: Jo; or The Act of Riding a Bike.

Entries.Title: Melody's Parade
Entries.Description: A man loses a woman in the crowd. Suddenly, an explosion. The parade erupts in to chaos. Her ghost travels through the streets of New York looking to save him.

Entries.Title: Good Morning
Entries.Description: Newly engaged bas wakes up next to the wrong woman. Now he needs to get her out of the house before his fiancé comes back

Entries.Title: Kick Away the Smoke
Entries.Description: After a walk in the woods, a smoker discovers a homeless soccer player who always misses despite being close to the goal.

Entries.Title: Tessitura
Entries.Description: Three trans opera singers refine their unique vocal talents and contemporize the history of gender-fluid performances in the art form.

Entries.Title: Animal Eye
Entries.Description: Scientists and philosophers work to understand animal vision in this multi textured rumination exploring our relationship to the nonhuman world.

Entries.Title: Mar
Entries.Description: While crossing the US-Mexico border, a young boy gets stuck in-between two boulders, leaving his guardians to decide on whether to call for help and risk deportation, or leave the kid behind and secure their future.

Entries.Title: Tides of Change
Entries.Description: Through stunning visuals and intimate encounters with marine life, the film showcases the hidden beauty of the ocean and the devastating impact of human pollution.

Entries.Title: Rare Cat Skills
Entries.Description: Rare cats of prey such as the manul, the black panther or the snow leopard have unique abilities and adaptations that ensure their survival in a wide variety of environments.

Entries.Title: The Forbidden Love
Entries.Description: Kaimook, a 25-year-old woman, recounts her past love with Wayu, a rival gang member of her brother. Six years ago, in a rural town plagued by gang conflicts, their paths crossed when Kaimook helped Wayu escape her brother’s pursuit. Despite knowing the risks, they secretly met in a dark alley, falling in love amid deep-seated hatred and past tragedies. Caught between family loyalty and forbidden love, they struggled to find a way out—uncertain if their love could ever overcome the weight of their divided worlds.

Entries.Title: Friends of the Frogpool Lane
Entries.Description: Follow a group of vigilante crossing guards as they help frogs and salamanders navigate a busy road through a rainy Spring night, so that these driven amphibians can arrive safely to the unique wetland that is critical for their life cycle. Produced in Partnership with the Schuylkill Highland Partners.

Entries.Title: Chanel No. 2
Entries.Description: In a single night of debauchery and chaos, a group of young party-goers embark on a journey to the club, but for Chanel, the night becomes a search for something she can't name. As the line between freedom and self-destruction blurs among the neon lights of the city, Chanel falls further from who she used to be.

Entries.Title: Resilience: The Story of Ryan Porter
Entries.Description: A short documentary on jazz trombonist, Ryan Porter.

Entries.Title: Mario Rossi - Only the Name is Common
Entries.Description: Mario Ubaldo Rossi's crime novel begins in Genoa in the 1970s, when, in the Italy of the Years of Lead, his gang becomes one of the most famous in Northern Italy. Then the first murder, the fugitive status and a journey to hell in the harshest prisons...

Entries.Title: Memento Mori
Entries.Description: Do you know the legend of the Valley Witch?

Entries.Title: Out of Reach
Entries.Description: Two best friends spend the day together while their partners are at an outing. They find ways to overcome obstacles they face from their disability while completing seemingly simple tasks like ordering takeout or drinking wine. James and Sawsan seem to clash at the idea of asking people for help in times of need. While being independent is a sentiment to them both, the way they define it looks very different.

Entries.Title: Moguls
Entries.Description: This is the story of the unknown legends that shaped our music world

Entries.Title: Death is Little More Tour Documentary
Entries.Description: A documentary of the band boundaries tour.

Entries.Title: I Swear to God I'm Not Crazy
Entries.Description: A girl sends a sexually explicit DM to her celebrity crush.

Entries.Title: Shock and Meditation
Entries.Description: After witnessing an accident, a man contemplates the inevitability of death.

Entries.Title: Thiago Ventura - O Pequeno Big Big
Entries.Description: The fifth stand-up special by comedian Thiago Ventura.

Entries.Title: Desert Island Discs
Entries.Description: A film about times of day, places and seasons. Shot on two camcorders by five directors over the course of 2 months.

Entries.Title: Nelson's Battles in 3D: Trafalgar
Entries.Description: In 1805, Napoleon is planning his move against the Third Coalition of Britain, Russia and Austria. He is determined to finally defeat Britain, and if he can manage to get the French army across the English Channel, his huge and experienced land forces would surely capture the island. Only the formidable British navy stands in his way.

Entries.Title: Sweetbriar
Entries.Description: A woman wakes up to a call from her son. They don't see each other much anymore. He will be in town and asks to spend the night at her house. She excitedly agrees and begins preparing the home for her son's arrival. It is the day in the life of a single mother, taking pride in her home. When her son finally arrives, he finds her asleep. In a kind of role reversal, he covers her in a blanket. With this small act, the visiting queer son takes care of his mother.

Entries.Title: Lint
Entries.Description: Iris and Susan, colleagues who work for an environmentally friendly dry cleaning company in Perth, seek revenge against their sleazy boss Vincent with information about a mysterious couple through surveillance.

Entries.Title: Merry Go Round
Entries.Description: After attending a funeral, a man returns to a merry-go-round where he once cherished joyful moments with someone deeply significant in his life.

Entries.Title: The Package
Entries.Description: A midnight business transaction doesn't go according to plan.

Entries.Title: Reincarnation
Entries.Description: "A man is confronted with a haunting reality as he uncovers dark secrets about his identity and the truth behind his mysterious circumstances."

Entries.Title: Shades of Blue
Entries.Description: Taking a moment to look back, longing. These images, the cutouts of life. A quiet absence comes in with the light. Only my inabilities and a glimpse of hope remain.

Entries.Title: Off Right
Entries.Description: A short film by Jacob Bixenman, featuring Elias Rønnenfelt in conversation with Elizabeth Peyton at Giorno Poetry Systems.

Entries.Title: A Renaissance Cat In Modern Times
Entries.Description: “A Renaissance Cat in Modern Times” short film by Chloe White (acting, directing, editing, cinematography) for the 2025 Public Domain Day Remix Contest  Original footage is licensed under CC0, No Rights Reserved

Entries.Title: Hitman: The Slaughter
Entries.Description: The bone-chilling story of two hitmen—Foxy and Chachi—who part ways when Chachi decides to retire. Feeling betrayed, Foxy dives into his work with ferocious intensity, leading to disastrous hits, vengeful mobsters, and an encounter with a deranged pig farmer.

Entries.Title: Target
Entries.Description: An exploration of a department store.

Entries.Title: Aldo's Bug Extravaganza
Entries.Description: Join 5-year-old Aldo and his dad on a backyard safari filled with tiny wonders and big laughs. Armed with a camera and boundless curiosity, Aldo embarks on a bug-hunting escapade, narrating his discoveries with adorable wit and charm. As the week unfolds, Aldo's wide-eyed explorations not only capture the audience's imagination, but also subtly echo the timeless wisdom of Aldo Leopold, making for a delightful and endearing ode to the joy of nature's smallest marvels.

Entries.Title: this is all there is
Entries.Description: an abstract short film about a boy left alone

Entries.Title: Jeff Gets A Job
Entries.Description: Jeff quits community college, and he doesn’t know what to do next with his life. He applies for jobs, but nothing has come to fruition. While waiting for any opportunity to present itself, Jeff goes to hangouts and parties with his friends. Throughout the film, Jeff quietly observes the different paths his friends are taking to move on with their lives.

Entries.Title: Beyond Eden
Entries.Description: In the 1970’s, lesbians across the United States moved out to wild, untamed landscapes to build a world without men. Some of them never left. 50 years on, Beyond Eden follows some of the original Land Dykes as they grapple with ageing, mortality and the legacy of the Women’s Lands they dedicated their lives to building.

Entries.Title: hidden note
Entries.Description: A musician’s therapy session is interrupted when he is transported through a portal to face his inner thoughts.

Entries.Title: The Poet's Daughter
Entries.Description: Set in the 1950s, it tells the story of Annabelle, a little girl longing for connection, and her mother Margaret, a sensitive poet torn between her artistry and the demands of family and society.

Entries.Title: V3.SS3L
Entries.Description: An adventure through the anephemera of the criminal undeground helmed by garish visuals and the spirit of creation [and destruction]

Entries.Title: Sabr O Shukr
Entries.Description: 10 year old Akram can't wait to get a cycle, what follows is his first encounter with patience and gratitude.

Entries.Title: Self Portrait
Entries.Description: When an artist's work is destroyed, she struggles to come to terms with her perceptions of herself as a painter.

Entries.Title: Superhost
Entries.Description: Hosting is easy. It’s the checkout that gets complicated.

Entries.Title: My PTSD Will Never Win Best Picture
Entries.Description: A panic attack and flashbacks propel a young woman out of her apartment and into the world, where she wrestles with her fears and tries to make sense of herself as the main character in the story of her life.

Entries.Title: Cowboy Dinner
Entries.Description: Alice is a lonely bookshop owner who decides to bring a community of movie lovers together for friendship and companionship. Her successful weekly movie nights gather more and more diverse attendees enjoying films and potlucks called “Cowboy Dinners.” Along the way, the community finds healing and love, along with a surprise visitor, Alice’s long separated sister.

Entries.Title: Ghost Problems
Entries.Description: Two friends run a ghost capturing business, but have never actually encountered a ghost. Their last ditch effort is when they get a call to a school claiming to be haunted, and they end up encountering the queen of the underworld who plans to open up a portal and release her evil army to take over the mortal plane. Now they must work together to defeat her.

Entries.Title: Shall Death Brag
Entries.Description: A recent graduate must confront his past as he packs his belongings.

Entries.Title: Femme De La Lune
Entries.Description: An enchanting short that follows Lucile mōna, a solemn witch living in rural England.

Entries.Title: Crash! Bang! Thud!
Entries.Description: After accidentally killing his landlord with a pot, Perry attempts to stop his brother, Eli, from finding the body when he shows up unexpectedly.

Entries.Title: SUPERSPICE
Entries.Description: Two kids, Ximena and Angel, are on the hunt for the latest spicy chips!

Entries.Title: In the Maritime Frequencies
Entries.Description: For the past year, I have been working on a project exploring the coastal landscapes of San Francisco, using darkroom developers made from the solutions of our times - bay water, hand sanitizer, and “safe” detergent. The resultant movie is a conversation about how we internalize our climate emergency, letting mortalities large and small emerge only when the night puts our guard down. Inspired by the San Francisco Bay, dreams, and novelist Octavia Butler's vision of a future California. This film embraces the aesthetics of a crumbling society – expired and cast off film, backyard developing, hand cranked camera – because it is a premonition, a goodbye, and a last look over the shoulder.

Entries.Title: Wild Kratts: Activate Kid Power
Entries.Description: When the Wild Kratts are in trouble, they learn Kid Power is perhaps the strongest creature power.

Entries.Title: My Best Friend
Entries.Description: Two long lost friends meet at the wake of their estranged friend's funeral

Entries.Title: Trash
Entries.Description: Two brothers are given the hardest task a human could do. They have to find a way to take out the trash.

Entries.Title: Zyndagi
Entries.Description: An experimental video collage piece that investigates the concept of self-destruction across genres, eras, and cultures. Features footage from Abbas Kiarostami's Taste of Cherry (1997), Satyajit Ray's Apur Sansar (1959), Charlie Chaplin's City Lights (1921), and Jeff Tremaine's Jackass 4.5 (2022), among others.

Entries.Title: Grown
Entries.Description: A teenager’s simple mission to buy a six-pack turns into a chaotic scheme involving a fake mustache and bad decisions. Grown is a fast-paced comedy about risking it all for a cold beer, a little pride, and the worst disguise you’ve ever seen.

Entries.Title: Images
Entries.Description: A tortured filmmaker's mind is deteriorating, and the images he captures begin to do the same.

Entries.Title: De Matadero A Vivero
Entries.Description: De Matadero A Vivero is an audiovisual piece by the artist Fernando Sánchez Castillo that covers the hundred-year history of the building of Matadero Madrid, from its inauguration in 1924 to the current moment as a cultural container, through the Civil War, the post-war and other moments of disuse. The project arises as a commission from the Center for Artistic Residences of Matadero within the framework of the celebration of the Centenary and is based on historical documentation, dialogues with historians, sociologists and people who have been linked to this space in its different stages.

Entries.Title: The White Box
Entries.Description: A misunderstood outcast discovers an untouched nook in his mind he can travel to that allows him to conquer outside from just his internal issues.

Entries.Title: Benefit of the Doubt
Entries.Description: A heartbroken daughter attempts to prevent her alcoholic father from drinking, as she tries looking beyond his disease to find hope in her heart to forgive him.

Entries.Title: Ada
Entries.Description: Ada spends one last day with her mother…underwater.

Entries.Title: Import Models
Entries.Description: Three generations of Asian American women who shaped Import Car culture discuss their struggles, successes, and overall reflections on the impact of modeling.

Entries.Title: Know Her Name
Entries.Description: Know Her Name delves into the legacy of filmmakers and uncovers the mystery of why women, especially from underrepresented communities - like Zora Neale Hurston and Esther Eng were - have been erased through HISTORICAL AMNESIA.

Entries.Title: Variations on a Life
Entries.Description: A loose poetic and personal retelling of Mishima's Runaway Horses.

Entries.Title: Mamis Tvalebi
Entries.Description: A young woman is ordered by her mother to retrieve her drunken father from the sacred male sanctuary of their synagogue. When he won’t leave, she decides to break a few taboos.

Entries.Title: Strawberry Apricot
Entries.Description: A movie with coffee, strawberries, and fire.

Entries.Title: Juana Pelos
Entries.Description: A young Latina girl, getting bullied at school for her prominent leg hair, begs her mother to let her shave her legs. When her mom adamantly refuses, the girl turns to her older sister for help.

Entries.Title: Call of the Vulture
Entries.Description: Renowned model and activist "Angel Harris" finally comes to terms with her treacherous, haunting past in this time-skipping, genre-bending comedy-drama.

Entries.Title: Denouement
Entries.Description: A cowboy looking to make a better life for his family pulls off one final heist & begins a perilous journey home.

Entries.Title: Las Animas
Entries.Description: A journey across the former coalfields of Las Animas County in Southeastern Colorado. In the early 1900s the region witnessed one of the bloodiest labor uprisings in U.S. history known as the Coalfield War. The conflict culminated in the Ludlow Massacre where 21 strikers and their families were murdered by the National Guard and CF&I pinkertons. After the decline of mining in the area, most former extraction sites were gradually converted into wilderness areas or flooded. It is believed that the coal fires from that era still burn somewhere deep below the landscape.

Entries.Title: Scurvy
Entries.Description: After an aimless morning looking for his best friend Sonia, a flowy kid named Hansen finds himself brutally injured by a strange and inexplicable accident. As he stumbles through the town in search of help that will probably never arrive, Sonia restively waits for him at a set of old sewage tubes.

Entries.Title: Monthly Issues
Entries.Description: A college student visits his local comic book store every month.

Entries.Title: World Of Hurt
Entries.Description: Anthony Gleason, a made man in a notorious Crime Family faces life in prison for attempted murder. When offered a way out by an idealistic FBI Agent, he faces the dilemma of being an informant on his best friend and mentor

Entries.Title: Ideal Failure
Entries.Description: Katherine struggles to find inspiration as an artist after recently moving in with her boyfriend Alex. She can't help but feel out of place even though she seems to have it all.

Entries.Title: The Lost Locket
Entries.Description: A modern-day African American journalist experiences a dual reality when wearing a mysterious locket - a forbidden dreamt romance with a white soldier in 1944 and a modern-day love with a white Civil Rights Attorney.

Entries.Title: human care
Entries.Description: the seattle zoo

Entries.Title: Tiktok Trilogy: 4 Tracks, Stories and E-Girls
Entries.Description: "It would follow the exact same structure of James Benning's YouTube Trilogy, except recreated with tiktoks that were similar to the YouTube videos..." - r.c.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Patrick: A Slave To Ireland
Entries.Description: The story of St Patrick and his extraordinary mission from Roman Britain to Ireland to spread the Christian faith 1,500 years ago. In a challenge to the conventional narrative, this places British-born Patrick in his European context and shows how Ireland’s patron saint was part of a radical Christian movement that converted, not only the Irish at the edge of the earth, but also large swathes of Europe, to Christianity.

Entries.Title: Nicked
Entries.Description: A man wakes up on a park bench with over a thousand notifications. We dont know what he's done, but we do know, he's Nicked.

Entries.Title: Thank you for living
Entries.Description: A short film arranged and edited by internet personality Benjamin De Almeida in honour of his dog Kobe's passing. Largely a social commentary on life and it's meaning, as well as some scattered personal links.

Entries.Title: Leave Yourself Behind
Entries.Description: A college professor takes on a new persona for an evening.

Entries.Title: Predisposition
Entries.Description: Elena works a minimum wage job by day and writes music with her childhood best friend, Moss, by night. After having a strange out-of-body experience, her anxiety around being predisposed to schizophrenia spirals out of control. Visions of an ancestor, who she believes to have had schizophrenia, haunt her dreams and soon begin to bleed into her everyday life. The stigma surrounding mental health disorders hangs over her head, forcing her to self-isolate despite Moss's attempts to help her. With an important gig coming up that could jumpstart her music career and get her out of employment limbo, Elena must confront her debilitating fears to find comfort - but not a cure - in music.

Entries.Title: Languid
Entries.Description: Set against a kaleidoscopic view of Midwestern ennui, a budding romance becomes shrouded in mystery by an inexplicable disappearance.

Entries.Title: Suzy Stardust
Entries.Description: Susan, a teenage girl who was forced into the pop-star lifestyle by her mother, finds that her fictional stage persona, Suzy Stardust, has escaped from within her with plans to replace her.

Entries.Title: Friday at the Grand Illusion
Entries.Description: Two women perform a religious service outside of a movie theater.

Entries.Title: We Were Once Orphans
Entries.Description: Calvin, a new enrollee in an orphanage is greeted by Jesse and Frank. The three soon form a bond of brotherhood that could never be broken - until Jesse and Frank are adopted by a wealthy family. 20 years later the brothers are reunited through unforeseen circumstances and they immediately realize that a lot has changed. Now the brothers are faced with the dilemma of how to coexist.

Entries.Title: THE HEXED
Entries.Description: Two witches must confront a fractured past as their estranged sister re-enters their lives and a dark conspiracy threatens their bloodline.

Entries.Title: Man of God
Entries.Description: A dark comedy about David, a closeted preacher in the 1980s Deep South. After losing his lover and church, he inherits a Miami nightclub and faces his dangerous stepmother in a world that could be his ruin or rebirth.

Entries.Title: Independent Spirits - Another Whisky Film
Entries.Description: Independent whisky bottlers are the rebels and visionaries of today’s whisky world—crafting rare, exceptional spirits that defy convention. Created by the team behind The Water of Life – A Whisky Film, Independent Spirits is a documentary that explores these passionate artisans redefining whisky through creativity and craftsmanship. The film, which was co-directed by Greg Swartz and Guy Satchwell, features exclusive interviews with more than 50 industry leaders, offering an inside look at their dedication to sourcing, blending, and aging exceptional whisky, highlighting the ingenuity that sets independent bottlers apart.

Entries.Title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Fucking Spirit
Entries.Description: A reserved college student navigates new love while caught in the pull of a complicated affair with his professor.

Entries.Title: The Christmas Decoy
Entries.Description: A socially awkward man finds himself stuck in a holiday love triangle and learns that doing the right thing can lead to something real.

Entries.Title: Play Free: The Championship Journey of Auburn Men’s Golf
Entries.Description: Get an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at Auburn Men's Golf’s journey to securing the National Championship title! Witness the incredible journey of the 2023-24 Auburn men’s golf team as they capture their first national championship in the WarEagle+ documentary, "Play Free: The Championship Journey of Auburn Men's Golf." This documentary takes you inside the pressure-packed moments that defined the historic season. With exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and unforgettable highlights, experience the resilience, teamwork, and clutch performances that brought the Tigers to the top of college golf.

Entries.Title: I Still Exist
Entries.Description: This video is made from my scraps and experiments - commissions, old footage, some film tests. What started as a forgotten notes app entry to myself, became a video that I desperately needed to make. A proof of my own existence, and a search for something real. What I ultimately realized in making this is that before I could figure out what's next, I first needed to ask myself “what’s here?” “what’s left?” “what is the point?” before I could move forward at all.

Entries.Title: My Name Is Not Amy
Entries.Description: On December 30, 2021, the worst wildfire in Colorado history rages through filmmaker Dewi Sungai’s community. A fire has been raging inside Dewi, too. Born to a young single mother on Indonesian soil, Dewi was adopted by white American parents as an infant, renamed “Amy,” and raised in white suburbia in the U.S.— a story her parents framed as a simple, happy story. But Dewi is noticing the cracks in their narrative. She realizes she is not, never has been, the daughter they see.  Driven by a deep sense of loss of her culture, family, and land, Dewi discovers and reclaims her birth name, builds community with other transracial adoptees, and begins excavating stories from her Native Bornean ancestry. It pushes her relationship with her 83-year-old adoptive mother to the brink.

Entries.Title: Community Service
Entries.Description: Two delinquents spend their day evading the police in a Ferris-Buellerian attempt to get out of their community service.

Entries.Title: YOUTH PLEDGE
Entries.Description: SUMPAH PEMUDA (YOUTH PLEDGE) is an experimental documentary exploring self and state-crafted conceptions of Indonesian national identity of young Indonesians in the U.S.. Composed of scans of personal identification documents and participants’ objects of ‘Indonesian-ness’, recitations of the Youth Pledge, digital video of the Indonesian consulate in New York, and 16mm footage of self-identified Indonesians dressed and posed for a U.S. visa-compliant photo, the film is an exploration of what it means to be ‘Indonesian’ beyond national borders, whether here by choice, necessity or otherwise.  SUMPAH PEMUDA is a reflection on migration and displacement in an age of rising authoritarianism and fascism.

Entries.Title: A Small Fiction of My Mother in Beijing
Entries.Description: Dorothea Sing Zhang’s documentary instincts reach new heights in this intimate behind-the-scenes glimpse of her mother’s solitary routine as the star of Chinese opera, a life’s calling that alienates her from her closest.

Entries.Title: Unlocking the Potential: The Vital Role of Specialist Education
Entries.Description: The inspiring story of Emerson School, a beacon of specialist education, and its profound impact on the lives of students with additional learning needs.

Entries.Title: Theosis
Entries.Description: A short film reflecting on the orthodox Christian belief of Theosis: the process by which humans participate in the life of God, becoming more like Him through divine grace.

Entries.Title: On Guard: A Story of American Youth
Entries.Description: Set in the hallways of Bel Air High School in El Paso, Texas, the documentary follows an all-girl Color Guard team as they balance the pressures of adolescence with the demands of competitive performance. As they prepare for the WGI World Championships, a devastating mass shooting strikes their hometown. In response, the team creates a tribute performance, transforming their sport into an expression of collective grief, pride, and resistance.

Entries.Title: The Edge
Entries.Description: Following a group of characters who are victims of knife crime over the course of one rough day.

Entries.Title: The Tenth Minute
Entries.Description: A man wakes up next to a corpse with no memory of who he is or how he got there. As he’s forced to relive the same ten minutes over and over, a mysterious voice on the phone guides him deeper into the truth. But what he finds isn’t escape.

Entries.Title: Un lugar para mí
Entries.Description: One day of a lonely boy who finds comfort in his solitude.

Entries.Title: Oríkì Oshun

Entries.Description: Aimee finds a mysterious box outside her apartment. Upon opening it, she's pulled into a dark basement where an eerie melody plays and reality begins to fracture.

Entries.Description: A man has to repay his debt the only way he knows how: by creating a clone who can gamble for him!

Entries.Title: Frozen Jr: The Ranches Academy School Performance
Entries.Description: Live Recording of the Ranches Academy School Performance of "Frozen Jr.". A story of true love and acceptance between sisters, Frozen Jr. expands upon the emotional relationship and journey between Princesses Anna and Elsa. When faced with danger, the two discover their hidden potential and the powerful bond of sisterhood. With a cast of beloved characters and loaded with magic, adventure, and plenty of humor, Frozen JR. is sure to thaw even the coldest heart!

Entries.Title: Fruit Fly
Entries.Description: A raw and dynamic exploration of snowboarding, [Insert Film Name] follows Jed Anderson, Kennedi Deck, Jake Kuzyk, Cole Navin, Casey Pflipsen, and Devi Gupta as they carve their way through the streets of Ohio, New York, and Pennsylvania. Filmed between January 4-28, this project captures the crew’s relentless pursuit of creativity and progression in urban snowboarding.  Tanner Pendleton, Cole Navin, Jake Kuzyk, Mikaela Kautzky, and Jon Stark bring their vision to life behind the lens, while Marc O'Malley documents the journey in stills. Crafted with precision, the film is pieced together by Pendleton, featuring title design powered by some heavy-duty tools.  Made possible by K2 Snowboarding, with additional support from Ride, Skullcandy, and Vans, [Insert Film Name] is a testament to the dedication and ingenuity of a tight-knit crew pushing the limits of their craft.

Entries.Title: Socio-Zombie
Entries.Description: What starts as a quiet night quickly turns chaotic at a neighbor's party. Cloe, an immortal zombie girl, is reluctantly forced to wake up when the noise from next door gets out of hand. Politely, she asks her neighbors to keep it down—but when they ignore her, she reaches her limit.  Determined to settle the matter, she grabs an axe from her shed and embarks on a vengeful hunt. After all, she did try to be reasonable.
Supreme Court plaintiff Kuntrell Jackson reflects on his adolescence before and after being sentenced to life-without-parole for a murder he didn’t commit when he was just 14-years-old.

Entries.Title: how gregor samsa became a bug (canonised)
Entries.Description: This movie expresses deep expressionism of the 20th century through it`s visuals and audio. What Kafka wanted to express in a whole 50 page book, we here expressed in 30 seconds. The so called Gregor Samsa (Samsa is actually a playword-Kafka) lays himself to sleep, as he is supernaturally awoken, through pain and angst, as an insectoid. He can now only be engulfed by this horror and scream himself only to fall asleep yet again (forever).

Entries.Title: Distorted Consciousness

As her grip on reality weakens, she struggles to distinguish between what is real and what’s imagined. Her mental state deteriorates leading to a traumatizing internal /external battle that threatens her as the night continues, the boundary of sanity become increasingly blurred, pushing towards breaking point.

Entries.Title: El Mundo Sin Color

Through an intense therapy session, Daniel embarks on a journey of self-discovery inside of his mind, confronting his deepest fears and nightmares in an effort to find inner peace.

Shown through the lens of Charlie, a cigarette-addicted and ADHD medicated teenager who breaks up with his girlfriend of one year, Evelyn. His best friend Vincent warns him to tread with caution, aware of Charlie's faults and how they lead to his own demise. As Charlie meets a new girl—Lily, will he be able to finally escape himself and find true love in the ever so desolate landscape of adolescence?

Entries.Title: Elevated

Led by Andrew, the star of the elevator filming scene on YouTube, they use the magical multi-sensory experience of elevator riding to discover who they want to be and demand acceptance in a world that is not made for them.

Doing so, she is lured into working for a mysterious company that promises fame and great wealth. But soon realizes, her new employer is a mystery, for many reasons.

Entries.Title: Confidence
Entries.Description: Natalia tries to overcome her lack of confidence in herself.

Entries.Title: Suitcases
Entries.Description: Thomas and Lilian, a couple once fully devoted to each other, find themselves separated and in situations where they can be unfaithful. Their love shakes, their bonds break and their relationship shatters. With one last fateful meeting in the place they once referred to as home, they will decide whether they can move past their mistakes, or say goodbye to each other forever.

Entries.Title: Bulbank

Entries.Title: The Slam Poet

Entries.Title: Return to Cheyenne
Entries.Description: At 70 years old Jonnie Jonckowski, reflects on a defining moment that forever reshaped her life and the rodeo world. After an injury crushed her Olympic dreams, Jonckowski unexpectedly turned to bull riding, embarking on a quest to become the top bull rider of her era. The women's rodeo circuit, however, suffered from serious neglect, sexism, and funding. After championing the women's circuit, she was confronted with the ultimate barrier: the banning of women from professional rodeos. Determined, Jonckowski orchestrated a massive media campaign, challenging the status quo and earning women a historic opportunity at Cheyenne Frontier Days, the crown jewel of rodeo competitions. With the spotlight firmly on her, Jonckowski was tasked with not just competing but proving the undeniable prowess and rightful place of women in the heart of rodeo's most revered arena.

Entries.Title: A Stone's Throw
Entries.Description: An employee of a strange town's tourism office must give an eye-opening tour to an even stranger tourist.

Entries.Title: Last Call!
Entries.Description: Two siblings, Rootie and Tootie, and their dog, Snootie, attempt to ride the tallest rollercoaster at an amusement park.

Entries.Title: Glint

Entries.Description: Jim Davidson stars in his new comedy stand up Too Risky!

Entries.Description: Two lifelong friends search their hometown for a missing cat.

Entries.Title: Little Caribou

Entries.Title: Vestida de Blanco
Entries.Description: Juan has woke up with scratches all over. Without paying attention to his mothers warnings and abandoning his wife, he walked through the streets of Guanajuato… drunk … without knowing what awaited him? Entries.Title: 40 Epochs
Entries.Description: But where does the heart go when that voice is displaced from a body that still breathes? In a world where artificial intelligence accelerates and replicates the human form, the boundary between spirit and simulation begins to dissolve. Time, life, and voice become commodities. 40 Epochs is a hybrid-narrative film exploring spiritual displacement, fractured identity, and the unseen labor behind human-like technologies. Inspired by the artists' experience training an AI model to reproduce Sun’s voice, the film follows a donor in solitude as she reads, records, and revises. What begins as ritual becomes rupture, as intimate gestures entwine with the demands of machinic repetition. Narration is carried by the artifact at its core: a synthetic voice generated from Sun’s speech. Disembodied from its origin, it speaks in her place—an uncanny meditation on memory, embodiment, and the estrangement of being heard without being present.

Entries.Title: I Was There

She performs acts of bearing witness not just for herself but also on behalf of her grandmother. Together, they testify to their experiences and the reverberations these stories have over time. I Was There is a palimpsest - a layered tapestry where past and present intertwine in the intimate process of activating memory and vulnerability as forms of resistance. It honors the testimonial object inherited from ancestors and the living connection that binds generations in the shared pursuit of justice and healing.

Entries.Title: Ecos del Subconsciente
Entries.Description: "Ecos del Subconsciente" is a one-minute short film that combines psychological suspense with intense visual elements. Its brief yet powerful narrative invites the viewer to reflect on the limits of consciousness.

Entries.Title: La Piel
Entries.Description: Time advances and leaves traces, in the bodies, in memory, in the cinema. A child grows up in an uncertain world, while his father, camera in hand, tries to capture that moment and build a bridge to the future. Between fragments of life, reflections and farewells, the question arises: how to raise a child in a time marked by collapse? Far from the noise of the city, looking for another way to inhabit the world, the director receives a visit from his father, a man who once lived in cinema and now carries the fragility of the years. Between grandfather and grandson, the director discovers himself in transit: still a son, now a father. The skin is a portrait of love as a refuge, of memory as an anchor and of cinema as a witness.

Entries.Title: Alaska's Vanishing Native Villages
Entries.Description: A look inside Alaska Native villages fighting for survival against climate change. With the Howard Center at ASU, FRONTLINE examines why communities are relocating and why they're struggling to preserve their traditions.

Entries.Title: False Skin
Entries.Description: A group of survivors search for their friend in a world overrun by creatures that can mimic humans perfectly.

Entries.Title: Two Dreams

Entries.Title: The Call

Entries.Title: Time in a Bottle

Entries.Title: Living Without Nick Bovado: The Director's Cut
Entries.Description: The epic director's cut of "Living Without Nick Bovado," arguably more epic than the original cut and featuring never before seen content!

Entries.Title: new(bird) life

Entries.Title: Girl Scout Law
