The interviews and trans perspectives presented here propose that believing trans people's identities is the first step toward trusting one another again.

Entries.Title: Senior Year - 2025
Entries.Description: A film filled with love, laughter, and a whole lotta fun. Follow Emma along for an unforgettable senior year at JMU.

Entries.Title: By the Time the Light Reaches You, It’s Already Dead
Entries.Description: When a bizarre event occurs while microwaving his TV dinner, a man falls down a rabbit hole that may offer him the key to enlightenment.

Entries.Title: American Problems, Trans Solutions
Entries.Description: Black trans people are among the most marginalized of marginalized Americans. But those closest to the nation's most pressing problems are often able to craft innovative solutions. An award-winning journalist travels across the country to spotlight three Black trans leaders on the front lines of change.

Entries.Title: Sghetti Boys 2
Entries.Description: Cassius, left heart broken by his former friend, decides to seek revenge while taking care of his mentally disabled brother.

Entries.Title: LOG₂ISTICS
Entries.Description: Based on Logistics, the world's longest documentary, LOG₂ISTICS is a high-speed journey through a global shipping supply chain.  Reaching speeds of 400 times faster than the original documentary, 857 hours (nearly 36 days) have been compressed into a standard theatrical movie length of 2 hours and 19 minutes.

Entries.Title: True Potential
Entries.Description: After being visited by Death himself and an entity named "The Last Call", Austin Gets the chance of redemption as he receives one day to turn his life around & reach his Truest Potential. If not, that one day may be his last…

Entries.Title: The Chronically Online Tour
Entries.Description: Adam Mcintyre's The Chronically Online Tour from the New York City show in February.

Entries.Title: Soundings
Entries.Description: Soundings is an expansive portrait of the deep ocean, confronting the intensifying attempts to begin the first-ever mining of seabed materials. It moves from intimate encounters between dancers and sea creatures to Indigenous ancestral narratives and the hand-drawn maps of the first ocean cartographer, Marie Tharp. The voices of Pacific activists, lawyers and scientists resonate throughout, reflecting the nuanced debates. A rolling transcript relays the latest meeting of the International Seabed Authority (ISA), where states are drawing up regulations for deep-sea mining, together with a public letter from the Republic of Nauru stating its intention to submit an application to mine.

Entries.Title: Where did the days of your life lose their color?
Entries.Description: The title of this song (Icelandic: "Hvar hafa dagar lífs þíns lit sínum glatað?") is the opening line of the Icelandic poem "Söknuður" by Jóhann Jónsson. The music video follows an artist who has been sleeping through life as he wakes up and confronts loss.

Entries.Title: Many Moons in the Vacancy
Entries.Description: This work is an exploration of life’s transience and the suspension of time. After experiencing heart failure brought by Covid-19 - Lynn found herself sick and in-between life and death. Now coming out on the other side - this work is a meditation on what it means to exist in the spaces between life’s fleeing moments. Ghostly silhouettes emerge and dissolve at the threshold between the world of the living and a shadowy realm. Muted colors with vibrant bursts suggest the fleeting nature of human experience. A celestial expanse reveals a distant watchful eye of the moons - a self-observing from afar - detached yet intimately aware of the cycle of existence. There is uncertainty and the weight of unfulfilled potential, a tension between existence and absence.

Entries.Title: Reach Out
Entries.Description: In an intergenerational collaboration between Los Angeles-based electronica/soul trio Bootleg Orchestra and singer Roger Rigor from iconic Filipino band VST & Co, this short documentary explores the creative process of producing a song that calls for international solidarity for climate justice and highlights the role of music in giving life to a movement.

Entries.Title: Twang & Trouble
Entries.Description: Two hitmen named Sam and Dan are trying to find an old guitar case for their boss. When the case falls in the hands of two brothers, chaos ensues.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: Homemade
Entries.Description: The story of Peter Parker and his life as Spider-Man.

Entries.Title: Day 200
Entries.Description: As Ricky struggles to get out of the loop, he must also fight oppositions and leave himself clues in hopes that he eventually escapes

Entries.Title: Brutal Bastard
Entries.Description: A city where people wear masks to represent their profession, one man stands out, and it's not because of mask choice, it's because he's a cold blooded killer who is taking over the city one person at a time. With no care to human life, this Bastard is Brutal.... and nothing is going to stop him.

Entries.Title: You're On Mute
Entries.Description: A remote worker notices something sinister happening in her coworker and neighbor's home.

Entries.Title: The Reprisal
Entries.Description: After a horrifying date, Luke finds out that vengeance always gets the last word.

Entries.Title: The Metamorphosis (or The Life, Times and Shenanigans of Gregor Samsa and When He Turned into a Cockroach)
Entries.Description: Gregor Samsa awakes to find himself as a huge insect! suddenly he finds himself going on a grand adventure to save his sister  from a mysterious shadowy figure!

Entries.Title: The Marley Brothers: The Legacy Concert
Entries.Description: Join Bob Marley's sons for a concert tribute in honor of their father’s 80th birthday in 2025. (57m 16s)

Entries.Title: Nîmeño II : Au bout d’une passion
Entries.Description: This remarkable feature film tells the story of Christian Montcouquiol, Nimeño II, bringing together countless testimonies about the life of the maestro from Nîmes.

Entries.Title: Table 10
Entries.Description: Sparks fly and die as two wedding goers share an unforgettable night together.

Entries.Title: Alein
Entries.Description: An Alien invasion happens on a school day, and 2 boys try their best stop to it.

Entries.Title: JAX-ON
Entries.Description: When a good-natured Michael Jackson impersonator named Jax is possessed by a demon, a detective named Archibald befriends him whilst investigating a string of supernatural murders, uncovering not just the truth about the case, but also this mysterious man.

Entries.Title: The Fall
Entries.Description: When two sisters living in rural Oklahoma are left home alone, Ryan, the elder of the two, tries to sneak away with a couple of boys – but firstly, she needs to find her long forgotten weed, stashed away in the family barn. Blake, feeling left out, is tight on Ryan’s heels, and when the arguing reaches its limit, a devastating accident happens, forcing Blake and Ryan to reconcile their past trauma.

Entries.Title: Spectros: Algum Nome, Nenhum Rosto
Entries.Description: In 1976, a 14-year-old boy in Sorocaba (SP) builds an FM transmitter and starts "Rádio Spectro", regarded as the first Brazilian pirate radio station. This short film explores matters of resistance and freedom by means of this pioneering initiative in sound communication.

Entries.Title: In Tune
Entries.Description: Gina, a young musician, spends the weekend at her family’s mountain hut to focus on her music. However, strange figures intrude, disrupting the peace with their obtrusive behavior. The escalating tension leads to an emotional explosion and a casual flower jam.

Entries.Title: Lost
Entries.Description: A girl makes the choice to hide from her brother while they are at the park.

Entries.Title: paranoia.
Entries.Description: Found footage of a group of friends wander into hiking where they film a documentary  on the case of murders near a cabin, they uncover the horrifying truth that haunts the  trees in the forest.

Entries.Title: Harvesting the Power of Music
Entries.Description: How did a heavy metal festival take root in the small farming town of Armstrong, BC? This locally produced documentary explores the story behind Armstrong MetalFest—from the early pushback and uncertainty to how it eventually became part of the town’s identity.  You’ll also get a look inside the festival itself: the culture, the people who travel here for it, and why it means more than just music to so many.

Entries.Title: Now That We Are Sending You to The End
Entries.Description: A young girl prophecies the end of time. With salt, water, and fire, direct-on-film techniques mirror the slow violence of the desert’s collapse through a handmade record of ecological loss.

Entries.Title: Hangang Paradise
Entries.Description: From a journey of a visually impaired man emerges the origin myths of South Korea’s Han River and its ultimate development into a river of illusions.

Entries.Title: Sports!
Entries.Description: Two friends get into an argument over a football game that quickly escalates.

Entries.Title: This Video is About Apple
Entries.Description: A belated riff on Charli XCX "Apple" choreography popularized during the 2024 "Brat Summer." [Overview courtesy of Electronic Arts Intermix]

Entries.Title: Ignacio Socias: Soy tu papá THE GRAND FINALE
Entries.Description: In "Soy tu Papá," his latest one-man show, Socías demonstrates his ability to explore universal themes with humor and depth. He addresses the complexities of modern fatherhood, changing family dynamics and intergenerational challenges, creating a show that resonates with diverse audiences.

Entries.Title: The Litterbug
Entries.Description: Park Ranger Charlie and her young recruit Ranger Casey track down a serial litterer, the Litterbug.

Entries.Title: Bird on a Wire
Entries.Description: There is a bird on a wire.

Entries.Title: Sweetness in Abundance Everywhere
Entries.Description: Vasquez La Roche’s practice is interested in aspects of the transatlantic slave trade that repeat themselves in varying ways in present. Aspects such as labour, death, erasure, oppression, violence, and discrimination are profoundly present.

Entries.Title: Stars Diner
Entries.Description: Wendy has learned that the bank is coming to foreclose on the diner unless they get their books in order, which she doesn’t know how to do. While Milius urges her to stand up to the bank “goons”, two volcanologists complain about the slow service. Their whining is cut short by a one-in-a-million volcanic eruption.

Entries.Title: Rumble
Entries.Description: Two sisters- Ribs and BabyGirl- return to The Factory for the first time in a year. The last time they were there, a typical rumble with their rival girl gang The Kittens, turned into a traumatic night that they still haven't moved on from.

Entries.Title: PASALUBONG!
Entries.Description: In an airport mall, two friends who've formed a life-changing friendship spend their last day together before they part ways.

Entries.Title: Love Me Tender, Love Me True
Entries.Description: A middle-aged man struggling with self-esteem prepares for an Elvis impersonation performance, only to face his greatest fear when his mother shows up at the show.

Entries.Title: Midnight Eyes
Entries.Description: Antonio is attempted to be robbed in an alley by Rocco. He then pulls a weapon on Rocco and takes him as his own.

Entries.Title: Weisse Bänder
Entries.Description: A white ribbon winds incessantly down from the summit towards the valley, flowing around flowers and mushrooms, dripping over moss and roots. Until the strange trickle turns into a small stream and reaches civilization. A bizarre-looking natural spectacle of eerie beauty.

Entries.Title: Chestnut
Entries.Description: A young Joey Chestnut navigates dominant rivals, an angry girlfriend, and a jealous brother in pursuit of his first hot dog eating championship win.

Entries.Title: Land of the Tea
Entries.Description: A class-A Paul Revere hater goes to the future and realizes that Paul might save the one thing he loves the most.  A short film made for the 2025 Boston 48 Hour Film Project by the Letterbox of Arabia team.

Entries.Title: Sewing Machine
Entries.Description: Heather, a young fashion designer, is working on her latest collection when a knock at the door changes everything. Left on her doorstep is a mysterious sewing machine, seemingly a gift - but it carries a lot more than just bad vibes. Heather discovers the ominous machine is tied to a demonic entity hell-bent on her destruction.

Entries.Title: Striya
Entries.Description: In the middle of the night, the beis din of a small medieval town is embroiled in an argument over whether – and how – to put teenage Gele to death for an unnamed offense. Her father, Ansel, soon arrives to make his case for allowing her to live, but his pleas fall on deaf ears. Meanwhile, Gele escapes and makes her way to the rabbi’s home, where the true horror of her supernatural transformation is revealed.

Entries.Title: Teagan and His Bros
Entries.Description: Teagan and His Bros is a show about two lovable stoners that adopt a cat who's...also a stoner. In this four episode "first season," Connor and Bobby learn what it truly means to own and love a cat with the help of their Muppet-esque talking feline Teagan.

Entries.Title: Dating Woof
Entries.Description: Dating Woof is about a gamer girl meets her mysterious online rival in real life—only to discover he’s actually a.....

Entries.Title: Rancid
Entries.Description: An experimental black and white short film by stikarto

Entries.Title: Try Digital Realism
Entries.Description: A short film about a super advanced VR device

Entries.Title: Berated by the Orb at the Office
Entries.Description: A man in an industrial office hellscape is under the surveillance of his boss, a large ominous red orb.

Entries.Title: In Your Shadow
Entries.Description: Teenage boy starts to grow into himself much to his parent’s dismay.

Entries.Title: CYBERSKATERS
Entries.Description: Extreme sports and video games collide in a neon soaked roller race - where the only way out is victory on the track. Who will get the high score and who will end up in megabytes?

Entries.Title: Low Spirits
Entries.Description: An affectionate cat tries to cheer up their owner one last time.

Entries.Title: Lucy and the Boundless Sky
Entries.Description: A father brings his daughter to a ceremony, where she will fly off to become a star in the sky.

Entries.Title: Blank Roll
Entries.Description: Can image represents the truth or preserves the reality?   In 2023, during my travel in Mexico, I had a serendipitous encounter with a 6-year-old boy at an archaeological site. We went into the jungle for adventures, where he guided me to the undeveloped area of underground Mayan tunnels, temple, showing me the endemic animals and plants. I took pictures of him with my film camera, but the rolls were completely blank after develop.

Entries.Title: Der Wettkampf meines Lebens - Die Geschichte von Axel Mitbauer
Entries.Description: On the night of August 17, 1969, the former GDR professional swimmer Axel Mitbauer swam from Boltenhagen (former GDR) to the Bay of Lübeck (former FRG). He covered a distance of around 25 km through the Baltic Sea. Before his spectacular escape from the GDR regime, he was imprisoned and interrogated by the Stasi (former secret police of the GDR) for several weeks as a result of various circumstances. As a grim consequence of his arrest, Axel Mitbauer was banned from sport and swimming in the GDR for life - the death blow to his sporting career in his former homeland and at the same time the impetus for one of the most unique escape attempts in the history of divided Germany. This film tells his story.

Entries.Title: The Test
Entries.Description: A boy (Alex) prepares for a test that he is very stressed about while his careless friend (Chris) thinks he will do good on. While studying, strange things start happening to Alex.

Entries.Title: Eeek!
Entries.Description: Following The Legend of Gourdface, Jesse, Nicole, Paul, and Felix hatch a plan to capture proof of the paranormal for a town-wide photo contest. While rumors of poltergeists and long forgotten cults haunt the hallways of the once-grand “Mourning Manor,” what really lurks inside is something sure to place first.

Entries.Title: Leela sundaram
Entries.Description: Two souls face external conflicts in their marriage, the battle slowly turns inward, unfolding into a deeply personal struggle that defines the rest of their journey.

Entries.Title: Pithan
Entries.Description: Kadhir, Jeeva, Krishna, Goutham and Kayal grapple with a demonic summoning in a search to make online content.

Entries.Title: A Few More Steps....
Entries.Description: A young couple go on a hike to escape the confines of their home, but when her boyfriend, Jake, goes missing, Amanda must find her way out of the forest before the darkness falls on her.

Entries.Title: Shan de Ling Yi Mian
Entries.Description: A filmmaker follows her father, an artist, in search of his childhood home in Southwestern China, fulfilling a wish of his aging mother. Changed by the tides of history, the streets are unrecognizable. Father and daughter meander through time, contemplating what it means to see and make images.

Entries.Title: Wohnjuwel
Entries.Description: A real estate agent shows clients around a vacant house. She finally meets a difficult customer who oversteps her boundaries.

Entries.Title: Light Fragments
Entries.Description: Once-seen dream, a place buried beneath the accumulation of time. Fragments of uncertain light floating between reality and sleep. Chains of flickering and repeating images.

Entries.Title: Out the Window
Entries.Description: A man in distress discovers what happens when you mess with the wrong guy.

Entries.Title: Astrodomus Never Predicted AI
Entries.Description: Dying young is not an option anymore

Entries.Title: Insaneshitter - A Documentary
Entries.Description: A once in a life-time, generationally exceptional, guerilla-styled documentary about the rise of Germany's most exciting musical Duo

Entries.Title: YOREBODY
Entries.Description: Studying stained glass, lines are drawn between the function of light and the space of time and the relationship between art, bodies, color, history, and buildings.

Entries.Title: AEW Road to Double or Nothing
Entries.Description: Don't miss the Road to Double or Nothing!

Entries.Title: Rocco
Entries.Description: In the hustle of New York City, Rocco feels small, lonely and alienated. He harbors a big heart and an even bigger dream of finding true love. Will he ever find it? Wandering the maze of the big city, he discovers the importance of being true to oneself and the beauty of fleeting moments.

Entries.Title: Land Lines
Entries.Description: Living In the shadows of an engineering marvel of the twentieth century is a place where the old New York still exists.  A haunted waterfront where people go to be alone in a city that increasingly watches your every step.  A place where you can make a call on an analog payphone while you watch massive ships pass through the misty channel.

Entries.Title: I am a Microscope
Entries.Description: This is a 2 channel installation consisting of two separate films made by painting directly onto 35mm film and working with various chemical solvents. The two films are projected side by side and slightly out of sync, creating a type of 'visual stereo' as they make random juxtapositions. The soundtrack being slightly out of sync creates an echo, so as the audience moves around the installation the sound changes, creating an aural sense of the space.

Entries.Title: Transmission Not Received
Entries.Description: Drew, a trans man, is suddenly reunited with an old friend, but when she fails to recognize him, he decides to keep their history a secret.

Entries.Title: The Last Bell
Entries.Description: A quiet, rain-drenched reflection on the emotions that come with the end of an era. In just 54 seconds, The Last Bell captures the unspoken weight of finishing high school — a mix of peace, sadness, and something unnamed. No classrooms, no crowds, just the feeling of goodbye hanging in the air like the rain: heavy, soft, and unforgettable.

Entries.Title: MONOCHROME
Entries.Description: A young man with PTSD is forced to confront his past and the demon that haunts him.

Entries.Title: Fortnite: The Musical
Entries.Description: 4 friends are magically transported into the world of Fortnite by the powerful Tooth Fairy. With nothing but each other to rely on the stop the evil Nick eh 30 and learn the value of teamwork.  This production was performed on May 24th 2024 for West Seneca East Senior’s short play and musical festival.

Entries.Title: Foot Step
Entries.Description: A short concept film for a series that follows the lives of different women as they navigate their way through a zombie apocalypse. This film shows a girl fleeing a facility of men who have taken her hostage in an attempt to try and restart humanity.

Entries.Title: My Own Damn Fault
Entries.Description: Two Chicago roommates handle a home invasion.

Entries.Title: Aooo -『Flash!!!!』
Entries.Description: Aooo 1st album “Aooo” release commemorative free live “Flash!!!!” 18th Ocotober, 2024  Free live “Flash!!!!” will be held at Cinecity Plaza in front of Tokyu Kabukicho Tower

Entries.Title: Remember Me!
Entries.Description: Childhood friends drift apart when the boy falls in love.

Entries.Title: Notice of Readiness
Entries.Description: Him and Her just broke up and there's a night of saying goodbye ahead of them. But some things are not as closed as they may seem.

Entries.Title: Vom Ende her gedacht
Entries.Description: Short film about death.

Entries.Title: Re: Unser Zuhause im Frankfurter Bahnhofsviertel
Entries.Description: Frankfurt's station district: many people only think of drugs, crime and social neglect. For tourists from all over Europe, "Zombieland" has become a freak show that they can either gawk at or use as a party zone. But the area around the central station is much more than that: it is also a place of cohesion, hope and change.

Entries.Title: Anónimo
Entries.Description: A monologue about a lost love

Entries.Title: The Shower
Entries.Description: A woman takes a shower.

Entries.Title: The Attendee
Entries.Description: A man is lured into a building, experiencing a seemingly life altering event.

Entries.Title: Brainwashed
Entries.Description: When a high school student realizes she's the only kid in the school that hasn't been brainwashed, she sets it up on herself to save everyone.

Entries.Title: Freeman Vines
Entries.Description: Freeman Vines built his first guitar when he was a teenager. Now 82-years-old and battling multiple myeloma, he's desperately trying to make a guitar that can reproduce an elusive sound the instrument made decades ago.

Entries.Title: The Piano
Entries.Description: One night, a young girl discovers her father bent over the keys at the piano, sparking a lifelong bond that resonates far beyond their final note.

Entries.Title: Whiskey
Entries.Description: An ex-couple's past bubbles to the surface over a discussion of drinks.

Entries.Title: BET ON ME | The Zakai Zeigler Story
Entries.Description: Standing just 5-9, Zakai Zeigler emerged from New York City obscurity to become the most decorated (and winningest) point guard in Tennessee Basketball history. Through exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access with Zeigler and those who followed his journey closest, BET ON ME chronicles Zeigler's meteoric rise and the tragedies that threatened to derail it all.

Entries.Title: Show Me How to Live
Entries.Description: A pair of enslaved clones escape to the wilderness in an attempt to discover their humanity.

Entries.Title: School Seasons
Entries.Description: When a high school senior moves to a new school, he quickly discovers that his teacher and all his classmates are utterly insane. He must navigate a minefield of oddities as the only normal person in the picture.

Entries.Title: What Is Going
Entries.Description: An unnamed person finds a magic trunk that teleports objects and people to them. What is Going is a queer contribution to surreal silent cinema exploring liminal space, compulsion, the pain of letting go, and the unresolved anguish of being let go of.

Entries.Title: pistanthrophobia
Entries.Description: A girl is stalked by her subconscious fear of intimacy.

Entries.Title: Clarity
Entries.Description: Short film screened at Chicago Horror Film Festival 2025 about a woman in recovery from addiction using a mindfulness app.

Entries.Title: Spiritus: No Business Like Dough Business
Entries.Description: Highlighting the rich history of one of the oldest and beloved family-run businesses in Provincetown—Spiritus Pizza is a local gem and iconic late-night gathering spot. Featuring homespun interviews with owner John Yingling and many former employees, SPIRITUS explores the challenges faced by the business, the queer community and the AIDS crisis, all against the backdrop of changing attitudes in the town during the 1970s and ’80s. Since its founding in 1971, and through the ensuing decades, Spiritus has remained a vibrant epicenter of activity, resilience, and deeply-rooted history in Provincetown—as well as a slice of pizza heaven!

Entries.Title: Queer Study
Entries.Description: A hopeless romantic tries desperately to figure out if her best friend and current beau is gay in the worst ways possible.

Entries.Title: Ya casi se ve el mar
Entries.Description: A group of friends spends their holidays in Tenerife. Through their wandering and inscription in the images, this project explores the answers to the question: why do we call each other friends?

Entries.Title: Early Version of Benny Feldman's Butterfly Pavilion
Entries.Description: Benny Feldman, a New York comedian with Tourette Syndrome, perfoms over 100 jokes about bugs, feces, steam punk, Ratatouille (2007), and so much more

Entries.Title: Orcagasm
Entries.Description: “Orcagasm” is a fantastical, stop-motion animation that follows two furries as they explore. They are cutting-edge, futuristic orca whale fur suits. Meanwhile, a hapless eraser is tasked with the cleanup of their antics.

Entries.Title: You Should Say Fuck Too
Entries.Description: An aspiring porn star and a local sex worker cum together to shoot an unconventionally adult film.

Entries.Title: Breaking Glass
Entries.Description: A young play-write is about to make his debut in a non profit theater, unfortunately his less than enthusiastic employees are causing him great dismay. Some trying to hit on other co-workers while others are having altercations with the triad.

Entries.Title: Prosperous Pairs
Entries.Description: In a desperate bid to save her dying brother, Asha enrolls in a shadowy program promising wealth and security, only to find herself drawn into a dangerous world of deception and decay. [Overview courtesy of Jibran Ahmed]

Entries.Title: Trying and Trying
Entries.Description: A couple navigates an awkward situation, a woman goes for a drive, and a celebrity scrolls through YouTube Shorts.

Entries.Title: Eugene Onegin
Entries.Description: Premiered at the Maly Theatre of the Moscow Conservatory in 1879, 46 years after the novel’s publication, Eugene Onegin follows the story of a self-centered hero who dismisses love and accepts a duel with deadly consequences. Tchaikovsky admired the work's "infinity of poetry" in letters to his brother. However, while Pushkin’s verse is often sharp and satirical, Tchaikovsky’s music emphasizes the characters’ strength of feeling. Join a brilliant lineup — including Ukrainian baritone Iurii Samoilov as Onegin and soprano Kristina Mkhitaryan as Tatyana — alongside the Chorus and Orchestra of the Teatro Real, led by conductor Gustavo Gimeno, in this "profound and intimate exploration of love, regret, and honor" (OperaWire).

Entries.Title: DEEP SILVER
Entries.Description: A young man struggling with a shopping addiction embarks on a fashion-fueled journey to cleanse himself of an ailment called "Deep Silver."

Entries.Title: Cuttlefish
Entries.Description: A hitman, desensitized and emotionless from his violent job, becomes infatuated with a women he has to kill, leading him down a path of redemption...

Entries.Title: IMNOTNOMINATINGANYONE
Entries.Description: Two guys have a fateful encounter outside of an AMC parking lot...  The director's cut of the film "I'm Not Nominating Anyone"

Entries.Title: Release
Entries.Description: A lifelong dancer unpacks her journey stepping away from the only dream she ever knew.

Entries.Title: New Models - Season Zero
Entries.Description: WE ARE LOOKING FOR NEW MODELS. THE MODEL WE ARE LOOKING FOR IS A NEW MODEL OF LOOKING FOR MODELS. WE ARE LOOKING FOR NEW MODELS TO LOOK FOR. WE ARE LOOKING FOR NEW WAYS OF LOOKING. AND WE ARE LOOKING FOR NEW LOOKING MODELS BECAUSE THE OLD MODEL IS KILLING US.

Entries.Title: Prometheus Cage
Entries.Description: Someone enters a house and is unsettled by the atmosphere.

Entries.Title: À travers l'objectif
Entries.Description: Lysa, a young woman stuck in an empty routine, discovers an old camera. As she begins filming her daily life, she slowly finds new meaning in the world around her. But behind every captured image, something feels off. What if the camera revealed more than just reality ?

Entries.Title: AutoErotica: We Buy Gay Stuff
Entries.Description: Behind an unassuming "We Buy Gay Stuff" sign in San Francisco's Castro district - complete with a striking leather daddy illustration - lies an unexpected treasure trove of queer history. AutoErotica's proprietor Patrick Batt has spent decades curating this living museum, packed with artifacts from shuttered gay bars, vintage leather magazines, activist pins, and rare 8mm films.

Entries.Title: A Day At The Berkeley Marina
Entries.Description: Beautiful landscape film highlighting the Berkeley Marina in Berkeley, CA—the debut from whiz kid director Ajay Bhargava.

Entries.Title: Rule #1
Entries.Description: Two friends decide to have one last nerf war, one that will decide who is the best nerf cowboy of all time

Entries.Title: The Homily
Entries.Description: Thomas, a catholic priest, prepares to give a homily where he recounts living in a rectory with his brother. But their envy towards one another threatens to rip the two apart.

Entries.Title: The Commuter
Entries.Description: A protagonist struggles to cope with a rough commute in the only way she knows how.

Entries.Title: 42: The Answer to Almost Everything What Did Dinosaurs Really Look Like?
Entries.Description: No film has influenced our perception of dinosaurs more than Steven Spielberg’s Jurassic Park. But more than three decades have passed since the classic film was released and palaeontologists have made further discoveries. Could dinosaurs have looked less reptilian, and perhaps have had feathers?

Entries.Title: Ringsnake
Entries.Description: A girl wakes up with a mysterious pattern on her face

Entries.Title: Blue Fox
Entries.Description: A cold-blooded detective flick with a blood-pumping cat chase

Entries.Title: Continue?
Entries.Description: CalArts film 2025 by Zechen Wang

Entries.Title: Anchored in Recovery
Entries.Description: Former ABQ convicts trying to make it in life after serving time in prison.

Entries.Title: Quietus
Entries.Description: Quietus is a visual poem about the invisible you. The thing that separates us from life the moment we die. It's a stream of consciousness that provokes unanswered questions of the unknown the moment you fade into darkness or perhaps light?

Entries.Title: Boundless: Arctic Surfing
Entries.Description: Paddle into icy waters with a group of intrepid surfers and feel the rush of riding Norway's wintry waves.

Entries.Title: Monument
Entries.Description: Monument is an experimental documentary that pairs hand-processed and chemically-altered Super 8 footage of the decaying monuments of Presidents Park (Croaker, VA), with original and community-sourced video footage captured on Monument Avenue (Richmond, VA) between 2020 and 2025. Themes of registration and re-calibration, and metaphor and analogy, are explored through form and content and the distinct features of the media employed.

Entries.Title: Preparation For A Time Well Spent
Entries.Description: After a night out a woman stumbles into a house, only to find out she is not alone.

Entries.Title: Panoramic Communion
Entries.Description: From the big wheel in the seaside district, a number of axes come forth. A succession of buildings compose the backdrop. The silhouettes and shadows wander and sway: strangely enough, they seem to stand alongside the same horizon.

Entries.Title: Pure Magic
Entries.Description: A crew of neurodivergent artists collaborates to document the unique creative process of Tamara Finlay, a stop-motion artist whose work blends family history, folklore, and personal healing. Drawing from her Ukrainian roots, Tamara incorporates her grandparents, the mythic Baba Yaga, and fragments of her past self to explore themes of identity, heritage, and resilience. As she brings her visions to life, Tamara taps into the power of art to bridge generational divides, using creativity as a means of healing that transcends both time and trauma one frame at a time.

Entries.Title: Between the Leaves
Entries.Description: First attempts at engagement with a small forest outside of the office. From strangers to partners, these arboreal visages had been reduced to mere subjects, often looked past.

Entries.Title: La Colle Falls
Entries.Description: At the beginning of the 20th century, a hydroelectric dam was partially built and later abandoned on the North Saskatchewan River near the city of Prince Albert. A century has passed and the concrete structures from this industrial folly continue to frame the surrounding river and forest. Through visual and sonic layerings of water, reflective surfaces, and transparency, this film mediates the consequences of colonial activity over time in a specific, ancient place.

Entries.Title: [sun]film
Entries.Description: An arrangement of found image sources from the 16th Century onward, the film looks at the changing representations of the giant star at the center of the solar system. From celestial maps to telescopic photos, the film traces the sun as a natural constant, a mirror of human curiosity, and a radiant symbol of mystery.

Entries.Title: Deer Boys
Entries.Description: A college student wanders off-campus. With the school year wrapping up, he reflects on his adventures, conversations, and changing relationships.

Entries.Title: 7Spade
Entries.Description: 7Spade was once the greatest magician in the world; now, he's retired, old, and washed up. And when he meets a shady back-alley time traveler, he takes the precautions needed to ensure his past self doesn't suffer the same fate.

Entries.Title: Oliver's Rose
Entries.Description: A pessimistic college student falls in love with his new coworker.

Entries.Title: Doom Scroll
Entries.Description: When a high school girl enters a new school, she realizes that all of her classmates are strangely obsessed with their phones and must figure out what is going on before she, too, is trapped in the doom scroll…

Entries.Title: Hang
Entries.Description: 'Hang' is a stop animation short film created by Sam Slowik, a sophomore at Brookfield Central High School in Wisconsin. The 3 minute short film is shot at 15 pictures/frames per second and is made up of nearly 4,500 individual pictures with minor movements to the character for a fluid animation style. 'Hang' features the music of Milwaukee punk band, Band Crime. Work is always more enjoyable when you get to do it with good friends and loud music. Watch as Lego Man and Rig work on building the spaceship of their dreams while while rocking out to amazing music of Bad Crime. The spaceship hanger is officially rocking with with song 'Hang’.

Entries.Title: Guairacá
Entries.Description: Guairacá is a documentary about the story of the Indigenous figure Guairacá, a character who gained prominence in Paraná’s cultural landscape through the Paranista art movement. The film explores how Guairacá’s image and story are interpreted by Indigenous communities and members of the Movimento Sem Terra (MST) in the region, offering important reflections on the territorial occupation of Paraná.

Entries.Title: Monica
Entries.Description: HOW FAR WOULD YOU GO?  An unstable girl gets an unthinkable offer. Now, without any more restraint, and in pursuit of a sadistic bargain, she quickly takes herself to dark places

Entries.Title: A Visitor in the Night
Entries.Description: One night, a strange entity enters a woman's apartment.

Entries.Title: Jethro The Clown
Entries.Description: Filmmaker Jack Bramley spends a day with Jethro The Clown, filming him at one of his clown gigs to see what clowning looks like up close. They discuss what got Jethro into clowning, the reputation of clowns over the years, his advice to aspiring clowns, and how his Christian clowning is different than typical clowning.

Entries.Title: MKT: The Movie
Entries.Description: After the death of his love, a former assassin must assemble a team to get revenge on the man who took everything from him.

Entries.Title: The Bagel Touch
Entries.Description: Two friends gain an ability that could change the world. The power to turn anything they touch... into bagels.

Entries.Title: Mutant Fish!
Entries.Description: When a couple goes swimming at an empty lake in the outskirts of New Jersey, they quickly find out why no one is there!

Entries.Title: Where’s Tony?
Entries.Description: Recording incriminating evidence for the FBI proves to be difficult for new mob member Eddie at his first sit down meeting when his boss, Sal would rather brag about his anger management progress than his crimes.

Entries.Title: Fiction Contract
Entries.Description: Fiction Contract documents a childbirth simulation facilitated by The Maternal Mortality Reduction Program (MMRP). Across all five boroughs of New York City, this team trains medical professionals through complex childbirth simulations. NYC H+H selected an all-black team of administrators, midwives, doctors, and nurses for this simulation. It was performed with and by Jayda, a black birthing mannequin who can simulate different complex childbirth scenarios. In 2020, as part of a comprehensive plan to “eliminate disparities in maternal mortality between Black and White women,” the Deblasio administration earmarked funds to incentivize medical mannequin manufacturers to produce mannequins with brown skin. Prior to 2020, almost all medical mannequins were white.

Entries.Title: eventide.
Entries.Description: With an emotional moment on the horizon and a thunderstorm rolling in, a boy and a girl drive to a marsh to talk.

Entries.Title: Red Dog
Entries.Description: "Red Dog" is a short animation about a young bison and his encounter with an unfamiliar character in his environment.

Entries.Title: Home-land: Hmong American Women
Entries.Description: Related to the Home-land video installation exhibition, this stand alone short film explores the identities, pursuits, and making of Home-land across various Hmong American Women.

Entries.Title: The Call of the Clue Crew
Entries.Description: When a dead body turns up bearing Lovecraftian symbols, it’s up to the Clue Crew, a gang of four happy-go-lucky teens and their talking puppet chicken, to solve the case; no matter how badly the police want them to leave it alone.

Entries.Title: Dead Weight Carries
Entries.Description: Two self-serving friends go on a chaotic ride after hiding their friend’s corpse, only to find themselves unraveling in a darkly absurd spiral—hunted by a mysterious figure with unknown motives

Entries.Title: “A Trial”
Entries.Description: A man is put on trial.

Entries.Title: Beautiful Humans: Creative Arts Therapy on Rikers
Entries.Description: Filmed at Rikers Island jail in NYC, this is the first time dance and music therapy sessions on Rikers have ever been recorded. The film documents creative arts therapy sessions on the island, with individuals detained at Rikers as the participants.

Entries.Title: Burnt Ends
Entries.Description: A murderer and an arsonist cross paths in prison.

Entries.Title: myself & i.
Entries.Description: Hannah’s need to please everyone but herself fractures her identity — and an unsettling version of herself begins to take over…something (or someone)…uncanny.

Entries.Title: The Mess
Entries.Description: A couple struggles to reconcile with each other’s mistakes and watches as their dreamy, blissful life slowly rots away.

Entries.Title: A Puppet's Madness
Entries.Description: A disgruntled Sesame Street-esque teacher wants to do more with his life than teach shapes and letters. That night, he is visited by 3 professors who guide him through an emotional journey and reveal to him the hard truth of their reality… This is a Remaster / Definitive Edition of a 2024 Short Film we made for a Cinematography class. This version has brand new color grading, new scenes, fixed audio, and a whole new original soundtrack. Premiered at ACT KU's First Annual Film Festival and Showing at DREXEL'S Sillydelphia Film Festival on May 30th.

Entries.Title: Oxridge
Entries.Description: Four towns in the wild west have been raided and left with no survivors. Now Charles, deputy of Oxridge, has to solve the mystery before it's too late.

Entries.Title: Raththa Dhanam Sei
Entries.Description: "Raththa Dhanam Sei" is a heartfelt and inspiring song composed, written, and performed by the multi-talented Ashoksaaravanan, who also handled the music, lyrics, vocals, and production. The song delivers a powerful message, earnestly urging listeners to donate blood and highlighting the life-saving impact of such a noble act. It celebrates blood donors as unsung heroes, deserving of deep respect and admiration for their selfless contribution to humanity. Through its compelling lyrics and stirring melody, "Raththa Dhanam Sei" inspires individuals to step forward, donate blood, and become real-life heroes in someone's story.

Entries.Title: Mat-Town USA
Entries.Description: A season of triumphs and trials pushes the Lock Haven University wrestling team to their limits as they fight for greatness, revealing who they are both on and off the mat.

Entries.Title: Glavlit
Entries.Description: In Soviet Russia, a photographer is blackmailed and bullied into the department of Glavlit, the propaganda wing of the KGB whose profession is to edit state photos. But when is it no longer a picture you are shaping, but the truth?

Entries.Title: Time Keeper
Entries.Description: An animated sci-fi adventure about a small windup robot tasked with repairing the Cosmic Clock. He and his his companions face danger and dark forces as they race to restore balance to the space-time continuum before it's too late.

Entries.Title: Scrapped
Entries.Description: A documentary exploring two student artists and their unfinished projects, discussing why certain projects are abandoned and the personal connections that the creator may have to them.

Entries.Title: Last Bite
Entries.Description: A young woman hires an escort for the evening to satisfy her unusual tastes.

Entries.Title: Toxic Medication
Entries.Description: In a world where viruses have mutated beyond medical comprehension, a boxer turned doctor's only option is to fight his patient's illnesses

Entries.Title: The Honeymoon
Entries.Description: Humiliated by her best friend and ex-fiancé's affair, Summer seeks revenge by sabotaging their honeymoon, but her plan unravels.

Entries.Title: Waverly Loves Tony
Entries.Description: An abused college student experiences a sudden and significant change in her life, providing much-needed clarity in regard to her tormentor.

Entries.Title: consuming
Entries.Description: a day at the office

Entries.Title: Minor Keys
Entries.Description: A young girl who doesn't want to connect with the outside world is finally convinced by her mother to leave the house. But if she has to go outside, she has one condition her mother has to accept.

Entries.Title: The Plot To Kill Holly Willoughby
Entries.Description: The true story of Gavin Plumb's plan to kidnap and kill one of the nation's most beloved television presenters, Holly Willoughby. Experts in criminal psychology and stalking behaviour examine Plumb's obsession with her.

Entries.Title: Nice Girls Don't Ask
Entries.Description: In the 1950s, thousands of “social guidance” films were shown to shape behavior according to traditional gender norms. “Nice Girls Don’t Ask” excavates footage from vintage educational films to cast a subversive but humorous lens on the proffered rules and expectations. What was the cost of this behavioral straitjacket for a generation of women? Is the pendulum creeping back?

Entries.Title: Epiphany (V)
Entries.Description: For Larry -F.S.

Entries.Title: before long
Entries.Description: 'before' series test reel 01 - before long

Entries.Title: Plush Carpet
Entries.Description: A young woman struggles to babysit her siblings the same night as a shift at a strip club.

Entries.Title: Tampa Tax Write Off
Entries.Description: 1004 Skateboards presents "Tampa Tax Write Off," a team video filmed during a week long trip to Tampa, Florida. Featuring Kiara Hargrove, Pat Anthony, Mishpat Jaquez, Lando Davis, Josiah “J2” West-Green, and Kate Dillon.

Entries.Title: Pharmacy Museum Tour, New Orleans
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Wing Spike
Entries.Description: Once a rising star on his school’s volleyball team, "Keng" a young boy is forced to leave it all behind and move into the Khlong Toei slums. Dreaming of reclaiming his passion, he sets out to unite the local kids through volleyball he loves. But just as hope begins to rise above the makeshift courts, a darker reality looms — the entire community is on the brink of being torn apart by eviction. Now, he must fight not only for the game, but for a place they can all still call home.

Entries.Title: Falcon Feud II
Entries.Description: Three teams of Pennsbury seniors compete in a bracket style game, based on the hit TV show, Family Feud. This season of Falcon Feud was hosted by Kalen Norris

Entries.Title: Cowboy Connor
Entries.Description: Tensions rise in the Old West as the town's new Marshall confronts a notorious outlaw.

Entries.Title: Sunday Service
Entries.Description: It’s Sunday morning, and three siblings are expected by their father to be at church for the annual high school graduate walk infront of the congregation. One small problem… Where is James?! A frantic eldest sister scrambles to find her younger brother after a rebellious night of celebration while carefree middle child Cara primps, preps, and does everything but have a sense of urgency. Will the siblings make it to church before their father notices?? I heard the church waits for no man.

Entries.Title: 1-800-ALL-GOOD
Entries.Description: Marisa must put on a brave face while auditioning at an infomercial studio in the late 2000s, as she deals with an issue she just can't get away from.

Entries.Title: I Loved, But...
Entries.Description: A personal letter and dedication to Ozu

Entries.Title: Future Progression
Entries.Description: In a world in which we run off of our phones. Two insufferable men have reached their limits.

Entries.Title: 88 days
Entries.Description: Damien, a young man recently widowed, wakes up from a disturbing nightmare. He does his morning routine, going downstairs for coffee and sits in front of the TV, putting the news on. Soon his wife greets him, grabbing a cup and sitting beside him. As the day goes on, an unsettling feeling that something is wrong. The cabin is too quiet; his wife is acting strange. Soon the truth comes crashing down on him; his wife is dead, and he is responsible. Desperate and scared, he begs for her forgiveness, swearing that he's changed, but she refuses, forcing him to relive what he did. As he spirals and begs for it to stop, Damien must accept the darkest part of himself, unsure if the never-ending nightmare will continue or if he will finally have redemption.

Entries.Title: Miss Sunday Pork Roast
Entries.Description: Feast on your inhibitions

Entries.Title: MOVIE
Entries.Description: LOVE / HOPE / LIVE / DIE.

Entries.Title: Spaghetti
Entries.Description: A man eats spaghetti every day

Entries.Title: Doença é Vida
Entries.Description: Valéria is a trans doctor obsessed with perfection and health. She argues with her careless husband and rushes to Aterro do Flamengo to see the sea and clear her mind. Along the way, she meets friends and neighbors who share the same level of obsession, even though all of them, in one way or another, are unwell.

Entries.Title: All Said Done
Entries.Description: From the disordered-saying(s) of a lifetime, to the material tracings of an unstructured narrative, ALL SAID DONE is less a portrait of a person than an incomplete image of class relations and affective labor. This film is dedicated to the memory of my father the one who laughed, 'kill'.

Entries.Title: Palo Santo
Entries.Description: A digital meditation on religion and worldly desire, filtered through ultrasounds of the heart that explore the everlasting bond to Christ created by the Holy Sacraments.

Entries.Title: Signals in Silence
Entries.Description: A young woman grapples with her fear of connection and commitment. Her moments of hesitation quietly shape the course of her days as she navigates missed opportunities and unspoken truths.

Entries.Title: Atlas de la desaparición
Entries.Description: Three relatives of missing people travel a long and complex path in search of the remains of their loved ones, facing bureaucratic, legal and social processes that have persisted since the Civil War. Atlas of disappearance reconstructs what oblivion and repression tried to hide. Through digital maps, archives and forensic architecture, the film illuminates the silent transfer of thousands of missing people to the Cuelgamuros Valley during the Franco dictatorship. Between absences and silences, the film shows the constant struggle to recover the truth, giving name and place to those who were torn from history.

Entries.Title: At Death's Door
Entries.Description: After his brother died in a drunk driving accident, Mark fell into a deep depression and a crippling drug addiction. Just over a year and countless rehab sessions later, Mark's friends take him on a trip to get his mind off of things. However, they are all unaware of the fact that they're being stalked by what seems to be Death?

Entries.Title: Kuleshov's Folly
Entries.Description: Two special agents are tasked with tracking down the Russian militant Sergei Kuleshov, but not everything goes according to plan.

Entries.Title: My Dad Asked Me What Acid Felt Like
Entries.Description: The shaggy dog story of the titular acid trip reveals a need to reconcile with his wife.

Entries.Title: Moving In
Entries.Description: LemonMold has a friend in the computer, and sometimes friends are cruel.

Entries.Title: Maybe It's Just The Rain
Entries.Description: In their debut at the FIFA World Cup, a diasporic, underdog group of young women become the first Filipino soccer team in history to win a match at the tournament. Combining home video footage and voice mail recordings, Reina, Filipino-American center back, brings us along on this turbulent journey, which culminates in an intimate, transformative trip to her grandmother’s hometown in the Philippines.

Entries.Title: IF IS
Entries.Description: Using the innovative technique of literally ripping apart charcoal drawings and sewing them back together with thread, the director imparts the anguish felt by a survivor of sexual assault in this haunting film that will stay with you long after its short runtime is over.

Entries.Title: Wait on a Postman
Entries.Description: A postman finds tranquillity in the monotonous lifestyle his job creates as he encounters and reflects on his role in society.

Entries.Title: America's Most Wanted: John Walsh's Dirty Dozen
Entries.Description: As prolific and Emmy-Award winning series host John Walsh hits a milestone of hosting 1,100 episodes of America's Most Wanted and helping capture 1,198 fugitives, America's Most Wanted: John Walsh's Dirty Dozen looks back at the origin story of this groundbreaking true crime series and how America's Most Wanted began back in 1988

Entries.Title: The Swear Jar
Entries.Description: A student working on a group project gets into an argument and tries to successfully communicate his way out of it while dealing with a endless time loop

Entries.Title: Florhood
Entries.Description: A woman in her 20s goes through a series of experiences in the city of New York that drive her to growth and self-love

Entries.Title: Last November
Entries.Description: A dialogue free, short film about two freshman college students who cross paths in New York City, only to gradually drift apart.

Entries.Title: Thunderous Applause
Entries.Description: In 2027, when the Preservation Act forbids 20% of citizens from having sex, fugitive lovers Peter and Laura hide in a rundown motel, torn between constant running and their final moments together.

Entries.Title: The Couch
Entries.Description: A magical couch consumes two lazy college students.

Entries.Title: We Buy Houses
Entries.Description: An entrepreneurial young Black man making a living flipping houses faces a reckoning when he encounters an old classmate who refuses to vacate his grandmother’s foreclosed home.

Entries.Title: Dream Job
Entries.Description: A young woman sells her dreams for cash- a transaction that leaves her unable to remember them.

Entries.Title: Sid
Entries.Description: A canceled hangout with his friend Andy turns Sid's lonely night of drinking into a surreal confrontation with an aloof Andy, who challenges Sid to overcome his alcoholism through a series of cryptic tests.

Entries.Title: Origami Club
Entries.Description: The origami club is in peril! With only four members, the Club Committee has threatened to revoke the club's room and their legitimacy as an organization. When a sliver of hope by the name of Daisy walks through their door, they must do all they can to get her to stay and save the group.

Entries.Title: Open House
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: If You Die I'll Kill You
Entries.Description: In the midst of the 1970 Student Strike, a Mother fights to stop her Daughter from attending increasingly dangerous protests.

Entries.Title: Radiation Nation
Entries.Description: High ranking military solider: Magnum Jones navigates an island that intel tells him aliens are hiding out on. He is joined by an Influencer who was enlisted by the military as an attempt to lighten the armed forces to younger audiences.

Entries.Title: Witchin'
Entries.Description: A college student discovers that her best friend is a witch and has been using her powers to plot revenge.

Entries.Title: Hello
Entries.Description: Hello is an indie short film.

Entries.Title: Against All Odds: 2024 Sterling High School Soccer Documentary
Entries.Description: Documentary on the 2024 Sterling High School boys soccer team winning the New Jersey State Championship

Entries.Title: Swerve · Eli
Entries.Description: After a major pandemic leaves a talented artist out of work, Van Xander reaches out to Remo, a former street friend for some fast cash. But Remo has something else in mind. He wants Van to mentor a bullied kid trying to fit in the BMX wheelie culture of Philadelphia. An artist tries to figure it out. A kid trying to fit in.

Entries.Title: Our Terrain
Entries.Description: Follows a group of trail runners in Missouri as they run a 100 mile race.

Entries.Title: our ob or os
Entries.Description: if every bone had not been sucked hollow, the meat held for ransom. the yearling still struggling to walk, its hock bent backwards. its tongue meant to be peeled after boiling —

Entries.Title: The Shadows of Paper Trees
Entries.Description: Time-collapsed images of nature collide with reverie-soaked tableaus in this experimental short film that illustrates and interprets verses from “Panjereh” (“Window”) by Iranian poet Forough Farrokhzad.

Entries.Title: Waves
Entries.Description: A young Black man grapples with his toxic cycle, his day unfolding through a visual poem set to a tape cassette that weaves the rhythm of his struggles, echoing his journey toward self-awareness and change.

Entries.Title: The Snail Disco Diner
Entries.Description: A diner managed by snails is frequented by customers who use time as currency.

Entries.Title: Jesus
Entries.Description: Envision Jesus as an immigrant crossing from Mexico into the US.

Entries.Title: Reparaciones
Entries.Description: The poetry and images of Reparaciones invoke a cycle of the doing and undoing of fabrics and flesh, of the material and the social. The threads that clothe our bodies and the relations that sustain us resist the ruptures and absorb the shocks that we encounter in all stages of life.

Entries.Title: Falling Up
Entries.Description: In a world where death is increasing, will anyone overcome it?

Entries.Title: Changed Vol. 2
Entries.Description: Three incredible true-life stories. Art was drowning in the broken life of alcohol abuse. Collette, a wild child from the 60's nearly fell into an early grave. Kevi struggled to rise above the strife of the inner-city. Hear their stories of life, faith and the powerful way they have been changed.

Entries.Title: Planetary Defenders
Entries.Description: How would humanity respond if we discovered an asteroid headed for Earth? NASA’s Planetary Defenders is a gripping documentary that delves into the high-stakes world of asteroid detection and planetary defense.

Entries.Title: Sanity Cream
Entries.Description: A sleazy salesman tries to sell a mysterious product...

Entries.Title: I remember the summer....
Entries.Description: A short experimental film based on the Poem I Remember The Summer. The poem is written by an Incarcerated person through the Just Write program

Entries.Title: Spider Grandmother
Entries.Description: A young girl tries to teach herself how to weave in a small bedroom, but magical help comes along the way through the spirit of Spider Grandmother

Entries.Title: Quarter
Entries.Description: Man finds interest in a quarter after it falls on his head from the sky

Entries.Title: Perfidious
Entries.Description: Perfidious is a compelling urban drama that explores the lives of a group of friends and their involvement in the drug trade. The story follows Fitz, a charismatic and ambitious young man trying to balance his life.

Entries.Title: Twin Fantasy
Entries.Description: Hayden, a recluse, is kept company by her loving girlfriend, Robin. A sudden announcement tests their wellbeings and the bonds of their relationship.

Entries.Title: Sadie
Entries.Description: A young girl, Sadie, has been bullied throughout her life and is going through hardships with her mom's health. She finally finds her voice in the theater when she tries out for the school play. Through her experience in the theater, she learns to deal with her hardships in a healthy way.

Entries.Title: Guts
Entries.Description: A hungry drifter on the Navajo reservation embarks on a comedic adventure to steal ceremonial sheep intestines, weaving together an uproarious tale that pays homage to Navajo folk stories and language.

Entries.Title: Living in the Last Days
Entries.Description: A young man looking for purpose and meaning meets a charismatic life coach and joins his multi-level marking company, only to discover it's a doomsday cult seeking the end of the world.

Entries.Title: In the Window
Entries.Description: A poetic narrative that blends enduro motorcycling and arborist life, romancing both pursuits to reveal the beauty in the shared spirit of adventure.

Entries.Title: rainy streets
Entries.Description: a contemplation of rain and its subsequent fall, seen from my window

Entries.Title: Usucapio
Entries.Description: A mentally unstable homebody becomes convinced that someone is secretly living alongside him in his apartment. Is black coffee and therapy enough to maintain his grip on reality?

Entries.Title: Where am I heading, Where am I from
Entries.Description: ‘Where am I heading, Where am I from’ is a personal film that explores the death of my grandfather, one of the two atheists in a multi-religious family, telling the story of how I, now the only remaining atheist who is terrified of death, confront the fact and embarking on a journey to religions and self-healing.

Entries.Title: Detective Antics
Entries.Description: Detective Dan Riddleton and his partner Detective Manny Festo examine a crime scene to find the killer, but everything is not as it seems.

Entries.Title: Guilt Trip
Entries.Description: Four friends. Three hammocks. One body.   A weekend getaway turns deadly when Evan discovers someone lurking in the woods.

Entries.Title: Golf or The Art of Forgetting
Entries.Description: An intimate look at one mans journey with the sport of golf and the life lessons it taught him.

Entries.Title: Repentance
Entries.Description: Repentance is a short film about the innocent mistakes of a teen and his journey towards repenting for his sin.

Entries.Title: Echoes of Conflict: The Forgotten Children of War
Entries.Description: In the heart of Sarajevo, three members of the Forgotten Children of War Association come forward to share their stories. Born from the horrors of wartime sexual violence during the Bosnian War, they now strive to create a better society and reclaim their identities.

Entries.Title: Darkness and Light
Entries.Description: In a space that seems to be shrouded in complete darkness, light finds a way to protrude, and somehow, warmth emerges. It is the New Year’s, a time to reconnect with family, friends, and have a nice time. It is a holiday of light and happiness. The time is life-affirming: by the celebrations and fireworks, people declare that they exist and that they will break through no matter how cold and miserable life may seem.

Entries.Title: Menthol
Entries.Description: Recorded narration of a Turkish student who recounts his trials and tribulations since moving to New York City. Family and aspiration struggles.

Entries.Title: Reclaiming Cocoa
Entries.Description: In Ghana, cocoa is more than a crop – it’s the backbone of rural communities, the livelihood of millions, and a national treasure. Yet for over a century, the value of Ghana’s cocoa has been diverted up North, locked in a system shaped by colonial history and sustained by global inequities. "Reclaiming Cocoa" peels back the layers of this complex industry, taking viewers on a journey from the lush cocoa farms of Ghana to the polished chocolate shelves in Switzerland – whose famous chocolate consists mostly of Ghanaian beans.

Entries.Title: Resolved: Never Again. The Alexandria Community Remembrance Project
Entries.Description: A community remembrance project aims to reconcile their city's ugly past to make Alexandria more equitable and welcoming for the future.

Entries.Title: Ghosts & Gunships: Lost Submarines of the Civil War
Entries.Description: Experts detail the disaster and discoveries of Civil War vessels USS Monitor and HL Hunley. This program draws heavily from Dept of Defense works now in public domain and has been repackaged for 2025 audiences.

Entries.Title: Liquidation
Entries.Description: Science-Fiction, Thriller

Entries.Title: Postpartum Film
Entries.Description: Exploring the coming together and separating out of my former self, myself as a mother, and my child during the postpartum period. The work uses reenactments, performances, and home-film to show the strangeness of time dilation, or the inability to perceive and measure time the same way.

Entries.Title: Over Easy
Entries.Description: After getting badly sunburned, a young woman’s misfortune leads her on a strange and unexpected journey through Palm Springs.

Entries.Title: Colors of a Womb (an archetypal flight)
Entries.Description: The birth of a season: the winter womb and an infant spring. On leaving and returning. Descents into the abstract and back out into the light of the projected concrete.

Entries.Title: Dave and Larry
Entries.Description: A horror comedy mockumentary that follows a struggling ventriloquist comedian on a meteoric rise to fame in which he consumes himself. Literally.

Entries.Title: Wizards
Entries.Description: After a suicidal spell destroys their home world, three legendary wizards — Balthazar the Blue, Fasgrin the Green, and Radovan the Red — escape to Earth. Stripped of their status and limited in magical power, the trio faces a new challenge: navigating modern life. From failing at odd jobs to accidentally committing crimes, their attempts to blend in only make things worse. Just when all hope seems lost, a random act of kindness restores their spirits... only for them to immediately blow it on alcohol and junk food. What follows is a chaotic series of misadventures, culminating in their arrest and a hilariously awkward jailbreak. With no clue how to thrive on Earth, they have only one thing keeping them going — each other... sort of.

Entries.Title: Cold Cut Case
Entries.Description: A detective with a haunted past tackles a gruesome homicide, unraveling mysteries in a case clouded by loss and justice.

Entries.Title: For Posterity
Entries.Description: Two girls memorialize their friend.

Entries.Title: The Age of Idiris, Season Six: All Stars/Sober
Entries.Description: Idiris Kabel has come a long way. After four magical seasons and a tumultuous, heart-wrenching fifth, he’s thankful for the mysteries, friendships, loves, and challenges that have set the stage for Season Six. But this is a different kind of story — complete with an all-star cast, haunting memories, formidable villains, and sobering lessons — that will change the young starlet’s life forever.

Entries.Title: Dean Delray: 5836
Entries.Description: 15 years in Comedy and over 5836 sets it’s time to drop my special. Shot live in a Cave in Tenn

Entries.Title: Vegetables All Over The Stovetop
Entries.Description: A short view into a relationship between two people that features both vegetables and stovetops.

Entries.Title: Longie
Entries.Description: Longie (a colloquial term for "longshoreman") is a short nonfiction film that features two dockworkers from the Los Angeles waterfront town of San Pedro, California.

Entries.Title: En Passant
Entries.Description: Stuck in detention, three teenagers are subjected to a horrific dystopian nightmare.

Entries.Title: DRAIN.
Entries.Description: A woman submerged into her subconscious and internal desires in dreams.

Entries.Title: Discrete Kinesis No. 1
Entries.Description: The first of an interlude series within the multiple potential interstitial states of string harmonics. Hand processing and 16mm-to-digital scanning are treated as points of intervention and compositional instruments.

Entries.Title: Wild Leaves Loosen
Entries.Description: A field recordist in the hills, accompanied by a cat. Autumnal shifts from green to brown lay ground for swarming insects.

Entries.Title: Items
Entries.Description: Film by Luca Lopriore

Entries.Title: Grey Matter
Entries.Description: A film exploring thoughts, dreams, and memories through poems and contemporary dance.

Entries.Title: Skip To My Rick
Entries.Description: Three boys ignore the liminal space between boyhood and manhood.

Entries.Title: Stabat Mater
Entries.Description: In an exercise in structured formal repetition, a portrait, a recorded dialogue, and the first movement of Giovanni Pergolesi’s “Stabat Mater” become a meditation on maternity and divorce.

Entries.Title: Ghosts
Entries.Description: The Albuquerque Railyard was built in the late 1880’s to service the steam engines newly arrived in the west. The railroad brought commerce, innovation, diverse populations, disease, corruption, imperialism. The rail lines through the southwest often had a negative impact on indigenous culture and contributed to the decimation of the buffalo. When the diesel engine was introduced, the railyard was no longer needed, and like many outmoded technologies, was left to the ghosts of the past. Ghosts is a tour of abandonment and unseen loss filmed in the Albuquerque Railyard.

Entries.Title: Kuleshov

Entries.Title: No Closet Space: The History of Gay Key West
Entries.Description: A heartfelt documentary that invites you to experience a time when the gay community transformed the island into a thriving, joyful sanctuary unlike anywhere else. More than just the clubs—The Copa, The Monster, Delmonico’s—or the guest houses like La Te Da and Atlantic Shores, this film celebrates the spirit of unity, resilience, and celebration that defined life in Gay Key West. Through rare interviews, humor, and nostalgia, revisit the unforgettable stories that shaped this magical era.

Entries.Title: Source to Sea down the River Thames WITHOUT Leaving it (Part 6)

Under the direction of Dev Patel, this documentary captures the triumphs, struggles, and relentless drive of students determined to make a lasting impact on their school and community.

Entries.Title: The Europe
Entries.Description: Andrés Narváez, Colombian social leader, music minstrel and empirical poet, returns to the Montes de María after his exile in Spain, following an attempt on his life in which he was shot four times.  His time in Asturias and the melancholy of a forced migration inspired him to compose several of his best known songs, connecting through song the two Europes: the one he left and the one that welcomed him.  Upon his return, with the violence still latent, Andrés delves into the deepest landscapes of his territory and the most painful memories that the war left behind, composing in memory of those who no longer walk with him; music saved him and that is why he decided that 'it is better to sing than to point out'.

Entries.Title: Did I Achieve My Goal?
Entries.Description: After receiving an unexpected message from an old friend asking, 'Did you achieve your goal?' a young woman finds herself caught in reflection. Revisiting past ambitions, fleeting friendships, and the weight of unfulfilled goals, she questions what it truly means to move forward. Blending nostalgia with quiet introspection, Did I Achieve My Goal? is an animated meditation on uncertainty and the messiness of progress.

Entries.Title: The ADHD Muses
Entries.Description: While experiencing writer’s block in developing this film, and waiting for inspiration to strike, it hit the filmmaker that all of the friends she intended to shoot, her so-called muses, had ADHD. Drawing a connection between her muses — charismatic centers of attention — and the generalized assault on our attention centers, Van-Huy uses ADHD as a fake theme around which to engage her muse-friends in interviews and in improvised activities based on these conversations, to make what she calls an “Action Documentary.”

Entries.Title: Girl/Friends
Entries.Description: Two girls, Olive and Clementine, go through their day. They follow their normal routines, similar yet different in many ways. Olive is an easygoing and less driven girl who hides her personality insecurities with her clothing. At the same time, Clementine is an ambitious and anxious girl who takes a lot of medication and stays busy to distract herself from all her anxieties. The two oddly find each other and can't shake the feeling from when they first spotted one another. When they continue to see each other, they realize there must be something between them.

Entries.Title: Sleight of Hand
Entries.Description: Three girls finally face the consequences when they con the wrong man.

Entries.Title: Resurrecting Legends: The Rebirth of the MK IV
Entries.Description: "Resurrecting Legends: The Rebirth of the MK IV"  The documentary captures the extraordinary efforts of Riley Technologies, led by Bob Riley, his son Bill Riley, and a team of master craftsmen, as they undertake the meticulous continuation build of the MK IV.  Drawing from original blueprints and modern enhancements for safety and materials, the team worked tirelessly to bring these iconic cars back to life while preserving their authentic spirit. The film features exclusive access to the Riley Technologies shop, showcasing the craftsmanship, innovation, and dedication behind the project.  A highlight of the documentary is Bob Riley's emotional reunion with the MK IV, witnessing his legendary design return to the track in its continuation form. This poignant moment, captured before Riley's passing October 22, 2024, stands as a testament to his lifelong passion for race car engineering and his unparalleled contributions to motorsport.

Entries.Title: I Killed A Demon

Entries.Title: A Culinary Uprising: The Story of Bloodroot
Entries.Description: In the 1970s and '80s, there were over 230 feminist restaurants, cafés, and coffeehouses across the United States and Canada. Bloodroot, located in Bridgeport, Connecticut, is now the oldest and longest-running of these spaces, operating continuously for over 46 years. 'A Culinary Uprising: The Story of Bloodroot' is a short documentary that explores this feminist, queer, vegan restaurant and bookstore, highlighting the legacy of its pioneering proprietors, Selma Miriam and Noel Furie. The film offers an intimate look at their 46-year working partnership and how they navigate sexism, homophobia, and the realities of aging. Despite challenges, Bloodroot has endured as a beloved space for generations of feminists, vegans, and queer people who continue to return.

A quarter century later, that passion remains steadfast for San Francisco-based fiddler Brandon Godman, helping him weather storms of injustice and adversity. Entries.Title: BuildFilm5: Damnatio Memoriae (Icositetragram Spell)
Entries.Description: "Damnatio memoriae" is a Latin phrase meaning "condemnation of memory." It refers to the practice of deliberately erasing or destroying records, monuments, and other traces of a person's existence as a form of posthumous punishment. --- An icositetragram is a 24-sided star. --- "Making a movie is casting a spell." -Kenneth Anger

As he dives into the dark world of his thoughts, he wonders: Does he really bear the blame, or is it just the echo of a toxic past?

Entries.Title: Canary Bones

Entries.Title: Happy People
Entries.Description: In a world, where a number on the neck shows how happy people are, Kristóf (hiding his number with a turtle-neck) waits for the mandatory Annual Happiness Measurement. In the checking room, first, the contrast material is injected into his body, as every year. But this time, the examiner is shocked, when she realizes, Kristóf is a problematic 21. This happiness level barely exceeds the critical minimum limit. If he goes below 20, he has to be reported to the authorities. On his way out, he bumps into his ex-girlfriend, who surprisingly doesn't hide the number on the neck. She is a proud 80. Seeing her happy, Kristóf starts to realize, maybe he was wrong to break up with her. Maybe, they could be happy again... together.

Entries.Title: Lorca en la Habana

We discover his influence on the island's music, poetry, dramatic scene and current narrative, as no other poet in the world has been as acclaimed, read and performed in Cuba as he has been. He is a legend in Cuba and, for this reason, Cuban writer Martínez Carmenate points out that his presence on the island is a phenomenon of atmosphere and underground roots, but, above all, Federico was immensely happy there.

Rachmaninoff’s Prelude in C-sharp Minor tolls the last bells for a strange march to the scaffold. A black-clad figure (concert pianist—or Death himself?) shares the screen with vintage bomb-testing footage, ending with the masters of war claiming their credit.

Entries.Title: Parts 1-7 [When moving the body forward, the term for the movement depends on the body part being moved.]
Entries.Description: Adapted and refined for the AAFF, seven interstitial videos mix content from the program’s discrete films and (adapted) performances to create a feature-length experience. During these events, video loops with live narration from the artist provides context and a first-person point of view of the screened films. Every show is unique—including this one.

Entries.Title: A Cave Carved in the Shape of a Waking Person
Entries.Description: "A Cave Carved in the Shape of a Waking Person" by Mateusz Sadowski explores human consciousness and our ancestral roots, inspired by the universal experience of waking up. Sadowski parallels his own morning routine's disorientation and reconnection with how ancient humans might have perceived their existence in caves. The cave symbolizes the continuity of consciousness through time. The video is crafted through a meticulous process: Sadowski records himself with green-screen technology, edits the frames using 3D animation software to create a cave interior, and then uses laser-cut physical representations reanimated through stop-motion. This work reflects on waking up as a timeless, universal moment, linking past and present, and inviting viewers to contemplate the nature of consciousness.

Entries.Title: Marratein, Marratein
Entries.Description: Letters to a maternal ancestor reflect on identity connected to ethnic heritage, while also embracing a broader notion of family beyond bloodlines. Weaving images and sounds from the filmmaker’s personal ties to two cities—Detroit and Beirut—the film poses the central question: How do we belong to each other?

Entries.Title: a_blurred_fluxx_00.avi
