Entries.Title: Daluyong
Entries.Description: Have you ever known the taste of 'sikap at tiyaga' (effort and perseverance)?  Based on a true life story from a local residing in Batangas, Philippines, "Lando" is a young man looking to help out with the financial burden of his family. Gaining advice from his friends, he then seeks to become a vendor who sells ice cream to tourists in the middle of the ocean, sacrificing his education in exchange for earning money. In order to do so, he swims from cottage to cottage in the blazing sun, looking for a consumer that is willing to buy popsicles from a styrofoam box, where he keeps the frozen desserts cool.  But to what extent should Lando keep on pushing through, and how did he know when he was going to get to the fruitful path? Lando did not have the answers to these questions, and still he managed to push through everything. He lived to get the fruits of his labors, and for every second of it he had no regrets.

Entries.Title: The Interrogation of Hugo Schreiber
Entries.Description: My friend and I were home from college for a few weeks and were inspired to make a film together. It had to be affordable on a college budget and logistically simple to film. Thus, we created this ten minute scene of two characters talking in a single room as an exercise in crafting interesting dialogue, cinematography, characters, world-building, and suspense within these restrictions. This was purely an inspired project, not for any class. We wanted to see what we were made of and what we could put together with limited resources and time. We’re incredibly proud of the results and in our evolution as filmmakers from this experience. The film takes place in a larger world, and if people are interested, we’d love to continue creating new stories within this world.

Entries.Title: Beetlemania

Entries.Title: This Year's Interns
Entries.Description: In this workplace comedy, Aaron, an easygoing intern, and Jayden, his arrogant and overly competitive coworker, are wrapping up their final week at a marketing firm. With only one full-time position up for grabs, tension between the two escalates. When Aaron is tasked with getting the boss's birthday cake, Jayden seizes the opportunity to sabotage him. Their fierce rivalry spirals into a series of chaotic and hilarious office mishaps as both interns scramble to outdo each other in a last-ditch effort to secure the job.

Entries.Title: Mommy

Her story is complemented with beautiful imagery shot by artist Eva Wu in the dramatic landscape of the North American Southwest, and scored by Pride Month Barbie’s musical sensation Josephine Shetty. Like honey on the tongue of a sweet tooth, Mommy pours pure honesty and vulnerability into the viewer’s eyes, ears, and hearts.

Entries.Title: Wander Alone
Entries.Description: On March 19, 2018, Sudan, the world’s last male Northern White Rhino, passed away, leaving only two females, Najin and Fatu, as the only surviving individuals. Once abundant across Central Africa, this keystone species has been decimated by poaching. Wander Alone tells the story of the last survivors as they live out their final days under constant armed protection at Kenya’s Ol Pejeta Conservancy. The rhinos' daily routines are sensitively documented in a series of vignettes that capture the intimate last moments of a dying species. The film blends insights from biology, psychology, anthropology and philosophy into a meditation on extinction, loneliness and the fragility of life on Earth. Through the rhinos’ decline we bear witness to the consequences of human exceptionalism and hubris and to the alarming material outcomes of our relentless industrial expansion.

Entries.Title: Cowboy Killer: The Collection Documentary

Entries.Title: 1000 Players Simulate Civilization: Rich & Poor
Entries.Description: Out of 8000+ applicants, 1300 players were accepted to play in my 1000 Player Civilization Experiment (also known as "Season 2.5"). Before the event began, players selected which island they wanted to join without knowing the traits of each island. Each day, all players logged on at the same time, and session lasted around 2-3 hours. For the most part, players could do whatever they want. We did set a few limitations on the players to promote a better experience, like banning random killing (RDM), disabling most Minecraft enchantments, disabling unrealistic items like ender pearls, disabling other dimensions like the Nether, and a few more misc. rules.

Entries.Title: Being Adolph Gasser
Entries.Description: Nearing the end of his life, Adolph Gasser looks back on a seventy-year career as a world-class camera repairman, WWII veteran, inventor, and best friend of nature photographer Ansel Adams, contributing developer of the first Nikon camera and a sales/rental/camera repair store owner who empowered other prominent Bay Area visual artists and inventors to succeed. As eminent domain, the internet and changing technologies threaten everything he has built, he struggles to find a way to keep moving forward. Inspired by his unique stories and abilities, filmmaker and professor John C. Aliano follows him over the course of several years and reflects on his own career trajectory.

Entries.Title: Waking Up
Entries.Description: Waking Up is a quietly introspective short film shot entirely on location in Japan during Devereaux's first tour in the country in September and October of 2024. Filmed across Tokyo (Nakano, Ekoda, Shinjuku, Chiyoda, and along the Chuo Line), Matsumoto in Nagano, and Ukyo in Kyoto, the film captures fleeting, seemingly mundane moments that held deep personal significance for the filmmaker. Each shot captures a distinct moment when Devereaux felt his nervous system decompress just enough to be inclined to film — moments of stillness and clarity amid the motion of travel and creative exploration.  Waking Up is both a poetic travelogue and a personal awakening. Echoing his own words — "When I arrived in Japan, it felt like I had finally woken up from a bad dream" — the film offers a meditative window into moments of quiet revelation, captured not for spectacle but for memory.

Entries.Title: The Creative Space
Entries.Description: The Creative Space is a short documentary, celebrating the strong community spirit at the Creative Space Beirut School of Design (CSB-SD).  Co-directed by Service95's content editor Pia Brynteson and filmmaker Ramzi Hibri, the film captures the challenges and triumphs of young Lebanese creatives as they navigate their education and careers in the fashion industry - particularly in the wake of the devastating explosion in the Port of Beirut in 2020. ‍ The film explores the political, social, and economic crisis facing the population of Lebanon, and how the government's limited assistance to the creative industries has made it a constant struggle for CSB-SD to continue supporting their students, and pursue their goal of expanding their initiative.  The Creative Space sheds light on the ongoing turbulence in Lebanon, the power of education and the importance of supporting the next generation of creative talent.

Entries.Title: Enduropale du Touquet-Pas-de-Calais

A legendary race, the Enduropale du Touquet-Pas-de-Calais is a must for speed lovers, sand and sea spray.  Enduropale du Touquet-Pas-de-Calais is an enduro bike – and now quad – race that’s taken place on the beach at Le Touquet, France, every year since 1975. It was the brainchild of adventurer, racer and founder of the original Paris-Dakar, Thierry Sabine, who was approached to develop an event to bring people to Le Touquet during the off-season, and its success provided Sabine with some of the motivation to create the Paris-Dakar Rally in 1978.

Entries.Title: The Walkout
Entries.Description: “The Walkout” is a new documentary that brings to light a pivotal but often overlooked moment in Texas history: the 1968 student walkout at Edgewood High School in San Antonio’s Westside. Fed up with underfunded classrooms, uncertified teachers, and crumbling facilities, a group of young Mexican American students and their families organized a bold protest that would become a catalyst for statewide education reform.  Told through the voices of the original students, community leaders, and historians, The Walkout weaves together personal testimony, historical footage, and present-day reflections to honor the legacy of resistance born in San Antonio’s Westside. This film doesn’t just revisit the past; it also draws a direct line to today’s struggles over school funding and equity in Texas.

Entries.Title: Mono Melancholia
Entries.Description: Mono Melancholia, the first standalone experimental film by Hrisiraj Sengupta, folds together fragments of the director’s own past with images captured for no purpose beyond the quiet act of noticing. Some shots were never meant for a film. They began as personal keepsakes, and now sit beside moments filmed solely for this piece. Every frame was taken quickly on a phone, under the light that was there, without the interference of formal setups. The monologue came later, written as an echo to the images, shaped by the atmosphere of its non-original soundtrack. More than a narrative, it is an instinctive arrangement of memory and mood, a small attempt to make sense of what refuses to be explained.

Entries.Description: Haunted by two tours in Iraq, a former Army combat engineer finds himself unraveling. But when Hurricane Helene devastates the Southeast, he volunteers with Team Rubicon, a veteran-led disaster response team.

Entries.Title: My Father Died in October
Entries.Description: After returning from her father’s funeral in October, a young girl senses she’s not alone, something has followed her home.

Entries.Title: I’m Not Getting Out of this Car
Entries.Description: A transgender barber travels the south giving gender-affirming haircuts to queer and trans youth and interviews pivotal figures in each community. He talks to survivors of a mass shooting at a gay bar in Colorado, the woman who started Pride in Kansas City, and many more.

Entries.Title: Tensile Strength
Entries.Description: A young Pakistani woman grapples with a difficult job market post-grad and tough financial pressures from her father and is hit by a tough reality of the American Dream.

Entries.Title: Paranoid
Entries.Description: A nervous man wanders around his neighbourhood when he notices a familiar force.

Entries.Title: Thoughts & Prayers
Entries.Description: In this dry absurdist comedy one millennial man’s life starts spiraling after an unexpected visit from two licensing inspectors.

Entries.Title: Waking Nightmare
Entries.Description: A man is haunted to by a musical sleep paralysis demon.

Entries.Title: Moving Line
Entries.Description: Moving Line is the story of the first ski-crossing of Colorado, and mountains as creative inspiration. Three amateur skiers from Boulder set out to find a historic path across the snow. Their route helped map the Colorado Trail, but along the way they discovered something much bigger. They discovered their passion for art.

Entries.Title: Journey Indiana: Underground
Entries.Description: Southern Indiana is home to some of nature’s most amazing treasures – over 4,000 caves, stretching for hundreds of miles beneath the surface of the Hoosier state. From show caves to state parks, Journey Indiana: Underground transports viewers to a world that few will experience in person.

Entries.Title: Burnt Orange
Entries.Description: A woman behind on payments is haunted by phone-call debt collectors, but one collector wants to harvest something more. Is the figure in her head, or does she owe a cosmic debt?

Entries.Title: Making Utopia
Entries.Description: An experimental oral history about Mount Lebanon in upstate New York. This project spans specific histories of the mountain by weaving the stories of five different people.

Entries.Title: Nonna's Nude
Entries.Description: After the death of their grandmother, Lisa and her brothers discover a nude painting of their aging Nonna. Their bickering forces Lisa to consider the value we place on women’s bodies both in the art world and in real life.

Entries.Title: The Price
Entries.Description: Music video for "The Price" by Adrianna Freeman.

Entries.Title: Fast Forward to Forever
Entries.Description: Josh and Anna connect as they recognize fellow lonely souls in each other. When Josh faces Anna's loss, he must quietly face his own grief.

Entries.Title: Catching Light
Entries.Description: Believing herself to be a failure as a painter, Renee works at a pigment shop instead. She must find faith in her own abilities to recapture her art.

Entries.Title: Counter-Reformation
Entries.Description: The self-portrait. The sacred icon. The incarnation. 16th-century Europe is at war with itself over questions of faith and form. Counter-Reformation observes these trends and tribulations, but observation soon gives way to self-reflection in this deeply personal 16mm meditation on religion and the moving image.

Entries.Title: Symphonies of Sound
Entries.Description: An exploration into the relationship between music and sound consisting of interviews with Dr. John Drumheller.

Entries.Title: Cranes and Ships
Entries.Description: This film was shot in Saint Petersburg, Russia, in March 2022—during the first month of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, which continues until today. It ponders the silences and small acts of resistance by anti-war individuals at a time when mass protest fails and mass migration begins, when the state introduces military censorship, and the full-scale war is not experienced directly.

Entries.Title: Over The Moon
Entries.Description: On a journey to see the stars, Jay, a young trans man confronts his childhood in the Burren, Ireland.

Entries.Title: Dishonoured: Discharge
Entries.Description: A feature-length fan edit of the 2016 Holbeach Film Company thriller, Dishonoured.

Entries.Title: Wracu
Entries.Description: A knight awakens in a carriage driven by Death. Tormented by the memory of his execution by a menacing king, he overcomes Death itself to seek revenge.

Entries.Title: Rebecca Sue Banana
Entries.Description: Rebecca Sue is an older banana who, despite being at the peak of her sweetness, is passed over daily for firmer, younger bananas in this unexpected commentary on aging.

Entries.Title: The Praise House
Entries.Description: In Harpersville, Alabama, a descendant community of enslaved people are collaborating with white descendants of the enslavers to reimagine the former plantation as a site for communal art and repair.

Entries.Title: Times Are Tough
Entries.Description: The cry of the working class. The official music video for Colby Battle's "Times Are Tough."

Entries.Title: Fight
Entries.Description: Official music video for Kurt Deimer's 'Fight.'

Entries.Title: The Vultures
Entries.Description: Two streamers embark on a journey in Alabama to investigate reports of animalistic behavior in this 48-hour film-making challenge project.

Entries.Title: Sistahood: A Story of Strength
Entries.Description: "Sistahood: A Story of Strength" follows the resilience of black, trans women in Memphis, Tennessee, as they find hope found through My Sistah’s House.

Entries.Title: The Last Winged Puppy
Entries.Description: The last surviving winged puppy traverses the forest alone until he encounters a group of forest sprites.

Entries.Title: In the Saddle
Entries.Description: Meet Sarah Roe and her coach, Andy Blalock, as they compete in the fast-paced world of barrel racing where precision, speed, and dedication collide.

Entries.Title: Oneyda
Entries.Description: Oneyda is a Guatemalan immigrant and single mom who works in construction and electrical services. She crosses traditional gender roles as she works day after day in a high-risk, traditionally male work environment.

Entries.Title: Rangeelee
Entries.Description: A family drama based in rural Haryana tells the story of Himmat Singh who brings colors to the lives of his two blind sons

Entries.Title: Sequin Smile
Entries.Description: A girl walks into a field holding a big mirror. Summertime, glimmering. Hundreds of sequins, a shimmer, born.

Entries.Title: Failure to Fail
Entries.Description: Delve into the troubling phenomenon of grade inflation in the United States education system. Through the stories of three dedicated teachers, we explore the systemic flaws that push unprepared students through the educational pipeline and consider critical questions about the true value of academic achievements.

Entries.Title: The Last Surprise
Entries.Description: A down-on-their-luck couple heads down to a holiday lodge in the hope to revive their relationship. However, their idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror when they are shortly invaded by a sadistic killer.

Entries.Title: PETAL
Entries.Description: Images of the vibrant in a grayscale landscape

Entries.Title: The Library Problem
Entries.Description: A short student documentary examining the history and current status of the ongoing battle taking place over LGBTQ+ content in the children's section of Alabama public libraries.

Entries.Title: ODD BALL
Entries.Description: Meditation of thought carried out by round eyed figures.

Entries.Title: New Hope
Entries.Description: A film about two people falling in love with each other and the life they were living.

Entries.Title: Great White North Invasion
Entries.Description: Great whites flood the quiet shores of Nova Scotia, threatening locals and igniting a mission to track the biggest sharks to identify the most dangerous areas before a deadly encounter.

Entries.Title: Counterfeit Criminal
Entries.Description: Daniel Cruz, a criminal who's been on the run from the law, is finally caught by the police. In exchange for all his charges being dropped, the police ask for his help in taking down a criminal known as the “Green Man”, who is running a counterfeit money operation. However, Daniel is forced to work with Officer Michael Hudson, a novice cop. Daniel wants to use his own criminal connections to take down the “Green Man”, while Michael wants to use the law to take him down, causing the two to conflict. However, the investigation soon becomes obvious that it is much deeper than it seems.

Entries.Title: Boris Godunov Mussorgsky (Dutch National Opera & Ballet)
Entries.Description: Nobleman Boris Godunov accumulates power in Russia, first as regent, then as tsar. But the ghosts of the past catch up with him and he ends up losing not only his power but his sanity. Russia sinks ever deeper into a mire of corruption, intrigue and coups.  In his grand choral opera, Modest Mussorgsky deals with a theme that offers poignant parallels to today’s world: the extremes to which one man’s thirst for power can lead. The director Kirill Serebrennikov incorporates his own experiences in Russia presenting his take on an opera about political turmoil and its consequences. Serebrennikov’s production focuses on the effect on the people of high-stakes political scheming. Conductor Vasily Petrenko makes his Amsterdam debut leading the Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra. A top-flight cast is led bass-baritone Tomasz Konieczny, celebrated for his ability to get into the skin of his characters both vocally and dramatically, sings the title role for the first time.

Entries.Title: Det nye huset
Entries.Description: Astrid has just one friend, her best friend Kristin, who lives in the neighbouring apartment building. She's just found out that Kristin is moving to another city, to a big house. Astrid feels scared of being left alone. She tries to arrange one last fantastic play session together in Kristin's apartment, but it's difficult when everything in the room reminds her that her friend is moving soon. It doesn't help that Kristin wants to play a game where Ken and Barbie buy a new, bigger house.

Entries.Title: CLOAKED
Entries.Description: CLOAKED is intended to be a TV series with 10 minute episodes. It's a fantasy action show that follows Nim while she balances learning to use her illegal magic to save the kingdom and her diplomatic duties as the princess's royal guard.

Entries.Title: The Breakup
Entries.Description: A young couple going off to college and scared of what lies ahead must resolve their ideas of the future in order to stay together.

Entries.Title: Runaway Renee
Entries.Description: When her best friend, Renee, fakes her own death Ella goes on a mission to find out why and how.

Entries.Title: Kaarawan
Entries.Description: An examination of trees, light, and shadows as manifestations of the passage of time.

Entries.Title: Listen to Me
Entries.Description: The road to motherhood while navigating institutional racism takes three Black women on a journey from heartbreak to resistance, healing and joy.

Entries.Title: Live Forever
Entries.Description: Live Forever  is a fan‑made concert film celebrating the music and spirit of the band Oasis. Created by Connor Withall, it’s a creative homage, featuring performances of iconic Oasis tracks in a live‑concert format

Entries.Title: Escape
Entries.Description: When the noise of the world gets too loud, escape isn't about running away-it's about remembering how to breathe. Escape is a quiet reckoning with distraction, stillness, and the everyday moments that slowly lead you back to yourself.

Entries.Title: Off-Script
Entries.Description: A couple are watching a horror film, however the main character in the film notices the camera. She gets out.

Entries.Title: Elastoplastic
Entries.Description: A broke young woman selling home-brew poison must stop a hitman from using her product to kill her sister’s primary school teacher — before the murder and her secret collide.

Entries.Title: Nuestra Torta
Entries.Description: Plot Withheld

Entries.Title: Dog.
Entries.Description: Short film by artist Sofia Isella

Entries.Title: InhuMaine
Entries.Description: InhuMaine is a powerful documentary that examines the growing homelessness crisis in Bangor. Filmed locally, it contrasts the natural beauty of iconic locations like Mount Katahdin and Cadillac Mountain with the stark reality faced by unhoused individuals living in encampments. Through intimate interviews with residents, advocates, nonprofit workers, and State Senator Joe Baldacci, the film exposes the systemic challenges and personal stories behind the crisis. InhuMaine offers a sobering look at the hidden darkness within so-called Vacationland, urging viewers to see beyond the postcard-perfect views and confront an urgent need for change. -NB, TL, JP, BW

Entries.Title: Thoosie Mob
Entries.Description: All amusement park enthusiasts (“Thoosies”) manage the dark, off-season months differently. Bay Village, Ohio natives Adam (Christmas Pets, Library Time) and Steph (Side Friction Podcast) share their visceral response to an absence of rollercoasters using the VHS format. These park-hopping coaster junkies take a multi-disciplinary approach to songwriting and arrangement. Subject matter includes the future of rollercoaster technology, standing in line for “credits”, and consuming park food exclusively. Join Thoosie Mob on their ride along America’s Rockin’ Roller Coast…

Entries.Title: color blind
Entries.Description: Trying to recontextualize the reality of the past, Alba is assaulted by mandatory emotions.

Entries.Title: The Reshoots
Entries.Description: When a client's video shoot is in danger of falling through last-minute, a scrappy indie film crew scrambles to figure out who among them is the “best guy” to handle the reshoot. Tensions rise, egos clash, and chaos ensues as they race against the clock to deliver the perfect shot.

Entries.Title: La Tierra de la Ballena
Entries.Description: For filmmaker Armando Capó, the southeastern Cuban town of Gibara is a place of ghosts, haunted by his lost youth, a bustling past that cannot be recovered — and the skeleton of a whale. THE LAND OF THE WHALE is a beautiful meditation on craft, beauty, aging, the transmission of knowledge, and what it means to be an artist.

Entries.Title: Wu Kids
Entries.Description: A man, lost in memories of his early life at Wu Kids Elementary, begins to wonder where all the time has gone. In search of nostalgia, he visits an old classmate-unaware that their reunion will uncover something far more devastating than he ever imagined.

Entries.Title: Re-animating lost echoes of cooperative dwelling at 835 Kings Road, West Hollywood
Entries.Description: 835 Kings Road is a classic example of early Californian modernist architecture. Constructed in 1922, this modernist home was initiated by four creative friends working to live together in a creative “cooperative enterprise”. But their ambitious and shared dream failed dramatically: within two years, one member of the group had attempted suicide and two others had abruptly left the project. In this stop-motion animated film carefully-made puppets of the original residents re-inhabit a set of their original self-built home. Sitting together, the puppets make repeated attempts to engage with each other in a different and, perhaps this time, a more mutually co-operative and less violent way.

Entries.Title: The Haunting Legacies of Pit-Ponies: Exploitation and the Echoes of Human-Equine Relations in Mining Systems
Entries.Description: This experimental film examines the entangled histories of human and equine lives bound in colonial and patriarchal oppressions through the industrial landscapes of Cornish pasts. Informed by the concept of 'haunting,' this practice research considers how legacies of exploitation continue to shape contemporary human-equine relationships.

Entries.Title: Requiem For A Dance!: The Turning Pointe
Entries.Description: A struggling ballet dancer is just getting settled in her new dance academy, but then gets falsely accused of a crime.

Entries.Title: Decending
Entries.Description: A girl new to town teams up with a stranger when a fire alarm sends them fleeing their apartment. As they navigate the stairwell and meet quirky neighbors, they begin to share a mutual bond.

Entries.Title: Precipice
Entries.Description: The earth spins around the sun at 30 km/sec. The habitable atmosphere on this planet extends 6 km into space and is composed of distinct layers. The troposphere extends upward from the earth to a height of about 8 km at the poles, to about 11.3 km in mid-latitudes, and to about 16.1 km at the equator. The air in the troposphere is in constant motion, with both horizontal and vertical air currents. As we exert ever increasing control we inevitably invite ever increasing chaos. The planetary boundaries framework defines a safe operating space for humanity based on the intrinsic biophysical processes that regulate the stability of the Earth system. From global warming to the biosphere and deforestation, from pollutants and plastic to nitrogen cycles and freshwater: Six of nine planetary boundaries are being crossed, while simultaneously pressure in all boundary processes is increasing.

Entries.Title: Brothers
Entries.Description: As they clean their childhood home ahead of their mother’s return from hospital, two brothers — Wayne and Ted — begin to sift through more than just dust.

Entries.Title: Desight
Entries.Description: If you believe in parallel worlds, please pray that they will take us in.

Entries.Title: Autumn Serenade
Entries.Description: Harry, a bisexual man, as he searches for connection on two dates-one with a man and one with a woman. Set against the autumnal backdrop of New York City and the Hudson Valley, this heartfelt and surrealist story explores difficulties with modern dating through the perspective of a bisexual man.

Entries.Title: Persistence
Entries.Description: El, a young anthropomorphic hyena woman, navigates the shadowy, litter-strewn back alleys of a sprawling futuristic city, where anthropomorphic animals and sentient robots of endless variety call home. El is in search of something lost to her and she is determined to find it. In hopes of answers, she heads into the inner city for something that could help...

Entries.Title: SKYBALLS(theatrical cut)
Entries.Description: Raegan and Lexi are siblings whose car breaks down on their way to rob a bank, and they encounter a surreal creature.

Entries.Title: I AM ME
Entries.Description: A look into identity and who I believe I am

Entries.Title: Memories of A Wedding
Entries.Description: Taqwa Bint Ali returns to Zarzis in southern Tunisia, observing its wedding customs as cultural events that anchor families in history and heritage.

Entries.Title: All Hail Sacrifice
Entries.Description: A film poem on the path to nonbeing.

Entries.Title: is it like being hypnotized
Entries.Description: an exercise in montage - a film that accompanies the audio collage of the same name (recordings of my dreams-)

Entries.Title: Game On
Entries.Description: As she creates her 50th game, legendary designer Brenda Romero leads her team through the highs and hurdles of game development, balancing motherhood, leadership, and creativity.

Entries.Title: Telefon-saudade
Entries.Description: Telefon-Saudade is an intimate short drama about an elderly woman mourning her lost son, who finds unexpected comfort in conversations with a phone scammer posing as her grandchild. As her daughter struggles to understand this fragile emotional coping mechanism, the film reveals the quiet depths of loneliness and the complex dynamics of love, grief, and letting go. Through everyday spaces and quiet moments, Telefon-Saudade explores the need to be heard—and the illusions we cling to in search of connection.

Entries.Title: The Elites
Entries.Description: A short film about a girl who gets kidnapped by high class people or is she really?

Entries.Title: Becoming Her - A Life in Drag
Entries.Description: This portrait accompanies 19 year-old Mats van Heusden, better known as Miss Hyon Metz, through a typical day of his life as one of Amsterdam's beloved Drag Queens. In 2024, at just 18, he won the title of Holland's Best Drag Artist, and this is just the beginning.

Entries.Title: This House Doesn’t End.Mov
Entries.Description: A man goes back to his childhood home but something was already there.

Entries.Title: The King
Entries.Description: A young man struggles with his power.

Entries.Title: Explant / implant
Entries.Description: A lifetime of surgeries continues with an upgrade in battery life and a downgrade in scar tissue.

Entries.Title: Jigsaw Falling
Entries.Description: When an artist struggles to complete an artwork overnight, the night slowly starts to devour him.

Entries.Title: Broken Past
Entries.Description: We follow Max, a young man haunted by the shadows of a troubled and precarious past. As he strives to build a new, peaceful life, a haunting question hangs heavy in the air: can he truly break free from what he once was, or will his past return to shatter the future he's so desperately trying to create?

Entries.Title: Passages
Entries.Description: A set of nine instructions guides willing participants in an attempt to cross the barrier between the screen and the world.

Entries.Title: In Love With The Colors
Entries.Description: A story about love, hope, and second chances, through the lens of all the colors of the world.

Entries.Title: Susbusters: Please Laugh (YTP)
Entries.Description: Susbusters: Please Laugh is a comedic retelling of the events of the indie film 'Ghostbusters Virginia: Don't Make Me Laugh'

Entries.Title: Just Breathe
Entries.Description: Nick Bianco sets out to reunite with the love of his life after serving a year in jail for assault, only to discover that she has a new admirer named Chester... who also happens to be his parole officer.

Entries.Title: Holding Liat
Entries.Description: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.

Entries.Title: Every Heavy Thing
Entries.Description: A journey centered around an ad-seller for one of the last alt-weeklies in the country, who, after witnessing a murder, is intimidated into being the killer's reluctant accomplice.

Entries.Title: Preparation for the Next Life
Entries.Description: Aishe, a Uyghur woman trained by her military father, migrates to New York City where she finds herself laboring in Chinatown’s underground kitchens. She fatefully encounters Skinner, a young American soldier who has just returned from three tours in the Middle East. While falling in love, they discover the possibility of a better life together than the ones they believed they were destined to live alone.

Entries.Title: Round the Decay
Entries.Description: Tourists and townspeople settle in for a seemingly normal off-season day in Newport's Valley, New Hampshire, while something sinister lurks.

Entries.Title: Zero A.D.
Entries.Description: A brutal ruler fears a prophecy and orders the death of a child—one who will change history.

Entries.Title: The Divorce Lawyer
Entries.Description: When emotionally abandoned wife Zahra Jones seeks the help of divorce attorney Joshua Wright, she becomes the target of a twisted obsession, forcing her and her husband Mark to survive against a man determined to ruin her life.

Entries.Title: Christmas Karma
Entries.Description: A Conservative voting, refugee hating curmudgeon undergoes a radical personality transformation over the course of a single night, thanks to a trio of ghosts.

Entries.Title: Mama Dearest
Entries.Description: When Josh, a handsome young football star, is left with a broken leg after a car accident on a remote road between Florida and Georgia, he is rescued by a strange girl named Hillary, who hides him away in a hunting cabin on her family’s run-down property to recuperate. When he realizes that she is not going to let him go, he es-capes, only to encounter her mother, Angela, who is even more twisted than her daughter and is determined to keep Josh prisoner for her own…

Entries.Title: Me Three
Entries.Description: Jeannie is a dark, self-destructive, closeted 17-year-old West L.A. girl.  She has to navigate school, friends, her first romance with a girl, and dealing with her bickering divorced parents.  Jeannie purchases a Native American pendant to help her gain positive energy. But something goes wrong when the pendent transfers the spirits of her slain parents into her body.

Entries.Title: Three Wisest Men
Entries.Description: Luke is expecting twins, Taylor is debating a life-changing job, and Stephan is planning a wedding — all while their mom is planning to put the family home up for sale.

Entries.Title: A Royal Montana Christmas
Entries.Description: A princess looking to decompress before the holidays heads to a Montana ranch and meets a charming guide.

Entries.Title: A Newport Christmas
Entries.Description: A charitable and spirited Newport socialite in 1905 finds out her father intends for her to become engaged to a man she’s never met at the upcoming Christmas Eve ball. When she wishes for a different life, a man appears — and she somehow time-travels to 2025.

Entries.Title: Starvedlight
Entries.Description: In a forgotten corner of medieval England, Adalira, haunted by the spirit of a unicorn, embarks on a perilous quest with her sister Edith into Acre Hollow - only to be ensnared by ancient folk magic and a descent into something more monstrous than myth.

Entries.Title: Ozzy Osbourne: No Escape from Now
Entries.Description: Ozzy Osbourne faces his identity and mortality after his world stops. Dealing with health issues and Parkinson's, he questions if he can perform again while music remains his life's cornerstone.

Entries.Title: She's Making a List
Entries.Description: Naughty or Nice inspector Isabel Haynes doesn’t anticipate anything out of the ordinary when she’s assigned to evaluate 11-year-old Charlie Duncan. However, soon, Isabel falls for Charlie’s widowed father Jason, which makes her question the rigid rules of her job. As Christmas approaches, Isabel must choose between following the holiday algorithm or following her heart.

Entries.Title: Unnatural
Entries.Description: An innocent sleepover turns horrific as Steph's unnatural feelings for her friend manifest in the grotesque.

Entries.Title: The Aesthetics of Fascism
Entries.Description: Fascists were the ultimate aura farmer. An aesthetic that was meant to hypnotize the public. Now we got ghibli-fied, shitposting clowns posing with chainsaws. What happened? To understand the "New Aesthetics of Fascism" we have to explore its "traditional" Aesthetics. Only by doing so we can recognize the parallels and especially the lost aura fascism once had.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: Web of Wonders
Entries.Description: Spider-Man finds Black Cat, Black Cat kisses Spider-Man then Spider-Man stops Venom and Dr Octopus.

Entries.Title: Dimwich
Entries.Description: A portrait of a small town shown through various drawings.

Entries.Title: The  New Aesthetics of Fascism
Entries.Description: The New Aesthetics of Fascism

Entries.Title: Earthquake: Joke Telling Business
Entries.Description: From unpacking celebrity scandals to hot takes on love, legendary comic Earthquake shakes things up in this explosive stand-up set.

Entries.Title: Unspoken Lines
Entries.Description: A lyrical meditation on love, creation, and a woman's quiet reclamation of her own power. An artist sketches a woman who comes to life. As he dives deeper into his work, she questions the limits of her existence.

Entries.Title: The Tremendous Video
Entries.Description: A compilation of unused videos from 2024.

Entries.Title: In the Hands of Fate
Entries.Description: In the Hands of Fate follows a hit man who must hunt down a witness he previously spared after she steals money from a dangerous drug kingpin. However, the witness seeks out an old friend for help who has since joined a cult. When the worlds of gangsters and cultists collide, everyone's life is In the Hands of Fate.—Samuel L. Fronsman

Entries.Title: A Christmas Angel Match
Entries.Description: Christmas angels used to working alone to bring “destined soulmates together” over the holidays, are unexpectedly paired; soon, their “clashing styles – and the undeniable spark growing between them – complicate their mission.”

Entries.Title: OH, DEER
Entries.Description: When a couple's explosive argument is interrupted by a tragic accident, the night takes a turn they never saw coming.

Entries.Title: Grin
Entries.Description: When newly elected mayor Frank Ford's failed attempts to run the local freak show out of town, Grady Nelson the ring master, and father figure to Grin, Karnage, and Kisses is murdered. Grin is well aware of who committed this heinous act, and The Circus Rejects seek revenge on the mayor and everyone who stands in their way!

Entries.Title: The Playwright's Lover
Entries.Description: Vivian, an emotionally alienated playwright, casts Anthony, an ennui-plagued womanizer desperate to win her affection, as the star of her upcoming play. As the production moves forward, their relationship on and off the stage is tested, forcing them to confront the truth of their very nature and state of perpetual unhappiness.

Entries.Title: Language Back
Entries.Description: Language Back is a short documentary featuring snippets of conversation and lectures at Indigenous Nations Poets #LanguageBack Workshops from UW-Milwaukee and The College of Menominee Nation in 2024.  The film consists of narration by Kimberly M. Blaeser (Founder of In-Na-Po), Mark Freeland (Director of the Electa Quinney Institute), and Language Revivalists: Rosa King, Richard Oshkeshequoam, Kai Pyle, Brock Schreiber, and Wayne Valliere.  This short showcases In-Na-Po workshop participants exploring poetic use of Native languages and gathering to build community in educational and outdoor settings. It features the work of poets along with time-lapse photography of LED letter panels from the Overpass Light Brigade.  It is set to a soundtrack featuring world music and a short poem by Jeremiah Moses, Jr.

Entries.Title: Tarantula Land
Entries.Description: A Texas brown tarantula navigates its changing landscape through touch and vibration in the grasslands of southern Colorado.

Entries.Title: I Am Sorry
Entries.Description: The confession of a young drug addict

Entries.Title: Ode to the Aimless
Entries.Description: A go-getter college dropout goes on a quirky quest of self discovery in order to appease the expectations of her younger self.

Entries.Title: Pigeon Hole
Entries.Description: When a man is late to work after getting pooped on by a pigeon, he hustles through the park to make it on time. Suddenly, it happens again. Only this time, when he looks up, he does not see a pigeon... He sees a PIGEON MAN!
Short film depicting a trip to the zoo. Originally shot in 2014, the film was assembled and released in 2025.

Entries.Title: The Pilgrim's Ballad
Entries.Description: A religious man becomes fearful of not being accepted into heaven after a priest discovers his secret

Entries.Title: Otherworld
Entries.Description: A poetic documentary exploring Abenaki ancestral memory and connection to Allen Island, the site of first contact with the English in 1605, which was bought and curated by the wife of American painter Andrew Wyeth three centuries later in hopes of enticing her husband’s inspiration.

Entries.Title: 'Napped
Entries.Description: Napped tells the story of two flatmates Owen and Tyler who wake up after a wild party to find a stranger tied up in their living room.

Entries.Title: Stay Here
Entries.Description: A short film about growing up.

Entries.Title: The Everglades
Entries.Description: While driving through a Miami car wash built on land that was once part of the Everglades, Campbell McGrath reads his poem on one of America’s great, vanishing wild spaces.

Entries.Title: & Nothing More
Entries.Description: Two girls, Anne and Daisy, have a late-night conversation. Daisy, a free spirit, and Anne, quiet but profound, share a moment of connection, with a subtle bond growing between them.

Entries.Title: Bleeding Insanity
Entries.Description: After a man being woken up from an alarm that's not his, he discovers everything is not so right, it’s a home invasion spiraling into disaster… or is it?

Entries.Title: Rockumentary: The Quiet Life of a Rock
Entries.Description: How do rocks live their life? in this mockumentary Rockumentary we take you on a journey to witness a rock in their natural habitat...

Entries.Title: Loverboy
Entries.Description: When Will and Blake decide to catch up, they soon find they're in a bit of a struggle when it comes to relationships.

Entries.Title: Transmission
Entries.Description: An audio-visual experience through the perspective of an iPhone depicting a harmonious city during the day quickly descend into technological madness as night falls.

Entries.Title: Crystalline
Entries.Description: A drag queen haunted by addiction must battle vivid hallucinations to nail a life-changing performance.

Entries.Title: Chalk Weather
Entries.Description: Two siblings build a device with the ability to contact their dead father.

Entries.Title: Ratman Goes to Therapy
Entries.Description: In order to receive medical treatment, the feral and monstrous Ratman is subjected to perverse psychoanalytic experiments.

Entries.Title: Debil Debil Baldwin Spencer

Drawing on Spencer’s controversial legacy as an evolutionary biologist whose work influenced the Stolen Generation policy, the film seeks to decolonize the space and reimagine its significance.   Walter Baldwin Spencer’s legacy is etched into the institution through the building and his ideology lingers in unsettling ways beyond the foundational bricks and mortar of the building itself.  The film is made through a sensitive observational and experimental documentary style lens which aims to translate the weight of his experience into an evocative and deeply immersive form.

Entries.Title: Archive of My Own

On August 5th, Archive of My Own proudly took home Best Production and Best Director (Zoé Zifer) at the NY Theater Festival Awards. Now, for the first time, experience the magic of this award-winning play on screen.  ABOUT THE SHOW: A coming-of-age story for the fanfic generation.‘Archive of My Own’ explores a young woman’s struggle to reconcile the steamy, highly choreographed love scenes from her fanfiction past with the jarringly messy and unpredictable world of real-life intimacy – through a series of her own authentic, verbatim Glee fanfiction excerpts.

Entries.Title: Lover, Lovers, Loving, Love

LOVER, LOVERS, LOVING, LOVE concentrates mostly on the idea of plant sex, mating, plant love, and reproduction to foreground the making of life as the inevitable making of death. The film will mix live action as well as continuous and discontinuous stroboscopic techniques.

Entries.Description: Grammy-nominated electronic artist ZHU is running out of time. Having bursted out of the dance scene in 2014 with his hit “Faded”, he finds himself a decade later at a musical crossroad. Steadily touring worldwide on the biggest stages with his band, he returns to San Francisco, a place where he grew up, to record his fourth studio album “Grace”. Inside this gothic cathedral, ZHU and his collaborators finish composing songs which are performed for an audience later that night.

Entries.Title: Unbroken Ties
Entries.Description: Unbroken Ties exposes the harsh realities of foster care. For many, the system is a nightmare—filled with trauma no child should endure. Protecting younger siblings became a mission then, and now that mission continues through this deeply personal documentary. It sheds light on the abuse countless children still face, not because they are the problem but because their environment has failed them. Yet, amidst the pain, there is hope. Through archival footage and interviews, Unbroken Ties explores resilience, chosen families, and the transformative power of love beyond blood.

Entries.Title: Palimpsest
Entries.Description: Palimpsest is an interactive documentary that traces childhood fear and anxiety from the Cold War to school shootings in America, while along the way connecting Archimedes, Choose Your Adventure books, Baseball, Ray Bradbury, Charles Dickens, Peter Pan, John Fahey, Turtles, and every demographic cohort from The Greatest Generation to Gen Z. Palimpsest scrapes at this messy history in an attempt to reveal causes and solutions for one of America's greatest public health epidemics.

Entries.Title: Pendelum
Entries.Description: An abandoned TV starts showing a collection of surreal short films from a recently defunct channel

Entries.Title: The Belly of the Beast
Entries.Description: It is a disorienting cave exploration with something sinister lurking in the shadows.

Entries.Title: Invisible Warriors: African American Women in World War II
Entries.Description: Invisible Warriors: African American Women in World War II, illuminates the wartime experiences of 600,000 “Rosie the Riveters” - pioneers who courageously triumph over racism and sexism to create job opportunities in industry and government for themselves and future generations of African American women.

Entries.Title: Unchoosing Yourself
Entries.Description: Presenting a short film I made during a 24-hour filmmaking challenge at my university.  The theme was "Unchosen Dream," and we had a maximum duration of 5 minutes.

Entries.Title: Welfare Warriors
Entries.Description: Two friends on government welfare who, upon being forced into jobs, decide to steal cryptocurrency from a self-absorbed influencer.

Entries.Title: B-Side
Entries.Description: In this liminal fantasy, a late night brush with magic sets Jesse on a new path towards healing.

Entries.Title: Halcyon
Entries.Description: A serene journey weaving through towering mountains, whispering trees, and drifting clouds where nature’s silence speaks louder than words, and every second feels like walking through a dream.

Entries.Title: Pumpkin
Entries.Description: A young woman embarks on a journey of finding her one true love within the modern dating world.

Entries.Title: Duplicity
Entries.Description: Suhrab, a notorious figure in the underground drug world, is invited to the luxurious home of his rival, Serg, for a supposed negotiation. However, upon arrival, Suhrab quickly realizes that Serg's intentions are far from peaceful.

Entries.Title: The Replicant
Entries.Description: The Replicant is a ballet of metallic humanoids, their shadows brushing and merging. Endlessly repeating.  Bodies multiply in sensual loops. Sweat becomes mercury. The heat rises as the silhouettes make contact.

Entries.Title: Afraid of Peacock
Entries.Description: On the way to the supermarket, a family discusses the history of the old zoo in Poznan, Poland, and Darwin’s absurd fear of peacocks.

Entries.Title: Genesis
Entries.Description: A short story of two best friends, or at least used to be until someone close to their heart manipulated one the friends into killing each other out of bloodthirsty jealously.

Entries.Title: Women of World War II: The Untold Stories
Entries.Description: Meet the American women who built the planes and flew them-- who fought on the war front and broke barriers on the home front. History comes alive with newly-rediscovered interviews and rarely seen archival footage.

Entries.Title: No Second Chances
Entries.Description: A man goes against his better judgement and chases his husband’s killer.

Entries.Title: After Grace IV
Entries.Description: As the artist disappears and reappears through a retrospective installation of their work, After Grace IV is a visual relic of Dez’Mon’s first foray into performance art. In an attempt to hold space for opposing principles while escalating towards a common vision, the After Grace series has become an ongoing project where filmmakers create pieces based on the same poem—a poem that convinced a painter to strongly consider writing, then writing strongly advocated for performance, then performance insisted upon installation. After Grace, as a whole, is meant to remind the artist of origins, being green, the earnestness and eagerness of unrefined creativity holding the many hands of collaboration and possibility, being led in many directions in the hopes of returning as something familiar, however renewed.

Entries.Title: Last Night in Urbana
Entries.Description: Over the course of a rain-soaked night, private detective Andre Conrad unravels a series of confounding murders, uncovering a deadly menace stalking the streets of Urbana.

Entries.Title: Tropicmania
Entries.Description: Steve Skyfire and Willard Midnight embark on the tenacious journey of becoming professional wrestlers, eventually venturing fame and superstardom.

Entries.Title: With Sympathy
Entries.Description: Two young dancers, August and Winter, grieve personal losses in radically different ways.

Entries.Title: Beautiful Was The Fight
Entries.Description: The stories of several women in the Boston music scene and their struggle to achieve equality and success while embracing their identities and finding a voice in the community.

Entries.Title: The Birdies Story
Entries.Description: Owen sits down with co-owner Bob Cutler to discuss how Birdies was founded.

Entries.Title: A Witch Makes A Puzzle
Entries.Description: A little witch working on a puzzle!

Entries.Title: Press F
Entries.Description: Two years in, but Zakovat Quiz podium is still out of reach.

Entries.Title: Wake
Entries.Description: In a poetic exploration of death and grief, filmmaker Eva Phillips embarks on a journey to reconnect with their grandfather years after his passing. Through testimonials from their mother and grandmother, Phillips uncovers new truths in their relationship with their grandfather and the significance of his life to their family.

Entries.Title: Time Warp
Entries.Description: you will lose all perception of time…

Entries.Title: The Great Godzilla War: Day 1
Entries.Description: The first installment in Jbots Stop-Motion Trilogy. As Godzilla variants across the multiverse vanish through mysterious portals, a cataclysmic war erupts between them - threatening the balance of all realities.

Entries.Description: Amber and Noah are on a camping trip to reconnect - but things take a turn for the worst, after Noah breaks their no-technology agreement.

Entries.Title: The Universal Catastrophe
Entries.Description: Confronted by an unworldly entity, a teenager is forced to fix a mistake he made years ago, which threatens the alleged safety of the universe.

Uganda is a land of hidden wonders and endless bounties, and activities include chowing down on street food in Entebbe, rafting down the Nile River, gorilla trekking, visiting banana and coffee farms and training with a local baseball team.

Entries.Title: Reflections
Entries.Description: Beloved textures left to their own devices. 2 of

Entries.Title: She'll Come Back
Entries.Description: A tale of mystery and quiet dread plays out in a cabin that sits alone deep within the still Florida-forest. Three friends, Amil, Michelle and Jay wake up on a cold morning to find their dog missing, leaving behind a peculiar trail. When Amil plunges into the woods alone, an uneasy silence falls, and the calm inside the cabin begins to fracture.

Entries.Title: radiation
Entries.Description: A mysterious stranger investigates a series of radiation spikes in New Mexico.

Entries.Title: The Doorbell

Entries.Title: Pearl Harbor: Through the Eyes of Japan
Entries.Description: For the first time, one of the deadliest moments in World War II is recreated in stunning detail: the surprise attack on the US Naval base at Pearl Harbor. But this time, through the eyes of the aggressors: the commanders and pilots of Imperial Japan.

Entries.Title: Exposing The 9/11 Cover-Up | TMZ Investigates: The Fifth Plane
Entries.Description: More than two decades after the September 11th attacks, chilling new claims are surfacing about a possible fifth plane intended to strike. While four hijacked planes carried out the devastating attacks, new information suggests another aircraft may have been part of the original plot — one that never reached its target. Was it grounded in time? Covered up? Or simply forgotten? This investigation digs into government documents, eyewitness accounts, and hidden details that may point to a fifth plane… and a deeper conspiracy.

Entries.Title: The Suffering Tenants - Showreel
Entries.Description: Henry invites his friend to repair his broken lamp. Strangely, there is a letter in it and soon things get out of hand...

Entries.Title: The Girl That Got Glue Stuck In Her Hair
Entries.Description: Learn what really happened during the “gorilla glue crisis”

Entries.Title: Welcome To Fredbear's
Entries.Description: Welcome to Fredbear’s follows three ghost hunters—Kevin, Mari, and Andrew—who explore the abandoned Fredbear’s Family Diner after its sudden shutdown. What starts as a routine investigation turns deadly when the animatronics begin to free roam—leaving the pizzeria and targeting the trio. As the robots hunt them down and slaughter anyone in their path, the ghost hunters must uncover the truth behind Fredbear’s dark past before they become its next victims.

Entries.Title: Death of a Jared
Entries.Description: A door-to-door salesman, Jared Vanson, arrives at a house of a young woman named Alethea Winnfield to sell her a vacuum cleaner. However, he soon realizes something is up with her, starting to realize this was a mistake.

Entries.Description: A salt of the earth, inner-city detective, 'Stefani Bennett' is assigned to a complex rash of deaths. While trying to understand her gift of clairvoyance, she seeks guidance from her late Father's Police partner, and long time family spiritual leader, Father Arland Anthony.

Entries.Title: Hide & Seek

Entries.Title: Single on the 25th
Entries.Description: After Nell’s family cancels holiday plans at the last minute, she decides to spend the week of Christmas having fun on her own — and crosses paths with her neighbor, who is “happily unattached.”

Entries.Title: Silver Needle
Entries.Description: After moving to China from New Zealand, two sisters try to adjust to their new ballet class, only to find that the teacher has an unusual teaching method.

Entries.Title: 404: An Internet Archive Doc
Entries.Description: An exploration of the mission and impact of the Internet Archive, spotlighting Brewster Kahle and Mark Graham, and their Wayback Machine as a powerful tool for preserving the ever-changing digital landscape.

Entries.Title: 10 Steps and 15 Beats
Entries.Description: A boy and girl take part in a duel together.

Entries.Description: Recovered footage from a lost episode of an old travel vlog.

Entries.Description: An exploration of fear, masculinity, and American gun culture.

Entries.Title: Johnny's Spitfire Vid
Entries.Description: Karim Callender, Antonio Durao, Max Palmer, Andrew Wilson, Cyrus Bennett, and friends in New York for the release of the new Burn Squad Pro Edition wheels.

Entries.Title: MAULED: Live at Black Circle
Entries.Description: SETLIST: resume carnage | NGEFY | mauled | time flies when you have a gun | unreleased | dead asleep | 4.2% | from life...to lifeless | the peaceful midwest

Entries.Description: Two friends and a cat hangout, make snacks and record music together.

Entries.Description: On his birthday, a man trapped in a never-ending party struggles to break free from a haunting feeling of isolation. The song won’t stop, the candles won’t die and what should feel like joy feels like drowning. Happy Birthday Amari!

Entries.Title: Missing Black Women
Entries.Description: Missing Black Women is a powerful new documentary that sheds light on one of America's most overlooked crises-the disappearance of Black women and girls across the country.

Entries.Title: Showdown

Entries.Description: A beauty influencer wannabe must battle murder allegations when a social media celebrity dies suddenly.

Entries.Title: NOON
Entries.Description: Consequences without any actions.

Entries.Title: Operation Talus
Entries.Description: When their heist to steal a power core from an evil corporation is compromised, the Echo and Cyrus must fight their way free.

Entries.Title: Shake Down
Entries.Description: A recently-fired man tries to cheer himself up with a Butterfinger milkshake, but doesn't get exactly what he expected.

Entries.Title: A Telephone for God
Entries.Description: Breathe in to receive. Exhale in a sharp burst through the nostrils to send. Quartz is the medium—amplifier, transducer, archive. Inspired by the research of Marcel Vogel—IBM senior research chemist turned spiritual scientist—A Telephone for God oscillates between past and present, tuning into frequencies of human–plant communication and energetic healing. The film follows Drew Tousley, one of the few crystal cutters personally trained by Vogel before his passing in 1991, as he creates a four-sided Vogel crystal modeled after the Kabbalistic Tree of Life. Alongside him, energy healer and Reiki Master Carly Tousley reflects on the use of crystals in healing. Award-winning artist Merik Goma stars as Vogel’s present-day assistant.

Entries.Title: CABINET
Entries.Description: Documenting the death of his father and birth of his daughter, CABINET presents a delicate conceptual space between nascency and expiration. So, a body starts, ends, and remains deeply interred: afloat, aloft.

Entries.Title: Arrested Autonomy
Entries.Description: Deep in the Bolivian Amazon, infant spider monkeys Ñoqui, Cesar, and Ness have been rescued from hunters and the illegal pet trade. But returning to the jungle without their mothers is no easy task. Arrested Autonomy follows their uncertain journey as they attempt to reclaim their place in the wild, questioning whether a second chance at true freedom is possible when that freedom must be brokered by humans.

Entries.Title: The Apocolypse
Entries.Description: Zombies run mad  In 2026 a mad virous outbreak turns infected into zombies  This could be the end of humanity as we know it

Entries.Title: I dream about Colorful Earth
Entries.Description: Using watercolor animation technique, "I dream about Colorful Earth" brings to life the director’s dreams and memories of Earth. Blending fluid motion and vibrant imagery, the film explores themes of connection, resilience, and unity. As colors merge and transform, the dream unfolds a poetic reflection on humanity’s shared journey.

Entries.Title: & After
Entries.Description: On the eve of a major life change, Abby sorts through memories, unfinished conversations, and the pieces of a friendship strained by ambition. As departure day looms, the past and present collide, forcing her to confront what moving forward really means.

Entries.Title: Retrospection
Entries.Description: Director Patrick Civitelli's first experimental documentary, Retrospection (2025), follows Civitelli as he travels through time, looking back at his childhood. Through different sources, Civitelli recounts memories that were unforgettable.

Entries.Title: Fake
Entries.Description: A lone man travels to universities bearing a message that the moon landings were staged and warning that the earth is not what it seems.

Entries.Title: STILLTURN
Entries.Description: Coming to terms with what hasn't worked and what will never work.

Entries.Title: BURREATO: a magnus burrito challenge
Entries.Description: Magnus has just 10 minutes to conquer the ultimate food challenge: a double steak, double-wrapped burrito.

Entries.Title: 25 Million Stitches: One Stitch, One Refugee
Entries.Description: 25 Million Stitches: One Stitch, One Refugee is an artistic statement from the international community about human displacement, on view at WMQFA from March 1 - July 28, 2024. Explore the creation, installation, and impact of this powerful exhibition with Jennifer Kim Sohn, the artist who conceived the project; panel makers and WMQFA volunteers Nina Edelman and Helen Lambron; WMQFA artist in residence Noora Badeen; and museum staff. The exhibition includes 25 million hand-sewn stitches, each representing a single displaced human being. The smaller panels are bound to 407 muslin banners. Building the physical representation of this statistic required participation from 2,300 stitches from 37 countries and all 50 U.S. states.

Entries.Title: Trump Revolution: 100 Days That Changed the World
Entries.Description: Following 100 turbulent days of Trump's second term - full of unprecedented political and economic decisions - commentators and insiders ask: is unpredictability and chaos part of the master plan?

Entries.Title: Oozing
Entries.Description: Maggie, with the help of her friend Charlize, deals with the anguish, pain and torment that is having a crush on someone. Her desires however are compromised when she finally goes on a date with the man of her... dreams?

Entries.Title: Town Square
Entries.Description: Memory care pioneers build a replica 1950s town, challenging Alzheimer's care norms while families desperately await a breakthrough.

Entries.Title: Phonetic Philmmaking
Entries.Description: For as long as I can remember, I have always lived with the disruption of language intertwined with my learning disability. “Phonetic Philmmaking”, a 20 minute experimental Super 8 film, satirizes normative language conventions and transforms them into a new visual vernacular linking metaphorical and literal meanings within the verbs, nouns and pictures. Shot in Toronto and New York City, it features an original soundtrack by Daniel Brlas. With the help of Cullen Ritchie, elements of the footage were purposely distressed to emphasize textual illegibility. This film explains my world – if only I can find the right word.

Entries.Title: Picture You
Entries.Description: Luna, a stubborn high school girl, is stuck in her ways with her boyfriend. Their  relationship takes a rocky turn when she starts to have visions of an enchanting girl  in the place of her boyfriend. She in turn must navigate these fantasies overtaking  her life and come to terms with her sexuality.

Entries.Title: The Good List
Entries.Description: A grown man with an unwavering belief in the magic of Christmas confronts his office's Santa Claus in an attempt to get himself back onto the good list.

Entries.Title: Lychgate
Entries.Description: Lychgate reimagines the selection of The Chosen One in the iconic ballet The Rite of Spring, depicting a community of women performing a ritual, not to sacrifice, but to honor the unknown and empower one member to envision it. This 360º dance film blurs the boundaries between terrestrial and ethereal planes, sweeping the viewer up in the fervor of bodies moving in ceremony and synchronicity.

Entries.Title: The Beyond in the Age of Aquarius
Entries.Description: Documentary on the American release of Lucio Fulci's THE BEYOND.

Entries.Title: Kai Bass podcast
Entries.Description: Kai Bass offers a nuanced glimpse into her perspective on Chappell Roan, reflecting on her rise to prominence—though not her fall—and shares her journey alongside her radiant friend.

Entries.Title: Wolf Land
Entries.Description: Range rider and "wolf-protecting cowboy" Daniel Curry and cattle rancher Jerry Francis try to find common ground between their conflicting interests in the forests of northeastern Washington, just 20 miles from the Canadian border.

Entries.Title: Jon Anderson And The Band Geeks - Live - Perpetual Change
Entries.Description: Video recorded on May 12, 2023 at the Arcada Theatre in St. Charles, IL and May 13, 2023 at the Des Plaines Theatre in Des Plaines, IL.

Entries.Title: Thump
Entries.Description: A teen girl prepares to leave for prom when she hears a thump as she backs out of her driveway.

Entries.Title: How Long Can You Go Without Breathing?

Entries.Title: The Danube so Blue
Entries.Description: A sketch. A freely-associating essay on the "beautiful blue Danube". Images of the Danube, images of blue, historical photographs and private archives: Everything is blended into an attempt to capture. stream of thoughts on the subject of the Blue Danube and - at least briefly - give it a form, before the stream is allowed to flow onward, like the river.

Entries.Title: A New War Film

They all do a good job of reminding each other of their biggest flaws. Jason masturbates too much, Nathan proposes to everyone who goes on a date with him, Gabriella is a dominatrix, Jessica is obsessed with herself.

Entries.Title: Not Alone
Entries.Description: Claustrophobic and the horror of being trapped alive in a box.

Entries.Title: Hold On
Entries.Description: A climber tries to complete his route. He stumbles upon a seemingly unconquerable obstacle, can he overcome it?

Entries.Title: Opposite Day
Entries.Description: Sam realizes her best friend Saffron hasn’t talked to her in exactly a year. When checking her calendar to see if it’s really been a full year, she finds out, it’s opposite day. When Sam confronts Saffron over the phone, Saffron shares her feelings about their friendship, except Sam hears everything she is saying as the opposite.  The two friends agree to meet up at a park to discuss things over in person. They have trouble communicating with each other and conflict arises.  Saffron ends up standing up for herself and leaving the toxic relationship with Sam behind.

Entries.Title: J.B. Ball - Jesus in the Crackhouse
Entries.Description: In his new stand-up comedy special Jesus in The Crackhouse, J.B. Ball covers everything from The Olympics to a bizarre security experience in the TSA line. J.B. isn’t afraid to speak his mind and is a master at finding humor in every situation. Watch now to hear J.B.’s thoughts on where we stand as a country and when you should (and shouldn’t) be shouting “‘MERICA!".

Entries.Title: Our Movement Starts Here
Entries.Description: The story of a rural community in the American South that inspired the international environmental justice movement and articulated the concept of environmental racism by fighting the state of North Carolina's toxic landfill.

Entries.Title: The Stones Are Speaking
Entries.Description: The Stones Are Speaking tells the inspiring story of how archaeologist Mike Collins, at great personal sacrifice, saved a looted piece of land in rural Texas that ultimately changed the story of the peopling of the Americas. It’s a tale of passion and perseverance and taking action for the greater good.

Entries.Title: Aeon Oz
Entries.Description: AEON OZ, a beautiful film about the meaning of life and the transformative power of metamorphosis in the meditative flow of time. Visual poetry, impressive images, extraordinary music, huge landscapes and a protagonist who moves through the transparent air in the dance of life, like a wave of energy. Aeon Oz, a complex meditative work of art and a hymn to the moment.

Entries.Title: 5-cent American Flag

Entries.Title: Misophonia

Entries.Title: Into the Night

Entries.Title: The Sounds of the City
Entries.Description: The untold story of one of the most influential cities in the history of music. From 1920 until today Kansas City has influenced music. Beginning in the 1920s with the evolution of Jazz and Blues from prohibition. In the 1960s and 70's a center for Folk music at the Vanguard Coffeehouse. The cultivation of the KC Sound by bands like Seasons to Risk, Frogpond and The Get Up Kids. Across Troost Avenue hip hop artists like Tech N9ne, Rich the Factor and Mac Lethal were making names Across the country and establishing Kansas City as a force in music.

Entries.Title: Home Front
Entries.Description: With their 8-year-old son, Henry, minutes away from returning home from summer camp, tensions boil between two long-struggling parents. As Rose and Malachi reach their breaking points, their home transforms into a war zone.

Entries.Title: Frats with Benefits

Entries.Title: Application To Be Lars Von Trier's "Female Girlfriend/Muse"
Entries.Description: Summer 2023 filmmaker and Dogme 95 founder Lars Von Trier posted a video on instagram seeking applications for a, "female girlfriend/muse." Later that week I visited Rose, my 72 year old neighbor, best friend, and possibly my muse to film an application and examine our relationship. Lars has yet to respond.

Entries.Title: Language of Life
Entries.Description: A bond forms between two women at opposite ends of life; they share a conversation that transcends age and experience.

Entries.Title: Blind Date
Entries.Description: When clout-chasing Leigh and cynical Mindy's first date takes a sinister turn, they discover that embracing their real, "no filters" selves might be their best shot at making it through the night.

Entries.Title: Guilty until Graduated
Entries.Description: A teenage slacker starts to revaluate his own actions when his graduation is around the corner. With his trusty band of quirky mates and an opportunity for love, he embarks on a personal journey of growth.

Entries.Title: Our Heart
Entries.Description: A testimony on the life of P Nuut, an artistan at Thai Village Inc. and how she came to discover faith and community in Thailand.

Entries.Title: The Great Entertainer
Entries.Description: Brian Walsh, a visionary in Australian media, revolutionized TV, entertainment, and sport, shaping how Australians saw themselves and their stories. He launched the careers of stars like Nicole Kidman, Hugh Jackman, Kylie Minogue, and Guy Pearce, and created cultural moments that defined a generation. Walsh championed diversity and modernity at a time when Australia was finding its cultural voice. A mentor and advocate for new voices, his influence extended far beyond the screen, leaving an enduring legacy in the country’s entertainment industry and cultural identity.

Entries.Title: Another Dull Ache

Entries.Title: Clovers

Entries.Title: The Will

Entries.Title: Bountiful Triumph
