Entries.Title: LAHAP
Entries.Description: Ari and Boris woke up in an empty room containing only two tables, two chairs, a camera, and a speaker. At first they were confused, but then they begin to remember why they’re there after the event organizer reminds them through the speaker—it’s an eating contest with a prize of 325 million Rupiah. The two men stop questioning when they’re given 25 million Rupiah upfront.  The eating contest begins. However, as time passes, the situation grows increasingly bizarre. They start seeing things and hallucinating, preventing them from winning the competition. Regardless, they must finish the food to claim the grand prize and ensure their survival.

Entries.Title: Encounter at Carillon Vault
Entries.Description: When the long-lost Grimoire resurfaces, former smuggler turned professor Bernie Barnes is forced back into action. What was once dismissed as legend is now a deadly reality, and in the wrong hands, the Grimoire could unleash consequences far beyond control. As lines are crossed and loyalties tested, Bernie must stop those pursuing the book… before it’s too late.

Entries.Title: Worship Awry
Entries.Description: This film follows a worship leader who questions her faith after a robbery incident.

Entries.Title: smear
Entries.Description: smear smear smear smear smear smear I do not have the rights for the music. This is just for fun. You can find the music credits under the youtube video description

Entries.Title: The Last Cinnamon Roll
Entries.Description: Danny tries to get the last of his beloved childhood snack, but his child needs a bathroom. With the last shred of his youth on the line, which will he choose: his daughter or The Last Cinnamon Roll?

Entries.Title: Chris Tanner Reveals
Entries.Description: Chris Tanner is a professional artist known for his assemblages, which make heavy use of found objects. Tanner gave Masa Gibson unrestricted access to all of his smartphone videos, which Gibson assembled into a found footage documentary collage.

Entries.Title: Vote For Wyrm
Entries.Description: A political attack ad for a small town mayoral race descends into horror.

Entries.Title: Lael Rides Around the World
Entries.Description: In 2024, Lael Wilcox set a new world record for circumnavigation of the Earth by bicycle. For 108 days, 12 hours, and 12 minutes, she rode, joined by friends and fans, with her journey documented by Rugile Kaladyte. This is the film of that ride, filled with highs and lows, incredible roads, friends, and fans. Beyond the record, it's about the experience and the connections made, and how the bicycle makes it possible.

Entries.Title: SOMEONE SPECIAL: KREAYSHAWN'S HOME VIDEOS
Entries.Description: Enamored by the vivid memory of short home videos Kreayshawn uploaded online 12 years ago, I reached out to ask if I could screen them. She sent over even more footage that has never been seen by the public eye.

Entries.Title: HORDES
Entries.Description: HORDES is an audio/visual project that focuses on the sensory nature of both people and objects when they get close together. It stems from deep claustrophobia. The film consists of English, German, Swedish, and French audio consisting of stories, seances, and gossip. The audio lays over the video and comes hand in hand.

Entries.Title: For Your Entertainment
Entries.Description: A documentary on music, art, manhood, and masculinity and where they collide.

Entries.Title: Perfect Machines
Entries.Description: In 2037, an android named Wires is on the hunt to discover the truth about a missing android, Sparks. On his journey, Wires finds himself remembering a past life of his own.

Entries.Title: Funeral Part 2
Entries.Description: Two brothers leave a funeral dissatisfied, agreeing that the by-the-books service didn’t properly honor their wild card brother. They spend the rest of the night trying to commemorate him in a way he would appreciate.

Entries.Title: How He Folds
Entries.Description: A writer attempts to create the greatest movie idea of all time until his imagination begins to bleed over into his reality

Entries.Title: Lost Dog
Entries.Description: Jobless and adrift, Richard finds unexpected purpose when he sets out to find a stranger's missing dog.

Entries.Title: Denim Terrains
Entries.Description: Denim Terrains comes out of a larger body of photographic work titled Denim (Worker Pants) that interrogates notions of value by using as a point of departure techniques and aesthetics typically reserved for studio portraiture and product photography. Together they highlight how image-based media produces, assigns, and props up value that is inherently arbitrary and/or autocratic. In that same vein, the photographs for this particular film were specifically made using expired film and positive slide film that was cross-processed as negative film to really exaggerate and experiment with color, and break away from traditional photography. In scanning and (re)photographing the results, these materials were transmuted and composited into new digital configurations.

Entries.Title: Beginning to See You
Entries.Description: An interracial couple's tumultuous relationship from 1960 to 2025. Their experience as parents to mixed-race daughters, cultural misfit and parental disapproval, the couple remain friends and here reveal the inside family's journey.

Entries.Title: Dermatophagia
Entries.Description: Fearing that his relationships are crumbling, a troubled young man takes magic mushrooms at his birthday party. But as the night spirals into hallucination and horror, he must decide whether his friends are betraying him or trying to save him from himself.

Entries.Title: La Pocha Film
Entries.Description: La Pocha Film is a film-diary of a road trip with friends based on a match of the La Pocha card game. Four perspectives that altogether portray a collective experience of friendship by intertwining chance with structure, portraying a space where play and filmic practice meet.

Entries.Title: The distance between the two
Entries.Description: Nina, a young woman passionate about music, lives in the shadow of her older sister, Emilia, who insists she pursue a traditional career. One day, Nina discovers an old violin in her deceased father's childhood home, revealing Emilia's musical past and discovering a way for them to connect together.

Entries.Title: Let's Get That Ego Death
Entries.Description: Igor runs a successful pharmacy with his wife Maggie. Maggie desperately wants to have children, but due to repressed childhood trauma, Igor doesn't feel he is ready. When a former lover of Maggie's, Jack, arrives and starts chatting up Maggie, Igor decides he needs a transformation. After seeing a game show in which contestants ingest psychedelic drugs to "put their fate in the hands of a higher power", Igor makes the decision to finally face his traumas, experiencing an ego shattering, life changing trip.

Entries.Title: Reverie
Entries.Description: Joe is a lonely writer who longs to be the hero of his own story. When it becomes increasingly clear that that’s not the case, he finds himself retreating to a place where he can have anything he dreams of; fame, love, even superpowers. When his real life becomes too much to bear, Joe must reconcile his imagination with reality, before he loses his grip on it.

Entries.Title: Saffron Robe
Entries.Description: An exploration of a Buddhist monastery in Laos and it's abbot's efforts to help his country's children out of poverty.

Entries.Title: The Odyssey Of Robo Bass 6.9
Entries.Description: A space rock band tries to escape an evil oppressor and make a new life elsewhere.

Entries.Title: Mandatory Bathroom Break
Entries.Description: An employee works tirelessly out of the back of a (moving) moving van. His unique work life takes a surprising turn when he discovers what he wants to do in life.

Entries.Title: Only in Theaters
Entries.Description: A student short film.

Entries.Title: Questioning Adonis
Entries.Description: A documentarian observes their fellow gym bros behaving more... openly... in the gym than they usually are outside of it.

Entries.Title: So Long, World
Entries.Description: A young woman fed up with the city decides to leave her life and best friend behind in attempts to escape society.

Entries.Title: Frail Hope
Entries.Description: A solitary figure pirates "A Ilha dos Prazeres Proibidos" (Carlos Reichenbach 1979), while also downloading "Carson City" (André De Toth, 1952). We see some of the latter film. The figure departs, wakes up, to then go about his day, leaving the door open. It is early spring.

Entries.Title: Breaking Al
Entries.Description: Come back and revisit Anchor Bay's Better Call Al and Breaking Broadcast in one full experience. This is an abridged/parody PG version of Better Call Saul and Breaking Bad.

Entries.Title: Medusa vs. the Men Who Want (Her) Head
Entries.Description: A modernized take on Medusa, reimagining her as a transgender woman just trying to get by.

Entries.Title: The Bagman: First Cut
Entries.Description: In a city gripped by fear, an elusive killer known only as Bagman lurks in the shadows. One night, as he targets his next victim, his carefully planned break-in goes wrong—forcing him into a chaotic struggle that leaves him exposed.

Entries.Title: Riders on the Storm
Entries.Description: Big wall climber Siebe Vanhee enlists Drew Smith and fellow Belgian countrymen Nico Favresse and Sean Villanueva O’Driscoll to attempt the first free ascent of the elusive Riders on the Storm route on the East Face of Patagonia’s Torre Central.

Entries.Title: The Tube
Entries.Description: A compilation of the most important and iconic segments to televise on screens from the 1920s all the way to the 2000s.

Entries.Title: Western Blood Never Sheds.
Entries.Description: An unknown sheriff gets a call from the man who killed his family years ago. The man tells the sheriff to meet him in a discreet location. Chaos brews.

Entries.Title: Feverish
Entries.Description: A teenager attempts to beat a video game level, but keeps getting distracted.

Entries.Title: Trinity's Angels

Entries.Title: Conversation with Two Lovers
Entries.Description: Shot in two places marrying with each other by a single and fractured bridge between Condrieu and les Roches-de-Condrieu, this film is the continuation of exploring ephemeral movement through the use of editing, camera movements and color sampling.

Entries.Title: Mr. Bound & Gagged
Entries.Description: The publishers of gay pornographic magazine "Bound & Gagged" venture to the Leather Archives in Chicago to comb through their personal and business archive. While there, they rediscover troves of art, stories, and political commentary from their lives making porn.

Entries.Title: Scrupulosity
Entries.Description: A person living with religious OCD struggles to get by.

Entries.Title: The Cancer Card
Entries.Description: The short film, The Cancer Card follows the story Benny, a cancer fighter, who seeks out advice from Tony, a cancer survivor, on how to deal with the overwhelming negative effects, and surprising perks that come with fighting the disease.

Entries.Title: The Terror
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: You are Home
Entries.Description: Every sports stadium in America has a story behind its namesake. None compare to the story behind Melissa Cook Stadium.

Entries.Title: Incubus
Entries.Description: “Kacey, a woman consumed by her thoughts and loneliness, begins to experience a sense that she’s being watched. No matter where she turns, invasive eyes stare back, corrupting her mind and driving her to the brink of destruction. Will Kacey overpower the darkness growing inside her? Or will she be seduced by the shadows that threaten to uproot her life as she knows it?”

Entries.Title: Ambivalence
Entries.Description: A group of mercenaries race against others to recover a mysterious package, only to discover that its contents will tear their loyalties apart.

Entries.Title: Treehouse
Entries.Description: A recovering addict returns to her childhood home where she is confronted with traumatic memories that help her realize what sacrifice has to be made.

Entries.Title: People of the Soil
Entries.Description: In today's world, soil is often treated as little more than a medium, to be moved around by bulldozers in the process of 'construction', or extracted of energy in the form of cash crops. Yet, for people still connected to land, to water, and to all human and non-human beings, soil is generosity itself. This is why generous people in Palestine are literally referred to as people of the soil, Ahl el Thara. This film charts a journey through the lives and terrains of people from around the world who share common attributes of warm-heartedness, generosity, and responsibility towards all living creatures.

Entries.Title: Pathway
Entries.Description: A camera rushes through downtown Vancouver along one straight path.

Entries.Title: Wingman
Entries.Description: As the first man to attempt to paraglide across the Colorado Rockies braves dangerous weather, camps in extreme weather, and hiking for miles in search of suitable launch points, he documents every minute of the perilous journey.

Entries.Title: Katie Boyle: Terapy
Entries.Description: Get ready for a fearless, fast-paced, and laugh-out-loud comedy special from Irish comedian Katie Boyle, filmed live in New York City! In TERAPY, Katie hilariously unpacks culture shocks, Catholic guilt, American dating, therapy sessions, and awkward family moments with her signature mix of wit, charm, and emotional honesty. From growing up in Ireland to navigating modern life in the U.S., nothing is off limits—from mast*rb*tion mishaps and mental health to language mix-ups and avocado injuries.

Entries.Title: No Trespassing In Transylvania
Entries.Description: A group of mummies stumbles onto a vampire's property.

Entries.Title: The Shed Incident

Entries.Title: Karuppiah Perumal
Entries.Description: This story is about four close friends, both good and bad, who face many problems after being used by others. They run away from their hometown to the city, where hardships force them to become thieves. Even though they know it's wrong, they have no other choice. At the same time, few other group is searching for a valuable diamond. One night, the four friends break into a house to steal—only to find the diamond inside. What will happen when they come face to face with the group?

Entries.Title: Shrunken Heads
Entries.Description: Owen, a new student, comes into conflict with his wacky substitute teacher

Entries.Title: Howl of the Hounds
Entries.Description: After swapping places with his American neighbor, Jobe, in Cleveland, Ohio, 9-year-old German boy, Bunker Hill, is forced back to Germany with Jobe's brother, James, and grandfather, G-Pa, to rescue Jobe from the manor of a mysterious man residing deep within The Hills.

Entries.Title: On the Limit - BTCC 2024
Entries.Description: From pre-season prep to the final showdown, capture every twist, turn, and triumph of the 2024 BTCC season.  Follow the highs and lows of drivers and teams up and down the grid with drama on and off the track—crashes, podiums, and championship battles—it’s the ultimate racing story.

Entries.Title: Paper Kingdom
Entries.Description: A struggling musician reconnects with an old flame.

Entries.Description: For all you brave and poor souls navigating the dating apps—remember, never swipe left on Valentine’s Day!! ❤️

Entries.Description: Always looking, needles in the haystack.

Entries.Title: The Little Things that Run the World
Entries.Description: THE LITTLE THINGS THAT RUN THE WORLD introduces viewers to a diverse group of scientists, nature lovers, gardeners, farmers, and general bug enthusiasts in exploring the importance of flying insects amid rapid declines in their numbers.  This most numerous group of animals on the planet by far - three quarters of all species - have also been called the “glue of life” on Earth.  They literally hold ecosystems together.  Insects were the first animals to evolve flight more than 400 million years ago, and they survived all five of the known mass extinctions since then.  But, there is evidence that the pace of decline among insects in parts of the world today is fast approaching the levels of previous catastrophes.

Entries.Description: A horror short film.

Entries.Title: Tramuntana
Entries.Description: In a remote area of northern Spain, the wind has a name: Tramuntana. Tramuntana takes what it wants—clothes, trees, boats, and the people of the landscape who live with the endless threat of being carried away by its force. This film is a lyrical portrait of this furious wind, woven from the stories passed down by local villagers.

Entries.Title: Making Passionate Disciples: 40 Years of Christ Community Church
Entries.Description: This documentary chronicles the journey of Christ Community Church, a thriving multisite church in Chicagoland, founded by Pastor Jim Nicodem and his wife, Sue. From its humble beginnings to its growth into a dynamic community of faith, the film explores the church’s foundation, history, and core values that have shaped its mission. Through interviews, archival footage, and personal stories, this documentary highlights the impact of Christ Community Church on its members, its surrounding communities, and its vision for the future.

Entries.Title: Com-mute
Entries.Description: Following a young man making his way to work.

Entries.Title: Acolyte
Entries.Description: When Kai returns home to reconnect with his estranged brother, he is tormented by the sinister past he tried to leave behind.

Entries.Title: Guy's Ultimate Family Cruise
Entries.Description: Guy Fieri heads to the Caribbean with family and friends on the Carnival Mardi Gras to celebrate his son's high school graduation.

Entries.Title: Ciclo
Entries.Description: The Intrusiveness.  An anxious young man wakes up in the woods with no recollection of how he got there. Panic starts to set in as the search for reality starts to blur with his internal conflict.

Entries.Title: Last Night's Dream
Entries.Description: An unknown figure beckons a dreamer to awaken.

Entries.Title: This Is The Summer
Entries.Description: Two high school graduates make a bucket list for their last summer together before leaving for university.

Entries.Title: Planet Planet I: Corruption
Entries.Description: In a distant galaxy, in the year 2189, the REPUBLIC OF SEBIA has been compromised.  Unknowingly to the people, a secret society, having built itself up for centuries, has officially taken over PLANET PLANET's government. Democracy has long been eradicated, and each 'elected' ruler since the society's takeover is unwillingly forced to do their deeds: enact progressively more controversial, free-will-stripping changes to an already impoverished world nation.  Its most recent ruler, GOVERNMENT MAN, declares the worst act yet.

Entries.Title: Mechanisms
Entries.Description: Everyone has their own way.

Entries.Title: Possibly Positive
Entries.Description: A young couple awaits the results of a pregnancy test that could change the fate of their lives forever.

Entries.Title: Real Fake Streets
Entries.Description: For the past two months, we dedicated out lives to documenting the life of Sam. Every human on a day to day basis encounters a "Sam", a peculiar somewhat unpredictable seemingly valueless person, and what you would probably refer to as "douchebag" or "arrogant prick". We found ourselves unknowingly siding with society until we took the time to really observe and realize the childhood trauma and drug abuse that contributed to creating this flawed but valuable human being.

Entries.Title: Brothers Beastly
Entries.Description: Isolated in the dreary tundra, identical twin brothers live a life consumed by sinister tradition. As one reaches his breaking point, the other manipulates and controls- trapping them in a traumatic familial bond forged by shadow and blood.

Entries.Title: Christmas at the Catnip Cafe
Entries.Description: When a marketing executive learns she’s short on the down payment for her dream condo, she’s informed that her great aunt left her half of a cat café in upstate New York. Hoping to sell it before the holidays, she then meets Dr. Ben Kane, the veterinarian who owns the other half, and has no intention of closing.

Entries.Title: Filthy and Wrecked
Entries.Description: Two best friends on a night out. It's their last but only Donna knows. As the night unravels, so does their friendship.

Entries.Title: To Catch a Cheat
Entries.Description: Ava cheated on her boyfriend, Stetler. To make amends and appease her guilt she confesses to Stetler, but his response leaves Ava more unsettled than better.

Entries.Title: Flow
Entries.Description: Flow follows a teenager on the cusp of adulthood who must confront his fears of life's flow and the bridge he must cross.

Entries.Title: Sally Has a Posse
Entries.Description: An inside look at a movement: "Sally" is a collective that brings many youth creatives together on the San Carlos Apache Reservation in what is now considered Arizona. The film follows Gio and other indigenous creators asking what it means to dream in the desert. Following the death of one of Sally's founders, Xen, Gio comes to terms with how their movement has explored their collective identity in skateboarding, tattoos, heavy metal music, and clothing design.

Entries.Title: Sweetest Dreams
Entries.Description: After a sudden tragedy, Phoebe is forced to grapple with her grief. She attempts to confide in her friends and teachers, but she feels that the only one who truly understands her is her boyfriend, Aster.

Entries.Title: Space Man
Entries.Description: An agoraphobic man traps himself in an astronaut costume to avoid the disastrous consequences of his condition

Entries.Title: Make A Change...
Entries.Description: New York City high school students discuss their thoughts on the future, adulthood and freedom.

Entries.Title: Un film de merde (A shitty movie)

Entries.Title: Anger Management
Entries.Description: In the summer of 2023, during a trip to Gorgan, we decided to create an audio-visual project at the family garden house of our friend Aria. Soheil narrated this adventure with an old JVC camera, and the audio of this video is from the album of the "Mourners Project".  The filming was done on the occasion of a solo live performance in the garden. At the time, we thought it would probably be the last time we would perform in that garden, as a long-term fraud process had led some people to attempt to confiscate the property. Although fortunately, they have not succeeded yet, and perhaps another trip to Gorgan will be an excuse for a new project.  In this video, the vintage aesthetic of the Handycam is blended with the personal shots from Aria's camera.  Finally, this year, on the occasion of the track "Anger Management," these images were edited together to preserve this memory of that friendly journey during the hot summer days.

Entries.Title: The Seventh Samurai
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Blind Mice
Entries.Description: When a man checks into a hotel, he learns everything isn't as it seems.

Entries.Title: Beachcombing
Entries.Description: Paul, lost in his own hometown, turns to beachcombing along the shoreline to reconnect with a life he’s lost touch with. As he collects fragments of the past, both physical and emotional, his discoveries force him to confront buried memories, unspoken truths, and the fragile beauty of what remains. On the beach, Paul finds a chance to rebuild, piece by piece, a sense of belonging and purpose.

Entries.Title: The Most Valuable Thing
Entries.Description: Four friends get lost in a parking garage with no exit in sight.

Entries.Title: Take Away
Entries.Description: We all fear being awakened by an unexpected phone call in the middle of the night. Unfortunately, most of us will eventually get that call, during which we learn that a loved one has died. It’s devastating and unmooring. In the blink of an eye, life as you’ve known it is irrevocably and permanently changed. But you’re still here and life goes on, whether you want it to or not. How do you pick up the pieces and move forward? Is it even possible? And what, if anything, can be taken away from sudden loss? Take Away explores the realities of this dreaded universally shared occurrence through the lens of a wide variety of ages, backgrounds, and cultural experiences.

Entries.Title: Inferno: The Burning of the SS Morro Castle
Entries.Description: A documentary covering the harrowing tragedy of the SS Morro Castle.

Entries.Title: The Girl In Red
Entries.Description: A lonely young man finally catches a break with someone he met online.  only to find that she and her family are not who they seem to be.

Entries.Title: More Than a Roast Chicken
Entries.Description: At the heart of every family recipe is a story. The recipes passed down from generation to generation are often attached to family history. This simple roast chicken and potato recipe connects Patty to people and places in her past.

Entries.Title: The Quest for the Magic Stone

Entries.Title: In the Red

Some find their way to a free program in Oakland, California that offers a lifeline – rigorous training to become firefighters and first responders. But the streets keep calling. Not everyone succeeds. But for those who do, their lives are forever changed.

Entries.Title: What's Next
Entries.Description: A young woman seeks out her biological father after her mother's death.

Entries.Title: The Car
Entries.Description: An animation from Ben Holt that follows a turtle as he makes the treacherous journey along a busy street.

Entries.Title: The Pink House
Entries.Description: Malcom, octogenarian and artist by trade, has to leave his house along with the neighborhood where his artistic approach is firmly rooted.

Entries.Title: Golden Boys
Entries.Description: Inside a frat house, holds many types of boys who want to prove their worth, in the middle of it all stands Cooper, Owen, and Austin. as the night progresses, their motives and loyalty is put to test when a sudden death happens within the brotherhood.

Entries.Title: The Samurai Cyborg Businessman
Entries.Description: After tragically losing his wife, a businessman trained in the ways of the Samurai gains cybernetic enhancements to avenge his wife and gain peace.

Entries.Title: Confusion
Entries.Description: A man experiences several visions

Entries.Title: Almost Perfect
Entries.Description: A sorority sister is driven to violent lengths to reach "perfect" beauty standards.

Entries.Title: Elegy for a Living Sea
Entries.Description: A little girl and her mother spend the day by a tide pool, the sea's health encroaching on their thoughts.

Entries.Description: Mrs. Ith Lom, a devout Theravada Buddhist, reveals that there is a God that many in her family and community may not have been aware of but have been guiding, loving and nurturing them.

Entries.Description: A man wakes up in a parking garage with no memory of who he is and how he got there.

Entries.Description: Framed through his therapy sessions, high school senior Xerxes Hughes struggles to juggle his double life as a student and superhero, all while trying to confront his inner demon—literally.

Entries.Description: Kitty, a disillusioned 20-something searching for meaning amidst societal pressures and personal insecurities must navigate an existential crisis after her best friend reveals she's skipping town to chase her dreams.

Entries.Title: Full Court Press
Entries.Description: A high school basketball player named Jayden has feelings for Shanelle, whose boyfriend Trey is the captain of the varsity basketball team. This leads to a tense confrontation on the court.

Entries.Title: The Harpies

A woman, fleeing her ex boyfriend, accompanied by her friend/annoying admirer; find themselves seeking refuge in an abandoned lumber mill. Little do they know, a dangerous harpy calls it home.

Entries.Title: Getting To Know You Again
Entries.Description: A once-close bond now tinged with emotional distance. A 60-year-old father and 25-year-old daughter confront their changing dynamic and the challenges of reconnecting.

Entries.Title: One Window

Entries.Title: āyí
Entries.Description: In a crowded dormitory in Flushing, NYC, an undocumented housekeeper, āyí, endures exploitation but Baduanjin offers her peace. As hardships mount, she must choose between silence and resistance.

Entries.Title: Listen
Entries.Description: Director Malakye Tsosie explores his identity through the Navajo language. A language that is spoken less frequently over the generations. However, the resilience of the language breathes through his journey with a small Navajo radio station, his family relatives, and the people of the Navajo Nation.

Entries.Title: Love And The All Night Horror Show
Entries.Description: After losing his partner, Roger is getting back into the gay dating scene. Sick of anonymous hookups, Roger looks for genuine connection, and finds it, with homicidal maniac, Abe. Blending humor, warmth, and blood drenched practical gore effects for a wild ride, this is the first date from hell!

Entries.Title: Little Bo Creep
Entries.Description: There's a new girl in town. Her name is LITTLE BO CREEP. And if you're not nice then you won't make a peep! All Bo wants is to find her lost sheep. Is that too much to ask? But she keeps meeting people who want to trick her and do very bad things. Good thing that Bo has a pet named RUFUS. When people hurt Bo, Rufus makes them sorry. VERY SORRY. So be nice to Bo and you'll live happily ever after. But if you're bad, she'll make you very, VERY sad!

Entries.Title: Ashore

Entries.Title: Breakfast for Dinner
Entries.Description: Detective Thaddeus McTweed is commisioned by the mayor of Waldorf Harbor to track down a serial killer. It seems, everyone in the town has a connection to this case.

Entries.Title: Goddamn's Great Big Adventure: The Dating Crisis!!
Entries.Description: In a heartfelt quest for love, an innocent and overly enthusiastic sock navigates the bizarre and often bewildering world of human dating—armed with nothing but optimism, a glitter-crafted ID, and a head full of romantic movie tropes.

Entries.Title: Ancraophobia
Entries.Description: Shot on a Bolex set on a tripod. Each shot with the duration that the fully rewound motor of the Bolex runs. Then comes in a gust of wind.

Entries.Title: In VRBubba's Day
Entries.Description: This is a short film about rapper VRBubba and his clique seeking retribution after a friend gets set up and put in jail by a rival gang. After recording a diss track, he shoots a music video on the way to murder the opposition.

Entries.Title: Talking Walls
Entries.Description: An audio-visual film and archive project canvasing the narratives of Black and queer/gay/lesbian/SGL-identified people, with a focus on personal and private spaces. The project is comprised of recorded interviews with self-identified community who have a strong memory or experiences connected to space/place. The project includes voices located in the cities of Philadelphia, New York, Chicago and Detroit, with hopes of expanding with ongoing support.

Entries.Title: Cops N Monsters

Entries.Title: Aoife's House

Entries.Title: StopTrackers - First Reveal

Entries.Description: On this episode of Shaneful we go to an abandoned water park! Is it illegal? Yes! Is it a landfill? Yes! Is it haunted? Maybe???

Entries.Title: Thomas and Friends: Sodor Sings Together
Entries.Description: In preparation for the big Sodor Sings Festival - the biggest musical event on the - the engines are hard at work to make the night one to remember.

Entries.Title: Hope: In the Aftermath of War
Entries.Description: Hope is an intimate portrait of a military family fractured by the invisible wounds of war. At its heart is Catherine, a decorated soldier and mother who returns from deployment profoundly changed—emotionally withdrawn, plagued by guilt, and struggling with addiction. Her daughter, Hope, once protected by her mother's strength, becomes a witness to her unraveling, forced to mature too quickly amid the chaos of relocation, strained family bonds, and a lack of institutional support. As Catherine battles to reintegrate, her marriage collapses, and the military’s absence of post-deployment care deepens her isolation. Her husband leaves, her daughter grows distant, and Catherine is left with the crushing realization that service came at a cost no one prepared her for.

Entries.Title: In Dreams...
Entries.Description: After a mysterious accident, a woman searches a dreamscape for her sister.

Entries.Title: The Chill Tapes
Entries.Description: With his trusty cameraman and a fistful of wilting tulips, a B-rate film student zig-zags through campus on the hunt for his latest infatuation.

Entries.Title: BellaDonna
Entries.Description: A narrative short film.

Entries.Title: Wall Udder
Entries.Description: In a world where the highest status symbol is an udder installed on your wall, the ultimate question is: would you f*** the Wall Udder?

Entries.Title: Rising: Surviving the Surge
Entries.Description: Rising: Surviving the Surge is a compelling new documentary that traces how Hurricane Ian reshaped Southwest Florida, and how the region continues to endure and adapt in the face of increasingly powerful storms. Featuring dramatic storm footage, first-hand survivor accounts, and insights from scientists, first responders, and community leaders, the film offers a sobering look at the realities of storm surge and resilience.

Entries.Title: JAMS
Entries.Description: Sixteen video artists offer a feature-length re-imagining of Jaws on its 50th anniversary.

Entries.Title: Teddy
Entries.Description: A verité portrait of a male birth doula working to improve birth outcomes for Black women in Houston, Texas.

Entries.Title: Pippy and the Typist
Entries.Description: Pippy discovers that a magical typewriter controls the events happening down below.

Entries.Title: NADIR: A documentary about surfing in Newport, Rhode Island in the summer and most of the other times as well
Entries.Description: A director’s surfing documentary spirals into dramatic reenactments and shady schemes as he grapples with his anxieties over riding the waves that are “a little bigger than we are comfortable with.”

Entries.Title: My Canada Train Journey
Entries.Description: According to McLennan, he pitched his idea to the Canada Council for the Arts back in December in hopes of putting the project in motion. When he learned in March that the council approved his grant, he began planning for his expedition that began last month. The grant is allowing McLennan to research, plan and make a journey on south-north trains in Canada off the main line to see how the country looks and feels some 50-plus years later as a Canadian who grew up in the 60s and 70s. [...] The first portion of McLennan’s project titled “My Canada Train Journey” took him north and east in Ontario and Quebec.

Entries.Title: I find comfort in sadness.
Entries.Description: a small part of my daily thoughts combined with the one thing that heals me most.  The background music and the written texts I post reflect who I am as a person and clarify the path I'm on.  -Ava B., Director

Entries.Title: daydream
Entries.Description: A short film shot on iPhone SE, mostly using repurposed footage. Has to do with outsideness and escape.

Entries.Title: THE DEAD DONT DREAM
Entries.Description: A man seeking shelter in a dreamlike world, running from his past, searches for his missing mother while encountering the dead, and dying numerous times where the shadows lurk.

Entries.Title: Exact Terms of Ownership
Entries.Description: A short film by Shannon Lyons

Entries.Title: Freedom of the Mind
Entries.Description: What seems like a normal television hijacking, spins into a self-exposing ocean of fear.

Entries.Title: 7 P.M.
Entries.Description: After a drug meet up gone wrong, two desperate dealers must deliver one thousand dollars by 7 P.M.

Entries.Title: The 11th Hour
Entries.Description: A young boy scrambles to get to his destination on time.

Entries.Title: 2:16 Ringing
Entries.Description: This is the last video my brother recorded.

Entries.Title: Death of Villains
Entries.Description: A former child climbing prodigy emerges from his struggle with disordered eating to attempt his life-long dream of a 5.15 first ascent, with the help of an unlikely and controversial partner.

Entries.Title: Visitant
Entries.Description: Two deer notice an unfamiliar presence in the forest.

Entries.Title: Un Inquilino Muy Particular
Entries.Description: A fascinating documentary made by film students that immerses us in the creative process and hard work behind the successful play "Un Inquilino Muy Particular." This documentary offers an authentic and deep insight into how the play was put together, from its first rehearsals to its premiere, giving a voice to those who experienced the process from within.  Throughout the film, the actors and actresses, the play's director, and the producer share their experiences, concerns, and key moments of the production, providing an intimate perspective on the challenges, emotions, and dynamics that arise between the cast and the creative team. The figure of Lucas Mancinelli, who is not only one of the directors of the documentary but also an essential part of the cast as an actor, intertwines with the narrative, offering a personal and close view of the artistic process.

Entries.Title: True Love
Entries.Description: A lonely man named Mateo tries to find love on a dating app called HeartLink in this suspenseful thriller comedy.

Entries.Title: CATCH ME ON THE ICE
Entries.Description: Ava Caputo, a freshman at Toronto Metropolitan University, left her home in Alberta to embark on her university journey as a female hockey athlete.

Entries.Title: IMPACT x Nightline: Kendrick v. Drake: The Fued
Entries.Description: Team Kendrick or Team Drake: which side are you on? Damning accusations, a real-life shooting, and now a lawsuit. Who will reign supreme in the hip-hop battle for the ages?

Entries.Title: American Sons
Entries.Description: "American Sons" follows a brotherhood of Marines a decade after their deployment to Afghanistan, as they struggle to overcome the trauma of combat and the loss of their best friend, Corporal JV Villarreal. Leaving more than his memory behind, JV’s narrated, first-person video diary of his life in Afghanistan serves as both a haunting window into these Marines’ past and a testament to the unbreakable bonds of those who sacrifice in war together.

Entries.Title: Plain and Dry
Entries.Description: This unconventional rom-com follows Chadd, a deceiving womanizer, who is attempting to get laid on a first date. This satirical, laugh-out-loud date night, is something you will not want to miss!

Entries.Title: CLUB GWYNETH PALTRO
Entries.Description: A drug-addicted gangster named Gwyneth Paltro has his world turned upside down when a former colleague and lover shows up at his club.

Entries.Title: Four Nations Facing Off
Entries.Description: In perhaps the most emotional release of the year, Captain Canada aka Sidney Crosby lets us know that Four Nations are... what? Watch this 1hr long masterpiece, created by FierySharky (Twitter), in order to find out.

Entries.Title: MICROCYCLE
Entries.Description: A surreal, low-budget odyssey through time, space, and toxic relationships.

Entries.Title: Jim Davidson: Live and (Very Very) Risky
Entries.Description: The countries most loved comedian is back (and very very risky!) as he refuses to back down to todays inoffensive and woke standard of comedy. Grab yourself a beer, sit back, relax and watch as Jim Davidson OBE brings you some proper comedy live at the Concorde club.

Entries.Title: The Feeling Remains
Entries.Description: The Feeling Remains is a haunting and profoundly personal documentary that plunges deep into the fractured heart of a family torn apart by trauma. With a blend of 16mm film and evocative home videos, it weaves a delicate yet powerful tapestry of past and present, unraveling the intricate and fragile threads of memory and storytelling.  Through each family member’s fragmented perspective, it embarks on a relentless search for an elusive truth, navigating the shadowy terrain where reality and recollection blur. The film unveils a poignant meditation on the enduring impact of trauma, the complexities of understanding, and the painful yet necessary journey toward reconciliation with the past.

Entries.Title: Eggshells
Entries.Description: Taking place in the near future, alien objects have become falling from the sky showing that earth isn’t the only place in the universe with life. A few days go by of time passes as we see someone called Charlie who owns debt to someone slowly selling things off to help pay it off. Charlie and their friend Jane go out to some of the crash sites and see what is left that they can sell. The objects that had fallen are able to show whoever holds it what they truly want and desire and more importantly see if it is achievable in this universe or they may get caught in an endless dream of chasing something they can never get.

Entries.Title: A Little Normal
Entries.Description: Does a child really think about so much? Childhood curiosity is an emotion like no other.

Entries.Title: As a Tree Walks to Its Forest
Entries.Description: A three-channel, double 8mm and 16mm projector installation.

Entries.Title: The Killer Prank
Entries.Description: Danger Derek is a terrible person who has no morals. He pulls a prank that goes way too far and may cost him everything

Entries.Title: Hello! My Name is Blotto: The Movie
Entries.Description: Scrappy documentary about a band that flew too close to the sun to make it really big. Albany, NY's Blotto rose from the ashes of the Star-Spangled Washboard Band and scored an unlikely hit with I Wanna Be A Lifeguard in the early 80's  thanks in part to  getting airplay on MTV when the network launched August 1, 1981. The film follows their struggles to land a major label deal despite huge success with touring and releasing their own EPs and Albums. First-time director Rob Lichter (aka Bert Blotto) puts together a funny, heart-felt portrait of the musical pranksters that is sometimes heartbreaking despite all the laughs.

Entries.Title: Watkins vs The World: The Man Who Scammed Millions
Entries.Description: William Watkins, CEO of Watkins Tech, has released his new invention to the world - but at a deadly cost. Following it's disastrous launch, the Mitish Moardcasting Corporation has produced a true crime documentary to uncover the truth behind Watkins and his invention, The JOHN.

Entries.Title: Nisaacharudu
Entries.Description: Jay hires James, a private detective, to find the mysterious figure responsible for his insomnia. As the case grows dire, Jay's secrets risk being uncovered.

Entries.Title: Chris Crofton: Nashville Famous
Entries.Description: Shot across the better part of the last decade, Seth Pomeroy’s long-gestating portrait of Nashville-based comedian, writer, podcaster and political candidate Chris Crofton emerges from the shadows — covering its subject from ascent, descent, and to ascent again. The film intersperses archival footage from the 1990s-2010s, following Crofton from Nashville to pre-COVID exile in Los Angeles — including a pivotal roller skating injury — and features commentary/appearances by departed local luminaries Dave Cloud and David Berman. Plenty of living luminaries show up as well, including Neil Hamburger and My Morning Jacket’s Jim James in a crucial “save.”

Entries.Title: Agent Troy
Entries.Description: The debut film from the acclaimed 505 Studios: A riveting and stimulating journey following special agent Troy, as he contemplates life and death, fame and fortune, and war and peace after being assigned a task from his superior, where he must intercept operations from an unknown organization and the mysterious Villan.

Entries.Title: From the Cowboy's Boot Heel: The Musical Journey of Rob McNurlin
Entries.Description: From the Cowboy's Boot Heel: The Musical Journey of Rob McNurlin is a captivating documentary that chronicles career of Appalachian musician Rob McNurlin. Directed by Steven Middleton, the film combines intimate interviews, live performances, and a treasure trove of archival media to trace McNurlin's evolution as an artist. From his early days to his status as a celebrated voice in Appalachian and Americana music, the film paints a vivid portrait of a musician whose work bridges country, folk, and gospel traditions, offering a rich exploration of heritage, artistry, and the enduring power of storytelling through song. Featuring interviews with J.T. Cure, Marty Stuart, Kenny Vaughn, Chris Scruggs, and Jorma Kaukonen,.

Entries.Title: Bone
Entries.Description: A man starts a painting while contemplating life and existence.

Entries.Title: beautiful gorgeous day
Entries.Description: dedicated to david lynch

Entries.Title: Bastard Toadflax
Entries.Description: When warehouse employee Jack gets questioned by police about a missing person named Barrera, he demands they focus their attention on finding his younger brother Mikey. With no clues and no one talking, the key to finding both missing persons might be found inside of a box truck.

Entries.Title: Aybsiz
Entries.Description: A young doctor, convicted of murder, joins forces with his friends from the orphanage to prove his innocence and expose a syndicate that is ensnaring innocent people

Entries.Title: Arthur Elgort: Models & Muses
Entries.Description: Famed photographer and Southampton resident Arthur Elgort defined an era of Vogue, introduced the candid ‘snapshot’ style of modern fashion photography, and lensed the legendary supermodels of the ’80s and ’90s. Now, the artist becomes muse and subject in this dynamic and affectionate portrait directed by his son Warren Elgort.

Entries.Title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Buried at C
Entries.Description: Our favorite music teacher Gethsemane is back again along with her trusted ghost friend Eamon to solve the unexplained death of a sea captain.

Entries.Title: Everything, Nothing and I...
Entries.Description: An architect revisits his past as the boundary between reality and imagination begins to unravel.

Entries.Title: Perfect Sound
Entries.Description: A boom mic operator gives up on the fakeness of films and tries to a find a real, perfect, sound.

Entries.Title: American Psychobaby 4
Entries.Description: Following the divorce of his wife and destruction of Nuclear Super Baby, now adopting a child with his best friend, Charles Billshaw quickly realizes he has adopted a psycho killer zombie baby. With 24 hours left before he can return the baby (for da money), Crispin must fight off the 7 evil lions, destroy a plane, rent a car, and destroy the killer baby before the baby destroys America via killing Americans, or else…

Entries.Title: Queen of Hearts
Entries.Description: An empathetic manager at a tech company receives a board-ordered directive that blows her mind.

Entries.Title: Krokus Live at Wacken Open Air 2025
Entries.Description: Krokus are the Swiss answer to classic stadium hard rock: massive, melodic, and razor-sharp. Since the mid-70s, they've delivered anthems like "Headhunter," "Screaming in the Night," and "Midnite Maniac," which have lost none of their brilliance decades later. With over 15 million albums sold and international stadium appearances, they're among the most consistent acts in the scene. At Wacken, Krokus demonstrate that rock can work without frills. Pure energy, honest riffs, and songs that immediately stick in your head: robust, charismatic, and a piece of music history in every note.

Entries.Title: Insomnia Of A Death Foretold
Entries.Description: An argument between roommates takes a dark turn.

Entries.Title: Earth, I Thank You: The Garden and Legacy of Anne Spencer
Entries.Description: This documentary traces the evolution of Anne Spencer's beloved garden from a personal retreat to a nationally significant cultural landscape. The garden was an oasis where she wrote much of her poetry, drawing inspiration and insights from the natural beauty surrounding her. It was also a vibrant gathering place, welcoming luminaries and civil rights leaders including Langston Hughes, James Weldon Johnson, Zora Neale Hurston, Thurgood Marshall, George Washington Carver, and Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.

Entries.Title: Peyton Parrish: Live at Wacken Open Air 2025
Entries.Description: Peyton Parrish, born in Washington, DC in 1996, has been making waves since 2020 with his blend of country-rock, post-grunge, and Norse-inspired themes. With his viral cover of "My Mother Told Me," known from the series Vikings, he took the scene by storm and established himself as the voice of modern Viking folk-rock. He has released albums such as Cowboy Man (2020), Rise of Vikingr (2022), and most recently Soul (2024), which offer a unique combination of raw emotionality and epic folk sensibility. Songs like "Ragnarök" and "Valhalla Calling" blend Norse mythology with youthful energy, creating a cinematic-inspired soundscape. Peyton writes his own music, streams live on TikTok, and has amassed an enormous following through social media. His stage presence is honest and passionate, an interplay of gentle melodies, powerful hooks and Nordic soul landscapes, with which he touches metal, folk and country fans alike.

Entries.Title: The Devil and His Son
Entries.Description: The Devil deals with becoming a father.

Entries.Title: Just Be Free?
Entries.Description: The search for freedom and survival in a World with limited solutions.

Entries.Title: Sex with an old woman
Entries.Description: Sex with an old woman

Entries.Title: Grinch V Board of Education
Entries.Description: When Grinch (Sarojam) finds himself in prison for "disrupting" a college class, he must ally himself with his quirky cellmate Kick Man (Charvin Snatchfinger) in order to take down the Blinch (Ranixo) lead Rodents and Snitchers to escape prison.

Entries.Title: Captain America: Red Threat
Entries.Description: Steve Rogers Captain America gets an offer by the president to an event that will launch both in a wild game of life and death (This is a fan film not in association with Marvel Studios).

Entries.Title: Script Tease
Entries.Description: An insecure screenwriter seeks validation on his script from a mysterious, sultry voice on a 1-900 hotline, only to find himself competing with a long line of creatives equally addicted to praise.

Entries.Title: Disco Fever
Entries.Description: Cal makes a drunken pit stop at a greasy diner for some late-night eats, only to find himself witnessing what appears to be a dance-fueled zombie attack.

Entries.Title: Relatos
Entries.Description: A serie of short film/stories focusing on places, themes and characters from director native province.

Entries.Description: Two young creatives pitch their latest ideas to the Board of Mictrotrends.
