Entries.Description: A short film by Sebastian Sommer

Entries.Title: illusions
Entries.Description: While driving to his new house, Leo gets into a car crash and begins experiencing hallucinations.

Entries.Title: Bloodright
Entries.Description: 'BLOODRIGHT' is a non-linear narrative that focuses on a young knight named Jonas who is thrust into a position of authority.  Determined to prove himself after fleeing battle, he must deal with Benedict and Roland, who challenge his position.

Entries.Title: Kill The Clown
Entries.Description: Rachel hosts a book release party for her closest friend, Kate Shepard. Kate's book, "Kill The Clown", is a memoir that follows her complex relationship with her father.  At this party, Kate begins to see a haunting figure that just won't leave her alone.

Entries.Title: La isla está viva
Entries.Description: This short documentary captures the mountains of San José de Ocoa in the Dominican Republic, once home to the Taíno people. Rooted in the Taíno belief that the island is a living, feminine being, where life begins within her cave-womb and sacred waters. An immersive landscape charged with spiritual and cultural meaning.

Entries.Title: New Year's Day
Entries.Description: When hosting a New Year’s Eve costume party, a people pleasing young woman has her plans for a perfect party derailed when a charismatic young man shows, uninvited and wearing a matching costume.

Entries.Title: Bloodlust
Entries.Description: A short experimental film by Jameson Hanna.

Entries.Title: Wide Awake?
Entries.Description: After experiencing a traumatic attack, Lily (Scarlett P. Oliver) begins seeing a creepy Figure (Zack Shamroukh) in her room. One night, the Figure begins to move and then everything changes. Is it just in Lily's mind, or is it something else...

Entries.Title: IF YOU WANNA TALK
Entries.Description: On his first day as a hotline operator, Leonard’s first call comes from a woman wanting to kill someone.

Entries.Title: Next In Line
Entries.Description: When an inspiring young actor is ruthlessly cut from his breakthrough role in a musical, there is nothing left for him to do but sing.

Entries.Title: Gnome Pay
Entries.Description: Amir the cashier’s sleepy night shift at the convenience store is interrupted by a weird gnome guy who introduces him to a new method of payment.

Entries.Title: Pneuma
Entries.Description: In the shadow of the forest, a flash goes through the darkness making the matter vibrate. Air, water and earth tune in to a cycle that begins and ends without anyone noticing. Before, everything was white. Now, it's just a vestige, while time advances and everything transforms. Between the visible and the invisible, everything is on the verge of being born or fading. A murmur in the current. Under the surface of the sea, the sound dissolves, the fish slide like shadows between reflections. The night returns, the stars insist. The light filters between the branches, showing what the gaze does not reach. With each 16mm frame, Pneuma reveals the essence of what persists, inviting us to feel the presence of the invisible that surrounds us.

Entries.Title: West Landing
Entries.Description: A short documentary about a group of open-water swimmers on Long Island who gather every summer morning in Hampton Bays. Born out of the post-pandemic era, their daily swims provide a sense of calm and a newfound community, proving that it’s never too late to find friendship, purpose, and joy in life’s simple pleasures.

Entries.Title: That Whole "Yale Thing"
Entries.Description: A collection of Yale references from more than 200 films going back nearly 100 years.

Entries.Title: LiDAR
Entries.Description: A man awakens and finds himself Lost in Depth And Reality!

Entries.Title: AEW Stories: ROH World Television Champion Komander
Entries.Description: AEW Stories follows ROH World Television Champion Komander on one of the biggest days of his career.

Entries.Title: The Callback
Entries.Description: A young actress receives a callback for an audition but the role she's given isn't anything like what she was expecting.

Entries.Title: Memories of the Dead
Entries.Description: Is fear the only thing keeping you alive or is the small ray of hope the silver lining in this world full of despair.

Entries.Title: Naam Pe Inam
Entries.Description: 🎧Song : Naam Pe Inam (नाम पे इनाम)  🎤Singer : Khushi Kakkar  💃🏻Feat :  Prithvi Tiwary & Mahima Singh  📝Lyrics : Raj Babbar Kavi  🎶Music Composer : Amit Arya

Entries.Title: Lavender Whispers
Entries.Description: Juliet has been stuck for 40 years waiting for any indication of why her lover left her. She finds a lost love letter after some investigation brings her the answer. Does she try to find her or move on?

Entries.Title: Behind The Scene
Entries.Description: "Di Balik Layar" tells the story of Raka, Dika, Yaya, Vania, and Karin's struggle to make a romance film. Raka, a student with a lot of imagination, has the ambition to create a perfect romance film. However, his high expectations clash with reality. His selfishness and unwillingness to listen to input from his team, put his film project on the verge of failure. When everything starts to fall apart, Raka is forced to face a choice: to maintain his ego or to start working with his team. Will this film be realized or will it be destroyed before it is born? Then, what tensions and conflicts are created by "Behind the Scenes"?

Entries.Title: And Now the Time Is Going
Entries.Description: A father and son explore their past, present, and future.

Entries.Title: Tooth
Entries.Description: A gangster gets caught up in some shady business at a butcher shop.

Entries.Title: Killer Intentions
Entries.Description: A group of high schoolers attempt to figure out who killed their friend Jackson in this campy slasher.

Entries.Title: Submerged Head
Entries.Description: A figure wanders through a snow storm, arriving in the crosshairs of an unseen weapon.

Entries.Title: Queasy Jack
Entries.Description: A filmmaker takes you behind the scenes of his new social media project.

Entries.Title: Soul Saving Station
Entries.Description: A meta-documentary venturing into the afterlife through found footage of deceased outsider musician S.V. Cramer's 2019 trip to a Tillamook beach.

Entries.Title: Susan
Entries.Description: While tirelessly advocating for others, Susan Suchan navigates a cruel life predicament, and secretly devises an unorthodox plan to control mortality.

Entries.Title: Ilraan's Contemplation On The Crisis of Existence
Entries.Description: Ilraan's Contemplation on the Crisis of Existence unfolds in six acts, each set in a different place. Ilraan moves through ruins, forests, abandoned houses, and distant shores not in search of beauty, but meaning. Yet the more he tries to make sense of the world, the less it offers. Each image, each moment, brings only more questions. The silence deepens, not with peace, but with doubt. The world refuses to explain itself it only mirrors his unease. And in that quiet unraveling, Ilraan begins to lose faith in the shape of reality itself.

Entries.Title: Kitchen Dialogue
Entries.Description: A generational trauma through the lens of an Asian American teenager through food and poetry.

Entries.Title: The Water We Swim In
Entries.Description: After a losing streak, the female coach of the Betta Warriors must save her team from a toxic patriarchal swimming league until her silent battles hinders her to do so.

Entries.Title: The Vermin Within
Entries.Description: While in town visiting his brother, Ken runs into an old high school crush. But at the same time Ken experiences something strange that may make things difficult for them.

Entries.Title: Night at the Park
Entries.Description: The next, upcoming short film from director Jode Lupercio.

Entries.Title: Píldora
Entries.Description: In San Juan, an under 21 trans woman abandoned by a recently broken support system,  forms an unlikely bond with a black market dealer that takes her to reclaim her identity—and a  renewed will to continue.

Entries.Title: The Banjo Boys
Entries.Description: The Banjo Boys follows the rise of Madalitso Band, Malawian musicians Yobu Maligwa and Yosefe Kalekeni, who craft a banjo, a one-stringed babatone, and foot drum, creating a sound that moves audiences. Once mocked as madmen in Lilongwe’s streets, they meet Neil Nayar, a British musician drawn to Malawi’s spirit. Their chance encounter sparks a trio, propelling them from local busking to global stages like Sauti za Busara, WOMAD, and Joshua Tree. Facing visa struggles, personal tragedies—including original member Rice’s imprisonment for murder—and cultural tensions, their grit fuels joyous performances. Yobu’s pastoral visions, Yosefe’s resilience, and Neil’s purpose drive their bond. Their minimalist sound bridges continents, culminating in a 2023 world tour and a legendary Malawi homecoming. Intimate interviews and vibrant performances reveal music’s power to unite and transform.

Entries.Title: Duck Santa
Entries.Description: A man wades through a river, sees God, and Duck Santa.

Entries.Title: A Light Amidst Ashes
Entries.Description: When a mysterious virus breaks out, 17-year-old Elijah Notch (Givan Onuaguluchi-May) is left alone in a time forever changed. With only his pet cat by his side, Eli must navigate the horrors of a world beholden to each remaining man and prove that there can still be good, even in a world on fire.

Entries.Title: Blossom Needs A Ride Home
Entries.Description: After defeating a bloodthirsty maniac, Blossom needs a ride home. What a hassle.

Entries.Title: Checky Checky
Entries.Description: A tense horror short about a man obsessed with checking lights and appliances, whose routine is shaken by a disturbing presence.

Entries.Title: Tagpo
Entries.Description: A series of street interviews shot in The Philippines asking individuals deep questions about purpose, meaning, and faith.

Entries.Title: To Cross; One Nail, Metal Spit
Entries.Description: Filmed over a period of 3 years, this video work is a meditation on the borderline of the river Tejo, between Marvila and Barreiro.  A psychogeographic piece that seeks out a feeling of doubt, inertia, and waiting.  "Two sides, along the boundary line  All the weight of the water above  Metal arms extended to the heavens  As if the sky was tilting to meet them  And those giants again;  Four by four . . . . all in a line,  up against the tide."

Entries.Title: From Salt to Soil
Entries.Description: From Salt to Soil is hour long audiovisual project bringing together the sounds of USOF & Zarya with the words of Joana Coelho and Madalena Anjos,  directed and edited by Léna Lewis-King. The film follows the landscapes from Barreiro to Crato, layered with notations, inner and outer worlds - tracing the geographic / poetic, with transportive and hypnotic sound scapes.  It was made for the 2025 edition of Waking Life festival, where it debuted as the opening event for their cinema programme, Moonscreen.

Entries.Title: Sightless Cinema
Entries.Description: A year in the life of the Sightless Cinema audio drama network, as they embark on their biggest show to date. The Sightless Cinema network is a group of blind and visually impaired people who create audio dramas for performance in theatres and cinemas. Founded in 2015 by theatre director Ciarán Taylor, and sound artist Rachel Ní Chuinn, Sightless Cinema has grown from a tiny group to a nationwide community. Director Gareth Stack followed Sightless Cinema as they rehearsed and performed their new show across Ireland. Members of the group candidly discuss their sight loss and how their lives have been shaped by blindness. We watch their creative process in action. As Sightless Cinema turn their lived experiences of blindness into compelling audio theatre.

Entries.Title: Thoughts of Infinity
Entries.Description: Abstract painter James Howell has created over 400 works composed entirely of varying shades of gray. For Howell, gray embodies the 'in-between' space of both color and existence. His paintings reflect not only his technical skill but also a deep, meditative spirit that permeates this documentary, exploring ideas of Taoism, meditation, and Howell’s relationship with public perception.

Entries.Title: The Secrets We Bury
Entries.Description: THE SECRETS WE BURY follows the Carroll siblings on their mission to find answers about their father’s mysterious disappearance 58 years ago. When the family’s search leads them to their Lake Grove childhood home, they uncover a story much darker than anything they could have imagined. Thrust into the media spotlight, the foundations of the Carrolls’ tight-knit family are shaken as they try to reconcile their childhood memories with the horrifying truth, highlighting the corrosive power of secrets.

Entries.Title: Autumn
Entries.Description: Keaton, a thirty-something former bachelor, is stuck in limbo. His ex-girlfriend (who he's still in love with) just gave birth to his son, his current girlfriend is saying 'it's her or me,' and he's stuck in Tennessee at his grandpa's funeral with his crazy southern family.

Entries.Title: Thetta
Entries.Description: Set in a hillside village on the edge of a dense forest, this survival thriller follows Shankaran, a young man haunted by a past wild boar attack. When his friends get trapped during a hunt, Shankaran must confront his deepest fears. As the group faces nature`s wrath and a deadly wild boar, the film unravels a gripping tale of survival and courage in the heart of the wilderness.

Entries.Title: If I'm Wrong
Entries.Description: A Vaporwave Inspired Short Film

Entries.Title: Lazy Boy
Entries.Description: Lazy Boy unfolds in long, unhurried takes that mirror the stillness of its subject: a full-time furniture salesman in the South Bay of Los Angeles, working through the quiet despair of an economic recession. With customers scarce and sales impossible, the film lingers on stalled transactions and empty showrooms, transforming the monotony of labor into a portrait of endurance.

Entries.Title: Summer Wedding
Entries.Description: Stefania struggles to take a pregnancy test amidst constant interruptions. When her fiancé unexpectedly confronts her, secrets are revealed, leading to a pivotal confrontation with her mother.

Entries.Title: Camper: A Revenge Story
Entries.Description: When a lone camper embarks on a treacherous journey through the Robusta forest, a mysterious stalker lurks in the shadows.

Entries.Title: The Musician
Entries.Description: A musician is faced with an unexpected message that leads him down a dark path. Through his struggles, his friend attempts to help him through his dark time.

Entries.Title: Candy Wars: Rise of Sweet-E
Entries.Description: This is the mockumentary describing the rise of infamous candy bootlegger Sweet-E (Eddie)

Entries.Title: Rush Light
Entries.Description: Shot in downtown Minneapolis, Rush Light assembles a rapid montage of fleeting street compositions. Through quick cuts and sudden shifts, Devereaux creates a collage of ready-made visual moments—buildings, signs, shadows, and chance alignments glimpsed in passing. The film operates as both a study of three-dimensional space and a meditation on the eye’s ability to seize upon images in a split second. Color, light, and shadow flicker across the frame, transforming the city into a shifting field of accidental design.

Entries.Title: Slippery Secrets
Entries.Description: Three curious teenage boys explore the quiet woods only to discover that they are walking into something they'll never forget....

Entries.Title: Extra Large
Entries.Description: "Don't Prove It, Just Relieve It"

Entries.Title: wehaveeachother - Sesame & Emily Grimm Spring Tour Documentary
Entries.Description: "wehaveeachother" is a tour documentary following screamo bands Sesame and Emily Grimm. It is an intimate look into the exploding underground east coast punk scene.

Entries.Title: The Black Gig
Entries.Description: Three black students try to navigate a predominantly white school. One looks for identity, another seeks acceptance, and another chooses to conform. Each tries to find their place in an environment where they aren't favored.

Entries.Title: Modern Art
Entries.Description: Follows the journey of a pitiful yet charming robot through a monotonous cleaning shift, surrounded by looming abstract artworks. Over the course of the night, he discovers the ability of art to transport emotions to life, and in the process – his own creativity.

Entries.Title: Out With the Old
Entries.Description: Ray Myers is an ageing actor past his prime and unable to accept it. After meeting Tobias Irons, a young actor who idolises him, his jealousy and ego begin to poison him. Ray must overcome his pride and move on from his past.

Entries.Title: Tall Tree
Entries.Description: Best friends Leo and Karl face a dark legend while documenting their town's history for their final school project.

Entries.Title: peace frog
Entries.Description: A bloke gets kicked out of a band then he meets a magical talking frog that has mysterious powers. The bloke becomes a DJ and tries to save the world with the help of his brand new frog friend. They meet a throng of life changing people on their adventure through the trees.

Entries.Title: The Bigsby
Entries.Description: In the stillness of a midnight graveyard, a boy is drawn into a strange search for an egg. Shadows deepen, silence lingers, and the ordinary gives way to something quietly uneasy.

Entries.Title: The Planets And Wilbur (A Brief Lesson of the Cosmos)
Entries.Description: Join Wilbur as he takes you on a journey to each planet of the solar system, and a personal journey of his own.

Entries.Title: Sunday Dinna
Entries.Description: An Italian-American family in Queens, NY sits down for their weekly traditional “Sunday Dinna." Isabella announces to the family over multiple plates of moozadell and meatballs, that she's... a VEGAN.

Entries.Title: Janthu
Entries.Description: Tale of two creatures

Entries.Title: Ballake Sissoko & Piers Faccini @ Jazz à Porquerolles 2025
Entries.Description: On the Jazz à Porquerolles stage, Ballaké Sissoko's kora blends with the delicate folk of Piers Faccini. It's a subtle and spellbinding union, sealed by a four-handed album: Our Calling.

Entries.Title: Dumb, Dumber& Dumbest.
Entries.Description: Three quirky criminals discovered that one of them had betrayed the other two, leading to an unexpectedly quirky situation.

Entries.Title: Casting Day
Entries.Description: When everything feels strange in a waiting room, a nervous aspiring actress must find out why the other girls don't return.

Entries.Title: Permanent City
Entries.Description: A wannabe filmaker encounters a group of hippie vampires that will change his life.

Entries.Title: The Real Question
Entries.Description: Ben is a hard worker and and independent person, but when it comes to making a hard decision about whether he should visit his friend or not, the two different versions of himself clash.

Entries.Title: Last Dance at the Sundance Stompede
Entries.Description: In November 2023, over 800 people from all over the world gathered in San Francisco to attend the Sundance Stompede, an LGBTQ+ country-western dance weekend with four days of workshops and exhibition performances across three venues. After 27 years this year is the final Stompede. The film documents the weekend of dancing and the thoughts and reflections of 15 participants. As we journey into the weekend, a film about country-western dancing reveals deeper insights into the power of dance - not only to create community but to offer a profound healing of bodies and minds.

Entries.Title: Heir to the Rift: Part I
Entries.Description: Adjusting to college life, Sammy is visited by Morague, who has bad news, which Sammy is responsible for. They must team up and seek out something which may hold the key to rebuilding the stability of time. In this thrilling story of fate, grief, and adventure, The Choice Saga will never be the same...

Entries.Title: Knock Knock
Entries.Description: A once-famous actor now a devoted Buddhist, Uncle Paul believes he has left behind the troublesome 'KNOCK-KNOCK' noise from his upstairs neighbors in his old apartment — until it follows him to his new house.

Entries.Title: Artfully United
Entries.Description: Artfully United follows artist Mike Norice as he creates a series of inspirational murals in underserved neighborhoods in and around Los Angeles. The Artfully United Tour transforms from a simple idea on a wall to a community of artists and activists coming together to heal and uplift the city they call home. As the murals are unveiled, this gritty documentary explores the forces that shape the streets of L.A. and those that shape Mike as an artist, delving into his past to create a rich tapestry of family and faith, love and loss, music, hope, and life. Artfully United, the first feature-length documentary from Chris Walters Productions, is a celebration of the power of positivity and a reminder that hope can sometimes grow in the most unlikely of places.

Entries.Title: Dinner
Entries.Description: It's time to feed, sheep beware. Splattering love. Vampire bats must feed, sheep beware. The film also pays tribute Disney’s Skeleton Dance, animated by Ub Irweks.

Entries.Title: Earth to Michael
Entries.Description: Before an astronaut leaves Earth to usher in a new era of spaceflight, his son asks him to explore the unresolved space between them.  Michael last went to space when Nico was six. During his time in orbit, their family broke apart. Although Michael returned to Earth, he never came home. Now he’s headed back to space, 15 years later. Can Nico bridge the distance before he leaves?  Equal parts interstellar and intimate, this coming-of-age story confronts two men of different generations, asking us what sacrifices we’ll make for our loved ones to achieve their dreams.

Entries.Title: Drowning in Reflection
Entries.Description: Drowning in Reflection tells snippets of Lux's journey as they grapple with the loss of their grandparent. As memories from the past intertwine with the struggles of the present, Lux finds themself caught between sorrow and peace. As emotions surge, will Lux find strength in reflection—or be overwhelmed by it?

Entries.Title: The Great Cover Up
Entries.Description: This is the story of a single concert that grew into a community institution in Raleigh, North Carolina, inspiring ordinary people to become rock stars for 15 glorious minutes.  After 15+ years and 500+ cover bands, the annual Great Cover Up event is an unabashedly creative, silly, DIY cover band concert that celebrates individuality amongst an increasingly uniform world.

Entries.Title: My Neighbor's Yard
Entries.Description: Neighbors from Pennsylvania's divided capital region use signs, flags, and halloween skeletons to turn their yards into opposing campaign endorsements leading up to the presidential election.

Entries.Title: SNAKEPIT
Entries.Description: A film student attempts to make a documentary on a narcissistic yet severely unsuccessful underground cloud rapper, but is interrupted by an unexpected tragedy.

Entries.Title: The Debt Addiction
Entries.Description: Developed economies around the world are loaded up with debt. That was less of a problem in the era of free money but inflationary pressures are back and structurally-higher interest rates mean debt is more expensive to issue and service. This film examines what some are calling the biggest issue in global finance today, the role of the 'bond vigilantes', and whether government borrowing could spiral out of control.

Entries.Title: Slushynoobz Out of Character- The documentary
Entries.Description: Unseen but always present, the lens drifts through the rise of Slushy Noobz—capturing the chaos, the creation, and the quiet battles behind the scenes. Tension flickers in and out as management shifts, plans evolve, and the machine keeps moving. Moments of frustration dissolve into laughter, progress, and the relentless push forward. Then, as Slushmas looms, the focus sharpens—the work, the pressure, the culmination of everything before it.

Entries.Title: Jeguatá Xirê
Entries.Description: The sky is an archive of narratives. In every star or shadow, stories resonate, guiding dreams and struggles. We follow the trail of a cosmic serpent that dissolves boundaries and traces new paths. Amidst ancestral chants, bodies and thoughts shine like insurgent constellations.

Entries.Title: A Soft Touch
Entries.Description: A tenant in seniors’ housing is forced to make a heartbreaking decision after she lends money to someone who disappears, revealing the isolation and fragile security experienced by those living on the margins of society in Heather Young’s deeply affecting drama.

Entries.Title: In This Life Or The Next
Entries.Description: Made as part of the Picturehouse 48 Hour Challenge 2025

Entries.Title: Barry
Entries.Description: Meet Barry a humble slug who spends his days visiting her mother, enjoying a walk at the local pond, and savouring his favourite meal.

Entries.Title: Out of the Woods
Entries.Description: Max reconnects with Diana, an old friend, stirring long-forgotten emotions. Her fading memory complicates matters as she grapples with her deep love for Diana and her commitment to her husband, Charlie.

Entries.Title: P.A. (Pirates Anonymous)
Entries.Description: A group of retired pirates meet to discuss their good old days.

Entries.Title: La dernière fête des blacklistés
Entries.Description: A documentary that brings to light the previously unseen testimonies of screenwriters, actors, and musicians blacklisted in 1950s Hollywood, filmed during a reunion banquet in the 1980s. A collective tale of lives shattered by repression, now reconstructed and returned to memory.

Entries.Title: Viewer Discretion Advised
Entries.Description: An aspiring horror filmmaker debates the horror genre with their hookup until snuff artists derail the night.

Entries.Title: Day Of The Dyer
Entries.Description: Two teenagers find lost footage from a years old cold case -and unknowingly awaken old nightmares.

Entries.Title: Wafaa From Gaza
Entries.Description: We follow the journey of a girl who started singing out her window in Gaza out of despair, to a woman living in Germany, scared to sing out of fear of deportation.

Entries.Title: Pip and Posy: Sandpit Friends
Entries.Description: Pip and Posy play in the sandpit, make clay food, avoid imaginary crocodiles, watch falling stars and play with their friends.

Entries.Title: Endless Labor
Entries.Description: Cameras watch as two women perform in a large house.

Entries.Title: Momentum
Entries.Description: The birth, life and death of a boy named Adam.

Entries.Title: Attic Archaeology
Entries.Description: After accidentally blowing a hole in his ceiling, an early 20th-century scientist discovers the ruins of an ancient civilization in his loft.

Entries.Title: Play It Safe
Entries.Description: Two criminals (and childhood best friends), Moose and Harman, try their best to pull off a heist.

Entries.Title: THE PROMOTION
Entries.Description: A hapless salaryman navigates the corporate hierarchy of his surreal office space in pursuit of a raise and a promotion. THE Promotion.

Entries.Title: Topaz Window
Entries.Description: Through a plastic cup of iced coffee on the windowsill. Silent.

Entries.Title: Theodore M.E. Taylor's Bowtie Guy
Entries.Description: Follow comedian Theodore M.E. Taylor as he discusses cultural and political differences, the pressures of poverty and passing in affluent company, and code switching and shaping identity around social prejudices.

Entries.Title: AFI in 16mm
Entries.Description: A day at a movie theater

Entries.Title: My Lens, My Land
Entries.Description: Daze, a Tibetan nomad, transformed his life with a camera. Documenting traditions and threats to the homeland, his philosophical films become a call to action, a lifeline for plateau creatures.

Entries.Title: LifeLong LoveLetter
Entries.Description: Sean loses “the love of his life,” so in a desperate attempt to win her back, he writes a love letter explaining the pain he is going through and why he needs her.

Entries.Title: Suchmos LIVE SPECIAL “TOUR THE KIDS” @OSAKA
Entries.Description: Cameras from their regular TV show “Suchmostyle” closely followed the Osaka leg of Suchmos' tour “TOUR THE KIDS” from March to April.  All the shows, including additional ones, have been sold out.  Don't miss this rare live footage of the band, which is now being called “the hardest band to see live in Japan!

Entries.Title: No Mill No Meal
Entries.Description: The film describes a father who has been working outside the home for fourteen years. During this period, the father has only a handful of time to live with his family. In order to search for the emotional understanding of his father and his family, the director conducted long-term grounded research and used participatory documentary shooting techniques to explore the connection between the family and the social landscape. He also gradually peeled back his father's inner world from the three contents of work, life and reality, trying to find the answer that had been buried in his heart for fourteen years.

Entries.Title: First Serve
Entries.Description: Leah Valentino struggles with a brutal loss at the Cincinnati Open...

Entries.Title: Henchmen Chronicles
Entries.Description: A journalist in a world of superheroes documents what it’s like to be a henchman instead of a main character. Predictably, it sucks.

Entries.Title: Terror Keeps You Slender
Entries.Description: On the Harlem Streets, a seasoned hustler takes life advice from one of her marks, a green street photographer. When it goes wrong, she returns for revenge.

Entries.Title: Bye Bye Barbarito
Entries.Description: Romelia and Antonio have been married for fifty-seven years “Too long,” according to Romelia. When Antonio, an eighty-something-year-old grouch suddenly dies, Romelia’s not so ready to mourn him; in fact, she feels like celebrating. She turns the living room into a tropical paradise and gets ready to live her remaining years with her one true love: Barbarito, her cockatiel. Her neighbor Ida, the crotchety church lady next door, judges her not so quietly. When Barbarito escapes, Romelia sets out in search of her avian friend.

Entries.Title: Agua Dulce
Entries.Description: Under the glow of the moon and shimmering stars, a playful water droplet and her firefly friend play tag across an idyllic lily pond. They laugh and cast ripples across the quiet darkness of the pond until their play leads them to the farthest edge of the pond, where neither of them have dared to go before.

Entries.Title: Scout
Entries.Description: A girl on a totally not dangerous journey through the wilderness…

Entries.Title: The Lost Camp
Entries.Description: Three boys at a sleep-away summer camp discover an abandoned town that is home to a dark spirit with intent on vengeance.

Entries.Title: Pulse
Entries.Description: An overworked college student hallucinates her final project coming to life, blurring reality with imagination amidst academic stress

Entries.Title: PUT ME IN A MOVIE
Entries.Description: PUT ME IN A MOVIE

Entries.Title: who knows for how long
Entries.Description: The story of Ibrahim, a young man from gaza, told as a testimony of what the whole Palestinian people is going through.

Entries.Title: Director's cut
Entries.Description: During the shooting of incompetent director PUNK's new film, a group of young actresses find themselves the target of a mysterious masked assailant.

Entries.Title: Biophilia
Entries.Description: A boy awakens to find himself bonding with nature and engaging in simpler activities.

Entries.Title: The Night Within
Entries.Description: A social worker’s obsession with a case plunges him into a fight for survival against malevolent forces.

Entries.Title: A Mother’s Love
Entries.Description: A young girl deals with the consequences of trusting a man online.

Entries.Title: The equilibrium
Entries.Description: Three workers play poker in a farmhouse, but tensions over the possibility of a cheater among them will trigger tragic events.

Entries.Title: Humans of Pride
Entries.Description: Inspirational footage capturing this once in a generation moment in NYC, when WorldPride came to the United States for the very first time to commemorate the Stonewall Riots 50th anniversary. Rare footage from the 60s, 70s, 80s, 90s, and 2019 will help to answer questions such as, “Who in our community ultimately got left behind? Why did this happen? What are the lasting effects, and how do we resolve them?”

Entries.Title: Afterthought
Entries.Description: When a hitman kills an innocent in a moment of panic, he descends on a religious journey of regret he has not before felt. All the while, a vengeful policeman is hot on his trail, set on his own form of justice.

Entries.Title: Stoned for Christmas
Entries.Description: A multimedia whirlwind and a love letter to weed, Stoned for Christmas follows the adventures of one cannabis courier delivering at Christmas time.

Entries.Title: The Dave Daucus Show
Entries.Description: Dave Daucus and his co-host Carson Lingerton interview a special guest

Entries.Title: Beyond The Nest
Entries.Description: A new coaching staff takes the reins of the legendary Keene State College basketball program as it hunts for its fourth straight conference championship.

Entries.Title: 【VIRTUAL HEAVEN】¡My first CONCERT 3D!【Eru Nabura】#VirtualHeaven3D
Entries.Description: Would you like to touch the sky?  ⚙️🤍⚙️🤍⚙️🤍⚙️🤍⚙️🤍⚙️🤍  I've been preparing really hard for this, so I hope I can make you proud to support me!

Entries.Title: The Drama Club
Entries.Description: A high school health teacher gets more than he bargained for when he’s asked to direct the school musical.

Entries.Title: Church of Media
Entries.Description: In a society hypnotized by the glow of the screen, a teenage girl raised in a media-worshipping cult begins to question the system that consumed her family.

Entries.Title: witchstone
Entries.Description: Claire follows a mysterious Gracie on her hunt to find the witchstones through a magical forest, sparking a connection of understanding between them.

Entries.Title: A Lenda de Zamu
Entries.Description: A dreamy boy and a young inventor tell different versions of the story behind their city's founding—a tale that involves a sea monster. As they argue over which version is true, a storm begins to brew, and they soon find themselves with the chance to come face-to-face with the legend.

Entries.Title: Poker Night
Entries.Description: Four friends get together for their monthly poker night. What could go wrong?

Entries.Title: Bag of Burden
Entries.Description: When a hotheaded, unpredictable father coerces his reluctant, rough-around-the-edges son into a late-night trip to the woods to bury a mysterious bag, what starts as a tense and cryptic errand quickly unravels into a darkly comedic spiral of family dysfunction, long-buried secrets, and a series of increasingly absurd revelations--including the true nature of the bag's contents. As tempers flare and loyalties are tested, father and son find themselves teetering between crime, chaos, and an unspoken desire to understand each other--one twisted moment at a time.

Entries.Title: One, two, three..., four, five, six
Entries.Description: In a boarding school, Miao Miao experiences an unusual day.

Entries.Title: Chandan's American Dream(Marketed by Sai Anirudh)
Entries.Description: Chandan composes his biggest dream at the time in a cutsu way

Entries.Title: Graduation 3D Mini Live - Gawr Gura
Entries.Description: Graduation 3D Mini Live - Gawr Gura

Entries.Title: Fan Girl 2
Entries.Description: Demetria meets a man named Malcolm, who charms himself into her life. Once she gives him her heart, he turns her into a cold-hearted killer.

Entries.Title: The Christmas Cup
Entries.Description: After an injury, Staff Sergeant Kelly Brandt returns home for the holidays and her family pushes her to get involved in the annual Christmas Cup against the rival town; with that, she teams up with Fire Captain Quinn Stokley.

Entries.Title: Resist
Entries.Description: Caspian learns of manipulation in the milk his school provides and tries to uncover the secret behind it.

Entries.Title: Chasing Cambodia
Entries.Description: Johnny Phan grew up balancing his Cambodian heritage with American life. As a son of refugees, an elite cyclist and a new father, Johnny takes to his bike to navigate a journey of identity that takes him to the other side of the world. He learns what it means to fully embrace his heritage in a world that tells him he's neither fully American nor fully Cambodian.

Entries.Title: Ravioli Wine Night
Entries.Description: A film that looks into the world of the Staten Island legendary experience, Ravioli Wine Night.

Entries.Title: Neh Neh Pok
Entries.Description: A girl longs to hit puberty and get big boobs, only to end up growing tiny ones. Confronting the judgment of others and herself, she struggles to accept her chest size.

Entries.Title: Mare
Entries.Description: A man transforms into a distorted version of himself.

Entries.Title: RIGHT ON!
Entries.Description: An aspiring writer uses increasingly desperate and unconventional methods to overcome a crippling ailment - writer's block.
